```
103. static int uct_obmm_parse_memid(const char *name, uint64_t *memid_p)
104. {
105.     const size_t prefix_len = sizeof(UCT_OBMM_SHMDEV_PREFIX) - 1;
106.     char        *end;
107.     uint64_t     memid;
108. 
109.     if (strncmp(name, UCT_OBMM_SHMDEV_PREFIX, prefix_len) != 0) {
110.         return 0;
111.     }
112. 
113.     if (name[prefix_len] == '\0') {
114.         return 0;
115.     }
116. 
117.     memid = strtoull(name + prefix_len, &end, 10);
118.     if ((*end != '\0') || (end == name + prefix_len)) {
119.         return 0;
120.     }
121. 
122.     *memid_p = memid;
123.     return 1;
124. }
125. 
126. 
127. static ucs_status_t
128. uct_obmm_sysfs_load_one(uct_obmm_dev_info_t *info, const char *dirname,
129.                         uint64_t memid)
130. {
131.     char           sysfs_dir[UCT_OBMM_PATH_MAX];
132.     char           type_buf[16];
133.     long           allow_mmap;
134.     ucs_status_t   status;
135.     ssize_t        n;
136. 
137.     ucs_snprintf_safe(sysfs_dir, sizeof(sysfs_dir), "%s/%s",
138.                       UCT_OBMM_SYSFS_ROOT, dirname);
139. 
140.     /* type */
141.     n = ucs_read_file_str(type_buf, sizeof(type_buf), 1, "%s/type", sysfs_dir);
142.     if (n < 0) {
143.         ucs_debug("obmm: %s: missing 'type'", sysfs_dir);
144.         return UCS_ERR_NO_ELEM;
145.     }
146.     ucs_strtrim(type_buf);
147. 
148.     if (!strcmp(type_buf, "export")) {
149.         info->type = UCT_OBMM_DEV_EXPORT;
150.     } else if (!strcmp(type_buf, "import")) {
151.         info->type = UCT_OBMM_DEV_IMPORT;
152.     } else {
153.         ucs_debug("obmm: %s: unknown type '%s'", sysfs_dir, type_buf);
154.         return UCS_ERR_NO_ELEM;
155.     }
156. 
157.     /* size (hex) */
158.     status = uct_obmm_read_u64_hex(&info->size, 1, "%s/size", sysfs_dir);
159.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
160.         ucs_debug("obmm: %s: missing/unreadable 'size'", sysfs_dir);
161.         return status;
162.     }
163. 
164.     /* allow_mmap (decimal) */
165.     status = ucs_read_file_number(&allow_mmap, 1, "%s/allow_mmap", sysfs_dir);
166.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
167.         ucs_debug("obmm: %s: missing 'allow_mmap'", sysfs_dir);
168.         return status;
169.     }
170.     info->allow_mmap = (allow_mmap != 0);
171. 
172.     if (!info->allow_mmap) {
173.         ucs_debug("obmm: %s: allow_mmap=0, skipping", sysfs_dir);
174.         return UCS_ERR_NO_ELEM;
175.     }
176. 
177.     info->memid = memid;
178.     ucs_snprintf_safe(info->dev_path, sizeof(info->dev_path),
179.                       UCT_OBMM_DEV_PATH_FMT, memid);
180. 
181.     if (info->type == UCT_OBMM_DEV_IMPORT) {
182.         /* exporter identity comes directly from import_info/{dcna,deid} */
183.         status = uct_obmm_read_u64_hex(&info->exporter_dcna, 1,
184.                                        "%s/import_info/dcna", sysfs_dir);
185.         if (status != UCS_OK) {
186.             ucs_debug("obmm: %s: missing import_info/dcna", sysfs_dir);
187.             return status;
188.         }
189.         status = uct_obmm_read_eid(&info->exporter_deid, 1,
190.                                    "%s/import_info/deid", sysfs_dir);
191.         if (status != UCS_OK) {
192.             ucs_debug("obmm: %s: missing import_info/deid", sysfs_dir);
193.             return status;
194.         }
195.     } else {
196.         /* For exports, exporter_deid is in export_info/deid; exporter_dcna
197.          * is THIS host's clan network address and is filled by a second
198.          * pass once we have observed any import device's import_info/scna.
199.          * Leave it at 0 for now. */
200.         status = uct_obmm_read_eid(&info->exporter_deid, 1,
201.                                    "%s/export_info/deid", sysfs_dir);
202.         if (status != UCS_OK) {
203.             ucs_debug("obmm: %s: missing export_info/deid", sysfs_dir);
204.             return status;
205.         }
206.         info->exporter_dcna = 0;
207.     }
208. 
209.     return UCS_OK;
210. }

213. static ucs_status_t uct_obmm_sysfs_grow(uct_obmm_sysfs_ctx_t *ctx)
214. {
215.     uct_obmm_dev_info_t *new_arr;
216.     unsigned             new_cap;
217. 
218.     if (ctx->count < ctx->capacity) {
219.         return UCS_OK;
220.     }
221. 
222.     new_cap = (ctx->capacity == 0) ? 8 : (ctx->capacity * 2);
223.     new_arr = ucs_realloc(ctx->devices, new_cap * sizeof(*new_arr),
224.                           "uct_obmm_dev_info");
225.     if (new_arr == NULL) {
226.         return UCS_ERR_NO_MEMORY;
227.     }
228. 
229.     ctx->devices  = new_arr;
230.     ctx->capacity = new_cap;
231.     return UCS_OK;
232. }
233.

235. static ucs_status_t uct_obmm_sysfs_readdir_cb(const struct dirent *entry,
236.                                               void *arg)
237. {
238.     uct_obmm_sysfs_ctx_t *ctx = (uct_obmm_sysfs_ctx_t*)arg;
239.     uct_obmm_dev_info_t  *info;
240.     ucs_status_t          status;
241.     uint64_t              memid;
242. 
243.     if (!uct_obmm_parse_memid(entry->d_name, &memid)) {
244.         return UCS_OK; /* not a shmdev entry */
245.     }
246. 
247.     status = uct_obmm_sysfs_grow(ctx);
248.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
249.         return status;
250.     }
251. 
252.     info   = &ctx->devices[ctx->count];
253.     memset(info, 0, sizeof(*info));
254. 
255.     status = uct_obmm_sysfs_load_one(info, entry->d_name, memid);
256.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
257.         /* skip silently; load_one already logged at debug */
258.         return UCS_OK;
259.     }
260. 
261.     ctx->count++;
262.     return UCS_OK;
263. }
264. 
265. 
266. /* After the first pass we may know our own clan network address (scna) from
267.  * any import device. Patch it into export entries' exporter_dcna so they
268.  * become uniquely identifiable across the cluster. */
269. static void uct_obmm_sysfs_patch_self_dcna(uct_obmm_sysfs_ctx_t *ctx)
270. {
271.     uint64_t      self_dcna = 0;
272.     int           have_self = 0;
273.     ucs_status_t  status;
274.     char          sysfs_dir[UCT_OBMM_PATH_MAX];
275.     unsigned      i;
276. 
277.     for (i = 0; i < ctx->count; ++i) {
278.         if (ctx->devices[i].type != UCT_OBMM_DEV_IMPORT) {
279.             continue;
280.         }
281.         ucs_snprintf_safe(sysfs_dir, sizeof(sysfs_dir), "%s/%s%" PRIu64,
282.                           UCT_OBMM_SYSFS_ROOT, UCT_OBMM_SHMDEV_PREFIX,
283.                           ctx->devices[i].memid);
284.         status = uct_obmm_read_u64_hex(&self_dcna, 1, "%s/import_info/scna",
285.                                        sysfs_dir);
286.         if (status == UCS_OK) {
287.             have_self = 1;
288.             break;
289.         }
290.     }
291. 
292.     if (!have_self) {
293.         ucs_debug("obmm: no import device available to derive self dcna; "
294.                   "export entries will keep exporter_dcna=0");
295.         return;
296.     }
297. 
298.     for (i = 0; i < ctx->count; ++i) {
299.         if (ctx->devices[i].type == UCT_OBMM_DEV_EXPORT) {
300.             ctx->devices[i].exporter_dcna = self_dcna;
301.         }
302.     }
303. }
304. 
305. 
306. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_sysfs_discover(uct_obmm_dev_info_t **devices_p,
307.                                      unsigned *num_devices_p)
308. {
309.     uct_obmm_sysfs_ctx_t ctx = { NULL, 0, 0 };
310.     ucs_status_t         status;
311. 
312.     status = ucs_sys_readdir(UCT_OBMM_SYSFS_ROOT, uct_obmm_sysfs_readdir_cb,
313.                              &ctx);
314.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
315.         ucs_debug("obmm: failed to scan %s: %s", UCT_OBMM_SYSFS_ROOT,
316.                   ucs_status_string(status));
317.         ucs_free(ctx.devices);
```

```
91.                                    UCT_IFACE_FLAG_AM_BCOPY         |

99.     attr->max_conn_priv          = 0;

101.     /* UCT contract: max_short is total bytes the caller may pass as
102.      * (header + payload), i.e. NOT counting the elem header. */
103.     attr->cap.am.max_short       = iface->fifo_elem_size - elem_hdr;

106.     attr->cap.am.max_zcopy       = 0;

110.     attr->cap.put.max_bcopy      = 0;
111.     attr->cap.put.min_zcopy      = 0;
112.     attr->cap.put.max_zcopy      = 0;
113.     attr->cap.put.max_iov        = 0;

117.     attr->cap.get.max_zcopy      = 0;
118.     attr->cap.get.max_iov        = 0;

121.     attr->bandwidth.dedicated    = iface->config.bandwidth;
122.     attr->bandwidth.shared       = 0;

159. static int
160. uct_obmm_iface_is_reachable_v2(const uct_iface_h tl_iface,
161.                                const uct_iface_is_reachable_params_t *params)
162. {
163.     uct_obmm_iface_t             *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_iface,
164.                                                          uct_obmm_iface_t);
165.     uct_obmm_md_t                *md    = ucs_derived_of(iface->super.md,
166.                                                          uct_obmm_md_t);
167.     const uct_obmm_device_addr_t *daddr;
168.     const uct_obmm_iface_addr_t  *iaddr;
169.     uct_obmm_eid_t                eid;
170.     uct_obmm_region_t            *export_r;
171. 
172.     if (!uct_iface_is_reachable_params_addrs_valid(params)) {
173.         return 0;
174.     }
175. 
176.     daddr = (const uct_obmm_device_addr_t*)params->device_addr;
177.     iaddr = (const uct_obmm_iface_addr_t*)params->iface_addr;
178.     if ((daddr == NULL) || (iaddr == NULL)) {
179.         uct_iface_fill_info_str_buf(params, "missing device or iface address");
180.         return 0;
181.     }
182. 
183.     if ((iaddr->fifo_size != iface->fifo_size) ||
184.         (iaddr->fifo_elem_size != iface->fifo_elem_size) ||
185.         (iaddr->bcopy_seg_size != iface->bcopy_seg_size)) {
186.         uct_iface_fill_info_str_buf(params,
187.                                     "incompatible OBMM geometry "
188.                                     "(peer fifo=%u elem=%u seg=%u, "
189.                                     "local fifo=%u elem=%u seg=%u)",
190.                                     iaddr->fifo_size, iaddr->fifo_elem_size,
191.                                     iaddr->bcopy_seg_size,
192.                                     iface->fifo_size, iface->fifo_elem_size,
193.                                     iface->bcopy_seg_size);
194.         return 0;
195.     }
196. 
197.     eid.hi = daddr->exporter_deid_hi;
198.     eid.lo = daddr->exporter_deid_lo;
199. 
200.     export_r = uct_obmm_md_export_region(md);
201.     if ((export_r != NULL) &&
202.         (export_r->info.exporter_dcna == daddr->exporter_dcna) &&
203.         (export_r->info.exporter_deid.hi == eid.hi) &&
204.         (export_r->info.exporter_deid.lo == eid.lo)) {
205.         return uct_iface_scope_is_reachable(tl_iface, params);
206.     }
207. 
208.     if (uct_obmm_md_find_import_region(md, daddr->exporter_dcna, &eid) != NULL) {
209.         return uct_iface_scope_is_reachable(tl_iface, params);
210.     }
211. 
212.     uct_iface_fill_info_str_buf(params,
213.                                 "no mapped region for peer dcna=0x%lx "
214.                                 "deid=0x%lx:0x%lx",
215.                                 (unsigned long)daddr->exporter_dcna,
216.                                 (unsigned long)eid.hi, (unsigned long)eid.lo);
217.     return 0;
218. }

221. static unsigned uct_obmm_iface_progress(uct_iface_h tl_iface)
222. {
223.     uct_obmm_iface_t        *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_iface, uct_obmm_iface_t);
224.     unsigned                 polled = 0;
225.     uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem;
226.     uint8_t                  flags;
227.     uint8_t                  expected_owner;
228.     size_t                   max_poll = iface->fifo_max_poll;
229. 
230.     while (polled < max_poll) {
231.         elem = uct_obmm_slot_elem(iface->recv_elems, iface->read_index,
232.                                   iface->fifo_mask, iface->fifo_elem_size);
233. 
234.         /* Owner bit alternates each lap of the ring; pass 0 expects 1, pass
235.          * 1 expects 0, etc. Combined with zero-fill on slot allocation, this
236.          * means an unwritten slot reads as flags==0 and is correctly skipped
237.          * on the very first lap. */
238.         expected_owner = ((iface->read_index / iface->fifo_size) & 1u) ?
239.                          0u : UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER;
240. 
241.         flags = elem->flags;
242.         if ((flags & UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER) != expected_owner) {
243.             break;
244.         }
245. 
246.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
247. 
248.         if (elem->generation != iface->generation) {
249.             /* Stale write from a previous slot owner (we were torn down and
250.              * re-allocated this slot). Drop silently. */
251.             ucs_trace_data("obmm: drop stale elem (gen=%u expected=%u) "
252.                            "at idx=%lu", elem->generation, iface->generation,
253.                            (unsigned long)iface->read_index);
254.         } else if (flags & UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_BCOPY) {
255.             /* am_bcopy: payload is in the paired desc[N], not in the FIFO
256.              * element body. The bus_load_fence above orders this load
257.              * with respect to the sender's bus_store_fence + flag write. */
258.             void *desc = uct_obmm_slot_desc(iface->recv_descs,
259.                                             iface->read_index,
260.                                             iface->fifo_mask,
```

```
760. int ucs_config_sscanf_range_spec(const char *buf, void *dest, const void *arg)
761. {
762.     ucs_range_spec_t *range_spec = dest;
763.     unsigned first, last;
764.     char *p, *str;
765.     int ret = 1;
766. 
767.     str = ucs_strdup(buf, "config_range_spec_str");
768.     if (str == NULL) {
769.         return 0;
770.     }
771. 
772.     /* Check if got a range or a single number */
773.     p = strchr(str, '-');
774.     if (p == NULL) {
775.         /* got only one value (not a range) */
776.         if (1 != sscanf(buf, "%u", &first)) {
777.             ret = 0;
778.             goto out;
779.         }
780.         last = first;
781.     } else {
782.         /* got a range of numbers */
783.         *p = 0;      /* split str */
784. 
785.         if ((1 != sscanf(str, "%u", &first))
786.             || (1 != sscanf(p + 1, "%u", &last))) {
787.             ret = 0;
788.             goto out;
789.         }
790.     }
791. 
792.     range_spec->first = first;
793.     range_spec->last = last;
794. 
795. out:
796.     ucs_free(str);
797.     return ret;
798. }
799. 
800. int ucs_config_sprintf_range_spec(char *buf, size_t max,
801.                                   const void *src, const void *arg)
802. {

804. 
805.     if (range_spec->first == range_spec->last) {
806.         snprintf(buf, max, "%d", range_spec->first);
807.     } else {
808.         snprintf(buf, max, "%d-%d", range_spec->first, range_spec->last);
809.     }
810. 
811.     return 1;
812. }

837.     }
838.

841.     temp_field = ucs_calloc(UCS_CONFIG_ARRAY_MAX, array->elem_size, "config array");
842.     i = 0;
843.     while (token != NULL) {
```

```
149. int uct_obmm_ep_is_connected(const uct_ep_h tl_ep,
150.                              const uct_ep_is_connected_params_t *params)
151. {
152.     const uct_obmm_ep_t          *ep = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep, uct_obmm_ep_t);
153.     const uct_obmm_device_addr_t *daddr;
154.     const uct_obmm_iface_addr_t  *iaddr;
155. 
156.     if (!uct_base_ep_is_connected(tl_ep, params)) {
157.         return 0;
158.     }
159. 
160.     daddr = (const uct_obmm_device_addr_t*)params->device_addr;
161.     iaddr = (const uct_obmm_iface_addr_t*)params->iface_addr;
162.     if ((daddr == NULL) || (iaddr == NULL)) {
163.         return 0;
164.     }
165. 
166.     return (daddr->exporter_dcna == ep->peer_dcna) &&
167.            (daddr->exporter_deid_hi == ep->peer_deid_hi) &&
168.            (daddr->exporter_deid_lo == ep->peer_deid_lo) &&
169.            (iaddr->slot_index == ep->peer_slot_index) &&
170.            (iaddr->generation == ep->expected_generation);
171. }

174. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_ep_am_short(uct_ep_h tl_ep, uint8_t id, uint64_t header,
175.                                   const void *payload, unsigned length)
176. {
177.     uct_obmm_ep_t           *ep    = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep, uct_obmm_ep_t);
178.     uct_obmm_iface_t        *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep->iface,
179.                                                     uct_obmm_iface_t);
180.     size_t                   payload_total = sizeof(header) + length;
181.     uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem;
182.     uint64_t                 head;
183.     uint8_t                  owner_bit;
184. 
185.     UCT_CHECK_AM_ID(id);
186.     UCT_CHECK_LENGTH(payload_total, 0,
187.                      ep->fifo_elem_size - sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_element_t),
188.                      "am_short");
189. 
190.     /* Reserve a slot in the peer's FIFO via load + CAS. FAA cannot be used:
191.      * if FAA succeeds but the FIFO turns out to be full, the bumped head
192.      * value can never be rolled back across hosts, leaving a permanent gap
193.      * the receiver will block on (its progress loop walks slots in order
194.      * and stops at any slot whose owner bit hasn't flipped). CAS lets us
195.      * decide capacity *before* committing the head bump.
196.      *
197.      * Multiple senders (across processes / hosts) compete on the same head
198.      * cell, so we retry on CAS miss. */
199.     for (;;) {
200.         head = ep->peer_ctl->head;
201. 
202.         if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
203.             ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
204.             ep->cached_tail = ep->peer_ctl->tail;
205.             if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
206.                 UCS_STATS_UPDATE_COUNTER(ep->super.stats, UCT_EP_STAT_NO_RES,
207.                                          1);
208.                 return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
209.             }
210.         }
211. 
212.         if (ucs_atomic_bool_cswap64(&ep->peer_ctl->head, head, head + 1)) {
213.             break;
214.         }
215.         /* Lost the race; another sender claimed this slot. Retry. */
216.     }
217. 
218.     elem = uct_obmm_slot_elem(ep->peer_elems, head, ep->fifo_mask,
219.                               ep->fifo_elem_size);
220.
```

### 💬 Copilot

**High**
- `self_dcna` is the main logic hole. Today exports get `exporter_dcna` only from a discovered import’s `import_info/scna`; if filtered discovery finds only export memids, exports keep `dcna=0`, and peer matching/reachability/`ep_create` break. Recommend either probing `scna` independently of the allow-list, or failing `md_open` when filtered exports cannot be patched. (`obmm_sysfs.c:266-303`, `obmm_iface.c:136-217`, `obmm_ep.c:61-89`)

- Strict mode must cover **mapping**, not just sysfs load. `uct_obmm_md_map_devices()` still warns-and-skips `region_open()` failures. In filtered mode, any requested memid that later fails open/mmap/size checks should abort `md_open`. Also fail early if the final set has no local export; otherwise iface creation fails later. (`obmm_md.c:68-117`, `obmm_region.c:23-54`, `obmm_iface.c:364-368`)

**Medium**
- `UCS_CONFIG_TYPE_STRING_ARRAY` is a bad fit for strict syntax. UCX array parsing uses `strtok_r(",", ...)`: empty tokens are collapsed, and whitespace is not trimmed. So `1,,2` / `1,` won’t be rejected reliably. Prefer a raw `UCS_CONFIG_TYPE_STRING` and custom parse in `md_open`; reject duplicates, `0` (`OBMM_INVALID_MEMID`), overflow, trailing junk, and empty/whitespace-only tokens there. (`ucs/config/parser.c:90-94,825-860`)

- Split failures by stage: parse stage for syntax/duplicates/zero; discover/map stage for missing memid, missing attrs, `allow_mmap=0`, and mmap/open unusable.

**Low**
- In explicit mode, silently “use first export” is surprising. Since the transport has a single `export_idx`, reject multiple selected export devices instead of warning-and-ignoring. (`obmm_md.c:95-103`)  

- No extra iface/reachability changes are needed **for this knob alone** if MD discovery preserves current region identity invariants.

```
38. static ucs_status_t uct_obmm_md_query(uct_md_h md, uct_md_attr_v2_t *attr)
39. {
40.     (void)md;
41.     uct_md_base_md_query(attr);
42.     /* obmm only does AM (short + bcopy). It does NOT expose remote memory
43.      * as a directly-dereferenceable pointer to its own peers: only the
44.      * pre-exported FIFO region is mmap'd, NOT the user's send/recv
45.      * buffers. So we MUST NOT advertise UCT_MD_FLAG_NEED_RKEY (which
46.      * implies remote-key-based access) -- doing so makes UCP pick
47.      * rendezvous-via-rkey_ptr for messages above the rndv threshold
48.      * (~256 KiB) and try to memcpy from a peer-VA pointer, segfaulting
49.      * inside ucs_memcpy_relaxed. */
50.     attr->flags                  = 0;
51.     attr->reg_mem_types          = 0;
52.     attr->reg_nonblock_mem_types = 0;
53.     attr->cache_mem_types        = 0;
54.     attr->access_mem_types       = UCS_BIT(UCS_MEMORY_TYPE_HOST);
55.     return UCS_OK;
56. }

181. static ucs_status_t uct_obmm_md_map_devices(uct_obmm_md_t *md,
182.                                             const uct_obmm_dev_info_t *devs,
183.                                             unsigned num_devs, int strict)
184. {
185.     uct_obmm_region_t *regions;
186.     ucs_status_t       status;
187.     unsigned           i, mapped, j;
188.     int                export_idx = -1;
189. 
190.     regions = ucs_calloc(num_devs, sizeof(*regions), "uct_obmm_regions");
191.     if (regions == NULL) {
192.         return UCS_ERR_NO_MEMORY;
193.     }
194. 
195.     for (i = 0; i < num_devs; ++i) {
196.         regions[i].fd = -1;
197.     }
198. 
199.     mapped = 0;
200.     for (i = 0; i < num_devs; ++i) {
201.         status = uct_obmm_region_open(&devs[i], &regions[mapped]);
202.         if (status != UCS_OK) {
203.             if (strict) {
204.                 ucs_error("obmm: OBMM_MEMIDS requested memid=%" PRIu64
205.                           " but mapping %s failed: %s",
206.                           devs[i].memid, devs[i].dev_path,
207.                           ucs_status_string(status));
208.                 goto err_unmap;
209.             }
210.             ucs_warn("obmm: skipping device %s: %s",
211.                      devs[i].dev_path, ucs_status_string(status));
212.             continue;
213.         }
214. 
215.         if ((regions[mapped].info.type == UCT_OBMM_DEV_EXPORT) &&
216.             (export_idx < 0)) {
217.             export_idx = (int)mapped;
218.         } else if (regions[mapped].info.type == UCT_OBMM_DEV_EXPORT) {
219.             if (strict) {
220.                 ucs_error("obmm: OBMM_MEMIDS selected multiple export regions "
221.                           "(memid=%" PRIu64 ", memid=%" PRIu64 "); obmm "
222.                           "requires exactly one local export",
223.                           regions[export_idx].info.memid,
224.                           regions[mapped].info.memid);
225.                 uct_obmm_region_close(&regions[mapped]);
226.                 status = UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
227.                 goto err_unmap;
228.             }
229.             ucs_warn("obmm: multiple export regions found; using first "
230.                      "(memid=%" PRIu64 "), ignoring memid=%" PRIu64,
231.                      regions[export_idx].info.memid,
232.                      regions[mapped].info.memid);
233.         }
234. 
235.         ++mapped;
236.     }
237. 
238.     if (mapped == 0) {
239.         ucs_free(regions);
240.         return UCS_ERR_NO_DEVICE;
241.     }
242. 
243.     if (strict && (export_idx < 0)) {
244.         ucs_error("obmm: OBMM_MEMIDS selected no local export region");
245.         status = UCS_ERR_NO_DEVICE;
246.         goto err_unmap;
247.     }
248. 
249.     md->regions     = regions;
250.     md->num_regions = mapped;
251.     md->export_idx  = export_idx;
252.     return UCS_OK;
253. 
254. err_unmap:
255.     for (j = 0; j < mapped; ++j) {
256.         uct_obmm_region_close(&regions[j]);
257.     }
258.     ucs_free(regions);
259.     return status;
260. }
```

```
213. static ucs_status_t uct_obmm_sysfs_grow(uct_obmm_sysfs_ctx_t *ctx)
214. {
215.     uct_obmm_dev_info_t *new_arr;
216.     unsigned             new_cap;
217. 
218.     if (ctx->count < ctx->capacity) {
219.         return UCS_OK;
220.     }
221. 
222.     new_cap = (ctx->capacity == 0) ? 8 : (ctx->capacity * 2);
223.     new_arr = ucs_realloc(ctx->devices, new_cap * sizeof(*new_arr),
224.                           "uct_obmm_dev_info");
225.     if (new_arr == NULL) {
226.         return UCS_ERR_NO_MEMORY;
227.     }
228. 
229.     ctx->devices  = new_arr;
230.     ctx->capacity = new_cap;
231.     return UCS_OK;
232. }

283. /* After the first pass we may know our own clan network address (scna) from
284.  * any import device. Patch it into export entries' exporter_dcna so they
285.  * become uniquely identifiable across the cluster. */
286. static ucs_status_t uct_obmm_sysfs_patch_self_dcna(uct_obmm_sysfs_ctx_t *ctx,
287.                                                    int strict)
288. {
289.     uint64_t      self_dcna = 0;
290.     int           have_self = 0;
291.     int           have_export = 0;
292.     ucs_status_t  status;
293.     char          sysfs_dir[UCT_OBMM_PATH_MAX];
294.     unsigned      i;
295. 
296.     for (i = 0; i < ctx->count; ++i) {
297.         if (ctx->devices[i].type == UCT_OBMM_DEV_EXPORT) {
298.             have_export = 1;
299.         }
300.         if (ctx->devices[i].type != UCT_OBMM_DEV_IMPORT) {
301.             continue;
302.         }
303.         ucs_snprintf_safe(sysfs_dir, sizeof(sysfs_dir), "%s/%s%" PRIu64,
304.                           UCT_OBMM_SYSFS_ROOT, UCT_OBMM_SHMDEV_PREFIX,
305.                           ctx->devices[i].memid);
306.         status = uct_obmm_read_u64_hex(&self_dcna, 1, "%s/import_info/scna",
307.                                        sysfs_dir);
308.         if (status == UCS_OK) {
309.             have_self = 1;
310.             break;
311.         }
312.     }
313. 
314.     if (!have_self) {
315.         if (strict && have_export) {
316.             ucs_error("obmm: OBMM_MEMIDS selected an export region but no "
317.                       "selected import region is available to derive self "
318.                       "dcna");
319.             return UCS_ERR_NO_DEVICE;
320.         }
321.         ucs_debug("obmm: no import device available to derive self dcna; "
322.                   "export entries will keep exporter_dcna=0");
323.         return UCS_OK;
324.     }
325. 
326.     for (i = 0; i < ctx->count; ++i) {
327.         if (ctx->devices[i].type == UCT_OBMM_DEV_EXPORT) {
328.             ctx->devices[i].exporter_dcna = self_dcna;
329.         }
330.     }
331.     return UCS_OK;
332. }

376.                       ucs_status_string(status));
```

```
335. uct_obmm_md_find_import_region(uct_obmm_md_t *md, uint64_t exporter_dcna,

337. {

344.             continue;

348.             (r->info.exporter_deid.lo == exporter_deid->lo)) {
349.             return r;
350.         }
351.     }
352.     return NULL;
353. }
```

```
310.         }
```

```diff
+static ucs_status_t
+uct_obmm_md_parse_memids(const char *memids_str, uint64_t **memids_p,
+                         unsigned *num_memids_p)
+{
+    uint64_t     *memids      = NULL;
+    char         *cursor;
+    char         *next;
+    char         *copy        = NULL;
+    char         *end;
+    ucs_status_t  status      = UCS_OK;
+    unsigned      count       = 0;
+    unsigned      capacity    = 1;
+    unsigned      i;
+    uint64_t      memid;
+
+    *memids_p     = NULL;
+    *num_memids_p = 0;
+
+    if (memids_str == NULL) {
+        return UCS_OK;
+    }
+
+    copy = ucs_strdup(memids_str, "obmm_memids");
+    if (copy == NULL) {
+        return UCS_ERR_NO_MEMORY;
+    }
+
+    ucs_strtrim(copy);
+    if (copy[0] == '\0') {
+        goto out;
+    }
+
+    for (cursor = copy; *cursor != '\0'; ++cursor) {
+        if (*cursor == ',') {
+            ++capacity;
+        }
+    }
+
+    memids = ucs_calloc(capacity, sizeof(*memids), "obmm_memid_list");
+    if (memids == NULL) {
+        status = UCS_ERR_NO_MEMORY;
+        goto err;
+    }
+
+    cursor = copy;
+    while (cursor != NULL) {
+        errno = 0;
+        next  = strchr(cursor, ',');
+        if (next != NULL) {
+            *next = '\0';
+            ++next;
+        }
+
+        ucs_strtrim(cursor);
+        if (cursor[0] == '\0') {
+            ucs_error("obmm: OBMM_MEMIDS contains an empty entry: '%s'",
+                      memids_str);
+            status = UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
+            goto err;
+        }
+
+        memid = strtoull(cursor, &end, 10);
+        if ((errno == ERANGE) || (*end != '\0')) {
+            ucs_error("obmm: invalid OBMM_MEMIDS entry '%s' in '%s'; "
+                      "expected decimal memid list like '1,2'",
+                      cursor, memids_str);
+            status = UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
+            goto err;
+        }
+
+        if (memid == 0) {
+            ucs_error("obmm: OBMM_MEMIDS cannot contain memid 0");
+            status = UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
+            goto err;
+        }
+
+        for (i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
+            if (memids[i] == memid) {
+                ucs_error("obmm: duplicate memid %" PRIu64
+                          " in OBMM_MEMIDS='%s'",
+                          memid, memids_str);
+                status = UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
+                goto err;
+            }
+        }
+
+        memids[count++] = memid;
+        cursor          = next;
+    }
+
+out:
+    ucs_free(copy);
+    *memids_p     = memids;
+    *num_memids_p = count;
+    return UCS_OK;
+
+err:
+    ucs_free(memids);
+    ucs_free(copy);
+    return status;
+}
```

```
38. static ucs_status_t uct_obmm_md_query(uct_md_h md, uct_md_attr_v2_t *attr)
39. {
40.     (void)md;
41.     uct_md_base_md_query(attr);
42.     /* obmm only does AM (short + bcopy). It does NOT expose remote memory
43.      * as a directly-dereferenceable pointer to its own peers: only the
44.      * pre-exported FIFO region is mmap'd, NOT the user's send/recv
45.      * buffers. So we MUST NOT advertise UCT_MD_FLAG_NEED_RKEY (which
46.      * implies remote-key-based access) -- doing so makes UCP pick
47.      * rendezvous-via-rkey_ptr for messages above the rndv threshold
48.      * (~256 KiB) and try to memcpy from a peer-VA pointer, segfaulting
49.      * inside ucs_memcpy_relaxed. */
50.     attr->flags                  = 0;
51.     attr->reg_mem_types          = 0;
52.     attr->reg_nonblock_mem_types = 0;
53.     attr->cache_mem_types        = 0;
54.     attr->access_mem_types       = UCS_BIT(UCS_MEMORY_TYPE_HOST);
55.     return UCS_OK;
56. }
```

```
23. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_region_open(const uct_obmm_dev_info_t *info,
24.                                   uct_obmm_region_t *region)
25. {
26.     ucs_status_t status;
27.     void        *map;
28.     int          fd;
29. 
30.     if (!info->allow_mmap) {
31.         ucs_error("obmm: device %s does not support mmap", info->dev_path);
32.         return UCS_ERR_UNSUPPORTED;
33.     }
34. 
35.     if (info->size == 0) {
36.         ucs_error("obmm: device %s reports zero size", info->dev_path);
37.         return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
38.     }
39. 
40.     /* O_SYNC selects the non-cacheable mapping, which is required for
41.      * cross-host shared FIFO use without obmm_set_ownership() flips. */
42.     fd = open(info->dev_path, O_RDWR | O_SYNC | O_CLOEXEC);
43.     if (fd < 0) {
44.         ucs_error("obmm: open(%s) failed: %m", info->dev_path);
45.         return UCS_ERR_IO_ERROR;
46.     }
47. 
48.     map = mmap(NULL, info->size, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED, fd, 0);
49.     if (map == MAP_FAILED) {
50.         ucs_error("obmm: mmap(%s, size=0x%" PRIx64 ") failed: %m",
51.                   info->dev_path, info->size);
52.         status = UCS_ERR_IO_ERROR;
53.         goto err_close;
54.     }
55. 
56.     region->info   = *info;
57.     region->fd     = fd;
58.     region->base   = map;
59.     region->length = info->size;
60.
```

### 💬 Copilot

## Issue: Resource leak in non-strict duplicate export handling
**File:** C:\Users\zl\Desktop\ucx_obmm_br\ucx\src\uct\obmm\base\obmm_md.c:218-235
**Severity:** Medium
**Problem:** In non-strict mode (when `OBMM_MEMIDS` is not set), encountering a second export region causes a resource leak. At line 218-232, when a duplicate export is found in non-strict mode, the code logs a warning but does NOT close the region or skip adding it to the array. Line 235 increments `mapped` unconditionally, including this unused region in `md-\>regions`. The duplicate export is successfully mapped into memory but never referenced (since `export_idx` points to the first export only) and wastes resources until `md_close` unmaps everything.

**Evidence:** Tracing the code path:
1. Line 201: `uct_obmm_region_open(&devs[i], &regions[mapped])` succeeds, mapping the duplicate export into memory
2. Line 218: Second export detected (export_idx \>= 0)
3. Lines 219-228: Strict block skipped when `strict=0` (non-strict mode)
4. Lines 229-232: Warning logged
5. Line 235: `++mapped` executes, adding the unused region to the array

In strict mode (lines 219-227), the code correctly calls `uct_obmm_region_close(&regions[mapped])` at line 225 before erroring out. The non-strict path lacks this cleanup.

**Suggested fix:** Add `uct_obmm_region_close(&regions[mapped]);` and `continue;` after the warning in the non-strict else-if branch (after line 232), similar to the strict-mode cleanup at line 225. This will unmap the duplicate export and skip incrementing `mapped`.

<sub>⏱️ 22m 22s</sub>

### 💬 Copilot

**已加上。**现在可以用 `UCX_OBMM_MEMIDS=1,2` 只让 obmm 处理指定的 shmdev memid；**不配这个参数时，行为保持原样**，仍然扫描全部可用 shmdev。

这次改动放在 obmm **MD discovery** 层：
- `obmm_md.*` 增加了 `MEMIDS` 配置项，并做了严格的 CSV 解析
- `obmm_sysfs.*` 支持**定向发现**指定 memid，不再必须全量扫描
- 显式配置时按你选的**严格模式**处理：任一 memid 不存在、不可 mmap、属性不完整、mmap/open 失败，或最终选出的集合不满足 obmm 需要的拓扑（比如没有本地 export、选出多个 export、只有 export 没有 import 以致无法补齐 `self_dcna`），都会直接让 `md_open` 失败
- `ucx\src\uct\obmm\DESIGN.md` 也补了这个配置说明

可直接这样用：

```bash
-x UCX_OBMM_MEMIDS=1,2
```

**当前还没在本机补跑 UCX build / `ucx_info`。** 这个 Windows 环境没有可用的 `bash` / `make` / `gcc`，所以只能把代码改完并做静态收口；后续需要在 Linux 构建机上看一下 `ucx_info -c` 里是否已暴露 `OBMM_MEMIDS`。

210.             ucs_warn("obmm: skipping device %s: %s",
211.                      devs[i].dev_path, ucs_status_string(status));
212.             continue;
213.         }
214. 
215.         if ((regions[mapped].info.type == UCT_OBMM_DEV_EXPORT) &&
216.             (export_idx < 0)) {
217.             export_idx = (int)mapped;
218.         } else if (regions[mapped].info.type == UCT_OBMM_DEV_EXPORT) {
219.             if (strict) {
220.                 ucs_error("obmm: OBMM_MEMIDS selected multiple export regions "
221.                           "(memid=%" PRIu64 ", memid=%" PRIu64 "); obmm "
222.                           "requires exactly one local export",
223.                           regions[export_idx].info.memid,
224.                           regions[mapped].info.memid);
225.                 uct_obmm_region_close(&regions[mapped]);
226.                 status = UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
227.                 goto err_unmap;
228.             }
229.             ucs_warn("obmm: multiple export regions found; using first "
230.                      "(memid=%" PRIu64 "), ignoring memid=%" PRIu64,
231.                      regions[export_idx].info.memid,
232.                      regions[mapped].info.memid);
233.             uct_obmm_region_close(&regions[mapped]);
234.             continue;
235.         }
236. 
237.         ++mapped;
238.     }
239. 
240.     if (mapped == 0) {
241.         ucs_free(regions);
242.         return UCS_ERR_NO_DEVICE;
243.     }
244. 
245.     if (strict && (export_idx < 0)) {
246.         ucs_error("obmm: OBMM_MEMIDS selected no local export region");
247.         status = UCS_ERR_NO_DEVICE;
248.         goto err_unmap;
249.     }
250. 
251.     md->regions     = regions;
252.     md->num_regions = mapped;
253.     md->export_idx  = export_idx;
254.     return UCS_OK;
255. 
256. err_unmap:
257.     for (j = 0; j < mapped; ++j) {
258.         uct_obmm_region_close(&regions[j]);
259.     }
260.     ucs_free(regions);
261.     return status;
262. }

300.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
301.         ucs_debug("obmm: sysfs discovery failed: %s",
302.                   ucs_status_string(status));
303.         goto err_free_memids;
304.     }
305. 
306.     if (num_devs == 0) {
307.         ucs_debug("obmm: no shmdev devices found under " UCT_OBMM_SYSFS_ROOT);
308.         status = UCS_ERR_NO_DEVICE;
309.         goto err_free_discovery;
310.     }
311. 
312.     status = uct_obmm_md_map_devices(md, devs, num_devs, num_memids > 0);
313.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
314.         ucs_debug("obmm: failed to map any device: %s",
315.                   ucs_status_string(status));
316.         goto err_free_discovery;
317.     }
318. 
319.     uct_obmm_sysfs_release(devs);
320.     ucs_free(memids);
321. 
322.     md->super.ops       = &md_ops;
323.     md->super.component = &uct_obmm_component;
324.     *md_p               = &md->super;
325.     return UCS_OK;
326. 
327. err_free_discovery:
328.     uct_obmm_sysfs_release(devs);
329. err_free_memids:
330.     ucs_free(memids);
331. err_free_md:
332.     ucs_free(md);
333.     return status;
334. }

106.     char        *end;

114.         return 0;

119.         return 0;

121. 
122.     *memid_p = memid;
123.     return 1;

285. static ucs_status_t uct_obmm_sysfs_patch_self_dcna(uct_obmm_sysfs_ctx_t *ctx,
286.                                                    int strict)
287. {
288.     uint64_t      self_dcna = 0;
289.     int           have_self = 0;
290.     int           have_export = 0;
291.     ucs_status_t  status;
292.     char          sysfs_dir[UCT_OBMM_PATH_MAX];
293.     unsigned      i;
294. 
295.     for (i = 0; i < ctx->count; ++i) {
296.         if (ctx->devices[i].type == UCT_OBMM_DEV_EXPORT) {
297.             have_export = 1;
298.         }
299.         if (ctx->devices[i].type != UCT_OBMM_DEV_IMPORT) {
300.             continue;
301.         }
302.         ucs_snprintf_safe(sysfs_dir, sizeof(sysfs_dir), "%s/%s%" PRIu64,
303.                           UCT_OBMM_SYSFS_ROOT, UCT_OBMM_SHMDEV_PREFIX,
304.                           ctx->devices[i].memid);
305.         status = uct_obmm_read_u64_hex(&self_dcna, 1, "%s/import_info/scna",
306.                                        sysfs_dir);
307.         if (status == UCS_OK) {
308.             have_self = 1;
309.             break;
310.         }
311.     }
312. 
313.     if (!have_self) {
314.         if (strict && have_export) {
315.             ucs_error("obmm: OBMM_MEMIDS selected an export region but no "
316.                       "selected import region is available to derive self "
317.                       "dcna");
318.             return UCS_ERR_NO_DEVICE;
319.         }
320.         ucs_debug("obmm: no import device available to derive self dcna; "
321.                   "export entries will keep exporter_dcna=0");
322.         return UCS_OK;
323.     }
324. 
325.     for (i = 0; i < ctx->count; ++i) {
326.         if (ctx->devices[i].type == UCT_OBMM_DEV_EXPORT) {
327.             ctx->devices[i].exporter_dcna = self_dcna;
328.         }
329.     }
330.     return UCS_OK;
331. }

356. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_sysfs_discover(uct_obmm_dev_info_t **devices_p,
357.                                      unsigned *num_devices_p,
358.                                      const uint64_t *filter_memids,
359.                                      unsigned num_filter_memids)
360. {
361.     uct_obmm_sysfs_ctx_t ctx = { NULL, 0, 0 };
362.     ucs_status_t         status;
363. 
364.     if (num_filter_memids > 0) {
365.         status = uct_obmm_sysfs_discover_filtered(&ctx, filter_memids,
366.                                                   num_filter_memids);
367.     } else {
368.         status = ucs_sys_readdir(UCT_OBMM_SYSFS_ROOT, uct_obmm_sysfs_readdir_cb,
369.                                  &ctx);
370.     }
371. 
372.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
373.         if (num_filter_memids == 0) {
374.             ucs_debug("obmm: failed to scan %s: %s", UCT_OBMM_SYSFS_ROOT,
375.                       ucs_status_string(status));
376.         }
377.         ucs_free(ctx.devices);
378.         *devices_p     = NULL;
379.         *num_devices_p = 0;
380.         /* Treat "no obmm at all" as success-with-zero so md_open can decide. */
381.         return (status == UCS_ERR_NO_ELEM) ? UCS_OK : status;
382.     }
383. 
384.     if (ctx.count == 0) {
385.         ucs_free(ctx.devices);
386.         *devices_p     = NULL;
387.         *num_devices_p = 0;
388.         return UCS_OK;
389.     }
390. 
391.     status = uct_obmm_sysfs_patch_self_dcna(&ctx, num_filter_memids > 0);
392.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
393.         ucs_free(ctx.devices);
394.         *devices_p     = NULL;
395.         *num_devices_p = 0;
396.         return status;
397.     }
398. 
399.     *devices_p     = ctx.devices;
400.     *num_devices_p = ctx.count;
401.     return UCS_OK;
402. }

1. Problem: add an optional obmm configuration knob so users can restrict UCX to an explicit set of OBMM shmdev memids, e.g. UCX_OBMM_MEMIDS=1,2, instead of scanning all shmdevs and trying to map every discovered device.
2. 
3. Approach:
4. - Keep the knob at the obmm MD layer because discovery and region mapping happen in uct_obmm_md_open().
5. - Add UCX_OBMM_MEMIDS as MD config, parse it as a comma-separated list, and pass the parsed allow-list into obmm sysfs discovery.
6. - Preserve current behavior when the knob is unset.
7. - When the knob is set, do direct targeted discovery for only those memids instead of scanning the whole sysfs tree.
8. - Use strict semantics for explicit memids: if any requested memid is missing, malformed, not mmap-capable, or otherwise unusable, fail md_open rather than silently degrading.

```
232. 
233. ## Configuration knobs
234. 
235. All under `UCX_OBMM_*` prefix.
236. 
237. | knob                      | default | meaning                          |
238. |---------------------------|---------|----------------------------------|
239. | FIFO_SIZE                 |    64   | ring depth (power of 2)          |
240. | FIFO_ELEM_SIZE            |  2048   | bytes per FIFO elem (incl. 16B hdr) → max_short = 2032 |
241. | BCOPY_SEG_SIZE   (v2 NEW) |  4096   | bytes per paired desc → max_bcopy |
242. | FIFO_MAX_POLL             |    16   | RX completions per progress()     |
243. | MEMIDS        (optional)  |   ""    | comma-separated explicit shmdev memids (for example `1,2`); when set, obmm queries only these memids instead of scanning all shmdevs, and any requested memid that is missing or unusable fails md_open |
244. 
245. Validation at iface init:
246. - `FIFO_SIZE` > 0, power of 2
247. - `FIFO_ELEM_SIZE` > sizeof(elem_hdr) and `(elem_size - hdr) <= UINT16_MAX`
248. - `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE` > 0 and `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE <= UINT16_MAX`
249. - `slot_count * slot_stride + pool_overhead <= region->length`
250. 
251. ---
```

```
335. static ucs_status_t
336. uct_obmm_sysfs_discover_filtered(uct_obmm_sysfs_ctx_t *ctx,
337.                                  const uint64_t *filter_memids,
338.                                  unsigned num_filter_memids)
339. {
340.     char          dirname[64];
341.     ucs_status_t  status;
342.     unsigned      i;
343. 
344.     for (i = 0; i < num_filter_memids; ++i) {
345.         ucs_snprintf_safe(dirname, sizeof(dirname), "%s%" PRIu64,
346.                           UCT_OBMM_SHMDEV_PREFIX, filter_memids[i]);
347.         status = uct_obmm_sysfs_append_entry(ctx, dirname, filter_memids[i]);
348.         if (status != UCS_OK) {
349.             return status;
350.         }
351.     }
352. 
353.     return UCS_OK;
354. }
355. 
356. 
357. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_sysfs_discover(uct_obmm_dev_info_t **devices_p,
358.                                      unsigned *num_devices_p,
359.                                      const uint64_t *filter_memids,
360.                                      unsigned num_filter_memids)
361. {
362.     uct_obmm_sysfs_ctx_t ctx = { NULL, 0, 0 };
363.     ucs_status_t         status;
364. 
365.     if (num_filter_memids > 0) {
366.         status = uct_obmm_sysfs_discover_filtered(&ctx, filter_memids,
367.                                                   num_filter_memids);
368.     } else {
369.         status = ucs_sys_readdir(UCT_OBMM_SYSFS_ROOT, uct_obmm_sysfs_readdir_cb,
370.                                  &ctx);
371.     }
372. 
373.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
374.         if (num_filter_memids == 0) {
375.             ucs_debug("obmm: failed to scan %s: %s", UCT_OBMM_SYSFS_ROOT,
376.                       ucs_status_string(status));
377.         }
378.         ucs_free(ctx.devices);
379.         *devices_p     = NULL;
380.         *num_devices_p = 0;
381.         /* Treat "no obmm at all" as success-with-zero so md_open can decide. */
382.         return (status == UCS_ERR_NO_ELEM) ? UCS_OK : status;
383.     }
384. 
385.     if (ctx.count == 0) {
386.         ucs_free(ctx.devices);
387.         *devices_p     = NULL;
388.         *num_devices_p = 0;
389.         return UCS_OK;
390.     }
391. 
392.     status = uct_obmm_sysfs_patch_self_dcna(&ctx);
393.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
394.         ucs_free(ctx.devices);
395.         *devices_p     = NULL;
396.         *num_devices_p = 0;
397.         return status;
398.     }
399. 
400.     *devices_p     = ctx.devices;
401.     *num_devices_p = ctx.count;
402.     return UCS_OK;
403. }
404.
```

```diff
+uct_obmm_md_parse_memids(const char *memids_str, uint64_t **memids_p,

+{
+    uint64_t     *memids      = NULL;

+        goto out;
+    }

+            ++capacity;

+    memids = ucs_calloc(capacity, sizeof(*memids), "obmm_memid_list");
+    if (memids == NULL) {

+        goto err;
+    }
+
+    cursor = copy;

+        errno = 0;
+        next  = strchr(cursor, ',');
+        if (next != NULL) {
+            *next = '\0';
+            ++next;
+        }
+
+        ucs_strtrim(cursor);

+                      cursor, memids_str);
+            status = UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
+            goto err;
+        }
+
+        if (memid == 0) {
+            ucs_error("obmm: OBMM_MEMIDS cannot contain memid 0");
+            status = UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
+            goto err;
+        }
+

+                status = UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
+                goto err;
+            }
+        }
+
+        memids[count++] = memid;
+        cursor          = next;
+    }
+
+out:
+    ucs_free(copy);
+    *memids_p     = memids;
+    *num_memids_p = count;

+

+    ucs_free(copy);
```

```diff
+static ucs_status_t
+uct_obmm_md_parse_memids(const char *memids_str, uint64_t **memids_p,
+                         unsigned *num_memids_p)
+{
+    uint64_t     *memids      = NULL;
+    char         *cursor;
+    char         *next;
+    char         *copy        = NULL;
+    char         *end;
+    ucs_status_t  status      = UCS_OK;
+    unsigned      count       = 0;
+    unsigned      capacity    = 1;
+    unsigned      i;
+    uint64_t      memid;
+
+    *memids_p     = NULL;
+    *num_memids_p = 0;
+
+    if (memids_str == NULL) {
+        return UCS_OK;
+    }
+
+    copy = ucs_strdup(memids_str, "obmm_memids");
+    if (copy == NULL) {
+        return UCS_ERR_NO_MEMORY;
+    }
+
+    ucs_strtrim(copy);
+    if (copy[0] == '\0') {
+        goto out;
+    }
+
+    for (cursor = copy; *cursor != '\0'; ++cursor) {
+        if (*cursor == ',') {
+            ++capacity;
+        }
+    }
+
+    memids = ucs_calloc(capacity, sizeof(*memids), "obmm_memid_list");
+    if (memids == NULL) {
+        status = UCS_ERR_NO_MEMORY;
+        goto err;
+    }
+
+    cursor = copy;
+    while (cursor != NULL) {
+        errno = 0;
+        next  = strchr(cursor, ',');
+        if (next != NULL) {
+            *next = '\0';
+            ++next;
+        }
+
+        ucs_strtrim(cursor);
+        if (cursor[0] == '\0') {
+            ucs_error("obmm: OBMM_MEMIDS contains an empty entry: '%s'",
+                      memids_str);
+            status = UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
+            goto err;
+        }
+
+        memid = strtoull(cursor, &end, 10);
+        if ((errno == ERANGE) || (*end != '\0')) {
+            ucs_error("obmm: invalid OBMM_MEMIDS entry '%s' in '%s'; "
+                      "expected decimal memid list like '1,2'",
+                      cursor, memids_str);
+            status = UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
+            goto err;
+        }
+
+        if (memid == 0) {
+            ucs_error("obmm: OBMM_MEMIDS cannot contain memid 0");
+            status = UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
+            goto err;
+        }
+
+        for (i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
+            if (memids[i] == memid) {
+                ucs_error("obmm: duplicate memid %" PRIu64
+                          " in OBMM_MEMIDS='%s'",
+                          memid, memids_str);
+                status = UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
+                goto err;
+            }
+        }
+
+        memids[count++] = memid;
+        cursor          = next;
+    }
+
+out:
+    ucs_free(copy);
+    *memids_p     = memids;
+    *num_memids_p = count;
+    return UCS_OK;
+
+err:
+    ucs_free(memids);
+    ucs_free(copy);
+    return status;
+}
```

```
39. {
40.     (void)md;
41.     uct_md_base_md_query(attr);
42.     /* obmm only does AM (short + bcopy). It does NOT expose remote memory
43.      * as a directly-dereferenceable pointer to its own peers: only the
44.      * pre-exported FIFO region is mmap'd, NOT the user's send/recv
45.      * buffers. So we MUST NOT advertise UCT_MD_FLAG_NEED_RKEY (which
46.      * implies remote-key-based access) -- doing so makes UCP pick
47.      * rendezvous-via-rkey_ptr for messages above the rndv threshold
48.      * (~256 KiB) and try to memcpy from a peer-VA pointer, segfaulting
49.      * inside ucs_memcpy_relaxed. */
50.     attr->flags                  = 0;
51.     attr->reg_mem_types          = 0;
52.     attr->reg_nonblock_mem_types = 0;
53.     attr->cache_mem_types        = 0;
54.     attr->access_mem_types       = UCS_BIT(UCS_MEMORY_TYPE_HOST);
55.     return UCS_OK;
56. }
```

```
32.                                           const char *path_fmt, ...)

35. static ucs_status_t uct_obmm_read_u64_hex(uint64_t *value, int silent,
36.                                           const char *path_fmt, ...)
37. {
38.     char     buf[64];
39.     char     path[UCT_OBMM_PATH_MAX];
40.     va_list  ap;
41.     ssize_t  n;
42.     uint64_t v;
43. 
44.     va_start(ap, path_fmt);
45.     vsnprintf(path, sizeof(path), path_fmt, ap);
46.     va_end(ap);
47. 
48.     n = ucs_read_file_str(buf, sizeof(buf), silent, "%s", path);
49.     if (n < 0) {
50.         return UCS_ERR_IO_ERROR;
51.     }
52. 
53.     if (sscanf(buf, "%" SCNx64, &v) != 1) {
54.         if (!silent) {
55.             ucs_error("obmm: failed to parse u64 hex from %s: '%s'", path, buf);
56.         }
57.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
58.     }
59. 
60.     *value = v;
61.     return UCS_OK;
62. }
63. 
64. 
65. static ucs_status_t uct_obmm_read_eid(uct_obmm_eid_t *eid, int silent,
66.                                       const char *path_fmt, ...)
67.     UCS_F_PRINTF(3, 4);
68. 
69. static ucs_status_t uct_obmm_read_eid(uct_obmm_eid_t *eid, int silent,
70.                                       const char *path_fmt, ...)
71. {
72.     char     buf[96];
73.     char     path[UCT_OBMM_PATH_MAX];
74.     va_list  ap;
75.     ssize_t  n;
76.     uint64_t hi, lo;
77. 
78.     va_start(ap, path_fmt);
79.     vsnprintf(path, sizeof(path), path_fmt, ap);
80.     va_end(ap);
81. 
82.     n = ucs_read_file_str(buf, sizeof(buf), silent, "%s", path);
83.     if (n < 0) {
84.         return UCS_ERR_IO_ERROR;
85.     }
86. 
87.     /* Format per obmm_shmdev_sysfs.md: "u64 : u64" with whitespace around ':'.
88.      * Accept either "0x%lx : 0x%lx" or bare hex with optional spaces. */
89.     if (sscanf(buf, "%" SCNx64 " : %" SCNx64, &hi, &lo) != 2) {
90.         if (!silent) {
91.             ucs_error("obmm: failed to parse eid (u64 : u64) from %s: '%s'",
92.                       path, buf);
93.         }
94.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
95.     }
96. 
97.     eid->hi = hi;
98.     eid->lo = lo;
99.     return UCS_OK;
100. }
```

```
182.                                             const uct_obmm_dev_info_t *devs,
183.                                             unsigned num_devs)
184. {
185.     uct_obmm_region_t *regions;
186.     ucs_status_t       status;
187.     unsigned           i, mapped, j;
188.     int                export_idx = -1;
189. 
190.     regions = ucs_calloc(num_devs, sizeof(*regions), "uct_obmm_regions");
191.     if (regions == NULL) {
192.         return UCS_ERR_NO_MEMORY;
193.     }
194. 
195.     for (i = 0; i < num_devs; ++i) {
196.         regions[i].fd = -1;
197.     }
198. 
199.     mapped = 0;
200.     for (i = 0; i < num_devs; ++i) {
201.         status = uct_obmm_region_open(&devs[i], &regions[mapped]);
202.         if (status != UCS_OK) {
203.             ucs_error("obmm: mapping %s (memid=%" PRIu64 ") failed: %s",
204.                       devs[i].dev_path, devs[i].memid,
205.                       ucs_status_string(status));
206.             goto err_unmap;
207.         }
208. 
209.         if ((regions[mapped].info.type == UCT_OBMM_DEV_EXPORT) &&
210.             (export_idx < 0)) {
211.             export_idx = (int)mapped;
212.         } else if (regions[mapped].info.type == UCT_OBMM_DEV_EXPORT) {
213.             ucs_error("obmm: multiple export regions found "
214.                       "(memid=%" PRIu64 ", memid=%" PRIu64 "); obmm "
215.                       "requires exactly one local export",
216.                       regions[export_idx].info.memid,
217.                       regions[mapped].info.memid);
218.             uct_obmm_region_close(&regions[mapped]);
219.             status = UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
220.             goto err_unmap;
221.         }
222. 
223.         ++mapped;
224.     }
225. 
226.     if (mapped == 0) {
227.         ucs_free(regions);
228.         return UCS_ERR_NO_DEVICE;
229.     }
230. 
231.     if (export_idx < 0) {
232.         ucs_error("obmm: no local export region found for obmm transport");
233.         status = UCS_ERR_NO_DEVICE;
234.         goto err_unmap;
235.     }
236. 
237.     md->regions     = regions;
238.     md->num_regions = mapped;
239.     md->export_idx  = export_idx;
240.     return UCS_OK;
241. 
242. err_unmap:
243.     for (j = 0; j < mapped; ++j) {
244.         uct_obmm_region_close(&regions[j]);
245.     }
246.     ucs_free(regions);
247.     return status;
```

```
298.             have_export = 1;
299.         }
300.         if (ctx->devices[i].type != UCT_OBMM_DEV_IMPORT) {
301.             continue;
302.         }
303.         ucs_snprintf_safe(sysfs_dir, sizeof(sysfs_dir), "%s/%s%" PRIu64,
304.                           UCT_OBMM_SYSFS_ROOT, UCT_OBMM_SHMDEV_PREFIX,
305.                           ctx->devices[i].memid);

319.             return UCS_ERR_NO_DEVICE;

327.         if (ctx->devices[i].type == UCT_OBMM_DEV_EXPORT) {
328.             ctx->devices[i].exporter_dcna = self_dcna;
```

### 💬 Copilot

Based on my review of the diff, I've traced through the fail-fast logic, error paths, memory management, and status code handling. Here are my findings:

## Issue: Potential inconsistency in memid validation

**File:** ucx/src/uct/obmm/base/obmm_md.c:73-78 vs obmm_sysfs.c:117-122

**Severity:** Low

**Problem:** In `uct_obmm_md_parse_memids`, memid 0 is explicitly rejected when specified via `MEMIDS` config:
```c
if (memid == 0) {
    ucs_error("obmm: OBMM_MEMIDS cannot contain memid 0");
    status = UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
    goto err;
}
```

However, in scan-all mode, `uct_obmm_parse_memid` would accept "shmdev0" and return memid=0 without validation. This creates an inconsistency where:
- `MEMIDS="0"` → error
- Scan-all discovering shmdev0 → accepted

**Evidence:** The error message says "OBMM_MEMIDS cannot contain memid 0" (config-specific), not "memid 0 is invalid" (general constraint). This suggests it might be intentional - perhaps memid 0 has special semantics that make it unsuitable for explicit user configuration but valid for auto-discovery. However, without additional validation or documentation, the intent is ambiguous.

**Suggested fix:** Either:
1. Add the same memid==0 check in scan-all path after line 280 in obmm_sysfs.c, OR
2. Add a code comment explaining why MEMIDS rejects 0 but scan-all accepts it

---

All other aspects of the change appear correct:
- Status remap correctly distinguishes "no /sys/devices/obmm directory" (UCS_ERR_NO_ELEM) from "device exists but unusable" (UCS_ERR_UNSUPPORTED)
- Memory cleanup paths properly handle all error cases
- Multiple-export detection correctly closes the duplicate before jumping to err_unmap
- The fail-fast behavior is consistently implemented across discovery and mapping

### 💬 Copilot

**已改成统一 fail-fast。**现在即使**不配 `UCX_OBMM_MEMIDS`**，obmm 也不会再“跳过坏设备继续凑合跑”，而是只要发现条件不满足就直接让 `md_open` 失败。

这次我收掉了几类分支：
- 全量扫描模式下，发现的 `shmdev` 只要缺属性、`allow_mmap=0`、不可用，就直接失败，不再 skip
- mmap/open 失败不再 warning-and-continue，直接失败
- 多个 export、不存在 export、只有 export 没有 import 无法推导 `self_dcna`，都直接失败
- `memid 0` 现在在 scan-all 路径里也统一视为无效，不再和 `MEMIDS=0` 的行为不一致

同时保留了 `UCX_OBMM_MEMIDS=1,2` 的过滤能力；它现在只是“**限制扫描范围**”，不再是“**唯一严格模式开关**”。

**构建验证这边还是同一个限制：**当前 Windows 环境没有可用的 `bash/make/gcc`，所以这次只能做到代码级静态收口；后续还是需要在 Linux 构建机上看一下 `ucx_info -c` 和实际 build。

```
174. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_ep_am_short(uct_ep_h tl_ep, uint8_t id, uint64_t header,
175.                                   const void *payload, unsigned length)
176. {
177.     uct_obmm_ep_t           *ep    = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep, uct_obmm_ep_t);
178.     uct_obmm_iface_t        *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep->iface,
179.                                                     uct_obmm_iface_t);
180.     size_t                   payload_total = sizeof(header) + length;
181.     uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem;
182.     uint64_t                 head;
183.     uint8_t                  owner_bit;
184. 
185.     UCT_CHECK_AM_ID(id);
186.     UCT_CHECK_LENGTH(payload_total, 0,
187.                      ep->fifo_elem_size - sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_element_t),
188.                      "am_short");
189. 
190.     /* Reserve a slot in the peer's FIFO via load + CAS. FAA cannot be used:
191.      * if FAA succeeds but the FIFO turns out to be full, the bumped head
192.      * value can never be rolled back across hosts, leaving a permanent gap
193.      * the receiver will block on (its progress loop walks slots in order
194.      * and stops at any slot whose owner bit hasn't flipped). CAS lets us
195.      * decide capacity *before* committing the head bump.
196.      *
197.      * Multiple senders (across processes / hosts) compete on the same head
198.      * cell, so we retry on CAS miss. */
199.     for (;;) {
200.         head = ep->peer_ctl->head;
201. 
202.         if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
203.             ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
204.             ep->cached_tail = ep->peer_ctl->tail;
205.             if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
206.                 UCS_STATS_UPDATE_COUNTER(ep->super.stats, UCT_EP_STAT_NO_RES,
207.                                          1);
208.                 return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
209.             }
210.         }
211. 
212.         if (ucs_atomic_bool_cswap64(&ep->peer_ctl->head, head, head + 1)) {
213.             break;
214.         }
215.         /* Lost the race; another sender claimed this slot. Retry. */
216.     }
217. 
218.     elem = uct_obmm_slot_elem(ep->peer_elems, head, ep->fifo_mask,
219.                               ep->fifo_elem_size);
220. 
221.     elem->am_id      = id;
222.     elem->length     = (uint16_t)payload_total;
223.     elem->generation = ep->expected_generation;
224.     elem->header     = header;
225.     if (length > 0) {
226.         memcpy(elem + 1, payload, length);
227.     }
228. 
229.     /* Publish: the OWNER bit toggles each wraparound. The receiver expects
230.      * bit==1 on even passes and bit==0 on odd passes (and vice versa) so
231.      * that uninitialized memory (zero) reads as "not yet written" on the
232.      * first pass. */
233.     owner_bit = ((head / ep->fifo_size) & 1u) ? 0u : UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER;
234. 
235.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
236.     elem->flags = owner_bit;
237. 
238.     UCT_TL_EP_STAT_OP(&ep->super, AM, SHORT, payload_total);
239.     uct_iface_trace_am(&iface->super, UCT_AM_TRACE_TYPE_SEND, id,
240.                        &header, payload_total, "TX: AM_SHORT");
241.     return UCS_OK;
242. }
243. 
244. 
245. /* Reserve one slot in the peer's FIFO, returning the head index that was
246.  * claimed. See am_short above for why load+CAS (not FAA). */
247. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE ucs_status_t
248. uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot(uct_obmm_ep_t *ep, uint64_t *head_p)
249. {
250.     uint64_t head;
251. 
252.     for (;;) {
253.         head = ep->peer_ctl->head;
254. 
255.         if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
256.             ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
257.             ep->cached_tail = ep->peer_ctl->tail;
258.             if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
259.                 UCS_STATS_UPDATE_COUNTER(ep->super.stats, UCT_EP_STAT_NO_RES,
260.                                          1);
261.                 return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
262.             }
263.         }
264. 
265.         if (ucs_atomic_bool_cswap64(&ep->peer_ctl->head, head, head + 1)) {
266.             *head_p = head;
267.             return UCS_OK;
268.         }
269.     }
270. }

273. ssize_t uct_obmm_ep_am_bcopy(uct_ep_h tl_ep, uint8_t id,
274.                              uct_pack_callback_t pack_cb, void *arg,
275.                              unsigned flags)
276. {
277.     uct_obmm_ep_t           *ep    = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep, uct_obmm_ep_t);
278.     uct_obmm_iface_t        *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep->iface,
279.                                                     uct_obmm_iface_t);
280.     uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem;
281.     void                    *desc;
282.     uint64_t                 head;
283.     size_t                   length;
284.     uint8_t                  owner_bit;
285.     ucs_status_t             status;
286. 
287.     /* flags (UCT_SEND_FLAG_PEER_CHECK etc.) are ignored: this transport
288.      * does not advertise EP_CHECK / keepalive in v1. */
289.     (void)flags;
290. 
291.     UCT_CHECK_AM_ID(id);
292. 
293.     status = uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot(ep, &head);
294.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
295.         return status;
296.     }
297. 
298.     elem = uct_obmm_slot_elem(ep->peer_elems, head, ep->fifo_mask,
299.                               ep->fifo_elem_size);
300.     desc = uct_obmm_slot_desc(ep->peer_descs, head, ep->fifo_mask,
301.                               ep->bcopy_seg_size);
302. 
303.     /* pack_cb writes pack_cb_ret bytes directly into the paired desc[N]
304.      * area. UCP guarantees pack_cb_ret <= cap.am.max_bcopy, which we set
305.      * to bcopy_seg_size. The asserts catch buggy direct UCT users in
306.      * debug builds; production safety relies on the iface cap contract. */
307.     length = pack_cb(desc, arg);
308.     ucs_assertv(length <= ep->bcopy_seg_size,
309.                 "obmm: pack_cb returned %zu > bcopy_seg_size=%u",
310.                 length, ep->bcopy_seg_size);
311.     ucs_assertv(length <= UINT16_MAX,
312.                 "obmm: pack_cb returned %zu > UINT16_MAX", length);
313. 
314.     elem->am_id      = id;
315.     elem->length     = (uint16_t)length;
316.     elem->generation = ep->expected_generation;
317.     elem->header     = 0; /* unused for bcopy */
318. 
319.     owner_bit = ((head / ep->fifo_size) & 1u) ? 0u :
320.                                                 UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER;
321. 
322.     /* Release barrier: orders the desc[N] payload writes AND elem header
323.      * writes BEFORE the flags publish. Receiver pairs with bus_load_fence
324.      * after observing the flags byte. */
325.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
326.     elem->flags = owner_bit | UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_BCOPY;
327. 
328.     UCT_TL_EP_STAT_OP(&ep->super, AM, BCOPY, length);
329.     uct_iface_trace_am(&iface->super, UCT_AM_TRACE_TYPE_SEND, id,
330.                        desc, length, "TX: AM_BCOPY");
331.     return (ssize_t)length;
332. }

335. /* Returns true iff the peer's FIFO has at least one free slot, refreshing
336.  * cached_tail (with a bus_load_fence pair) before declaring "full". Mirrors
337.  * the resource check used by mm in pending_add. */
338. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE int
339. uct_obmm_ep_has_tx_resource(uct_obmm_ep_t *ep)
340. {
341.     uint64_t head = ep->peer_ctl->head;
342. 
343.     if ((head - ep->cached_tail) < ep->fifo_size) {
344.         return 1;
345.     }
346.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
347.     ep->cached_tail = ep->peer_ctl->tail;
348.     return (head - ep->cached_tail) < ep->fifo_size;
349. }

352. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_ep_pending_add(uct_ep_h tl_ep, uct_pending_req_t *n,
353.                                      unsigned flags)
354. {

378. ucs_arbiter_cb_result_t
379. uct_obmm_ep_process_pending(ucs_arbiter_t *arbiter, ucs_arbiter_group_t *group,
380.                             ucs_arbiter_elem_t *elem, void *arg)
381. {
382.     uct_obmm_ep_t     *ep    = ucs_container_of(group, uct_obmm_ep_t, arb_group);
383.     unsigned          *count = (unsigned*)arg;
384.     uct_pending_req_t *req;
385.     ucs_status_t       status;
386. 
387.     /* Refresh cached tail so the request callback's am_short/am_bcopy sees
388.      * the freshest peer state and is not falsely starved. */
389.     if (!uct_obmm_ep_has_tx_resource(ep)) {
390.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_RESCHED_GROUP;
391.     }
392. 
393.     req    = ucs_container_of(elem, uct_pending_req_t, priv);
394.     status = req->func(req);
395. 
396.     if (status == UCS_OK) {
397.         ++(*count);
398.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_REMOVE_ELEM;
399.     } else if (status == UCS_INPROGRESS) {
400.         ++(*count);
401.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_NEXT_GROUP;
402.     }
403. 
404.     /* NO_RESOURCE (or any other transient): keep the request and try
405.      * again the next time iface_progress runs. */
406.     return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_RESCHED_GROUP;
407. }
```

```
197.     eid.hi = daddr->exporter_deid_hi;

221. static unsigned uct_obmm_iface_progress(uct_iface_h tl_iface)
222. {
223.     uct_obmm_iface_t        *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_iface, uct_obmm_iface_t);
224.     unsigned                 polled = 0;
225.     uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem;
226.     uint8_t                  flags;
227.     uint8_t                  expected_owner;
228.     size_t                   max_poll = iface->fifo_max_poll;
229. 
230.     while (polled < max_poll) {
231.         elem = uct_obmm_slot_elem(iface->recv_elems, iface->read_index,
232.                                   iface->fifo_mask, iface->fifo_elem_size);
233. 
234.         /* Owner bit alternates each lap of the ring; pass 0 expects 1, pass
235.          * 1 expects 0, etc. Combined with zero-fill on slot allocation, this
236.          * means an unwritten slot reads as flags==0 and is correctly skipped
237.          * on the very first lap. */
238.         expected_owner = ((iface->read_index / iface->fifo_size) & 1u) ?
239.                          0u : UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER;
240. 
241.         flags = elem->flags;
242.         if ((flags & UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER) != expected_owner) {
243.             break;
244.         }
245. 
246.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
247. 
248.         if (elem->generation != iface->generation) {
249.             /* Stale write from a previous slot owner (we were torn down and
250.              * re-allocated this slot). Drop silently. */
251.             ucs_trace_data("obmm: drop stale elem (gen=%u expected=%u) "
252.                            "at idx=%lu", elem->generation, iface->generation,
253.                            (unsigned long)iface->read_index);
254.         } else if (flags & UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_BCOPY) {
255.             /* am_bcopy: payload is in the paired desc[N], not in the FIFO
256.              * element body. The bus_load_fence above orders this load
257.              * with respect to the sender's bus_store_fence + flag write. */
258.             void *desc = uct_obmm_slot_desc(iface->recv_descs,
259.                                             iface->read_index,
260.                                             iface->fifo_mask,
261.                                             iface->bcopy_seg_size);
262.             uct_iface_invoke_am(&iface->super, elem->am_id,
263.                                 desc, elem->length, 0);
264.         } else {
265.             /* am_short: contiguous [header(8B)][payload] starting at
266.              * &elem->header. elem->length already includes the 8B header. */
267.             uct_iface_invoke_am(&iface->super, elem->am_id,
268.                                 &elem->header, elem->length, 0);
269.         }
270. 
271.         iface->read_index++;
272.         polled++;
273.     }
274. 
275.     if (polled > 0) {
276.         /* Full bus fence: orders the AM handler's LOADS from desc[]/elem
277.          * payload BEFORE the STORE that publishes the new tail. A plain
278.          * bus_store_fence (e.g. dmb oshst on aarch64) only orders
279.          * store→store, which would let a sender observe the advanced
280.          * tail and overwrite desc[N] while we still have outstanding
281.          * loads in flight. See obmm_fifo.h:uct_obmm_bus_full_fence. */
282.         uct_obmm_bus_full_fence();
283.         iface->recv_ctl->tail = iface->read_index;
284.     }
285. 
286.     /* Drain any UCP requests waiting on TX backpressure. The peer-side
287.      * tail advance we just published may also have freed slots that *our*
288.      * pending eps have been waiting for; dispatch with a fresh head/tail
289.      * snapshot so retries see the latest state. Without this dispatch,
290.      * UCS_ERR_BUSY-only pending_add caused a livelock under symmetric
291.      * bidirectional load (osu_bibw at size==BCOPY_SEG_SIZE). */
292.     ucs_arbiter_dispatch(&iface->arbiter, 1, uct_obmm_ep_process_pending,
293.                          &polled);
294. 
295.     return polled;
296. }

333.     if (!ucs_is_pow2(config->fifo_size)) {
334.         ucs_error("obmm: FIFO_SIZE (%u) must be a power of 2",
335.                   config->fifo_size);
336.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;

340.                   config->fifo_elem_size, sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_element_t));
341.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
342.     }
343.     /* elem->length is uint16_t; reject geometries whose advertised
344.      * max_short / max_bcopy would not fit in that field. */
345.     if ((config->fifo_elem_size - sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_element_t)) >
346.         UINT16_MAX) {
347.         ucs_error("obmm: FIFO_ELEM_SIZE (%u) too large; payload area must fit "
348.                   "in uint16 (max %zu)",
349.                   config->fifo_elem_size,
350.                   (size_t)UINT16_MAX + sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_element_t));
351.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
352.     }

354.         ucs_error("obmm: BCOPY_SEG_SIZE must be > 0");
355.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
356.     }
357.     if (config->bcopy_seg_size > UINT16_MAX) {
358.         ucs_error("obmm: BCOPY_SEG_SIZE (%u) too large; max_bcopy must fit "
359.                   "in uint16 (max %u)",
360.                   config->bcopy_seg_size, (unsigned)UINT16_MAX);
```

```
11. #include <ucs/sys/compiler.h>
12. #include <ucs/sys/compiler_def.h>
13. #include <ucs/sys/ptr_arith.h>

18. /* Element flags carried in the shared FIFO element header. */
19. enum {
20.     /* Toggled every FIFO wraparound; receiver uses this to detect a freshly
21.      * written element without taking a tail/head delta lock. */
22.     UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER = UCS_BIT(0),
23. 
24.     /* Set by senders that wrote via am_bcopy (pack_cb output stored in the
25.      * payload area starting at elem+1, with NO 8-byte am_short header
26.      * prefix). When clear, the element was written via am_short and
27.      * &elem->header + length covers the [hdr][payload] buffer. */
28.     UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_BCOPY = UCS_BIT(1)
29. };
30. 
31. 
32. /* Per-slot FIFO control header. Lives at offset 0 of every allocated slot in
33.  * the obmm pool. The producer atomically FAA-s `head` to claim an element;
34.  * the consumer reads `tail` to release space. Both fields are accessed via
35.  * non-cacheable mappings, therefore all updates must be paired with bus
36.  * fences (ucs_memory_bus_*_fence), not CPU fences. */
37. typedef struct uct_obmm_fifo_ctl {
38.     /* 1st cacheline: producer-touched */
39.     volatile uint64_t head;
40.     UCS_CACHELINE_PADDING(uint64_t);
41. 
42.     /* 2nd cacheline: consumer-touched */
43.     volatile uint64_t tail;
44.     UCS_CACHELINE_PADDING(uint64_t);
45. } UCS_V_ALIGNED(UCS_SYS_CACHE_LINE_SIZE) uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t;
46. 
47. 
48. /* FIFO element header. The element body (am short header + payload) follows
49.  * immediately. Total element stride is iface->config.fifo_elem_size, which
50.  * the iface chooses so that header+payload <= elem_size. */
51. typedef struct uct_obmm_fifo_element {
52.     uint8_t  flags;       /* UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_xx */
53.     uint8_t  am_id;       /* active message id */
54.     uint16_t length;      /* payload length (excluding am_short header) */
55.     uint32_t generation;  /* owner-slot generation token; receiver discards
56.                              elements whose generation doesn't match the
57.                              slot's current meta.generation */
58.     uint64_t header;      /* am_short 64-bit header */
59.     /* payload[length] follows here */
60. } UCS_S_PACKED uct_obmm_fifo_element_t;
61. 
62. 
63. /* Compute slot stride: control header + fifo_size * elem_size + (v2)
64.  * fifo_size * bcopy_seg_size, cacheline aligned so that adjacent slots
65.  * don't share a line. Returned as size_t; callers must validate the
66.  * result fits in the uint32_t pool_hdr->slot_size field before passing
67.  * to pool_attach. */
68. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE size_t
69. uct_obmm_slot_stride(unsigned fifo_size, unsigned fifo_elem_size,
70.                      unsigned bcopy_seg_size)
71. {
72.     return ucs_align_up(sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t) +
73.                         ((size_t)fifo_size * fifo_elem_size) +
74.                         ((size_t)fifo_size * bcopy_seg_size),
75.                         UCS_SYS_CACHE_LINE_SIZE);
76. }
77. 
78. 
79. /* Get FIFO control header pointer from a slot base pointer. */
80. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t*
81. uct_obmm_slot_ctl(void *slot_base)
82. {
83.     return (uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t*)slot_base;
84. }
85. 
86. 
87. /* Get FIFO elements array pointer from a slot base pointer. */
88. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void*
89. uct_obmm_slot_elems(void *slot_base)
90. {
91.     return UCS_PTR_BYTE_OFFSET(slot_base, sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t));
92. }
93. 
94. 
95. /* Get bcopy desc array pointer from a slot base pointer. The desc area
96.  * lives immediately after the FIFO element array. Each desc is
97.  * `bcopy_seg_size` bytes; index N is paired 1:1 with FIFO element N. */
98. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void*
99. uct_obmm_slot_descs(void *slot_base, unsigned fifo_size,
100.                     unsigned fifo_elem_size)
101. {
102.     return UCS_PTR_BYTE_OFFSET(slot_base,
103.                                sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t) +
104.                                ((size_t)fifo_size * fifo_elem_size));
105. }
106. 
107. 
108. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE uct_obmm_fifo_element_t*
109. uct_obmm_slot_elem(void *elems, uint64_t index, unsigned mask,
110.                    unsigned elem_size)
111. {
112.     return (uct_obmm_fifo_element_t*)
113.            UCS_PTR_BYTE_OFFSET(elems, (size_t)(index & mask) * elem_size);
114. }
115. 
116. 
117. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void*
118. uct_obmm_slot_desc(void *descs, uint64_t index, unsigned mask,
119.                    unsigned seg_size)
120. {
121.     return UCS_PTR_BYTE_OFFSET(descs, (size_t)(index & mask) * seg_size);
122. }
123. 
124. 
125. /* Full bus-domain fence: orders ALL prior memory accesses (loads and
126.  * stores) before ALL subsequent memory accesses, in the outer-shareable /
127.  * device domain that includes cross-host obmm peers.
128.  *
129.  * Why we need this in addition to ucs_memory_bus_{store,load}_fence:
130.  * the receiver must order its desc[N] LOADS (issued during the AM
131.  * handler) before the STORE that publishes the new tail. On ARM64,
132.  * ucs_memory_bus_store_fence() is `dmb oshst` (store→store only) and
133.  * does not order prior loads. Without this load→store barrier, a sender
134.  * could observe the advanced tail and overwrite desc[N] while the
135.  * receiver still has outstanding loads from the previous lap's payload.
136.  *
137.  * Defined locally in obmm rather than added to ucs/arch to keep the
138.  * change inside ucx/src/uct/obmm/ per AGENTS.md. */
139. #if defined(__aarch64__)
140. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() __asm__ __volatile__("dmb osh" ::: "memory")
141. #elif defined(__x86_64__) || defined(__i386__)
142. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() __asm__ __volatile__("mfence" ::: "memory")
143. #elif defined(__powerpc64__)
144. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() __asm__ __volatile__("sync" ::: "memory")
145. #elif defined(__riscv) && (__riscv_xlen == 64)
146. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() \
147.     __asm__ __volatile__("fence iorw, iorw" ::: "memory")
148. #else
149. /* Fallback: combine store + load fences. Not strictly load→store on all
150.  * archs but better than nothing; build will warn so the porter notices. */
151. #warning "obmm: no full bus fence for this arch; receiver tail release ordering may be weak"
152. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() do { \
153.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();        \
154.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();       \
155. } while (0)
156. #endif
157. 
158. #endif
159.
```

```
52.     uint32_t bitmap_words;      /* number of u64 words in alloc bitmap */
53.     uint32_t initializer_pid;   /* pid that owned the INITING transition */
54.     uint64_t initializer_starttime;
55.     uint64_t reserved[2];
56.     /* followed by:
57.      *   uint64_t alloc_bitmap[bitmap_words];
58.      *   uct_obmm_slot_meta_t slot_meta[slot_count];
59.      */

67.     uint32_t generation;       /* monotonically increasing; bumped on free,

104.                                   uint32_t slot_count, uint32_t slot_size,
```

```
11. #include <ucs/sys/compiler.h>
```
