18. /* Element flags carried in the shared FIFO element header. */
19. enum {
20.     /* Toggled every FIFO wraparound; receiver uses this to detect a freshly
21.      * written element without taking a tail/head delta lock. */
22.     UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER = UCS_BIT(0),
23. 
24.     /* Set by senders that wrote via am_bcopy (pack_cb output stored in the
25.      * payload area starting at elem+1, with NO 8-byte am_short header
26.      * prefix). When clear, the element was written via am_short and
27.      * &elem->header + length covers the [hdr][payload] buffer. */
28.     UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_BCOPY = UCS_BIT(1)
29. };
30. 
31. 
32. /* Per-slot FIFO control header. Lives at offset 0 of every allocated slot in
33.  * the obmm pool. The producer atomically FAA-s `head` to claim an element;
34.  * the consumer reads `tail` to release space. Both fields are accessed via
35.  * non-cacheable mappings, therefore all updates must be paired with bus
36.  * fences (ucs_memory_bus_*_fence), not CPU fences. */
37. typedef struct uct_obmm_fifo_ctl {
38.     /* 1st cacheline: producer-touched */
39.     volatile uint64_t head;
40.     UCS_CACHELINE_PADDING(uint64_t);
41. 
42.     /* 2nd cacheline: consumer-touched */
43.     volatile uint64_t tail;
44.     UCS_CACHELINE_PADDING(uint64_t);
45. } UCS_V_ALIGNED(UCS_SYS_CACHE_LINE_SIZE) uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t;
46. 
47. 
48. /* FIFO element header. The element body (am short header + payload) follows
49.  * immediately. Total element stride is iface->config.fifo_elem_size, which
50.  * the iface chooses so that header+payload <= elem_size. */
51. typedef struct uct_obmm_fifo_element {
52.     uint8_t  flags;       /* UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_xx */
53.     uint8_t  am_id;       /* active message id */
54.     uint16_t length;      /* payload length (excluding am_short header) */
55.     uint32_t generation;  /* owner-slot generation token; receiver discards
56.                              elements whose generation doesn't match the
57.                              slot's current meta.generation */
58.     uint64_t header;      /* am_short 64-bit header */
59.     /* payload[length] follows here */
60. } UCS_S_PACKED uct_obmm_fifo_element_t;
61. 
62. 
63. /* Compute slot stride: control header + fifo_size * elem_size + (v2)
64.  * fifo_size * bcopy_seg_size, cacheline aligned so that adjacent slots
65.  * don't share a line. Returned as size_t; callers must validate the
66.  * result fits in the uint32_t pool_hdr->slot_size field before passing
67.  * to pool_attach. */
68. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE size_t
69. uct_obmm_slot_stride(unsigned fifo_size, unsigned fifo_elem_size,
70.                      unsigned bcopy_seg_size)
71. {
72.     return ucs_align_up(sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t) +
73.                         ((size_t)fifo_size * fifo_elem_size) +
74.                         ((size_t)fifo_size * bcopy_seg_size),
75.                         UCS_SYS_CACHE_LINE_SIZE);
76. }
77. 
78. 
79. /* Get FIFO control header pointer from a slot base pointer. */
80. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t*
81. uct_obmm_slot_ctl(void *slot_base)
82. {
83.     return (uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t*)slot_base;
84. }
85. 
86. 
87. /* Get FIFO elements array pointer from a slot base pointer. */
88. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void*
89. uct_obmm_slot_elems(void *slot_base)
90. {
91.     return UCS_PTR_BYTE_OFFSET(slot_base, sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t));
92. }
93. 
94. 
95. /* Get bcopy desc array pointer from a slot base pointer. The desc area
96.  * lives immediately after the FIFO element array. Each desc is
97.  * `bcopy_seg_size` bytes; index N is paired 1:1 with FIFO element N. */
98. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void*
99. uct_obmm_slot_descs(void *slot_base, unsigned fifo_size,
100.                     unsigned fifo_elem_size)
101. {
102.     return UCS_PTR_BYTE_OFFSET(slot_base,
103.                                sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t) +
104.                                ((size_t)fifo_size * fifo_elem_size));
105. }
106. 
107. 
108. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE uct_obmm_fifo_element_t*
109. uct_obmm_slot_elem(void *elems, uint64_t index, unsigned mask,
110.                    unsigned elem_size)
111. {
112.     return (uct_obmm_fifo_element_t*)
113.            UCS_PTR_BYTE_OFFSET(elems, (size_t)(index & mask) * elem_size);
114. }
115. 
116. 
117. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void*
118. uct_obmm_slot_desc(void *descs, uint64_t index, unsigned mask,
119.                    unsigned seg_size)
120. {
121.     return UCS_PTR_BYTE_OFFSET(descs, (size_t)(index & mask) * seg_size);
122. }

125. /* Full bus-domain fence: orders ALL prior memory accesses (loads and
126.  * stores) before ALL subsequent memory accesses, in the outer-shareable /
127.  * device domain that includes cross-host obmm peers.
128.  *
129.  * Why we need this in addition to ucs_memory_bus_{store,load}_fence:
130.  * the receiver must order its desc[N] LOADS (issued during the AM
131.  * handler) before the STORE that publishes the new tail. On ARM64,
132.  * ucs_memory_bus_store_fence() is `dmb oshst` (store→store only) and
133.  * does not order prior loads. Without this load→store barrier, a sender
134.  * could observe the advanced tail and overwrite desc[N] while the
135.  * receiver still has outstanding loads from the previous lap's payload.
136.  *
137.  * Defined locally in obmm rather than added to ucs/arch to keep the
138.  * change inside ucx/src/uct/obmm/ per AGENTS.md. */
139. #if defined(__aarch64__)
140. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() __asm__ __volatile__("dmb osh" ::: "memory")
141. #elif defined(__x86_64__) || defined(__i386__)
142. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() __asm__ __volatile__("mfence" ::: "memory")
143. #elif defined(__powerpc64__)
144. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() __asm__ __volatile__("sync" ::: "memory")
145. #elif defined(__riscv) && (__riscv_xlen == 64)
146. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() \
147.     __asm__ __volatile__("fence iorw, iorw" ::: "memory")
148. #else
149. /* Fallback: combine store + load fences. Not strictly load→store on all
150.  * archs but better than nothing; build will warn so the porter notices. */
151. #warning "obmm: no full bus fence for this arch; receiver tail release ordering may be weak"
152. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() do { \
153.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();        \
154.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();       \
155. } while (0)
156. #endif
157. 
158. #endif

26. static UCS_CLASS_INIT_FUNC(uct_obmm_ep_t, const uct_ep_params_t *params)
27. {
28.     uct_obmm_iface_t             *iface = ucs_derived_of(params->iface,
29.                                                          uct_obmm_iface_t);
30.     uct_obmm_md_t                *md    = ucs_derived_of(iface->super.md,
31.                                                          uct_obmm_md_t);
32.     const uct_obmm_device_addr_t *daddr;
33.     const uct_obmm_iface_addr_t  *iaddr;
34.     uct_obmm_region_t            *region;
35.     uct_obmm_pool_t               peer_pool;
36.     void                         *peer_slot;
37.     ucs_status_t                  status;
38. 
39.     UCT_EP_PARAMS_CHECK_DEV_IFACE_ADDRS(params);
40.     UCS_CLASS_CALL_SUPER_INIT(uct_base_ep_t, &iface->super);
41. 
42.     ucs_arbiter_group_init(&self->arb_group);
43. 
44.     daddr = (const uct_obmm_device_addr_t*)params->dev_addr;
45.     iaddr = (const uct_obmm_iface_addr_t*)params->iface_addr;
46. 
47.     /* Reject incompatible geometry. UCX wireup should already have filtered
48.      * this out via is_reachable_v2, but double-check. */
49.     if ((iaddr->fifo_size != iface->fifo_size) ||
50.         (iaddr->fifo_elem_size != iface->fifo_elem_size) ||
51.         (iaddr->bcopy_seg_size != iface->bcopy_seg_size)) {
52.         ucs_error("obmm: peer geometry (fifo=%u elem=%u seg=%u) differs from "
53.                   "local (fifo=%u elem=%u seg=%u); ep_create rejected",
54.                   iaddr->fifo_size, iaddr->fifo_elem_size,
55.                   iaddr->bcopy_seg_size,
56.                   iface->fifo_size, iface->fifo_elem_size,
57.                   iface->bcopy_seg_size);
58.         return UCS_ERR_UNREACHABLE;
59.     }
60. 
61.     /* Find the local region (export-for-self, import-for-remote) that maps
62.      * the peer's exporter coordinates. */
63.     {
64.         uct_obmm_region_t *exp_r;
65.         uct_obmm_eid_t     eid;
66. 
67.         eid.hi = daddr->exporter_deid_hi;
68.         eid.lo = daddr->exporter_deid_lo;
69. 
70.         exp_r  = uct_obmm_md_export_region(md);
71.         region = NULL;
72.         if ((exp_r != NULL) &&
73.             (exp_r->info.exporter_dcna == daddr->exporter_dcna) &&
74.             (exp_r->info.exporter_deid.hi == eid.hi) &&
75.             (exp_r->info.exporter_deid.lo == eid.lo)) {
76.             region = exp_r;
77.         } else {
78.             region = uct_obmm_md_find_import_region(md, daddr->exporter_dcna,
79.                                                     &eid);
80.         }
81.     }
82.     if (region == NULL) {
83.         ucs_error("obmm: ep_create cannot find region for peer "
84.                   "dcna=0x%lx deid=0x%lx:0x%lx",
85.                   (unsigned long)daddr->exporter_dcna,
86.                   (unsigned long)daddr->exporter_deid_hi,
87.                   (unsigned long)daddr->exporter_deid_lo);
88.         return UCS_ERR_UNREACHABLE;
89.     }
90. 
91.     status = uct_obmm_pool_open(region->base, region->length, &peer_pool);
92.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
93.         ucs_error("obmm: failed to open peer pool: %s",
94.                   ucs_status_string(status));
95.         return status;
96.     }
97. 
98.     if (iaddr->slot_index >= peer_pool.slot_count) {
99.         ucs_error("obmm: peer slot_index %u out of range (slot_count=%u)",
100.                   iaddr->slot_index, peer_pool.slot_count);
101.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
102.     }
103. 
104.     if (peer_pool.slot_size !=
105.         uct_obmm_slot_stride(iaddr->fifo_size, iaddr->fifo_elem_size,
106.                              iaddr->bcopy_seg_size)) {
107.         ucs_error("obmm: peer pool slot_size %u inconsistent with iface_addr "
108.                   "geometry (fifo=%u elem=%u seg=%u)",
109.                   peer_pool.slot_size, iaddr->fifo_size,
110.                   iaddr->fifo_elem_size, iaddr->bcopy_seg_size);
111.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
112.     }
113. 
114.     peer_slot = uct_obmm_pool_slot_ptr(&peer_pool, iaddr->slot_index);
115. 
116.     self->peer_ctl            = uct_obmm_slot_ctl(peer_slot);
117.     self->peer_elems          = uct_obmm_slot_elems(peer_slot);
118.     self->peer_descs          = uct_obmm_slot_descs(peer_slot,
119.                                                     iaddr->fifo_size,
120.                                                     iaddr->fifo_elem_size);
121.     self->cached_tail         = self->peer_ctl->tail;
122.     self->expected_generation = iaddr->generation;
123.     self->fifo_size           = iaddr->fifo_size;
124.     self->fifo_mask           = iaddr->fifo_size - 1u;
125.     self->fifo_elem_size      = iaddr->fifo_elem_size;
126.     self->bcopy_seg_size      = iaddr->bcopy_seg_size;
127.     self->peer_dcna           = daddr->exporter_dcna;
128.     self->peer_deid_hi        = daddr->exporter_deid_hi;
129.     self->peer_deid_lo        = daddr->exporter_deid_lo;
130.     self->peer_slot_index     = iaddr->slot_index;
131.     self->peer_pid            = iaddr->pid;
132.     return UCS_OK;
133. }

136. {

138.      * before the iface tears down its arbiter. mm follows the same

149. int uct_obmm_ep_is_connected(const uct_ep_h tl_ep,
150.                              const uct_ep_is_connected_params_t *params)
151. {
152.     const uct_obmm_ep_t          *ep = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep, uct_obmm_ep_t);
153.     const uct_obmm_device_addr_t *daddr;
154.     const uct_obmm_iface_addr_t  *iaddr;
155. 
156.     if (!uct_base_ep_is_connected(tl_ep, params)) {
157.         return 0;
158.     }
159. 
160.     daddr = (const uct_obmm_device_addr_t*)params->device_addr;
161.     iaddr = (const uct_obmm_iface_addr_t*)params->iface_addr;
162.     if ((daddr == NULL) || (iaddr == NULL)) {
163.         return 0;
164.     }
165. 
166.     return (daddr->exporter_dcna == ep->peer_dcna) &&
167.            (daddr->exporter_deid_hi == ep->peer_deid_hi) &&
168.            (daddr->exporter_deid_lo == ep->peer_deid_lo) &&
169.            (iaddr->slot_index == ep->peer_slot_index) &&
170.            (iaddr->generation == ep->expected_generation);
171. }

173. 
174. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_ep_am_short(uct_ep_h tl_ep, uint8_t id, uint64_t header,
175.                                   const void *payload, unsigned length)
176. {
177.     uct_obmm_ep_t           *ep    = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep, uct_obmm_ep_t);
178.     uct_obmm_iface_t        *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep->iface,
179.                                                     uct_obmm_iface_t);
180.     size_t                   payload_total = sizeof(header) + length;
181.     uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem;
182.     uint64_t                 head;
183.     uint8_t                  owner_bit;
184. 
185.     UCT_CHECK_AM_ID(id);
186.     UCT_CHECK_LENGTH(payload_total, 0,
187.                      ep->fifo_elem_size - sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_element_t),
188.                      "am_short");
189. 
190.     /* Reserve a slot in the peer's FIFO via load + CAS. FAA cannot be used:
191.      * if FAA succeeds but the FIFO turns out to be full, the bumped head
192.      * value can never be rolled back across hosts, leaving a permanent gap
193.      * the receiver will block on (its progress loop walks slots in order
194.      * and stops at any slot whose owner bit hasn't flipped). CAS lets us
195.      * decide capacity *before* committing the head bump.
196.      *
197.      * Multiple senders (across processes / hosts) compete on the same head
198.      * cell, so we retry on CAS miss. */
199.     for (;;) {
200.         head = ep->peer_ctl->head;
201. 
202.         if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
203.             ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
204.             ep->cached_tail = ep->peer_ctl->tail;
205.             if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
206.                 UCS_STATS_UPDATE_COUNTER(ep->super.stats, UCT_EP_STAT_NO_RES,
207.                                          1);
208.                 return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
209.             }
210.         }
211. 
212.         if (ucs_atomic_bool_cswap64(&ep->peer_ctl->head, head, head + 1)) {
213.             break;
214.         }
215.         /* Lost the race; another sender claimed this slot. Retry. */
216.     }
217. 
218.     elem = uct_obmm_slot_elem(ep->peer_elems, head, ep->fifo_mask,
219.                               ep->fifo_elem_size);
220. 
221.     elem->am_id      = id;
222.     elem->length     = (uint16_t)payload_total;
223.     elem->generation = ep->expected_generation;
224.     elem->header     = header;
225.     if (length > 0) {
226.         memcpy(elem + 1, payload, length);
227.     }
228. 
229.     /* Publish: the OWNER bit toggles each wraparound. The receiver expects
230.      * bit==1 on even passes and bit==0 on odd passes (and vice versa) so
231.      * that uninitialized memory (zero) reads as "not yet written" on the
232.      * first pass. */
233.     owner_bit = ((head / ep->fifo_size) & 1u) ? 0u : UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER;
234. 
235.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
236.     elem->flags = owner_bit;
237. 
238.     UCT_TL_EP_STAT_OP(&ep->super, AM, SHORT, payload_total);
239.     uct_iface_trace_am(&iface->super, UCT_AM_TRACE_TYPE_SEND, id,
240.                        &header, payload_total, "TX: AM_SHORT");
241.     return UCS_OK;
242. }
243. 
244. 
245. /* Reserve one slot in the peer's FIFO, returning the head index that was
246.  * claimed. See am_short above for why load+CAS (not FAA). */
247. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE ucs_status_t
248. uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot(uct_obmm_ep_t *ep, uint64_t *head_p)
249. {
250.     uint64_t head;
251. 
252.     for (;;) {
253.         head = ep->peer_ctl->head;
254. 
255.         if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
256.             ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
257.             ep->cached_tail = ep->peer_ctl->tail;
258.             if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
259.                 UCS_STATS_UPDATE_COUNTER(ep->super.stats, UCT_EP_STAT_NO_RES,
260.                                          1);
261.                 return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
262.             }
263.         }
264. 
265.         if (ucs_atomic_bool_cswap64(&ep->peer_ctl->head, head, head + 1)) {
266.             *head_p = head;
267.             return UCS_OK;
268.         }
269.     }
270. }

272. 
273. ssize_t uct_obmm_ep_am_bcopy(uct_ep_h tl_ep, uint8_t id,
274.                              uct_pack_callback_t pack_cb, void *arg,
275.                              unsigned flags)
276. {
277.     uct_obmm_ep_t           *ep    = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep, uct_obmm_ep_t);
278.     uct_obmm_iface_t        *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep->iface,
279.                                                     uct_obmm_iface_t);
280.     uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem;
281.     void                    *desc;
282.     uint64_t                 head;
283.     size_t                   length;
284.     uint8_t                  owner_bit;
285.     ucs_status_t             status;
286. 
287.     /* flags (UCT_SEND_FLAG_PEER_CHECK etc.) are ignored: this transport
288.      * does not advertise EP_CHECK / keepalive in v1. */
289.     (void)flags;
290. 
291.     UCT_CHECK_AM_ID(id);
292. 
293.     status = uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot(ep, &head);
294.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
295.         return status;
296.     }
297. 
298.     elem = uct_obmm_slot_elem(ep->peer_elems, head, ep->fifo_mask,
299.                               ep->fifo_elem_size);
300.     desc = uct_obmm_slot_desc(ep->peer_descs, head, ep->fifo_mask,
301.                               ep->bcopy_seg_size);
302. 
303.     /* pack_cb writes pack_cb_ret bytes directly into the paired desc[N]
304.      * area. UCP guarantees pack_cb_ret <= cap.am.max_bcopy, which we set
305.      * to bcopy_seg_size. The asserts catch buggy direct UCT users in
306.      * debug builds; production safety relies on the iface cap contract. */
307.     length = pack_cb(desc, arg);
308.     ucs_assertv(length <= ep->bcopy_seg_size,
309.                 "obmm: pack_cb returned %zu > bcopy_seg_size=%u",
310.                 length, ep->bcopy_seg_size);
311.     ucs_assertv(length <= UINT16_MAX,
312.                 "obmm: pack_cb returned %zu > UINT16_MAX", length);
313. 
314.     elem->am_id      = id;
315.     elem->length     = (uint16_t)length;
316.     elem->generation = ep->expected_generation;
317.     elem->header     = 0; /* unused for bcopy */
318. 
319.     owner_bit = ((head / ep->fifo_size) & 1u) ? 0u :
320.                                                 UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER;
321. 
322.     /* Release barrier: orders the desc[N] payload writes AND elem header
323.      * writes BEFORE the flags publish. Receiver pairs with bus_load_fence
324.      * after observing the flags byte. */
325.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
326.     elem->flags = owner_bit | UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_BCOPY;
327. 
328.     UCT_TL_EP_STAT_OP(&ep->super, AM, BCOPY, length);
329.     uct_iface_trace_am(&iface->super, UCT_AM_TRACE_TYPE_SEND, id,
330.                        desc, length, "TX: AM_BCOPY");
331.     return (ssize_t)length;
332. }
333. 
334. 
335. /* Returns true iff the peer's FIFO has at least one free slot, refreshing
336.  * cached_tail (with a bus_load_fence pair) before declaring "full". Mirrors
337.  * the resource check used by mm in pending_add. */
338. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE int
339. uct_obmm_ep_has_tx_resource(uct_obmm_ep_t *ep)
340. {
341.     uint64_t head = ep->peer_ctl->head;
342. 
343.     if ((head - ep->cached_tail) < ep->fifo_size) {
344.         return 1;
345.     }
346.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
347.     ep->cached_tail = ep->peer_ctl->tail;
348.     return (head - ep->cached_tail) < ep->fifo_size;
349. }
350. 
351. 
352. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_ep_pending_add(uct_ep_h tl_ep, uct_pending_req_t *n,
353.                                      unsigned flags)
354. {
355.     uct_obmm_ep_t    *ep    = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep, uct_obmm_ep_t);
356.     uct_obmm_iface_t *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep->iface, uct_obmm_iface_t);
357. 
358.     (void)flags;
359. 
360.     /* Resources may have appeared between the failed send and this call;
361.      * tell UCP to retry directly instead of queueing. mm uses the same
362.      * pattern (mm_ep.c:452-456). */
363.     if (uct_obmm_ep_has_tx_resource(ep)) {
364.         ucs_assert(ucs_arbiter_group_is_empty(&ep->arb_group));
365.         return UCS_ERR_BUSY;
366.     }
367. 
368.     UCS_STATIC_ASSERT(sizeof(uct_pending_req_priv_arb_t) <=
369.                       UCT_PENDING_REQ_PRIV_LEN);
370.     uct_pending_req_arb_group_push(&ep->arb_group, n);
371.     ucs_arbiter_group_schedule(&iface->arbiter, &ep->arb_group);
372.     UCT_TL_EP_STAT_PEND(&ep->super);
373. 
374.     return UCS_OK;
375. }
376. 
377. 
378. ucs_arbiter_cb_result_t
379. uct_obmm_ep_process_pending(ucs_arbiter_t *arbiter, ucs_arbiter_group_t *group,
380.                             ucs_arbiter_elem_t *elem, void *arg)
381. {
382.     uct_obmm_ep_t     *ep    = ucs_container_of(group, uct_obmm_ep_t, arb_group);
383.     unsigned          *count = (unsigned*)arg;
384.     uct_pending_req_t *req;
385.     ucs_status_t       status;
386. 
387.     /* Refresh cached tail so the request callback's am_short/am_bcopy sees
388.      * the freshest peer state and is not falsely starved. */
389.     if (!uct_obmm_ep_has_tx_resource(ep)) {
390.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_RESCHED_GROUP;
391.     }
392. 
393.     req    = ucs_container_of(elem, uct_pending_req_t, priv);
394.     status = req->func(req);
395. 
396.     if (status == UCS_OK) {
397.         ++(*count);
398.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_REMOVE_ELEM;
399.     } else if (status == UCS_INPROGRESS) {
400.         ++(*count);
401.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_NEXT_GROUP;
402.     }
403. 
404.     /* NO_RESOURCE (or any other transient): keep the request and try
405.      * again the next time iface_progress runs. */
406.     return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_RESCHED_GROUP;
407. }

180.         return 0;

182. 
183.     if ((iaddr->fifo_size != iface->fifo_size) ||
184.         (iaddr->fifo_elem_size != iface->fifo_elem_size) ||
185.         (iaddr->bcopy_seg_size != iface->bcopy_seg_size)) {
186.         uct_iface_fill_info_str_buf(params,
187.                                     "incompatible OBMM geometry "
188.                                     "(peer fifo=%u elem=%u seg=%u, "
189.                                     "local fifo=%u elem=%u seg=%u)",
190.                                     iaddr->fifo_size, iaddr->fifo_elem_size,
191.                                     iaddr->bcopy_seg_size,
192.                                     iface->fifo_size, iface->fifo_elem_size,
193.                                     iface->bcopy_seg_size);
194.         return 0;
195.     }
196. 
197.     eid.hi = daddr->exporter_deid_hi;
198.     eid.lo = daddr->exporter_deid_lo;
199. 
200.     export_r = uct_obmm_md_export_region(md);
201.     if ((export_r != NULL) &&
202.         (export_r->info.exporter_dcna == daddr->exporter_dcna) &&
203.         (export_r->info.exporter_deid.hi == eid.hi) &&
204.         (export_r->info.exporter_deid.lo == eid.lo)) {
205.         return uct_iface_scope_is_reachable(tl_iface, params);
206.     }
207. 
208.     if (uct_obmm_md_find_import_region(md, daddr->exporter_dcna, &eid) != NULL) {
209.         return uct_iface_scope_is_reachable(tl_iface, params);
210.     }
211. 
212.     uct_iface_fill_info_str_buf(params,
213.                                 "no mapped region for peer dcna=0x%lx "
214.                                 "deid=0x%lx:0x%lx",
215.                                 (unsigned long)daddr->exporter_dcna,
216.                                 (unsigned long)eid.hi, (unsigned long)eid.lo);
217.     return 0;
218. }

221. static unsigned uct_obmm_iface_progress(uct_iface_h tl_iface)
222. {
223.     uct_obmm_iface_t        *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_iface, uct_obmm_iface_t);
224.     unsigned                 polled = 0;
225.     uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem;
226.     uint8_t                  flags;
227.     uint8_t                  expected_owner;
228.     size_t                   max_poll = iface->fifo_max_poll;
229. 
230.     while (polled < max_poll) {
231.         elem = uct_obmm_slot_elem(iface->recv_elems, iface->read_index,
232.                                   iface->fifo_mask, iface->fifo_elem_size);
233. 
234.         /* Owner bit alternates each lap of the ring; pass 0 expects 1, pass
235.          * 1 expects 0, etc. Combined with zero-fill on slot allocation, this
236.          * means an unwritten slot reads as flags==0 and is correctly skipped
237.          * on the very first lap. */
238.         expected_owner = ((iface->read_index / iface->fifo_size) & 1u) ?
239.                          0u : UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER;
240. 
241.         flags = elem->flags;
242.         if ((flags & UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER) != expected_owner) {
243.             break;
244.         }
245. 
246.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
247. 
248.         if (elem->generation != iface->generation) {
249.             /* Stale write from a previous slot owner (we were torn down and
250.              * re-allocated this slot). Drop silently. */
251.             ucs_trace_data("obmm: drop stale elem (gen=%u expected=%u) "
252.                            "at idx=%lu", elem->generation, iface->generation,
253.                            (unsigned long)iface->read_index);
254.         } else if (flags & UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_BCOPY) {
255.             /* am_bcopy: payload is in the paired desc[N], not in the FIFO
256.              * element body. The bus_load_fence above orders this load
257.              * with respect to the sender's bus_store_fence + flag write. */
258.             void *desc = uct_obmm_slot_desc(iface->recv_descs,
259.                                             iface->read_index,
260.                                             iface->fifo_mask,
261.                                             iface->bcopy_seg_size);
262.             uct_iface_invoke_am(&iface->super, elem->am_id,
263.                                 desc, elem->length, 0);
264.         } else {
265.             /* am_short: contiguous [header(8B)][payload] starting at
266.              * &elem->header. elem->length already includes the 8B header. */
267.             uct_iface_invoke_am(&iface->super, elem->am_id,
268.                                 &elem->header, elem->length, 0);
269.         }
270. 
271.         iface->read_index++;
272.         polled++;
273.     }
274. 
275.     if (polled > 0) {
276.         /* Full bus fence: orders the AM handler's LOADS from desc[]/elem
277.          * payload BEFORE the STORE that publishes the new tail. A plain
278.          * bus_store_fence (e.g. dmb oshst on aarch64) only orders
279.          * store→store, which would let a sender observe the advanced
280.          * tail and overwrite desc[N] while we still have outstanding
281.          * loads in flight. See obmm_fifo.h:uct_obmm_bus_full_fence. */
282.         uct_obmm_bus_full_fence();
283.         iface->recv_ctl->tail = iface->read_index;
284.     }
285. 
286.     /* Drain any UCP requests waiting on TX backpressure. The peer-side
287.      * tail advance we just published may also have freed slots that *our*
288.      * pending eps have been waiting for; dispatch with a fresh head/tail
289.      * snapshot so retries see the latest state. Without this dispatch,
290.      * UCS_ERR_BUSY-only pending_add caused a livelock under symmetric
291.      * bidirectional load (osu_bibw at size==BCOPY_SEG_SIZE). */
292.     ucs_arbiter_dispatch(&iface->arbiter, 1, uct_obmm_ep_process_pending,
293.                          &polled);
294. 
295.     return polled;
296. }

41. /* In-region pool header. Lives at offset 0 of the local export region. All
42.  * fields are written via non-cacheable mappings: state transitions must be
43.  * paired with ucs_memory_bus_store_fence so peers (potentially on another
44.  * host) see the geometry before the READY transition. */
45. typedef struct uct_obmm_pool_hdr {
46.     uint64_t magic;             /* UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC */
47.     uint32_t version;           /* UCT_OBMM_POOL_VERSION */
48.     uint32_t state;             /* UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_xx, atomic */
49.     uint32_t slot_count;
50.     uint32_t slot_size;
51.     uint64_t slot_array_offset; /* offset (from region base) of slot 0 */
52.     uint32_t bitmap_words;      /* number of u64 words in alloc bitmap */
53.     uint32_t initializer_pid;   /* pid that owned the INITING transition */
54.     uint64_t initializer_starttime;
55.     uint64_t reserved[2];
56.     /* followed by:
57.      *   uint64_t alloc_bitmap[bitmap_words];
58.      *   uct_obmm_slot_meta_t slot_meta[slot_count];
59.      */
60. } uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t;

63. /* Per-slot ownership metadata. Stored adjacent to the bitmap, separate from
64.  * the slot's actual FIFO contents. */
65. typedef struct uct_obmm_slot_meta {

67.     uint32_t generation;       /* monotonically increasing; bumped on free,
68.                                   scavenge, and when readers must discard
69.                                   in-flight stale elements */
70.     uint32_t owner_pid;
71.     uint32_t reserved;
72.     uint64_t owner_starttime;  /* /proc/<pid>/stat field 22, for liveness */
73. } uct_obmm_slot_meta_t;

229. static inline ucs_status_t
230. uct_mm_ep_get_remote_elem(uct_mm_ep_t *ep, uint64_t head,
231.                           uct_mm_fifo_element_t **elem)
232. {
233.     uct_mm_iface_t *iface = ucs_derived_of(ep->super.super.iface, uct_mm_iface_t);
234.     uint64_t new_head, prev_head;
235.     uint64_t elem_index;   /* index of the element to write */
236. 
237.     elem_index = head & iface->fifo_mask;
238.     *elem      = UCT_MM_IFACE_GET_FIFO_ELEM(iface, ep->fifo_elems, elem_index);
239.     new_head   = (head + 1) & ~UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_HEAD_EVENT_ARMED;
240. 
241.     /* try to get ownership of the head element */
242.     prev_head = ucs_atomic_cswap64(ucs_unaligned_ptr(&ep->fifo_ctl->head), head,
243.                                    new_head);
244.     if (prev_head != head) {
245.         return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
246.     }
247. 
248.     return UCS_OK;
249. }

315.     if (status != UCS_OK) {

317.         ucs_trace_poll("couldn't get an available FIFO element. retrying");
318.         goto retry;
319.     }
320. 
321.     switch (send_op) {

323.         /* write to the remote FIFO */

325.                                UCS_ARCH_MEMCPY_NT_DEST);
326. 
327.         elem_flags   = UCT_MM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_INLINE;
328.         elem->length = length + sizeof(header);
329. 
330.         uct_mm_iface_trace_am(iface, UCT_AM_TRACE_TYPE_SEND, elem_flags, am_id,
331.                               elem + 1, elem->length,
332.                               head & ~UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_HEAD_EVENT_ARMED);
333.         UCT_TL_EP_STAT_OP(&ep->super, AM, SHORT, sizeof(header) + length);

340.         if (ucs_unlikely(status != UCS_OK)) {
341.             return status;
342.         }
343. 
344.         desc_data    = UCS_PTR_BYTE_OFFSET(base_address, elem->desc.offset);

346.         elem_flags   = 0;
347.         elem->length = length;
348. 
349.         uct_mm_iface_trace_am(iface, UCT_AM_TRACE_TYPE_SEND, elem_flags, am_id,
350.                               desc_data, elem->length,
351.                               head & ~UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_HEAD_EVENT_ARMED);
352.         UCT_TL_EP_STAT_OP(&ep->super, AM, BCOPY, length);
353.         break;
354.     case UCT_MM_SEND_AM_SHORT_IOV:
355.         elem_flags   = UCT_MM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_INLINE;
356.         ucs_iov_iter_init(&iov_iter);
357.         elem->length = uct_iov_to_buffer(iov, iovcnt, &iov_iter, elem + 1,
358.                                          SIZE_MAX);
359. 
360.         uct_mm_iface_trace_am(iface, UCT_AM_TRACE_TYPE_SEND, elem_flags, am_id,
361.                               elem + 1, elem->length,
362.                               head & ~UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_HEAD_EVENT_ARMED);
363.         UCT_TL_EP_STAT_OP(&ep->super, AM, SHORT, elem->length);

386.     switch (send_op) {

388.     case UCT_MM_SEND_AM_SHORT_IOV:

390.     case UCT_MM_SEND_AM_BCOPY:
391.         return length;
392.     default:

400. static unsigned uct_mm_iface_progress(uct_iface_h tl_iface)
401. {
402.     uct_mm_iface_t *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_iface, uct_mm_iface_t);
403.     unsigned total_count  = 0;
404.     unsigned count;
405. 
406.     ucs_assert(iface->fifo_poll_count >= UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_MIN_POLL);
407. 
408.     /* progress receive */

410.         count = uct_mm_iface_poll_fifo(iface);
411.         ucs_assert(count < 2);
412.         total_count += count;
413.         ucs_assert(total_count < UINT_MAX);
414.     } while ((count != 0) && (total_count < iface->fifo_poll_count));
415. 
416.     uct_mm_iface_fifo_window_adjust(iface, total_count);
417. 
418.     /* progress the pending sends (if there are any) */
419.     ucs_arbiter_dispatch(&iface->arbiter, 1, uct_mm_ep_process_pending,
420.                          &total_count);
421.

432. static ucs_status_t
433. uct_mm_iface_event_fd_arm(uct_iface_h tl_iface, unsigned events)
434. {
435.     uct_mm_iface_t *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_iface, uct_mm_iface_t);
436.     char dummy[UCT_MM_IFACE_MAX_SIG_EVENTS]; /* pop multiple signals at once */
437.     uint64_t head, prev_head;
438.     int ret;
439. 
440.     if ((events & UCT_EVENT_SEND_COMP) &&
441.         !ucs_arbiter_is_empty(&iface->arbiter)) {
442.         /* if we have outstanding send operations, can't go to sleep */
443.         return UCS_ERR_BUSY;
444.     }
445. 
446.     if (!(events & UCT_EVENT_RECV)) {
447.         /* Nothing to do anymore */
448.         return UCS_OK;
449.     }
450. 
451.     /* Make the next sender which writes to the FIFO signal the receiver */
452.     head = iface->recv_fifo_ctl->head;
453.     if ((head & ~UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_HEAD_EVENT_ARMED) > iface->read_index) {
454.         /* head element was not read yet */
455.         ucs_trace("iface %p: cannot arm, head %" PRIu64 " read_index %" PRIu64,
456.                   iface, head & ~UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_HEAD_EVENT_ARMED,
457.                   iface->read_index);
458.         return UCS_ERR_BUSY;
459.     }
460. 
461.     if (!(head & UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_HEAD_EVENT_ARMED)) {
462.         /* Try to mark the head index as armed in an atomic way; fail if any
463.            sender managed to update the head at the same time */
464.         prev_head = ucs_atomic_cswap64(
465.                 ucs_unaligned_ptr(&iface->recv_fifo_ctl->head), head,
466.                 head | UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_HEAD_EVENT_ARMED);
467.         if (prev_head != head) {
468.             /* race with sender; need to retry */
469.             ucs_assert(!(prev_head & UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_HEAD_EVENT_ARMED));
470.             ucs_trace("iface %p: cannot arm, head %" PRIu64
471.                       " prev_head %" PRIu64,
472.                       iface, head, prev_head);
473.             return UCS_ERR_BUSY;
474.         }
475.     }
476. 
477.     /* check for pending events */
478.     ret = recvfrom(iface->signal_fd, &dummy, sizeof(dummy), 0, NULL, 0);
479.     if (ret > 0) {
480.         ucs_trace("iface %p: cannot arm, got a signal", iface);
481.         return UCS_ERR_BUSY;
482.     } else if (ret == -1) {
483.         if (errno == EAGAIN) {
484.             ucs_trace("iface %p: armed head %" PRIu64 " read_index %" PRIu64,
485.                       iface, head & ~UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_HEAD_EVENT_ARMED,
486.                       iface->read_index);
487.             return UCS_OK;
488.         } else if (errno == EINTR) {
489.             return UCS_ERR_BUSY;
490.         } else {
491.             ucs_error("iface %p: failed to retrieve message from socket: %m",
492.                       iface);
493.             return UCS_ERR_IO_ERROR;
494.         }
495.     } else {
496.         ucs_assert(ret == 0);
497.         ucs_trace("iface %p: remote socket closed", iface);
498.         return UCS_ERR_CONNECTION_RESET;
499.     }
500. }

27. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE size_t
28. uct_obmm_pool_bitmap_words(uint32_t slot_count)
29. {
30.     return (slot_count + 63u) / 64u;
31. }

35. {

37.            uct_obmm_pool_bitmap_words(slot_count) * sizeof(uint64_t);
38. }

42. {
43.     return ucs_align_up(uct_obmm_pool_meta_offset(slot_count) +
44.                         (size_t)slot_count * sizeof(uct_obmm_slot_meta_t),

52.            (size_t)slot_count * slot_size;

56. static int uct_obmm_proc_alive(uint32_t pid, uint64_t starttime)
57. {
58.     unsigned long live;
59. 
60.     if (pid == 0) {
61.         return 0;
62.     }
63. 
64.     live = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time((pid_t)pid);
65.     if (live == 0ul) {
66.         /* /proc/<pid>/stat unreadable: pid does not exist any more */
67.         return 0;
68.     }
69. 
70.     return (uint64_t)live == starttime;
71. }

73. 
74. /* CAS-claim the INITING transition; if we lose, wait until READY (or
75.  * recover the slot if the prior initializer died mid-init). */
76. static ucs_status_t
77. uct_obmm_pool_init_or_wait(uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t *hdr, uint32_t slot_count,
78.                            uint32_t slot_size)
79. {
80.     unsigned long      self_starttime = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time(getpid());
81.     uint32_t           prev;
82.     unsigned           spin;
83.     size_t             bitmap_words = uct_obmm_pool_bitmap_words(slot_count);
84.     size_t             slot_off     = uct_obmm_pool_slot_offset(slot_count);
85. 
86. retry:
87.     prev = ucs_atomic_cswap32(&hdr->state, UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT,
88.                               UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_INITING);
89. 
90.     if (prev == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT) {
91.         /* We won: zero metadata, fill geometry, publish READY */
92.         memset((char*)hdr + sizeof(*hdr), 0,
93.                bitmap_words * sizeof(uint64_t) +
94.                (size_t)slot_count * sizeof(uct_obmm_slot_meta_t));
95. 
96.         hdr->magic                 = UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC;
97.         hdr->version               = UCT_OBMM_POOL_VERSION;
98.         hdr->slot_count            = slot_count;
99.         hdr->slot_size             = slot_size;
100.         hdr->slot_array_offset     = slot_off;
101.         hdr->bitmap_words          = (uint32_t)bitmap_words;
102.         hdr->initializer_pid       = (uint32_t)getpid();
103.         hdr->initializer_starttime = (uint64_t)self_starttime;
104. 
105.         ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
106.         hdr->state = UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY;
107.         return UCS_OK;
108.     }
109. 
110.     if (prev == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
111.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
112.         return UCS_OK;
113.     }
114. 
115.     /* state == INITING : wait or recover */
116.     for (spin = 0; spin < UCT_OBMM_POOL_INIT_SPIN_LIMIT; ++spin) {
117.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
118.         if (hdr->state == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
119.             return UCS_OK;
120.         }
121.         if (hdr->state == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT) {
122.             /* Some other rescuer reset; race for init */
123.             goto retry;
124.         }
125. 
126.         if ((spin & 0xfffu) == 0xfffu) {
127.             /* Periodically check if the initializer is alive. If not,
128.              * try to reset back to UNINIT so someone can re-init. */
129.             if (!uct_obmm_proc_alive(hdr->initializer_pid,
130.                                      hdr->initializer_starttime)) {
131.                 ucs_warn("obmm: pool initializer pid=%u died; resetting "
132.                          "pool init state",
133.                          hdr->initializer_pid);
134.                 ucs_atomic_cswap32(&hdr->state, UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_INITING,
135.                                    UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT);
136.                 goto retry;
137.             }
138.         }
139.     }
140. 
141.     ucs_error("obmm: timed out waiting for pool init to complete "
142.               "(initializer pid=%u)", hdr->initializer_pid);
143.     return UCS_ERR_TIMED_OUT;
144. }

147. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_attach(void *region_base, size_t region_size,
148.                                   uint32_t slot_count, uint32_t slot_size,
149.                                   uct_obmm_pool_t *pool)
150. {
151.     uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t *hdr = (uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t*)region_base;
152.     size_t               required;
153.     ucs_status_t         status;
154. 
155.     if ((slot_count == 0) || (slot_size == 0)) {
156.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
157.     }
158. 
159.     required = uct_obmm_pool_required_size(slot_count, slot_size);
160.     if (region_size < required) {
161.         ucs_error("obmm: region size %zu < required pool size %zu "
162.                   "(slots=%u, slot_size=%u)",
163.                   region_size, required, slot_count, slot_size);
164.         return UCS_ERR_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL;
165.     }
166. 
167.     status = uct_obmm_pool_init_or_wait(hdr, slot_count, slot_size);
168.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
169.         return status;
170.     }
171. 
172.     if (hdr->magic != UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC) {
173.         ucs_error("obmm: pool magic mismatch (got 0x%lx, expected 0x%lx)",
174.                   (unsigned long)hdr->magic, (unsigned long)UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC);
175.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
176.     }
177.     if (hdr->version != UCT_OBMM_POOL_VERSION) {
178.         ucs_error("obmm: pool version mismatch (got %u, expected %u)",
179.                   hdr->version, UCT_OBMM_POOL_VERSION);
180.         return UCS_ERR_UNSUPPORTED;
181.     }
182.     if ((hdr->slot_count != slot_count) || (hdr->slot_size != slot_size)) {
183.         ucs_error("obmm: pool geometry mismatch "
184.                   "(have slots=%u size=%u, expected %u/%u)",
185.                   hdr->slot_count, hdr->slot_size, slot_count, slot_size);
186.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
187.     }
188. 
189.     pool->base       = region_base;
190.     pool->length     = region_size;
191.     pool->hdr        = hdr;
192.     pool->bitmap     = (volatile uint64_t*)((char*)hdr + sizeof(*hdr));
193.     pool->meta       = (uct_obmm_slot_meta_t*)((char*)hdr +
194.                                                uct_obmm_pool_meta_offset(slot_count));
195.     pool->slots      = (char*)hdr + hdr->slot_array_offset;
196.     pool->slot_count = slot_count;
197.     pool->slot_size  = slot_size;
198.     return UCS_OK;
199. }

201. 
202. /* Try to claim slot `idx` for the current process. Returns 1 on success
203.  * (bit was set by us, meta updated). On scavenge of a dead owner, generation
204.  * is bumped and the slot is taken over. Returns 0 if the slot is unclaimable
205.  * (live owner). */
206. static int uct_obmm_pool_try_claim(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t idx,
207.                                    uint32_t self_pid, uint64_t self_starttime,
208.                                    uint32_t *generation_p)
209. {
210.     volatile uint64_t    *word    = &pool->bitmap[idx >> 6];
211.     uint64_t              bit     = 1ull << (idx & 63u);
212.     uct_obmm_slot_meta_t *m       = &pool->meta[idx];
213.     uint64_t              cur, oldval;
214.     int                   take_over;
215. 
216.     cur = *word;
217.     if (cur & bit) {
218.         /* allocated: maybe the owner is dead */
219.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
220.         if ((m->state == UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_IN_USE) &&
221.             uct_obmm_proc_alive(m->owner_pid, m->owner_starttime)) {
222.             return 0;
223.         }
224.         take_over = 1;
225.     } else {
226.         /* free: try to set the bit */
227.         oldval = ucs_atomic_cswap64(word, cur, cur | bit);
228.         if (oldval != cur) {
229.             return 0; /* lost the race; caller will retry next slot */
230.         }
231.         take_over = 0;
232.     }
233. 
234.     /* Bump generation so any in-flight stale messages from prior owner are
235.      * dropped by the receive path. memset slot bytes only AFTER bumping
236.      * generation, so any racing writer's bytes won't survive un-stamped. */
237.     m->generation += 1;
238.     m->owner_pid       = self_pid;
239.     m->owner_starttime = self_starttime;
240.     /* Zero the slot bytes for our use (FIFO ctl + elements). */
241.     memset(uct_obmm_pool_slot_ptr(pool, idx), 0, pool->slot_size);
242.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
243.     m->state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_IN_USE;
244.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
245. 
246.     *generation_p = m->generation;
247.     (void)take_over;
248.     return 1;
249. }
250. 
251. 
252. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_alloc_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool,
253.                                       uint32_t *slot_index_p,
254.                                       void **slot_ptr_p,
255.                                       uint32_t *generation_p)
256. {
257.     uint32_t      self_pid       = (uint32_t)getpid();
258.     unsigned long self_starttime = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time(getpid());
259.     uint32_t      i;
260. 
261.     if (self_starttime == 0ul) {
262.         ucs_warn("obmm: cannot read self process start time; "
263.                  "scavenge will treat us as dead");
264.     }
265. 
266.     for (i = 0; i < pool->slot_count; ++i) {
267.         if (uct_obmm_pool_try_claim(pool, i, self_pid,
268.                                     (uint64_t)self_starttime, generation_p)) {
269.             *slot_index_p = i;
270.             *slot_ptr_p   = uct_obmm_pool_slot_ptr(pool, i);
271.             return UCS_OK;
272.         }
273.     }
274. 
275.     return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
276. }
277. 
278. 
279. void uct_obmm_pool_free_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t slot_index)
280. {
281.     volatile uint64_t    *word = &pool->bitmap[slot_index >> 6];
282.     uint64_t              bit  = 1ull << (slot_index & 63u);
283.     uct_obmm_slot_meta_t *m    = &pool->meta[slot_index];
284.     uint64_t              cur, oldval;
285. 
286.     /* Bump generation first so any in-flight stale messages are discarded by
287.      * a future re-using owner; mark DEAD and bus fence before clearing the
288.      * bit so a racing claimer sees the new generation. */
289.     m->generation += 1;
290.     m->state       = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_DEAD;
291.     m->owner_pid   = 0;
292.     m->owner_starttime = 0;
293.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
294. 
295.     do {
296.         cur    = *word;
297.         oldval = ucs_atomic_cswap64(word, cur, cur & ~bit);
298.     } while (oldval != cur);
299. 
300.     m->state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE;
301.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
302. }

305. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_open(void *region_base, size_t region_size,
306.                                 uct_obmm_pool_t *pool)
307. {
308.     uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t *hdr = (uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t*)region_base;
309.     uint32_t             state;
310.     uint32_t             slot_count, slot_size;
311.     size_t               required;
312. 
313.     if (region_size < sizeof(*hdr)) {
314.         return UCS_ERR_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL;
315.     }
316. 
317.     state = hdr->state;
318.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
319.     if (state != UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
320.         ucs_debug("obmm: pool at %p not READY (state=%u)", region_base, state);
321.         return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
322.     }
323. 
324.     if (hdr->magic != UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC) {
325.         ucs_error("obmm: pool magic mismatch on open (got 0x%lx)",
326.                   (unsigned long)hdr->magic);
327.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
328.     }
329.     if (hdr->version != UCT_OBMM_POOL_VERSION) {
330.         ucs_error("obmm: pool version mismatch on open (got %u, expected %u)",
331.                   hdr->version, UCT_OBMM_POOL_VERSION);
332.         return UCS_ERR_UNSUPPORTED;
333.     }
334. 
335.     slot_count = hdr->slot_count;
336.     slot_size  = hdr->slot_size;
337.     if ((slot_count == 0) || (slot_size == 0)) {
338.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
339.     }
340. 
341.     required = uct_obmm_pool_required_size(slot_count, slot_size);
342.     if (region_size < required) {
343.         ucs_error("obmm: peer pool geometry exceeds region size "
344.                   "(slots=%u, slot_size=%u, region=%zu, required=%zu)",
345.                   slot_count, slot_size, region_size, required);
346.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
347.     }
348. 
349.     pool->base       = region_base;
350.     pool->length     = region_size;
351.     pool->hdr        = hdr;
352.     pool->bitmap     = (volatile uint64_t*)((char*)hdr + sizeof(*hdr));
353.     pool->meta       = (uct_obmm_slot_meta_t*)((char*)hdr +
354.                                                uct_obmm_pool_meta_offset(slot_count));
355.     pool->slots      = (char*)hdr + hdr->slot_array_offset;
356.     pool->slot_count = slot_count;
357.     pool->slot_size  = slot_size;
358.     return UCS_OK;
359. }

### 💬 Copilot

- **High:** Don’t patch only `uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot()`. `uct_obmm_ep_am_short()` still has its own CAS reservation loop (`ucx\src\uct\obmm\base\obmm_ep.c:174-216`), separate from the helper (`:245-270`). Smallest correct diff: make `am_short()` use the helper, then change the helper once.

- **Medium:** **Do bump** `UCT_OBMM_POOL_VERSION`, but not because stride must change. With `UCS_CACHELINE_PADDING`, `sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t)` may stay unchanged (`obmm_fifo.h:37-45`, `ucs\sys\compiler.h:99-105`). Version bump is still needed so old/new peers cannot silently mix protocols.

- **Medium:** Preserve a **full bus fence before `head = head + 1`** and a **bus-store fence before `lock = 0`**. On aarch64, store-only fencing is not enough for the load→store ordering here (`obmm_fifo.h:125-156`).

- **Low:** I would keep pending/arbiter logic unchanged for this fix; `try_lock_head()` can return `NO_RESOURCE` once rather than spin. No extra reset path is needed beyond slot zeroing plus `recv_ctl-\>lock = 0` (`obmm_pool.c:234-243`, `obmm_iface.c:431-446`).

174. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_ep_am_short(uct_ep_h tl_ep, uint8_t id, uint64_t header,
175.                                   const void *payload, unsigned length)
176. {
177.     uct_obmm_ep_t           *ep    = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep, uct_obmm_ep_t);
178.     uct_obmm_iface_t        *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep->iface,
179.                                                     uct_obmm_iface_t);
180.     size_t                   payload_total = sizeof(header) + length;
181.     uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem;
182.     uint64_t                 head;
183.     uint8_t                  owner_bit;
184. 
185.     UCT_CHECK_AM_ID(id);
186.     UCT_CHECK_LENGTH(payload_total, 0,
187.                      ep->fifo_elem_size - sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_element_t),
188.                      "am_short");
189. 
190.     /* Reserve a slot in the peer's FIFO via load + CAS. FAA cannot be used:
191.      * if FAA succeeds but the FIFO turns out to be full, the bumped head
192.      * value can never be rolled back across hosts, leaving a permanent gap
193.      * the receiver will block on (its progress loop walks slots in order
194.      * and stops at any slot whose owner bit hasn't flipped). CAS lets us
195.      * decide capacity *before* committing the head bump.
196.      *
197.      * Multiple senders (across processes / hosts) compete on the same head
198.      * cell, so we retry on CAS miss. */
199.     for (;;) {
200.         head = ep->peer_ctl->head;
201. 
202.         if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
203.             ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
204.             ep->cached_tail = ep->peer_ctl->tail;
205.             if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
206.                 UCS_STATS_UPDATE_COUNTER(ep->super.stats, UCT_EP_STAT_NO_RES,
207.                                          1);
208.                 return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
209.             }
210.         }
211. 
212.         if (ucs_atomic_bool_cswap64(&ep->peer_ctl->head, head, head + 1)) {
213.             break;
214.         }
215.         /* Lost the race; another sender claimed this slot. Retry. */
216.     }
217.

222.     elem->length     = (uint16_t)payload_total;

225.     if (length > 0) {

235.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();

237. 
238.     UCT_TL_EP_STAT_OP(&ep->super, AM, SHORT, payload_total);

240.                        &header, payload_total, "TX: AM_SHORT");

245. /* Reserve one slot in the peer's FIFO, returning the head index that was
246.  * claimed. See am_short above for why load+CAS (not FAA). */
247. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE ucs_status_t
248. uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot(uct_obmm_ep_t *ep, uint64_t *head_p)
249. {
250.     uint64_t head;
251. 
252.     for (;;) {
253.         head = ep->peer_ctl->head;
254. 
255.         if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
256.             ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
257.             ep->cached_tail = ep->peer_ctl->tail;
258.             if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
259.                 UCS_STATS_UPDATE_COUNTER(ep->super.stats, UCT_EP_STAT_NO_RES,
260.                                          1);
261.                 return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
262.             }
263.         }
264. 
265.         if (ucs_atomic_bool_cswap64(&ep->peer_ctl->head, head, head + 1)) {
266.             *head_p = head;
267.             return UCS_OK;
268.         }
269.     }
270. }

273. ssize_t uct_obmm_ep_am_bcopy(uct_ep_h tl_ep, uint8_t id,
274.                              uct_pack_callback_t pack_cb, void *arg,
275.                              unsigned flags)
276. {
277.     uct_obmm_ep_t           *ep    = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep, uct_obmm_ep_t);
278.     uct_obmm_iface_t        *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep->iface,

288.      * does not advertise EP_CHECK / keepalive in v1. */

290. 
291.     UCT_CHECK_AM_ID(id);
292. 
293.     status = uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot(ep, &head);
294.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
295.         return status;
296.     }
297. 
298.     elem = uct_obmm_slot_elem(ep->peer_elems, head, ep->fifo_mask,
299.                               ep->fifo_elem_size);
300.     desc = uct_obmm_slot_desc(ep->peer_descs, head, ep->fifo_mask,
301.                               ep->bcopy_seg_size);
302. 
303.     /* pack_cb writes pack_cb_ret bytes directly into the paired desc[N]

306.      * debug builds; production safety relies on the iface cap contract. */

308.     ucs_assertv(length <= ep->bcopy_seg_size,
309.                 "obmm: pack_cb returned %zu > bcopy_seg_size=%u",
310.                 length, ep->bcopy_seg_size);
311.     ucs_assertv(length <= UINT16_MAX,
312.                 "obmm: pack_cb returned %zu > UINT16_MAX", length);
313. 
314.     elem->am_id      = id;
315.     elem->length     = (uint16_t)length;
316.     elem->generation = ep->expected_generation;
317.     elem->header     = 0; /* unused for bcopy */
318. 
319.     owner_bit = ((head / ep->fifo_size) & 1u) ? 0u :
320.                                                 UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER;
321. 
322.     /* Release barrier: orders the desc[N] payload writes AND elem header
323.      * writes BEFORE the flags publish. Receiver pairs with bus_load_fence
324.      * after observing the flags byte. */
325.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
326.     elem->flags = owner_bit | UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_BCOPY;
327. 
328.     UCT_TL_EP_STAT_OP(&ep->super, AM, BCOPY, length);
329.     uct_iface_trace_am(&iface->super, UCT_AM_TRACE_TYPE_SEND, id,
330.                        desc, length, "TX: AM_BCOPY");
331.     return (ssize_t)length;
332. }

````
137. ## Sender side (`obmm_ep`)
138. 
139. Both `am_short` and `am_bcopy` reserve a slot identically:
140. 
141. ```
142. 1. load head from peer_ctl->head
143. 2. if (head - cached_tail) >= fifo_size:
144.        bus_load_fence; refresh cached_tail; recheck;
145.        if still full: return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE
146. 3. CAS head → head+1 (load+CAS, NOT FAA, see "FIFO slot reservation"
147.    memory: FAA cannot be rolled back across hosts so a "full" rejection
148.    would leave a permanent gap stalling the in-order receiver)
149. 4. compute idx = head, N = idx & mask
150. 5. payload write:
151.      short: memcpy header+payload into elem[N]+1
152.      bcopy: pack_cb(desc[N], arg) -> length
153. 6. fill elem[N] header fields (am_id, length, generation, [header])
154. 7. ucs_memory_bus_store_fence()                          <- release barrier
155. 8. elem[N]->flags = OWNER_BIT_FOR_THIS_LAP | (BCOPY if bcopy)
156. ```
157. 
158. The OWNER bit alternates each lap of the ring (see `obmm_iface.c`
159. `uct_obmm_iface_progress` for why). Since `desc[N]` writes happen
160. **before** the bus_store_fence, they become visible to the peer at the
161. same time as the published flags byte.
162. 
163. ### Pending
164. 
165. `ep_pending_add` returns `UCS_ERR_BUSY` (UCP retries via its own
166. progress loop). Real arbiter is out of scope for v1/v2 — backpressure
167. is bounded because the receiver drains continuously.
168. 
169. ---
170.

279. void uct_obmm_pool_free_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t slot_index)

281.     volatile uint64_t    *word = &pool->bitmap[slot_index >> 6];
282.     uint64_t              bit  = 1ull << (slot_index & 63u);
283.     uct_obmm_slot_meta_t *m    = &pool->meta[slot_index];
284.     uint64_t              cur, oldval;
285. 
286.     /* Bump generation first so any in-flight stale messages are discarded by
287.      * a future re-using owner; mark DEAD and bus fence before clearing the
288.      * bit so a racing claimer sees the new generation. */
289.     m->generation += 1;
290.     m->state       = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_DEAD;
291.     m->owner_pid   = 0;
292.     m->owner_starttime = 0;
293.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
294. 
295.     do {
296.         cur    = *word;
297.         oldval = ucs_atomic_cswap64(word, cur, cur & ~bit);
298.     } while (oldval != cur);
299. 
300.     m->state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE;
301.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
302. }

212. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_ep_am_short(uct_ep_h tl_ep, uint8_t id, uint64_t header,
213.                                   const void *payload, unsigned length)
214. {
215.     uct_obmm_ep_t           *ep    = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep, uct_obmm_ep_t);
216.     uct_obmm_iface_t        *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep->iface,
217.                                                     uct_obmm_iface_t);
218.     size_t                   payload_total = sizeof(header) + length;
219.     uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem;
220.     uint64_t                 head;
221.     uint8_t                  owner_bit;
222. 
223.     UCT_CHECK_AM_ID(id);
224.     UCT_CHECK_LENGTH(payload_total, 0,
225.                      ep->fifo_elem_size - sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_element_t),
226.                      "am_short");
227. 
228.     if (uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot(ep, &head) != UCS_OK) {
229.         return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
230.     }
231. 
232.     elem = uct_obmm_slot_elem(ep->peer_elems, head, ep->fifo_mask,
233.                               ep->fifo_elem_size);
234. 
235.     elem->am_id      = id;
236.     elem->length     = (uint16_t)payload_total;
237.     elem->generation = ep->expected_generation;
238.     elem->header     = header;
239.     if (length > 0) {
240.         memcpy(elem + 1, payload, length);
241.     }
242. 
243.     /* Publish: the OWNER bit toggles each wraparound. The receiver expects
244.      * bit==1 on even passes and bit==0 on odd passes (and vice versa) so
245.      * that uninitialized memory (zero) reads as "not yet written" on the
246.      * first pass. */
247.     owner_bit = ((head / ep->fifo_size) & 1u) ? 0u : UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER;
248. 
249.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
250.     elem->flags = owner_bit;
251. 
252.     UCT_TL_EP_STAT_OP(&ep->super, AM, SHORT, payload_total);
253.     uct_iface_trace_am(&iface->super, UCT_AM_TRACE_TYPE_SEND, id,
254.                        &header, payload_total, "TX: AM_SHORT");
255.     return UCS_OK;
256. }
257. 
258. 
259. /* Reserve one slot in the peer's FIFO, returning the head index that was
260.  * claimed. Multi-producer reservation is serialized with a token lock because
261.  * on target NC/aarch64 mappings, CAS updates memory but its return value is
262.  * not a reliable ownership result. */
263. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE ucs_status_t
264. uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot(uct_obmm_ep_t *ep, uint64_t *head_p)
265. {
266.     uint64_t head;
267. 
268.     if (!uct_obmm_ep_try_lock_head(ep)) {
269.         UCS_STATS_UPDATE_COUNTER(ep->super.stats, UCT_EP_STAT_NO_RES, 1);
270.         return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
271.     }
272. 
273.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
274.     head = ep->peer_ctl->head;
275. 
276.     if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
277.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
278.         ep->cached_tail = ep->peer_ctl->tail;
279.         if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
280.             UCS_STATS_UPDATE_COUNTER(ep->super.stats, UCT_EP_STAT_NO_RES, 1);
281.             uct_obmm_ep_unlock_head(ep);
282.             return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
283.         }
284.     }
285. 
286.     uct_obmm_bus_full_fence();
287.     ep->peer_ctl->head = head + 1;
288.     uct_obmm_ep_unlock_head(ep);
289. 
290.     *head_p = head;

216.                                   const void *payload, unsigned length)

225. 
226.     UCT_CHECK_AM_ID(id);

229.                      "am_short");
230. 
231.     if (uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot(ep, &head) != UCS_OK) {
232.         return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
233.     }
234. 
235.     elem = uct_obmm_slot_elem(ep->peer_elems, head, ep->fifo_mask,
236.                               ep->fifo_elem_size);
237. 
238.     elem->am_id      = id;
239.     elem->length     = (uint16_t)payload_total;
240.     elem->generation = ep->expected_generation;
241.     elem->header     = header;
242.     if (length > 0) {
243.         memcpy(elem + 1, payload, length);
244.     }
245. 
246.     /* Publish: the OWNER bit toggles each wraparound. The receiver expects
247.      * bit==1 on even passes and bit==0 on odd passes (and vice versa) so
248.      * that uninitialized memory (zero) reads as "not yet written" on the
249.      * first pass. */
250.     owner_bit = ((head / ep->fifo_size) & 1u) ? 0u : UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER;
251. 
252.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
253.     elem->flags = owner_bit;
254. 
255.     UCT_TL_EP_STAT_OP(&ep->super, AM, SHORT, payload_total);
256.     uct_iface_trace_am(&iface->super, UCT_AM_TRACE_TYPE_SEND, id,
257.                        &header, payload_total, "TX: AM_SHORT");

266. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE ucs_status_t
267. uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot(uct_obmm_ep_t *ep, uint64_t *head_p)
268. {
269.     uint64_t head;
270. 
271.     if (!uct_obmm_ep_try_lock_head(ep)) {
272.         UCS_STATS_UPDATE_COUNTER(ep->super.stats, UCT_EP_STAT_NO_RES, 1);
273.         return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
274.     }
275. 
276.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
277.     head = ep->peer_ctl->head;
278. 
279.     if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
280.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
281.         ep->cached_tail = ep->peer_ctl->tail;
282.         if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
283.             UCS_STATS_UPDATE_COUNTER(ep->super.stats, UCT_EP_STAT_NO_RES, 1);
284.             uct_obmm_ep_unlock_head(ep);

286.         }
287.     }
288. 
289.     uct_obmm_bus_full_fence();
290.     ep->peer_ctl->head = head + 1;
291.     uct_obmm_ep_unlock_head(ep);
292. 
293.     *head_p = head;
294.     return UCS_OK;

32. /* Per-slot FIFO control header. Lives at offset 0 of every allocated slot in

35.  * value is not a reliable ownership result. Consumers read/write `tail` to
36.  * release space. Control fields are accessed via non-cacheable mappings,
37.  * therefore all updates must be paired with bus fences
38.  * (ucs_memory_bus_*_fence), not CPU fences. */

45.     /* 2nd cacheline: consumer-touched */
46.     volatile uint64_t tail;
47.     UCS_CACHELINE_PADDING(uint64_t);
48. } UCS_V_ALIGNED(UCS_SYS_CACHE_LINE_SIZE) uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t;
49. 
50. 
51. /* FIFO element header. The element body (am short header + payload) follows
52.  * immediately. Total element stride is iface->config.fifo_elem_size, which
53.  * the iface chooses so that header+payload <= elem_size. */
54. typedef struct uct_obmm_fifo_element {
55.     uint8_t  flags;       /* UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_xx */
56.     uint8_t  am_id;       /* active message id */
57.     uint16_t length;      /* payload length (excluding am_short header) */
58.     uint32_t generation;  /* owner-slot generation token; receiver discards
59.                              elements whose generation doesn't match the
60.                              slot's current meta.generation */
61.     uint64_t header;      /* am_short 64-bit header */
62.     /* payload[length] follows here */
63. } UCS_S_PACKED uct_obmm_fifo_element_t;
64. 
65. 
66. /* Compute slot stride: control header + fifo_size * elem_size + (v2)
67.  * fifo_size * bcopy_seg_size, cacheline aligned so that adjacent slots
68.  * don't share a line. Returned as size_t; callers must validate the
69.  * result fits in the uint32_t pool_hdr->slot_size field before passing
70.  * to pool_attach. */
71. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE size_t
72. uct_obmm_slot_stride(unsigned fifo_size, unsigned fifo_elem_size,
73.                      unsigned bcopy_seg_size)
74. {
75.     return ucs_align_up(sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t) +
76.                         ((size_t)fifo_size * fifo_elem_size) +
77.                         ((size_t)fifo_size * bcopy_seg_size),
78.                         UCS_SYS_CACHE_LINE_SIZE);
79. }
80. 
81. 
82. /* Get FIFO control header pointer from a slot base pointer. */
83. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t*
84. uct_obmm_slot_ctl(void *slot_base)
85. {
86.     return (uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t*)slot_base;
87. }
88. 
89. 
90. /* Get FIFO elements array pointer from a slot base pointer. */
91. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void*
92. uct_obmm_slot_elems(void *slot_base)
93. {
94.     return UCS_PTR_BYTE_OFFSET(slot_base, sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t));
95. }
96. 
97. 
98. /* Get bcopy desc array pointer from a slot base pointer. The desc area
99.  * lives immediately after the FIFO element array. Each desc is
100.  * `bcopy_seg_size` bytes; index N is paired 1:1 with FIFO element N. */
101. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void*
102. uct_obmm_slot_descs(void *slot_base, unsigned fifo_size,
103.                     unsigned fifo_elem_size)
104. {
105.     return UCS_PTR_BYTE_OFFSET(slot_base,
106.                                sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t) +
107.                                ((size_t)fifo_size * fifo_elem_size));
108. }
109. 
110. 
111. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE uct_obmm_fifo_element_t*
112. uct_obmm_slot_elem(void *elems, uint64_t index, unsigned mask,
113.                    unsigned elem_size)
114. {
115.     return (uct_obmm_fifo_element_t*)
116.            UCS_PTR_BYTE_OFFSET(elems, (size_t)(index & mask) * elem_size);
117. }
118. 
119. 
120. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void*
121. uct_obmm_slot_desc(void *descs, uint64_t index, unsigned mask,
122.                    unsigned seg_size)
123. {
124.     return UCS_PTR_BYTE_OFFSET(descs, (size_t)(index & mask) * seg_size);
125. }
126. 
127. 
128. /* Full bus-domain fence: orders ALL prior memory accesses (loads and
129.  * stores) before ALL subsequent memory accesses, in the outer-shareable /
130.  * device domain that includes cross-host obmm peers.
131.  *
132.  * Why we need this in addition to ucs_memory_bus_{store,load}_fence:
133.  * the receiver must order its desc[N] LOADS (issued during the AM
134.  * handler) before the STORE that publishes the new tail. On ARM64,
135.  * ucs_memory_bus_store_fence() is `dmb oshst` (store→store only) and
136.  * does not order prior loads. Without this load→store barrier, a sender
137.  * could observe the advanced tail and overwrite desc[N] while the
138.  * receiver still has outstanding loads from the previous lap's payload.
139.  *
140.  * Defined locally in obmm rather than added to ucs/arch to keep the
141.  * change inside ucx/src/uct/obmm/ per AGENTS.md. */
142. #if defined(__aarch64__)
143. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() __asm__ __volatile__("dmb osh" ::: "memory")
144. #elif defined(__x86_64__) || defined(__i386__)
145. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() __asm__ __volatile__("mfence" ::: "memory")
146. #elif defined(__powerpc64__)
147. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() __asm__ __volatile__("sync" ::: "memory")
148. #elif defined(__riscv) && (__riscv_xlen == 64)
149. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() \
150.     __asm__ __volatile__("fence iorw, iorw" ::: "memory")
151. #else
152. /* Fallback: combine store + load fences. Not strictly load→store on all
153.  * archs but better than nothing; build will warn so the porter notices. */
154. #warning "obmm: no full bus fence for this arch; receiver tail release ordering may be weak"
155. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() do { \
156.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();        \
157.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();       \
158. } while (0)
159. #endif
160. 
161. #endif
162.
```

277.          * payload BEFORE the STORE that publishes the new tail. A plain
278.          * bus_store_fence (e.g. dmb oshst on aarch64) only orders
279.          * store→store, which would let a sender observe the advanced
280.          * tail and overwrite desc[N] while we still have outstanding
281.          * loads in flight. See obmm_fifo.h:uct_obmm_bus_full_fence. */
282.         uct_obmm_bus_full_fence();
283.         iface->recv_ctl->tail = iface->read_index;
284.     }
285. 
286.     /* Drain any UCP requests waiting on TX backpressure. The peer-side
287.      * tail advance we just published may also have freed slots that *our*
288.      * pending eps have been waiting for; dispatch with a fresh head/tail
289.      * snapshot so retries see the latest state. Without this dispatch,
290.      * UCS_ERR_BUSY-only pending_add caused a livelock under symmetric
291.      * bidirectional load (osu_bibw at size==BCOPY_SEG_SIZE). */
292.     ucs_arbiter_dispatch(&iface->arbiter, 1, uct_obmm_ep_process_pending,
293.                          &polled);
294. 
295.     return polled;
296. }
297.

300. {
301.     (void)flags;
302.     ucs_memory_cpu_fence();
303.     UCT_TL_IFACE_STAT_FENCE(ucs_derived_of(tl_iface, uct_base_iface_t));
304.     return UCS_OK;
305. }

279. void uct_obmm_pool_free_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t slot_index)
280. {
281.     volatile uint64_t    *word = &pool->bitmap[slot_index >> 6];
282.     uint64_t              bit  = 1ull << (slot_index & 63u);
283.     uct_obmm_slot_meta_t *m    = &pool->meta[slot_index];
284.     uint64_t              cur, oldval;
285. 
286.     /* Bump generation first so any in-flight stale messages are discarded by
287.      * a future re-using owner; mark DEAD and bus fence before clearing the
288.      * bit so a racing claimer sees the new generation. */
289.     m->generation += 1;
290.     m->state       = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_DEAD;

201. 
202. /* Try to claim slot `idx` for the current process. Returns 1 on success
203.  * (bit was set by us, meta updated). On scavenge of a dead owner, generation
204.  * is bumped and the slot is taken over. Returns 0 if the slot is unclaimable
205.  * (live owner). */
206. static int uct_obmm_pool_try_claim(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t idx,
207.                                    uint32_t self_pid, uint64_t self_starttime,
208.                                    uint32_t *generation_p)
209. {
210.     volatile uint64_t    *word    = &pool->bitmap[idx >> 6];
211.     uint64_t              bit     = 1ull << (idx & 63u);
212.     uct_obmm_slot_meta_t *m       = &pool->meta[idx];
213.     uint64_t              cur, oldval;
214.     int                   take_over;
215. 
216.     cur = *word;
217.     if (cur & bit) {
218.         /* allocated: maybe the owner is dead */
219.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
220.         if ((m->state == UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_IN_USE) &&
221.             uct_obmm_proc_alive(m->owner_pid, m->owner_starttime)) {
222.             return 0;
223.         }
224.         take_over = 1;
225.     } else {
226.         /* free: try to set the bit */
227.         oldval = ucs_atomic_cswap64(word, cur, cur | bit);
228.         if (oldval != cur) {
229.             return 0; /* lost the race; caller will retry next slot */
230.         }
231.         take_over = 0;
232.     }
233. 
234.     /* Bump generation so any in-flight stale messages from prior owner are
235.      * dropped by the receive path. memset slot bytes only AFTER bumping
236.      * generation, so any racing writer's bytes won't survive un-stamped. */
237.     m->generation += 1;
238.     m->owner_pid       = self_pid;
239.     m->owner_starttime = self_starttime;
240.     /* Zero the slot bytes for our use (FIFO ctl + elements). */
241.     memset(uct_obmm_pool_slot_ptr(pool, idx), 0, pool->slot_size);
242.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
243.     m->state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_IN_USE;
244.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
245. 
246.     *generation_p = m->generation;
247.     (void)take_over;
248.     return 1;
249. }
250.
```

### 💬 Copilot

Based on my thorough review of the obmm hang-fix diff, I've identified one **critical correctness issue**:

## Issue: Race condition in lock acquisition protocol
**File:** ucx/src/uct/obmm/base/obmm_ep.c:42-52
**Severity:** Critical
**Problem:** The `uct_obmm_ep_try_lock_head` function has a check-then-act race condition. Line 45 checks if `ep-\>peer_ctl-\>lock != 0` without synchronization, then line 49 does a CAS to claim the lock, then line 51 reads back to verify ownership. However, between the check at line 45 and the CAS at line 49, another producer could have claimed and released the lock, leaving it zero. This allows multiple producers to pass the initial check simultaneously and all attempt the CAS, potentially leading to multiple claimers thinking they own the lock if the readback timing is unlucky.

**Evidence:** 
1. Line 45: `if (ep-\>peer_ctl-\>lock != 0) return 0;` - non-atomic check
2. Line 49: `ucs_atomic_cswap64(&ep-\>peer_ctl-\>lock, 0, ep-\>lock_token);` - CAS attempt (ignoring return value)
3. Line 51: `return ep-\>peer_ctl-\>lock == ep-\>lock_token;` - readback check

The pattern is:
```c
if (lock != 0) return 0;  // racy check
CAS(lock, 0, my_token);   // ignore result
fence;
return (lock == my_token); // racy readback
```

If producer A passes line 45 (lock==0), then producer B also passes line 45 before A executes the CAS, both will attempt CAS. Even though only one CAS succeeds, the `uct_obmm_bus_full_fence()` at line 50 and the readback at line 51 don't guarantee that the value read is the one written by *this* thread's CAS - it could be reading a value written by another racing thread that won the CAS, then released the lock, then another thread claimed it with a different token.

**Suggested fix:** Use the CAS return value directly as the ownership indicator:
```c
static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE int
uct_obmm_ep_try_lock_head(uct_obmm_ep_t *ep)
{
    uint64_t old;
    
    ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
    old = ucs_atomic_cswap64(&ep-\>peer_ctl-\>lock, 0, ep-\>lock_token);
    if (old != 0) {
        return 0;  // lock was already held
    }
    uct_obmm_bus_full_fence();
    return 1;  // we claimed it
}
```

This ensures atomicity: only the thread whose CAS succeeded (old==0) will return success, preventing the race window.

### 💬 Copilot

**已按那个已验证 commit 的核心逻辑做了最小适配。**这次只动了治“静默卡死”的那一层：把 `peer_ctl-\>head` 的预留从“依赖 CAS 结果判定成功”改成了**token-lock 串行预留**，并保留了你现在代码里的 pending/arbiter 逻辑不动。

改动点很小：
- `obmm_fifo.h`：给 `uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t` 加了 `lock`
- `obmm_ep.h/.c`：给 ep 加 `lock_token`，新增 `try_lock_head/unlock_head`，并让 `am_short` 和 `am_bcopy` 共用新的 `reserve_slot()`
- `obmm_iface.c`：初始化本地槽时把 `recv_ctl-\>lock = 0`
- `obmm_pool.h`：`UCT_OBMM_POOL_VERSION` 从 `2` 升到 `3`
- `DESIGN.md`：把发送侧预留流程改成 token-lock 描述

**需要注意：**因为 pool version 升到了 `3`，你下次上机验证前要先把旧的 obmm pool 头清掉，不然会直接命中版本不匹配。之前那个 `obmm_pool_reset` 流程这次仍然需要。

23. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_region_open(const uct_obmm_dev_info_t *info,
24.                                   uct_obmm_region_t *region)
25. {
26.     ucs_status_t status;
27.     void        *map;
28.     int          fd;
29. 
30.     if (!info->allow_mmap) {
31.         ucs_error("obmm: device %s does not support mmap", info->dev_path);
32.         return UCS_ERR_UNSUPPORTED;
33.     }
34. 
35.     if (info->size == 0) {
36.         ucs_error("obmm: device %s reports zero size", info->dev_path);
37.         return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
38.     }
39. 
40.     /* O_SYNC selects the non-cacheable mapping, which is required for
41.      * cross-host shared FIFO use without obmm_set_ownership() flips. */
42.     fd = open(info->dev_path, O_RDWR | O_SYNC | O_CLOEXEC);
43.     if (fd < 0) {
44.         ucs_error("obmm: open(%s) failed: %m", info->dev_path);
45.         return UCS_ERR_IO_ERROR;
46.     }
47. 
48.     map = mmap(NULL, info->size, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED, fd, 0);
49.     if (map == MAP_FAILED) {
50.         ucs_error("obmm: mmap(%s, size=0x%" PRIx64 ") failed: %m",
51.                   info->dev_path, info->size);
52.         status = UCS_ERR_IO_ERROR;
53.         goto err_close;
54.     }
55. 
56.     region->info   = *info;
57.     region->fd     = fd;
58.     region->base   = map;
59.     region->length = info->size;
60. 
61.     ucs_debug("obmm: mapped %s memid=%" PRIu64 " size=0x%" PRIx64
62.               " base=%p type=%s dcna=0x%" PRIx64,
63.               info->dev_path, info->memid, info->size, map,
64.               (info->type == UCT_OBMM_DEV_EXPORT) ? "export" : "import",
65.               info->exporter_dcna);
66. 
67.     return UCS_OK;
68. 
69. err_close:
70.     close(fd);
71.     return status;
72. }
73.

75. void uct_obmm_region_close(uct_obmm_region_t *region)
76. {
77.     if (region->base != NULL) {
78.         if (munmap(region->base, region->length) != 0) {
79.             ucs_warn("obmm: munmap(%s, %p, 0x%zx) failed: %m",
80.                      region->info.dev_path, region->base, region->length);
81.         }
82.         region->base = NULL;
83.     }
84. 
85.     if (region->fd >= 0) {
86.         close(region->fd);
87.         region->fd = -1;
88.     }
89. }

291. static ucs_status_t uct_obmm_sysfs_patch_self_dcna(uct_obmm_sysfs_ctx_t *ctx)
292. {
293.     uint64_t      self_dcna = 0;
294.     int           have_self = 0;
295.     int           have_export = 0;
296.     ucs_status_t  status;
297.     char          sysfs_dir[UCT_OBMM_PATH_MAX];

299.
