301.         if (ctx->devices[i].type == UCT_OBMM_DEV_EXPORT) {
302.             have_export = 1;
303.         }
304.         if (ctx->devices[i].type != UCT_OBMM_DEV_IMPORT) {
305.             continue;
306.         }
307.         ucs_snprintf_safe(sysfs_dir, sizeof(sysfs_dir), "%s/%s%" PRIu64,
308.                           UCT_OBMM_SYSFS_ROOT, UCT_OBMM_SHMDEV_PREFIX,
309.                           ctx->devices[i].memid);
310.         status = uct_obmm_read_u64_hex(&self_dcna, 1, "%s/import_info/scna",
311.                                        sysfs_dir);
312.         if (status == UCS_OK) {
313.             have_self = 1;
314.             break;
315.         }
316.     }
317. 
318.     if (!have_self) {
319.         if (have_export) {
320.             ucs_error("obmm: an export region exists but no import region is "
321.                       "available to derive self "
322.                       "dcna");
323.             return UCS_ERR_NO_DEVICE;
324.         }
325.         ucs_debug("obmm: no import device available to derive self dcna; "
326.                   "export entries will keep exporter_dcna=0");
327.         return UCS_OK;
328.     }
329. 
330.     for (i = 0; i < ctx->count; ++i) {
331.         if (ctx->devices[i].type == UCT_OBMM_DEV_EXPORT) {
332.             ctx->devices[i].exporter_dcna = self_dcna;
333.         }
334.     }
335.     return UCS_OK;
336. }

149.     }

151.

153.         info->type = UCT_OBMM_DEV_EXPORT;

155.         info->type = UCT_OBMM_DEV_IMPORT;

165.         return status;
166.     }
167. 
168.     /* allow_mmap (decimal) */
169.     status = ucs_read_file_number(&allow_mmap, 1, "%s/allow_mmap", sysfs_dir);
170.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
171.         ucs_debug("obmm: %s: missing 'allow_mmap'", sysfs_dir);
172.         return status;
173.     }
174.     info->allow_mmap = (allow_mmap != 0);
175. 
176.     if (!info->allow_mmap) {
177.         ucs_debug("obmm: %s: allow_mmap=0", sysfs_dir);
178.         return UCS_ERR_NO_ELEM;
179.     }
180. 
181.     info->memid = memid;
182.     ucs_snprintf_safe(info->dev_path, sizeof(info->dev_path),
183.                       UCT_OBMM_DEV_PATH_FMT, memid);
184.

187.         status = uct_obmm_read_u64_hex(&info->exporter_dcna, 1,

192.         }

209.         }
210.         info->exporter_dcna = 0;

### 💬 Copilot

## Issue: Incomplete probe-path error suppression in uct_obmm_md_map_devices
**File:** C:\Users\zl\Desktop\ucx_obmm_br/ucx/src/uct/obmm/base/obmm_md.c:206
**Severity:** Medium
**Problem:** The loop logic at line 206 exits with `goto err_unmap` on the first device that fails to open. This means if device #0 fails to open, the function immediately returns an error without attempting to open remaining devices. However, the code at line 226 suggests that `mapped == 0` is an acceptable outcome (returns `UCS_ERR_NO_DEVICE`), implying that the design might intend to tolerate individual device failures and only fail if *no* devices can be opened.

With the current logic, if you have 3 discoverable devices and device #1 fails to open (e.g., permission denied) but devices #2 and #3 would succeed, the function never tries #2 and #3. This could cause unnecessary probe failures when using obmm, not just when probing with other transports.

**Evidence:** 
- Line 206: First `region_open` failure immediately jumps to `err_unmap`
- Line 226: Special handling for `mapped == 0` suggests zero successful opens is explicitly handled
- The intent statement says probe failures "should not be reported as user-visible errors," but the logic prevents attempting all available devices

**Suggested fix:** Consider changing line 206 from `goto err_unmap;` to `continue;` so the loop attempts all devices. Only fail if `mapped == 0` at the end. This would make the code more resilient to partial device availability. However, verify this aligns with obmm's design requirements - the current fail-fast behavior might be intentional if partial device sets are considered invalid configurations.

**Note:** This appears to be a pre-existing logic issue, not introduced by the log-level changes. The diff only changes log levels and doesn't modify the control flow.

1. Problem: the current obmm cleanup path frees only the local slot and leaves the
2. rest of the shared export region intact. The user wants all residual shared
3. memory data cleared on exit, following commit
4. `6ff2ef6fc253d3b7c40b785159d465c5d3947ae3`.
5. 
6. Approach:
7. - Mirror only the cleanup-related parts of the reference commit that still fit
8.   the current NC-only branch:
9.   - make `uct_obmm_pool_free_slot()` report whether the caller released the
10.     final local slot and successfully acquired exclusive reset ownership
11.   - add `uct_obmm_pool_reset()` to zero the full local export region while
12.     keeping `hdr->state` in `INITING` until the rest of the pool is cleared
13.   - route iface cleanup through one shared helper so the last local iface
14.     resets the export region, while non-last ifaces still just free their slot
15. - Also mirror the reference commit's removal of persisted pool-version
16.   restrictions on this branch by turning the pool header's version word into a
17.   reserved field and dropping attach/open version checks.
18. 
19. Files:
20. - ucx\src\uct\obmm\base\obmm_region.h
21. - ucx\src\uct\obmm\base\obmm_region.c
22. - ucx\src\uct\obmm\base\obmm_iface.c
23. - ucx\src\uct\obmm\base\obmm_pool.h
24. - ucx\src\uct\obmm\base\obmm_pool.c
25. - ucx\src\uct\obmm\DESIGN.md
26. 
27. Todos:
28. - obmm-cleanup-plan
29. - obmm-cleanup-implement
30. - obmm-cleanup-review
31. 
32. Notes:
33. - Current branch is simpler than the reference commit: there is no hybrid CC
34.   state to port, so the cleanup adaptation should stay focused on the local NC
35.   export region and pool header/slot lifecycle.
36. - The last-slot reset path must be race-safe with a new attach: once cleanup
37.   wins the `READY -> INITING` transition, no new attach may observe partially
38.   zeroed pool metadata.
39. - Validation remains static only in this Windows workspace.
40. - Implemented:
41.   - removed persistent pool-version storage/checks from shared memory
42.   - last local iface now wins cleanup ownership and zeroes the full local
43.     export region before returning the pool to `UNINIT`
44.   - updated DESIGN.md to describe full-region zero-on-exit semantics
45. - Deliberately not added on this NC-only branch:
46.   - `uct_obmm_region_zero()`, because `uct_obmm_pool_reset()` already zeros the
47.     full local export mapping and there is no separate CC cleanup path here

41. /* In-region pool header. Lives at offset 0 of the local export region. All
42.  * fields are written via non-cacheable mappings: state transitions must be
43.  * paired with ucs_memory_bus_store_fence so peers (potentially on another
44.  * host) see the geometry before the READY transition. */
45. typedef struct uct_obmm_pool_hdr {
46.     uint64_t magic;             /* UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC */
47.     uint32_t version;           /* UCT_OBMM_POOL_VERSION */
48.     uint32_t state;             /* UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_xx, atomic */
49.     uint32_t slot_count;
50.     uint32_t slot_size;
51.     uint64_t slot_array_offset; /* offset (from region base) of slot 0 */
52.     uint32_t bitmap_words;      /* number of u64 words in alloc bitmap */
53.     uint32_t initializer_pid;   /* pid that owned the INITING transition */
54.     uint64_t initializer_starttime;
55.     uint64_t reserved[2];
56.     /* followed by:
57.      *   uint64_t alloc_bitmap[bitmap_words];
58.      *   uct_obmm_slot_meta_t slot_meta[slot_count];
59.      */
60. } uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t;
61. 
62. 
63. /* Per-slot ownership metadata. Stored adjacent to the bitmap, separate from
64.  * the slot's actual FIFO contents. */
65. typedef struct uct_obmm_slot_meta {
66.     uint32_t state;            /* UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_xx */
67.     uint32_t generation;       /* monotonically increasing; bumped on free,
68.                                   scavenge, and when readers must discard
69.                                   in-flight stale elements */
70.     uint32_t owner_pid;
71.     uint32_t reserved;
72.     uint64_t owner_starttime;  /* /proc/<pid>/stat field 22, for liveness */
73. } uct_obmm_slot_meta_t;
74. 
75. 
76. /* Convenience accessor populated by uct_obmm_pool_attach. Pointers point
77.  * into the mapped region; nothing is owned by this struct. */
78. typedef struct uct_obmm_pool {
79.     void                  *base;     /* region base (pool hdr) */
80.     size_t                 length;   /* mapped region size */
81.     uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t   *hdr;
82.     volatile uint64_t     *bitmap;
83.     uct_obmm_slot_meta_t  *meta;
84.     void                  *slots;    /* base + hdr->slot_array_offset */
85.     uint32_t               slot_count;
86.     uint32_t               slot_size;
87. } uct_obmm_pool_t;
88. 
89. 
90. /* Compute the minimum region size required to hold a pool with the given
91.  * geometry. */
92. size_t uct_obmm_pool_required_size(uint32_t slot_count, uint32_t slot_size);
93. 
94. 
95. /* Initialize the pool inside `region_base` if not already initialized, or
96.  * attach to an existing valid pool. Cross-process safe: races between
97.  * multiple processes attaching to the same region are resolved via the
98.  * hdr->state CAS. On success, `pool` is populated with cached pointers.
99.  *
100.  * If an existing pool's geometry doesn't match the requested
101.  * (slot_count, slot_size), returns UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM.
102.  */
103. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_attach(void *region_base, size_t region_size,
104.                                   uint32_t slot_count, uint32_t slot_size,
105.                                   uct_obmm_pool_t *pool);
106. 
107. 
108. /* Allocate a free slot. Scavenges slots owned by dead processes. Returns the
109.  * slot index (0..slot_count-1), a pointer to the slot bytes (length
110.  * slot_size), and the generation token the caller must stamp into outgoing
111.  * iface_addr. Slot bytes are zeroed before return.
112.  *
113.  * Returns UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE if no slot can be obtained (all slots in use
114.  * by live processes).
115.  */
116. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_alloc_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool,
117.                                       uint32_t *slot_index_p,
118.                                       void **slot_ptr_p,
119.                                       uint32_t *generation_p);
120. 
121. 
122. /* Release a slot the caller owns. Bumps generation so any stale in-flight
123.  * elements written by remote senders are dropped on the next receiver's
124.  * dispatch. Marks slot as FREE in the bitmap. */
125. void uct_obmm_pool_free_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t slot_index);
126. 
127. 
128. /* Compute pointer to a slot by index. Does not validate ownership. */
129. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void*
130. uct_obmm_pool_slot_ptr(const uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t slot_index)
131. {
132.     return (char*)pool->slots + (size_t)slot_index * pool->slot_size;
133. }

106.         hdr->state = UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY;
107.         return UCS_OK;
108.     }
109. 
110.     if (prev == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
111.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
112.         return UCS_OK;
113.     }
114. 
115.     /* state == INITING : wait or recover */
116.     for (spin = 0; spin < UCT_OBMM_POOL_INIT_SPIN_LIMIT; ++spin) {
117.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
118.         if (hdr->state == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
119.             return UCS_OK;
120.         }
121.         if (hdr->state == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT) {
122.             /* Some other rescuer reset; race for init */
123.             goto retry;
124.         }
125. 
126.         if ((spin & 0xfffu) == 0xfffu) {
127.             /* Periodically check if the initializer is alive. If not,
128.              * try to reset back to UNINIT so someone can re-init. */
129.             if (!uct_obmm_proc_alive(hdr->initializer_pid,
130.                                      hdr->initializer_starttime)) {
131.                 ucs_warn("obmm: pool initializer pid=%u died; resetting "
132.                          "pool init state",
133.                          hdr->initializer_pid);
134.                 ucs_atomic_cswap32(&hdr->state, UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_INITING,
135.                                    UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT);
136.                 goto retry;
137.             }
138.         }
139.     }
140. 
141.     ucs_error("obmm: timed out waiting for pool init to complete "
142.               "(initializer pid=%u)", hdr->initializer_pid);
143.     return UCS_ERR_TIMED_OUT;
144. }

147. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_attach(void *region_base, size_t region_size,
148.                                   uint32_t slot_count, uint32_t slot_size,
149.                                   uct_obmm_pool_t *pool)
150. {
151.     uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t *hdr = (uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t*)region_base;
152.     size_t               required;
153.     ucs_status_t         status;
154. 
155.     if ((slot_count == 0) || (slot_size == 0)) {
156.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
157.     }
158. 
159.     required = uct_obmm_pool_required_size(slot_count, slot_size);
160.     if (region_size < required) {
161.         ucs_error("obmm: region size %zu < required pool size %zu "
162.                   "(slots=%u, slot_size=%u)",
163.                   region_size, required, slot_count, slot_size);
164.         return UCS_ERR_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL;
165.     }
166. 
167.     status = uct_obmm_pool_init_or_wait(hdr, slot_count, slot_size);
168.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
169.         return status;
170.     }
171. 
172.     if (hdr->magic != UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC) {
173.         ucs_error("obmm: pool magic mismatch (got 0x%lx, expected 0x%lx)",
174.                   (unsigned long)hdr->magic, (unsigned long)UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC);
175.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
176.     }
177.     if (hdr->version != UCT_OBMM_POOL_VERSION) {
178.         ucs_error("obmm: pool version mismatch (got %u, expected %u)",
179.                   hdr->version, UCT_OBMM_POOL_VERSION);
180.         return UCS_ERR_UNSUPPORTED;
181.     }
182.     if ((hdr->slot_count != slot_count) || (hdr->slot_size != slot_size)) {
183.         ucs_error("obmm: pool geometry mismatch "
184.                   "(have slots=%u size=%u, expected %u/%u)",
185.                   hdr->slot_count, hdr->slot_size, slot_count, slot_size);
186.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
187.     }
188. 
189.     pool->base       = region_base;
190.     pool->length     = region_size;
191.     pool->hdr        = hdr;
192.     pool->bitmap     = (volatile uint64_t*)((char*)hdr + sizeof(*hdr));
193.     pool->meta       = (uct_obmm_slot_meta_t*)((char*)hdr +
194.                                                uct_obmm_pool_meta_offset(slot_count));
195.     pool->slots      = (char*)hdr + hdr->slot_array_offset;
196.     pool->slot_count = slot_count;
197.     pool->slot_size  = slot_size;
198.     return UCS_OK;
199. }

201. 
202. /* Try to claim slot `idx` for the current process. Returns 1 on success
203.  * (bit was set by us, meta updated). On scavenge of a dead owner, generation
204.  * is bumped and the slot is taken over. Returns 0 if the slot is unclaimable
205.  * (live owner). */
206. static int uct_obmm_pool_try_claim(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t idx,
207.                                    uint32_t self_pid, uint64_t self_starttime,
208.                                    uint32_t *generation_p)
209. {
210.     volatile uint64_t    *word    = &pool->bitmap[idx >> 6];
211.     uint64_t              bit     = 1ull << (idx & 63u);
212.     uct_obmm_slot_meta_t *m       = &pool->meta[idx];
213.     uint64_t              cur, oldval;
214.     int                   take_over;
215. 
216.     cur = *word;
217.     if (cur & bit) {
218.         /* allocated: maybe the owner is dead */
219.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
220.         if ((m->state == UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_IN_USE) &&
221.             uct_obmm_proc_alive(m->owner_pid, m->owner_starttime)) {
222.             return 0;
223.         }
224.         take_over = 1;
225.     } else {
226.         /* free: try to set the bit */
227.         oldval = ucs_atomic_cswap64(word, cur, cur | bit);
228.         if (oldval != cur) {
229.             return 0; /* lost the race; caller will retry next slot */
230.         }
231.         take_over = 0;
232.     }
233. 
234.     /* Bump generation so any in-flight stale messages from prior owner are
235.      * dropped by the receive path. memset slot bytes only AFTER bumping
236.      * generation, so any racing writer's bytes won't survive un-stamped. */
237.     m->generation += 1;
238.     m->owner_pid       = self_pid;
239.     m->owner_starttime = self_starttime;
240.     /* Zero the slot bytes for our use (FIFO ctl + elements). */
241.     memset(uct_obmm_pool_slot_ptr(pool, idx), 0, pool->slot_size);
242.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
243.     m->state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_IN_USE;
244.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
245. 
246.     *generation_p = m->generation;
247.     (void)take_over;
248.     return 1;
249. }
250. 
251. 
252. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_alloc_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool,
253.                                       uint32_t *slot_index_p,
254.                                       void **slot_ptr_p,
255.                                       uint32_t *generation_p)
256. {
257.     uint32_t      self_pid       = (uint32_t)getpid();
258.     unsigned long self_starttime = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time(getpid());
259.     uint32_t      i;
260. 
261.     if (self_starttime == 0ul) {
262.         ucs_warn("obmm: cannot read self process start time; "
263.                  "scavenge will treat us as dead");
264.     }
265. 
266.     for (i = 0; i < pool->slot_count; ++i) {
267.         if (uct_obmm_pool_try_claim(pool, i, self_pid,
268.                                     (uint64_t)self_starttime, generation_p)) {
269.             *slot_index_p = i;
270.             *slot_ptr_p   = uct_obmm_pool_slot_ptr(pool, i);
271.             return UCS_OK;
272.         }
273.     }
274. 
275.     return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
276. }
277. 
278. 
279. void uct_obmm_pool_free_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t slot_index)
280. {
281.     volatile uint64_t    *word = &pool->bitmap[slot_index >> 6];
282.     uint64_t              bit  = 1ull << (slot_index & 63u);
283.     uct_obmm_slot_meta_t *m    = &pool->meta[slot_index];
284.     uint64_t              cur, oldval;
285. 
286.     /* Bump generation first so any in-flight stale messages are discarded by
287.      * a future re-using owner; mark DEAD and bus fence before clearing the
288.      * bit so a racing claimer sees the new generation. */
289.     m->generation += 1;
290.     m->state       = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_DEAD;
291.     m->owner_pid   = 0;
292.     m->owner_starttime = 0;
293.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
294. 
295.     do {
296.         cur    = *word;
297.         oldval = ucs_atomic_cswap64(word, cur, cur & ~bit);
298.     } while (oldval != cur);
299. 
300.     m->state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE;
301.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
302. }
303.

305. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_open(void *region_base, size_t region_size,
306.                                 uct_obmm_pool_t *pool)
307. {
308.     uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t *hdr = (uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t*)region_base;
309.     uint32_t             state;
310.     uint32_t             slot_count, slot_size;
311.     size_t               required;
312. 
313.     if (region_size < sizeof(*hdr)) {
314.         return UCS_ERR_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL;
315.     }
316. 
317.     state = hdr->state;
318.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
319.     if (state != UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
320.         ucs_debug("obmm: pool at %p not READY (state=%u)", region_base, state);
321.         return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
322.     }
323. 
324.     if (hdr->magic != UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC) {
325.         ucs_error("obmm: pool magic mismatch on open (got 0x%lx)",
326.                   (unsigned long)hdr->magic);
327.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
328.     }
329.     if (hdr->version != UCT_OBMM_POOL_VERSION) {
330.         ucs_error("obmm: pool version mismatch on open (got %u, expected %u)",
331.                   hdr->version, UCT_OBMM_POOL_VERSION);
332.         return UCS_ERR_UNSUPPORTED;
333.     }
334. 
335.     slot_count = hdr->slot_count;
336.     slot_size  = hdr->slot_size;
337.     if ((slot_count == 0) || (slot_size == 0)) {
338.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
339.     }
340. 
341.     required = uct_obmm_pool_required_size(slot_count, slot_size);
342.     if (region_size < required) {
343.         ucs_error("obmm: peer pool geometry exceeds region size "
344.                   "(slots=%u, slot_size=%u, region=%zu, required=%zu)",
345.                   slot_count, slot_size, region_size, required);
346.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
347.     }
348. 
349.     pool->base       = region_base;
350.     pool->length     = region_size;
351.     pool->hdr        = hdr;
352.     pool->bitmap     = (volatile uint64_t*)((char*)hdr + sizeof(*hdr));
353.     pool->meta       = (uct_obmm_slot_meta_t*)((char*)hdr +
354.                                                uct_obmm_pool_meta_offset(slot_count));
355.     pool->slots      = (char*)hdr + hdr->slot_array_offset;
356.     pool->slot_count = slot_count;
357.     pool->slot_size  = slot_size;
358.     return UCS_OK;
359. }

17. #define UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC    0x4f424d50554c534full /* "OBMPULSO" */
18. /* v1: am_short only; bcopy used FIFO elem body (max_bcopy == max_short).
19.  * v2: per-slot bcopy desc array of (fifo_size * bcopy_seg_size) appended
20.  *     to each slot, max_bcopy == bcopy_seg_size.
21.  * v3: FIFO control header adds a token lock for producer-side head
22.  *     reservation, so old/new peers must not attach to each other's shared
23.  *     slot layout or reservation protocol. */
24. #define UCT_OBMM_POOL_VERSION  3u
25. 
26. 
27. enum {
28.     UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT = 0u,
29.     UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_INITING = 1u,
30.     UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY = 2u
31. };
32.

34. enum {
35.     UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE = 0u,
36.     UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_IN_USE = 1u,
37.     UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_DEAD = 2u
38. };
39.

41. /* In-region pool header. Lives at offset 0 of the local export region. All
42.  * fields are written via non-cacheable mappings: state transitions must be
43.  * paired with ucs_memory_bus_store_fence so peers (potentially on another
44.  * host) see the geometry before the READY transition. */
45. typedef struct uct_obmm_pool_hdr {
46.     uint64_t magic;             /* UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC */
47.     uint32_t version;           /* UCT_OBMM_POOL_VERSION */
48.     uint32_t state;             /* UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_xx, atomic */
49.     uint32_t slot_count;
50.     uint32_t slot_size;
51.     uint64_t slot_array_offset; /* offset (from region base) of slot 0 */
52.     uint32_t bitmap_words;      /* number of u64 words in alloc bitmap */
53.     uint32_t initializer_pid;   /* pid that owned the INITING transition */
54.     uint64_t initializer_starttime;
55.     uint64_t reserved[2];
56.     /* followed by:
57.      *   uint64_t alloc_bitmap[bitmap_words];
58.      *   uct_obmm_slot_meta_t slot_meta[slot_count];
59.      */
60. } uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t;
61. 
62. 
63. /* Per-slot ownership metadata. Stored adjacent to the bitmap, separate from
64.  * the slot's actual FIFO contents. */
65. typedef struct uct_obmm_slot_meta {
66.     uint32_t state;            /* UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_xx */
67.     uint32_t generation;       /* monotonically increasing; bumped on free,
68.                                   scavenge, and when readers must discard
69.                                   in-flight stale elements */
70.     uint32_t owner_pid;
71.     uint32_t reserved;
72.     uint64_t owner_starttime;  /* /proc/<pid>/stat field 22, for liveness */
73. } uct_obmm_slot_meta_t;
74. 
75. 
76. /* Convenience accessor populated by uct_obmm_pool_attach. Pointers point
77.  * into the mapped region; nothing is owned by this struct. */
78. typedef struct uct_obmm_pool {

74. /* CAS-claim the INITING transition; if we lose, wait until READY (or
75.  * recover the slot if the prior initializer died mid-init). */
76. static ucs_status_t
77. uct_obmm_pool_init_or_wait(uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t *hdr, uint32_t slot_count,
78.                            uint32_t slot_size)
79. {
80.     unsigned long      self_starttime = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time(getpid());
81.     uint32_t           prev;
82.     unsigned           spin;
83.     size_t             bitmap_words = uct_obmm_pool_bitmap_words(slot_count);
84.     size_t             slot_off     = uct_obmm_pool_slot_offset(slot_count);
85. 
86. retry:
87.     prev = ucs_atomic_cswap32(&hdr->state, UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT,
88.                               UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_INITING);
89. 
90.     if (prev == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT) {
91.         /* We won: zero metadata, fill geometry, publish READY */
92.         memset((char*)hdr + sizeof(*hdr), 0,
93.                bitmap_words * sizeof(uint64_t) +
94.                (size_t)slot_count * sizeof(uct_obmm_slot_meta_t));
95. 
96.         hdr->magic                 = UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC;
97.         hdr->version               = UCT_OBMM_POOL_VERSION;
98.         hdr->slot_count            = slot_count;
99.         hdr->slot_size             = slot_size;
100.         hdr->slot_array_offset     = slot_off;
101.         hdr->bitmap_words          = (uint32_t)bitmap_words;
102.         hdr->initializer_pid       = (uint32_t)getpid();
103.         hdr->initializer_starttime = (uint64_t)self_starttime;
104. 
105.         ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
106.         hdr->state = UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY;
107.         return UCS_OK;
108.     }
109. 
110.     if (prev == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
111.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
112.         return UCS_OK;
113.     }
114. 
115.     /* state == INITING : wait or recover */
116.     for (spin = 0; spin < UCT_OBMM_POOL_INIT_SPIN_LIMIT; ++spin) {
117.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
118.         if (hdr->state == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
119.             return UCS_OK;
120.         }
121.         if (hdr->state == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT) {
122.             /* Some other rescuer reset; race for init */
123.             goto retry;
124.         }
125. 
126.         if ((spin & 0xfffu) == 0xfffu) {
127.             /* Periodically check if the initializer is alive. If not,
128.              * try to reset back to UNINIT so someone can re-init. */
129.             if (!uct_obmm_proc_alive(hdr->initializer_pid,
130.                                      hdr->initializer_starttime)) {
131.                 ucs_warn("obmm: pool initializer pid=%u died; resetting "
132.                          "pool init state",
133.                          hdr->initializer_pid);
134.                 ucs_atomic_cswap32(&hdr->state, UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_INITING,
135.                                    UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT);
136.                 goto retry;
137.             }
138.         }
139.     }
140. 
141.     ucs_error("obmm: timed out waiting for pool init to complete "
142.               "(initializer pid=%u)", hdr->initializer_pid);
143.     return UCS_ERR_TIMED_OUT;
144. }

202. /* Try to claim slot `idx` for the current process. Returns 1 on success
203.  * (bit was set by us, meta updated). On scavenge of a dead owner, generation
204.  * is bumped and the slot is taken over. Returns 0 if the slot is unclaimable
205.  * (live owner). */
206. static int uct_obmm_pool_try_claim(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t idx,
207.                                    uint32_t self_pid, uint64_t self_starttime,
208.                                    uint32_t *generation_p)
209. {
210.     volatile uint64_t    *word    = &pool->bitmap[idx >> 6];
211.     uint64_t              bit     = 1ull << (idx & 63u);
212.     uct_obmm_slot_meta_t *m       = &pool->meta[idx];
213.     uint64_t              cur, oldval;
214.     int                   take_over;
215. 
216.     cur = *word;
217.     if (cur & bit) {
218.         /* allocated: maybe the owner is dead */
219.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
220.         if ((m->state == UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_IN_USE) &&
221.             uct_obmm_proc_alive(m->owner_pid, m->owner_starttime)) {
222.             return 0;
223.         }
224.         take_over = 1;
225.     } else {
226.         /* free: try to set the bit */
227.         oldval = ucs_atomic_cswap64(word, cur, cur | bit);
228.         if (oldval != cur) {
229.             return 0; /* lost the race; caller will retry next slot */
230.         }
231.         take_over = 0;
232.     }
233. 
234.     /* Bump generation so any in-flight stale messages from prior owner are
235.      * dropped by the receive path. memset slot bytes only AFTER bumping
236.      * generation, so any racing writer's bytes won't survive un-stamped. */
237.     m->generation += 1;
238.     m->owner_pid       = self_pid;
239.     m->owner_starttime = self_starttime;
240.     /* Zero the slot bytes for our use (FIFO ctl + elements). */
241.     memset(uct_obmm_pool_slot_ptr(pool, idx), 0, pool->slot_size);
242.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
243.     m->state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_IN_USE;
244.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
245. 
246.     *generation_p = m->generation;
247.     (void)take_over;
248.     return 1;
249. }

252. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_alloc_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool,
253.                                       uint32_t *slot_index_p,
254.                                       void **slot_ptr_p,
255.                                       uint32_t *generation_p)
256. {
257.     uint32_t      self_pid       = (uint32_t)getpid();
258.     unsigned long self_starttime = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time(getpid());
259.     uint32_t      i;
260. 
261.     if (self_starttime == 0ul) {
262.         ucs_warn("obmm: cannot read self process start time; "
263.                  "scavenge will treat us as dead");
264.     }
265. 
266.     for (i = 0; i < pool->slot_count; ++i) {
267.         if (uct_obmm_pool_try_claim(pool, i, self_pid,
268.                                     (uint64_t)self_starttime, generation_p)) {
269.             *slot_index_p = i;
270.             *slot_ptr_p   = uct_obmm_pool_slot_ptr(pool, i);
271.             return UCS_OK;
272.         }
273.     }
274. 
275.     return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
276. }

278. 
279. void uct_obmm_pool_free_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t slot_index)
280. {
281.     volatile uint64_t    *word = &pool->bitmap[slot_index >> 6];
282.     uint64_t              bit  = 1ull << (slot_index & 63u);
283.     uct_obmm_slot_meta_t *m    = &pool->meta[slot_index];
284.     uint64_t              cur, oldval;
285. 
286.     /* Bump generation first so any in-flight stale messages are discarded by
287.      * a future re-using owner; mark DEAD and bus fence before clearing the
288.      * bit so a racing claimer sees the new generation. */
289.     m->generation += 1;
290.     m->state       = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_DEAD;
291.     m->owner_pid   = 0;
292.     m->owner_starttime = 0;
293.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
294. 
295.     do {
296.         cur    = *word;
297.         oldval = ucs_atomic_cswap64(word, cur, cur & ~bit);
298.     } while (oldval != cur);
299. 
300.     m->state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE;
301.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
302. }

1. Problem: the current obmm cleanup path frees only the local slot and leaves the
2. rest of the shared export region intact. The user wants all residual shared
3. memory data cleared on exit, following commit
4. `6ff2ef6fc253d3b7c40b785159d465c5d3947ae3`.
5. 
6. Approach:
7. - Mirror only the cleanup-related parts of the reference commit that still fit
8.   the current NC-only branch:
9.   - make `uct_obmm_pool_free_slot()` report whether the caller released the
10.     final local slot and successfully acquired exclusive reset ownership
11.   - add `uct_obmm_pool_reset()` to zero the full local export region while
12.     keeping `hdr->state` in `INITING` until the rest of the pool is cleared
13.   - route iface cleanup through one shared helper so the last local iface
14.     resets the export region, while non-last ifaces still just free their slot
15. - Also mirror the reference commit's removal of persisted pool-version
16.   restrictions on this branch by turning the pool header's version word into a
17.   reserved field and dropping attach/open version checks.
18.

20. - ucx\src\uct\obmm\base\obmm_region.h
21. - ucx\src\uct\obmm\base\obmm_region.c
22. - ucx\src\uct\obmm\base\obmm_iface.c

23. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_region_open(const uct_obmm_dev_info_t *info,
24.                                   uct_obmm_region_t *region)
25. {
26.     ucs_status_t status;
27.     void        *map;
28.     int          fd;
29. 
30.     if (!info->allow_mmap) {
31.         ucs_debug("obmm: device %s does not support mmap", info->dev_path);
32.         return UCS_ERR_UNSUPPORTED;
33.     }
34. 
35.     if (info->size == 0) {
36.         ucs_debug("obmm: device %s reports zero size", info->dev_path);
37.         return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
38.     }
39. 
40.     /* O_SYNC selects the non-cacheable mapping, which is required for
41.      * cross-host shared FIFO use without obmm_set_ownership() flips. */
42.     fd = open(info->dev_path, O_RDWR | O_SYNC | O_CLOEXEC);
43.     if (fd < 0) {
44.         ucs_debug("obmm: open(%s) failed: %m", info->dev_path);
45.         return UCS_ERR_IO_ERROR;
46.     }
47. 
48.     map = mmap(NULL, info->size, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED, fd, 0);
49.     if (map == MAP_FAILED) {
50.         ucs_debug("obmm: mmap(%s, size=0x%" PRIx64 ") failed: %m",
51.                   info->dev_path, info->size);
52.         status = UCS_ERR_IO_ERROR;
53.         goto err_close;
54.     }
55. 
56.     region->info   = *info;
57.     region->fd     = fd;
58.     region->base   = map;
59.     region->length = info->size;
60. 
61.     ucs_debug("obmm: mapped %s memid=%" PRIu64 " size=0x%" PRIx64
62.               " base=%p type=%s dcna=0x%" PRIx64,
63.               info->dev_path, info->memid, info->size, map,
64.               (info->type == UCT_OBMM_DEV_EXPORT) ? "export" : "import",
65.               info->exporter_dcna);
66. 
67.     return UCS_OK;
68. 
69. err_close:
70.     close(fd);
71.     return status;
72. }
73. 
74. 
75. void uct_obmm_region_close(uct_obmm_region_t *region)
76. {
77.     if (region->base != NULL) {
78.         if (munmap(region->base, region->length) != 0) {
79.             ucs_warn("obmm: munmap(%s, %p, 0x%zx) failed: %m",
80.                      region->info.dev_path, region->base, region->length);
81.         }
82.         region->base = NULL;
83.     }
84. 
85.     if (region->fd >= 0) {
86.         close(region->fd);
87.         region->fd = -1;
88.     }
89. }

222. 
223. ## Wire-format compat
224. 
225. `uct_obmm_iface_addr_t` carries `(slot_index, generation, pid,
226. fifo_size, fifo_elem_size, bcopy_seg_size)`. v2 **adds** `bcopy_seg_size`
227. (replaces v1's `reserved` u32 → no struct-size change). Two ifaces are
228. mutually reachable iff all three geometry fields match — guarded in
229. `is_reachable_v2`.
230. 
231. Pool `version` stays at 1 because the on-region pool header layout has
232. not changed (only the per-slot stride changed, and stride is recorded
233. in `hdr->slot_size`). A peer attaching with a different `slot_size`
234. will hit the existing geometry-mismatch error in `pool_attach`.
235. 
236. ---
237. 
238. ## Configuration knobs
239. 
240. All under `UCX_OBMM_*` prefix.
241. 
242. | knob                      | default | meaning                          |
243. |---------------------------|---------|----------------------------------|
244. | FIFO_SIZE                 |    64   | ring depth (power of 2)          |
245. | FIFO_ELEM_SIZE            |  2048   | bytes per FIFO elem (incl. 16B hdr) → max_short = 2032 |
246. | BCOPY_SEG_SIZE   (v2 NEW) |  4096   | bytes per paired desc → max_bcopy |
247. | FIFO_MAX_POLL             |    16   | RX completions per progress()     |
248. | MEMIDS        (optional)  |   ""    | comma-separated explicit shmdev memids (for example `1,2`); when set, obmm queries only these memids instead of scanning all shmdevs. Regardless of whether this knob is set, discovery is fail-fast: any discovered/requested shmdev that is missing, unusable, or yields an invalid export/import topology fails md_open |
249. 
250. Validation at iface init:
251. - `FIFO_SIZE` > 0, power of 2
252. - `FIFO_ELEM_SIZE` > sizeof(elem_hdr) and `(elem_size - hdr) <= UINT16_MAX`
253. - `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE` > 0 and `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE <= UINT16_MAX`
254. - `slot_count * slot_stride + pool_overhead <= region->length`
255.

if (self_starttime == 0ul) {
        ucs_warn("obmm: cannot read self process start time; "
                 "scavenge will treat us as dead");
    }    for (i = 0; i < pool->slot_count; ++i) {

                                    (uint64_t)self_starttime, generation_p)) {

            *slot_ptr_p   = uct_obmm_pool_slot_ptr(pool, i);

        }
    }    return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
}static int uct_obmm_pool_all_slots_free(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool)
{
    uint32_t i;    for (i = 0; i < pool->hdr->bitmap_words; ++i) {
        if (pool->bitmap[i] != 0) {
            return 0;
        }
    }    return 1;
}int uct_obmm_pool_free_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t slot_index)
{
    volatile uint64_t    *word = &pool->bitmap[slot_index >> 6];
    uint64_t              bit  = 1ull << (slot_index & 63u);
    uct_obmm_slot_meta_t *m    = &pool->meta[slot_index];
    unsigned long         self_starttime;
    uint64_t              cur, oldval;    /* Bump generation first so any in-flight stale messages are discarded by
     * a future re-using owner; mark DEAD and bus fence before clearing the
     * bit so a racing claimer sees the new generation. */
    m->generation += 1;
    m->state       = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_DEAD;
    m->owner_pid   = 0;
    m->owner_starttime = 0;
    ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();    do {
        cur    = *word;
        oldval = ucs_atomic_cswap64(word, cur, cur & ~bit);
    } while (oldval != cur);    m->state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE;
    ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();    if (!uct_obmm_pool_all_slots_free(pool)) {
        return 0;
    }    self_starttime = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time(getpid());
    pool->hdr->initializer_pid       = (uint32_t)getpid();
    pool->hdr->initializer_starttime = (uint64_t)self_starttime;
    ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();    oldval = ucs_atomic_cswap32(&pool->hdr->state, UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY,
                                UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_INITING);
    if (oldval != UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
        return 0;
    }

    ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
    if (!uct_obmm_pool_all_slots_free(pool)) {
        ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
        pool->hdr->state = UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY;
        return 0;
    }

    return 1;
}


void uct_obmm_pool_reset(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool)
{
    uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t *hdr;

    if ((pool == NULL) || (pool->hdr == NULL) || (pool->base == NULL)) {
        return;
    }

    hdr = pool->hdr;

    if (pool->length > sizeof(*hdr)) {
        memset((char*)pool->base + sizeof(*hdr), 0, pool->length - sizeof(*hdr));
    }

    hdr->magic                 = 0;
    hdr->reserved0             = 0;
    hdr->slot_count            = 0;
    hdr->slot_size             = 0;
    hdr->slot_array_offset     = 0;
    hdr->bitmap_words          = 0;
    hdr->initializer_pid       = 0;
    hdr->initializer_starttime = 0;
    hdr->mode                  = 0;
    hdr->cc_chunk_size         = 0;
    hdr->cc_chunks_per_slot    = 0;
    hdr->reserved              = 0;
    ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();

    hdr->state = UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT;
    ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();

    memset(pool, 0, sizeof(*pool));
}

#define UCT_OBMM_POOL_H_#include <ucs/sys/compiler_def.h>
#include <ucs/type/status.h>#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>#define UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC       0x4f424d50554c534full /* "OBMPULSO" */typedef enum {

} uct_obmm_mem_mode_t;enum {
    UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT = 0u,
    UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_INITING = 1u,

};enum {
    UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE = 0u,
    UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_IN_USE = 1u,
    UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_DEAD = 2u
};/* In-region pool header. Lives at offset 0 of the local export region. All
 * fields are written via non-cacheable mappings: state transitions must be
 * paired with ucs_memory_bus_store_fence so peers (potentially on another
 * host) see the geometry before the READY transition. */
typedef struct uct_obmm_pool_hdr {
    uint64_t magic;             /* UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC */
    uint32_t reserved0;
    uint32_t state;             /* UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_xx, atomic */
    uint32_t slot_count;
    uint32_t slot_size;
    uint64_t slot_array_offset; /* offset (from region base) of slot 0 */
    uint32_t bitmap_words;      /* number of u64 words in alloc bitmap */
    uint32_t initializer_pid;   /* pid that owned the INITING transition */
    uint64_t initializer_starttime;
    uint32_t mode;              /* uct_obmm_mem_mode_t */
    uint32_t cc_chunk_size;     /* hybrid only */
    uint32_t cc_chunks_per_slot;/* hybrid only */
    uint32_t reserved;
    /* followed by:
     *   uint64_t alloc_bitmap[bitmap_words];
     *   uct_obmm_slot_meta_t slot_meta[slot_count];
     */
} uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t;/* Per-slot ownership metadata. Stored adjacent to the bitmap, separate from
 * the slot's actual FIFO contents. */
typedef struct uct_obmm_slot_meta {
    uint32_t state;            /* UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_xx */
    uint32_t generation;       /* monotonically increasing; bumped on free,
                                  scavenge, and when readers must discard
                                  in-flight stale elements */
    uint32_t owner_pid;
    uint32_t reserved;
    uint64_t owner_starttime;  /* /proc/<pid>/stat field 22, for liveness */
} uct_obmm_slot_meta_t;


/* Convenience accessor populated by uct_obmm_pool_attach. Pointers point
 * into the mapped region; nothing is owned by this struct. */
typedef struct uct_obmm_pool {
    void                  *base;     /* region base (pool hdr) */
    size_t                 length;   /* mapped region size */
    uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t   *hdr;
    volatile uint64_t     *bitmap;
    uct_obmm_slot_meta_t  *meta;
    void                  *slots;    /* base + hdr->slot_array_offset */
    uint32_t               slot_count;
    uint32_t               slot_size;
    uct_obmm_mem_mode_t    mode;
    uint32_t               cc_chunk_size;
    uint32_t               cc_chunks_per_slot;
} uct_obmm_pool_t;


/* Compute the minimum region size required to hold a pool with the given
 * geometry. */
size_t uct_obmm_pool_required_size(uint32_t slot_count, uint32_t slot_size);


/* Initialize the pool inside `region_base` if not already initialized, or
 * attach to an existing valid pool. Cross-process safe: races between
 * multiple processes attaching to the same region are resolved via the
 * hdr->state CAS. On success, `pool` is populated with cached pointers.
 *
 * If an existing pool's geometry doesn't match the requested
 * (slot_count, slot_size), returns UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM.
 */
ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_attach(void *region_base, size_t region_size,
                                   uint32_t slot_count, uint32_t slot_size,
                                   uct_obmm_mem_mode_t mode,
                                   uint32_t cc_chunk_size,
                                   uint32_t cc_chunks_per_slot,
                                   uct_obmm_pool_t *pool);


/* Allocate a free slot. Scavenges slots owned by dead processes. Returns the
 * slot index (0..slot_count-1), a pointer to the slot bytes (length
 * slot_size), and the generation token the caller must stamp into outgoing
 * iface_addr. Slot bytes are zeroed before return.
 *
 * Returns UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE if no slot can be obtained (all slots in use
 * by live processes).
 */
ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_alloc_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool,
                                      uint32_t *slot_index_p,
                                      void **slot_ptr_p,
                                      uint32_t *generation_p);


/* Release a slot the caller owns. Bumps generation so any stale in-flight
 * elements written by remote senders are dropped on the next receiver's
 * dispatch. Marks slot as FREE in the bitmap. Returns non-zero only if this
 * caller released the final local slot and acquired exclusive permission to
 * reset the whole export region to zero before another attach re-initializes
 * it. */
int uct_obmm_pool_free_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t slot_index);


/* Reset the whole local export pool region to zero. The caller must already
 * hold exclusive cleanup ownership from uct_obmm_pool_free_slot(); this helper
 * keeps hdr->state in INITING until the rest of the region is zero so a new
 * attach cannot race against a partially cleared pool. */
void uct_obmm_pool_reset(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool);


/* Compute pointer to a slot by index. Does not validate ownership. */
static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void*
uct_obmm_pool_slot_ptr(const uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t slot_index)
{
    return (char*)pool->slots + (size_t)slot_index * pool->slot_size;
}


/* Read-only attach: validates that an existing READY pool lives at

 * READY (e.g. peer iface was destroyed between address exchange and ep

1. ---
2. name: obmm-api-and-env
3. description: >
4.   Authoritative facts about the libobmm API and the target test environment
5.   for the UCT obmm transport. Use whenever writing or reviewing obmm
6.   transport code that touches memory setup, addressing, or peer reachability,
7.   to avoid hallucinating runtime behavior we do not actually have hardware
8.   to verify.
9. ---
10. 
11. # OBMM API and Test Environment
12. 
13. This skill is the **single source of truth** for what the agent may assume
14. about libobmm and the deployment topology. If something is not stated here,
15. the agent must ASK the user instead of inventing it.
16. 
17. ## libobmm public API (from `obmm/src/libobmm/libobmm.h`)
18. 
19. ```c
20. mem_id obmm_export(const size_t length[OBMM_MAX_LOCAL_NUMA_NODES],
21.                    unsigned long flags, struct obmm_mem_desc *desc);
22. int    obmm_unexport(mem_id id, unsigned long flags);
23. 
24. int    obmm_preimport(struct obmm_preimport_info *preimport_info,
25.                       unsigned long flags);
26. int    obmm_unpreimport(const struct obmm_preimport_info *preimport_info,
27.                         unsigned long flags);
28. 
29. mem_id obmm_export_useraddr(int pid, void *va, size_t length,
30.                             unsigned long flags, struct obmm_mem_desc *desc);
31. 
32. mem_id obmm_import(const struct obmm_mem_desc *desc, unsigned long flags,
33.                    int base_dist, int *numa);
34. int    obmm_unimport(mem_id id, unsigned long flags);
35. 
36. int    obmm_set_ownership(int fd, void *start, void *end, int prot);
37. 
38. int    obmm_query_memid_by_pa(unsigned long pa, mem_id *id,
39.                               unsigned long *offset);
40. int    obmm_query_pa_by_memid(mem_id id, unsigned long offset,
41.                               unsigned long *pa);
42. ```
43. 
44. Key data structures:
45. 
46. - `struct obmm_mem_desc { addr; length; seid[16]; deid[16]; tokenid; scna;
47.   dcna; priv_len; priv[]; }` — the descriptor returned by export and
48.   consumed by import.
49. - `struct obmm_preimport_info { pa; length; base_dist; numa_id; seid; deid;
50.   scna; dcna; priv_len; priv[]; }`
51. - `mem_id` is `uint64_t`; `OBMM_INVALID_MEMID == 0`.
52. 
53. ## Test environment — IMMUTABLE FACTS
54. 
55. These were stated by the project owner. The transport implementation MUST
56. be designed against exactly this topology:
57. 
58. 1. **Two nodes**, node 0 and node 1.
59. 2. Each node has **already exported a 128 MiB memory region** to the other
60.    side, before any UCX / MPI process starts.
61. 3. Each node has **already imported** the peer's 128 MiB region.
62. 4. The export / import / preimport / unimport / unexport lifecycle is
63.    handled outside the UCX transport — **the obmm UCT transport must NOT
64.    call** `obmm_export`, `obmm_unexport`, `obmm_import`, `obmm_unimport`,
65.    `obmm_preimport`, or `obmm_unpreimport` at runtime.
66. 5. Inside UCT, access to the local and peer regions is done with
67.    **`open("/dev/obmm_shmdev${memid}", O_RDWR | O_SYNC)` + `mmap`**
68.    (NC mapping; see "Locked-in design decisions" below).
69.    The local export memid and peer import memid are discovered by
70.    scanning `/sys/devices/obmm/obmm_shmdev*/` and inspecting whether
71.    each contains an `export_info/` or `import_info/` subdirectory.
72. 6. **No hardware is available** in the development environment. Do not
73.    attempt to run `mpirun`, real `ucx_perftest`, or any test that requires
74.    the obmm device. Validation is limited to:
75.      - `make` / `make install` succeeding,
76.      - `ucx_info -d` listing the obmm component, md, and tl,
77.      - `ucx_info -c` showing OBMM_* env vars,
78.      - static review against this skill and `uct-transport-patterns`.
79. 
80. ## Locked-in design decisions (do not change without re-asking)
81. 
82. These were explicitly decided with the project owner during the v1
83. am_short plan review. They override any conflicting suggestion the
84. agent may otherwise default to (notably the mm transport's behavior).
85. 
86. 1. **NC mapping for the data path.** Open shmdev with
87.    `O_RDWR | O_SYNC` and mmap with `MAP_SHARED`. This puts the FIFO
88.    region into a non-cacheable mapping, which:
89.      - bypasses the OBMM cacheable consistency model (writers and
90.        readers from any host coexist),
91.      - removes the need to ever call `obmm_set_ownership` from the
92.        transport.
93. 2. **Cross-node atomic RMW on NC is guaranteed.** The project owner
94.    has stated that the obmm fabric supports atomic FAA / CAS on NC
95.    mappings across nodes. The transport may therefore use mm-style
96.    multi-producer FIFOs (FAA on a shared head) without redesigning
97.    for SPSC.
98. 3. **UCT owns the in-region layout.** The 128 MiB exported region is
99.    zero-filled at platform export time. The transport places its own
100.    header (state / version / slot bitmap / slot_meta / fixed-size
101.    slots) at the start of the region. A two-phase init is used:
102.    `state` transitions UNINIT→INITING (CAS) → fill geometry → bus
103.    fence → store READY. Losers spin on READY then bus-load fence.
104.    Single-magic init is racy (geometry not yet visible) and must
105.    not be used.
106. 4. **Topology**: per node there is exactly 1 export region and 1
107.    import region (the peer node's export). Discovered via
108.    `/sys/devices/obmm/obmm_shmdev*/{export_info,import_info}`.
109.    Reachability and mapping table keys are
110.    `(exporter_dcna, exporter_deid, memid)` from sysfs — NOT memid
111.    alone (collision-prone).
112. 5. **Self-loopback inside one node** is supported: same-node processes
113.    communicate by both mapping the local export region (the imported
114.    "peer region" entry simply will not exist in the single-node case,
115.    or will equal the local one — handle both).
116. 6. **Slot lifecycle uses generation tokens.** Each slot has
117.    `(owner_pid, owner_starttime, generation, state)` in slot_meta.
118.    `iface_addr` and every FIFO elem carry `generation`; receiver
119.    discards mismatches. Destroy = mark DEAD → bus fence → bump
120.    generation → clear bit. Crash recovery: scan bitmap, validate
121.    `/proc/<pid>/stat starttime`, reclaim. PID alone is insufficient
122.    (PID reuse).
123. 7. **Cross-node memory ordering uses BUS-domain fences.**
124.    `ucs_memory_bus_store_fence()` / `ucs_memory_bus_load_fence()`
125.    (sfence/lfence on x86, `dmb oshst`/`dmb oshld` on arm64). The
126.    CPU-domain fences mm uses (`ucs_memory_cpu_*_fence`) are
127.    inner-shareable only and DO NOT cover cross-host NC visibility.
128. 
129. ## OBMM consistency model — why NC matters
130. 
131. From `obmm/doc/libobmm.md` and `obmm/doc/obmm_set_ownership.md`:
132. 
133. - For **cacheable** OBMM mappings, at any moment all hosts touching a
134.   region must be in one of two states:
135.     a) all hosts are PROT_READ or PROT_NONE, OR
136.     b) exactly one host has writers; all other hosts must be PROT_NONE.
137. - A receive-FIFO model (writer on the sending host, reader on the
138.   receiving host, on the SAME region) violates this: it would require
139.   one host to write while another host reads simultaneously.
140. - Therefore the obmm transport CANNOT use cacheable mappings for the
141.   FIFO region without expensive ownership flips per message.
142. - NC (O_SYNC) mappings are exempt: per the doc, "用户无需关心一致性
143.   模型，所有的用户均具备读写权限". This is why decision (1) above
144.   is mandatory, not optional.
145. 
146. ## Implications for the transport design
147. 
148. These follow from the facts above and should be treated as defaults; ask
149. the user before deviating:
150. 
151. - **Memory registration** (`uct_md_ops_t::mem_reg` / `mem_dereg`) does not
152.   need to call libobmm. The current placeholders
153.   (`uct_md_dummy_mem_reg` / `uct_md_dummy_mem_dereg`) are appropriate
154.   because the buffers used by am_short live inside the pre-imported
155.   peer region, not in arbitrary user buffers.
156. - **Address exchange** for am_short: `iface_addr` MUST carry
157.   `(exporter_dcna, exporter_deid, memid, slot_index, generation)`
158.   so the peer can (a) look up the already-mmap'd region in our MD's
159.   mapping table by exporter identity + memid, and (b) detect stale
160.   slot reuse via generation. Memid alone is unsafe and was rejected
161.   in plan-review. The current `uct_obmm_iface_addr_t = uint64_t`
162.   must be widened.
163. - **Reachability**: `iface_is_reachable_v2` matches on
164.   `(exporter_dcna, exporter_deid, memid)` against the MD's known
165.   exports + imports. Drop the `uct_sm_iface_is_reachable` (same-host)
166.   call — obmm is cross-node by construction.
167. - **Progress wiring**: `iface_progress_enable/disable` MUST call
168.   `uct_base_iface_progress_enable_cb(...)` /
169.   `uct_base_iface_progress_disable(...)`. The current
170.   `ucs_empty_function` stubs prevent UCP from ever polling the iface.
171. - **EP_CHECK**: do NOT advertise `UCT_IFACE_FLAG_EP_CHECK` in v1.
172.   The current skeleton sets it but `ep_check` only returns OK; no
173.   cross-node liveness check exists. PID-in-addr is not enough.
174. - **Ownership / `obmm_set_ownership`**: only call this if the UCT layer
175.   needs to flip read/write permission on a sub-range of the imported
176.   region; for a first am_short pass with a producer/consumer FIFO this
177.   is typically NOT needed. Ask before adding it.
178. 
179. ## What to ASK the user before writing code
180. 
181. Do not invent answers to any of these. Use the `ask_user` tool:
182. 
183. 1. Whether multiple obmm ifaces per process are expected, or strictly
184.    one peer per local iface (current assumption: 1 iface per process,
185.    pool holds many ifaces from many processes).
186. 2. What the wire `am_id` / header / payload alignment requirements are
187.    on the obmm hardware (e.g. 64 B cache line? 256 B?). Default plan
188.    aligns elements to 64 B; confirm before tuning.
189. 3. ~~Whether NC writes from one host become visible to remote loads
190.    without an explicit fabric-level barrier other than CPU
191.    `dmb`/`mfence`.~~ **RESOLVED in plan-review**: must use bus-domain
192.    fences (`ucs_memory_bus_*_fence`), not CPU-domain. CPU fences are
193.    inner-shareable only and don't reach cross-host NC.
194. 
195. ## Forbidden assumptions
196. 
197. - Do NOT assume libobmm performs its own synchronization — am_short
198.   ordering must be enforced by the transport (release / acquire fences,
199.   same as mm).
200. - Do NOT use cacheable mappings on the FIFO region. NC (`O_SYNC`)
201.   is mandatory; see "Locked-in design decisions".
202. - Do NOT call any `obmm_*` runtime API in the UCT transport unless this
203.   document is updated to allow it. In particular do NOT call
204.   `obmm_set_ownership` — its semantics conflict with the FIFO usage
205.   pattern.
206. - Do NOT use `ucs_memory_cpu_*_fence()` on the obmm data path. They
207.   are inner-shareable / compiler-only and do not cover cross-host NC
208.   visibility. Use `ucs_memory_bus_store_fence()` /
209.   `ucs_memory_bus_load_fence()` (sfence/lfence on x86,
210.   `dmb oshst`/`dmb oshld` on arm64). The mm transport gets away with
211.   CPU fences only because mm peers share an inner-shareable cache
212.   domain; obmm peers do not.
213. 
214. ## Why cacheable + manual cache management was rejected
215. 
216. Asked and answered during plan-review. Do not re-litigate without new
217. information about the obmm fabric.
218. 
219. 1. **OBMM cacheable consistency is enforced at the page-table level**,
220.    not at the cache level. `obmm/doc/libobmm.md:196-211` and
````

56. static int uct_obmm_proc_alive(uint32_t pid, uint64_t starttime)
57. {
58.     unsigned long live;
59. 
60.     if (pid == 0) {
61.         return 0;
62.     }
63. 
64.     live = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time((pid_t)pid);
65.     if (live == 0ul) {
66.         /* /proc/<pid>/stat unreadable: pid does not exist any more */
67.         return 0;
68.     }
69. 
70.     return (uint64_t)live == starttime;
71. }

74. /* CAS-claim the INITING transition; if we lose, wait until READY (or
75.  * recover the slot if the prior initializer died mid-init). */
76. static ucs_status_t
77. uct_obmm_pool_init_or_wait(uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t *hdr, uint32_t slot_count,
78.                            uint32_t slot_size)
79. {
80.     unsigned long      self_starttime = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time(getpid());
81.     uint32_t           prev;
82.     unsigned           spin;
83.     size_t             bitmap_words = uct_obmm_pool_bitmap_words(slot_count);
84.     size_t             slot_off     = uct_obmm_pool_slot_offset(slot_count);
85. 
86. retry:
87.     prev = ucs_atomic_cswap32(&hdr->state, UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT,
88.                               UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_INITING);
89. 
90.     if (prev == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT) {
91.         /* We won: zero metadata, fill geometry, publish READY */
92.         memset((char*)hdr + sizeof(*hdr), 0,
93.                bitmap_words * sizeof(uint64_t) +
94.                (size_t)slot_count * sizeof(uct_obmm_slot_meta_t));
95. 
96.         hdr->magic                 = UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC;
97.         hdr->version               = UCT_OBMM_POOL_VERSION;
98.         hdr->slot_count            = slot_count;
99.         hdr->slot_size             = slot_size;
100.         hdr->slot_array_offset     = slot_off;
101.         hdr->bitmap_words          = (uint32_t)bitmap_words;
102.         hdr->initializer_pid       = (uint32_t)getpid();
103.         hdr->initializer_starttime = (uint64_t)self_starttime;
104. 
105.         ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
106.         hdr->state = UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY;
107.         return UCS_OK;
108.     }
109. 
110.     if (prev == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
111.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
112.         return UCS_OK;
113.     }
114. 
115.     /* state == INITING : wait or recover */
116.     for (spin = 0; spin < UCT_OBMM_POOL_INIT_SPIN_LIMIT; ++spin) {
117.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
118.         if (hdr->state == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
119.             return UCS_OK;
120.         }
121.         if (hdr->state == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT) {
122.             /* Some other rescuer reset; race for init */
123.             goto retry;
124.         }
125. 
126.         if ((spin & 0xfffu) == 0xfffu) {
127.             /* Periodically check if the initializer is alive. If not,
128.              * try to reset back to UNINIT so someone can re-init. */
129.             if (!uct_obmm_proc_alive(hdr->initializer_pid,
130.                                      hdr->initializer_starttime)) {
131.                 ucs_warn("obmm: pool initializer pid=%u died; resetting "
132.                          "pool init state",
133.                          hdr->initializer_pid);
134.                 ucs_atomic_cswap32(&hdr->state, UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_INITING,
135.                                    UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT);
136.                 goto retry;
137.             }
138.         }
139.     }
140. 
141.     ucs_error("obmm: timed out waiting for pool init to complete "
142.               "(initializer pid=%u)", hdr->initializer_pid);
143.     return UCS_ERR_TIMED_OUT;
144. }

202. /* Try to claim slot `idx` for the current process. Returns 1 on success
203.  * (bit was set by us, meta updated). On scavenge of a dead owner, generation
204.  * is bumped and the slot is taken over. Returns 0 if the slot is unclaimable
205.  * (live owner). */
206. static int uct_obmm_pool_try_claim(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t idx,
207.                                    uint32_t self_pid, uint64_t self_starttime,
208.                                    uint32_t *generation_p)
209. {
210.     volatile uint64_t    *word    = &pool->bitmap[idx >> 6];
211.     uint64_t              bit     = 1ull << (idx & 63u);
212.     uct_obmm_slot_meta_t *m       = &pool->meta[idx];
213.     uint64_t              cur, oldval;
214.     int                   take_over;
215. 
216.     cur = *word;
217.     if (cur & bit) {
218.         /* allocated: maybe the owner is dead */
219.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
220.         if ((m->state == UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_IN_USE) &&
221.             uct_obmm_proc_alive(m->owner_pid, m->owner_starttime)) {
222.             return 0;
223.         }
224.         take_over = 1;
225.     } else {
226.         /* free: try to set the bit */
227.         oldval = ucs_atomic_cswap64(word, cur, cur | bit);
228.         if (oldval != cur) {
229.             return 0; /* lost the race; caller will retry next slot */
230.         }
231.         take_over = 0;
232.     }
233. 
234.     /* Bump generation so any in-flight stale messages from prior owner are
235.      * dropped by the receive path. memset slot bytes only AFTER bumping
236.      * generation, so any racing writer's bytes won't survive un-stamped. */
237.     m->generation += 1;
238.     m->owner_pid       = self_pid;
239.     m->owner_starttime = self_starttime;
240.     /* Zero the slot bytes for our use (FIFO ctl + elements). */
241.     memset(uct_obmm_pool_slot_ptr(pool, idx), 0, pool->slot_size);
242.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
243.     m->state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_IN_USE;
244.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
245. 
246.     *generation_p = m->generation;
247.     (void)take_over;
248.     return 1;
249. }

252. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_alloc_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool,
253.                                       uint32_t *slot_index_p,
254.                                       void **slot_ptr_p,
255.                                       uint32_t *generation_p)
256. {
257.     uint32_t      self_pid       = (uint32_t)getpid();
258.     unsigned long self_starttime = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time(getpid());
259.     uint32_t      i;
260. 
261.     if (self_starttime == 0ul) {
262.         ucs_warn("obmm: cannot read self process start time; "
263.                  "scavenge will treat us as dead");
264.     }
265. 
266.     for (i = 0; i < pool->slot_count; ++i) {
267.         if (uct_obmm_pool_try_claim(pool, i, self_pid,
268.                                     (uint64_t)self_starttime, generation_p)) {
269.             *slot_index_p = i;
270.             *slot_ptr_p   = uct_obmm_pool_slot_ptr(pool, i);
271.             return UCS_OK;
272.         }
273.     }
274. 
275.     return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
276. }

278. 
279. void uct_obmm_pool_free_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t slot_index)
280. {
281.     volatile uint64_t    *word = &pool->bitmap[slot_index >> 6];
282.     uint64_t              bit  = 1ull << (slot_index & 63u);
283.     uct_obmm_slot_meta_t *m    = &pool->meta[slot_index];
284.     uint64_t              cur, oldval;
285. 
286.     /* Bump generation first so any in-flight stale messages are discarded by
287.      * a future re-using owner; mark DEAD and bus fence before clearing the
288.      * bit so a racing claimer sees the new generation. */
289.     m->generation += 1;
290.     m->state       = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_DEAD;
291.     m->owner_pid   = 0;
292.     m->owner_starttime = 0;
293.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
294. 
295.     do {
296.         cur    = *word;
297.         oldval = ucs_atomic_cswap64(word, cur, cur & ~bit);
298.     } while (oldval != cur);
299. 
300.     m->state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE;
301.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
302. }

356.     pool->slot_count = slot_count;
357.     pool->slot_size  = slot_size;
358.     return UCS_OK;
359. }

159. static int
160. uct_obmm_iface_is_reachable_v2(const uct_iface_h tl_iface,
161.                                const uct_iface_is_reachable_params_t *params)
162. {
163.     uct_obmm_iface_t             *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_iface,
164.                                                          uct_obmm_iface_t);
165.     uct_obmm_md_t                *md    = ucs_derived_of(iface->super.md,
166.                                                          uct_obmm_md_t);
167.     const uct_obmm_device_addr_t *daddr;
168.     const uct_obmm_iface_addr_t  *iaddr;
169.     uct_obmm_eid_t                eid;
170.     uct_obmm_region_t            *export_r;
171. 
172.     if (!uct_iface_is_reachable_params_addrs_valid(params)) {
173.         return 0;
174.     }
175. 
176.     daddr = (const uct_obmm_device_addr_t*)params->device_addr;
177.     iaddr = (const uct_obmm_iface_addr_t*)params->iface_addr;
178.     if ((daddr == NULL) || (iaddr == NULL)) {
179.         uct_iface_fill_info_str_buf(params, "missing device or iface address");
180.         return 0;
181.     }
182. 
183.     if ((iaddr->fifo_size != iface->fifo_size) ||
184.         (iaddr->fifo_elem_size != iface->fifo_elem_size) ||
185.         (iaddr->bcopy_seg_size != iface->bcopy_seg_size)) {
186.         uct_iface_fill_info_str_buf(params,
187.                                     "incompatible OBMM geometry "
188.                                     "(peer fifo=%u elem=%u seg=%u, "
189.                                     "local fifo=%u elem=%u seg=%u)",
190.                                     iaddr->fifo_size, iaddr->fifo_elem_size,
191.                                     iaddr->bcopy_seg_size,
192.                                     iface->fifo_size, iface->fifo_elem_size,
193.                                     iface->bcopy_seg_size);
194.         return 0;
195.     }
196. 
197.     eid.hi = daddr->exporter_deid_hi;
198.     eid.lo = daddr->exporter_deid_lo;
199. 
200.     export_r = uct_obmm_md_export_region(md);
201.     if ((export_r != NULL) &&
202.         (export_r->info.exporter_dcna == daddr->exporter_dcna) &&
203.         (export_r->info.exporter_deid.hi == eid.hi) &&
204.         (export_r->info.exporter_deid.lo == eid.lo)) {
205.         return uct_iface_scope_is_reachable(tl_iface, params);
206.     }
207. 
208.     if (uct_obmm_md_find_import_region(md, daddr->exporter_dcna, &eid) != NULL) {
209.         return uct_iface_scope_is_reachable(tl_iface, params);
210.     }
211. 
212.     uct_iface_fill_info_str_buf(params,
213.                                 "no mapped region for peer dcna=0x%lx "
214.                                 "deid=0x%lx:0x%lx",
215.                                 (unsigned long)daddr->exporter_dcna,
216.                                 (unsigned long)eid.hi, (unsigned long)eid.lo);
217.     return 0;
218. }

221. static unsigned uct_obmm_iface_progress(uct_iface_h tl_iface)
222. {
223.     uct_obmm_iface_t        *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_iface, uct_obmm_iface_t);
224.     unsigned                 polled = 0;
225.     uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem;
226.     uint8_t                  flags;
227.     uint8_t                  expected_owner;
228.     size_t                   max_poll = iface->fifo_max_poll;
229. 
230.     while (polled < max_poll) {
231.         elem = uct_obmm_slot_elem(iface->recv_elems, iface->read_index,
232.                                   iface->fifo_mask, iface->fifo_elem_size);
233. 
234.         /* Owner bit alternates each lap of the ring; pass 0 expects 1, pass
235.          * 1 expects 0, etc. Combined with zero-fill on slot allocation, this
236.          * means an unwritten slot reads as flags==0 and is correctly skipped
237.          * on the very first lap. */
238.         expected_owner = ((iface->read_index / iface->fifo_size) & 1u) ?
239.                          0u : UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER;
240. 
241.         flags = elem->flags;
242.         if ((flags & UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER) != expected_owner) {
243.             break;
244.         }
245. 
246.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
247. 
248.         if (elem->generation != iface->generation) {
249.             /* Stale write from a previous slot owner (we were torn down and
250.              * re-allocated this slot). Drop silently. */
251.             ucs_trace_data("obmm: drop stale elem (gen=%u expected=%u) "
252.                            "at idx=%lu", elem->generation, iface->generation,
253.                            (unsigned long)iface->read_index);
254.         } else if (flags & UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_BCOPY) {
255.             /* am_bcopy: payload is in the paired desc[N], not in the FIFO
256.              * element body. The bus_load_fence above orders this load
257.              * with respect to the sender's bus_store_fence + flag write. */
258.             void *desc = uct_obmm_slot_desc(iface->recv_descs,
259.                                             iface->read_index,

461. static UCS_CLASS_CLEANUP_FUNC(uct_obmm_iface_t)
462. {
463.     uct_base_iface_progress_disable(&self->super.super,
464.                                     UCT_PROGRESS_SEND | UCT_PROGRESS_RECV);
465.     if (self->pool.hdr != NULL) {
466.         uct_obmm_pool_free_slot(&self->pool, self->slot_index);
467.     }
468.     /* All eps were destroyed before iface cleanup (UCX framework
469.      * contract; mm relies on the same), so the arbiter is empty. */
470.     ucs_arbiter_cleanup(&self->arbiter);
471. }
