1. # obmm UCT transport — design notes
2. 
3. This file is the **single source of truth** for the on-region wire format
4. and the data-path semantics of the `obmm` UCT transport. Update it
5. **before** changing layout, capabilities, or sync rules. AGENTS.md
6. mandates retrieve-before-recall; this doc is the first thing to grep.
7. 
8. Status legend:
9. - **v1** = shipped, MPI cross-node smoke tests pass.
10. - **v2** = current target: complete `am_bcopy` (max_bcopy decoupled from
11.   FIFO element size, no per-message UCP fragmentation below seg_size).
12. 
13. ---
14. 
15. ## Locked-in environment facts
16. 
17. (Mirrors `.github/skills/obmm-api-and-env/SKILL.md`. Do NOT contradict
18. without re-checking that file.)
19. 
20. - Each node pre-exports **one 128 MiB region**; export/import is done
21.   outside UCX. UCT must NOT call `obmm_export/import/preimport/...`.
22. - Data-path mapping is **non-cacheable** (`open(... O_SYNC)` + mmap).
23.   `obmm_set_ownership` is forbidden and irrelevant.
24. - Cross-host atomic FAA/CAS on NC is supported (project-owner statement).
25. - Memory ordering uses **bus-domain fences**
26.   (`ucs_memory_bus_store_fence` / `ucs_memory_bus_load_fence`), NOT the
27.   CPU-domain `ucs_memory_cpu_*_fence` that mm uses. mm peers share an
28.   inner-shareable cache domain; obmm peers do not.
29. - Reachability is keyed on `(exporter_dcna, exporter_deid, memid)`,
30.   never memid alone.
31. - Two-phase pool init (UNINIT → INITING → READY via CAS) plus per-slot
32.   `(generation, owner_pid, owner_starttime)` for crash/PID-reuse safety.
33. - ARM64 is the production ISA. NC + bus fences are correct on aarch64.
34. 
35. ---
36. 
37. ## Region layout (v2)
38. 
39. Inside the 128 MiB exported region:
40. 
41. ```
42. +-------------------------------------------------------+ offset 0
43. | uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t (magic, version, state, geometry) |
44. +-------------------------------------------------------+
45. | alloc_bitmap[bitmap_words]                            |
46. +-------------------------------------------------------+
47. | slot_meta[slot_count]  (gen, owner_pid, starttime, …) |
48. +-------------------------------------------------------+ hdr->slot_array_offset
49. | slot[0]:                                              |
50. |   uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t  (head + tail, padded)          |
51. |   fifo_elem[fifo_size]  (elem_size each)              |
52. |   bcopy_desc[fifo_size] (seg_size each)   <-- NEW v2  |
53. +-------------------------------------------------------+
54. | slot[1]: …                                            |
55. …
56. ```
57. 
58. **Key invariant (v2)**: every FIFO element `elem[N]` (N = `idx & mask`)
59. has a paired `desc[N]` of `seg_size` bytes in the same slot. Lifetime of
60. `desc[N]` is **identical** to lifetime of `elem[N]` — both are released
61. together when the receiver bumps tail past index N, and both are
62. overwritten together by the sender that claims index N+fifo_size.
63. 
64. This eliminates the cross-host desc free-list problem: there is no
65. separate desc allocator, no per-desc CAS, and no risk of the desc pool
66. running dry while FIFO slots remain available. The FIFO already has
67. exactly the right backpressure semantics.
68. 
69. ### Slot stride
70. 
71. ```
72. slot_stride = align_up(
73.     sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t) +
74.     fifo_size * elem_size +
75.     fifo_size * seg_size,
76.     cacheline)
77. ```
78. 
79. The pool's `slot_count` (compile-time `UCT_OBMM_POOL_SLOT_COUNT = 256`)
80. **times** `slot_stride` MUST fit in `region->length` (128 MiB minus pool
81. header overhead). Defaults are picked so that this holds; callers may
82. shrink (not grow) `seg_size` / `fifo_size` if they need more slots.
83. 
84. Default budget check:
85. ```
86. fifo_size       =     64
87. elem_size       =   2048   (max_short = 2032)
88. seg_size        =   4096   (max_bcopy = 4096)
89. ctl + slot data = 128 + 64*(2048+4096) = ~384 KiB / slot
90. slot_count      =    256
91. total           = ~ 96 MiB / 128 MiB                     ✓
92. ```
93. If a user bumps `seg_size` to 8192, total grows to ~160 MiB and pool
94. attach fails with a clear error pointing at the geometry knobs.
95. 
96. ---
97. 
98. ## FIFO element layout
99. 
100. `uct_obmm_fifo_element_t` (16 bytes, packed) is unchanged from v1:
101. 
102. | field      | bytes | notes                                          |
103. |------------|-------|------------------------------------------------|
104. | flags      |   1   | OWNER bit + BCOPY bit                          |
105. | am_id      |   1   |                                                |
106. | length     |   2   | u16 — payload bytes (excl. am_short hdr)       |
107. | generation |   4   | slot generation token at TX time               |
108. | header     |   8   | am_short user-visible 8B header (unused bcopy) |
109. 
110. **am_short payload** still lives inline at `elem + 1` in the FIFO area.
111. Wire format and `max_short = elem_size - 16` are unchanged.
112. 
113. **am_bcopy payload** (NEW in v2) lives in the paired `desc[N]` instead
114. of inside the FIFO element body. The element body is unused for bcopy;
115. on bcopy the sender writes:
116. - `elem->flags  = OWNER | BCOPY`
117. - `elem->am_id  = id`
118. - `elem->length = pack_cb_returned_length`     (≤ seg_size, so ≤ u16max)
119. - `elem->generation = ep->expected_generation`
120. - `elem->header = 0` (unused)
121. 
122. Receiver, on seeing FLAG_BCOPY, computes
123. `desc[N] = slot_descs + (idx & mask) * seg_size` and calls
124. `uct_iface_invoke_am(am_id, desc[N], length, 0)`.
125. 
126. Because `desc[N]` is bound 1:1 to `elem[N]`, no extra metadata is
127. exchanged in the FIFO element to locate the desc.
128. 
129. ### `length` field width
130. 
131. `elem->length` stays `uint16_t`, capping `seg_size` at 65535. We reject
132. larger `seg_size` at iface init. If a future `seg_size > 64KiB` is
133. needed, widen `length` to `uint32_t` (and bump pool `version`).
134. 
135. ---
136. 
137. ## Sender side (`obmm_ep`)
138. 
139. Both `am_short` and `am_bcopy` reserve a slot identically:
140. 
141. ```
142. 1. load head from peer_ctl->head
143. 2. if (head - cached_tail) >= fifo_size:
144.        bus_load_fence; refresh cached_tail; recheck;
145.        if still full: return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE
146. 3. claim producer lock (`peer_ctl->lock`) with a unique token, then
147.    store head → head+1, then release the lock
148. 4. compute idx = head, N = idx & mask
149. 5. payload write:
150.      short: memcpy header+payload into elem[N]+1
151.      bcopy: pack_cb(desc[N], arg) -> length
152. 6. fill elem[N] header fields (am_id, length, generation, [header])
153. 7. ucs_memory_bus_store_fence()                          <- release barrier
154. 8. elem[N]->flags = OWNER_BIT_FOR_THIS_LAP | (BCOPY if bcopy)
155. ```
156. 
157. The OWNER bit alternates each lap of the ring (see `obmm_iface.c`
158. `uct_obmm_iface_progress` for why). Since `desc[N]` writes happen
159. **before** the bus_store_fence, they become visible to the peer at the
160. same time as the published flags byte.
161. 
162. The producer lock exists because on the validated target aarch64 NC
163. environment, cross-node CAS updates memory correctly but its return value
164. is not reliable enough to use as a head-claim ownership result. The token
165. lock converts reservation into: acquire lock by readback, re-check space,
166. plain-store new head, release lock.
167. 
168. ### Pending
169. 
170. `ep_pending_add` returns `UCS_ERR_BUSY` (UCP retries via its own
171. progress loop). Real arbiter is out of scope for v1/v2 — backpressure
172. is bounded because the receiver drains continuously.
173. 
174. ---
175. 
176. ## Receiver side (`obmm_iface_progress`)
177. 
178. ```
179. loop up to fifo_max_poll:
180.     elem = elem[read_index & mask]
181.     expected_owner = lap_parity(read_index)
182.     if (elem->flags & OWNER) != expected_owner: break       (no work)
183.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence()                              (acquire)
184.     if elem->generation != iface->generation:
185.         drop silently (slot was reused after our death+rebirth)
186.     elif elem->flags & BCOPY:
187.         desc = desc[read_index & mask]
188.         invoke_am(am_id, desc,  length, 0)
189.     else:
190.         invoke_am(am_id, &elem->header, length, 0)
191.     read_index++
192. if any progress:
193.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence()
194.     recv_ctl->tail = read_index
195. ```
196. 
197. **Why the fence ordering is correct for bcopy too**: the
198. `ucs_memory_bus_load_fence()` issued after observing the flags byte
199. orders **all** subsequent loads in this iteration — including the
200. load of `desc[N]` performed inside the AM handler's memcpy. The handler
201. is `CB_SYNC` (synchronous), so the fence-acquire pairs with the
202. sender's `bus_store_fence` before publishing flags.
203. 
204. ---
205. 
206. ## Capabilities (`iface_query`)
207. 
208. | flag                            | v1 | v2 | notes                       |
209. |---------------------------------|----|----|-----------------------------|
210. | AM_SHORT                        |  ✓ |  ✓ | max = elem_size - 16        |
211. | AM_BCOPY                        |  ✓ |  ✓ | v1: = max_short (cramped); v2: = seg_size |
212. | PENDING                         |  ✓ |  ✓ | returns BUSY only           |
213. | CONNECT_TO_IFACE                |  ✓ |  ✓ |                             |
214. | CB_SYNC                         |  ✓ |  ✓ |                             |
215. | INTER_NODE                      |  ✓ |  ✓ | required for cross-host UCT (otherwise OMPI's NET_ONLY filter strips us — see ucp_worker.c:2962) |
216. 
217. **Not advertised** in v1/v2: PUT/GET (any), ATOMIC, AM_ZCOPY, EP_CHECK,
218. AM_DUP, ERRHANDLE_PEER. Adding any of these requires a separate design
219. note.
220. 
221. ---
222. 
223. ## Wire-format compat
224. 
225. `uct_obmm_iface_addr_t` carries `(slot_index, generation, pid,
226. fifo_size, fifo_elem_size, bcopy_seg_size)`. v2 **adds** `bcopy_seg_size`
227. (replaces v1's `reserved` u32 → no struct-size change). Two ifaces are
228. mutually reachable iff all three geometry fields match — guarded in
229. `is_reachable_v2`.
230. 
231. Pool `version` stays at 1 because the on-region pool header layout has
232. not changed (only the per-slot stride changed, and stride is recorded
233. in `hdr->slot_size`). A peer attaching with a different `slot_size`
234. will hit the existing geometry-mismatch error in `pool_attach`.
235. 
236. ---
237. 
238. ## Configuration knobs
239. 
240. All under `UCX_OBMM_*` prefix.
241. 
242. | knob                      | default | meaning                          |
243. |---------------------------|---------|----------------------------------|
244. | FIFO_SIZE                 |    64   | ring depth (power of 2)          |
245. | FIFO_ELEM_SIZE            |  2048   | bytes per FIFO elem (incl. 16B hdr) → max_short = 2032 |
246. | BCOPY_SEG_SIZE   (v2 NEW) |  4096   | bytes per paired desc → max_bcopy |
247. | FIFO_MAX_POLL             |    16   | RX completions per progress()     |
248. | MEMIDS        (optional)  |   ""    | comma-separated explicit shmdev memids (for example `1,2`); when set, obmm queries only these memids instead of scanning all shmdevs. Regardless of whether this knob is set, discovery is fail-fast: any discovered/requested shmdev that is missing, unusable, or yields an invalid export/import topology fails md_open |
249. 
250. Validation at iface init:
251. - `FIFO_SIZE` > 0, power of 2
252. - `FIFO_ELEM_SIZE` > sizeof(elem_hdr) and `(elem_size - hdr) <= UINT16_MAX`
253. - `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE` > 0 and `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE <= UINT16_MAX`
254. - `slot_count * slot_stride + pool_overhead <= region->length`
255. 
256. ---
257.

259. 
260. - `am_zcopy`: requires UCT MD memory-handle plumbing (`mem_reg`,

/**

 * See file LICENSE for terms.
 */#ifndef UCT_OBMM_POOL_H_
#define UCT_OBMM_POOL_H_#include <ucs/sys/compiler_def.h>
#include <ucs/type/status.h>#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>#define UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC       0x4f424d50554c534full /* "OBMPULSO" */typedef enum {
    UCT_OBMM_MEM_MODE_NC = 0,
    UCT_OBMM_MEM_MODE_HYBRID = 1
} uct_obmm_mem_mode_t;enum {
    UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT = 0u,
    UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_INITING = 1u,
    UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY = 2u
};enum {
    UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE = 0u,
    UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_IN_USE = 1u,
    UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_DEAD = 2u
};/* In-region pool header. Lives at offset 0 of the local export region. All
 * fields are written via non-cacheable mappings: state transitions must be
 * paired with ucs_memory_bus_store_fence so peers (potentially on another
 * host) see the geometry before the READY transition. */
typedef struct uct_obmm_pool_hdr {
    uint64_t magic;             /* UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC */
    uint32_t reserved0;
    uint32_t state;             /* UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_xx, atomic */
    uint32_t slot_count;
    uint32_t slot_size;
    uint64_t slot_array_offset; /* offset (from region base) of slot 0 */
    uint32_t bitmap_words;      /* number of u64 words in alloc bitmap */
    uint32_t initializer_pid;   /* pid that owned the INITING transition */
    uint64_t initializer_starttime;
    uint32_t mode;              /* uct_obmm_mem_mode_t */
    uint32_t cc_chunk_size;     /* hybrid only */
    uint32_t cc_chunks_per_slot;/* hybrid only */
    uint32_t reserved;
    /* followed by:
     *   uint64_t alloc_bitmap[bitmap_words];
     *   uct_obmm_slot_meta_t slot_meta[slot_count];
     */
} uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t;/* Per-slot ownership metadata. Stored adjacent to the bitmap, separate from
 * the slot's actual FIFO contents. */
typedef struct uct_obmm_slot_meta {
    uint32_t state;            /* UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_xx */
    uint32_t generation;       /* monotonically increasing; bumped on free,
                                  scavenge, and when readers must discard
                                  in-flight stale elements */
    uint32_t owner_pid;
    uint32_t reserved;
    uint64_t owner_starttime;  /* /proc/<pid>/stat field 22, for liveness */
} uct_obmm_slot_meta_t;


/* Convenience accessor populated by uct_obmm_pool_attach. Pointers point
 * into the mapped region; nothing is owned by this struct. */
typedef struct uct_obmm_pool {
    void                  *base;     /* region base (pool hdr) */
    size_t                 length;   /* mapped region size */
    uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t   *hdr;
    volatile uint64_t     *bitmap;
    uct_obmm_slot_meta_t  *meta;
    void                  *slots;    /* base + hdr->slot_array_offset */
    uint32_t               slot_count;
    uint32_t               slot_size;
    uct_obmm_mem_mode_t    mode;
    uint32_t               cc_chunk_size;
    uint32_t               cc_chunks_per_slot;
} uct_obmm_pool_t;


/* Compute the minimum region size required to hold a pool with the given
 * geometry. */
size_t uct_obmm_pool_required_size(uint32_t slot_count, uint32_t slot_size);


/* Initialize the pool inside `region_base` if not already initialized, or
 * attach to an existing valid pool. Cross-process safe: races between
 * multiple processes attaching to the same region are resolved via the
 * hdr->state CAS. On success, `pool` is populated with cached pointers.
 *
 * If an existing pool's geometry doesn't match the requested
 * (slot_count, slot_size), returns UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM.
 */
ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_attach(void *region_base, size_t region_size,
                                   uint32_t slot_count, uint32_t slot_size,
                                   uct_obmm_mem_mode_t mode,
                                   uint32_t cc_chunk_size,
                                   uint32_t cc_chunks_per_slot,
                                   uct_obmm_pool_t *pool);


/* Allocate a free slot. Scavenges slots owned by dead processes. Returns the
 * slot index (0..slot_count-1), a pointer to the slot bytes (length
 * slot_size), and the generation token the caller must stamp into outgoing
 * iface_addr. Slot bytes are zeroed before return.
 *
 * Returns UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE if no slot can be obtained (all slots in use
 * by live processes).
 */
ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_alloc_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool,
                                      uint32_t *slot_index_p,
                                      void **slot_ptr_p,
                                      uint32_t *generation_p);


/* Release a slot the caller owns. Bumps generation so any stale in-flight
 * elements written by remote senders are dropped on the next receiver's
 * dispatch. Marks slot as FREE in the bitmap. Returns non-zero only if this
 * caller released the final local slot and acquired exclusive permission to
 * reset the whole export region to zero before another attach re-initializes
 * it. */
int uct_obmm_pool_free_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t slot_index);


/* Reset the whole local export pool region to zero. The caller must already
 * hold exclusive cleanup ownership from uct_obmm_pool_free_slot(); this helper
 * keeps hdr->state in INITING until the rest of the region is zero so a new
 * attach cannot race against a partially cleared pool. */
void uct_obmm_pool_reset(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool);


/* Compute pointer to a slot by index. Does not validate ownership. */
static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void*
uct_obmm_pool_slot_ptr(const uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t slot_index)
{
    return (char*)pool->slots + (size_t)slot_index * pool->slot_size;
}


/* Read-only attach: validates that an existing READY pool lives at
 * `region_base`, and populates `pool` with cached pointers. Does NOT
 * attempt initialization. Used by ep_create to access a peer's pool
 * without owning it. Returns UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE if the pool is not
 * READY (e.g. peer iface was destroyed between address exchange and ep
 * create). */
ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_open(void *region_base, size_t region_size,
                                uct_obmm_pool_t *pool);

/**
 * Copyright (c) 2026 Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd. ALL RIGHTS RESERVED.
 *
 * See file LICENSE for terms.
 */#ifdef HAVE_CONFIG_H
#  include "config.h"
#endif#include "obmm_pool.h"#include <ucs/arch/atomic.h>
#include <ucs/arch/cpu.h>
#include <ucs/debug/log.h>
#include <ucs/sys/sys.h>
#include <ucs/sys/math.h>
#include <ucs/sys/ptr_arith.h>#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>#define UCT_OBMM_POOL_INIT_SPIN_LIMIT  (1u << 22) /* ~ a few seconds of spin */static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE size_t
uct_obmm_pool_bitmap_words(uint32_t slot_count)
{
    return (slot_count + 63u) / 64u;
}static size_t uct_obmm_pool_meta_offset(uint32_t slot_count)
{
    return sizeof(uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t) +
           uct_obmm_pool_bitmap_words(slot_count) * sizeof(uint64_t);
}static size_t uct_obmm_pool_slot_offset(uint32_t slot_count)
{
    return ucs_align_up(uct_obmm_pool_meta_offset(slot_count) +
                        (size_t)slot_count * sizeof(uct_obmm_slot_meta_t),
                        UCS_SYS_CACHE_LINE_SIZE);
}size_t uct_obmm_pool_required_size(uint32_t slot_count, uint32_t slot_size)
{
    return uct_obmm_pool_slot_offset(slot_count) +
           (size_t)slot_count * slot_size;
}static int uct_obmm_proc_alive(uint32_t pid, uint64_t starttime)
{
    unsigned long live;    if (pid == 0) {
        return 0;
    }    live = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time((pid_t)pid);
    if (live == 0ul) {
        /* /proc/<pid>/stat unreadable: pid does not exist any more */
        return 0;
    }    return (uint64_t)live == starttime;
}


/* CAS-claim the INITING transition; if we lose, wait until READY (or
 * recover the slot if the prior initializer died mid-init). */
static ucs_status_t
uct_obmm_pool_init_or_wait(uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t *hdr, uint32_t slot_count,
                           uint32_t slot_size, uct_obmm_mem_mode_t mode,
                           uint32_t cc_chunk_size,
                           uint32_t cc_chunks_per_slot)
{
    unsigned long      self_starttime = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time(getpid());
    uint32_t           prev;
    unsigned           spin;
    size_t             bitmap_words = uct_obmm_pool_bitmap_words(slot_count);
    size_t             slot_off     = uct_obmm_pool_slot_offset(slot_count);

retry:
    prev = ucs_atomic_cswap32(&hdr->state, UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT,
                              UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_INITING);

    if (prev == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT) {
        /* We won: zero metadata, fill geometry, publish READY */
        memset((char*)hdr + sizeof(*hdr), 0,
               bitmap_words * sizeof(uint64_t) +
               (size_t)slot_count * sizeof(uct_obmm_slot_meta_t));

        hdr->magic                 = UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC;
        hdr->reserved0             = 0;
        hdr->slot_count            = slot_count;
        hdr->slot_size             = slot_size;
        hdr->slot_array_offset     = slot_off;
        hdr->bitmap_words          = (uint32_t)bitmap_words;
        hdr->initializer_pid       = (uint32_t)getpid();
        hdr->initializer_starttime = (uint64_t)self_starttime;
        hdr->mode                  = mode;
        hdr->cc_chunk_size         = cc_chunk_size;
        hdr->cc_chunks_per_slot    = cc_chunks_per_slot;

        ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
        hdr->state = UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY;
        return UCS_OK;
    }

    if (prev == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
        ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
        return UCS_OK;
    }

    /* state == INITING : wait or recover */
    for (spin = 0; spin < UCT_OBMM_POOL_INIT_SPIN_LIMIT; ++spin) {
        ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
        if (hdr->state == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
            return UCS_OK;
        }
        if (hdr->state == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT) {
            /* Some other rescuer reset; race for init */
            goto retry;
        }

        if ((spin & 0xfffu) == 0xfffu) {
            /* Periodically check if the initializer is alive. If not,
             * try to reset back to UNINIT so someone can re-init. */
            if (!uct_obmm_proc_alive(hdr->initializer_pid,
                                     hdr->initializer_starttime)) {
                ucs_warn("obmm: pool initializer pid=%u died; resetting "
                         "pool init state",
                         hdr->initializer_pid);
                ucs_atomic_cswap32(&hdr->state, UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_INITING,
                                   UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT);
                goto retry;
            }
        }
    }

    ucs_error("obmm: timed out waiting for pool init to complete "
              "(initializer pid=%u)", hdr->initializer_pid);
    return UCS_ERR_TIMED_OUT;
}


ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_attach(void *region_base, size_t region_size,
                                   uint32_t slot_count, uint32_t slot_size,
                                   uct_obmm_mem_mode_t mode,
                                   uint32_t cc_chunk_size,
                                   uint32_t cc_chunks_per_slot,
                                   uct_obmm_pool_t *pool)
{
    uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t *hdr = (uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t*)region_base;
    size_t               required;
    ucs_status_t         status;

    if ((slot_count == 0) || (slot_size == 0)) {
        return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    if ((mode != UCT_OBMM_MEM_MODE_NC) &&
        (mode != UCT_OBMM_MEM_MODE_HYBRID)) {
        return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    required = uct_obmm_pool_required_size(slot_count, slot_size);
    if (region_size < required) {
        ucs_error("obmm: region size %zu < required pool size %zu "
                  "(slots=%u, slot_size=%u)",
                  region_size, required, slot_count, slot_size);
        return UCS_ERR_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL;
    }

    status = uct_obmm_pool_init_or_wait(hdr, slot_count, slot_size, mode,
                                        cc_chunk_size,
                                        cc_chunks_per_slot);
    if (status != UCS_OK) {
        return status;
    }

    if (hdr->magic != UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC) {
        ucs_error("obmm: pool magic mismatch (got 0x%lx, expected 0x%lx)",
                  (unsigned long)hdr->magic, (unsigned long)UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC);
        return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    if ((hdr->mode != mode) || (hdr->cc_chunk_size != cc_chunk_size) ||
        (hdr->cc_chunks_per_slot != cc_chunks_per_slot)) {
        ucs_error("obmm: pool mode/chunk mismatch (have mode=%u chunk=%u/%u, "
                  "expected mode=%u chunk=%u/%u)",
                  hdr->mode, hdr->cc_chunk_size, hdr->cc_chunks_per_slot,
                  mode, cc_chunk_size, cc_chunks_per_slot);
        return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    if ((hdr->slot_count != slot_count) || (hdr->slot_size != slot_size)) {
        ucs_error("obmm: pool geometry mismatch "
                  "(have slots=%u size=%u, expected %u/%u)",
                  hdr->slot_count, hdr->slot_size, slot_count, slot_size);
        return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    pool->base       = region_base;
    pool->length     = region_size;
    pool->hdr        = hdr;
    pool->bitmap     = (volatile uint64_t*)((char*)hdr + sizeof(*hdr));
    pool->meta       = (uct_obmm_slot_meta_t*)((char*)hdr +
                                               uct_obmm_pool_meta_offset(slot_count));
    pool->slots      = (char*)hdr + hdr->slot_array_offset;
    pool->slot_count = slot_count;
    pool->slot_size  = slot_size;
    pool->mode       = (uct_obmm_mem_mode_t)hdr->mode;
    pool->cc_chunk_size      = hdr->cc_chunk_size;
    pool->cc_chunks_per_slot = hdr->cc_chunks_per_slot;
    return UCS_OK;
}


/* Try to claim slot `idx` for the current process. Returns 1 on success
 * (bit was set by us, meta updated). On scavenge of a dead owner, generation
 * is bumped and the slot is taken over. Returns 0 if the slot is unclaimable
 * (live owner). */
static int uct_obmm_pool_try_claim(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t idx,
                                   uint32_t self_pid, uint64_t self_starttime,
                                   uint32_t *generation_p)
{
    volatile uint64_t    *word    = &pool->bitmap[idx >> 6];
    uint64_t              bit     = 1ull << (idx & 63u);
    uct_obmm_slot_meta_t *m       = &pool->meta[idx];
    uint64_t              cur, oldval;
    int                   take_over;

    cur = *word;
    if (cur & bit) {
        /* allocated: maybe the owner is dead */
        ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
        if ((m->state == UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_IN_USE) &&
            uct_obmm_proc_alive(m->owner_pid, m->owner_starttime)) {
            return 0;
        }
        take_over = 1;
    } else {
        /* free: try to set the bit */
        oldval = ucs_atomic_cswap64(word, cur, cur | bit);
        if (oldval != cur) {
            return 0; /* lost the race; caller will retry next slot */
        }
        take_over = 0;
    }

    /* Bump generation so any in-flight stale messages from prior owner are
     * dropped by the receive path. memset slot bytes only AFTER bumping
     * generation, so any racing writer's bytes won't survive un-stamped. */
    m->generation += 1;
    m->owner_pid       = self_pid;
    m->owner_starttime = self_starttime;
    /* Zero the slot bytes for our use (FIFO ctl + elements). */
    memset(uct_obmm_pool_slot_ptr(pool, idx), 0, pool->slot_size);
    ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
    m->state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_IN_USE;
    ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();

    *generation_p = m->generation;
    (void)take_over;
    return 1;
}


ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_alloc_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool,
                                      uint32_t *slot_index_p,
                                      void **slot_ptr_p,
                                      uint32_t *generation_p)
{
    uint32_t      self_pid       = (uint32_t)getpid();
    unsigned long self_starttime = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time(getpid());
    uint32_t      i;

    if (self_starttime == 0ul) {
        ucs_warn("obmm: cannot read self process start time; "
                 "scavenge will treat us as dead");
    }

    for (i = 0; i < pool->slot_count; ++i) {
        if (uct_obmm_pool_try_claim(pool, i, self_pid,
                                    (uint64_t)self_starttime, generation_p)) {
            *slot_index_p = i;
            *slot_ptr_p   = uct_obmm_pool_slot_ptr(pool, i);
            return UCS_OK;
        }
    }

    return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
}


static int uct_obmm_pool_all_slots_free(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool)
{
    uint32_t i;

    for (i = 0; i < pool->hdr->bitmap_words; ++i) {
        if (pool->bitmap[i] != 0) {
            return 0;
        }
    }

    return 1;
}


int uct_obmm_pool_free_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t slot_index)
{
    volatile uint64_t    *word = &pool->bitmap[slot_index >> 6];
    uint64_t              bit  = 1ull << (slot_index & 63u);
    uct_obmm_slot_meta_t *m    = &pool->meta[slot_index];
    unsigned long         self_starttime;
    uint64_t              cur, oldval;

    /* Bump generation first so any in-flight stale messages are discarded by
     * a future re-using owner; mark DEAD and bus fence before clearing the
     * bit so a racing claimer sees the new generation. */
    m->generation += 1;
    m->state       = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_DEAD;
    m->owner_pid   = 0;
    m->owner_starttime = 0;
    ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();

    do {
        cur    = *word;
        oldval = ucs_atomic_cswap64(word, cur, cur & ~bit);
    } while (oldval != cur);

    m->state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE;
    ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();

    if (!uct_obmm_pool_all_slots_free(pool)) {
        return 0;
    }

    self_starttime = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time(getpid());
    pool->hdr->initializer_pid       = (uint32_t)getpid();
    pool->hdr->initializer_starttime = (uint64_t)self_starttime;
    ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();

    oldval = ucs_atomic_cswap32(&pool->hdr->state, UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY,
                                UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_INITING);
    if (oldval != UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
        return 0;
    }

    ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
    if (!uct_obmm_pool_all_slots_free(pool)) {
        ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
        pool->hdr->state = UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY;
        return 0;
    }

    return 1;
}


void uct_obmm_pool_reset(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool)
{
    uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t *hdr;

    if ((pool == NULL) || (pool->hdr == NULL) || (pool->base == NULL)) {
        return;
    }

    hdr = pool->hdr;

    if (pool->length > sizeof(*hdr)) {
        memset((char*)pool->base + sizeof(*hdr), 0, pool->length - sizeof(*hdr));
    }

    hdr->magic                 = 0;
    hdr->reserved0             = 0;
    hdr->slot_count            = 0;
    hdr->slot_size             = 0;
    hdr->slot_array_offset     = 0;
    hdr->bitmap_words          = 0;
    hdr->initializer_pid       = 0;
    hdr->initializer_starttime = 0;
    hdr->mode                  = 0;
    hdr->cc_chunk_size         = 0;
    hdr->cc_chunks_per_slot    = 0;
    hdr->reserved              = 0;
    ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();

    hdr->state = UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT;
    ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();

    memset(pool, 0, sizeof(*pool));
}

### 💬 Copilot

1. **Scope:** Yes, for the NC-only branch this repo scope is sufficient. All persisted pool-version logic is in `obmm_pool.h/c`, the only `free_slot()` caller is iface cleanup, and iface creation already binds to the local export region (`obmm_pool.h:17-25,45-55,122-125`; `obmm_pool.c:96-104,172-181,279-333`; `obmm_iface.c:364-369,461-467`). `DESIGN.md` must be updated because it still describes pool-version compatibility (`DESIGN.md:223-235`).

2. **Must-address race:** Yes: **attach-vs-reset**. A new local process can return from `uct_obmm_pool_attach()` while state is still `READY`, then the last cleaner can win `READY-\>INITING` and reset before that attacher sets a bitmap bit. The bitmap-empty recheck does **not** catch that pre-attached/non-allocated contender. Either close that race or explicitly accept “no concurrent new attach during teardown.” Also, this patch does not coordinate stale **remote** writers after local last-iface teardown.

3. **Extra files:** No extra repo files are strictly required beyond those listed.

4. **Keep version checks?** No strong reason on this branch. There is no wire `pool_version`, and zero-on-exit plus `magic/state/geometry` checks are enough for stale local-pool reuse. Only keep versioning if mixed-binary live attachment with identical geometry is a supported goal.

79. The pool's `slot_count` (compile-time `UCT_OBMM_POOL_SLOT_COUNT = 256`)
80. **times** `slot_stride` MUST fit in `region->length` (128 MiB minus pool
81. header overhead). Defaults are picked so that this holds; callers may
82. shrink (not grow) `seg_size` / `fifo_size` if they need more slots.
83. 
84. Default budget check:
85. ```
86. fifo_size       =     64
87. elem_size       =   2048   (max_short = 2032)
88. seg_size        =   4096   (max_bcopy = 4096)
89. ctl + slot data = 128 + 64*(2048+4096) = ~384 KiB / slot
90. slot_count      =    256
91. total           = ~ 96 MiB / 128 MiB                     ✓
92. ```
93. If a user bumps `seg_size` to 8192, total grows to ~160 MiB and pool
94. attach fails with a clear error pointing at the geometry knobs.
95. 
96. ---
97. 
98. ## FIFO element layout
99. 
100. `uct_obmm_fifo_element_t` (16 bytes, packed) is unchanged from v1:
101. 
102. | field      | bytes | notes                                          |
103. |------------|-------|------------------------------------------------|
104. | flags      |   1   | OWNER bit + BCOPY bit                          |
105. | am_id      |   1   |                                                |
106. | length     |   2   | u16 — payload bytes (excl. am_short hdr)       |
107. | generation |   4   | slot generation token at TX time               |
108. | header     |   8   | am_short user-visible 8B header (unused bcopy) |
109. 
110. **am_short payload** still lives inline at `elem + 1` in the FIFO area.
111. Wire format and `max_short = elem_size - 16` are unchanged.
112. 
113. **am_bcopy payload** (NEW in v2) lives in the paired `desc[N]` instead
114. of inside the FIFO element body. The element body is unused for bcopy;
115. on bcopy the sender writes:
116. - `elem->flags  = OWNER | BCOPY`
117. - `elem->am_id  = id`
118. - `elem->length = pack_cb_returned_length`     (≤ seg_size, so ≤ u16max)
119. - `elem->generation = ep->expected_generation`
120. - `elem->header = 0` (unused)
121. 
122. Receiver, on seeing FLAG_BCOPY, computes
123. `desc[N] = slot_descs + (idx & mask) * seg_size` and calls
124. `uct_iface_invoke_am(am_id, desc[N], length, 0)`.
125. 
126. Because `desc[N]` is bound 1:1 to `elem[N]`, no extra metadata is
127. exchanged in the FIFO element to locate the desc.
128. 
129. ### `length` field width
130.

60. `desc[N]` is **identical** to lifetime of `elem[N]` — both are released

129. ### `length` field width
130. 
131. `elem->length` stays `uint16_t`, capping `seg_size` at 65535. We reject
132. larger `seg_size` at iface init. If a future `seg_size > 64KiB` is
133. needed, widen `length` to `uint32_t` (and bump pool `version`).
134. 
135. ---
136. 
137. ## Sender side (`obmm_ep`)
138. 
139. Both `am_short` and `am_bcopy` reserve a slot identically:
140. 
141. ```
142. 1. load head from peer_ctl->head
143. 2. if (head - cached_tail) >= fifo_size:
144.        bus_load_fence; refresh cached_tail; recheck;
145.        if still full: return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE
146. 3. claim producer lock (`peer_ctl->lock`) with a unique token, then
147.    store head → head+1, then release the lock
148. 4. compute idx = head, N = idx & mask
149. 5. payload write:
150.      short: memcpy header+payload into elem[N]+1
````

28. uct_obmm_pool_bitmap_words(uint32_t slot_count)
29. {
30.     return (slot_count + 63u) / 64u;
31. }
32. 
33. 
34. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE int
35. uct_obmm_pool_is_ready(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool)
36. {
37.     uint32_t state = pool->hdr->state;
38. 
39.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
40.     return state == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY;
41. }

43. 
44. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void
45. uct_obmm_pool_clear_bit(volatile uint64_t *word, uint64_t bit)
46. {
47.     uint64_t cur, oldval;
48. 
49.     do {
50.         cur    = *word;
51.         oldval = ucs_atomic_cswap64(word, cur, cur & ~bit);
52.     } while (oldval != cur);
53. }
54.

56. static size_t uct_obmm_pool_meta_offset(uint32_t slot_count)
57. {
58.     return sizeof(uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t) +
59.            uct_obmm_pool_bitmap_words(slot_count) * sizeof(uint64_t);
60. }

63. static size_t uct_obmm_pool_slot_offset(uint32_t slot_count)
64. {
65.     return ucs_align_up(uct_obmm_pool_meta_offset(slot_count) +
66.                         (size_t)slot_count * sizeof(uct_obmm_slot_meta_t),
67.                         UCS_SYS_CACHE_LINE_SIZE);
68. }

71. size_t uct_obmm_pool_required_size(uint32_t slot_count, uint32_t slot_size)
72. {
73.     return uct_obmm_pool_slot_offset(slot_count) +
74.            (size_t)slot_count * slot_size;
75. }

78. static int uct_obmm_proc_alive(uint32_t pid, uint64_t starttime)
79. {
80.     unsigned long live;
81. 
82.     if (pid == 0) {
83.         return 0;
84.     }
85. 
86.     live = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time((pid_t)pid);
87.     if (live == 0ul) {
88.         /* /proc/<pid>/stat unreadable: pid does not exist any more */
89.         return 0;
90.     }
91. 
92.     return (uint64_t)live == starttime;
93. }
94. 
95. 
96. /* CAS-claim the INITING transition; if we lose, wait until READY (or
97.  * recover the slot if the prior initializer died mid-init). */
98. static ucs_status_t
99. uct_obmm_pool_init_or_wait(uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t *hdr, uint32_t slot_count,
100.                            uint32_t slot_size)
101. {
102.     unsigned long      self_starttime = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time(getpid());
103.     uint32_t           prev;
104.     unsigned           spin;
105.     size_t             bitmap_words = uct_obmm_pool_bitmap_words(slot_count);
106.     size_t             slot_off     = uct_obmm_pool_slot_offset(slot_count);
107. 
108. retry:
109.     prev = ucs_atomic_cswap32(&hdr->state, UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT,
110.                               UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_INITING);
111. 
112.     if (prev == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT) {
113.         /* We won: zero metadata, fill geometry, publish READY */
114.         memset((char*)hdr + sizeof(*hdr), 0,
115.                bitmap_words * sizeof(uint64_t) +
116.                (size_t)slot_count * sizeof(uct_obmm_slot_meta_t));
117. 
118.         hdr->magic                 = UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC;
119.         hdr->reserved0             = 0;
120.         hdr->slot_count            = slot_count;
121.         hdr->slot_size             = slot_size;
122.         hdr->slot_array_offset     = slot_off;
123.         hdr->bitmap_words          = (uint32_t)bitmap_words;
124.         hdr->initializer_pid       = (uint32_t)getpid();
125.         hdr->initializer_starttime = (uint64_t)self_starttime;
126. 
127.         ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
128.         hdr->state = UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY;
129.         return UCS_OK;
130.     }
131. 
132.     if (prev == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
133.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
134.         return UCS_OK;
135.     }
136. 
137.     /* state == INITING : wait or recover */
138.     for (spin = 0; spin < UCT_OBMM_POOL_INIT_SPIN_LIMIT; ++spin) {
139.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
140.         if (hdr->state == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
141.             return UCS_OK;
142.         }
143.         if (hdr->state == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT) {
144.             /* Some other rescuer reset; race for init */
145.             goto retry;
146.         }
147. 
148.         if ((spin & 0xfffu) == 0xfffu) {
149.             /* Periodically check if the initializer is alive. If not,
150.              * try to reset back to UNINIT so someone can re-init. */
151.             if (!uct_obmm_proc_alive(hdr->initializer_pid,
152.                                      hdr->initializer_starttime)) {
153.                 ucs_warn("obmm: pool initializer pid=%u died; resetting "
154.                          "pool init state",
155.                          hdr->initializer_pid);
156.                 ucs_atomic_cswap32(&hdr->state, UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_INITING,
157.                                    UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT);
158.                 goto retry;
159.             }
160.         }
161.     }
162. 
163.     ucs_error("obmm: timed out waiting for pool init to complete "
164.               "(initializer pid=%u)", hdr->initializer_pid);
165.     return UCS_ERR_TIMED_OUT;
166. }
167. 
168. 
169. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_attach(void *region_base, size_t region_size,
170.                                   uint32_t slot_count, uint32_t slot_size,
171.                                   uct_obmm_pool_t *pool)
172. {
173.     uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t *hdr = (uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t*)region_base;
174.     size_t               required;
175.     ucs_status_t         status;
176. 
177.     if ((slot_count == 0) || (slot_size == 0)) {
178.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
179.     }
180. 
181.     required = uct_obmm_pool_required_size(slot_count, slot_size);
182.     if (region_size < required) {
183.         ucs_error("obmm: region size %zu < required pool size %zu "
184.                   "(slots=%u, slot_size=%u)",
185.                   region_size, required, slot_count, slot_size);
186.         return UCS_ERR_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL;
187.     }
188. 
189.     status = uct_obmm_pool_init_or_wait(hdr, slot_count, slot_size);
190.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
191.         return status;
192.     }
193. 
194.     if (hdr->magic != UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC) {
195.         ucs_error("obmm: pool magic mismatch (got 0x%lx, expected 0x%lx)",
196.                   (unsigned long)hdr->magic, (unsigned long)UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC);
197.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
198.     }
199.     if ((hdr->slot_count != slot_count) || (hdr->slot_size != slot_size)) {
200.         ucs_error("obmm: pool geometry mismatch "
201.                   "(have slots=%u size=%u, expected %u/%u)",
202.                   hdr->slot_count, hdr->slot_size, slot_count, slot_size);
203.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
204.     }
205. 
206.     pool->base       = region_base;
207.     pool->length     = region_size;
208.     pool->hdr        = hdr;
209.     pool->bitmap     = (volatile uint64_t*)((char*)hdr + sizeof(*hdr));
210.     pool->meta       = (uct_obmm_slot_meta_t*)((char*)hdr +
211.                                                uct_obmm_pool_meta_offset(slot_count));
212.     pool->slots      = (char*)hdr + hdr->slot_array_offset;
213.     pool->slot_count = slot_count;
214.     pool->slot_size  = slot_size;
215.     return UCS_OK;
216. }
217. 
218. 
219. /* Try to claim slot `idx` for the current process. Returns 1 on success
220.  * (bit was set by us, meta updated). On scavenge of a dead owner, generation
221.  * is bumped and the slot is taken over. Returns 0 if the slot is unclaimable
222.  * (live owner). */
223. static int uct_obmm_pool_try_claim(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t idx,
224.                                    uint32_t self_pid, uint64_t self_starttime,
225.                                    uint32_t *generation_p)
226. {
227.     volatile uint64_t    *word    = &pool->bitmap[idx >> 6];
228.     uint64_t              bit     = 1ull << (idx & 63u);
229.     uct_obmm_slot_meta_t *m       = &pool->meta[idx];
230.     uint64_t              cur, oldval;
231.     int                   take_over;
232. 
233.     if (!uct_obmm_pool_is_ready(pool)) {
234.         return 0;
235.     }
236. 
237.     cur = *word;
238.     if (cur & bit) {
239.         /* allocated: maybe the owner is dead */
240.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
241.         if ((m->state == UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_IN_USE) &&
242.             uct_obmm_proc_alive(m->owner_pid, m->owner_starttime)) {
243.             return 0;
244.         }
245.         take_over = 1;
246.     } else {
247.         /* free: try to set the bit */
248.         oldval = ucs_atomic_cswap64(word, cur, cur | bit);
249.         if (oldval != cur) {
250.             return 0; /* lost the race; caller will retry next slot */
251.         }
252.         take_over = 0;
253.     }
254. 
255.     if (!uct_obmm_pool_is_ready(pool)) {
256.         if (!take_over) {
257.             uct_obmm_pool_clear_bit(word, bit);
258.         }
259.         return 0;
260.     }
261. 
262.     /* Bump generation so any in-flight stale messages from prior owner are
263.      * dropped by the receive path. memset slot bytes only AFTER bumping
264.      * generation, so any racing writer's bytes won't survive un-stamped. */
265.     m->generation += 1;
266.     m->owner_pid       = self_pid;
267.     m->owner_starttime = self_starttime;
268.     /* Zero the slot bytes for our use (FIFO ctl + elements). */
269.     memset(uct_obmm_pool_slot_ptr(pool, idx), 0, pool->slot_size);
270.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
271.     m->state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_IN_USE;
272.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
273. 
274.     *generation_p = m->generation;
275.     (void)take_over;
276.     return 1;
277. }
278. 
279. 
280. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_alloc_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool,
281.                                       uint32_t *slot_index_p,
282.                                       void **slot_ptr_p,
283.                                       uint32_t *generation_p)
284. {
285.     uint32_t      self_pid       = (uint32_t)getpid();
286.     unsigned long self_starttime = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time(getpid());
287.     uint32_t      i;
288. 
289.     if (self_starttime == 0ul) {
290.         ucs_warn("obmm: cannot read self process start time; "
291.                  "scavenge will treat us as dead");
292.     }
293. 
294.     for (i = 0; i < pool->slot_count; ++i) {
295.         if (!uct_obmm_pool_is_ready(pool)) {
296.             return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
297.         }
298.         if (uct_obmm_pool_try_claim(pool, i, self_pid,
299.                                     (uint64_t)self_starttime, generation_p)) {
300.             *slot_index_p = i;
301.             *slot_ptr_p   = uct_obmm_pool_slot_ptr(pool, i);
302.             return UCS_OK;
303.         }
304.     }
305. 
306.     return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
307. }
308. 
309. 
310. static int uct_obmm_pool_all_slots_free(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool)
311. {
312.     uint32_t i;
313. 
314.     for (i = 0; i < pool->hdr->bitmap_words; ++i) {
315.         if (pool->bitmap[i] != 0) {
316.             return 0;
317.         }
318.     }
319. 
320.     return 1;
321. }
322. 
323. 
324. int uct_obmm_pool_free_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t slot_index)
325. {
326.     volatile uint64_t    *word = &pool->bitmap[slot_index >> 6];
327.     uint64_t              bit  = 1ull << (slot_index & 63u);
328.     uct_obmm_slot_meta_t *m    = &pool->meta[slot_index];
329.     unsigned long         self_starttime;
330.     uint64_t              oldval;
331. 
332.     /* Bump generation first so any in-flight stale messages are discarded by
333.      * a future re-using owner; mark DEAD and bus fence before clearing the
334.      * bit so a racing claimer sees the new generation. */
335.     m->generation += 1;
336.     m->state       = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_DEAD;
337.     m->owner_pid   = 0;
338.     m->owner_starttime = 0;
339.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
340. 
341.     uct_obmm_pool_clear_bit(word, bit);
342. 
343.     m->state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE;
344.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
345. 
346.     if (!uct_obmm_pool_all_slots_free(pool)) {
347.         return 0;
348.     }
349. 
350.     self_starttime = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time(getpid());
351.     pool->hdr->initializer_pid       = (uint32_t)getpid();
352.     pool->hdr->initializer_starttime = (uint64_t)self_starttime;
353.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
354. 
355.     oldval = ucs_atomic_cswap32(&pool->hdr->state, UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY,
356.                                 UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_INITING);
357.     if (oldval != UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
358.         return 0;
359.     }
360. 
361.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
362.     if (!uct_obmm_pool_all_slots_free(pool)) {
363.         ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
364.         pool->hdr->state = UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY;
365.         return 0;
366.     }
367. 
368.     return 1;
369. }
370.

372. void uct_obmm_pool_reset(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool)
373. {
374.     uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t *hdr;
375. 
376.     if ((pool == NULL) || (pool->hdr == NULL) || (pool->base == NULL)) {
377.         return;
378.     }
379. 
380.     hdr = pool->hdr;

324. int uct_obmm_pool_free_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t slot_index)
325. {
326.     volatile uint64_t    *word = &pool->bitmap[slot_index >> 6];
327.     uint64_t              bit  = 1ull << (slot_index & 63u);
328.     uct_obmm_slot_meta_t *m    = &pool->meta[slot_index];
329.     unsigned long         self_starttime;
330.     uint32_t              state_prev;
331. 
332.     /* Bump generation first so any in-flight stale messages are discarded by
333.      * a future re-using owner; mark DEAD and bus fence before clearing the
334.      * bit so a racing claimer sees the new generation. */
335.     m->generation += 1;
336.     m->state       = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_DEAD;
337.     m->owner_pid   = 0;
338.     m->owner_starttime = 0;
339.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
340. 
341.     uct_obmm_pool_clear_bit(word, bit);
342. 
343.     m->state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE;
344.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
345. 
346.     if (!uct_obmm_pool_all_slots_free(pool)) {
347.         return 0;
348.     }
349. 
350.     self_starttime = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time(getpid());
351.     pool->hdr->initializer_pid       = (uint32_t)getpid();
352.     pool->hdr->initializer_starttime = (uint64_t)self_starttime;
353.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
354. 
355.     state_prev = ucs_atomic_cswap32(&pool->hdr->state, UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY,
356.                                     UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_INITING);
357.     if (state_prev != UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
358.         return 0;
359.     }
360. 
361.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
362.     if (!uct_obmm_pool_all_slots_free(pool)) {
363.         ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
364.         pool->hdr->state = UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY;
365.         return 0;
366.     }
367. 
368.     return 1;
369. }

219. /* Try to claim slot `idx` for the current process. Returns 1 on success
220.  * (bit was set by us, meta updated). On scavenge of a dead owner, generation
221.  * is bumped and the slot is taken over. Returns 0 if the slot is unclaimable
222.  * (live owner). */
223. static int uct_obmm_pool_try_claim(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t idx,
224.                                    uint32_t self_pid, uint64_t self_starttime,
225.                                    uint32_t *generation_p)
226. {
227.     volatile uint64_t    *word    = &pool->bitmap[idx >> 6];
228.     uint64_t              bit     = 1ull << (idx & 63u);
229.     uct_obmm_slot_meta_t *m       = &pool->meta[idx];
230.     uint64_t              cur, oldval;
231.     int                   take_over;
232. 
233.     if (!uct_obmm_pool_is_ready(pool)) {
234.         return 0;
235.     }
236. 
237.     cur = *word;
238.     if (cur & bit) {
239.         /* allocated: maybe the owner is dead */
240.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
241.         if ((m->state == UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_IN_USE) &&
242.             uct_obmm_proc_alive(m->owner_pid, m->owner_starttime)) {
243.             return 0;
244.         }
245.         take_over = 1;
246.     } else {
247.         /* free: try to set the bit */
248.         oldval = ucs_atomic_cswap64(word, cur, cur | bit);
249.         if (oldval != cur) {
250.             return 0; /* lost the race; caller will retry next slot */
251.         }
252.         take_over = 0;
253.     }
254. 
255.     if (!uct_obmm_pool_is_ready(pool)) {
256.         if (!take_over) {

273.

## Issue: Race condition allows wrong initializer_pid to be stored during cleanup

**File:** ucx/src/uct/obmm/base/obmm_pool.c:350-358  
**Severity:** High

**Problem:** In `uct_obmm_pool_free_slot()`, the code updates `hdr-\>initializer_pid` and `hdr-\>initializer_starttime` (lines 351-353) **before** performing the atomic CAS to claim the INITING state (line 355). This creates a race where multiple threads freeing their last slots can overwrite these fields, but only one thread will win the CAS and actually perform the reset.

**Race timeline:**
1. Thread A (freeing last slot): checks all_slots_free → true (line 346)
2. Thread A: writes `hdr-\>initializer_pid = A` (line 351)
3. Thread B (also freeing last slot): checks all_slots_free → true
4. Thread B: writes `hdr-\>initializer_pid = B` (line 351) — **overwrites Thread A's value**
5. Thread B: CAS state READY→INITING fails because Thread A already changed it
6. Thread B: returns 0 (line 358)
7. Thread A: CAS state READY→INITING succeeds (line 355)
8. Thread A: proceeds to reset, but **hdr-\>initializer_pid now contains B's pid, not A's**

**Impact:** If another process attaches while Thread A is resetting, it will wait for the initializer to finish by checking `uct_obmm_proc_alive(hdr-\>initializer_pid, ...)` (line 151). But `initializer_pid` points to Thread B (who lost the race and isn't doing the reset), not Thread A (who won and is doing the reset). If Thread B dies while Thread A is still resetting, the waiter will incorrectly conclude the initializer died and attempt a competing reset.

**Evidence:** The `uct_obmm_pool_init_or_wait()` function at lines 151-152 explicitly checks whether the process identified by `hdr-\>initializer_pid` and `hdr-\>initializer_starttime` is alive. This check is only valid if these fields accurately identify the thread that won the INITING state transition.

**Suggested fix:** Move lines 350-353 to **after** the successful CAS at line 355-359. Only the thread that wins the CAS should update `initializer_pid` and `initializer_starttime`. For example:

```c
state_prev = ucs_atomic_cswap32(&pool-\>hdr-\>state, UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY,
                                UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_INITING);
if (state_prev != UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
    return 0;
}

/* We won the INITING transition; now stamp our pid */
self_starttime = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time(getpid());
pool-\>hdr-\>initializer_pid       = (uint32_t)getpid();
pool-\>hdr-\>initializer_starttime = (uint64_t)self_starttime;
ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();

ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
if (!uct_obmm_pool_all_slots_free(pool)) {
    /* ... rollback ... */
}
```

## Issue: Race condition in pool reset allows concurrent attach/allocations

**File:** ucx/src/uct/obmm/base/obmm_pool.c:350-368, 372-402

**Severity:** High

**Problem:** 

In `uct_obmm_pool_free_slot()`, the pool state is transitioned from READY to INITING at line 350-351 using CAS. Between lines 361-365, there's a TOCTOU (time-of-check-time-of-use) vulnerability:

1. After setting state=INITING (line 350-351), the code does a load fence and re-checks `all_slots_free` (line 362)
2. If a new slot was allocated by a concurrent thread, it reverts state back to READY (line 364) and returns 0
3. **BUT**: The revert to READY happens BEFORE ensuring no other thread is already executing `uct_obmm_pool_reset()`

If two threads T1 and T2 both pass the initial `all_slots_free()` check at line 346 and both successfully CAS at line 350:
- T1 wins the CAS, sets state=INITING
- T1 begins reset in `uct_obmm_pool_reset()` at line 383 (zeroing the region)
- Meanwhile, T2 sees state != READY in its CAS (line 352) and returns 0
- T2's caller (iface cleanup at obmm_iface.c:465-467) skips calling `pool_reset` because `free_slot` returned 0
- A third thread T3 could allocate a slot via `pool_alloc_slot` which checks `pool_is_ready` - but state is INITING, so T3 sees not-ready
- However, between lines 383-398 in `pool_reset`, the header is being actively zeroed/modified

The real issue: there's no mechanism preventing a thread that returned 0 from `free_slot` (at line 365) from immediately calling `pool_alloc_slot`, which might observe a partially-reset pool state if the winning resetter is between lines 383-398.

**Evidence:**

Based on my review of the uncommitted diff in the specified files, I found one material bug:

## Issue: Race condition between pool reset and concurrent attach causes spurious errors

**File:** ucx/src/uct/obmm/base/obmm_pool.c:386-398

**Severity:** Medium

**Problem:** 

In `uct_obmm_pool_reset()`, the shared region header fields are zeroed in an order that creates a window where concurrent `pool_attach()` calls will fail with errors rather than blocking or succeeding:

1. Line 386: `hdr-\>magic = 0` (zeroed immediately)
2. Lines 387-396: Other header fields zeroed, then store fence
3. Line 398: `hdr-\>state = UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT`

During lines 386-396, the pool state is still `INITING` (set at obmm_pool.c:351 before reset was called), but `magic` is already 0.

If another process/thread calls `pool_attach()` during this window:
- The state check at pool_attach:189 (`init_or_wait`) will see `state=INITING`, not `UNINIT`
- `init_or_wait` will spin-wait for state to become READY or detect dead initializer
- After returning, `pool_attach` checks `magic` at line 194
- Magic is 0, so it fails with `UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM`: "pool magic mismatch"

**Evidence:**

Traced the execution flow:
- `pool_free_slot` sets state=INITING at line 350-351 when last slot is freed
- `pool_reset` is called while state=INITING
- Magic is zeroed before state transitions to UNINIT
- `pool_attach` has no special handling for state=INITING with magic=0

This can occur in multi-process scenarios where one process is tearing down (last iface exits, triggers reset) while another process attempts to attach a new iface.

**Suggested fix:** 

Set `hdr-\>state = UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT` before zeroing `hdr-\>magic`, or zero magic after state transition. This ensures `init_or_wait` sees state=UNINIT and takes the init path at line 112, rather than waiting for a READY state that will never arrive.

1. Problem: the current obmm cleanup path frees only the local slot and leaves the
2. rest of the shared export region intact. The user wants all residual shared
3. memory data cleared on exit, following commit
4. `6ff2ef6fc253d3b7c40b785159d465c5d3947ae3`.
5. 
6. Approach:
7. - Mirror only the cleanup-related parts of the reference commit that still fit
8.   the current NC-only branch:
9.   - make `uct_obmm_pool_free_slot()` report whether the caller released the
10.     final local slot and successfully acquired exclusive reset ownership
11.   - add `uct_obmm_pool_reset()` to zero the full local export region while
12.     keeping `hdr->state` in `INITING` until the rest of the pool is cleared
13.   - route iface cleanup through one shared helper so the last local iface
14.     resets the export region, while non-last ifaces still just free their slot
15. - Also mirror the reference commit's removal of persisted pool-version
16.   restrictions on this branch by turning the pool header's version word into a
17.   reserved field and dropping attach/open version checks.
18. 
19. Files:
20. - ucx\src\uct\obmm\base\obmm_region.h
21. - ucx\src\uct\obmm\base\obmm_region.c
22. - ucx\src\uct\obmm\base\obmm_iface.c
23. - ucx\src\uct\obmm\base\obmm_pool.h
24. - ucx\src\uct\obmm\base\obmm_pool.c
25. - ucx\src\uct\obmm\DESIGN.md
26. 
27. Todos:
28. - obmm-cleanup-plan
29. - obmm-cleanup-implement
30. - obmm-cleanup-review
31. 
32. Notes:
33. - Current branch is simpler than the reference commit: there is no hybrid CC
34.   state to port, so the cleanup adaptation should stay focused on the local NC
35.   export region and pool header/slot lifecycle.
36. - The last-slot reset path must be race-safe with a new attach: once cleanup
37.   wins the `READY -> INITING` transition, no new attach may observe partially
38.   zeroed pool metadata.
39. - Validation remains static only in this Windows workspace.
40. - To close the attach-vs-reset gap from review, make `pool_alloc_slot()`
41.   refuse a pool that is no longer `READY`, so a late local attach cannot claim
42.   a slot after cleanup has already switched the pool to `INITING`.
43. - Implemented:
44.   - removed persistent pool-version storage/checks from shared memory
45.   - last local iface now wins cleanup ownership and zeroes the full local
46.     export region before returning the pool to `UNINIT`
47.   - `pool_alloc_slot()` now stops claiming slots once teardown has moved the
48.     pool out of `READY`
49.   - updated DESIGN.md to describe full-region zero-on-exit semantics
50. - Deliberately not added on this NC-only branch:
51.   - `uct_obmm_region_zero()`, because `uct_obmm_pool_reset()` already zeros the
52.     full local export mapping and there is no separate CC cleanup path here
53.

34. /* In-region pool header. Lives at offset 0 of the local export region. All
35.  * fields are written via non-cacheable mappings: state transitions must be
36.  * paired with ucs_memory_bus_store_fence so peers (potentially on another
37.  * host) see the geometry before the READY transition. */
38. typedef struct uct_obmm_pool_hdr {
39.     uint64_t magic;             /* UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC */
40.     uint32_t reserved0;
41.     uint32_t state;             /* UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_xx, atomic */
42.     uint32_t slot_count;
43.     uint32_t slot_size;
44.     uint64_t slot_array_offset; /* offset (from region base) of slot 0 */
45.     uint32_t bitmap_words;      /* number of u64 words in alloc bitmap */
46.     uint32_t initializer_pid;   /* pid that owned the INITING transition */
47.     uint64_t initializer_starttime;
48.     uint64_t reserved[2];
49.     /* followed by:
50.      *   uint64_t alloc_bitmap[bitmap_words];
51.      *   uct_obmm_slot_meta_t slot_meta[slot_count];
52.      */
53. } uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t;
54. 
55. 
56. /* Per-slot ownership metadata. Stored adjacent to the bitmap, separate from
57.  * the slot's actual FIFO contents. */
58. typedef struct uct_obmm_slot_meta {
59.     uint32_t state;            /* UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_xx */
60.     uint32_t generation;       /* monotonically increasing; bumped on free,
61.                                   scavenge, and when readers must discard
62.                                   in-flight stale elements */
63.     uint32_t owner_pid;
64.     uint32_t reserved;
65.     uint64_t owner_starttime;  /* /proc/<pid>/stat field 22, for liveness */
66. } uct_obmm_slot_meta_t;
67. 
68. 
69. /* Convenience accessor populated by uct_obmm_pool_attach. Pointers point
70.  * into the mapped region; nothing is owned by this struct. */
71. typedef struct uct_obmm_pool {
72.     void                  *base;     /* region base (pool hdr) */
73.     size_t                 length;   /* mapped region size */
74.     uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t   *hdr;
75.     volatile uint64_t     *bitmap;
76.     uct_obmm_slot_meta_t  *meta;
77.     void                  *slots;    /* base + hdr->slot_array_offset */
78.     uint32_t               slot_count;
79.     uint32_t               slot_size;
80. } uct_obmm_pool_t;
81. 
82.

84.  * geometry. */

86. 
87. 
88. /* Initialize the pool inside `region_base` if not already initialized, or
89.  * attach to an existing valid pool. Cross-process safe: races between
90.  * multiple processes attaching to the same region are resolved via the
91.  * hdr->state CAS. On success, `pool` is populated with cached pointers.
92.  *
93.  * If an existing pool's geometry doesn't match the requested
94.  * (slot_count, slot_size), returns UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM.
95.  */
96. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_attach(void *region_base, size_t region_size,
97.                                   uint32_t slot_count, uint32_t slot_size,
98.                                   uct_obmm_pool_t *pool);
99. 
100. 
101. /* Allocate a free slot. Scavenges slots owned by dead processes. Returns the
102.  * slot index (0..slot_count-1), a pointer to the slot bytes (length
103.  * slot_size), and the generation token the caller must stamp into outgoing
104.  * iface_addr. Slot bytes are zeroed before return.
105.  *
106.  * Returns UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE if no slot can be obtained (all slots in use
107.  * by live processes).
108.  */
109. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_alloc_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool,
110.                                       uint32_t *slot_index_p,

113. 
114. 
115. /* Release a slot the caller owns. Bumps generation so any stale in-flight
116.  * elements written by remote senders are dropped on the next receiver's
117.  * dispatch. Marks slot as FREE in the bitmap. Returns non-zero only if this
118.  * caller released the final local slot and acquired exclusive permission to
119.  * reset the whole export region to zero before another attach re-initializes
120.  * it. */
121. int uct_obmm_pool_free_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t slot_index);
122. 
123. 
124. /* Reset the whole local export pool region to zero. The caller must already
125.  * hold exclusive cleanup ownership from uct_obmm_pool_free_slot(); this helper
126.  * keeps hdr->state in INITING until the rest of the region is zero so a new
127.  * attach cannot race against a partially cleared pool. */

24. #define UCT_OBMM_POOL_INIT_SPIN_LIMIT  (1u << 22) /* ~ a few seconds of spin */

26. 
27. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE size_t
28. uct_obmm_pool_bitmap_words(uint32_t slot_count)
29. {
30.     return (slot_count + 63u) / 64u;
31. }
32. 
33. 
34. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE int
35. uct_obmm_pool_is_ready(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool)
36. {
37.     uint32_t state = pool->hdr->state;
38. 
39.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
40.     return state == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY;
41. }
42. 
43. 
44. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void
45. uct_obmm_pool_clear_bit(volatile uint64_t *word, uint64_t bit)
46. {
47.     uint64_t cur, oldval;
48. 
49.     do {
50.         cur    = *word;
51.         oldval = ucs_atomic_cswap64(word, cur, cur & ~bit);
52.     } while (oldval != cur);
53. }
54. 
55. 
56. static size_t uct_obmm_pool_meta_offset(uint32_t slot_count)
57. {
58.     return sizeof(uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t) +
59.            uct_obmm_pool_bitmap_words(slot_count) * sizeof(uint64_t);
60. }
61.

63. static size_t uct_obmm_pool_slot_offset(uint32_t slot_count)
64. {
65.     return ucs_align_up(uct_obmm_pool_meta_offset(slot_count) +
66.                         (size_t)slot_count * sizeof(uct_obmm_slot_meta_t),
67.                         UCS_SYS_CACHE_LINE_SIZE);
68. }

71. size_t uct_obmm_pool_required_size(uint32_t slot_count, uint32_t slot_size)
72. {
73.     return uct_obmm_pool_slot_offset(slot_count) +
74.            (size_t)slot_count * slot_size;
75. }

78. static int uct_obmm_proc_alive(uint32_t pid, uint64_t starttime)
79. {
80.     unsigned long live;
81. 
82.     if (pid == 0) {
83.         return 0;
84.     }
85. 
86.     live = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time((pid_t)pid);
87.     if (live == 0ul) {
88.         /* /proc/<pid>/stat unreadable: pid does not exist any more */
89.         return 0;
90.     }
91. 
92.     return (uint64_t)live == starttime;
93. }

96. /* CAS-claim the INITING transition; if we lose, wait until READY (or
97.  * recover the slot if the prior initializer died mid-init). */
98. static ucs_status_t
99. uct_obmm_pool_init_or_wait(uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t *hdr, uint32_t slot_count,
100.                            uint32_t slot_size)
101. {
102.     unsigned long      self_starttime = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time(getpid());
103.     uint32_t           prev;
104.     unsigned           spin;
105.     size_t             bitmap_words = uct_obmm_pool_bitmap_words(slot_count);
106.     size_t             slot_off     = uct_obmm_pool_slot_offset(slot_count);
107. 
108. retry:
109.     prev = ucs_atomic_cswap32(&hdr->state, UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT,
110.                               UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_INITING);
111. 
112.     if (prev == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT) {
113.         /* We won: zero metadata, fill geometry, publish READY */
114.         memset((char*)hdr + sizeof(*hdr), 0,
115.                bitmap_words * sizeof(uint64_t) +
116.                (size_t)slot_count * sizeof(uct_obmm_slot_meta_t));
117. 
118.         hdr->magic                 = UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC;
119.         hdr->reserved0             = 0;
120.         hdr->slot_count            = slot_count;
121.         hdr->slot_size             = slot_size;
122.         hdr->slot_array_offset     = slot_off;
123.         hdr->bitmap_words          = (uint32_t)bitmap_words;
124.         hdr->initializer_pid       = (uint32_t)getpid();
125.         hdr->initializer_starttime = (uint64_t)self_starttime;
126. 
127.         ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
128.         hdr->state = UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY;
129.         return UCS_OK;
130.     }
131. 
132.     if (prev == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
133.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
134.         return UCS_OK;
135.     }
136. 
137.     /* state == INITING : wait or recover */
138.     for (spin = 0; spin < UCT_OBMM_POOL_INIT_SPIN_LIMIT; ++spin) {
139.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
140.         if (hdr->state == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
141.             return UCS_OK;
142.         }
143.         if (hdr->state == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT) {
144.             /* Some other rescuer reset; race for init */
145.             goto retry;
146.         }
147. 
148.         if ((spin & 0xfffu) == 0xfffu) {
149.             /* Periodically check if the initializer is alive. If not,
150.              * try to reset back to UNINIT so someone can re-init. */
151.             if (!uct_obmm_proc_alive(hdr->initializer_pid,
152.                                      hdr->initializer_starttime)) {
153.                 ucs_warn("obmm: pool initializer pid=%u died; resetting "
154.                          "pool init state",
155.                          hdr->initializer_pid);
156.                 ucs_atomic_cswap32(&hdr->state, UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_INITING,
157.                                    UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT);
158.                 goto retry;
159.             }
160.         }
161.     }
162. 
163.     ucs_error("obmm: timed out waiting for pool init to complete "
164.               "(initializer pid=%u)", hdr->initializer_pid);
165.     return UCS_ERR_TIMED_OUT;
166. }

168. 
169. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_attach(void *region_base, size_t region_size,
170.                                   uint32_t slot_count, uint32_t slot_size,
171.                                   uct_obmm_pool_t *pool)
172. {
173.     uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t *hdr = (uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t*)region_base;
174.     size_t               required;
175.     ucs_status_t         status;
176. 
177.     if ((slot_count == 0) || (slot_size == 0)) {
178.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
179.     }
180. 
181.     required = uct_obmm_pool_required_size(slot_count, slot_size);
182.     if (region_size < required) {
183.         ucs_error("obmm: region size %zu < required pool size %zu "
184.                   "(slots=%u, slot_size=%u)",
185.                   region_size, required, slot_count, slot_size);
186.         return UCS_ERR_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL;
187.     }
188. 
189.     status = uct_obmm_pool_init_or_wait(hdr, slot_count, slot_size);
190.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
191.         return status;
192.     }
193. 
194.     if (hdr->magic != UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC) {
195.         ucs_error("obmm: pool magic mismatch (got 0x%lx, expected 0x%lx)",
196.                   (unsigned long)hdr->magic, (unsigned long)UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC);
197.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
198.     }
199.     if ((hdr->slot_count != slot_count) || (hdr->slot_size != slot_size)) {
200.         ucs_error("obmm: pool geometry mismatch "
201.                   "(have slots=%u size=%u, expected %u/%u)",
202.                   hdr->slot_count, hdr->slot_size, slot_count, slot_size);
203.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
204.     }
205. 
206.     pool->base       = region_base;
207.     pool->length     = region_size;
208.     pool->hdr        = hdr;
209.     pool->bitmap     = (volatile uint64_t*)((char*)hdr + sizeof(*hdr));
210.     pool->meta       = (uct_obmm_slot_meta_t*)((char*)hdr +
211.                                                uct_obmm_pool_meta_offset(slot_count));
212.     pool->slots      = (char*)hdr + hdr->slot_array_offset;
213.     pool->slot_count = slot_count;
214.     pool->slot_size  = slot_size;
215.     return UCS_OK;
216. }

218. 
219. /* Try to claim slot `idx` for the current process. Returns 1 on success
220.  * (bit was set by us, meta updated). On scavenge of a dead owner, generation
221.  * is bumped and the slot is taken over. Returns 0 if the slot is unclaimable
222.  * (live owner). */
223. static int uct_obmm_pool_try_claim(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t idx,
224.                                    uint32_t self_pid, uint64_t self_starttime,
225.                                    uint32_t *generation_p)
226. {
227.     volatile uint64_t    *word    = &pool->bitmap[idx >> 6];
228.     uint64_t              bit     = 1ull << (idx & 63u);
229.     uct_obmm_slot_meta_t *m       = &pool->meta[idx];
230.     uint64_t              cur, oldval;
231.     int                   take_over;
232. 
233.     if (!uct_obmm_pool_is_ready(pool)) {
234.         return 0;
235.     }
236. 
237.     cur = *word;
238.     if (cur & bit) {
239.         /* allocated: maybe the owner is dead */
240.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
241.         if ((m->state == UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_IN_USE) &&
242.             uct_obmm_proc_alive(m->owner_pid, m->owner_starttime)) {
243.             return 0;
244.         }
245.         take_over = 1;
246.     } else {
247.         /* free: try to set the bit */
248.         oldval = ucs_atomic_cswap64(word, cur, cur | bit);
249.         if (oldval != cur) {
250.             return 0; /* lost the race; caller will retry next slot */
251.         }
252.         take_over = 0;
253.     }
254. 
255.     if (!uct_obmm_pool_is_ready(pool)) {
256.         if (!take_over) {
257.             uct_obmm_pool_clear_bit(word, bit);
258.         }
259.         return 0;
260.     }
261. 
262.     /* Bump generation so any in-flight stale messages from prior owner are
263.      * dropped by the receive path. memset slot bytes only AFTER bumping
264.      * generation, so any racing writer's bytes won't survive un-stamped. */
265.     m->generation += 1;
266.     m->owner_pid       = self_pid;
267.     m->owner_starttime = self_starttime;
268.     /* Zero the slot bytes for our use (FIFO ctl + elements). */
269.     memset(uct_obmm_pool_slot_ptr(pool, idx), 0, pool->slot_size);
270.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
271.     m->state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_IN_USE;
272.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
273. 
274.     *generation_p = m->generation;
275.     (void)take_over;
276.     return 1;
277. }
278. 
279. 
280. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_alloc_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool,
281.                                       uint32_t *slot_index_p,
282.                                       void **slot_ptr_p,
283.                                       uint32_t *generation_p)
284. {
285.     uint32_t      self_pid       = (uint32_t)getpid();
286.     unsigned long self_starttime = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time(getpid());
287.     uint32_t      i;
288. 
289.     if (self_starttime == 0ul) {
290.         ucs_warn("obmm: cannot read self process start time; "
291.                  "scavenge will treat us as dead");
292.     }
293. 
294.     for (i = 0; i < pool->slot_count; ++i) {
295.         if (!uct_obmm_pool_is_ready(pool)) {
296.             return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
297.         }
298.         if (uct_obmm_pool_try_claim(pool, i, self_pid,
299.                                     (uint64_t)self_starttime, generation_p)) {
300.             *slot_index_p = i;
301.             *slot_ptr_p   = uct_obmm_pool_slot_ptr(pool, i);
302.             return UCS_OK;
303.         }
304.     }
305. 
306.     return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
307. }
308. 
309. 
310. static int uct_obmm_pool_all_slots_free(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool)
311. {
312.     uint32_t i;
313. 
314.     for (i = 0; i < pool->hdr->bitmap_words; ++i) {
315.         if (pool->bitmap[i] != 0) {
316.             return 0;
317.         }
318.     }
319. 
320.     return 1;
321. }
322. 
323. 
324. int uct_obmm_pool_free_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t slot_index)
325. {
326.     volatile uint64_t    *word = &pool->bitmap[slot_index >> 6];
327.     uint64_t              bit  = 1ull << (slot_index & 63u);
328.     uct_obmm_slot_meta_t *m    = &pool->meta[slot_index];
329.     unsigned long         self_starttime;
330.     uint32_t              state_prev;
331. 
332.     /* Bump generation first so any in-flight stale messages are discarded by
333.      * a future re-using owner; mark DEAD and bus fence before clearing the
334.      * bit so a racing claimer sees the new generation. */
335.     m->generation += 1;
336.     m->state       = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_DEAD;
337.     m->owner_pid   = 0;
338.     m->owner_starttime = 0;
339.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
340. 
341.     uct_obmm_pool_clear_bit(word, bit);
342. 
343.     m->state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE;
344.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
345. 
346.     if (!uct_obmm_pool_all_slots_free(pool)) {
347.         return 0;
348.     }
349. 
350.     state_prev = ucs_atomic_cswap32(&pool->hdr->state, UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY,
351.                                     UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_INITING);
352.     if (state_prev != UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
353.         return 0;
354.     }
355. 
356.     self_starttime = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time(getpid());
357.     pool->hdr->initializer_pid       = (uint32_t)getpid();
358.     pool->hdr->initializer_starttime = (uint64_t)self_starttime;
359.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
360. 
361.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
362.     if (!uct_obmm_pool_all_slots_free(pool)) {
363.         ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
364.         pool->hdr->state = UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY;
365.         return 0;
366.     }
367. 
368.     return 1;
369. }
370. 
371. 
372. void uct_obmm_pool_reset(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool)
373. {
374.     uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t *hdr;
375. 
376.     if ((pool == NULL) || (pool->hdr == NULL) || (pool->base == NULL)) {
377.         return;
378.     }
379. 
380.     hdr = pool->hdr;
381. 
382.     if (pool->length > sizeof(*hdr)) {
383.         memset((char*)pool->base + sizeof(*hdr), 0, pool->length - sizeof(*hdr));
384.     }
385. 
386.     hdr->magic                 = 0;
387.     hdr->reserved0             = 0;
388.     hdr->slot_count            = 0;
389.     hdr->slot_size             = 0;
390.     hdr->slot_array_offset     = 0;
391.     hdr->bitmap_words          = 0;
392.     hdr->initializer_pid       = 0;
393.     hdr->initializer_starttime = 0;
394.     hdr->reserved[0]           = 0;
395.     hdr->reserved[1]           = 0;
396.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
397. 
398.     hdr->state = UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT;
399.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
400. 
401.     memset(pool, 0, sizeof(*pool));
402. }
403.
