405. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_open(void *region_base, size_t region_size,
406.                                 uct_obmm_pool_t *pool)
407. {
408.     uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t *hdr = (uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t*)region_base;
409.     uint32_t             state;
410.     uint32_t             slot_count, slot_size;
411.     size_t               required;
412. 
413.     if (region_size < sizeof(*hdr)) {
414.         return UCS_ERR_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL;
415.     }
416. 
417.     state = hdr->state;
418.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
419.     if (state != UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
420.         ucs_debug("obmm: pool at %p not READY (state=%u)", region_base, state);
421.         return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
422.     }
423. 
424.     if (hdr->magic != UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC) {
425.         ucs_error("obmm: pool magic mismatch on open (got 0x%lx)",
426.                   (unsigned long)hdr->magic);
427.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
428.     }
429. 
430.     slot_count = hdr->slot_count;

86. def tokenize(query: str) -> list[str]:
87.     return re.findall(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*|\d+", query)
88.

90. def build_match_expressions(query: str) -> list[str]:
91.     raw = query.strip()
92.     if not raw:
93.         return []
94. 
95.     expressions: list[str] = []
96.     escaped = raw.replace('"', '""')
97. 
98.     if len(raw.split()) == 1 or "_" in raw or "/" in raw:
99.         expressions.append(f'"{escaped}"')
100. 
101.     tokens = tokenize(raw)
102.     if tokens:
103.         expressions.append(" AND ".join(f'"{token.replace(chr(34), chr(34) * 2)}"' for token in tokens))
104.         if len(tokens) > 1:
105.             expressions.append(" OR ".join(f'"{token.replace(chr(34), chr(34) * 2)}"' for token in tokens))
106. 
107.     if f'"{escaped}"' not in expressions:
108.         expressions.append(f'"{escaped}"')
109. 
110.     deduped: list[str] = []
111.     for expr in expressions:
112.         if expr not in deduped:
113.             deduped.append(expr)
114.     return deduped
115. 
116. 
117. def clean_snippet(document: str, limit: int = 220) -> str:
118.     lines = document.splitlines()
119.     if lines[:3] and lines[0].startswith("path: ") and any(line.startswith("root: ") for line in lines[:4]):
120.         body_start = 0
121.         blank_seen = False
122.         for i, line in enumerate(lines):
123.             if line.strip():
124.                 if blank_seen:
125.                     body_start = i
126.                     break
127.             else:
128.                 blank_seen = True
129.         body = "\n".join(lines[body_start:]).strip()
130.     else:
131.         body = document.strip()
132.     body = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", body)
133.     return body[:limit]
134. 
135. 
136. def path_bias(collection: str, path: str) -> float:
137.     for prefix, bias in PATH_BIAS_RULES.get(collection, []):
138.         if path.startswith(prefix):
139.             return bias
140.     return 0.0
141. 
142. 
143. def hint_bias(path: str, hints: Iterable[str]) -> float:
144.     path_lower = path.lower()
145.     bias = 0.0
146.     for hint in hints:
147.         if hint.lower() in path_lower:
148.             bias -= 1.5
149.     return bias
150. 
151. 
152. def exact_bias(query: str, path: str, document: str) -> float:
153.     lowered = query.lower()
154.     bias = 0.0
155.     if lowered in path.lower():
156.         bias -= 1.0
157.     if lowered in document.lower():
158.         bias -= 1.5
159.     return bias
160. 
161. 
162. def fetch_candidates(
163.     con: sqlite3.Connection,
164.     collection: str,
165.     query: str,
166.     limit: int,
167. ) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
168.     results: dict[tuple[str, int, int], dict[str, object]] = {}
169.     expressions = build_match_expressions(query)
170.     if not expressions:
171.         return []
172. 
173.     sql = """
174.         select bm25(embedding_fulltext_search) as bm25_score,
175.                p.string_value as path,
176.                s.int_value as start_line,
177.                e.int_value as end_line,
178.                d.string_value as document
179.         from embedding_fulltext_search
180.         join embeddings emb on emb.id = embedding_fulltext_search.rowid
181.         join segments seg on seg.id = emb.segment_id and seg.scope = 'METADATA'
182.         join collections c on c.id = seg.collection
183.         join embedding_metadata d on d.id = emb.id and d.key = 'chroma:document'
184.         join embedding_metadata p on p.id = emb.id and p.key = 'path'
185.         join embedding_metadata s on s.id = emb.id and s.key = 'start_line'
186.         join embedding_metadata e on e.id = emb.id and e.key = 'end_line'
187.         where c.name = ? and embedding_fulltext_search match ?
188.         order by bm25_score
189.         limit ?
190.     """
191. 
192.     for expr in expressions:
193.         for row in con.execute(sql, (collection, expr, limit)):
194.             key = (row["path"], row["start_line"], row["end_line"])
195.             candidate = {
196.                 "collection": collection,
197.                 "path": row["path"],
198.                 "start_line": row["start_line"],
199.                 "end_line": row["end_line"],
200.                 "document": row["document"],
201.                 "bm25": float(row["bm25_score"]),
202.                 "match_expression": expr,
203.             }
204.             prev = results.get(key)
205.             if prev is None or candidate["bm25"] < prev["bm25"]:
206.                 results[key] = candidate
207.     return list(results.values())
208. 
209. 
210. def rerank(candidates: list[dict[str, object]], query: str, hints: list[str]) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
211.     reranked = []
212.     for item in candidates:
213.         doc = str(item["document"])
214.         path = str(item["path"])
215.         collection = str(item["collection"])
216.         adjusted = (
217.             float(item["bm25"])
218.             + path_bias(collection, path)
219.             + hint_bias(path, hints)
220.             + exact_bias(query, path, doc)
221.         )
222.         reranked.append(
223.             {
224.                 **item,
225.                 "adjusted_score": adjusted,
226.                 "snippet": clean_snippet(doc),
227.             }
228.         )
229.     reranked.sort(key=lambda item: (item["adjusted_score"], item["bm25"], item["path"], item["start_line"]))
230.     return reranked
231. 
232. 
233. def render_text(collection: str, query: str, results: list[dict[str, object]]) -> str:
234.     lines = [f"[{collection}] query={query}"]
235.     if not results:
236.         lines.append("(no hits)")
237.         return "\n".join(lines)
238. 
239.     for index, item in enumerate(results, 1):
240.         score = item.get("adjusted_score", item.get("score"))
241.         lines.append(
242.             f"{index}. {item['path']}:{item['start_line']}-{item['end_line']} "
243.             f"(score={float(score):.3f}, bm25={float(item['bm25']):.3f})"
244.         )
245.         lines.append(f"   {item['snippet']}")
246.     return "\n".join(lines)
247. 
248. 
249. def main() -> int:
250.     args = parse_args()
251.     if not DB_PATH.exists():
252.         print(f"Chroma DB not found: {DB_PATH}", file=sys.stderr)
253.         return 1
254. 
255.     con = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
256.     con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
257. 
258.     collections = args.collections or list(COLLECTIONS)
259.     candidate_limit = max(args.k * args.candidate_multiplier, args.k)
260.     payload = []
261. 
262.     for collection in collections:
263.         candidates = fetch_candidates(con, collection, args.query, candidate_limit)
264.         ranked = rerank(candidates, args.query, args.path_hint)[: args.k]
265.         payload.append(
266.             {
267.                 "collection": collection,
268.                 "query": args.query,
269.                 "results": [
270.                     {
271.                         "path": item["path"],
272.                         "start_line": item["start_line"],
273.                         "end_line": item["end_line"],
274.                         "score": round(float(item["adjusted_score"]), 6),
275.                         "bm25": round(float(item["bm25"]), 6),
276.                         "snippet": item["snippet"],
277.                     }
278.                     for item in ranked
279.                 ],
280.             }
281.         )
282. 
283.     if args.json:
284.         print(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
285.     else:
286.         print("\n\n".join(render_text(item["collection"], item["query"], item["results"]) for item in payload))
287. 
288.     return 0
289. 
290. 
291. if __name__ == "__main__":
292.     raise SystemExit(main())
293.
```

</details>

1. ---
2. name: obmm-api-and-env
3. description: >
4.   Authoritative facts about the libobmm API and the target test environment
5.   for the UCT obmm transport. Use whenever writing or reviewing obmm
6.   transport code that touches memory setup, addressing, or peer reachability,
7.   to avoid hallucinating runtime behavior we do not actually have hardware
8.   to verify.
9. ---
10. 
11. # OBMM API and Test Environment
12. 
13. This skill is the **single source of truth** for what the agent may assume
14. about libobmm and the deployment topology. If something is not stated here,
15. the agent must ASK the user instead of inventing it.
16. 
17. ## libobmm public API (from `obmm/src/libobmm/libobmm.h`)
18. 
19. ```c
20. mem_id obmm_export(const size_t length[OBMM_MAX_LOCAL_NUMA_NODES],
21.                    unsigned long flags, struct obmm_mem_desc *desc);
22. int    obmm_unexport(mem_id id, unsigned long flags);
23. 
24. int    obmm_preimport(struct obmm_preimport_info *preimport_info,
25.                       unsigned long flags);
26. int    obmm_unpreimport(const struct obmm_preimport_info *preimport_info,
27.                         unsigned long flags);
28. 
29. mem_id obmm_export_useraddr(int pid, void *va, size_t length,
30.                             unsigned long flags, struct obmm_mem_desc *desc);
31. 
32. mem_id obmm_import(const struct obmm_mem_desc *desc, unsigned long flags,
33.                    int base_dist, int *numa);
34. int    obmm_unimport(mem_id id, unsigned long flags);
35. 
36. int    obmm_set_ownership(int fd, void *start, void *end, int prot);
37. 
38. int    obmm_query_memid_by_pa(unsigned long pa, mem_id *id,
39.                               unsigned long *offset);
40. int    obmm_query_pa_by_memid(mem_id id, unsigned long offset,
41.                               unsigned long *pa);
42. ```
43. 
44. Key data structures:
45. 
46. - `struct obmm_mem_desc { addr; length; seid[16]; deid[16]; tokenid; scna;
47.   dcna; priv_len; priv[]; }` — the descriptor returned by export and
48.   consumed by import.
49. - `struct obmm_preimport_info { pa; length; base_dist; numa_id; seid; deid;
50.   scna; dcna; priv_len; priv[]; }`
51. - `mem_id` is `uint64_t`; `OBMM_INVALID_MEMID == 0`.
52. 
53. ## Test environment — IMMUTABLE FACTS
54. 
55. These were stated by the project owner. The transport implementation MUST
56. be designed against exactly this topology:
57. 
58. 1. **Two nodes**, node 0 and node 1.
59. 2. Each node has **already exported a 128 MiB memory region** to the other
60.    side, before any UCX / MPI process starts.
61. 3. Each node has **already imported** the peer's 128 MiB region.
62. 4. The export / import / preimport / unimport / unexport lifecycle is
63.    handled outside the UCX transport — **the obmm UCT transport must NOT
64.    call** `obmm_export`, `obmm_unexport`, `obmm_import`, `obmm_unimport`,
65.    `obmm_preimport`, or `obmm_unpreimport` at runtime.
66. 5. Inside UCT, access to the local and peer regions is done with
67.    **`open("/dev/obmm_shmdev${memid}", O_RDWR | O_SYNC)` + `mmap`**
68.    (NC mapping; see "Locked-in design decisions" below).
69.    The local export memid and peer import memid are discovered by
70.    scanning `/sys/devices/obmm/obmm_shmdev*/` and inspecting whether
71.    each contains an `export_info/` or `import_info/` subdirectory.
72. 6. **No hardware is available** in the development environment. Do not
73.    attempt to run `mpirun`, real `ucx_perftest`, or any test that requires
74.    the obmm device. Validation is limited to:
75.      - `make` / `make install` succeeding,
76.      - `ucx_info -d` listing the obmm component, md, and tl,
77.      - `ucx_info -c` showing OBMM_* env vars,
78.      - static review against this skill and `uct-transport-patterns`.
79. 
80. ## Locked-in design decisions (do not change without re-asking)
81. 
82. These were explicitly decided with the project owner during the v1
83. am_short plan review. They override any conflicting suggestion the
84. agent may otherwise default to (notably the mm transport's behavior).
85. 
86. 1. **NC mapping for the data path.** Open shmdev with
87.    `O_RDWR | O_SYNC` and mmap with `MAP_SHARED`. This puts the FIFO
88.    region into a non-cacheable mapping, which:
89.      - bypasses the OBMM cacheable consistency model (writers and
90.        readers from any host coexist),
91.      - removes the need to ever call `obmm_set_ownership` from the
92.        transport.
93. 2. **Cross-node atomic RMW on NC is guaranteed.** The project owner
94.    has stated that the obmm fabric supports atomic FAA / CAS on NC
95.    mappings across nodes. The transport may therefore use mm-style
96.    multi-producer FIFOs (FAA on a shared head) without redesigning
97.    for SPSC.
98. 3. **UCT owns the in-region layout.** The 128 MiB exported region is
99.    zero-filled at platform export time. The transport places its own
100.    header (state / version / slot bitmap / slot_meta / fixed-size
101.    slots) at the start of the region. A two-phase init is used:
102.    `state` transitions UNINIT→INITING (CAS) → fill geometry → bus
103.    fence → store READY. Losers spin on READY then bus-load fence.
104.    Single-magic init is racy (geometry not yet visible) and must
105.    not be used.
106. 4. **Topology**: per node there is exactly 1 export region and 1
107.    import region (the peer node's export). Discovered via
108.    `/sys/devices/obmm/obmm_shmdev*/{export_info,import_info}`.
109.    Reachability and mapping table keys are
110.    `(exporter_dcna, exporter_deid, memid)` from sysfs — NOT memid
111.    alone (collision-prone).
112. 5. **Self-loopback inside one node** is supported: same-node processes
113.    communicate by both mapping the local export region (the imported
114.    "peer region" entry simply will not exist in the single-node case,
115.    or will equal the local one — handle both).
116. 6. **Slot lifecycle uses generation tokens.** Each slot has
117.    `(owner_pid, owner_starttime, generation, state)` in slot_meta.
118.    `iface_addr` and every FIFO elem carry `generation`; receiver
119.    discards mismatches. Destroy = mark DEAD → bus fence → bump
120.    generation → clear bit. Crash recovery: scan bitmap, validate
121.    `/proc/<pid>/stat starttime`, reclaim. PID alone is insufficient
122.    (PID reuse).
123. 7. **Cross-node memory ordering uses BUS-domain fences.**
124.    `ucs_memory_bus_store_fence()` / `ucs_memory_bus_load_fence()`
125.    (sfence/lfence on x86, `dmb oshst`/`dmb oshld` on arm64). The
126.    CPU-domain fences mm uses (`ucs_memory_cpu_*_fence`) are
127.    inner-shareable only and DO NOT cover cross-host NC visibility.
128. 
129. ## OBMM consistency model — why NC matters
130. 
131. From `obmm/doc/libobmm.md` and `obmm/doc/obmm_set_ownership.md`:
132. 
133. - For **cacheable** OBMM mappings, at any moment all hosts touching a
134.   region must be in one of two states:
135.     a) all hosts are PROT_READ or PROT_NONE, OR
136.     b) exactly one host has writers; all other hosts must be PROT_NONE.
137. - A receive-FIFO model (writer on the sending host, reader on the
138.   receiving host, on the SAME region) violates this: it would require
139.   one host to write while another host reads simultaneously.
140. - Therefore the obmm transport CANNOT use cacheable mappings for the
141.   FIFO region without expensive ownership flips per message.
142. - NC (O_SYNC) mappings are exempt: per the doc, "用户无需关心一致性
143.   模型，所有的用户均具备读写权限". This is why decision (1) above
144.   is mandatory, not optional.
145. 
146. ## Implications for the transport design
147. 
148. These follow from the facts above and should be treated as defaults; ask
149. the user before deviating:
150. 
151. - **Memory registration** (`uct_md_ops_t::mem_reg` / `mem_dereg`) does not
152.   need to call libobmm. The current placeholders
153.   (`uct_md_dummy_mem_reg` / `uct_md_dummy_mem_dereg`) are appropriate
154.   because the buffers used by am_short live inside the pre-imported
155.   peer region, not in arbitrary user buffers.
156. - **Address exchange** for am_short: `iface_addr` MUST carry
157.   `(exporter_dcna, exporter_deid, memid, slot_index, generation)`
158.   so the peer can (a) look up the already-mmap'd region in our MD's
159.   mapping table by exporter identity + memid, and (b) detect stale
160.   slot reuse via generation. Memid alone is unsafe and was rejected
161.   in plan-review. The current `uct_obmm_iface_addr_t = uint64_t`
162.   must be widened.
163. - **Reachability**: `iface_is_reachable_v2` matches on
164.   `(exporter_dcna, exporter_deid, memid)` against the MD's known
165.   exports + imports. Drop the `uct_sm_iface_is_reachable` (same-host)
166.   call — obmm is cross-node by construction.
167. - **Progress wiring**: `iface_progress_enable/disable` MUST call
168.   `uct_base_iface_progress_enable_cb(...)` /
169.   `uct_base_iface_progress_disable(...)`. The current
170.   `ucs_empty_function` stubs prevent UCP from ever polling the iface.
171. - **EP_CHECK**: do NOT advertise `UCT_IFACE_FLAG_EP_CHECK` in v1.
172.   The current skeleton sets it but `ep_check` only returns OK; no
173.   cross-node liveness check exists. PID-in-addr is not enough.
174. - **Ownership / `obmm_set_ownership`**: only call this if the UCT layer
175.   needs to flip read/write permission on a sub-range of the imported
176.   region; for a first am_short pass with a producer/consumer FIFO this
177.   is typically NOT needed. Ask before adding it.
178. 
179. ## What to ASK the user before writing code
180. 
181. Do not invent answers to any of these. Use the `ask_user` tool:
182. 
183. 1. Whether multiple obmm ifaces per process are expected, or strictly
184.    one peer per local iface (current assumption: 1 iface per process,
185.    pool holds many ifaces from many processes).
186. 2. What the wire `am_id` / header / payload alignment requirements are
187.    on the obmm hardware (e.g. 64 B cache line? 256 B?). Default plan
188.    aligns elements to 64 B; confirm before tuning.
189. 3. ~~Whether NC writes from one host become visible to remote loads
190.    without an explicit fabric-level barrier other than CPU
191.    `dmb`/`mfence`.~~ **RESOLVED in plan-review**: must use bus-domain
192.    fences (`ucs_memory_bus_*_fence`), not CPU-domain. CPU fences are
193.    inner-shareable only and don't reach cross-host NC.
194. 
195. ## Forbidden assumptions
196. 
197. - Do NOT assume libobmm performs its own synchronization — am_short
198.   ordering must be enforced by the transport (release / acquire fences,
199.   same as mm).
200. - Do NOT use cacheable mappings on the FIFO region. NC (`O_SYNC`)
201.   is mandatory; see "Locked-in design decisions".
202. - Do NOT call any `obmm_*` runtime API in the UCT transport unless this
203.   document is updated to allow it. In particular do NOT call
204.   `obmm_set_ownership` — its semantics conflict with the FIFO usage
205.   pattern.
206. - Do NOT use `ucs_memory_cpu_*_fence()` on the obmm data path. They
207.   are inner-shareable / compiler-only and do not cover cross-host NC
208.   visibility. Use `ucs_memory_bus_store_fence()` /
209.   `ucs_memory_bus_load_fence()` (sfence/lfence on x86,
210.   `dmb oshst`/`dmb oshld` on arm64). The mm transport gets away with
211.   CPU fences only because mm peers share an inner-shareable cache
212.   domain; obmm peers do not.
213. 
214. ## Why cacheable + manual cache management was rejected
215. 
216. Asked and answered during plan-review. Do not re-litigate without new
217. information about the obmm fabric.
218. 
219. 1. **OBMM cacheable consistency is enforced at the page-table level**,
220.    not at the cache level. `obmm/doc/libobmm.md:196-211` and
221.    `obmm/doc/obmm_set_ownership.md` require that at any moment either
222.    all hosts touching a region are PROT_READ/PROT_NONE, or exactly
223.    one host has writers and all other hosts are PROT_NONE. Even a
224.    correctly `clflush`-ed write from host A is not legal to read on
225.    host B until ownership is flipped via the `obmm_set_ownership()`
226.    syscall. That is one syscall per message — incompatible with
227.    `am_short` latency goals.
228. 2. **arm64 user-space lacks `dc ivac`** (invalidate by VA to PoC, EL0
229.    typically only exposes `dc civac` = clean+invalidate). A reader-side
230.    "discard cache, then load" sequence would have to clean+invalidate
231.    on every poll, doubling the writer-side cost.
232. 3. **UCX has no precedent** for cross-host cacheable shared memory with
233.    manual coherence on a hot data path. `ucs_arch_clear_cache` exists
234.    (x86: `mfence; clflush; mfence` per line; arm64: `dc cvau` +
235.    `ic ivau`) but is used only for instruction-cache coherence
236.    (JIT / code patching), never for transport data. All cross-host
237.    UCX transports either use a NIC (NIC handles coherence) or rely
238.    on a HW-coherent fabric. Inventing a new pattern here would carry
239.    risk far above what NC mapping costs.
240. 4. **Bulk-flip ownership** (writer holds write, batches N messages,
241.    flips, reader batches N reads) is a possible future path for
242.    `put/get` bulk transfers but trades latency for throughput and
243.    defeats AM short's purpose. Out of scope for v1.
244. 
245. NC (`O_SYNC`) avoids all four issues at the cost of uncached load/store
246. performance, which the project owner has accepted.
247.
````

96. /* CAS-claim the INITING transition; if we lose, wait until READY (or
97.  * recover the slot if the prior initializer died mid-init). */
98. static ucs_status_t
99. uct_obmm_pool_init_or_wait(uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t *hdr, uint32_t slot_count,
100.                            uint32_t slot_size)
101. {
102.     unsigned long      self_starttime = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time(getpid());
103.     uint32_t           prev;
104.     unsigned           spin;
105.     size_t             bitmap_words = uct_obmm_pool_bitmap_words(slot_count);
106.     size_t             slot_off     = uct_obmm_pool_slot_offset(slot_count);
107. 
108. retry:
109.     prev = ucs_atomic_cswap32(&hdr->state, UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT,
110.                               UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_INITING);
111. 
112.     if (prev == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT) {
113.         /* We won: zero metadata, fill geometry, publish READY */
114.         memset((char*)hdr + sizeof(*hdr), 0,
115.                bitmap_words * sizeof(uint64_t) +
116.                (size_t)slot_count * sizeof(uct_obmm_slot_meta_t));
117. 
118.         hdr->magic                 = UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC;
119.         hdr->reserved0             = 0;
120.         hdr->slot_count            = slot_count;
121.         hdr->slot_size             = slot_size;
122.         hdr->slot_array_offset     = slot_off;
123.         hdr->bitmap_words          = (uint32_t)bitmap_words;
124.         hdr->initializer_pid       = (uint32_t)getpid();
125.         hdr->initializer_starttime = (uint64_t)self_starttime;
126. 
127.         ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
128.         hdr->state = UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY;
129.         return UCS_OK;
130.     }
131. 
132.     if (prev == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
133.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
134.         return UCS_OK;
135.     }
136. 
137.     /* state == INITING : wait or recover */
138.     for (spin = 0; spin < UCT_OBMM_POOL_INIT_SPIN_LIMIT; ++spin) {
139.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
140.         if (hdr->state == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
141.             return UCS_OK;
142.         }
143.         if (hdr->state == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT) {
144.             /* Some other rescuer reset; race for init */
145.             goto retry;
146.         }
147. 
148.         if ((spin & 0xfffu) == 0xfffu) {
149.             /* Periodically check if the initializer is alive. If not,
150.              * try to reset back to UNINIT so someone can re-init. */
151.             if (!uct_obmm_proc_alive(hdr->initializer_pid,
152.                                      hdr->initializer_starttime)) {
153.                 ucs_warn("obmm: pool initializer pid=%u died; resetting "
154.                          "pool init state",
155.                          hdr->initializer_pid);
156.                 ucs_atomic_cswap32(&hdr->state, UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_INITING,
157.                                    UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT);
158.                 goto retry;
159.             }
160.         }
161.     }
162. 
163.     ucs_error("obmm: timed out waiting for pool init to complete "
164.               "(initializer pid=%u)", hdr->initializer_pid);
165.     return UCS_ERR_TIMED_OUT;
166. }
167. 
168. 
169. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_attach(void *region_base, size_t region_size,
170.                                   uint32_t slot_count, uint32_t slot_size,
171.                                   uct_obmm_pool_t *pool)
172. {
173.     uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t *hdr = (uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t*)region_base;
174.     size_t               required;
175.     ucs_status_t         status;
176. 
177.     if ((slot_count == 0) || (slot_size == 0)) {
178.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
179.     }
180. 
181.     required = uct_obmm_pool_required_size(slot_count, slot_size);
182.     if (region_size < required) {
183.         ucs_error("obmm: region size %zu < required pool size %zu "
184.                   "(slots=%u, slot_size=%u)",
185.                   region_size, required, slot_count, slot_size);
186.         return UCS_ERR_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL;
187.     }
188. 
189.     status = uct_obmm_pool_init_or_wait(hdr, slot_count, slot_size);
190.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
191.         return status;
192.     }
193. 
194.     if (hdr->magic != UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC) {
195.         ucs_error("obmm: pool magic mismatch (got 0x%lx, expected 0x%lx)",
196.                   (unsigned long)hdr->magic, (unsigned long)UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC);
197.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
198.     }
199.     if ((hdr->slot_count != slot_count) || (hdr->slot_size != slot_size)) {
200.         ucs_error("obmm: pool geometry mismatch "
201.                   "(have slots=%u size=%u, expected %u/%u)",
202.                   hdr->slot_count, hdr->slot_size, slot_count, slot_size);
203.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
204.     }
205. 
206.     pool->base       = region_base;
207.     pool->length     = region_size;
208.     pool->hdr        = hdr;
209.     pool->bitmap     = (volatile uint64_t*)((char*)hdr + sizeof(*hdr));
210.     pool->meta       = (uct_obmm_slot_meta_t*)((char*)hdr +
211.                                                uct_obmm_pool_meta_offset(slot_count));
212.     pool->slots      = (char*)hdr + hdr->slot_array_offset;
213.     pool->slot_count = slot_count;
214.     pool->slot_size  = slot_size;
215.     return UCS_OK;
216. }
217. 
218. 
219. /* Try to claim slot `idx` for the current process. Returns 1 on success
220.  * (bit was set by us, meta updated). On scavenge of a dead owner, generation
221.  * is bumped and the slot is taken over. Returns 0 if the slot is unclaimable
222.  * (live owner). */
223. static int uct_obmm_pool_try_claim(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t idx,
224.                                    uint32_t self_pid, uint64_t self_starttime,
225.                                    uint32_t *generation_p)
226. {
227.     volatile uint64_t    *word    = &pool->bitmap[idx >> 6];
228.     uint64_t              bit     = 1ull << (idx & 63u);
229.     uct_obmm_slot_meta_t *m       = &pool->meta[idx];
230.     uint64_t              cur, oldval;
231.     int                   take_over;
232. 
233.     if (!uct_obmm_pool_is_ready(pool)) {
234.         return 0;
235.     }
236. 
237.     cur = *word;
238.     if (cur & bit) {
239.         /* allocated: maybe the owner is dead */
240.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
241.         if ((m->state == UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_IN_USE) &&
242.             uct_obmm_proc_alive(m->owner_pid, m->owner_starttime)) {
243.             return 0;
244.         }
245.         take_over = 1;
246.     } else {
247.         /* free: try to set the bit */
248.         oldval = ucs_atomic_cswap64(word, cur, cur | bit);
249.         if (oldval != cur) {
250.             return 0; /* lost the race; caller will retry next slot */
251.         }
252.         take_over = 0;
253.     }
254. 
255.     if (!uct_obmm_pool_is_ready(pool)) {
256.         if (!take_over) {
257.             uct_obmm_pool_clear_bit(word, bit);
258.         }
259.         return 0;
260.     }
261. 
262.     /* Bump generation so any in-flight stale messages from prior owner are
263.      * dropped by the receive path. memset slot bytes only AFTER bumping
264.      * generation, so any racing writer's bytes won't survive un-stamped. */
265.     m->generation += 1;
266.     m->owner_pid       = self_pid;
267.     m->owner_starttime = self_starttime;
268.     /* Zero the slot bytes for our use (FIFO ctl + elements). */
269.     memset(uct_obmm_pool_slot_ptr(pool, idx), 0, pool->slot_size);
270.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
271.     m->state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_IN_USE;
272.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
273. 
274.     *generation_p = m->generation;
275.     (void)take_over;
276.     return 1;
277. }
278. 
279. 
280. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_alloc_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool,
281.                                       uint32_t *slot_index_p,
282.                                       void **slot_ptr_p,
283.                                       uint32_t *generation_p)
284. {
285.     uint32_t      self_pid       = (uint32_t)getpid();
286.     unsigned long self_starttime = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time(getpid());
287.     uint32_t      i;
288. 
289.     if (self_starttime == 0ul) {
290.         ucs_warn("obmm: cannot read self process start time; "
291.                  "scavenge will treat us as dead");
292.     }
293. 
294.     for (i = 0; i < pool->slot_count; ++i) {
295.         if (!uct_obmm_pool_is_ready(pool)) {
296.             return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
297.         }
298.         if (uct_obmm_pool_try_claim(pool, i, self_pid,
299.                                     (uint64_t)self_starttime, generation_p)) {
300.             *slot_index_p = i;
301.             *slot_ptr_p   = uct_obmm_pool_slot_ptr(pool, i);
302.             return UCS_OK;
303.         }
304.     }
305. 
306.     return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
307. }
308. 
309. 
310. static int uct_obmm_pool_all_slots_free(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool)
311. {
312.     uint32_t i;
313. 
314.     for (i = 0; i < pool->hdr->bitmap_words; ++i) {
315.         if (pool->bitmap[i] != 0) {
316.             return 0;
317.         }
318.     }
319. 
320.     return 1;
321. }
322. 
323. 
324. int uct_obmm_pool_free_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t slot_index)
325. {
326.     volatile uint64_t    *word = &pool->bitmap[slot_index >> 6];
327.     uint64_t              bit  = 1ull << (slot_index & 63u);
328.     uct_obmm_slot_meta_t *m    = &pool->meta[slot_index];
329.     unsigned long         self_starttime;
330.     uint32_t              state_prev;
331. 
332.     /* Bump generation first so any in-flight stale messages are discarded by
333.      * a future re-using owner; mark DEAD and bus fence before clearing the
334.      * bit so a racing claimer sees the new generation. */
335.     m->generation += 1;
336.     m->state       = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_DEAD;
337.     m->owner_pid   = 0;
338.     m->owner_starttime = 0;
339.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
340. 
341.     uct_obmm_pool_clear_bit(word, bit);
342. 
343.     m->state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE;
344.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
345. 
346.     if (!uct_obmm_pool_all_slots_free(pool)) {
347.         return 0;
348.     }
349. 
350.     state_prev = ucs_atomic_cswap32(&pool->hdr->state, UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY,
351.                                     UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_INITING);
352.     if (state_prev != UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
353.         return 0;
354.     }
355. 
356.     self_starttime = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time(getpid());
357.     pool->hdr->initializer_pid       = (uint32_t)getpid();
358.     pool->hdr->initializer_starttime = (uint64_t)self_starttime;
359.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
360. 
361.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
362.     if (!uct_obmm_pool_all_slots_free(pool)) {
363.         ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
364.         pool->hdr->state = UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY;
365.         return 0;
366.     }
367. 
368.     return 1;
369. }
370. 
371. 
372. void uct_obmm_pool_reset(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool)
373. {
374.     uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t *hdr;
375. 
376.     if ((pool == NULL) || (pool->hdr == NULL) || (pool->base == NULL)) {
377.         return;
378.     }
379. 
380.     hdr = pool->hdr;
381. 
382.     if (pool->length > sizeof(*hdr)) {
383.         memset((char*)pool->base + sizeof(*hdr), 0, pool->length - sizeof(*hdr));
384.     }
385. 
386.     hdr->magic                 = 0;
387.     hdr->reserved0             = 0;
388.     hdr->slot_count            = 0;
389.     hdr->slot_size             = 0;
390.     hdr->slot_array_offset     = 0;
391.     hdr->bitmap_words          = 0;
392.     hdr->initializer_pid       = 0;
393.     hdr->initializer_starttime = 0;
394.     hdr->reserved[0]           = 0;
395.     hdr->reserved[1]           = 0;
396.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
397. 
398.     hdr->state = UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT;
399.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
400. 
401.     memset(pool, 0, sizeof(*pool));
402. }
403. 
404. 
405. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_open(void *region_base, size_t region_size,
406.                                 uct_obmm_pool_t *pool)
407. {
408.     uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t *hdr = (uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t*)region_base;
409.     uint32_t             state;
410.     uint32_t             slot_count, slot_size;
411.     size_t               required;
412. 
413.     if (region_size < sizeof(*hdr)) {
414.         return UCS_ERR_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL;
415.     }
416. 
417.     state = hdr->state;
418.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
419.     if (state != UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
420.         ucs_debug("obmm: pool at %p not READY (state=%u)", region_base, state);
421.         return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
422.     }
423. 
424.     if (hdr->magic != UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC) {
425.         ucs_error("obmm: pool magic mismatch on open (got 0x%lx)",
426.                   (unsigned long)hdr->magic);
427.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
428.     }
429. 
430.     slot_count = hdr->slot_count;
431.     slot_size  = hdr->slot_size;
432.     if ((slot_count == 0) || (slot_size == 0)) {
433.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
434.     }
435. 
436.     required = uct_obmm_pool_required_size(slot_count, slot_size);
437.     if (region_size < required) {
438.         ucs_error("obmm: peer pool geometry exceeds region size "
439.                   "(slots=%u, slot_size=%u, region=%zu, required=%zu)",
440.                   slot_count, slot_size, region_size, required);
441.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
442.     }
443. 
444.     pool->base       = region_base;
445.     pool->length     = region_size;
446.     pool->hdr        = hdr;
447.     pool->bitmap     = (volatile uint64_t*)((char*)hdr + sizeof(*hdr));
448.     pool->meta       = (uct_obmm_slot_meta_t*)((char*)hdr +
449.                                                uct_obmm_pool_meta_offset(slot_count));
450.     pool->slots      = (char*)hdr + hdr->slot_array_offset;
451.     pool->slot_count = slot_count;
452.     pool->slot_size  = slot_size;
453.     return UCS_OK;
454. }

````
1. # obmm UCT transport — design notes
2. 
3. This file is the **single source of truth** for the on-region wire format
4. and the data-path semantics of the `obmm` UCT transport. Update it
5. **before** changing layout, capabilities, or sync rules. AGENTS.md
6. mandates retrieve-before-recall; this doc is the first thing to grep.
7. 
8. Status legend:
9. - **v1** = shipped, MPI cross-node smoke tests pass.
10. - **v2** = current target: complete `am_bcopy` (max_bcopy decoupled from
11.   FIFO element size, no per-message UCP fragmentation below seg_size).
12. 
13. ---
14. 
15. ## Locked-in environment facts
16. 
17. (Mirrors `.github/skills/obmm-api-and-env/SKILL.md`. Do NOT contradict
18. without re-checking that file.)
19. 
20. - Each node pre-exports **one 128 MiB region**; export/import is done
21.   outside UCX. UCT must NOT call `obmm_export/import/preimport/...`.
22. - Data-path mapping is **non-cacheable** (`open(... O_SYNC)` + mmap).
23.   `obmm_set_ownership` is forbidden and irrelevant.
24. - Cross-host atomic FAA/CAS on NC is supported (project-owner statement).
25. - Memory ordering uses **bus-domain fences**
26.   (`ucs_memory_bus_store_fence` / `ucs_memory_bus_load_fence`), NOT the
27.   CPU-domain `ucs_memory_cpu_*_fence` that mm uses. mm peers share an
28.   inner-shareable cache domain; obmm peers do not.
29. - Reachability is keyed on `(exporter_dcna, exporter_deid, memid)`,
30.   never memid alone.
31. - Two-phase pool init (UNINIT → INITING → READY via CAS) plus per-slot
32.   `(generation, owner_pid, owner_starttime)` for crash/PID-reuse safety.
33. - ARM64 is the production ISA. NC + bus fences are correct on aarch64.
34. 
35. ---
36. 
37. ## Region layout (v2)
38. 
39. Inside the 128 MiB exported region:
40. 
41. ```
42. +-------------------------------------------------------+ offset 0
43. | uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t (magic, state, geometry)          |
44. +-------------------------------------------------------+
45. | alloc_bitmap[bitmap_words]                            |
46. +-------------------------------------------------------+
47. | slot_meta[slot_count]  (gen, owner_pid, starttime, …) |
48. +-------------------------------------------------------+ hdr->slot_array_offset
49. | slot[0]:                                              |
50. |   uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t  (head + tail, padded)          |
51. |   fifo_elem[fifo_size]  (elem_size each)              |
52. |   bcopy_desc[fifo_size] (seg_size each)   <-- NEW v2  |
53. +-------------------------------------------------------+
54. | slot[1]: …                                            |
55. …
56. ```
57. 
58. **Key invariant (v2)**: every FIFO element `elem[N]` (N = `idx & mask`)
59. has a paired `desc[N]` of `seg_size` bytes in the same slot. Lifetime of
60. `desc[N]` is **identical** to lifetime of `elem[N]` — both are released
61. together when the receiver bumps tail past index N, and both are
62. overwritten together by the sender that claims index N+fifo_size.
63. 
64. This eliminates the cross-host desc free-list problem: there is no
65. separate desc allocator, no per-desc CAS, and no risk of the desc pool
66. running dry while FIFO slots remain available. The FIFO already has
67. exactly the right backpressure semantics.
68. 
69. ### Slot stride
70. 
71. ```
72. slot_stride = align_up(
73.     sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t) +
74.     fifo_size * elem_size +
75.     fifo_size * seg_size,
76.     cacheline)
77. ```
78. 
79. The pool's `slot_count` (compile-time `UCT_OBMM_POOL_SLOT_COUNT = 256`)
80. **times** `slot_stride` MUST fit in `region->length` (128 MiB minus pool
81. header overhead). Defaults are picked so that this holds; callers may
82. shrink (not grow) `seg_size` / `fifo_size` if they need more slots.
83. 
84. Default budget check:
85. ```
86. fifo_size       =     64
87. elem_size       =   2048   (max_short = 2032)
88. seg_size        =   4096   (max_bcopy = 4096)
89. ctl + slot data = 128 + 64*(2048+4096) = ~384 KiB / slot
90. slot_count      =    256
91. total           = ~ 96 MiB / 128 MiB                     ✓
92. ```
93. If a user bumps `seg_size` to 8192, total grows to ~160 MiB and pool
94. attach fails with a clear error pointing at the geometry knobs.
95. 
96. When the last local iface on an export exits, UCX resets the entire local
97. export region to zero before another attach may re-initialize the pool.
98. 
99. ---
100. 
101. ## FIFO element layout
102. 
103. `uct_obmm_fifo_element_t` (16 bytes, packed) is unchanged from v1:
104. 
105. | field      | bytes | notes                                          |
106. |------------|-------|------------------------------------------------|
107. | flags      |   1   | OWNER bit + BCOPY bit                          |
108. | am_id      |   1   |                                                |
109. | length     |   2   | u16 — payload bytes (excl. am_short hdr)       |
110. | generation |   4   | slot generation token at TX time               |
111. | header     |   8   | am_short user-visible 8B header (unused bcopy) |
112. 
113. **am_short payload** still lives inline at `elem + 1` in the FIFO area.
114. Wire format and `max_short = elem_size - 16` are unchanged.
115. 
116. **am_bcopy payload** (NEW in v2) lives in the paired `desc[N]` instead
117. of inside the FIFO element body. The element body is unused for bcopy;
118. on bcopy the sender writes:
119. - `elem->flags  = OWNER | BCOPY`
120. - `elem->am_id  = id`
121. - `elem->length = pack_cb_returned_length`     (≤ seg_size, so ≤ u16max)
122. - `elem->generation = ep->expected_generation`
123. - `elem->header = 0` (unused)
124. 
125. Receiver, on seeing FLAG_BCOPY, computes
126. `desc[N] = slot_descs + (idx & mask) * seg_size` and calls
127. `uct_iface_invoke_am(am_id, desc[N], length, 0)`.
128. 
129. Because `desc[N]` is bound 1:1 to `elem[N]`, no extra metadata is
130. exchanged in the FIFO element to locate the desc.
131. 
132. ### `length` field width
133. 
134. `elem->length` stays `uint16_t`, capping `seg_size` at 65535. We reject
135. larger `seg_size` at iface init. If a future `seg_size > 64KiB` is
136. needed, widen `length` to `uint32_t` and update the compatibility checks.
137. 
138. ---
139. 
140. ## Sender side (`obmm_ep`)
141. 
142. Both `am_short` and `am_bcopy` reserve a slot identically:
143. 
144. ```
145. 1. load head from peer_ctl->head
146. 2. if (head - cached_tail) >= fifo_size:
147.        bus_load_fence; refresh cached_tail; recheck;
148.        if still full: return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE
149. 3. claim producer lock (`peer_ctl->lock`) with a unique token, then
150.    store head → head+1, then release the lock
151. 4. compute idx = head, N = idx & mask
152. 5. payload write:
153.      short: memcpy header+payload into elem[N]+1
154.      bcopy: pack_cb(desc[N], arg) -> length
155. 6. fill elem[N] header fields (am_id, length, generation, [header])
156. 7. ucs_memory_bus_store_fence()                          <- release barrier
157. 8. elem[N]->flags = OWNER_BIT_FOR_THIS_LAP | (BCOPY if bcopy)
158. ```
159. 
160. The OWNER bit alternates each lap of the ring (see `obmm_iface.c`
161. `uct_obmm_iface_progress` for why). Since `desc[N]` writes happen
162. **before** the bus_store_fence, they become visible to the peer at the
163. same time as the published flags byte.
164. 
165. The producer lock exists because on the validated target aarch64 NC
166. environment, cross-node CAS updates memory correctly but its return value
167. is not reliable enough to use as a head-claim ownership result. The token
168. lock converts reservation into: acquire lock by readback, re-check space,
169. plain-store new head, release lock.
170. 
171. ### Pending
172. 
173. `ep_pending_add` returns `UCS_ERR_BUSY` (UCP retries via its own
174. progress loop). Real arbiter is out of scope for v1/v2 — backpressure
175. is bounded because the receiver drains continuously.
176. 
177. ---
178. 
179. ## Receiver side (`obmm_iface_progress`)
180. 
181. ```
182. loop up to fifo_max_poll:
183.     elem = elem[read_index & mask]
184.     expected_owner = lap_parity(read_index)
185.     if (elem->flags & OWNER) != expected_owner: break       (no work)
186.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence()                              (acquire)
187.     if elem->generation != iface->generation:
188.         drop silently (slot was reused after our death+rebirth)
189.     elif elem->flags & BCOPY:
190.         desc = desc[read_index & mask]
191.         invoke_am(am_id, desc,  length, 0)
192.     else:
193.         invoke_am(am_id, &elem->header, length, 0)
194.     read_index++
195. if any progress:
196.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence()
197.     recv_ctl->tail = read_index
198. ```
199. 
200. **Why the fence ordering is correct for bcopy too**: the
201. `ucs_memory_bus_load_fence()` issued after observing the flags byte
202. orders **all** subsequent loads in this iteration — including the
203. load of `desc[N]` performed inside the AM handler's memcpy. The handler
204. is `CB_SYNC` (synchronous), so the fence-acquire pairs with the
205. sender's `bus_store_fence` before publishing flags.
206. 
207. ---
208. 
209. ## Capabilities (`iface_query`)
210. 
211. | flag                            | v1 | v2 | notes                       |
212. |---------------------------------|----|----|-----------------------------|
213. | AM_SHORT                        |  ✓ |  ✓ | max = elem_size - 16        |
214. | AM_BCOPY                        |  ✓ |  ✓ | v1: = max_short (cramped); v2: = seg_size |
215. | PENDING                         |  ✓ |  ✓ | returns BUSY only           |
216. | CONNECT_TO_IFACE                |  ✓ |  ✓ |                             |
217. | CB_SYNC                         |  ✓ |  ✓ |                             |
218. | INTER_NODE                      |  ✓ |  ✓ | required for cross-host UCT (otherwise OMPI's NET_ONLY filter strips us — see ucp_worker.c:2962) |
219. 
220. **Not advertised** in v1/v2: PUT/GET (any), ATOMIC, AM_ZCOPY, EP_CHECK,
221. AM_DUP, ERRHANDLE_PEER. Adding any of these requires a separate design
222. note.
223. 
224. ---
225. 
226. ## Wire-format compat
227. 
228. `uct_obmm_iface_addr_t` carries `(slot_index, generation, pid,
229. fifo_size, fifo_elem_size, bcopy_seg_size)`. v2 **adds** `bcopy_seg_size`
230. (replaces v1's `reserved` u32 → no struct-size change). Two ifaces are
231. mutually reachable iff all three geometry fields match — guarded in
232. `is_reachable_v2`. Pool compatibility is enforced by the shared pool
233. geometry checks in `pool_attach`/`pool_open`; the shared region does not
234. persist a separate pool version word.
235. 
236. ---
237. 
238. ## Configuration knobs
239. 
240. All under `UCX_OBMM_*` prefix.
241. 
242. | knob                      | default | meaning                          |
243. |---------------------------|---------|----------------------------------|
244. | FIFO_SIZE                 |    64   | ring depth (power of 2)          |
245. | FIFO_ELEM_SIZE            |  2048   | bytes per FIFO elem (incl. 16B hdr) → max_short = 2032 |
246. | BCOPY_SEG_SIZE   (v2 NEW) |  4096   | bytes per paired desc → max_bcopy |
247. | FIFO_MAX_POLL             |    16   | RX completions per progress()     |

249.

251. - `FIFO_SIZE` > 0, power of 2

253. - `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE` > 0 and `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE <= UINT16_MAX`
254. - `slot_count * slot_stride + pool_overhead <= region->length`
255.

### 💬 Copilot

- **Plan:** Mostly correct. Making reset end in a **literal all-zero region** is cleaner and matches `DESIGN.md`’s zero-on-exit model better than “conceptually UNINIT.”

- **Fix first:** There is an **INITING-owner race**. `uct_obmm_pool_init_or_wait()` currently treats `initializer_pid/starttime==0` as dead; your proposed final step can expose `INITING + zero owner` while cleanup is still live. The same smaller race already exists just after `READY-\>INITING` in `uct_obmm_pool_free_slot()`. Reclaim only when a **nonzero** owner tuple is proven dead, and keep the **bus-store fence immediately before publishing state=0**.

- **Removing useless header fields:** **Yes, safe enough on this branch**, **if all processes are rebuilt together**. It is **not** mixed-binary safe, because shrinking `uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t` changes bitmap/meta/slot offsets (`obmm_pool.h/c`, `DESIGN.md`).

34. /* In-region pool header. Lives at offset 0 of the local export region. All
35.  * fields are written via non-cacheable mappings: state transitions must be

37.  * host) see the geometry before the READY transition. */
38. typedef struct uct_obmm_pool_hdr {
39.     uint64_t magic;             /* UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC */
40.     uint32_t reserved0;
41.     uint32_t state;             /* UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_xx, atomic */
42.     uint32_t slot_count;
43.     uint32_t slot_size;
44.     uint64_t slot_array_offset; /* offset (from region base) of slot 0 */
45.     uint32_t bitmap_words;      /* number of u64 words in alloc bitmap */
46.     uint32_t initializer_pid;   /* pid that owned the INITING transition */
47.     uint64_t initializer_starttime;
48.     uint64_t reserved[2];
49.     /* followed by:
50.      *   uint64_t alloc_bitmap[bitmap_words];
51.      *   uct_obmm_slot_meta_t slot_meta[slot_count];
52.      */
53. } uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t;
54. 
55. 
56. /* Per-slot ownership metadata. Stored adjacent to the bitmap, separate from
57.  * the slot's actual FIFO contents. */
58. typedef struct uct_obmm_slot_meta {
59.     uint32_t state;            /* UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_xx */
60.     uint32_t generation;       /* monotonically increasing; bumped on free,
61.                                   scavenge, and when readers must discard
62.                                   in-flight stale elements */
63.     uint32_t owner_pid;
64.     uint32_t reserved;
65.     uint64_t owner_starttime;  /* /proc/<pid>/stat field 22, for liveness */
66. } uct_obmm_slot_meta_t;
67. 
68.

70.  * into the mapped region; nothing is owned by this struct. */
71. typedef struct uct_obmm_pool {
72.     void                  *base;     /* region base (pool hdr) */
73.     size_t                 length;   /* mapped region size */
74.     uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t   *hdr;
75.     volatile uint64_t     *bitmap;
76.     uct_obmm_slot_meta_t  *meta;
77.     void                  *slots;    /* base + hdr->slot_array_offset */
78.     uint32_t               slot_count;
79.     uint32_t               slot_size;
80. } uct_obmm_pool_t;

92.  *
93.  * If an existing pool's geometry doesn't match the requested

95.  */

104.  * iface_addr. Slot bytes are zeroed before return.

86.     live = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time((pid_t)pid);
87.     if (live == 0ul) {
88.         /* /proc/<pid>/stat unreadable: pid does not exist any more */
89.         return 0;
90.     }
91. 
92.     return (uint64_t)live == starttime;
93. }
94. 
95. 
96. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE int
97. uct_obmm_pool_initializer_stamped(uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t *hdr)
98. {
99.     return (hdr->initializer_pid != 0) && (hdr->initializer_starttime != 0);
100. }
101. 
102. 
103. /* CAS-claim the INITING transition; if we lose, wait until READY (or
104.  * recover the slot if the prior initializer died mid-init). */
105. static ucs_status_t
106. uct_obmm_pool_init_or_wait(uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t *hdr, uint32_t slot_count,
107.                            uint32_t slot_size)
108. {
109.     unsigned long      self_starttime = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time(getpid());
110.     uint32_t           prev;
111.     unsigned           spin;
112.     size_t             bitmap_words = uct_obmm_pool_bitmap_words(slot_count);
113.     size_t             slot_off     = uct_obmm_pool_slot_offset(slot_count);
114. 
115. retry:
116.     prev = ucs_atomic_cswap32(&hdr->state, UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT,
117.                               UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_INITING);
118. 
119.     if (prev == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT) {
120.         /* We won: zero metadata, fill geometry, publish READY */
121.         memset((char*)hdr + sizeof(*hdr), 0,
122.                bitmap_words * sizeof(uint64_t) +
123.                (size_t)slot_count * sizeof(uct_obmm_slot_meta_t));
124. 
125.         hdr->magic                 = UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC;
126.         hdr->slot_count            = slot_count;
127.         hdr->slot_size             = slot_size;
128.         hdr->slot_array_offset     = slot_off;
129.         hdr->bitmap_words          = (uint32_t)bitmap_words;
130.         hdr->initializer_pid       = (uint32_t)getpid();
131.         hdr->initializer_starttime = (uint64_t)self_starttime;
132. 
133.         ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
134.         hdr->state = UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY;
135.         return UCS_OK;
136.     }
137. 
138.     if (prev == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
139.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
140.         return UCS_OK;
141.     }
142. 
143.     /* state == INITING : wait or recover */
144.     for (spin = 0; spin < UCT_OBMM_POOL_INIT_SPIN_LIMIT; ++spin) {
145.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
146.         if (hdr->state == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
147.             return UCS_OK;
148.         }
149.         if (hdr->state == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT) {
150.             /* Some other rescuer reset; race for init */
151.             goto retry;
152.         }
153. 
154.         if ((spin & 0xfffu) == 0xfffu) {
155.             /* Periodically check if the initializer is alive. If not,
156.              * try to reset back to UNINIT so someone can re-init. */
157.             if (uct_obmm_pool_initializer_stamped(hdr) &&
158.                 !uct_obmm_proc_alive(hdr->initializer_pid,
159.                                      hdr->initializer_starttime)) {
160.                 ucs_warn("obmm: pool initializer pid=%u died; resetting "
161.                          "pool init state",
162.                          hdr->initializer_pid);
163.                 ucs_atomic_cswap32(&hdr->state, UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_INITING,
164.                                    UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT);
165.                 goto retry;
166.             }
167.         }
168.     }
169. 
170.     ucs_error("obmm: timed out waiting for pool init to complete "
171.               "(initializer pid=%u)", hdr->initializer_pid);
172.     return UCS_ERR_TIMED_OUT;
173. }
174. 
175.

```
24. - Cross-host atomic FAA/CAS on NC is supported (project-owner statement).
25. - Memory ordering uses **bus-domain fences**
26.   (`ucs_memory_bus_store_fence` / `ucs_memory_bus_load_fence`), NOT the
27.   CPU-domain `ucs_memory_cpu_*_fence` that mm uses. mm peers share an
28.   inner-shareable cache domain; obmm peers do not.
29. - Reachability is keyed on `(exporter_dcna, exporter_deid, memid)`,
30.   never memid alone.
31. - Two-phase pool init (UNINIT → INITING → READY via CAS) plus per-slot
32.   `(generation, owner_pid, owner_starttime)` for crash/PID-reuse safety.
33.   During teardown, INITING is reused only as a transient cleanup lock; after
34.   reset the shared region returns to literal all-zero memory.
35. - ARM64 is the production ISA. NC + bus fences are correct on aarch64.
```

331. int uct_obmm_pool_free_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t slot_index)
332. {
333.     volatile uint64_t    *word = &pool->bitmap[slot_index >> 6];
334.     uint64_t              bit  = 1ull << (slot_index & 63u);
335.     uct_obmm_slot_meta_t *m    = &pool->meta[slot_index];
336.     unsigned long         self_starttime;
337.     uint32_t              state_prev;
338. 
339.     /* Bump generation first so any in-flight stale messages are discarded by
340.      * a future re-using owner; mark DEAD and bus fence before clearing the
341.      * bit so a racing claimer sees the new generation. */
342.     m->generation += 1;
343.     m->state       = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_DEAD;
344.     m->owner_pid   = 0;
345.     m->owner_starttime = 0;
346.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
347. 
348.     uct_obmm_pool_clear_bit(word, bit);
349. 
350.     m->state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE;
351.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
352. 
353.     if (!uct_obmm_pool_all_slots_free(pool)) {
354.         return 0;
355.     }
356. 
357.     state_prev = ucs_atomic_cswap32(&pool->hdr->state, UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY,
358.                                     UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_INITING);
359.     if (state_prev != UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
360.         return 0;

362. 
363.     self_starttime = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time(getpid());
364.     pool->hdr->initializer_pid       = (uint32_t)getpid();
365.     pool->hdr->initializer_starttime = (uint64_t)self_starttime;
366.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
367.

369.     if (!uct_obmm_pool_all_slots_free(pool)) {
370.         ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
371.         pool->hdr->state = UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY;
372.         return 0;
373.     }

230. static int uct_obmm_pool_try_claim(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t idx,
231.                                    uint32_t self_pid, uint64_t self_starttime,
232.                                    uint32_t *generation_p)
233. {
234.     volatile uint64_t    *word    = &pool->bitmap[idx >> 6];
235.     uint64_t              bit     = 1ull << (idx & 63u);
236.     uct_obmm_slot_meta_t *m       = &pool->meta[idx];
237.     uint64_t              cur, oldval;
238.     int                   take_over;
239. 
240.     if (!uct_obmm_pool_is_ready(pool)) {
241.         return 0;
242.     }
243. 
244.     cur = *word;
245.     if (cur & bit) {
246.         /* allocated: maybe the owner is dead */
247.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
248.         if ((m->state == UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_IN_USE) &&
249.             uct_obmm_proc_alive(m->owner_pid, m->owner_starttime)) {
250.             return 0;
251.         }
252.         take_over = 1;
253.     } else {
254.         /* free: try to set the bit */
255.         oldval = ucs_atomic_cswap64(word, cur, cur | bit);
256.         if (oldval != cur) {
257.             return 0; /* lost the race; caller will retry next slot */
258.         }
259.         take_over = 0;
260.     }
261. 
262.     if (!uct_obmm_pool_is_ready(pool)) {
263.         if (!take_over) {
264.             uct_obmm_pool_clear_bit(word, bit);
265.         }
266.         return 0;
267.     }
268. 
269.     /* Bump generation so any in-flight stale messages from prior owner are
270.      * dropped by the receive path. memset slot bytes only AFTER bumping
271.      * generation, so any racing writer's bytes won't survive un-stamped. */
272.     m->generation += 1;
273.     m->owner_pid       = self_pid;
274.     m->owner_starttime = self_starttime;
275.     /* Zero the slot bytes for our use (FIFO ctl + elements). */
276.     memset(uct_obmm_pool_slot_ptr(pool, idx), 0, pool->slot_size);
277.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
278.     m->state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_IN_USE;
279.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
280.

104.  * recover the slot if the prior initializer died mid-init). */
105. static ucs_status_t
106. uct_obmm_pool_init_or_wait(uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t *hdr, uint32_t slot_count,
107.                            uint32_t slot_size)
108. {
109.     unsigned long      self_starttime = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time(getpid());
110.     uint32_t           prev;
111.     unsigned           spin;
112.     size_t             bitmap_words = uct_obmm_pool_bitmap_words(slot_count);
113.     size_t             slot_off     = uct_obmm_pool_slot_offset(slot_count);
114. 
115. retry:
116.     prev = ucs_atomic_cswap32(&hdr->state, UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT,
117.                               UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_INITING);
118. 
119.     if (prev == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT) {
120.         /* We won: zero metadata, fill geometry, publish READY */
121.         memset((char*)hdr + sizeof(*hdr), 0,
122.                bitmap_words * sizeof(uint64_t) +
123.                (size_t)slot_count * sizeof(uct_obmm_slot_meta_t));
124. 
125.         hdr->magic                 = UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC;
126.         hdr->slot_count            = slot_count;
127.         hdr->slot_size             = slot_size;
128.         hdr->slot_array_offset     = slot_off;
129.         hdr->bitmap_words          = (uint32_t)bitmap_words;
130.         hdr->initializer_pid       = (uint32_t)getpid();
131.         hdr->initializer_starttime = (uint64_t)self_starttime;
132. 
133.         ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
134.         hdr->state = UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY;
135.         return UCS_OK;
136.     }
137. 
138.     if (prev == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
139.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
140.         return UCS_OK;
141.     }
142. 
143.     /* state == INITING : wait or recover */
144.     for (spin = 0; spin < UCT_OBMM_POOL_INIT_SPIN_LIMIT; ++spin) {
145.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
146.         if (hdr->state == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
147.             return UCS_OK;
148.         }
149.         if (hdr->state == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT) {
150.             /* Some other rescuer reset; race for init */
151.             goto retry;
152.         }
153. 
154.         if ((spin & 0xfffu) == 0xfffu) {
155.             /* Periodically check if the initializer is alive. If not,
156.              * try to reset back to UNINIT so someone can re-init. */
157.             if (uct_obmm_pool_initializer_stamped(hdr) &&
158.                 !uct_obmm_proc_alive(hdr->initializer_pid,
159.                                      hdr->initializer_starttime)) {
160.                 ucs_warn("obmm: pool initializer pid=%u died; resetting "
161.                          "pool init state",
162.                          hdr->initializer_pid);
163.                 ucs_atomic_cswap32(&hdr->state, UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_INITING,
164.                                    UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT);
165.                 goto retry;
166.             }
167.         }
168.     }
169. 
170.     ucs_error("obmm: timed out waiting for pool init to complete "
171.               "(initializer pid=%u)", hdr->initializer_pid);
172.     return UCS_ERR_TIMED_OUT;
173. }

34. /* In-region pool header. Lives at offset 0 of the local export region. All
35.  * fields are written via non-cacheable mappings: state transitions must be
36.  * paired with ucs_memory_bus_store_fence so peers (potentially on another
37.  * host) see the geometry before the READY transition. During cleanup, INITING
38.  * is only a transient coordination state; once reset completes, the shared
39.  * region is fully zero again. */
40. typedef struct uct_obmm_pool_hdr {
41.     uint64_t magic;             /* UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC */
42.     uint32_t state;             /* UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_xx, atomic */
43.     uint32_t slot_count;
44.     uint32_t slot_size;
45.     uint64_t slot_array_offset; /* offset (from region base) of slot 0 */
46.     uint32_t bitmap_words;      /* number of u64 words in alloc bitmap */
47.     uint32_t initializer_pid;   /* pid that owned the INITING transition */
48.     uint64_t initializer_starttime;
49.     /* followed by:
50.      *   uint64_t alloc_bitmap[bitmap_words];
51.      *   uct_obmm_slot_meta_t slot_meta[slot_count];
52.      */
53. } uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t;
54. 
55. 
56. /* Per-slot ownership metadata. Stored adjacent to the bitmap, separate from
57.  * the slot's actual FIFO contents. */
58. typedef struct uct_obmm_slot_meta {
59.     uint32_t state;            /* UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_xx */
60.     uint32_t generation;       /* monotonically increasing; bumped on free,
61.                                   scavenge, and when readers must discard
62.                                   in-flight stale elements */
63.     uint32_t owner_pid;
64.     uint32_t reserved;
65.     uint64_t owner_starttime;  /* /proc/<pid>/stat field 22, for liveness */
66. } uct_obmm_slot_meta_t;
67.

### 💬 Copilot

Now I need to trace through the race scenario more carefully. Let me analyze the critical window between checking all slots are free and the state transition:

## Issue: Race condition between pool_free_slot and pool_alloc_slot

**File:** ucx/src/uct/obmm/base/obmm_pool.c:331-376
**Severity:** High

**Problem:** There is a race condition in `uct_obmm_pool_free_slot` between the first `uct_obmm_pool_all_slots_free()` check (line 353) and the CAS transition to INITING (line 357). If another thread allocates a slot in this window, the resetter will incorrectly gain exclusive cleanup permission and zero out the pool while the allocator is still using it.

**Race sequence:**
1. Thread A (freer): Clears bitmap bit at line 348, checks `all_slots_free()` at line 353 → returns true
2. Thread B (allocator): Sets bitmap bit in `try_claim()` line 255, but hasn't written metadata yet
3. Thread A: CAS state to INITING at line 357 → succeeds (bitmap shows allocated but state hasn't been read)
4. Thread A: Re-checks `all_slots_free()` at line 369 → returns false, aborts reset
5. BUT: Thread A already stamped `initializer_pid/starttime` (lines 364-365) and state is INITING

At this point the pool is in INITING state, blocking all future allocations (`uct_obmm_pool_is_ready()` returns false at line 240, 262, 302). Thread B's allocation succeeded but the pool is now stuck in INITING state.

**Evidence:** The sequence of operations is:
- Line 353: First check sees bitmap clear
- Line 357: CAS READY→INITING (no barrier)
- Line 364-366: Stamp initializer fields + store fence
- Line 368: Load fence
- Line 369: Re-check bitmap

Between lines 353 and 357, there is no memory barrier that would synchronize with the bitmap write at line 255 in `try_claim`. The `ucs_atomic_cswap32` at line 357 doesn't order with the bitmap word access.

**Suggested fix:** Add `ucs_memory_bus_load_fence()` before the first `uct_obmm_pool_all_slots_free()` check at line 353 to ensure visibility of recent bitmap allocations, or move the CAS to occur before checking the bitmap and then verify again afterward.

<sub>⏱️ 233m 19s</sub>

### 💬 Copilot

已经改了：**`UCT_OBMM_POOL_VERSION` / `hdr-\>version` 不再用“保留字段”顶替，那个多出来的 `reserved0` 和无用 filler 都删掉了。**

你问的两个点，结论是：

1. **“改成保留字段”**
   之前那样确实不对，只是把旧洞位换了个名字，本质还是把无用元数据留在共享区里。现在已经去掉，不再保留这个替身字段。

2. **“pool 状态回到 UNINIT 是什么意思”**
   这里原本表达得不准确。`UNINIT` 只是内部协议里的 **0 值语义**，不是说清零后还额外留了一个“状态对象”在内存里。
   
   现在的实现是：
   - cleanup 过程中，临时用 `INITING` 挡住新的 attach，避免别人撞上“清到一半”的共享区；
   - 清零完成后，最后发布的结果就是**整块 export region 全 0**；
   - 代码里最后那句 `hdr-\>state = UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT;` 实际写进去的也是 **0**，所以最终共享内存里**没有额外残留状态**，就是纯零块。

另外我顺手把相关注释也改了，避免后面再把“内部同步状态”和“最终共享内存内容”混为一谈。

````
60. **Key invariant (v2)**: every FIFO element `elem[N]` (N = `idx & mask`)
61. has a paired `desc[N]` of `seg_size` bytes in the same slot. Lifetime of
62. `desc[N]` is **identical** to lifetime of `elem[N]` — both are released
63. together when the receiver bumps tail past index N, and both are
64. overwritten together by the sender that claims index N+fifo_size.
65. 
66. This eliminates the cross-host desc free-list problem: there is no
67. separate desc allocator, no per-desc CAS, and no risk of the desc pool
68. running dry while FIFO slots remain available. The FIFO already has
69. exactly the right backpressure semantics.
70. 
71. ### Slot stride
72. 
73. ```
74. slot_stride = align_up(
75.     sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t) +
76.     fifo_size * elem_size +
77.     fifo_size * seg_size,
78.     cacheline)
79. ```
80. 
81. The pool's `slot_count` (compile-time `UCT_OBMM_POOL_SLOT_COUNT = 256`)
82. **times** `slot_stride` MUST fit in `region->length` (128 MiB minus pool
83. header overhead). Defaults are picked so that this holds; callers may
84. shrink (not grow) `seg_size` / `fifo_size` if they need more slots.
85. 
86. Default budget check:
87. ```
88. fifo_size       =     64
89. elem_size       =   2048   (max_short = 2032)
90. seg_size        =   4096   (max_bcopy = 4096)
91. ctl + slot data = 128 + 64*(2048+4096) = ~384 KiB / slot
92. slot_count      =    256
93. total           = ~ 96 MiB / 128 MiB                     ✓
94. ```
95. If a user bumps `seg_size` to 8192, total grows to ~160 MiB and pool
96. attach fails with a clear error pointing at the geometry knobs.
97. 
98. When the last local iface on an export exits, UCX resets the entire local
99. export region to zero before another attach may re-initialize the pool.
100. 
101. ---
102. 
103. ## FIFO element layout
104. 
105. `uct_obmm_fifo_element_t` (16 bytes, packed) is unchanged from v1:
106. 
107. | field      | bytes | notes                                          |
108. |------------|-------|------------------------------------------------|
109. | flags      |   1   | OWNER bit + BCOPY bit                          |
110. | am_id      |   1   |                                                |
111. | length     |   2   | u16 — payload bytes (excl. am_short hdr)       |
112. | generation |   4   | slot generation token at TX time               |
113. | header     |   8   | am_short user-visible 8B header (unused bcopy) |
114. 
115. **am_short payload** still lives inline at `elem + 1` in the FIFO area.
116. Wire format and `max_short = elem_size - 16` are unchanged.
117. 
118. **am_bcopy payload** (NEW in v2) lives in the paired `desc[N]` instead
119. of inside the FIFO element body. The element body is unused for bcopy;
120. on bcopy the sender writes:
121. - `elem->flags  = OWNER | BCOPY`
122. - `elem->am_id  = id`
123. - `elem->length = pack_cb_returned_length`     (≤ seg_size, so ≤ u16max)
124. - `elem->generation = ep->expected_generation`
125. - `elem->header = 0` (unused)
126. 
127. Receiver, on seeing FLAG_BCOPY, computes
128. `desc[N] = slot_descs + (idx & mask) * seg_size` and calls
129. `uct_iface_invoke_am(am_id, desc[N], length, 0)`.
130. 
131. Because `desc[N]` is bound 1:1 to `elem[N]`, no extra metadata is
132. exchanged in the FIFO element to locate the desc.
133. 
134. ### `length` field width
135. 
136. `elem->length` stays `uint16_t`, capping `seg_size` at 65535. We reject
137. larger `seg_size` at iface init. If a future `seg_size > 64KiB` is
138. needed, widen `length` to `uint32_t` and update the compatibility checks.
139. 
140. ---
141. 
142. ## Sender side (`obmm_ep`)
143. 
144. Both `am_short` and `am_bcopy` reserve a slot identically:
145. 
146. ```
147. 1. load head from peer_ctl->head
148. 2. if (head - cached_tail) >= fifo_size:
149.        bus_load_fence; refresh cached_tail; recheck;
150.        if still full: return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE
151. 3. claim producer lock (`peer_ctl->lock`) with a unique token, then
152.    store head → head+1, then release the lock
153. 4. compute idx = head, N = idx & mask
154. 5. payload write:
155.      short: memcpy header+payload into elem[N]+1
156.      bcopy: pack_cb(desc[N], arg) -> length
157. 6. fill elem[N] header fields (am_id, length, generation, [header])
158. 7. ucs_memory_bus_store_fence()                          <- release barrier
159. 8. elem[N]->flags = OWNER_BIT_FOR_THIS_LAP | (BCOPY if bcopy)
160. ```
161. 
162. The OWNER bit alternates each lap of the ring (see `obmm_iface.c`
163. `uct_obmm_iface_progress` for why). Since `desc[N]` writes happen
164. **before** the bus_store_fence, they become visible to the peer at the
165. same time as the published flags byte.
166. 
167. The producer lock exists because on the validated target aarch64 NC
168. environment, cross-node CAS updates memory correctly but its return value
169. is not reliable enough to use as a head-claim ownership result. The token
170. lock converts reservation into: acquire lock by readback, re-check space,
171. plain-store new head, release lock.
172. 
173. ### Pending
174. 
175. `ep_pending_add` returns `UCS_ERR_BUSY` (UCP retries via its own
176. progress loop). Real arbiter is out of scope for v1/v2 — backpressure
177. is bounded because the receiver drains continuously.
178. 
179. ---
180.
````

31.     token = iface->region->info.exporter_dcna ^
32.             iface->region->info.exporter_deid.hi ^
33.             iface->region->info.exporter_deid.lo ^
34.             ((uint64_t)iface->slot_index << 32) ^
35.             iface->generation ^
36.             (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)ep;
37.     return (token == 0) ? 1 : token;
38. }

41. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE int
42. uct_obmm_ep_try_lock_head(uct_obmm_ep_t *ep)
43. {
44.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
45.     if (ep->peer_ctl->lock != 0) {
46.         return 0;
47.     }
48. 
49.     (void)ucs_atomic_cswap64(&ep->peer_ctl->lock, 0, ep->lock_token);
50.     uct_obmm_bus_full_fence();
51.     return ep->peer_ctl->lock == ep->lock_token;
52. }
53. 
54. 
55. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void
56. uct_obmm_ep_unlock_head(uct_obmm_ep_t *ep)
57. {
58.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
59.     ep->peer_ctl->lock = 0;
60. }

66. static UCS_CLASS_INIT_FUNC(uct_obmm_ep_t, const uct_ep_params_t *params)
67. {
68.     uct_obmm_iface_t             *iface = ucs_derived_of(params->iface,
69.                                                          uct_obmm_iface_t);
70.     uct_obmm_md_t                *md    = ucs_derived_of(iface->super.md,
71.                                                          uct_obmm_md_t);
72.     const uct_obmm_device_addr_t *daddr;
73.     const uct_obmm_iface_addr_t  *iaddr;
74.     uct_obmm_region_t            *region;
75.     uct_obmm_pool_t               peer_pool;
76.     void                         *peer_slot;
77.     ucs_status_t                  status;
78. 
79.     UCT_EP_PARAMS_CHECK_DEV_IFACE_ADDRS(params);
80.     UCS_CLASS_CALL_SUPER_INIT(uct_base_ep_t, &iface->super);
81. 
82.     ucs_arbiter_group_init(&self->arb_group);
83. 
84.     daddr = (const uct_obmm_device_addr_t*)params->dev_addr;
85.     iaddr = (const uct_obmm_iface_addr_t*)params->iface_addr;
86. 
87.     /* Reject incompatible geometry. UCX wireup should already have filtered
88.      * this out via is_reachable_v2, but double-check. */
89.     if ((iaddr->fifo_size != iface->fifo_size) ||
90.         (iaddr->fifo_elem_size != iface->fifo_elem_size) ||
91.         (iaddr->bcopy_seg_size != iface->bcopy_seg_size)) {
92.         ucs_error("obmm: peer geometry (fifo=%u elem=%u seg=%u) differs from "
93.                   "local (fifo=%u elem=%u seg=%u); ep_create rejected",
94.                   iaddr->fifo_size, iaddr->fifo_elem_size,
95.                   iaddr->bcopy_seg_size,
96.                   iface->fifo_size, iface->fifo_elem_size,
97.                   iface->bcopy_seg_size);
98.         return UCS_ERR_UNREACHABLE;
99.     }
100. 
101.     /* Find the local region (export-for-self, import-for-remote) that maps
102.      * the peer's exporter coordinates. */
103.     {
104.         uct_obmm_region_t *exp_r;
105.         uct_obmm_eid_t     eid;
106. 
107.         eid.hi = daddr->exporter_deid_hi;
108.         eid.lo = daddr->exporter_deid_lo;
109. 
110.         exp_r  = uct_obmm_md_export_region(md);
111.         region = NULL;
112.         if ((exp_r != NULL) &&
113.             (exp_r->info.exporter_dcna == daddr->exporter_dcna) &&
114.             (exp_r->info.exporter_deid.hi == eid.hi) &&
115.             (exp_r->info.exporter_deid.lo == eid.lo)) {
116.             region = exp_r;
117.         } else {
118.             region = uct_obmm_md_find_import_region(md, daddr->exporter_dcna,
119.                                                     &eid);
120.         }
121.     }
122.     if (region == NULL) {
123.         ucs_error("obmm: ep_create cannot find region for peer "
124.                   "dcna=0x%lx deid=0x%lx:0x%lx",
125.                   (unsigned long)daddr->exporter_dcna,
126.                   (unsigned long)daddr->exporter_deid_hi,
127.                   (unsigned long)daddr->exporter_deid_lo);
128.         return UCS_ERR_UNREACHABLE;
129.     }
130. 
131.     status = uct_obmm_pool_open(region->base, region->length, &peer_pool);
132.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
133.         ucs_error("obmm: failed to open peer pool: %s",
134.                   ucs_status_string(status));
135.         return status;
136.     }
137. 
138.     if (iaddr->slot_index >= peer_pool.slot_count) {
139.         ucs_error("obmm: peer slot_index %u out of range (slot_count=%u)",
140.                   iaddr->slot_index, peer_pool.slot_count);
141.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
142.     }
143. 
144.     if (peer_pool.slot_size !=
145.         uct_obmm_slot_stride(iaddr->fifo_size, iaddr->fifo_elem_size,
146.                              iaddr->bcopy_seg_size)) {
147.         ucs_error("obmm: peer pool slot_size %u inconsistent with iface_addr "
148.                   "geometry (fifo=%u elem=%u seg=%u)",
149.                   peer_pool.slot_size, iaddr->fifo_size,
150.                   iaddr->fifo_elem_size, iaddr->bcopy_seg_size);
151.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
152.     }
153. 
154.     peer_slot = uct_obmm_pool_slot_ptr(&peer_pool, iaddr->slot_index);
155. 
156.     self->peer_ctl            = uct_obmm_slot_ctl(peer_slot);
157.     self->peer_elems          = uct_obmm_slot_elems(peer_slot);
158.     self->peer_descs          = uct_obmm_slot_descs(peer_slot,
159.                                                     iaddr->fifo_size,
160.                                                     iaddr->fifo_elem_size);
161.     self->cached_tail         = self->peer_ctl->tail;
162.     self->expected_generation = iaddr->generation;
163.     self->fifo_size           = iaddr->fifo_size;
164.     self->fifo_mask           = iaddr->fifo_size - 1u;
165.     self->fifo_elem_size      = iaddr->fifo_elem_size;
166.     self->bcopy_seg_size      = iaddr->bcopy_seg_size;
167.     self->peer_dcna           = daddr->exporter_dcna;
168.     self->peer_deid_hi        = daddr->exporter_deid_hi;
169.     self->peer_deid_lo        = daddr->exporter_deid_lo;
170.     self->peer_slot_index     = iaddr->slot_index;
171.     self->peer_pid            = iaddr->pid;
172.     self->lock_token          = uct_obmm_ep_make_lock_token(iface, self);
173.     return UCS_OK;
174. }

176. static UCS_CLASS_CLEANUP_FUNC(uct_obmm_ep_t)
177. {
178.     /* Drain any UCP requests still parked on this ep's arbiter group
179.      * before the iface tears down its arbiter. mm follows the same
180.      * order (mm_ep.c:217). */
181.     uct_obmm_ep_pending_purge(&self->super.super, NULL, NULL);
182.     /* Peer pool memory is owned by the MD; nothing else to release. */
183. }

191.                              const uct_ep_is_connected_params_t *params)
