215. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_ep_am_short(uct_ep_h tl_ep, uint8_t id, uint64_t header,
216.                                   const void *payload, unsigned length)
217. {
218.     uct_obmm_ep_t           *ep    = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep, uct_obmm_ep_t);
219.     uct_obmm_iface_t        *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep->iface,
220.                                                     uct_obmm_iface_t);
221.     size_t                   payload_total = sizeof(header) + length;
222.     uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem;
223.     uint64_t                 head;
224.     uint8_t                  owner_bit;
225. 
226.     UCT_CHECK_AM_ID(id);
227.     UCT_CHECK_LENGTH(payload_total, 0,
228.                      ep->fifo_elem_size - sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_element_t),
229.                      "am_short");
230. 
231.     if (uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot(ep, &head) != UCS_OK) {
232.         return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
233.     }
234. 
235.     elem = uct_obmm_slot_elem(ep->peer_elems, head, ep->fifo_mask,
236.                               ep->fifo_elem_size);
237. 
238.     elem->am_id      = id;
239.     elem->length     = (uint16_t)payload_total;
240.     elem->generation = ep->expected_generation;
241.     elem->header     = header;
242.     if (length > 0) {
243.         memcpy(elem + 1, payload, length);
244.     }
245. 
246.     /* Publish: the OWNER bit toggles each wraparound. The receiver expects
247.      * bit==1 on even passes and bit==0 on odd passes (and vice versa) so
248.      * that uninitialized memory (zero) reads as "not yet written" on the
249.      * first pass. */
250.     owner_bit = ((head / ep->fifo_size) & 1u) ? 0u : UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER;
251. 
252.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
253.     elem->flags = owner_bit;
254. 
255.     UCT_TL_EP_STAT_OP(&ep->super, AM, SHORT, payload_total);
256.     uct_iface_trace_am(&iface->super, UCT_AM_TRACE_TYPE_SEND, id,
257.                        &header, payload_total, "TX: AM_SHORT");
258.     return UCS_OK;
259. }
260.

262. /* Reserve one slot in the peer's FIFO, returning the head index that was
263.  * claimed. Multi-producer reservation is serialized with a token lock because
264.  * on target NC/aarch64 mappings, CAS updates memory but its return value is
265.  * not a reliable ownership result. */
266. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE ucs_status_t
267. uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot(uct_obmm_ep_t *ep, uint64_t *head_p)
268. {
269.     uint64_t head;
270. 
271.     if (!uct_obmm_ep_try_lock_head(ep)) {
272.         UCS_STATS_UPDATE_COUNTER(ep->super.stats, UCT_EP_STAT_NO_RES, 1);
273.         return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
274.     }
275. 
276.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
277.     head = ep->peer_ctl->head;
278. 
279.     if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
280.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
281.         ep->cached_tail = ep->peer_ctl->tail;
282.         if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
283.             UCS_STATS_UPDATE_COUNTER(ep->super.stats, UCT_EP_STAT_NO_RES, 1);
284.             uct_obmm_ep_unlock_head(ep);
285.             return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
286.         }
287.     }
288. 
289.     uct_obmm_bus_full_fence();
290.     ep->peer_ctl->head = head + 1;
291.     uct_obmm_ep_unlock_head(ep);
292. 
293.     *head_p = head;
294.     return UCS_OK;
295. }

299.                              uct_pack_callback_t pack_cb, void *arg,

302.     uct_obmm_ep_t           *ep    = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep, uct_obmm_ep_t);
303.     uct_obmm_iface_t        *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep->iface,

221. static unsigned uct_obmm_iface_progress(uct_iface_h tl_iface)
222. {
223.     uct_obmm_iface_t        *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_iface, uct_obmm_iface_t);
224.     unsigned                 polled = 0;
225.     uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem;
226.     uint8_t                  flags;
227.     uint8_t                  expected_owner;
228.     size_t                   max_poll = iface->fifo_max_poll;
229. 
230.     while (polled < max_poll) {
231.         elem = uct_obmm_slot_elem(iface->recv_elems, iface->read_index,
232.                                   iface->fifo_mask, iface->fifo_elem_size);
233. 
234.         /* Owner bit alternates each lap of the ring; pass 0 expects 1, pass
235.          * 1 expects 0, etc. Combined with zero-fill on slot allocation, this
236.          * means an unwritten slot reads as flags==0 and is correctly skipped
237.          * on the very first lap. */
238.         expected_owner = ((iface->read_index / iface->fifo_size) & 1u) ?
239.                          0u : UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER;
240. 
241.         flags = elem->flags;
242.         if ((flags & UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER) != expected_owner) {
243.             break;
244.         }
245. 
246.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
247. 
248.         if (elem->generation != iface->generation) {
249.             /* Stale write from a previous slot owner (we were torn down and
250.              * re-allocated this slot). Drop silently. */
251.             ucs_trace_data("obmm: drop stale elem (gen=%u expected=%u) "
252.                            "at idx=%lu", elem->generation, iface->generation,
253.                            (unsigned long)iface->read_index);
254.         } else if (flags & UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_BCOPY) {
255.             /* am_bcopy: payload is in the paired desc[N], not in the FIFO
256.              * element body. The bus_load_fence above orders this load
257.              * with respect to the sender's bus_store_fence + flag write. */
258.             void *desc = uct_obmm_slot_desc(iface->recv_descs,
259.                                             iface->read_index,
260.                                             iface->fifo_mask,
261.                                             iface->bcopy_seg_size);
262.             uct_iface_invoke_am(&iface->super, elem->am_id,
263.                                 desc, elem->length, 0);
264.         } else {
265.             /* am_short: contiguous [header(8B)][payload] starting at
266.              * &elem->header. elem->length already includes the 8B header. */
267.             uct_iface_invoke_am(&iface->super, elem->am_id,
268.                                 &elem->header, elem->length, 0);
269.         }
270. 
271.         iface->read_index++;
272.         polled++;
273.     }
274. 
275.     if (polled > 0) {
276.         /* Full bus fence: orders the AM handler's LOADS from desc[]/elem
277.          * payload BEFORE the STORE that publishes the new tail. A plain
278.          * bus_store_fence (e.g. dmb oshst on aarch64) only orders
279.          * store→store, which would let a sender observe the advanced
280.          * tail and overwrite desc[N] while we still have outstanding
281.          * loads in flight. See obmm_fifo.h:uct_obmm_bus_full_fence. */
282.         uct_obmm_bus_full_fence();
283.         iface->recv_ctl->tail = iface->read_index;
284.     }
285. 
286.     /* Drain any UCP requests waiting on TX backpressure. The peer-side
287.      * tail advance we just published may also have freed slots that *our*
288.      * pending eps have been waiting for; dispatch with a fresh head/tail
289.      * snapshot so retries see the latest state. Without this dispatch,
290.      * UCS_ERR_BUSY-only pending_add caused a livelock under symmetric
291.      * bidirectional load (osu_bibw at size==BCOPY_SEG_SIZE). */
292.     ucs_arbiter_dispatch(&iface->arbiter, 1, uct_obmm_ep_process_pending,
293.                          &polled);
294. 
295.     return polled;
296. }

32. /* Per-slot FIFO control header. Lives at offset 0 of every allocated slot in

35.  * value is not a reliable ownership result. Consumers read/write `tail` to
36.  * release space. Control fields are accessed via non-cacheable mappings,
37.  * therefore all updates must be paired with bus fences
38.  * (ucs_memory_bus_*_fence), not CPU fences. */
39. typedef struct uct_obmm_fifo_ctl {

41.     volatile uint64_t head;
42.     volatile uint64_t lock;
43.     UCS_CACHELINE_PADDING(uint64_t, uint64_t);
44. 
45.     /* 2nd cacheline: consumer-touched */
46.     volatile uint64_t tail;
47.     UCS_CACHELINE_PADDING(uint64_t);

180. 
181. ## Receiver side (`obmm_iface_progress`)
182. 
183. ```
184. loop up to fifo_max_poll:
185.     elem = elem[read_index & mask]
186.     expected_owner = lap_parity(read_index)
187.     if (elem->flags & OWNER) != expected_owner: break       (no work)
188.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence()                              (acquire)
189.     if elem->generation != iface->generation:
190.         drop silently (slot was reused after our death+rebirth)
191.     elif elem->flags & BCOPY:
192.         desc = desc[read_index & mask]
193.         invoke_am(am_id, desc,  length, 0)
194.     else:
195.         invoke_am(am_id, &elem->header, length, 0)
196.     read_index++
197. if any progress:
198.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence()
199.     recv_ctl->tail = read_index
200. ```
201. 
202. **Why the fence ordering is correct for bcopy too**: the
203. `ucs_memory_bus_load_fence()` issued after observing the flags byte
204. orders **all** subsequent loads in this iteration — including the
205. load of `desc[N]` performed inside the AM handler's memcpy. The handler
206. is `CB_SYNC` (synchronous), so the fence-acquire pairs with the
207. sender's `bus_store_fence` before publishing flags.
208.

354.     case UCT_MM_SEND_AM_SHORT_IOV:
355.         elem_flags   = UCT_MM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_INLINE;
356.         ucs_iov_iter_init(&iov_iter);
357.         elem->length = uct_iov_to_buffer(iov, iovcnt, &iov_iter, elem + 1,
358.                                          SIZE_MAX);
359. 
360.         uct_mm_iface_trace_am(iface, UCT_AM_TRACE_TYPE_SEND, elem_flags, am_id,
361.                               elem + 1, elem->length,
362.                               head & ~UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_HEAD_EVENT_ARMED);
363.         UCT_TL_EP_STAT_OP(&ep->super, AM, SHORT, elem->length);
364.         break;
365.     }
366. 
367.     elem->am_id = am_id;
368. 
369.     /* memory barrier - make sure that the memory is flushed before setting the
370.      * 'writing is complete' flag which the reader checks */
371.     ucs_memory_cpu_store_fence();
372. 
373.     /* set the owner bit to indicate that the writing is complete.
374.      * the owner bit flips after every FIFO wraparound */
375.     if (head & iface->config.fifo_size) {
376.         elem_flags |= UCT_MM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER;
377.     }
378.     elem->flags = elem_flags;
379. 
380.     if (ucs_unlikely(head & UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_HEAD_EVENT_ARMED)) {
381.         uct_mm_ep_signal_remote(ep);
382.     }
383. 
384.     uct_mm_ep_peer_check(ep, flags);
385. 
386.     switch (send_op) {
387.     case UCT_MM_SEND_AM_SHORT:
388.     case UCT_MM_SEND_AM_SHORT_IOV:
389.         return UCS_OK;
390.     case UCT_MM_SEND_AM_BCOPY:
391.         return length;
392.     default:
393.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
394.     }
395. }
396. 
397. ucs_status_t uct_mm_ep_am_short(uct_ep_h tl_ep, uint8_t id, uint64_t header,
398.                                 const void *payload, unsigned length)
399. {
400.     uct_mm_iface_t *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep->iface, uct_mm_iface_t);
401.     uct_mm_ep_t *ep = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep, uct_mm_ep_t);
402. 
403.     UCT_CHECK_LENGTH(length + sizeof(header), 0,
404.                      iface->config.fifo_elem_size - sizeof(uct_mm_fifo_element_t),
405.                      "am_short");
406. 
407.     return (ucs_status_t)uct_mm_ep_am_common_send(UCT_MM_SEND_AM_SHORT, ep,
408.                                                   iface, id, length, header,
409.                                                   payload, NULL, NULL, NULL, 0,
410.                                                   0);
411. }
412. 
413. ucs_status_t uct_mm_ep_am_short_iov(uct_ep_h tl_ep, uint8_t id,
414.                                     const uct_iov_t *iov, size_t iovcnt)
415. {
416.     uct_mm_iface_t *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep->iface, uct_mm_iface_t);
417.     uct_mm_ep_t *ep       = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep, uct_mm_ep_t);
418. 
419.     UCT_CHECK_LENGTH(uct_iov_total_length(iov, iovcnt), 0,
420.                      iface->config.fifo_elem_size -
421.                              sizeof(uct_mm_fifo_element_t),
422.                      "am_short_iov");
423. 
424.     return (ucs_status_t)uct_mm_ep_am_common_send(UCT_MM_SEND_AM_SHORT_IOV, ep,
425.                                                   iface, id, 0, 0, NULL, NULL,
426.                                                   NULL, iov, iovcnt, 0);
427. }
428. 
429. ssize_t uct_mm_ep_am_bcopy(uct_ep_h tl_ep, uint8_t id, uct_pack_callback_t pack_cb,
430.                            void *arg, unsigned flags)
431. {
432.     uct_mm_iface_t *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep->iface, uct_mm_iface_t);
433.     uct_mm_ep_t *ep = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep, uct_mm_ep_t);
434.

<sub>⏱️ 247m 59s</sub>

### 💬 Copilot

**有，但优势很窄，核心不是更快，而是给这套 obmm 设计补上“中等消息”路径。**

从当前实现看，`am_bcopy` 的**真实优势**主要只有这几个：

- **把 `max_bcopy` 和 `max_short` 解耦**：现在默认是 `max_short = 2032`，`max_bcopy = 4096`（`obmm_iface.c`, `DESIGN.md`）。没有 `am_bcopy`，这段区间就没法优雅覆盖。
- **给 UCP 一个标准的 medium-message AM 路径**：UCT 本身就把 `short` 定义为小消息、`bcopy` 定义为中等消息/可 pack 的消息（`ucx\docs\doxygen\design.md`）。
- **支持上层直接 `pack_cb()` 到共享区**：如果上层数据不是天然连续的，`am_bcopy` 可以直接打包到 `desc[N]`，不用先拼出一块连续本地缓冲。
- **不必把“轮询热点区”做得更胖**：当前 `desc[N]` 和 `elem[N]` 分离，`am_bcopy` 扩容的是 desc 区，不是把每个 FIFO elem 都做大；这样接收侧一直轮询的 elem 区 stride 不用跟着 `max_bcopy` 一起长。

但在**我们这套架构下，它没有这些优势**：

- **没有更好的并发/背压能力**：`am_short` 和 `am_bcopy` 走的是同一套 slot reservation、同一个 head lock、同一个 tail 回收（`obmm_ep.c`, `DESIGN.md:142-160`）。一条消息一样只占一个 FIFO 槽。
- **没有更好的接收侧拷贝语义**：两者最终都是把数据写进对端共享区，然后 `CB_SYNC` 同步回调消费；不是一个 zero-copy、一个 non-zero-copy。
- **对小消息通常不会更快**：`am_short` 只是把 `[8B header][payload]` 直接写进 elem；`am_bcopy` 还要走 `pack_cb()`，再写 desc，再带 BCOPY 分支标记。小而连续的消息，`am_short` 更直接。
- **它有固定内存代价**：当前设计里每个 FIFO elem 都配了一个 `desc[N]`，即使很多流量根本不用 `bcopy`，这块 region 预算也已经花掉了（`DESIGN.md:60-79`）。

所以结论可以说得很直接：

- **如果你的消息基本都落在 `max_short` 内，而且数据本来就是连续的，`am_bcopy` 对这套 obmm 架构几乎没有架构级优势。**
- **如果你确实有 2KB~4KB 这类中等 AM，或者上层经常需要 pack 非连续数据，那么 `am_bcopy` 还是有价值的。**

一句话概括：  
**在当前 obmm 设计里，`am_bcopy` 的价值主要是“扩能力范围、减少上层 fragmentation / pack 麻烦”，不是“数据面天然比 `am_short` 更优”。**

60. **Key invariant (v2)**: every FIFO element `elem[N]` (N = `idx & mask`)
61. has a paired `desc[N]` of `seg_size` bytes in the same slot. Lifetime of
62. `desc[N]` is **identical** to lifetime of `elem[N]` — both are released
63. together when the receiver bumps tail past index N, and both are
64. overwritten together by the sender that claims index N+fifo_size.
65. 
66. This eliminates the cross-host desc free-list problem: there is no
67. separate desc allocator, no per-desc CAS, and no risk of the desc pool
68. running dry while FIFO slots remain available. The FIFO already has
69. exactly the right backpressure semantics.
70. 
71. ### Slot stride
72. 
73. ```
74. slot_stride = align_up(
75.     sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t) +
76.     fifo_size * elem_size +
77.     fifo_size * seg_size,
78.     cacheline)
79. ```
80. 
81. The pool's `slot_count` (compile-time `UCT_OBMM_POOL_SLOT_COUNT = 256`)
82. **times** `slot_stride` MUST fit in `region->length` (128 MiB minus pool
83. header overhead). Defaults are picked so that this holds; callers may
84. shrink (not grow) `seg_size` / `fifo_size` if they need more slots.
85. 
86. Default budget check:
87. ```
88. fifo_size       =     64
89. elem_size       =   2048   (max_short = 2032)
90. seg_size        =   4096   (max_bcopy = 4096)
91. ctl + slot data = 128 + 64*(2048+4096) = ~384 KiB / slot
92. slot_count      =    256
93. total           = ~ 96 MiB / 128 MiB                     ✓
94. ```
95. If a user bumps `seg_size` to 8192, total grows to ~160 MiB and pool
96. attach fails with a clear error pointing at the geometry knobs.
97. 
98. When the last local iface on an export exits, UCX resets the entire local
99. export region to zero before another attach may re-initialize the pool.
100. 
101. ---
102. 
103. ## FIFO element layout
104. 
105. `uct_obmm_fifo_element_t` (16 bytes, packed) is unchanged from v1:
106. 
107. | field      | bytes | notes                                          |
108. |------------|-------|------------------------------------------------|
109. | flags      |   1   | OWNER bit + BCOPY bit                          |
110. | am_id      |   1   |                                                |

<sub>⏱️ 293m 28s</sub>

### 💬 Copilot

**可以，而且这是当前架构下很自然的调优方向，但不能把 `bcopy` 盲目压得太小。**

原因很直接：

- **这套设计允许你做“等预算置换”**：`slot_stride = sizeof(ctl) + fifo_size * (elem_size + seg_size)`，所以在 `FIFO_SIZE` 和 `slot_count` 不变时，**缩小 `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE`，基本就能等量放大 `FIFO_ELEM_SIZE`**。也就是：
  - `max_short = FIFO_ELEM_SIZE - 16` 变大
  - `max_bcopy = BCOPY_SEG_SIZE` 变小
- **UCP 确实会更偏向 short**：在 `packed_size \<= am.max_short` 时，UCP 会直接选 `uct_ep_am_short()`，源码里还明确写了“because it should be faster than bcopy” (`ucp\src\ucp\proto\proto_am.c:62-79`)。所以把 `max_short` 做大，确实会把更多消息推到 short。
- **但 `bcopy` 有硬下限**：
  1. 你自己的 obmm 配置注释已经写了：`BCOPY_SEG_SIZE` 大一些能**减少 UCP 中等消息 fragmentation**，压太小会反过来增加分片 (`obmm_iface.c:53-58`)。
  2. UCP 还有一个明确约束：`config-\>rndv.rkey_size \<= config-\>am.max_bcopy` (`ucp\src\ucp\core\ucp_ep.c:2879-2884`)。所以 `max_bcopy` 不能随便压到很小，不然有些协议路径会直接不成立。

所以结论是：

- **可以压缩 bcopy、放大 short**，而且这大概率会让更多流量走 short。
- 但更合理的策略是 **“温和挪预算”**，不是“把 bcopy 砍废”。
- 从性能直觉上，优先建议：
  1. **先保持 `FIFO_SIZE` 不变**
  2. **把 `FIFO_ELEM_SIZE` 往上调、`BCOPY_SEG_SIZE` 等量往下调**
  3. **不要把 `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE` 压到接近协议元数据下限**

如果只讲方向，我会建议优先尝试这种 **memory-neutral trade**：  
`2048 / 4096` → `3072 / 3072`，而不是直接把 `bcopy` 压到很小。这样既能明显抬高 short 覆盖面，又不至于马上把 medium-message 路径打残。

1. Problem: the current obmm cleanup path frees only the local slot and leaves the
2. rest of the shared export region intact. The user wants all residual shared
3. memory data cleared on exit, following commit
4. `6ff2ef6fc253d3b7c40b785159d465c5d3947ae3`.
5. 
6. Approach:
7. - Mirror only the cleanup-related parts of the reference commit that still fit
8.   the current NC-only branch:
9.   - make `uct_obmm_pool_free_slot()` report whether the caller released the
10.     final local slot and successfully acquired exclusive reset ownership
11.   - add `uct_obmm_pool_reset()` to zero the full local export region while
12.     keeping `hdr->state` in `INITING` until the rest of the pool is cleared
13.   - route iface cleanup through one shared helper so the last local iface
14.     resets the export region, while non-last ifaces still just free their slot
15. - Also mirror the reference commit's removal of persisted pool-version
16.   restrictions on this branch by turning the pool header's version word into a
17.   reserved field and dropping attach/open version checks.
18. 
19. Files:
20. - ucx\src\uct\obmm\base\obmm_region.h
21. - ucx\src\uct\obmm\base\obmm_region.c
22. - ucx\src\uct\obmm\base\obmm_iface.c
23. - ucx\src\uct\obmm\base\obmm_pool.h
24. - ucx\src\uct\obmm\base\obmm_pool.c
25. - ucx\src\uct\obmm\DESIGN.md
26. 
27. Todos:
28. - obmm-cleanup-plan
29. - obmm-cleanup-implement
30. - obmm-cleanup-review
31. 
32. Notes:
33. - Current branch is simpler than the reference commit: there is no hybrid CC
34.   state to port, so the cleanup adaptation should stay focused on the local NC
35.   export region and pool header/slot lifecycle.
36. - The last-slot reset path must be race-safe with a new attach: once cleanup
37.   wins the `READY -> INITING` transition, no new attach may observe partially
38.   zeroed pool metadata.
39. - Validation remains static only in this Windows workspace.
40. - To close the attach-vs-reset gap from review, make `pool_alloc_slot()`
41.   refuse a pool that is no longer `READY`, so a late local attach cannot claim
42.   a slot after cleanup has already switched the pool to `INITING`.
43. - Follow-up cleanup refinement:
44.   - remove the `version -> reserved0` replacement and drop other useless
45.     persistent pool-header filler fields
46.   - keep `state` and initializer ownership only as transient reset
47.     synchronization, then finish with literal all-zero shared memory
48. - Implemented:
49.   - removed persistent pool-version storage/checks from shared memory
50.   - last local iface now wins cleanup ownership and zeroes the full local
51.     export region and leaves the shared image as literal all-zero memory
52.   - `pool_alloc_slot()` now stops claiming slots once teardown has moved the
53.     pool out of `READY`
54.   - updated DESIGN.md to describe full-region zero-on-exit semantics
55. - Deliberately not added on this NC-only branch:
56.   - `uct_obmm_region_zero()`, because `uct_obmm_pool_reset()` already zeros the
57.     full local export mapping and there is no separate CC cleanup path here
58.

215. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_ep_am_short(uct_ep_h tl_ep, uint8_t id, uint64_t header,
216.                                   const void *payload, unsigned length)
217. {
218.     uct_obmm_ep_t           *ep    = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep, uct_obmm_ep_t);
219.     uct_obmm_iface_t        *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep->iface,
220.                                                     uct_obmm_iface_t);
221.     size_t                   payload_total = sizeof(header) + length;
222.     uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem;
223.     uint64_t                 head;
224.     uint8_t                  owner_bit;
225. 
226.     UCT_CHECK_AM_ID(id);
227.     UCT_CHECK_LENGTH(payload_total, 0,
228.                      ep->fifo_elem_size - sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_element_t),
229.                      "am_short");
230. 
231.     if (uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot(ep, &head) != UCS_OK) {
232.         return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
233.     }
234. 
235.     elem = uct_obmm_slot_elem(ep->peer_elems, head, ep->fifo_mask,
236.                               ep->fifo_elem_size);
237. 
238.     elem->am_id      = id;
239.     elem->length     = (uint16_t)payload_total;
240.     elem->generation = ep->expected_generation;
241.     elem->header     = header;
242.     if (length > 0) {
243.         memcpy(elem + 1, payload, length);
244.     }
245. 
246.     /* Publish: the OWNER bit toggles each wraparound. The receiver expects
247.      * bit==1 on even passes and bit==0 on odd passes (and vice versa) so
248.      * that uninitialized memory (zero) reads as "not yet written" on the
249.      * first pass. */
250.     owner_bit = ((head / ep->fifo_size) & 1u) ? 0u : UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER;
251. 
252.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
253.     elem->flags = owner_bit;
254. 
255.     UCT_TL_EP_STAT_OP(&ep->super, AM, SHORT, payload_total);
256.     uct_iface_trace_am(&iface->super, UCT_AM_TRACE_TYPE_SEND, id,
257.                        &header, payload_total, "TX: AM_SHORT");
258.     return UCS_OK;
259. }
260. 
261. 
262. /* Reserve one slot in the peer's FIFO, returning the head index that was
263.  * claimed. Multi-producer reservation is serialized with a token lock because
264.  * on target NC/aarch64 mappings, CAS updates memory but its return value is
265.  * not a reliable ownership result. */
266. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE ucs_status_t
267. uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot(uct_obmm_ep_t *ep, uint64_t *head_p)
268. {
269.     uint64_t head;
270. 
271.     if (!uct_obmm_ep_try_lock_head(ep)) {
272.         UCS_STATS_UPDATE_COUNTER(ep->super.stats, UCT_EP_STAT_NO_RES, 1);
273.         return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
274.     }
275. 
276.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
277.     head = ep->peer_ctl->head;
278. 
279.     if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
280.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
281.         ep->cached_tail = ep->peer_ctl->tail;
282.         if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
283.             UCS_STATS_UPDATE_COUNTER(ep->super.stats, UCT_EP_STAT_NO_RES, 1);
284.             uct_obmm_ep_unlock_head(ep);
285.             return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
286.         }
287.     }
288. 
289.     uct_obmm_bus_full_fence();
290.     ep->peer_ctl->head = head + 1;
291.     uct_obmm_ep_unlock_head(ep);
292. 
293.     *head_p = head;
294.     return UCS_OK;
295. }
296. 
297. 
298. ssize_t uct_obmm_ep_am_bcopy(uct_ep_h tl_ep, uint8_t id,
299.                              uct_pack_callback_t pack_cb, void *arg,
300.                              unsigned flags)
301. {
302.     uct_obmm_ep_t           *ep    = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep, uct_obmm_ep_t);
303.     uct_obmm_iface_t        *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep->iface,
304.                                                     uct_obmm_iface_t);
305.     uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem;
306.     void                    *desc;
307.     uint64_t                 head;
308.     size_t                   length;
309.     uint8_t                  owner_bit;
310.     ucs_status_t             status;
311. 
312.     /* flags (UCT_SEND_FLAG_PEER_CHECK etc.) are ignored: this transport
313.      * does not advertise EP_CHECK / keepalive in v1. */
314.     (void)flags;
315. 
316.     UCT_CHECK_AM_ID(id);
317. 
318.     status = uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot(ep, &head);
319.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
320.         return status;
321.     }
322. 
323.     elem = uct_obmm_slot_elem(ep->peer_elems, head, ep->fifo_mask,
324.                               ep->fifo_elem_size);
325.     desc = uct_obmm_slot_desc(ep->peer_descs, head, ep->fifo_mask,
326.                               ep->bcopy_seg_size);
327. 
328.     /* pack_cb writes pack_cb_ret bytes directly into the paired desc[N]
329.      * area. UCP guarantees pack_cb_ret <= cap.am.max_bcopy, which we set
330.      * to bcopy_seg_size. The asserts catch buggy direct UCT users in
331.      * debug builds; production safety relies on the iface cap contract. */
332.     length = pack_cb(desc, arg);
333.     ucs_assertv(length <= ep->bcopy_seg_size,
334.                 "obmm: pack_cb returned %zu > bcopy_seg_size=%u",
335.                 length, ep->bcopy_seg_size);
336.     ucs_assertv(length <= UINT16_MAX,
337.                 "obmm: pack_cb returned %zu > UINT16_MAX", length);
338. 
339.     elem->am_id      = id;
340.     elem->length     = (uint16_t)length;
341.     elem->generation = ep->expected_generation;
342.     elem->header     = 0; /* unused for bcopy */
343. 
344.     owner_bit = ((head / ep->fifo_size) & 1u) ? 0u :
345.                                                 UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER;
346. 
347.     /* Release barrier: orders the desc[N] payload writes AND elem header
348.      * writes BEFORE the flags publish. Receiver pairs with bus_load_fence
349.      * after observing the flags byte. */
350.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
351.     elem->flags = owner_bit | UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_BCOPY;
352. 
353.     UCT_TL_EP_STAT_OP(&ep->super, AM, BCOPY, length);
354.     uct_iface_trace_am(&iface->super, UCT_AM_TRACE_TYPE_SEND, id,
355.                        desc, length, "TX: AM_BCOPY");
356.     return (ssize_t)length;
357. }

108. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void ucp_am_release_long_desc(ucp_recv_desc_t *desc)
109. {
110.     /* Don't use UCS_PTR_BYTE_OFFSET here due to coverity false positive report.
111.      * Need to step back by release_desc_offset, where originally allocated
112.      * pointer resides. */
113.     ucs_free((char*)desc - desc->release_desc_offset);
114. }

116. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE int
117. ucp_am_rdesc_in_progress(ucp_recv_desc_t *desc, ucs_status_t am_cb_status)
118. {
119.     if (!(desc->flags & UCP_RECV_DESC_FLAG_AM_CB_INPROGRESS)) {
120.         /* Inprogress flag is cleared - it means ucp_am_recv_data_nbx operation
121.          * was initiated and already completed. Thus, no need to save this data
122.          * descriptor.
123.          */
124.         ucs_assert(desc->flags & UCP_RECV_DESC_FLAG_RECV_STARTED);
125.         return 0;
126.     } else if ((am_cb_status != UCS_INPROGRESS) &&
127.                (!(desc->flags & UCP_RECV_DESC_FLAG_RECV_STARTED))) {
128.         /* User returned UCS_OK or error (which is allowed in RNDV flow), and
129.          * did not initiate receive operation. Thus, according to API, this data
130.          * descriptor is not needed.
131.          */
132.         return 0;
133.     }
134. 
135.     return 1;
136. }

138. UCS_PROFILE_FUNC_VOID(ucp_am_data_release, (worker, data),
139.                       ucp_worker_h worker, void *data)
140. {
141.     ucp_recv_desc_t *rdesc = (ucp_recv_desc_t *)data - 1;
142. 
143.     if (ucs_unlikely(rdesc->flags & UCP_RECV_DESC_FLAG_MALLOC)) {
144.         ucp_am_release_long_desc(rdesc);
145.         return;
146.     }
147. 
148.     if (rdesc->flags & UCP_RECV_DESC_FLAG_RNDV) {
149.         if (rdesc->flags & UCP_RECV_DESC_FLAG_RECV_STARTED) {
150.             ucs_error("rndv receive is initiated on desc %p and cannot be "
151.                       "released ",
152.                       data);
153.             return;
154.         }
155. 
156.         /* This data is not needed (rndv receive was not initiated), send ATS
157.          * back to the sender to complete its send request. */
158.         ucp_am_rndv_send_ats(worker, data, UCS_OK);
159.     }
160. 
161.     UCP_WORKER_THREAD_CS_ENTER_CONDITIONAL(worker);
162.     ucp_recv_desc_release(rdesc);
163.     UCP_WORKER_THREAD_CS_EXIT_CONDITIONAL(worker);
164. }

166. static void ucp_worker_am_init_handler(ucp_worker_h worker, uint16_t id,
167.                                        void *context, unsigned flags,
168.                                        ucp_am_callback_t cb_old,
169.                                        ucp_am_recv_callback_t cb)
170. {
171.     ucp_am_entry_t *am_cb = &ucs_array_elem(&worker->am.cbs, id);
172. 
173.     am_cb->context = context;
174.     am_cb->flags   = flags;
175. 
176.     if (cb_old != NULL) {
177.         ucs_assert(cb == NULL);
178.         am_cb->cb_old = cb_old;
179.     } else {
180.         am_cb->cb     = cb;
181.     }
182. }
183. 
184. static ucs_status_t ucp_worker_set_am_handler_common(ucp_worker_h worker,
185.                                                      uint16_t id,
186.                                                      unsigned flags)
187. {
188.     static const ucp_am_entry_t empty_am_handler = {
189.         .cb      = NULL,
190.         .context = NULL,
191.         .flags   = 0
192.     };
193. 
194.     UCP_CONTEXT_CHECK_FEATURE_FLAGS(worker->context, UCP_FEATURE_AM,
195.                                     return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM);
196. 
197.     if (flags >= UCP_AM_CB_PRIV_FIRST_FLAG) {
198.         ucs_error("unsupported flags requested for UCP AM handler: 0x%x",
199.                   flags);
200.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
201.     }
202. 
203.     /* User handlers may be registered in any order, we need to resize the
204.      * lookup array only when new ID is equal or above the current length */
205.     if (id >= ucs_array_length(&worker->am.cbs)) {
206.         ucs_array_resize(&worker->am.cbs, id + 1, empty_am_handler,
207.                          return UCS_ERR_NO_MEMORY);
208.     }
209.     return UCS_OK;
210. }

215. {
216.     ucs_status_t status;
217. 
218.     UCP_WORKER_THREAD_CS_ENTER_CONDITIONAL(worker);
219.

80. 
81. The pool's `slot_count` (compile-time `UCT_OBMM_POOL_SLOT_COUNT = 256`)
82. **times** `slot_stride` MUST fit in `region->length` (128 MiB minus pool
83. header overhead). Defaults are picked so that this holds; callers may
84. shrink (not grow) `seg_size` / `fifo_size` if they need more slots.
85. 
86. Default budget check:
87. ```
88. fifo_size       =     64
89. elem_size       =   2048   (max_short = 2032)
90. seg_size        =   4096   (max_bcopy = 4096)
91. ctl + slot data = 128 + 64*(2048+4096) = ~384 KiB / slot
92. slot_count      =    256
93. total           = ~ 96 MiB / 128 MiB                     ✓
94. ```
95. If a user bumps `seg_size` to 8192, total grows to ~160 MiB and pool
96. attach fails with a clear error pointing at the geometry knobs.
97. 
98. When the last local iface on an export exits, UCX resets the entire local
99. export region to zero before another attach may re-initialize the pool.
100. 
101. ---
102. 
103. ## FIFO element layout
104. 
105. `uct_obmm_fifo_element_t` (16 bytes, packed) is unchanged from v1:
106. 
107. | field      | bytes | notes                                          |
108. |------------|-------|------------------------------------------------|
109. | flags      |   1   | OWNER bit + BCOPY bit                          |
110. | am_id      |   1   |                                                |
111. | length     |   2   | u16 — payload bytes (excl. am_short hdr)       |
112. | generation |   4   | slot generation token at TX time               |
113. | header     |   8   | am_short user-visible 8B header (unused bcopy) |
114. 
115. **am_short payload** still lives inline at `elem + 1` in the FIFO area.
116. Wire format and `max_short = elem_size - 16` are unchanged.
117. 
118. **am_bcopy payload** (NEW in v2) lives in the paired `desc[N]` instead
119. of inside the FIFO element body. The element body is unused for bcopy;
120. on bcopy the sender writes:
121. - `elem->flags  = OWNER | BCOPY`
122. - `elem->am_id  = id`
123. - `elem->length = pack_cb_returned_length`     (≤ seg_size, so ≤ u16max)
124. - `elem->generation = ep->expected_generation`
125. - `elem->header = 0` (unused)
126. 
127. Receiver, on seeing FLAG_BCOPY, computes
128. `desc[N] = slot_descs + (idx & mask) * seg_size` and calls
129. `uct_iface_invoke_am(am_id, desc[N], length, 0)`.
130.
````

240. ## Configuration knobs
241. 
242. All under `UCX_OBMM_*` prefix.
243. 
244. | knob                      | default | meaning                          |
245. |---------------------------|---------|----------------------------------|
246. | FIFO_SIZE                 |    64   | ring depth (power of 2)          |
247. | FIFO_ELEM_SIZE            |  2048   | bytes per FIFO elem (incl. 16B hdr) → max_short = 2032 |
248. | BCOPY_SEG_SIZE   (v2 NEW) |  4096   | bytes per paired desc → max_bcopy |
249. | FIFO_MAX_POLL             |    16   | RX completions per progress()     |
250. | MEMIDS        (optional)  |   ""    | comma-separated explicit shmdev memids (for example `1,2`); when set, obmm queries only these memids instead of scanning all shmdevs. Regardless of whether this knob is set, discovery is fail-fast: any discovered/requested shmdev that is missing, unusable, or yields an invalid export/import topology fails md_open |
251. 
252. Validation at iface init:
253. - `FIFO_SIZE` > 0, power of 2
254. - `FIFO_ELEM_SIZE` > sizeof(elem_hdr) and `(elem_size - hdr) <= UINT16_MAX`
255. - `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE` > 0 and `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE <= UINT16_MAX`
256. - `slot_count * slot_stride + pool_overhead <= region->length`
257. 
258. ---
259.

2435. ucp_ep_config_max_short(ucp_context_t *context, uct_iface_attr_t *iface_attr,
2436.                         uint64_t short_flag, size_t max_short, unsigned hdr_len,
2437.                         size_t zcopy_thresh,
2438.                         const ucp_rndv_thresh_t *rndv_thresh)
2439. {
2440.     ssize_t cfg_max_short;
2441. 
2442.     if (!(iface_attr->cap.flags & short_flag) ||
2443.         ucp_context_usage_tracker_enabled(context)) {
2444.         return -1;
2445.     }
2446. 
2447.     cfg_max_short = max_short - hdr_len;
2448. 
2449.     if (context->config.ext.zcopy_thresh != UCS_MEMUNITS_AUTO) {
2450.         /* Adjust max_short if zcopy_thresh is set externally */
2451.         ucp_ep_config_adjust_max_short(&cfg_max_short, zcopy_thresh);
2452.     }
2453. 
2454.     if ((rndv_thresh != NULL) &&
2455.         (context->config.ext.rndv_inter_thresh != UCS_MEMUNITS_AUTO)) {
2456.         /* Adjust max_short if rndv_inter_thresh is set externally. Note local and
2457.          * remote threshold values are the same if set externally, so can
2458.          * compare with just one of them. */
2459.         ucs_assert(rndv_thresh->remote == rndv_thresh->local);
2460.         ucp_ep_config_adjust_max_short(&cfg_max_short, rndv_thresh->remote);
2461.     }
2462. 
2463.     return cfg_max_short;
2464. }

780. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE size_t
781. ucp_am_rndv_thresh(ucp_request_t *req, const ucp_request_param_t *param,
782.                    ucp_ep_config_t *ep_config, uint32_t flags,
783.                    ssize_t *max_short)
784. {
785.     size_t rndv_rma_thresh, rndv_am_thresh;
786. 
787.     if (flags & UCP_AM_SEND_FLAG_EAGER) {
788.         return SIZE_MAX;
789.     } else if (flags & UCP_AM_SEND_FLAG_RNDV) {
790.         *max_short = -1; /* disable short, rndv is explicitly requested */
791.         return 0;
792.     } else {
793.         ucp_request_param_rndv_thresh(req, param, &ep_config->rndv.rma_thresh,
794.                                       &ep_config->rndv.am_thresh,
795.                                       &rndv_rma_thresh, &rndv_am_thresh);
796.         return ucs_min(rndv_rma_thresh, rndv_am_thresh);
797.     }
798. }
799. 
800. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE ucs_status_ptr_t
801. ucp_am_send_req(ucp_request_t *req, size_t count,
802.                 const ucp_ep_msg_config_t *msg_config,
803.                 const ucp_request_param_t *param,
804.                 const ucp_request_send_proto_t *proto, ssize_t max_short,
805.                 uint32_t flags)
806. {
807.     unsigned user_header_length = req->send.msg_proto.am.header.length;
808.     ucp_context_t *context      = req->send.ep->worker->context;
809.     ucp_ep_config_t *ep_config  = ucp_ep_config(req->send.ep);
810.     size_t rndv_thresh;
811.     size_t zcopy_thresh;
812.     ucs_status_t status;
813. 
814.     max_short   = ucp_am_get_short_max(req, max_short);
815.     rndv_thresh = ucp_am_rndv_thresh(req, param, ep_config, flags, &max_short);
816. 
817.     if ((msg_config->max_iov == 1) ||
818.         ((user_header_length + sizeof(ucp_am_first_ftr_t)) >
819.          context->config.ext.seg_size)) {
820.         /*
821.          * If user header is specified, it will be copied to the buffer taken
822.          * from pre-registered memory pool. AM footers are also copied to
823.          * this buffer. Disable zcopy protocol if pre-registered buffer does not
824.          * fit AM footers and/or user header.
825.          */
826.         zcopy_thresh = rndv_thresh;
827.     } else {
828.         zcopy_thresh = ucp_proto_get_zcopy_threshold(req, msg_config, count,
829.                                                      rndv_thresh);
830.     }

215. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_ep_am_short(uct_ep_h tl_ep, uint8_t id, uint64_t header,
216.                                   const void *payload, unsigned length)
217. {
218.     uct_obmm_ep_t           *ep    = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep, uct_obmm_ep_t);
219.     uct_obmm_iface_t        *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep->iface,
220.                                                     uct_obmm_iface_t);
221.     size_t                   payload_total = sizeof(header) + length;
222.     uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem;
223.     uint64_t                 head;
224.     uint8_t                  owner_bit;
225. 
226.     UCT_CHECK_AM_ID(id);
227.     UCT_CHECK_LENGTH(payload_total, 0,
228.                      ep->fifo_elem_size - sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_element_t),
229.                      "am_short");
230. 
231.     if (uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot(ep, &head) != UCS_OK) {
232.         return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
233.     }
234. 
235.     elem = uct_obmm_slot_elem(ep->peer_elems, head, ep->fifo_mask,
236.                               ep->fifo_elem_size);
237. 
238.     elem->am_id      = id;
239.     elem->length     = (uint16_t)payload_total;
240.     elem->generation = ep->expected_generation;
241.     elem->header     = header;
242.     if (length > 0) {
243.         memcpy(elem + 1, payload, length);
244.     }
245. 
246.     /* Publish: the OWNER bit toggles each wraparound. The receiver expects
247.      * bit==1 on even passes and bit==0 on odd passes (and vice versa) so
248.      * that uninitialized memory (zero) reads as "not yet written" on the
249.      * first pass. */
250.     owner_bit = ((head / ep->fifo_size) & 1u) ? 0u : UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER;
251. 
252.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
253.     elem->flags = owner_bit;
254. 
255.     UCT_TL_EP_STAT_OP(&ep->super, AM, SHORT, payload_total);
256.     uct_iface_trace_am(&iface->super, UCT_AM_TRACE_TYPE_SEND, id,
257.                        &header, payload_total, "TX: AM_SHORT");
258.     return UCS_OK;
259. }
260. 
261. 
262. /* Reserve one slot in the peer's FIFO, returning the head index that was
263.  * claimed. Multi-producer reservation is serialized with a token lock because
264.  * on target NC/aarch64 mappings, CAS updates memory but its return value is
265.  * not a reliable ownership result. */
266. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE ucs_status_t
267. uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot(uct_obmm_ep_t *ep, uint64_t *head_p)
268. {
269.     uint64_t head;
270. 
271.     if (!uct_obmm_ep_try_lock_head(ep)) {
272.         UCS_STATS_UPDATE_COUNTER(ep->super.stats, UCT_EP_STAT_NO_RES, 1);
273.         return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
274.     }
275. 
276.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
277.     head = ep->peer_ctl->head;
278. 
279.     if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
280.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
281.         ep->cached_tail = ep->peer_ctl->tail;
282.         if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
283.             UCS_STATS_UPDATE_COUNTER(ep->super.stats, UCT_EP_STAT_NO_RES, 1);
284.             uct_obmm_ep_unlock_head(ep);
285.             return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
286.         }
287.     }
288. 
289.     uct_obmm_bus_full_fence();
290.     ep->peer_ctl->head = head + 1;
291.     uct_obmm_ep_unlock_head(ep);
292. 
293.     *head_p = head;
294.     return UCS_OK;
295. }
296.

298. ssize_t uct_obmm_ep_am_bcopy(uct_ep_h tl_ep, uint8_t id,
299.                              uct_pack_callback_t pack_cb, void *arg,
300.                              unsigned flags)
301. {
302.     uct_obmm_ep_t           *ep    = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep, uct_obmm_ep_t);
303.     uct_obmm_iface_t        *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep->iface,
304.                                                     uct_obmm_iface_t);
305.     uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem;
306.     void                    *desc;
307.     uint64_t                 head;
308.     size_t                   length;
309.     uint8_t                  owner_bit;
310.     ucs_status_t             status;
311. 
312.     /* flags (UCT_SEND_FLAG_PEER_CHECK etc.) are ignored: this transport
313.      * does not advertise EP_CHECK / keepalive in v1. */
314.     (void)flags;
315. 
316.     UCT_CHECK_AM_ID(id);
317. 
318.     status = uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot(ep, &head);
319.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
320.         return status;
321.     }
322. 
323.     elem = uct_obmm_slot_elem(ep->peer_elems, head, ep->fifo_mask,
324.                               ep->fifo_elem_size);
325.     desc = uct_obmm_slot_desc(ep->peer_descs, head, ep->fifo_mask,
326.                               ep->bcopy_seg_size);
327. 
328.     /* pack_cb writes pack_cb_ret bytes directly into the paired desc[N]
329.      * area. UCP guarantees pack_cb_ret <= cap.am.max_bcopy, which we set
330.      * to bcopy_seg_size. The asserts catch buggy direct UCT users in

### 💬 Copilot

1. Broadly yes—for MPI/tag. `cap.am.max_short = elem-16`, UCP then subtracts 8B, so 2048B is just over today’s effective short limit; keeping `elem+seg=6144` keeps slot stride/budget unchanged.

2. No UCX correctness red flag. Caveats: generic UCP AM still has a separate 1200B stack-pack gate, `UCX_*THRESH` can clamp short, mixed peers must match geometry, and `max_bcopy=3072` likely just moves the next cliff down.

3. I’d prefer a smaller constant-footprint bump: `FIFO_ELEM_SIZE` just above 2072 (e.g. 2176) and `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE` 3968. If extra memory is acceptable, 3072/4096 is better than 3072/3072.

1. # obmm UCT transport — design notes
2. 
3. This file is the **single source of truth** for the on-region wire format
4. and the data-path semantics of the `obmm` UCT transport. Update it
5. **before** changing layout, capabilities, or sync rules. AGENTS.md
6. mandates retrieve-before-recall; this doc is the first thing to grep.
7. 
8. Status legend:
9. - **v1** = shipped, MPI cross-node smoke tests pass.
10. - **v2** = current target: complete `am_bcopy` (max_bcopy decoupled from
11.   FIFO element size, no per-message UCP fragmentation below seg_size).
12. 
13. ---
14. 
15. ## Locked-in environment facts
16. 
17. (Mirrors `.github/skills/obmm-api-and-env/SKILL.md`. Do NOT contradict
18. without re-checking that file.)
19. 
20. - Each node pre-exports **one 128 MiB region**; export/import is done
21.   outside UCX. UCT must NOT call `obmm_export/import/preimport/...`.
22. - Data-path mapping is **non-cacheable** (`open(... O_SYNC)` + mmap).
23.   `obmm_set_ownership` is forbidden and irrelevant.
24. - Cross-host atomic FAA/CAS on NC is supported (project-owner statement).
25. - Memory ordering uses **bus-domain fences**
26.   (`ucs_memory_bus_store_fence` / `ucs_memory_bus_load_fence`), NOT the
27.   CPU-domain `ucs_memory_cpu_*_fence` that mm uses. mm peers share an
28.   inner-shareable cache domain; obmm peers do not.
29. - Reachability is keyed on `(exporter_dcna, exporter_deid, memid)`,
30.   never memid alone.
```

</details>

240. ## Configuration knobs
241. 
242. All under `UCX_OBMM_*` prefix.
243. 
244. | knob                      | default | meaning                          |
245. |---------------------------|---------|----------------------------------|
246. | FIFO_SIZE                 |    64   | ring depth (power of 2)          |
247. | FIFO_ELEM_SIZE            |  2048   | bytes per FIFO elem (incl. 16B hdr) → max_short = 2032 |
248. | BCOPY_SEG_SIZE   (v2 NEW) |  4096   | bytes per paired desc → max_bcopy |
249. | FIFO_MAX_POLL             |    16   | RX completions per progress()     |
250. | MEMIDS        (optional)  |   ""    | comma-separated explicit shmdev memids (for example `1,2`); when set, obmm queries only these memids instead of scanning all shmdevs. Regardless of whether this knob is set, discovery is fail-fast: any discovered/requested shmdev that is missing, unusable, or yields an invalid export/import topology fails md_open |
251. 
252. Validation at iface init:
253. - `FIFO_SIZE` > 0, power of 2
254. - `FIFO_ELEM_SIZE` > sizeof(elem_hdr) and `(elem_size - hdr) <= UINT16_MAX`
255. - `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE` > 0 and `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE <= UINT16_MAX`

8.   the current NC-only branch:
9.   - make `uct_obmm_pool_free_slot()` report whether the caller released the
10.     final local slot and successfully acquired exclusive reset ownership
11.   - add `uct_obmm_pool_reset()` to zero the full local export region while
12.     keeping `hdr->state` in `INITING` until the rest of the pool is cleared
13.   - route iface cleanup through one shared helper so the last local iface
14.     resets the export region, while non-last ifaces still just free their slot
15. - Also mirror the reference commit's removal of persisted pool-version
16.   restrictions on this branch by turning the pool header's version word into a

35.   export region and pool header/slot lifecycle.

38.   zeroed pool metadata.

33.  * the obmm pool. Producers serialize `head` reservation with a token lock:
34.  * on target aarch64 NC mappings, cross-node CAS updates memory but its return
35.  * value is not a reliable ownership result. Consumers read/write `tail` to
36.  * release space. Control fields are accessed via non-cacheable mappings,
37.  * therefore all updates must be paired with bus fences
38.  * (ucs_memory_bus_*_fence), not CPU fences. */

115. | generation |   4   | slot generation token at TX time               |
116. | header     |   8   | am_short user-visible 8B header (unused bcopy) |
117. 
118. **am_short payload** still lives inline at `elem + 1` in the FIFO area.
119. Wire format and `max_short = elem_size - 16` are unchanged.
120. 
121. **am_bcopy payload** (NEW in v2) lives in the paired `desc[N]` instead
122. of inside the FIFO element body. The element body is unused for bcopy;
123. on bcopy the sender writes:
124. - `elem->flags  = OWNER | BCOPY`
125. - `elem->am_id  = id`
126. - `elem->length = pack_cb_returned_length`     (≤ seg_size, so ≤ u16max)
127. - `elem->generation = ep->expected_generation`
128. - `elem->header = 0` (unused)
129. 
130. Receiver, on seeing FLAG_BCOPY, computes
131. `desc[N] = slot_descs + (idx & mask) * seg_size` and calls
132. `uct_iface_invoke_am(am_id, desc[N], length, 0)`.
133. 
134. Because `desc[N]` is bound 1:1 to `elem[N]`, no extra metadata is
135. exchanged in the FIFO element to locate the desc.
```

26. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE uint64_t
27. uct_obmm_ep_make_lock_token(uct_obmm_iface_t *iface, const uct_obmm_ep_t *ep)
28. {
29.     uint64_t token;
30. 
31.     token = iface->region->info.exporter_dcna ^
32.             iface->region->info.exporter_deid.hi ^
33.             iface->region->info.exporter_deid.lo ^
34.             ((uint64_t)iface->slot_index << 32) ^
35.             iface->generation ^
36.             (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)ep;
37.     return (token == 0) ? 1 : token;
38. }
39. 
40. 
41. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE int
42. uct_obmm_ep_try_lock_head(uct_obmm_ep_t *ep)
43. {
44.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
45.     if (ep->peer_ctl->lock != 0) {
46.         return 0;
47.     }
48. 
49.     (void)ucs_atomic_cswap64(&ep->peer_ctl->lock, 0, ep->lock_token);
50.     uct_obmm_bus_full_fence();
51.     return ep->peer_ctl->lock == ep->lock_token;
52. }
53. 
54. 
55. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void
56. uct_obmm_ep_unlock_head(uct_obmm_ep_t *ep)
57. {
58.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
59.     ep->peer_ctl->lock = 0;
60. }

215. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_ep_am_short(uct_ep_h tl_ep, uint8_t id, uint64_t header,
216.                                   const void *payload, unsigned length)
217. {
218.     uct_obmm_ep_t           *ep    = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep, uct_obmm_ep_t);
219.     uct_obmm_iface_t        *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep->iface,
220.                                                     uct_obmm_iface_t);
221.     size_t                   payload_total = sizeof(header) + length;
222.     uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem;
223.     uint64_t                 head;
224.     uint8_t                  owner_bit;
225. 
226.     UCT_CHECK_AM_ID(id);
227.     UCT_CHECK_LENGTH(payload_total, 0,
228.                      ep->fifo_elem_size - sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_element_t),
229.                      "am_short");
230. 
231.     if (uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot(ep, &head) != UCS_OK) {
232.         return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
233.     }
234. 
235.     elem = uct_obmm_slot_elem(ep->peer_elems, head, ep->fifo_mask,
236.                               ep->fifo_elem_size);
237. 
238.     elem->am_id      = id;
239.     elem->length     = (uint16_t)payload_total;
240.     elem->generation = ep->expected_generation;
241.     elem->header     = header;
242.     if (length > 0) {
243.         memcpy(elem + 1, payload, length);
244.     }
245. 
246.     /* Publish: the OWNER bit toggles each wraparound. The receiver expects
247.      * bit==1 on even passes and bit==0 on odd passes (and vice versa) so
248.      * that uninitialized memory (zero) reads as "not yet written" on the
249.      * first pass. */
250.     owner_bit = ((head / ep->fifo_size) & 1u) ? 0u : UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER;
251. 
252.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
253.     elem->flags = owner_bit;
254. 
255.     UCT_TL_EP_STAT_OP(&ep->super, AM, SHORT, payload_total);
256.     uct_iface_trace_am(&iface->super, UCT_AM_TRACE_TYPE_SEND, id,
257.                        &header, payload_total, "TX: AM_SHORT");
258.     return UCS_OK;
259. }

261. 
262. /* Reserve one slot in the peer's FIFO, returning the head index that was
263.  * claimed. Multi-producer reservation is serialized with a token lock because
264.  * on target NC/aarch64 mappings, CAS updates memory but its return value is
265.  * not a reliable ownership result. */
266. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE ucs_status_t
267. uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot(uct_obmm_ep_t *ep, uint64_t *head_p)
268. {
269.     uint64_t head;
270. 
271.     if (!uct_obmm_ep_try_lock_head(ep)) {
272.         UCS_STATS_UPDATE_COUNTER(ep->super.stats, UCT_EP_STAT_NO_RES, 1);
273.         return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
274.     }
275. 
276.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
277.     head = ep->peer_ctl->head;
278. 
279.     if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
280.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
281.         ep->cached_tail = ep->peer_ctl->tail;
282.         if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
283.             UCS_STATS_UPDATE_COUNTER(ep->super.stats, UCT_EP_STAT_NO_RES, 1);
284.             uct_obmm_ep_unlock_head(ep);
285.             return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
286.         }
287.     }
288. 
289.     uct_obmm_bus_full_fence();
290.     ep->peer_ctl->head = head + 1;
291.     uct_obmm_ep_unlock_head(ep);
292. 
293.     *head_p = head;
294.     return UCS_OK;
295. }
296. 
297. 
298. ssize_t uct_obmm_ep_am_bcopy(uct_ep_h tl_ep, uint8_t id,
299.                              uct_pack_callback_t pack_cb, void *arg,
300.                              unsigned flags)
301. {
302.     uct_obmm_ep_t           *ep    = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep, uct_obmm_ep_t);
303.     uct_obmm_iface_t        *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep->iface,
304.                                                     uct_obmm_iface_t);
305.     uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem;
306.     void                    *desc;
307.     uint64_t                 head;
308.     size_t                   length;
309.     uint8_t                  owner_bit;
310.     ucs_status_t             status;
311. 
312.     /* flags (UCT_SEND_FLAG_PEER_CHECK etc.) are ignored: this transport
313.      * does not advertise EP_CHECK / keepalive in v1. */
314.     (void)flags;
315. 
316.     UCT_CHECK_AM_ID(id);
317. 
318.     status = uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot(ep, &head);
319.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
320.         return status;
321.     }
322. 
323.     elem = uct_obmm_slot_elem(ep->peer_elems, head, ep->fifo_mask,
324.                               ep->fifo_elem_size);
325.     desc = uct_obmm_slot_desc(ep->peer_descs, head, ep->fifo_mask,
326.                               ep->bcopy_seg_size);
327. 
328.     /* pack_cb writes pack_cb_ret bytes directly into the paired desc[N]
329.      * area. UCP guarantees pack_cb_ret <= cap.am.max_bcopy, which we set
330.      * to bcopy_seg_size. The asserts catch buggy direct UCT users in
331.      * debug builds; production safety relies on the iface cap contract. */
332.     length = pack_cb(desc, arg);
333.     ucs_assertv(length <= ep->bcopy_seg_size,
334.                 "obmm: pack_cb returned %zu > bcopy_seg_size=%u",
335.                 length, ep->bcopy_seg_size);
336.     ucs_assertv(length <= UINT16_MAX,
337.                 "obmm: pack_cb returned %zu > UINT16_MAX", length);
338. 
339.     elem->am_id      = id;
340.     elem->length     = (uint16_t)length;
341.     elem->generation = ep->expected_generation;
342.     elem->header     = 0; /* unused for bcopy */
343. 
344.     owner_bit = ((head / ep->fifo_size) & 1u) ? 0u :
345.                                                 UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER;
346. 
347.     /* Release barrier: orders the desc[N] payload writes AND elem header
348.      * writes BEFORE the flags publish. Receiver pairs with bus_load_fence
349.      * after observing the flags byte. */
350.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
351.     elem->flags = owner_bit | UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_BCOPY;
352. 
353.     UCT_TL_EP_STAT_OP(&ep->super, AM, BCOPY, length);
354.     uct_iface_trace_am(&iface->super, UCT_AM_TRACE_TYPE_SEND, id,
355.                        desc, length, "TX: AM_BCOPY");
356.     return (ssize_t)length;
357. }
358.

361.  * cached_tail (with a bus_load_fence pair) before declaring "full". Mirrors
362.  * the resource check used by mm in pending_add. */
363. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE int
364. uct_obmm_ep_has_tx_resource(uct_obmm_ep_t *ep)
365. {
366.     uint64_t head = ep->peer_ctl->head;
367. 
368.     if ((head - ep->cached_tail) < ep->fifo_size) {
369.         return 1;

67.  * fifo_size * bcopy_seg_size, cacheline aligned so that adjacent slots
68.  * don't share a line. Returned as size_t; callers must validate the

**Verification summary:**

  - Old: 128 + 64×(2048+4096) = 393,344

  - New max_short = 2096 → 2048-byte payload + 8-byte header = 2056 bytes **fits**

✓ **Runtime validation confirmed:** Code uses `ep-\>fifo_elem_size` and `ep-\>bcopy_seg_size` throughout (lines 228, 326, 333), not hardcoded constants

✓ **Documentation consistent:** DESIGN.md and obmm_iface.c agree on all values (2112/4032)

✓ **No stale references:** No hardcoded occurrences of old max_short (2032) found in codebase

The tradeoff is max_bcopy shrinking from 4096 to 4032 (64 bytes), which the documentation explicitly acknowledges as intentional to optimize for common 2KB payloads.

<sub>⏱️ 308m 8s</sub>

### 💬 Copilot

**结论先说：这更像是协议边界导致的性能 cliff，不像数据面 bug。**  
当前默认值下，`2048B` 恰好掉出 short、落到 bcopy；而 `4096B` 又很可能继续掉到下一层协议区间，所以你看到 **1024→2048 变慢、4096 又回落**。

我已经做了一个**最小、定向的优化**，只改默认参数，不改数据路径逻辑：

- `FIFO_ELEM_SIZE: 2048 -\> 2112`
- `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE: 4096 -\> 4032`

这样做的效果是：

- `max_short: 2032 -\> 2096`
- 对 UCP/tag 来说，`2048B payload + 8B header = 2056B`
  - **旧默认值下放不进 short**
  - **新默认值下能继续走 short**
- 同时 `FIFO_ELEM_SIZE + BCOPY_SEG_SIZE` 仍然保持 `6144`
  - 所以 **每个 slot 的 footprint 不变**
  - 整体 pool 内存预算不变

为什么我判断问题在这里：

- `obmm` 当前上报 `cap.am.max_short = fifo_elem_size - 16`，旧值就是 `2032`。
- UCP 在选 short 时还会再扣掉自己的 AM 头（代码在 `ucp_ep.c` / `proto_am.c`）。
- 所以 `2048B` 恰好越界，从 `am_short` 切到 `am_bcopy`。
- 而 `am_bcopy` 在我们这套 NC 共享内存架构里，本来就比 short 更重：要 `pack_cb(desc[N])`，不是简单 inline 写 elem。
- `4096B` 再往上时，UCP 很可能又切到另一个区间（multi-bcopy 或 rndv），所以曲线会再次变化。

这次改动的意义就是：  
**先把最明显的 2048 cliff 消掉，而且不扩大总内存占用。**

改到的文件：
- `ucx\src\uct\obmm\base\obmm_iface.c`
- `ucx\src\uct\obmm\DESIGN.md`

如果后面你在硬件上复测：
- 重点看 `1024 / 2048 / 4096`
- 我预期 **2048 的时延应该明显更接近 1024**
- `4096` 是否还跳，要看它在 UCP 上层是否已经进入下一协议区间，这次改动不保证把 4096 也抹平，但至少把最不自然的 **2048 cliff** 先处理掉了。

1. #!/usr/bin/env python3

20.     "ucx_code": [

46.

48. def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
49.     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
50.         description="Query the local Chroma DB without relying on a mismatched embedding model."
51.     )
52.     parser.add_argument("query", help="Symbol, API, concept, or phrase to retrieve.")
53.     parser.add_argument(
54.         "--collection",
55.         action="append",
56.         choices=COLLECTIONS,
57.         dest="collections",
58.         help="Collection(s) to search. Defaults to all collections.",
59.     )
60.     parser.add_argument(
61.         "--k",
62.         type=int,
63.         default=8,
64.         help="Number of final ranked hits to return per collection.",
65.     )
66.     parser.add_argument(
67.         "--candidate-multiplier",
68.         type=int,
69.         default=4,
70.         help="Fetch this many multiples of k before reranking.",
71.     )
72.     parser.add_argument(
73.         "--path-hint",
74.         action="append",
75.         default=[],
76.         help="Prefer paths containing this substring. Repeatable.",
77.     )
78.     parser.add_argument(
79.         "--json",
80.         action="store_true",
81.         help="Emit machine-readable JSON.",
82.     )
83.     return parser.parse_args()
84. 
85. 
86. def tokenize(query: str) -> list[str]:
87.     return re.findall(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*|\d+", query)
88. 
89. 
90. def build_match_expressions(query: str) -> list[str]:
91.     raw = query.strip()
92.     if not raw:
93.         return []
94. 
95.     expressions: list[str] = []
96.     escaped = raw.replace('"', '""')
97. 
98.     if len(raw.split()) == 1 or "_" in raw or "/" in raw:
99.         expressions.append(f'"{escaped}"')
100. 
101.     tokens = tokenize(raw)
102.     if tokens:
103.         expressions.append(" AND ".join(f'"{token.replace(chr(34), chr(34) * 2)}"' for token in tokens))
104.         if len(tokens) > 1:
105.             expressions.append(" OR ".join(f'"{token.replace(chr(34), chr(34) * 2)}"' for token in tokens))
106. 
107.     if f'"{escaped}"' not in expressions:
108.         expressions.append(f'"{escaped}"')
109. 
110.     deduped: list[str] = []
111.     for expr in expressions:
112.         if expr not in deduped:
113.             deduped.append(expr)
114.     return deduped
115. 
116. 
117. def clean_snippet(document: str, limit: int = 220) -> str:
118.     lines = document.splitlines()
119.     if lines[:3] and lines[0].startswith("path: ") and any(line.startswith("root: ") for line in lines[:4]):
120.         body_start = 0
121.         blank_seen = False
122.         for i, line in enumerate(lines):
123.             if line.strip():
124.                 if blank_seen:
125.                     body_start = i
126.                     break
127.             else:
128.                 blank_seen = True
129.         body = "\n".join(lines[body_start:]).strip()
130.     else:
131.         body = document.strip()
132.     body = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", body)
133.     return body[:limit]
134. 
135. 
136. def path_bias(collection: str, path: str) -> float:
137.     for prefix, bias in PATH_BIAS_RULES.get(collection, []):
138.         if path.startswith(prefix):
139.             return bias
140.     return 0.0
141. 
142. 
143. def hint_bias(path: str, hints: Iterable[str]) -> float:
144.     path_lower = path.lower()
145.     bias = 0.0
146.     for hint in hints:
147.         if hint.lower() in path_lower:
148.             bias -= 1.5
149.     return bias
150. 
151. 
152. def exact_bias(query: str, path: str, document: str) -> float:
153.     lowered = query.lower()
154.     bias = 0.0
155.     if lowered in path.lower():
156.         bias -= 1.0
157.     if lowered in document.lower():
158.         bias -= 1.5
159.     return bias
160. 
161. 
162. def fetch_candidates(
163.     con: sqlite3.Connection,
164.     collection: str,
165.     query: str,
166.     limit: int,
167. ) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
168.     results: dict[tuple[str, int, int], dict[str, object]] = {}
169.     expressions = build_match_expressions(query)
170.     if not expressions:
171.         return []
172. 
173.     sql = """
174.         select bm25(embedding_fulltext_search) as bm25_score,
175.                p.string_value as path,
176.                s.int_value as start_line,
177.                e.int_value as end_line,
178.                d.string_value as document
179.         from embedding_fulltext_search
180.         join embeddings emb on emb.id = embedding_fulltext_search.rowid
181.         join segments seg on seg.id = emb.segment_id and seg.scope = 'METADATA'
182.         join collections c on c.id = seg.collection
183.         join embedding_metadata d on d.id = emb.id and d.key = 'chroma:document'
184.         join embedding_metadata p on p.id = emb.id and p.key = 'path'
185.         join embedding_metadata s on s.id = emb.id and s.key = 'start_line'
186.         join embedding_metadata e on e.id = emb.id and e.key = 'end_line'
187.         where c.name = ? and embedding_fulltext_search match ?
188.         order by bm25_score
189.         limit ?
190.     """
191. 
192.     for expr in expressions:
193.         for row in con.execute(sql, (collection, expr, limit)):
194.             key = (row["path"], row["start_line"], row["end_line"])
195.             candidate = {
196.                 "collection": collection,
197.                 "path": row["path"],
198.                 "start_line": row["start_line"],
199.                 "end_line": row["end_line"],
200.                 "document": row["document"],
201.                 "bm25": float(row["bm25_score"]),
202.                 "match_expression": expr,
203.             }
204.             prev = results.get(key)
205.             if prev is None or candidate["bm25"] < prev["bm25"]:
206.                 results[key] = candidate
207.     return list(results.values())
208. 
209. 
210. def rerank(candidates: list[dict[str, object]], query: str, hints: list[str]) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
211.     reranked = []
212.     for item in candidates:
213.         doc = str(item["document"])
214.         path = str(item["path"])
215.         collection = str(item["collection"])
216.         adjusted = (
217.             float(item["bm25"])
218.             + path_bias(collection, path)
219.             + hint_bias(path, hints)
220.             + exact_bias(query, path, doc)
```

161. static int
162. uct_obmm_iface_is_reachable_v2(const uct_iface_h tl_iface,
163.                                const uct_iface_is_reachable_params_t *params)
164. {
165.     uct_obmm_iface_t             *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_iface,
166.                                                          uct_obmm_iface_t);
167.     uct_obmm_md_t                *md    = ucs_derived_of(iface->super.md,
168.                                                          uct_obmm_md_t);
169.     const uct_obmm_device_addr_t *daddr;
170.     const uct_obmm_iface_addr_t  *iaddr;
171.     uct_obmm_eid_t                eid;
172.     uct_obmm_region_t            *export_r;
173. 
174.     if (!uct_iface_is_reachable_params_addrs_valid(params)) {
175.         return 0;
176.     }
177. 
178.     daddr = (const uct_obmm_device_addr_t*)params->device_addr;
179.     iaddr = (const uct_obmm_iface_addr_t*)params->iface_addr;
180.     if ((daddr == NULL) || (iaddr == NULL)) {
181.         uct_iface_fill_info_str_buf(params, "missing device or iface address");
182.         return 0;
183.     }
184. 
185.     if ((iaddr->fifo_size != iface->fifo_size) ||
186.         (iaddr->fifo_elem_size != iface->fifo_elem_size) ||
187.         (iaddr->bcopy_seg_size != iface->bcopy_seg_size)) {
188.         uct_iface_fill_info_str_buf(params,
189.                                     "incompatible OBMM geometry "
190.                                     "(peer fifo=%u elem=%u seg=%u, "
191.                                     "local fifo=%u elem=%u seg=%u)",
192.                                     iaddr->fifo_size, iaddr->fifo_elem_size,
193.                                     iaddr->bcopy_seg_size,
194.                                     iface->fifo_size, iface->fifo_elem_size,
195.                                     iface->bcopy_seg_size);
196.         return 0;
197.     }
198. 
199.     eid.hi = daddr->exporter_deid_hi;
200.     eid.lo = daddr->exporter_deid_lo;
201. 
202.     export_r = uct_obmm_md_export_region(md);
203.     if ((export_r != NULL) &&
204.         (export_r->info.exporter_dcna == daddr->exporter_dcna) &&
205.         (export_r->info.exporter_deid.hi == eid.hi) &&
206.         (export_r->info.exporter_deid.lo == eid.lo)) {
207.         return uct_iface_scope_is_reachable(tl_iface, params);
208.     }
209. 
210.     if (uct_obmm_md_find_import_region(md, daddr->exporter_dcna, &eid) != NULL) {
211.         return uct_iface_scope_is_reachable(tl_iface, params);
212.     }
213. 
214.     uct_iface_fill_info_str_buf(params,
215.                                 "no mapped region for peer dcna=0x%lx "
216.                                 "deid=0x%lx:0x%lx",
217.                                 (unsigned long)daddr->exporter_dcna,
218.                                 (unsigned long)eid.hi, (unsigned long)eid.lo);
219.     return 0;
220. }

80. 
81. The pool's `slot_count` (compile-time `UCT_OBMM_POOL_SLOT_COUNT = 256`)
82. **times** `slot_stride` MUST fit in `region->length` (128 MiB minus pool
83. header overhead). Defaults are picked so that this holds; callers may
84. shrink (not grow) `seg_size` / `fifo_size` if they need more slots.
85. 
86. Default budget check:
87. ```
88. fifo_size       =     64
89. elem_size       =   2112   (max_short = 2096)
90. seg_size        =   4032   (max_bcopy = 4032)
91. ctl + slot data = 128 + 64*(2112+4032) = ~384 KiB / slot
92. slot_count      =    256
93. total           = ~ 96 MiB / 128 MiB                     ✓
94. ```
95. These defaults keep the slot footprint unchanged while moving the effective
96. UCP eager-short boundary above common 2048-byte payloads.
97. 
98. If a user bumps `seg_size` to 8192, total grows to ~160 MiB and pool
99. attach fails with a clear error pointing at the geometry knobs.
100. 
101. When the last local iface on an export exits, UCX resets the entire local
102. export region to zero before another attach may re-initialize the pool.
103. 
104. ---
105. 
106. ## FIFO element layout
107. 
108. `uct_obmm_fifo_element_t` (16 bytes, packed) is unchanged from v1:
109. 
110. | field      | bytes | notes                                          |

7. #ifndef UCT_OBMM_FIFO_H_
8. #define UCT_OBMM_FIFO_H_
9. 
10. #include <ucs/arch/cpu.h>
11. #include <ucs/sys/compiler.h>
12. #include <ucs/sys/compiler_def.h>
13. #include <ucs/sys/ptr_arith.h>
14. 
15. #include <stdint.h>
16. 
17. 
18. /* Element flags carried in the shared FIFO element header. */
19. enum {
20.     /* Toggled every FIFO wraparound; receiver uses this to detect a freshly
21.      * written element without taking a tail/head delta lock. */
22.     UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER = UCS_BIT(0),
23. 
24.     /* Set by senders that wrote via am_bcopy (pack_cb output stored in the
25.      * payload area starting at elem+1, with NO 8-byte am_short header
26.      * prefix). When clear, the element was written via am_short and
27.      * &elem->header + length covers the [hdr][payload] buffer. */
28.     UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_BCOPY = UCS_BIT(1)
29. };
30. 
31. 
32. /* Per-slot FIFO control header. Lives at offset 0 of every allocated slot in
33.  * the obmm pool. Producers serialize `head` reservation with a token lock:
34.  * on target aarch64 NC mappings, cross-node CAS updates memory but its return
35.  * value is not a reliable ownership result. Consumers read/write `tail` to
36.  * release space. Control fields are accessed via non-cacheable mappings,
37.  * therefore all updates must be paired with bus fences
38.  * (ucs_memory_bus_*_fence), not CPU fences. */
39. typedef struct uct_obmm_fifo_ctl {
40.     /* 1st cacheline: producer-touched */
41.     volatile uint64_t head;
42.     volatile uint64_t lock;
43.     UCS_CACHELINE_PADDING(uint64_t, uint64_t);
44. 
45.     /* 2nd cacheline: consumer-touched */
46.     volatile uint64_t tail;
47.     UCS_CACHELINE_PADDING(uint64_t);
48. } UCS_V_ALIGNED(UCS_SYS_CACHE_LINE_SIZE) uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t;
49. 
50. 
51. /* FIFO element header. The element body (am short header + payload) follows
52.  * immediately. Total element stride is iface->config.fifo_elem_size, which
53.  * the iface chooses so that header+payload <= elem_size. */
54. typedef struct uct_obmm_fifo_element {
55.     uint8_t  flags;       /* UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_xx */
56.     uint8_t  am_id;       /* active message id */
57.     uint16_t length;      /* payload length (excluding am_short header) */
58.     uint32_t generation;  /* owner-slot generation token; receiver discards
59.                              elements whose generation doesn't match the
60.                              slot's current meta.generation */
61.     uint64_t header;      /* am_short 64-bit header */
62.     /* payload[length] follows here */
63. } UCS_S_PACKED uct_obmm_fifo_element_t;
64. 
65. 
66. /* Compute slot stride: control header + fifo_size * elem_size + (v2)
67.  * fifo_size * bcopy_seg_size, cacheline aligned so that adjacent slots
68.  * don't share a line. Returned as size_t; callers must validate the
69.  * result fits in the uint32_t pool_hdr->slot_size field before passing
70.  * to pool_attach. */
71. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE size_t
72. uct_obmm_slot_stride(unsigned fifo_size, unsigned fifo_elem_size,
73.                      unsigned bcopy_seg_size)
74. {
75.     return ucs_align_up(sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t) +
76.                         ((size_t)fifo_size * fifo_elem_size) +
77.                         ((size_t)fifo_size * bcopy_seg_size),
78.                         UCS_SYS_CACHE_LINE_SIZE);
79. }
80. 
81. 
82. /* Get FIFO control header pointer from a slot base pointer. */
83. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t*
84. uct_obmm_slot_ctl(void *slot_base)
85. {
86.     return (uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t*)slot_base;
87. }
88. 
89. 
90. /* Get FIFO elements array pointer from a slot base pointer. */
91. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void*
92. uct_obmm_slot_elems(void *slot_base)
93. {
94.     return UCS_PTR_BYTE_OFFSET(slot_base, sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t));
95. }
96. 
97. 
98. /* Get bcopy desc array pointer from a slot base pointer. The desc area
99.  * lives immediately after the FIFO element array. Each desc is
100.  * `bcopy_seg_size` bytes; index N is paired 1:1 with FIFO element N. */
101. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void*
102. uct_obmm_slot_descs(void *slot_base, unsigned fifo_size,
103.                     unsigned fifo_elem_size)
104. {
105.     return UCS_PTR_BYTE_OFFSET(slot_base,
106.                                sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t) +
107.                                ((size_t)fifo_size * fifo_elem_size));
108. }
109. 
110. 
111. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE uct_obmm_fifo_element_t*
112. uct_obmm_slot_elem(void *elems, uint64_t index, unsigned mask,
113.                    unsigned elem_size)
114. {
115.     return (uct_obmm_fifo_element_t*)
116.            UCS_PTR_BYTE_OFFSET(elems, (size_t)(index & mask) * elem_size);
117. }
118. 
119.

27. uct_obmm_ep_make_lock_token(uct_obmm_iface_t *iface, const uct_obmm_ep_t *ep)
28. {
29.     uint64_t token;
30.

33.             iface->region->info.exporter_deid.lo ^
34.             ((uint64_t)iface->slot_index << 32) ^

36.             (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)ep;

42. uct_obmm_ep_try_lock_head(uct_obmm_ep_t *ep)
43. {
44.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
45.     if (ep->peer_ctl->lock != 0) {

209.            (daddr->exporter_deid_lo == ep->peer_deid_lo) &&

211.            (iaddr->generation == ep->expected_generation);

248.      * that uninitialized memory (zero) reads as "not yet written" on the
249.      * first pass. */
250.     owner_bit = ((head / ep->fifo_size) & 1u) ? 0u : UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER;
251. 
252.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();

262. /* Reserve one slot in the peer's FIFO, returning the head index that was
263.  * claimed. Multi-producer reservation is serialized with a token lock because
264.  * on target NC/aarch64 mappings, CAS updates memory but its return value is
265.  * not a reliable ownership result. */
266. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE ucs_status_t
267. uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot(uct_obmm_ep_t *ep, uint64_t *head_p)
268. {
269.     uint64_t head;
270. 
271.     if (!uct_obmm_ep_try_lock_head(ep)) {
272.         UCS_STATS_UPDATE_COUNTER(ep->super.stats, UCT_EP_STAT_NO_RES, 1);
273.         return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
274.     }
275. 
276.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
277.     head = ep->peer_ctl->head;
278. 
279.     if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
280.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
281.         ep->cached_tail = ep->peer_ctl->tail;
282.         if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
283.             UCS_STATS_UPDATE_COUNTER(ep->super.stats, UCT_EP_STAT_NO_RES, 1);
284.             uct_obmm_ep_unlock_head(ep);
285.             return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
286.         }
287.     }
288. 
289.     uct_obmm_bus_full_fence();
290.     ep->peer_ctl->head = head + 1;
291.     uct_obmm_ep_unlock_head(ep);
292. 
293.     *head_p = head;
294.     return UCS_OK;
295. }

34. /* In-region pool header. Lives at offset 0 of the local export region. All
35.  * fields are written via non-cacheable mappings: state transitions must be
36.  * paired with ucs_memory_bus_store_fence so peers (potentially on another
37.  * host) see the geometry before the READY transition. During cleanup, INITING
38.  * is only a transient coordination state; once reset completes, the shared
39.  * region is fully zero again. */
40. typedef struct uct_obmm_pool_hdr {
41.     uint64_t magic;             /* UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC */
42.     uint32_t state;             /* UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_xx, atomic */
43.     uint32_t slot_count;
44.     uint32_t slot_size;
45.     uint64_t slot_array_offset; /* offset (from region base) of slot 0 */
46.     uint32_t bitmap_words;      /* number of u64 words in alloc bitmap */
47.     uint32_t initializer_pid;   /* pid that owned the INITING transition */
48.     uint64_t initializer_starttime;
49.     /* followed by:
50.      *   uint64_t alloc_bitmap[bitmap_words];
51.      *   uct_obmm_slot_meta_t slot_meta[slot_count];
52.      */
53. } uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t;
54. 
55. 
56. /* Per-slot ownership metadata. Stored adjacent to the bitmap, separate from
57.  * the slot's actual FIFO contents. */
58. typedef struct uct_obmm_slot_meta {
59.     uint32_t state;            /* UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_xx */
60.     uint32_t generation;       /* monotonically increasing; bumped on free,
61.                                   scavenge, and when readers must discard
62.                                   in-flight stale elements */
63.     uint32_t owner_pid;
64.     uint32_t reserved;
65.     uint64_t owner_starttime;  /* /proc/<pid>/stat field 22, for liveness */
66. } uct_obmm_slot_meta_t;
67. 
68. 
69. /* Convenience accessor populated by uct_obmm_pool_attach. Pointers point
70.  * into the mapped region; nothing is owned by this struct. */
71. typedef struct uct_obmm_pool {
72.     void                  *base;     /* region base (pool hdr) */
73.     size_t                 length;   /* mapped region size */
74.     uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t   *hdr;
75.     volatile uint64_t     *bitmap;
76.     uct_obmm_slot_meta_t  *meta;
77.     void                  *slots;    /* base + hdr->slot_array_offset */
78.     uint32_t               slot_count;
79.     uint32_t               slot_size;
80. } uct_obmm_pool_t;
81.

92.  *
93.  * If an existing pool's geometry doesn't match the requested

95.  */
96. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_attach(void *region_base, size_t region_size,
97.                                   uint32_t slot_count, uint32_t slot_size,
