226. /* Try to claim slot `idx` for the current process. Returns 1 on success
227.  * (bit was set by us, meta updated). On scavenge of a dead owner, generation
228.  * is bumped and the slot is taken over. Returns 0 if the slot is unclaimable
229.  * (live owner). */
230. static int uct_obmm_pool_try_claim(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t idx,
231.                                    uint32_t self_pid, uint64_t self_starttime,
232.                                    uint32_t *generation_p)
233. {
234.     volatile uint64_t    *word    = &pool->bitmap[idx >> 6];
235.     uint64_t              bit     = 1ull << (idx & 63u);
236.     uct_obmm_slot_meta_t *m       = &pool->meta[idx];
237.     uint64_t              cur, oldval;
238.     int                   take_over;
239. 
240.     if (!uct_obmm_pool_is_ready(pool)) {
241.         return 0;
242.     }
243. 
244.     cur = *word;
245.     if (cur & bit) {
246.         /* allocated: maybe the owner is dead */
247.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
248.         if ((m->state == UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_IN_USE) &&
249.             uct_obmm_proc_alive(m->owner_pid, m->owner_starttime)) {
250.             return 0;
251.         }
252.         take_over = 1;
253.     } else {
254.         /* free: try to set the bit */
255.         oldval = ucs_atomic_cswap64(word, cur, cur | bit);
256.         if (oldval != cur) {
257.             return 0; /* lost the race; caller will retry next slot */
258.         }
259.         take_over = 0;
260.     }

18. /* Number of slots in the per-region pool. Caps how many ifaces can attach
19.  * to a single 128 MiB obmm region from this host. The first iface to
20.  * attach to a fresh region "wins" the geometry; subsequent attaches must
21.  * present matching numbers. */
22. #define UCT_OBMM_POOL_SLOT_COUNT 32u
23. 
24. 
25. /* Wire-format device address: identifies the obmm-side fabric coordinates
26.  * of the iface's owning region. Two ifaces are reachable from each other
27.  * iff each side has a mapped region (export OR import) carrying the
28.  * other's (exporter_dcna, exporter_deid). */
29. typedef struct uct_obmm_device_addr {
30.     uint64_t exporter_dcna;
31.     uint64_t exporter_deid_hi;
32.     uint64_t exporter_deid_lo;
33. } uct_obmm_device_addr_t;
34. 
35. 
36. /* Wire-format iface address: identifies the FIFO slot inside the region
37.  * named by the device address, plus enough geometry for the peer to
38.  * validate compatibility before trusting any pointer math. */
39. typedef struct uct_obmm_iface_addr {
40.     uint32_t slot_index;
41.     uint32_t generation;
42.     uint32_t pid;
43.     uint32_t fifo_size;
44.     uint32_t fifo_elem_size;
45.     uint32_t bcopy_seg_size;  /* v2: per-elem bcopy desc size; locks
46.                                   max_bcopy and slot_stride. v1 wrote 0
47.                                   here (named `reserved`); slot geometry
48.                                   checks prevent v1↔v2 mixing. */
49. } uct_obmm_iface_addr_t;
50. 
51. 
52. typedef struct uct_obmm_iface_common_config {
53.     uct_iface_config_t     super;
54.     double                 bandwidth; /* Memory bandwidth in bytes per second */
55. } uct_obmm_iface_common_config_t;
56. 
57. 
58. typedef struct uct_obmm_iface_config {
59.     uct_obmm_iface_common_config_t super;
60.     unsigned                       fifo_size;       /* FIFO ring depth (power of 2) */
61.     unsigned                       fifo_elem_size;  /* bytes per element (incl. hdr) */
62.     unsigned                       bcopy_seg_size;  /* v2: bytes per bcopy desc */
63.     size_t                         fifo_max_poll;   /* RX completions per progress() */
64. } uct_obmm_iface_config_t;
65. 
66. 
67. typedef struct uct_obmm_iface {
68.     uct_base_iface_t         super;
69.     struct {
70.         double               bandwidth; /* Memory bandwidth in bytes per second */
71.     } config;
72. 
73.     /* Local receive state -- our own slot inside the local export region. */
74.     uct_obmm_pool_t          pool;            /* attached local export pool */
75.     uct_obmm_region_t       *region;          /* points into md->regions[]  */
76.     void                    *recv_slot;       /* base of our slot bytes     */
77.     uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t     *recv_ctl;        /* head/tail in our slot      */
78.     void                    *recv_elems;      /* fifo[] in our slot         */
79.     void                    *recv_descs;      /* v2: bcopy desc[] in slot   */
80.     uint32_t                 slot_index;      /* our slot index in pool     */
81.     uint32_t                 generation;      /* our slot generation token  */
82.     uint64_t                 read_index;      /* monotonic RX cursor        */
83. 
84.     /* Geometry, cached from config. fifo_size MUST be power of 2. */
85.     unsigned                 fifo_size;
86.     unsigned                 fifo_mask;       /* fifo_size - 1              */
87.     unsigned                 fifo_elem_size;
88.     unsigned                 bcopy_seg_size;  /* v2: == max_bcopy           */
89.     size_t                   fifo_max_poll;
90. 
91.     /* Pending send arbiter (mirrors mm). pending_add queues UCP requests
92.      * here when peer FIFO is full; iface_progress dispatches them after
93.      * draining receives so any tail advance becomes immediately visible
94.      * to retries. Without this, UCP busy-spins inside ucp_do_am_bcopy_*
95.      * on UCS_ERR_BUSY from a no-op pending_add. */
96.     ucs_arbiter_t            arbiter;
97. } uct_obmm_iface_t;

66. /* Compute slot stride: control header + fifo_size * elem_size + (v2)
67.  * fifo_size * bcopy_seg_size, cacheline aligned so that adjacent slots
68.  * don't share a line. Returned as size_t; callers must validate the
69.  * result fits in the uint32_t pool_hdr->slot_size field before passing
70.  * to pool_attach. */
71. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE size_t
72. uct_obmm_slot_stride(unsigned fifo_size, unsigned fifo_elem_size,
73.                      unsigned bcopy_seg_size)
74. {
75.     return ucs_align_up(sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t) +
76.                         ((size_t)fifo_size * fifo_elem_size) +
77.                         ((size_t)fifo_size * bcopy_seg_size),
78.                         UCS_SYS_CACHE_LINE_SIZE);
79. }
80.

34. /* In-region pool header. Lives at offset 0 of the local export region. All
35.  * fields are written via non-cacheable mappings: state transitions must be
36.  * paired with ucs_memory_bus_store_fence so peers (potentially on another
37.  * host) see the geometry before the READY transition. During cleanup, INITING
38.  * is only a transient coordination state; once reset completes, the shared
39.  * region is fully zero again. */
40. typedef struct uct_obmm_pool_hdr {
41.     uint64_t magic;             /* UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC */
42.     uint32_t state;             /* UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_xx, atomic */
43.     uint32_t slot_count;
44.     uint32_t slot_size;
45.     uint64_t slot_array_offset; /* offset (from region base) of slot 0 */
46.     uint32_t bitmap_words;      /* number of u64 words in alloc bitmap */
47.     uint32_t initializer_pid;   /* pid that owned the INITING transition */
48.     uint64_t initializer_starttime;
49.     /* followed by:
50.      *   uint64_t alloc_bitmap[bitmap_words];
51.      *   uct_obmm_slot_meta_t slot_meta[slot_count];
52.      */
53. } uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t;
54. 
55. 
56. /* Per-slot ownership metadata. Stored adjacent to the bitmap, separate from
57.  * the slot's actual FIFO contents. */
58. typedef struct uct_obmm_slot_meta {
59.     uint32_t state;            /* UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_xx */
60.     uint32_t generation;       /* monotonically increasing; bumped on free,
61.                                   scavenge, and when readers must discard
62.                                   in-flight stale elements */
63.     uint32_t owner_pid;
64.     uint32_t reserved;
65.     uint64_t owner_starttime;  /* /proc/<pid>/stat field 22, for liveness */
66. } uct_obmm_slot_meta_t;
67. 
68. 
69. /* Convenience accessor populated by uct_obmm_pool_attach. Pointers point
70.  * into the mapped region; nothing is owned by this struct. */
71. typedef struct uct_obmm_pool {
72.     void                  *base;     /* region base (pool hdr) */
73.     size_t                 length;   /* mapped region size */
74.     uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t   *hdr;
75.     volatile uint64_t     *bitmap;
76.     uct_obmm_slot_meta_t  *meta;
77.     void                  *slots;    /* base + hdr->slot_array_offset */
78.     uint32_t               slot_count;
79.     uint32_t               slot_size;
80. } uct_obmm_pool_t;

215. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_ep_am_short(uct_ep_h tl_ep, uint8_t id, uint64_t header,
216.                                   const void *payload, unsigned length)
217. {
218.     uct_obmm_ep_t           *ep    = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep, uct_obmm_ep_t);
219.     uct_obmm_iface_t        *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep->iface,
220.                                                     uct_obmm_iface_t);
221.     size_t                   payload_total = sizeof(header) + length;
222.     uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem;
223.     uint64_t                 head;
224.     uint8_t                  owner_bit;
225. 
226.     UCT_CHECK_AM_ID(id);
227.     UCT_CHECK_LENGTH(payload_total, 0,
228.                      ep->fifo_elem_size - sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_element_t),
229.                      "am_short");
230. 
231.     if (uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot(ep, &head) != UCS_OK) {
232.         return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
233.     }
234. 
235.     elem = uct_obmm_slot_elem(ep->peer_elems, head, ep->fifo_mask,
236.                               ep->fifo_elem_size);
237. 
238.     elem->am_id      = id;
239.     elem->length     = (uint16_t)payload_total;
240.     elem->generation = ep->expected_generation;
241.     elem->header     = header;
242.     if (length > 0) {
243.         memcpy(elem + 1, payload, length);
244.     }
245. 
246.     /* Publish: the OWNER bit toggles each wraparound. The receiver expects
247.      * bit==1 on even passes and bit==0 on odd passes (and vice versa) so
248.      * that uninitialized memory (zero) reads as "not yet written" on the
249.      * first pass. */
250.     owner_bit = ((head / ep->fifo_size) & 1u) ? 0u : UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER;
251. 
252.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
253.     elem->flags = owner_bit;
254. 
255.     UCT_TL_EP_STAT_OP(&ep->super, AM, SHORT, payload_total);
256.     uct_iface_trace_am(&iface->super, UCT_AM_TRACE_TYPE_SEND, id,
257.                        &header, payload_total, "TX: AM_SHORT");
258.     return UCS_OK;

### 💬 Copilot

**已经重新平衡成 `16KiB short / 32KiB bcopy` 了。**  
现在默认几何是：

- `slot_count = 32`
- `FIFO_ELEM_SIZE = 16408` → `max_short = 16392` total bytes，也就是 **16384B 业务 payload + 8B short header**
- `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE = 32768` → **raw UCT `max_bcopy = 32KiB`**

这比上一版更适合你说的 **1B-1MiB OSU 默认 2 的幂 sweep**：小消息仍优先走 short，但超过 16KiB 后，不会太早掉进很碎的 multi-bcopy；32KiB 级消息会更长时间停留在 single-bcopy 附近。总 footprint 仍然约 **96 MiB / 128 MiB**，因为这次只是把同一预算从 short 侧挪了一部分到 bcopy 侧，没有改数据路径逻辑。

顺便把前面的歧义也落到了文档里：这里的 **32KiB bcopy** 指的是 **UCT 单次 bcopy 预算**，不是所有 UCP/MPI 路径下都保证恰好 32KiB 纯业务 payload；UCP 自己的 eager 头也会占这 32KiB 里的几字节到几十字节。

<sub>⏱️ 420m 50s</sub>

### 💬 Copilot

**可以，而且值得再放大一点；我建议不是直接打满到极限，而是先把 `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE` 从 `32768` 提到 `32792`。**

原因是这 24B 不是随便加的，刚好能把常见 tag eager bcopy 的 UCP 头吃掉：

- `ucp_tag_hdr_t` 是 **8B**  
  `ucx\src\ucp\tag\tag_match.h:25-30`
- `ucp_eager_first_hdr_t` 是 **24B**，`ucp_eager_middle_hdr_t` 是 **16B**  
  `ucx\src\ucp\tag\eager.h:34-50`
- UCP 判断单片 bcopy 的条件是  
  `length \<= max_bcopy - only_hdr_size`  
  `ucx\src\ucp\core\ucp_request.c:607-617`
- 实际打包时也是 `payload + UCP_hdr \<= max_bcopy`  
  `ucx\src\ucp\tag\eager_snd.c:20-35,61-76,100-112`

所以如果把 `max_bcopy` 设成 **32792**：

1. **32KiB 业务消息**可以落在 **single-bcopy**  
   因为 `32792 - 8 \>= 32768`
2. **64KiB 业务消息**可以刚好用 **2 个 bcopy 分片**  
   因为 `(32792 - 24) + (32792 - 16) = 65544 \>= 65536`
3. 同理，**128KiB / 256KiB** 这类 2 的幂消息，也更容易落成 **4 / 8 个分片**，不会比理想值多出一个零头分片

而你现在的 `32768` 做不到这一点：

- 32KiB 单片是否稳定要看路径，余量很紧
- 64KiB 在常见 tag eager 路径下会差 **24~40B**，容易退成 **3 片**
- 128KiB、256KiB 也会连带多出一个分片

---

**再往上当然还能加，但 `32792` 是“性价比最高”的第一个台阶。**  
在当前这套 `slot_count=32`、`FIFO_ELEM_SIZE=16408` 下，`bcopy` 的理论上限大约还能到 **49125**；但从 `32792` 再往上，收益就主要变成“继续拉宽非整边界消息的单片/少片区间”，不再像 `32792` 这样刚好把 **32KiB / 64KiB / 128KiB / 256KiB** 这些常见 OSU 点位卡顺。

**所以结论是：**
- **是，可以再放大**
- **最推荐先改到 `32792`**
- **不建议直接拉满到 `49125`**，因为收益不如 `32792` 这么“整齐”且可解释

---

251. ---
252. 
253. ## Configuration knobs
254. 
255. All under `UCX_OBMM_*` prefix.
256. 
257. | knob                      | default | meaning                          |
258. |---------------------------|---------|----------------------------------|
259. | FIFO_SIZE                 |    64   | ring depth (power of 2)          |
260. | FIFO_ELEM_SIZE            | 16408   | bytes per FIFO elem (incl. 16B hdr) → UCT max_short = 16392 total bytes (16384B payload + 8B short hdr) |
261. | BCOPY_SEG_SIZE   (v2 NEW) | 32768   | bytes per paired desc → raw UCT max_bcopy |
262. | FIFO_MAX_POLL             |    16   | RX completions per progress()     |
263. | MEMIDS        (optional)  |   ""    | comma-separated explicit shmdev memids (for example `1,2`); when set, obmm queries only these memids instead of scanning all shmdevs. Regardless of whether this knob is set, discovery is fail-fast: any discovered/requested shmdev that is missing, unusable, or yields an invalid export/import topology fails md_open |
264. 
265. Validation at iface init:
266. - `FIFO_SIZE` > 0, power of 2
267. - `FIFO_ELEM_SIZE` > sizeof(elem_hdr) and `(elem_size - hdr) <= UINT16_MAX`
268. - `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE` > 0 and `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE <= UINT16_MAX`
269. - `slot_count * slot_stride + pool_overhead <= region->length`
270. 
271. ---
272. 
273. ## Future scope (not in v2)
274. 
275. - `am_zcopy`: requires UCT MD memory-handle plumbing (`mem_reg`,
276.   `mkey_pack`, `mem_attach`). Currently obmm has no MD-level
277.   registration — every peer access is via the pre-existing 128 MiB
278.   region. Out of scope until libobmm-aware md is added.
279. - `put_bcopy / get_bcopy`: blocked by the same MD plumbing; UCP RMA
280.   cannot be served by the FIFO-only data path.
281. - Real pending arbiter: needed only if profiling shows BUSY-retry
282.   storms.
283. - Multi-region per node, NUMA-aware slot placement.
284. - Variable-size desc allocator (mm-style mpool) to cover medium-size
285.   messages without burning seg_size per FIFO depth.
286. 
287. ---
288. 
289. ## Receive-side fence ordering (full bus fence at tail release)
290. 
291. `ucs_memory_bus_store_fence()` on aarch64 is `dmb oshst` — store→store
292. only. It does NOT order prior loads against subsequent stores. The
293. receiver's lifetime invariant requires:
294. 
295. ```
296. loads from desc[N]  HAPPENS-BEFORE  store to recv_ctl->tail = N+1
297. ```
298. 
299. Otherwise a sender that observes the new tail can reuse `desc[N]` while
300. the receiver core still has outstanding loads in flight from the old
301. lap's payload. We therefore use `uct_obmm_bus_full_fence()` (defined
302. locally in `obmm_fifo.h`: `dmb osh` on aarch64, `mfence` on x86,
303. `sync` on ppc64, `fence iorw,iorw` on rv64) before the tail store, not
304. the bus_store fence.
305. 
306. Why a local helper rather than adding `ucs_memory_bus_fence()` for all
307. archs in `ucs/arch/`: AGENTS.md restricts changes to
308. `ucx/src/uct/obmm/`. If/when the helper proves useful elsewhere, it can
309. be promoted to ucs/arch — but that is a separate ask.
310. 
311. ## Receive-buffer semantics for AM handler
312. 
313. `invoke_am(..., desc, length, 0)` — the trailing `0` (no
314. `UCT_CB_PARAM_FLAG_DESC`) means the data pointer is valid **only for the
315. duration of the callback**. The handler MUST NOT retain it; UCP knows
316. this contract and copies into its own buffer when persistence is
317. needed.
318. 
319. This is by design: the desc lifetime is bound 1:1 to the FIFO element
320. slot, so as soon as the receiver advances `tail` past N, the sender is
321. free to overwrite `desc[N]` on the next lap. There is no separate desc
322. allocator to support post-callback retention.
323. 
324. If a future need arises to support `UCT_CB_PARAM_FLAG_DESC`-style
325. returnable descriptors (e.g. for AM zcopy or large-message rendezvous
326. without copy), it requires a real per-iface mpool of receive
327. descriptors that the upper layer can hold and release explicitly —
328. mirroring `uct_mm_recv_desc_t`. Out of scope for v2.
329.

331. 
332. Per `.github/skills/ucx-build-verify/SKILL.md`:
333. 
334. 1. Build via `task` agent: `./autogen.sh && ./contrib/configure-devel

46.                                   max_bcopy and slot_stride. v1 wrote 0

## Issue: Incorrect claim about the old BCOPY_SEG_SIZE default
**File:** ucx/src/uct/obmm/DESIGN.md:78-99
**Severity:** Medium
**Problem:** The documentation states "Raise default BCOPY_SEG_SIZE from 32768 to 32792," but the git history shows the old default was actually `4096`, not `32768`. The diff confirms this:
- Old: `{"BCOPY_SEG_SIZE", "4096",`
- New: `{"BCOPY_SEG_SIZE", "32792",`

This is an 8x increase (4096 → 32792), not a minor bump from 32768 → 32792.

**Evidence:** `git show HEAD:ucx/src/uct/obmm/base/obmm_iface.c` shows the old value was "4096".

**Impact:** The DESIGN.md document's overrun calculation mentions "If a user also pushes the short geometry back to a 32768-byte payload (`elem_size=32792`) while keeping `seg_size=32792`, the pool overruns the 128 MiB region by 103232 bytes". My calculation shows the overrun is actually **102400 bytes**, not 103232 bytes (difference of 832 bytes).

**Suggested fix:** Verify the intended claim in the commit message/intent. If this was meant to document a jump from the old 4096 default to 32792, update the documentation accordingly. Also correct the overrun calculation to 102400 bytes.

---

## Issue: Arithmetic discrepancy in documented overrun scenario
**File:** ucx/src/uct/obmm/DESIGN.md:104
**Severity:** Medium
**Problem:** Documentation claims that when `elem_size=32792` and `seg_size=32792`, the pool "overruns the 128 MiB region by 103232 bytes."

**Evidence:** Manual calculation:
```
slot_data = 128 + 64*(32792 + 32792) = 128 + 64*65584 = 4197376 bytes
total = 32 * 4197376 = 134320128 bytes
region_size = 128 * 1024 * 1024 = 134217728 bytes
overrun = 134320128 - 134217728 = 102400 bytes
```

The documented value (103232) differs from the calculated value (102400) by 832 bytes.

**Suggested fix:** Correct the overrun value to 102400 bytes, or verify if there's additional overhead not accounted for in the formula (e.g., pool header that isn't included in the per-slot calculation).

**已经改到 `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE = 32792` 了。**  
现在默认几何是：

- `slot_count = 32`
- `FIFO_ELEM_SIZE = 16408` → `max_short = 16392` total bytes，也就是 **16384B payload + 8B short header**
- `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE = 32792` → **raw UCT `max_bcopy = 32792`**

文档也同步改成了这次的真实意图：`32792` 不是为了凑整，而是为了把常见 UCP eager bcopy 的 **8B / 16B / 24B** 头部吃进去，这样 **32KiB-class** 消息更容易保持 single-bcopy，**64KiB-class** 消息在常见 tag eager 路径上更容易保持 2 个 bcopy 分片。这样你跑 OSU 时，更适合看 32KiB、64KiB、128KiB 这些点位是否变平滑。

86.     status = ucp_request_send_start(req, max_short, zcopy_thresh, rndv_thresh,
87.                                     dt_count, 0, req->send.length, msg_config,
88.                                     proto, param);
89.     if (ucs_likely(status == UCS_OK)) {
90.         /* Eager send initialized successfully */
91.         if (req->flags & UCP_REQUEST_FLAG_SYNC) {
92.             ucp_send_request_id_alloc(req);
93.             UCP_EP_STAT_TAG_OP(req->send.ep, EAGER_SYNC);
94.         } else {
95.             UCP_EP_STAT_TAG_OP(req->send.ep, EAGER);
96.         }
97.     } else if (status == UCS_ERR_NO_PROGRESS) {
98.         /* RMA/AM rendezvous */
99.         ucs_assert(req->send.length >= rndv_thresh);
100.         status = ucp_tag_send_start_rndv(req, param);
101.         if (status != UCS_OK) {
102.             return UCS_STATUS_PTR(status);
103.         }
104. 
105.         UCP_EP_STAT_TAG_OP(req->send.ep, RNDV);
106.     } else {
107.         return UCS_STATUS_PTR(status);
108.     }
109. 
110.     /*
111.      * Start the request.
112.      * If it is completed immediately and this completion is allowed,
113.      * release the request and return the status.
114.      * Otherwise, return the request.
115.      */
116.     ucp_request_send(req);
117.     if (req->flags & UCP_REQUEST_FLAG_COMPLETED) {
118.         /* Coverity wrongly resolves completion callback function to
119.          * 'ucp_cm_client_connect_progress' */
120.         /* coverity[offset_free] */
121.         ucp_request_imm_cmpl_param(param, req, send);
122.     }
123. 
124.     ucp_request_set_send_callback_param(param, req, send);
125.     ucs_trace_req("returning send request %p", req);
126.     return req + 1;
127. }

129. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void
130. ucp_tag_send_req_init(ucp_request_t *req, ucp_ep_h ep, const void *buffer,
131.                       uintptr_t datatype, size_t count, ucp_tag_t tag,
132.                       uint32_t flags, const ucp_request_param_t *param)
133. {
134.     req->flags              = flags | UCP_REQUEST_FLAG_SEND_TAG;
135.     req->send.ep            = ep;
136.     req->send.buffer        = (void*)buffer;
137.     req->send.datatype      = datatype;
138.     req->send.msg_proto.tag = tag;
139.     ucp_request_send_state_init(req, datatype, count);
140.     req->send.length       = ucp_dt_length(req->send.datatype, count,
141.                                            req->send.buffer,
142.                                            &req->send.state.dt);
143.     req->send.mem_type     = ucp_request_get_memory_type(
144.                                  ep->worker->context, (void*)buffer, count,
145.                                  datatype, req->send.length, param);
146.     req->send.lane         = ucp_ep_config(ep)->tag.lane;
147.     req->send.pending_lane = UCP_NULL_LANE;
148. }

150. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE ucs_status_t
151. ucp_tag_send_inline(ucp_ep_h ep, const void *buffer, size_t length,
152.                     ucp_tag_t tag, const ucp_request_param_t *param)
153. {
154.     ucs_status_t status;
155. 
156.     if (ucp_proto_is_inline(ep, &ucp_ep_config(ep)->tag.max_eager_short,
157.                             length, param)) {
158.         UCS_STATIC_ASSERT(sizeof(ucp_tag_t) == sizeof(ucp_eager_hdr_t));
159.         UCS_STATIC_ASSERT(sizeof(ucp_tag_t) == sizeof(uint64_t));
160.         status = uct_ep_am_short(ucp_ep_get_am_uct_ep(ep), UCP_AM_ID_EAGER_ONLY,
161.                                  tag, buffer, length);
162.     } else if (ucp_proto_is_inline(ep,
163.                                    &ucp_ep_config(ep)->tag.offload.max_eager_short,
164.                                    length, param)) {
165.         UCS_STATIC_ASSERT(sizeof(ucp_tag_t) == sizeof(uct_tag_t));
166.         status = uct_ep_tag_eager_short(ucp_ep_get_tag_uct_ep(ep), tag, buffer,
167.                                         length);
168.     } else {
169.         return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
170.     }
171. 
172.     if (status != UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE) {
173.         UCP_EP_STAT_TAG_OP(ep, EAGER);
174.     }
175. 
176.     return status;
177. }

231. UCS_PROFILE_FUNC(ucs_status_ptr_t, ucp_tag_send_nbx,
232.                  (ep, buffer, count, tag, param),
233.                  ucp_ep_h ep, const void *buffer, size_t count,
234.                  ucp_tag_t tag, const ucp_request_param_t *param)
235. {
236.     size_t contig_length = 0;
237.     ucs_status_t status;
238.     ucp_request_t *req;
239.     ucs_status_ptr_t ret;
240.     uintptr_t datatype;
241.     uint32_t attr_mask;
242.     ucp_worker_h worker;
243. 
244.     UCP_CONTEXT_CHECK_FEATURE_FLAGS(ep->worker->context, UCP_FEATURE_TAG,
245.                                     return UCS_STATUS_PTR(UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM));
246.     UCP_REQUEST_CHECK_PARAM(param);
247. 
248.     UCP_WORKER_THREAD_CS_ENTER_CONDITIONAL(ep->worker);
249. 
250.     ucs_trace_req("send_nbx buffer %p count %zu tag %"PRIx64" to %s",
251.                   buffer, count, tag, ucp_ep_peer_name(ep));
252. 
253.     attr_mask = param->op_attr_mask &
254.                 (UCP_OP_ATTR_FIELD_DATATYPE | UCP_OP_ATTR_FLAG_NO_IMM_CMPL);
255. 
256.     if (ucs_likely(attr_mask == 0)) {
257.         status = UCS_PROFILE_CALL(ucp_tag_send_inline, ep, buffer, count, tag,
258.                                   param);
259.         ucp_request_send_check_status(status, ret, goto out);
260.         datatype      = ucp_dt_make_contig(1);
261.         contig_length = count;
262.     } else if (attr_mask == UCP_OP_ATTR_FIELD_DATATYPE) {
263.         datatype = param->datatype;
264.         if (ucs_likely(UCP_DT_IS_CONTIG(datatype))) {
265.             contig_length = ucp_contig_dt_length(datatype, count);
266.             status        = UCS_PROFILE_CALL(ucp_tag_send_inline, ep, buffer,
267.                                              contig_length, tag, param);
268.             ucp_request_send_check_status(status, ret, goto out);
269.         }
270.     } else if (attr_mask == UCP_OP_ATTR_FLAG_NO_IMM_CMPL) {
271.         datatype      = ucp_dt_make_contig(1);
272.         contig_length = count;
273.     } else {
274.         /* UCP_OP_ATTR_FIELD_DATATYPE | UCP_OP_ATTR_FLAG_NO_IMM_CMPL */
275.         datatype = param->datatype;
276.         if (UCP_DT_IS_CONTIG(datatype)) {
277.             contig_length = ucp_contig_dt_length(datatype, count);
278.         }
279.     }
280. 
281.     if (ucs_unlikely(param->op_attr_mask & UCP_OP_ATTR_FLAG_FORCE_IMM_CMPL)) {
282.         ret = UCS_STATUS_PTR(UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE);
283.         goto out;

80. 
81. The pool's `slot_count` (compile-time `UCT_OBMM_POOL_SLOT_COUNT = 32`)
82. **times** `slot_stride` MUST fit in `region->length` (128 MiB minus pool
83.  header overhead). Defaults are picked to favor short-path coverage over
84.  maximum local process count; lowering `seg_size` and/or `fifo_size`
85.  reduces per-slot footprint, but the supported local attach count remains
86.  the compile-time `slot_count`.
87. 
88. Default budget check:
89. ```
90. fifo_size       =     64
91. elem_size       =  32768   (raw UCT max_short = 32752 total bytes)
92. seg_size        =  16384   (raw UCT max_bcopy = 16384)
93. ctl + slot data = 128 + 64*(32768+16384) = ~3072 KiB / slot
94. slot_count      =     32
95. total           = ~ 96 MiB / 128 MiB                     ✓
96. ```
97. These defaults are chosen from the measured OSU latency sweep rather than from
98. wire-format arithmetic alone. With Open MPI PML/UCX on this tree, ordinary
99. `MPI_Send` goes through `mca_pml_ucx_send_nbr()` into `ucp_tag_send_nbx()`,
100. and UCX defaults `PROTO_ENABLE=y`, so protocol v2 selects between eager short,
101. eager bcopy single/multi, and rendezvous using its own headers and cost model.
102. In the user's measurements, trying to make raw bcopy "just large enough" for
103. 32KiB-class messages (`seg_size=32768` or `32792`) was worse than keeping
104. `seg_size=16384`, because the larger bcopy window delayed higher-level
105. protocol transitions and hurt 16KiB+ / 32KiB+ / 64KiB+ points. Keeping
106. `FIFO_ELEM_SIZE=32768` still leaves the short path with plenty of headroom for
107. small and medium messages without forcing 32KiB payloads to stay on short.
108. 
109. If a user also pushes the short geometry back to a 32768-byte payload
110. (`elem_size=32792`) while simultaneously stretches bcopy to `seg_size=32792`,
111. the pool overruns the 128 MiB region by 103232 bytes and attach fails with a
112. clear error pointing at the geometry knobs.
113. 
114. When the last local iface on an export exits, UCX resets the entire local
115. export region to zero before another attach may re-initialize the pool.
116.

34. /* In-region pool header. Lives at offset 0 of the local export region. All
35.  * fields are written via non-cacheable mappings: state transitions must be
36.  * paired with ucs_memory_bus_store_fence so peers (potentially on another
37.  * host) see the geometry before the READY transition. During cleanup, INITING
38.  * is only a transient coordination state; once reset completes, the shared
39.  * region is fully zero again. */
40. typedef struct uct_obmm_pool_hdr {
41.     uint64_t magic;             /* UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC */
42.     uint32_t state;             /* UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_xx, atomic */
43.     uint32_t slot_count;
44.     uint32_t slot_size;
45.     uint64_t slot_array_offset; /* offset (from region base) of slot 0 */
46.     uint32_t bitmap_words;      /* number of u64 words in alloc bitmap */
47.     uint32_t initializer_pid;   /* pid that owned the INITING transition */
48.     uint64_t initializer_starttime;
49.     /* followed by:
50.      *   uint64_t alloc_bitmap[bitmap_words];
51.      *   uct_obmm_slot_meta_t slot_meta[slot_count];
52.      */
53. } uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t;
54. 
55. 
56. /* Per-slot ownership metadata. Stored adjacent to the bitmap, separate from
57.  * the slot's actual FIFO contents. */
58. typedef struct uct_obmm_slot_meta {
59.     uint32_t state;            /* UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_xx */
60.     uint32_t generation;       /* monotonically increasing; bumped on free,
61.                                   scavenge, and when readers must discard
62.                                   in-flight stale elements */
63.     uint32_t owner_pid;
64.     uint32_t reserved;
65.     uint64_t owner_starttime;  /* /proc/<pid>/stat field 22, for liveness */
66. } uct_obmm_slot_meta_t;
67. 
68. 
69. /* Convenience accessor populated by uct_obmm_pool_attach. Pointers point
70.  * into the mapped region; nothing is owned by this struct. */
71. typedef struct uct_obmm_pool {
72.     void                  *base;     /* region base (pool hdr) */
73.     size_t                 length;   /* mapped region size */
74.     uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t   *hdr;
75.     volatile uint64_t     *bitmap;
76.     uct_obmm_slot_meta_t  *meta;
77.     void                  *slots;    /* base + hdr->slot_array_offset */
78.     uint32_t               slot_count;
79.     uint32_t               slot_size;
80. } uct_obmm_pool_t;

<sub>⏱️ 876m 20s</sub>

### 💬 Copilot

**你说得对，之前那套“按 UCP 头把 bcopy 刚好放大”的判断是错的，我已经把默认值改回当前实测最优的 `FIFO_ELEM_SIZE=32768`、`BCOPY_SEG_SIZE=16384`。**

关键原因是这条 OSU latency 路径并不是我之前主要按的老式阈值逻辑。你这条命令在当前 Open MPI/UCX 上走的是：

1. `MPI_Send` → `mca_pml_ucx_send_nbr()` → `ucp_tag_send_nbx()`  
2. UCX 默认 `PROTO_ENABLE=y`，所以实际走 **proto v2** 的 cost-based 选择  
3. 这样 `max_short/max_bcopy` 改动会影响 **eager short / eager bcopy single/multi / rendezvous** 的整体切换，不是简单的“能装下就更快”

`latency_test.xlsx` 里的 6 组数据也印证了这一点：  
`32768 / 16384` 的总和最好（**806**），而我之前推的“刚好吃掉 UCP 头”的两组反而最差：`16408 / 32792 = 6097`，`32768 / 16408 = 5899`。这说明在你这条 benchmark 路径里，把 bcopy 放到“刚好能让 32KiB/64KiB eager 更久停留”会**推迟更合适的高层协议切换**，于是 16KiB+、32KiB+、64KiB+ 的点整体变差。

顺着别的传输层看，这个结论也更合理：

- **mm** 默认就是小 short、适中的 seg（`FIFO_ELEM_SIZE=128`, `SEG_SIZE=8256`）
- **tcp** 直接让 `max_short == max_bcopy == tx_seg_size - hdr`
- **IB RC** 的 `am_short/am_bcopy` 也是按 inline/seg_size/硬件能力推出来，并不追求“刚好覆盖 2 的幂消息”

所以，**当前基于你已有实测，最优默认配置就是 `UCX_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_SIZE=32768`、`UCX_OBMM_BCOPY_SEG_SIZE=16384`。**

### 💬 Copilot

**我重新看完后，最有希望的未测组合是 `FIFO_ELEM_SIZE=16448, BCOPY_SEG_SIZE=32768`。**  
第二候选是 `FIFO_ELEM_SIZE=16448, BCOPY_SEG_SIZE=16384`。我不建议再试 `16408/32768`、`16392/32768`、`32792` 这类值了，方向不对。

理由不是“多补几个 UCP 头字节”，而是两条更重要的规律：

1. **你这条路径实际是 MPI → PML UCX → `ucp_tag_send_nbx()`，而且默认 `PROTO_ENABLE=y`，走的是 UCP proto v2。**  
   所以性能由 **short / bcopy single / bcopy multi / rndv** 的整体切换决定，不是老式“cap 大一点就一定更快”。  
   相关路径：`ompi\ompi\mca\pml\ucx\pml_ucx.c:1050-1060`，`ucx\src\ucp\tag\tag_send.c:292-303`，`ucx\src\ucp\core\ucp_context.c` 里 `PROTO_ENABLE = "y"`。

2. **你现有 6 组数据暴露出的真正主因，是 obmm 自己的 stride 对齐，而不是 UCP 头部那 8/16/24B。**  
   obmm 的 FIFO element 和 bcopy desc 都是按你配置的 `elem_size` / `seg_size` 直接做字节步进：  
   `ucx\src\uct\obmm\base\obmm_fifo.h:111-124`  
   这意味着：
   - `16384`, `32768` 都是 **64B 对齐**
   - `16392` 是 `mod 64 = 8`
   - `16408` / `32792` 是 `mod 64 = 24`

   在 NC 映射上，这种“每个 elem/desc 都错开 8B/24B”的布局，和你的实测完全一致地表现出大幅退化。  
   **所以后面不要再测非 64B 对齐值。**

---

基于当前代码路径，针对 `osu_latency -m 1:1048576` 这组 **2 的幂** 点位，最该卡的两个边界其实是：

- **16KiB 要留在 short**
- **32KiB / 64KiB 不要因为多了几十字节就继续留在 eager bcopy 里**

对 tag 路径，可以近似看成：

- short 业务 payload 上限 ≈ `FIFO_ELEM_SIZE - 24`
- single-bcopy 业务 payload 上限 ≈ `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE - 8`
- 2 片 bcopy 业务 payload 上限 ≈ `2 * BCOPY_SEG_SIZE - 40`

所以：

- 要让 **16KiB** 还在 short：`FIFO_ELEM_SIZE \>= 16408`  
  最小的 **64B 对齐**解就是 **`16448`**
- `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE=32768` 时：
  - 32KiB 单片仍然**放不下**：`32768 - 8 = 32760 \< 32768`
  - 64KiB 两片也仍然**差一点**：`2*32768 - 40 = 65512 \< 65536`

这点很关键：  
**`32768` 这个 bcopy 值虽然大，但它刚好还没跨过 32KiB / 64KiB 这两个 power-of-two eager 边界。**  
而 `32792` 恰好把这两个边界跨过去了，这就是你之前实测变差的根本原因。

---

所以我现在的判断是：

| 候选 | 作用 | 我对它的判断 |
|---|---|---|
| **`16448 / 32768`** | 16KiB 保持 short；32KiB/64KiB 仍不会因为 eager 头而跨边界；而且两边都 64B 对齐 | **最强未测候选** |
| **`16448 / 16384`** | 保留当前最好基线的 bcopy 行为，只把 short 从“过大”收敛到“刚好覆盖 16KiB” | **第二候选** |
| `32768 / 16384` | 你目前 6 组里总成绩最好 | **当前已知最优基线** |
| `16384 / 32768` | 大消息不错，但 16KiB 点会掉坑 | 不如 `16448 / 32768` |
| 任何 `...08 / ...92 / ...24` 这类非 64B 对齐值 | stride 错位 | **不建议再测** |

---

**结论：如果只追加一组，我建议先跑 `FIFO_ELEM_SIZE=16448`、`BCOPY_SEG_SIZE=32768`。**  
这是你当前测试矩阵里**最关键的缺失点**：它同时修复了

1. `16384 / 32768` 的 **16KiB short 不够**
2. `16408 / 32768` 的 **非 64B 对齐**

如果这组跑赢 `32768 / 16384`，那它就是比“凭感觉试出来的当前最优”更有理论支撑的新默认。

18.

20. enum {
21.     UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT = 0u,
22.     UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_INITING = 1u,
23.     UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY = 2u
24. };
25.

27. enum {

33. 
34. /* In-region pool header. Lives at offset 0 of the local export region. All
35.  * fields are written via non-cacheable mappings: state transitions must be
36.  * paired with ucs_memory_bus_store_fence so peers (potentially on another
37.  * host) see the geometry before the READY transition. During cleanup, INITING
38.  * is only a transient coordination state; once reset completes, the shared
39.  * region is fully zero again. */
40. typedef struct uct_obmm_pool_hdr {
41.     uint64_t magic;             /* UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC */
42.     uint32_t state;             /* UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_xx, atomic */
43.     uint32_t slot_count;
44.     uint32_t slot_size;
45.     uint64_t slot_array_offset; /* offset (from region base) of slot 0 */
46.     uint32_t bitmap_words;      /* number of u64 words in alloc bitmap */
47.     uint32_t initializer_pid;   /* pid that owned the INITING transition */
48.     uint64_t initializer_starttime;
49.     /* followed by:
50.      *   uint64_t alloc_bitmap[bitmap_words];
51.      *   uct_obmm_slot_meta_t slot_meta[slot_count];
52.      */
53. } uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t;
54. 
55. 
56. /* Per-slot ownership metadata. Stored adjacent to the bitmap, separate from
57.  * the slot's actual FIFO contents. */
58. typedef struct uct_obmm_slot_meta {
59.     uint32_t state;            /* UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_xx */
60.     uint32_t generation;       /* monotonically increasing; bumped on free,
61.                                   scavenge, and when readers must discard
62.                                   in-flight stale elements */
63.     uint32_t owner_pid;
64.     uint32_t reserved;
65.     uint64_t owner_starttime;  /* /proc/<pid>/stat field 22, for liveness */
66. } uct_obmm_slot_meta_t;
67. 
68. 
69. /* Convenience accessor populated by uct_obmm_pool_attach. Pointers point
70.  * into the mapped region; nothing is owned by this struct. */
71. typedef struct uct_obmm_pool {
72.     void                  *base;     /* region base (pool hdr) */
73.     size_t                 length;   /* mapped region size */
74.     uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t   *hdr;
75.     volatile uint64_t     *bitmap;
76.     uct_obmm_slot_meta_t  *meta;
77.     void                  *slots;    /* base + hdr->slot_array_offset */
78.     uint32_t               slot_count;
79.     uint32_t               slot_size;
80. } uct_obmm_pool_t;

26. 
27. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE size_t
28. uct_obmm_pool_bitmap_words(uint32_t slot_count)
29. {
30.     return (slot_count + 63u) / 64u;
31. }
32. 
33. 
34. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE int
35. uct_obmm_pool_is_ready(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool)
36. {
37.     uint32_t state = pool->hdr->state;
38. 
39.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
40.     return state == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY;
41. }
42. 
43. 
44. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void
45. uct_obmm_pool_clear_bit(volatile uint64_t *word, uint64_t bit)
46. {
47.     uint64_t cur, oldval;
48. 
49.     do {
50.         cur    = *word;
51.         oldval = ucs_atomic_cswap64(word, cur, cur & ~bit);
52.     } while (oldval != cur);
53. }
54. 
55. 
56. static size_t uct_obmm_pool_meta_offset(uint32_t slot_count)
57. {
58.     return sizeof(uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t) +
59.            uct_obmm_pool_bitmap_words(slot_count) * sizeof(uint64_t);
60. }
61. 
62. 
63. static size_t uct_obmm_pool_slot_offset(uint32_t slot_count)
64. {
65.     return ucs_align_up(uct_obmm_pool_meta_offset(slot_count) +
66.                         (size_t)slot_count * sizeof(uct_obmm_slot_meta_t),
67.                         UCS_SYS_CACHE_LINE_SIZE);
68. }
69. 
70. 
71. size_t uct_obmm_pool_required_size(uint32_t slot_count, uint32_t slot_size)
72. {
73.     return uct_obmm_pool_slot_offset(slot_count) +
74.            (size_t)slot_count * slot_size;
75. }

78. static int uct_obmm_proc_alive(uint32_t pid, uint64_t starttime)
79. {
80.     unsigned long live;
81. 
82.     if (pid == 0) {
83.         return 0;
84.     }
85. 
86.     live = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time((pid_t)pid);
87.     if (live == 0ul) {
88.         /* /proc/<pid>/stat unreadable: pid does not exist any more */
89.         return 0;
90.     }
91. 
92.     return (uint64_t)live == starttime;
93. }

97. uct_obmm_pool_initializer_stamped(uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t *hdr)

103. /* CAS-claim the INITING transition; if we lose, wait until READY (or

1. # Agent Operating Rules — ucx_obmm_br
2. 
3. This file is the **mandatory workflow** for any agent (human or AI) working
4. in this repository. It exists because the work — implementing a new UCT
5. transport (`obmm`) on top of UCX, against hardware that is not present in
6. the development environment — is high-risk for hallucination, framework
7. mis-wiring, and silent capability mismatches.
8. 
9. Skills referenced below live under `.github/skills/`:
10. 
11. - `vector-db-retrieval`     — semantic search over ucx / obmm / ompi
12. - `uct-transport-patterns`  — UCX UCT framework contracts and references
13. - `obmm-api-and-env`        — libobmm API + immutable test-env facts
14. - `ucx-build-verify`        — build commands and no-hardware verification
15. 
16. ## Scope reminder
17. 
18. - Repos: `ucx/`, `obmm/`, `ompi/`. Active development is in `ucx/src/uct/obmm/`.
19. - `ompi/` is **read-only context** — MPI is the consumer above UCP; we do not

2. 
3. This file is the mandatory workflow for agents working in this repository. The
4. project implements a UCX UCT transport (`obmm`) against hardware that is not
5. available in the local development environment, so the main risk is
6. hallucinating UCX framework behavior, OBMM runtime semantics, or hardware facts.

13. - `.github/skills/ucx-build-verify/SKILL.md` — environment-gated verification.
14. - `ucx/src/uct/obmm/DESIGN.md` — current wire format and data-path design.
15. 
16. ## Scope reminder
17. 
18. - Repos: `ucx/`, `obmm/`, `ompi/`.
19. - Active transport development is in `ucx/src/uct/obmm/`.
20. - `ompi/` is read-only context.
21. - `obmm/` is libobmm context; do not extend its API for transport work.
22. - V2 NC baseline is stable: `am_short`, `am_bcopy`, pending arbiter, and
23.   cross-node MPI/OSU bring-up fixes. Preserve `MEM_MODE=nc` behavior.
24. - V3 target is hybrid: NC FIFO/control/short plus CC chunks for selected
25.   `am_bcopy` payloads. Pure CC FIFO/control is not a target.
26. - PUT/GET/RMA/zcopy/atomics are not implemented and must remain unsupported
27.   unless a separate design is approved.
28. 
29. ## Mandatory workflow for obmm transport changes
30. 
31. 1. **Retrieve before reasoning.**
32.    Query the local vector DB before making code-grounded UCX/OBMM/OMPI
33.    conclusions. Direct file reads are for confirming exact code after retrieval.
34. 
35. 2. **Re-read environment facts.**
36.    Read `obmm-api-and-env` before touching memory setup, mmap, ownership,
37.    addressing, reachability, or hardware assumptions. If a fact is missing,
38.    ask the user; do not invent it.
39. 
40. 3. **Diagnose before changing code.**
41.    For failures, first locate evidence:
42.    - Literal UCX/OMPI error string: grep the string and read the emit site.
43.    - Stack trace: read from the top UCX/UCP function down to the transport
44.      capability/ops that selected the path.
45.    - Hang: inspect progress, pending, FIFO backpressure, and ownership state
46.      before changing fences or wire format.
47. 
48. 4. **Plan and review non-trivial changes.**
49.    Update the session `plan.md` for design-level changes. For ops table,
50.    capability, wire-format, ownership, or reachability changes, run a design
51.    critique (`rubber-duck` if available; otherwise a synchronous review agent
52.    or an explicit self-review checklist) before implementation.
53. 
54. 5. **Implement coherently.**
55.    Mirror mm/self structure for UCX framework wiring, but do not copy their
56.    memory capabilities blindly. Keep these in sync:
57.    - ops table entries
58.    - `iface_query` capability flags and numeric caps
59.    - iface/device address structs
60.    - reachability checks and diagnostics
61.    - pool version / wire format / `DESIGN.md`
62. 
63. 6. **Verify in the right environment.**
64.    Follow `ucx-build-verify`. In this Windows workspace, do not waste time
65.    trying to run Linux UCX build commands. If no Linux shell/toolchain is
66.    available, do static checks locally and hand the build commands to the user
67.    or a Linux build host.
68. 
69. 7. **Code-review before declaring done.**
70.    Run a high-signal code review on the diff. Adopt findings that prevent
71.    correctness, compile, resource-lifetime, or protocol bugs; skip style-only
72.    feedback.
73. 
74. ## Hard rules
75. 
76. - Do not call `obmm_export`, `obmm_unexport`, `obmm_import`, `obmm_unimport`,
77.   `obmm_preimport`, or `obmm_unpreimport` from inside the UCT transport.
78. - In NC mode, do not call `obmm_set_ownership`.
79. - In V3 hybrid, `obmm_set_ownership` is allowed only for CC mappings/chunks and
80.   only according to `DESIGN.md` and `obmm-api-and-env`.
81. - Do not assume static-CC remote visibility on the current hardware. The `dr`
82.   A/B experiment showed that a sender can read back a new CC payload locally
83.   while the peer import still sees stale data until `obmm_set_ownership()` (or
84.   later cache eviction) makes it visible.
85. - Do not run `mpirun`, `ucx_perftest`, OSU, or hardware/two-node tests locally.
86. - Do not modify `ompi/` or `obmm/` unless the user explicitly asks.
87. - Do not modify files outside `ucx/src/uct/obmm/`, `ucx/src/uct/Makefile.am`,
88.   and needed build wiring without user approval, except for explicit workflow,
89.   test, or documentation tasks requested by the user.
90. - Do not advertise a UCT/MD capability unless the corresponding operation and
91.   memory semantics are truly implemented in obmm.
92. - Do not use memid as a cross-node peer key. Import memid is local to the
93.   importing node; match peers by exporter identity.
94. - Do not bypass this workflow for capability bits, class macros, ops tables,
95.   wire format, reachability, or ownership logic. Those are the high-risk areas.
96. 
97. ## Agent assignments
98. 
99. | Activity | Preferred approach |
100. | --- | --- |
101. | UCX/OBMM/OMPI code-grounded research | `vector-db-retrieval`, then direct file reads |
102. | Targeted symbol lookup | direct `rg`/`view` after retrieval |
103. | Design critique | rubber-duck/review agent or explicit self-review |
104. | Coupled md/iface/ep implementation | primary agent/self, not split across low-context workers |
105. | Verbose Linux build/test execution | `task` agent only when Linux toolchain exists |
106. | Final diff review | `code-review` |
107. 
108. ## When to stop and ask
109. 
110. Ask the user before assuming:
111. 
112. - hardware behavior not documented in `obmm-api-and-env`
113. - NC/CC role, ownership granularity, mmap offset, or cache-coherence semantics
114. - changes to libobmm or OMPI
115. - broad scope changes such as PUT/GET/RMA/zcopy
116. 
117. The cost of one clarification is lower than baking an unverifiable hardware
118. assumption into a UCT transport.
119.

If a fact is missing,\n+   ask the user; do not invent it.\n+\n+3. **Diagnose before changing code.**\n+   For failures or regressions, first locate evidence:\n+   - literal UCX/OMPI error string: grep the string and read the emit site\n+   - stack trace: read from the top UCX/UCP function down to the transport\n+     capability/ops that selected the path\n+   - hang: inspect progress, pending, FIFO backpressure, and ownership state\n+     before changing fences or wire format\n+   - performance regression: trace the actual MPI → PML UCX → UCP path,\n+     confirm whether proto v2 is active, and check alignment/threshold effects\n+     before retuning raw UCT caps\n+\n+4. **Plan and critique non-trivial changes.**\n+   Update the session `plan.md` for design-level changes. For ops table,\n+   capability, wire-format, ownership, reachability, or tuning changes, run a\n+   design critique (`rubber-duck` if available; otherwise a synchronous review\n+   agent or explicit self-review checklist) before implementation.\n+\n+5. **Implement coherently.**\n+   Mirror mm/self structure for UCX framework wiring, but do not copy their\n+   memory capabilities blindly. Keep these in sync:\n+   - ops table entries\n+   - `iface_query` capability flags and numeric caps\n+   - iface/device address structs\n+   - reachability checks and diagnostics\n+   - pool geometry / wire format / `DESIGN.md`\n+\n+6. **Verify in the right environment.**\n+   Follow `ucx-build-verify`. In this Windows workspace, do not waste time\n+   trying to run Linux UCX build commands. If no Linux shell/toolchain is\n+   available, do static checks locally and hand the build commands to the user\n+   or a Linux build host. Do not claim a feature works if it cannot be\n+   observed by `ucx_info -d -t obmm`, `ucx_info -c`, symbol inspection, or\n+   user-provided benchmark data.\n+\n+7. **Code-review before declaring done.**\n+   Run a high-signal code review on the diff. Adopt findings that prevent\n+   correctness, compile, resource-lifetime, or protocol bugs; skip style-only\n+   feedback.\n+\n+## Hard rules\n+\n+- Do not call `obmm_export`, `obmm_unexport`, `obmm_import`, `obmm_unimport`,\n+  `obmm_preimport`, or `obmm_unpreimport` from inside the UCT transport.\n+- In the current NC transport, do not call `obmm_set_ownership`.\n+- Do not run `mpirun`, `ucx_perftest`, or any hardware/two-node test locally.\n+- Do not modify `ompi/` or `obmm/` unless the user explicitly asks.\n+- Do not modify files outside `ucx/src/uct/obmm/`,\n+  `ucx/src/uct/Makefile.am`, and needed build wiring without user approval,\n+  except for explicit workflow or documentation tasks requested by the user.\n+- Do not advertise a UCT/MD capability unless the corresponding operation and\n+  memory semantics are truly implemented in obmm.\n+- Do not use memid as a cross-node peer key. Match peers by exporter identity.\n+- Do not invent libobmm semantics, device paths, mmap offsets, cache\n+  coherence, or protocol behavior above UCT. Ask the user when facts are\n+  missing.\n+- Do not bypass this workflow for capability bits, class macros, ops tables,\n+  wire format, reachability, ownership logic, or geometry tuning.\n+\n+## Agent assignments\n+\n+| Activity | Preferred approach |\n+| --- | --- |\n+| UCX/OBMM/OMPI code-grounded research | `vector-db-retrieval`, then direct file reads |\n+| Targeted symbol lookup | direct `rg`/`view` after retrieval |\n+| Design critique | `rubber-duck`/review agent or explicit self-review |\n+| Coupled md/iface/ep implementation | primary agent/self, not split across low-context workers |\n+| Verbose Linux build/test execution | `task` agent only when Linux toolchain exists |\n+| Final diff review | `code-review` |\n+\n+## When to stop and ask\n+\n+Ask the user before assuming:\n+\n+- hardware behavior not documented in `obmm-api-and-env`\n+- NC memory semantics or any future CC/ownership semantics\n+- changes to libobmm or OMPI\n+- broad scope changes such as PUT/GET/RMA/zcopy\n+- benchmark conclusions that need more data than the current measurements cover\n+\n+The cost of one clarification is lower than baking an unverifiable assumption\n+into a UCT transport.\n*** End Patch\n"

90.         (iaddr->fifo_elem_size != iface->fifo_elem_size) ||
91.         (iaddr->bcopy_seg_size != iface->bcopy_seg_size)) {
92.         ucs_error("obmm: peer geometry (fifo=%u elem=%u seg=%u) differs from "
93.                   "local (fifo=%u elem=%u seg=%u); ep_create rejected",
94.                   iaddr->fifo_size, iaddr->fifo_elem_size,
95.                   iaddr->bcopy_seg_size,
96.                   iface->fifo_size, iface->fifo_elem_size,
97.                   iface->bcopy_seg_size);
98.         return UCS_ERR_UNREACHABLE;
99.     }
100. 
101.     /* Find the local region (export-for-self, import-for-remote) that maps
102.      * the peer's exporter coordinates. */
103.     {
104.         uct_obmm_region_t *exp_r;
105.         uct_obmm_eid_t     eid;
106. 
107.         eid.hi = daddr->exporter_deid_hi;
108.         eid.lo = daddr->exporter_deid_lo;
109. 
110.         exp_r  = uct_obmm_md_export_region(md);
111.         region = NULL;
112.         if ((exp_r != NULL) &&
113.             (exp_r->info.exporter_dcna == daddr->exporter_dcna) &&
114.             (exp_r->info.exporter_deid.hi == eid.hi) &&
115.             (exp_r->info.exporter_deid.lo == eid.lo)) {
116.             region = exp_r;
117.         } else {
118.             region = uct_obmm_md_find_import_region(md, daddr->exporter_dcna,
119.                                                     &eid);
120.         }
121.     }
122.     if (region == NULL) {
123.         ucs_error("obmm: ep_create cannot find region for peer "
124.                   "dcna=0x%lx deid=0x%lx:0x%lx",
125.                   (unsigned long)daddr->exporter_dcna,
126.                   (unsigned long)daddr->exporter_deid_hi,
127.                   (unsigned long)daddr->exporter_deid_lo);
128.         return UCS_ERR_UNREACHABLE;
129.     }
130. 
131.     status = uct_obmm_pool_open(region->base, region->length, &peer_pool);
132.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
133.         ucs_error("obmm: failed to open peer pool: %s",
134.                   ucs_status_string(status));
135.         return status;
136.     }
137. 
138.     if (iaddr->slot_index >= peer_pool.slot_count) {
139.         ucs_error("obmm: peer slot_index %u out of range (slot_count=%u)",
140.                   iaddr->slot_index, peer_pool.slot_count);
141.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
142.     }
143. 
144.     if (peer_pool.slot_size !=
145.         uct_obmm_slot_stride(iaddr->fifo_size, iaddr->fifo_elem_size,
146.                              iaddr->bcopy_seg_size)) {
147.         ucs_error("obmm: peer pool slot_size %u inconsistent with iface_addr "
148.                   "geometry (fifo=%u elem=%u seg=%u)",
149.                   peer_pool.slot_size, iaddr->fifo_size,
150.                   iaddr->fifo_elem_size, iaddr->bcopy_seg_size);
151.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
152.     }
153. 
154.     peer_slot = uct_obmm_pool_slot_ptr(&peer_pool, iaddr->slot_index);
155. 
156.     self->peer_ctl            = uct_obmm_slot_ctl(peer_slot);
157.     self->peer_elems          = uct_obmm_slot_elems(peer_slot);
158.     self->peer_descs          = uct_obmm_slot_descs(peer_slot,
159.                                                     iaddr->fifo_size,
160.                                                     iaddr->fifo_elem_size);
161.     self->cached_tail         = self->peer_ctl->tail;
162.     self->expected_generation = iaddr->generation;
163.     self->fifo_size           = iaddr->fifo_size;
164.     self->fifo_mask           = iaddr->fifo_size - 1u;
165.     self->fifo_elem_size      = iaddr->fifo_elem_size;
166.     self->bcopy_seg_size      = iaddr->bcopy_seg_size;
167.     self->peer_dcna           = daddr->exporter_dcna;
168.     self->peer_deid_hi        = daddr->exporter_deid_hi;
169.     self->peer_deid_lo        = daddr->exporter_deid_lo;
170.     self->peer_slot_index     = iaddr->slot_index;
171.     self->peer_pid            = iaddr->pid;
172.     self->lock_token          = uct_obmm_ep_make_lock_token(iface, self);
173.     return UCS_OK;
174. }

176. static UCS_CLASS_CLEANUP_FUNC(uct_obmm_ep_t)
177. {
178.     /* Drain any UCP requests still parked on this ep's arbiter group
179.      * before the iface tears down its arbiter. mm follows the same
180.      * order (mm_ep.c:217). */
181.     uct_obmm_ep_pending_purge(&self->super.super, NULL, NULL);
182.     /* Peer pool memory is owned by the MD; nothing else to release. */

190. int uct_obmm_ep_is_connected(const uct_ep_h tl_ep,
191.                              const uct_ep_is_connected_params_t *params)
192. {
193.     const uct_obmm_ep_t          *ep = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep, uct_obmm_ep_t);
194.     const uct_obmm_device_addr_t *daddr;
195.     const uct_obmm_iface_addr_t  *iaddr;
196. 
197.     if (!uct_base_ep_is_connected(tl_ep, params)) {
198.         return 0;

201.     daddr = (const uct_obmm_device_addr_t*)params->device_addr;
202.     iaddr = (const uct_obmm_iface_addr_t*)params->iface_addr;
203.     if ((daddr == NULL) || (iaddr == NULL)) {

208.            (daddr->exporter_deid_hi == ep->peer_deid_hi) &&
209.            (daddr->exporter_deid_lo == ep->peer_deid_lo) &&
210.            (iaddr->slot_index == ep->peer_slot_index) &&
211.            (iaddr->generation == ep->expected_generation);

214. 
215. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_ep_am_short(uct_ep_h tl_ep, uint8_t id, uint64_t header,
216.                                   const void *payload, unsigned length)
217. {
218.     uct_obmm_ep_t           *ep    = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep, uct_obmm_ep_t);
219.     uct_obmm_iface_t        *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep->iface,
220.                                                     uct_obmm_iface_t);
221.     size_t                   payload_total = sizeof(header) + length;
222.     uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem;
223.     uint64_t                 head;
224.     uint8_t                  owner_bit;
225. 
226.     UCT_CHECK_AM_ID(id);
227.     UCT_CHECK_LENGTH(payload_total, 0,
228.                      ep->fifo_elem_size - sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_element_t),
229.                      "am_short");
230. 
231.     if (uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot(ep, &head) != UCS_OK) {
232.         return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
233.     }
234. 
235.     elem = uct_obmm_slot_elem(ep->peer_elems, head, ep->fifo_mask,
236.                               ep->fifo_elem_size);
237. 
238.     elem->am_id      = id;
239.     elem->length     = (uint16_t)payload_total;
240.     elem->generation = ep->expected_generation;
241.     elem->header     = header;
242.     if (length > 0) {
243.         memcpy(elem + 1, payload, length);
244.     }
245. 
246.     /* Publish: the OWNER bit toggles each wraparound. The receiver expects
247.      * bit==1 on even passes and bit==0 on odd passes (and vice versa) so
248.      * that uninitialized memory (zero) reads as "not yet written" on the
249.      * first pass. */
250.     owner_bit = ((head / ep->fifo_size) & 1u) ? 0u : UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER;
251. 
252.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
253.     elem->flags = owner_bit;
254. 
255.     UCT_TL_EP_STAT_OP(&ep->super, AM, SHORT, payload_total);
256.     uct_iface_trace_am(&iface->super, UCT_AM_TRACE_TYPE_SEND, id,
257.                        &header, payload_total, "TX: AM_SHORT");
258.     return UCS_OK;
259. }
260. 
261. 
262. /* Reserve one slot in the peer's FIFO, returning the head index that was
263.  * claimed. Multi-producer reservation is serialized with a token lock because
264.  * on target NC/aarch64 mappings, CAS updates memory but its return value is
265.  * not a reliable ownership result. */
266. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE ucs_status_t
267. uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot(uct_obmm_ep_t *ep, uint64_t *head_p)
268. {
269.     uint64_t head;
270. 
271.     if (!uct_obmm_ep_try_lock_head(ep)) {
272.         UCS_STATS_UPDATE_COUNTER(ep->super.stats, UCT_EP_STAT_NO_RES, 1);
273.         return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
274.     }
275. 
276.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
277.     head = ep->peer_ctl->head;
278. 
279.     if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
280.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
281.         ep->cached_tail = ep->peer_ctl->tail;
282.         if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
283.             UCS_STATS_UPDATE_COUNTER(ep->super.stats, UCT_EP_STAT_NO_RES, 1);
284.             uct_obmm_ep_unlock_head(ep);
285.             return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
286.         }
287.     }
288. 
289.     uct_obmm_bus_full_fence();
290.     ep->peer_ctl->head = head + 1;
291.     uct_obmm_ep_unlock_head(ep);
292. 
293.     *head_p = head;
294.     return UCS_OK;
295. }

297. 
298. ssize_t uct_obmm_ep_am_bcopy(uct_ep_h tl_ep, uint8_t id,
299.                              uct_pack_callback_t pack_cb, void *arg,
300.                              unsigned flags)
301. {
302.     uct_obmm_ep_t           *ep    = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep, uct_obmm_ep_t);
303.     uct_obmm_iface_t        *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep->iface,
304.                                                     uct_obmm_iface_t);
305.     uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem;
306.     void                    *desc;
307.     uint64_t                 head;
308.     size_t                   length;
309.     uint8_t                  owner_bit;
310.     ucs_status_t             status;
311. 
312.     /* flags (UCT_SEND_FLAG_PEER_CHECK etc.) are ignored: this transport
313.      * does not advertise EP_CHECK / keepalive in v1. */
314.     (void)flags;
315. 
316.     UCT_CHECK_AM_ID(id);
317. 
318.     status = uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot(ep, &head);
319.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
320.         return status;
321.     }
322. 
323.     elem = uct_obmm_slot_elem(ep->peer_elems, head, ep->fifo_mask,
324.                               ep->fifo_elem_size);
325.     desc = uct_obmm_slot_desc(ep->peer_descs, head, ep->fifo_mask,
326.                               ep->bcopy_seg_size);
327. 
328.     /* pack_cb writes pack_cb_ret bytes directly into the paired desc[N]
329.      * area. UCP guarantees pack_cb_ret <= cap.am.max_bcopy, which we set
330.      * to bcopy_seg_size. The asserts catch buggy direct UCT users in
331.      * debug builds; production safety relies on the iface cap contract. */
332.     length = pack_cb(desc, arg);
333.     ucs_assertv(length <= ep->bcopy_seg_size,
334.                 "obmm: pack_cb returned %zu > bcopy_seg_size=%u",
335.                 length, ep->bcopy_seg_size);
336.     ucs_assertv(length <= UINT16_MAX,
337.                 "obmm: pack_cb returned %zu > UINT16_MAX", length);
338. 
339.     elem->am_id      = id;
340.     elem->length     = (uint16_t)length;
341.     elem->generation = ep->expected_generation;
342.     elem->header     = 0; /* unused for bcopy */
343. 
344.     owner_bit = ((head / ep->fifo_size) & 1u) ? 0u :
345.                                                 UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER;
346. 
347.     /* Release barrier: orders the desc[N] payload writes AND elem header
348.      * writes BEFORE the flags publish. Receiver pairs with bus_load_fence
349.      * after observing the flags byte. */
350.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
351.     elem->flags = owner_bit | UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_BCOPY;
352. 
353.     UCT_TL_EP_STAT_OP(&ep->super, AM, BCOPY, length);
354.     uct_iface_trace_am(&iface->super, UCT_AM_TRACE_TYPE_SEND, id,
355.                        desc, length, "TX: AM_BCOPY");
356.     return (ssize_t)length;
357. }
358. 
359. 
360. /* Returns true iff the peer's FIFO has at least one free slot, refreshing
361.  * cached_tail (with a bus_load_fence pair) before declaring "full". Mirrors
362.  * the resource check used by mm in pending_add. */
363. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE int
364. uct_obmm_ep_has_tx_resource(uct_obmm_ep_t *ep)
365. {
366.     uint64_t head = ep->peer_ctl->head;
367. 
368.     if ((head - ep->cached_tail) < ep->fifo_size) {
369.         return 1;
370.     }
371.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
372.     ep->cached_tail = ep->peer_ctl->tail;
373.     return (head - ep->cached_tail) < ep->fifo_size;
374. }
375. 
376. 
377. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_ep_pending_add(uct_ep_h tl_ep, uct_pending_req_t *n,
378.                                      unsigned flags)
379. {
380.     uct_obmm_ep_t    *ep    = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep, uct_obmm_ep_t);
381.     uct_obmm_iface_t *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep->iface, uct_obmm_iface_t);
382. 
383.     (void)flags;
384. 
385.     /* Resources may have appeared between the failed send and this call;
386.      * tell UCP to retry directly instead of queueing. mm uses the same
387.      * pattern (mm_ep.c:452-456). */
388.     if (uct_obmm_ep_has_tx_resource(ep)) {
389.         ucs_assert(ucs_arbiter_group_is_empty(&ep->arb_group));
390.         return UCS_ERR_BUSY;
391.     }
392. 
393.     UCS_STATIC_ASSERT(sizeof(uct_pending_req_priv_arb_t) <=
394.                       UCT_PENDING_REQ_PRIV_LEN);
395.     uct_pending_req_arb_group_push(&ep->arb_group, n);
396.     ucs_arbiter_group_schedule(&iface->arbiter, &ep->arb_group);
397.     UCT_TL_EP_STAT_PEND(&ep->super);
398. 
399.     return UCS_OK;
400. }
401. 
402. 
403. ucs_arbiter_cb_result_t
404. uct_obmm_ep_process_pending(ucs_arbiter_t *arbiter, ucs_arbiter_group_t *group,
405.                             ucs_arbiter_elem_t *elem, void *arg)
406. {
407.     uct_obmm_ep_t     *ep    = ucs_container_of(group, uct_obmm_ep_t, arb_group);
408.     unsigned          *count = (unsigned*)arg;
409.     uct_pending_req_t *req;
410.     ucs_status_t       status;
411. 
412.     /* Refresh cached tail so the request callback's am_short/am_bcopy sees
413.      * the freshest peer state and is not falsely starved. */
414.     if (!uct_obmm_ep_has_tx_resource(ep)) {
415.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_RESCHED_GROUP;
416.     }
417. 
418.     req    = ucs_container_of(elem, uct_pending_req_t, priv);
419.     status = req->func(req);
420. 
421.     if (status == UCS_OK) {
422.         ++(*count);
423.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_REMOVE_ELEM;
424.     } else if (status == UCS_INPROGRESS) {
425.         ++(*count);
426.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_NEXT_GROUP;
427.     }
428. 
429.     /* NO_RESOURCE (or any other transient): keep the request and try
430.      * again the next time iface_progress runs. */
431.     return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_RESCHED_GROUP;
432. }

436.     uct_pending_purge_callback_t cb;
437.     void                        *arg;
438. } uct_obmm_purge_args_t;
439. 
440. 
441. static ucs_arbiter_cb_result_t
442. uct_obmm_ep_arbiter_purge_cb(ucs_arbiter_t *arbiter, ucs_arbiter_group_t *group,
443.                              ucs_arbiter_elem_t *elem, void *arg)
444. {
445.     uct_obmm_ep_t         *ep   = ucs_container_of(group, uct_obmm_ep_t,
446.                                                    arb_group);
447.     uct_obmm_purge_args_t *args = arg;
448.     uct_pending_req_t     *req;
449. 
450.     req = ucs_container_of(elem, uct_pending_req_t, priv);
451.     if (args->cb != NULL) {
452.         args->cb(req, args->arg);
453.     } else {
454.         ucs_warn("obmm: ep=%p canceling pending request %p", ep, req);
455.     }
456.     return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_REMOVE_ELEM;
457. }

227. static unsigned uct_obmm_iface_progress(uct_iface_h tl_iface)
228. {
229.     uct_obmm_iface_t        *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_iface, uct_obmm_iface_t);
230.     unsigned                 polled = 0;
231.     uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem;
232.     uint8_t                  flags;
233.     uint8_t                  expected_owner;
234.     size_t                   max_poll = iface->fifo_max_poll;
235. 
236.     while (polled < max_poll) {
237.         elem = uct_obmm_slot_elem(iface->recv_elems, iface->read_index,
238.                                   iface->fifo_mask, iface->fifo_elem_size);
239. 
240.         /* Owner bit alternates each lap of the ring; pass 0 expects 1, pass
241.          * 1 expects 0, etc. Combined with zero-fill on slot allocation, this
242.          * means an unwritten slot reads as flags==0 and is correctly skipped
243.          * on the very first lap. */
244.         expected_owner = ((iface->read_index / iface->fifo_size) & 1u) ?
245.                          0u : UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER;
246. 
247.         flags = elem->flags;
248.         if ((flags & UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER) != expected_owner) {
249.             break;
250.         }
251. 
252.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
253. 
254.         if (elem->generation != iface->generation) {
255.             /* Stale write from a previous slot owner (we were torn down and
256.              * re-allocated this slot). Drop silently. */
257.             ucs_trace_data("obmm: drop stale elem (gen=%u expected=%u) "
258.                            "at idx=%lu", elem->generation, iface->generation,
259.                            (unsigned long)iface->read_index);
260.         } else if (flags & UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_BCOPY) {
261.             /* am_bcopy: payload is in the paired desc[N], not in the FIFO
262.              * element body. The bus_load_fence above orders this load
263.              * with respect to the sender's bus_store_fence + flag write. */
264.             void *desc = uct_obmm_slot_desc(iface->recv_descs,
265.                                             iface->read_index,
266.                                             iface->fifo_mask,
267.                                             iface->bcopy_seg_size);
268.             uct_iface_invoke_am(&iface->super, elem->am_id,
269.                                 desc, elem->length, 0);
270.         } else {
271.             /* am_short: contiguous [header(8B)][payload] starting at
272.              * &elem->header. elem->length already includes the 8B header. */
273.             uct_iface_invoke_am(&iface->super, elem->am_id,
274.                                 &elem->header, elem->length, 0);
275.         }
276. 
277.         iface->read_index++;
278.         polled++;
279.     }
280. 
281.     if (polled > 0) {
282.         /* Full bus fence: orders the AM handler's LOADS from desc[]/elem
283.          * payload BEFORE the STORE that publishes the new tail. A plain
284.          * bus_store_fence (e.g. dmb oshst on aarch64) only orders
285.          * store→store, which would let a sender observe the advanced
286.          * tail and overwrite desc[N] while we still have outstanding
287.          * loads in flight. See obmm_fifo.h:uct_obmm_bus_full_fence. */
288.         uct_obmm_bus_full_fence();
289.         iface->recv_ctl->tail = iface->read_index;
290.     }
291. 
292.     /* Drain any UCP requests waiting on TX backpressure. The peer-side
293.      * tail advance we just published may also have freed slots that *our*
294.      * pending eps have been waiting for; dispatch with a fresh head/tail
295.      * snapshot so retries see the latest state. Without this dispatch,
296.      * UCS_ERR_BUSY-only pending_add caused a livelock under symmetric
297.      * bidirectional load at BCOPY_SEG_SIZE. */
298.     ucs_arbiter_dispatch(&iface->arbiter, 1, uct_obmm_ep_process_pending,
299.                          &polled);
300. 
301.     return polled;
302. }

38. static UCS_F_NOINLINE ucs_status_t
39. uct_mm_ep_attach_remote_seg(uct_mm_ep_t *ep, uct_mm_seg_id_t seg_id,
40.                             size_t length, void **address_p)
41. {
42.     uct_mm_iface_t *iface = ucs_derived_of(ep->super.super.iface,
43.                                            uct_mm_iface_t);
44.     uct_mm_remote_seg_t *remote_seg;
45.     ucs_status_t status;
46.     khiter_t khiter;
47.     int khret;
48. 
49.     khiter = kh_put(uct_mm_remote_seg, &ep->remote_segs, seg_id, &khret);
50.     if (khret == UCS_KH_PUT_FAILED) {
51.         ucs_error("failed to add remote segment to mm ep hash");
52.         return UCS_ERR_NO_MEMORY;
53.     }
54. 
55.     /* we expect the key would either be
56.      * never used (BUCKET_EMPTY) or deleted (BUCKET_CLEAR) */
57.     ucs_assert_always((khret == UCS_KH_PUT_BUCKET_EMPTY) ||
58.                       (khret == UCS_KH_PUT_BUCKET_CLEAR));
59. 
60.     remote_seg = &kh_val(&ep->remote_segs, khiter);
61. 
62.     status = uct_mm_iface_mapper_call(iface, mem_attach, seg_id, length,
63.                                       ep->remote_iface_addr, remote_seg);
64.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
65.         kh_del(uct_mm_remote_seg, &ep->remote_segs, khiter);
66.         return status;
67.     }
68. 
69.     *address_p = remote_seg->address;
70.     ucs_debug("mm_ep %p: attached remote segment id 0x%"PRIx64" at %p cookie %p",
71.               ep, seg_id, remote_seg->address, remote_seg->cookie);
72.     return UCS_OK;

107. /* send a signal to remote interface using Unix-domain socket */
108. static void uct_mm_ep_signal_remote(uct_mm_ep_t *ep)
109. {
110.     uct_mm_iface_t *iface = ucs_derived_of(ep->super.super.iface, uct_mm_iface_t);
111.     char dummy = 0;
112.     int ret;
113. 
114.     ucs_trace("ep %p: signal remote", ep);
115. 
116.     for (;;) {
117.         ret = sendto(iface->signal_fd, &dummy, sizeof(dummy), 0,
118.                      (const struct sockaddr*)&ep->fifo_ctl->signal_sockaddr,
119.                      ep->fifo_ctl->signal_addrlen);
120.         if (ucs_unlikely(ret < 0)) {
121.             if (errno == EINTR) {
122.                 /* Interrupted system call - retry */
123.                 continue;
124.             }
125.             if ((errno == EAGAIN) || (errno == ECONNREFUSED)) {
126.                 /* If we failed to signal because buffer is full - ignore the error
127.                  * since it means the remote side would get a signal anyway.
128.                  * If the remote side is not there - ignore the error as well.
129.                  */
130.                 ucs_trace("failed to send wakeup signal: %m");
131.                 return;
132.             } else {
133.                 ucs_warn("failed to send wakeup signal: %m");
134.                 return;
135.             }
136.         } else {
137.             ucs_assert(ret == sizeof(dummy));
138.             ucs_trace("sent wakeup from socket %d to %s", iface->signal_fd,
139.                       ep->fifo_ctl->signal_sockaddr.sun_path);
140.             return;
141.         }
142.     }
143. }

158. static UCS_CLASS_INIT_FUNC(uct_mm_ep_t, const uct_ep_params_t *params)
159. {
160.     uct_mm_iface_t            *iface = ucs_derived_of(params->iface, uct_mm_iface_t);
161.     uct_mm_md_t               *md    = ucs_derived_of(iface->super.super.md, uct_mm_md_t);
162.     const uct_mm_iface_addr_t *addr  = (const void *)params->iface_addr;
163.     ucs_status_t status;
164.     void *fifo_ptr;
165. 
166.     UCT_EP_PARAMS_CHECK_DEV_IFACE_ADDRS(params);
167.     UCS_CLASS_CALL_SUPER_INIT(uct_base_ep_t, &iface->super.super);
168. 
169.     kh_init_inplace(uct_mm_remote_seg, &self->remote_segs);
170.     ucs_arbiter_group_init(&self->arb_group);
171. 
172.     /* save remote md address */
173.     if (md->iface_addr_len > 0) {
174.         self->remote_iface_addr = ucs_malloc(md->iface_addr_len, "mm_md_addr");
175.         if (self->remote_iface_addr == NULL) {
176.             status = UCS_ERR_NO_MEMORY;
177.             goto err;
178.         }
179. 
180.         memcpy(self->remote_iface_addr, addr + 1, md->iface_addr_len);
181.     } else {
182.         self->remote_iface_addr = NULL;
183.     }
184. 
185.     /* Attach the remote FIFO, use the same method as bcopy descriptors */
186.     status = uct_mm_ep_get_remote_seg(self, addr->fifo_seg_id,
187.                                       UCT_MM_GET_FIFO_SIZE(iface), &fifo_ptr);
188.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
189.         ucs_error("mm ep failed to connect to remote FIFO id 0x%"PRIx64": %s",
190.                   addr->fifo_seg_id, ucs_status_string(status));
191.         goto err_free_md_addr;
192.     }
193. 
194.     /* Initialize remote FIFO control structure */
195.     uct_mm_iface_set_fifo_ptrs(fifo_ptr, &self->fifo_ctl, &self->fifo_elems);
196.     self->cached_tail = self->fifo_ctl->tail;
197.     ucs_arbiter_elem_init(&self->arb_elem);
198. 
199.     status = uct_ep_keepalive_init(&self->keepalive, self->fifo_ctl->pid);
200.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
201.         goto err_free_segs;
202.     }
203. 
204.     ucs_debug("created mm ep %p, connected to remote FIFO id 0x%"PRIx64,
205.               self, addr->fifo_seg_id);
206. 
207.     return UCS_OK;
208. 
209. err_free_segs:
210.     uct_mm_ep_cleanup_remote_segs(self);
211. err_free_md_addr:
212.     ucs_free(self->remote_iface_addr);
213. err:
214.     return status;
215. }

468. ucs_arbiter_cb_result_t uct_mm_ep_process_pending(ucs_arbiter_t *arbiter,
469.                                                   ucs_arbiter_group_t *group,
470.                                                   ucs_arbiter_elem_t *elem,
471.                                                   void *arg)
472. {
473.     uct_mm_ep_t *ep        = ucs_container_of(group, uct_mm_ep_t, arb_group);
474.     unsigned *count        = (unsigned*)arg;
475.     uct_pending_req_t *req;
476.     ucs_status_t status;
477. 
478.     /* update the local tail with its actual value from the remote peer
479.      * making sure that the pending sends would use the real tail value */
480.     uct_mm_ep_update_cached_tail(ep);
481. 
482.     if (!uct_mm_ep_has_tx_resources(ep)) {
483.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_RESCHED_GROUP;
484.     }
485. 
486.     if (elem == &ep->arb_elem) {
487.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_REMOVE_ELEM;
488.     }
489. 
490.     req = ucs_container_of(elem, uct_pending_req_t, priv);
491. 
492.     ucs_trace_data("progressing pending request %p", req);
493.     status = req->func(req);
494.     ucs_trace_data("status returned from progress pending: %s",
495.                    ucs_status_string(status));
496. 
497.     if (status == UCS_OK) {
498.         (*count)++;
499.         /* sent successfully. remove from the arbiter */
500.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_REMOVE_ELEM;
501.     } else if (status == UCS_INPROGRESS) {
502.         (*count)++;
503.         /* sent but not completed, keep in the arbiter */
504.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_NEXT_GROUP;
505.     } else {
506.         /* couldn't send. keep this request in the arbiter until the next time
507.          * this function is called */
508.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_RESCHED_GROUP;
509.     }
510. }

404. uct_obmm_ep_process_pending(ucs_arbiter_t *arbiter, ucs_arbiter_group_t *group,
405.                             ucs_arbiter_elem_t *elem, void *arg)

408.     unsigned          *count = (unsigned*)arg;
409.     uct_pending_req_t *req;
410.     ucs_status_t       status;
411. 
412.     /* Refresh cached tail so the request callback's am_short/am_bcopy sees
413.      * the freshest peer state and is not falsely starved. */
414.     if (!uct_obmm_ep_has_tx_resource(ep)) {
415.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_RESCHED_GROUP;

424.     } else if (status == UCS_INPROGRESS) {
425.         ++(*count);
426.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_NEXT_GROUP;
427.     }

429.     /* NO_RESOURCE (or any other transient): keep the request and try
430.      * again the next time iface_progress runs. */

27. uct_obmm_ep_make_lock_token(uct_obmm_iface_t *iface, const uct_obmm_ep_t *ep)
28. {
29.     uint64_t token;
30. 
31.     token = iface->region->info.exporter_dcna ^
32.             iface->region->info.exporter_deid.hi ^
33.             iface->region->info.exporter_deid.lo ^
34.             ((uint64_t)iface->slot_index << 32) ^
35.             iface->generation ^
36.             (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)ep;
37.     return (token == 0) ? 1 : token;
38. }

42. uct_obmm_ep_try_lock_head(uct_obmm_ep_t *ep)
43. {
44.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
45.     if (ep->peer_ctl->lock != 0) {
46.         return 0;
47.     }
48. 
49.     (void)ucs_atomic_cswap64(&ep->peer_ctl->lock, 0, ep->lock_token);
50.     uct_obmm_bus_full_fence();

364. uct_obmm_ep_has_tx_resource(uct_obmm_ep_t *ep)
365. {
366.     uint64_t head = ep->peer_ctl->head;
367. 
368.     if ((head - ep->cached_tail) < ep->fifo_size) {
369.         return 1;
370.     }
371.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
372.     ep->cached_tail = ep->peer_ctl->tail;
373.     return (head - ep->cached_tail) < ep->fifo_size;

404. ucs_arbiter_cb_result_t
405. uct_obmm_ep_process_pending(ucs_arbiter_t *arbiter, ucs_arbiter_group_t *group,
406.                             ucs_arbiter_elem_t *elem, void *arg)
407. {
408.     uct_obmm_ep_t     *ep    = ucs_container_of(group, uct_obmm_ep_t, arb_group);
409.     unsigned          *count = (unsigned*)arg;
410.     uct_pending_req_t *req;
411.     ucs_status_t       status;
412. 
413.     /* Refresh cached tail so the request callback's am_short/am_bcopy sees
414.      * the freshest peer state and is not falsely starved. */
415.     if (!uct_obmm_ep_has_tx_resource(ep)) {
416.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_RESCHED_GROUP;
417.     }
418. 
419.     req    = ucs_container_of(elem, uct_pending_req_t, priv);
420.     status = req->func(req);
421. 
422.     if (status == UCS_OK) {
423.         ++(*count);
424.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_REMOVE_ELEM;
425.     } else if (status == UCS_INPROGRESS) {
426.         ++(*count);
427.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_NEXT_GROUP;
428.     }
429. 
430.     /* NO_RESOURCE (or any other transient): keep the request and try
431.      * again the next time iface_progress runs. */
432.     return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_RESCHED_GROUP;
433. }
434.

267. uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot(uct_obmm_ep_t *ep, uint64_t *head_p)
268. {
269.     uint64_t head;
270. 
271.     if (!uct_obmm_ep_try_lock_head(ep)) {
272.         UCS_STATS_UPDATE_COUNTER(ep->super.stats, UCT_EP_STAT_NO_RES, 1);
273.         return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
274.     }
275. 
276.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
277.     head = ep->peer_ctl->head;
278. 
279.     if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
280.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
281.         ep->cached_tail = ep->peer_ctl->tail;
282.         if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
283.             UCS_STATS_UPDATE_COUNTER(ep->super.stats, UCT_EP_STAT_NO_RES, 1);
284.             uct_obmm_ep_unlock_head(ep);
285.             return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
286.         }
287.     }
288. 
289.     uct_obmm_bus_full_fence();
290.     ep->peer_ctl->head = head + 1;
291.     uct_obmm_ep_unlock_head(ep);
292. 
293.     *head_p = head;
294.     return UCS_OK;
295. }
