```
226. /* Try to claim slot `idx` for the current process. Returns 1 on success
227.  * (bit was set by us, meta updated). Slots transition through CLAIMING so a
228.  * second process cannot take over while allocation/free is still publishing
229.  * ownership metadata. Dead owners (including crashed CLAIMING/DEAD states) may
230.  * be scavenged. Returns 0 if the slot is currently unclaimable. */
231. static int uct_obmm_pool_try_claim(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t idx,
232.                                    uint32_t self_pid, uint64_t self_starttime,
233.                                    uint32_t *generation_p)
234. {
235.     volatile uint64_t    *word    = &pool->bitmap[idx >> 6];
236.     uint64_t              bit     = 1ull << (idx & 63u);
237.     uct_obmm_slot_meta_t *m       = &pool->meta[idx];
238.     uint64_t              cur, oldval;
239.     uint32_t              state, rollback_state, state_prev, owner_pid;
240.     uint64_t              owner_starttime;
241.     int                   take_over = 0;
242. 
243.     if (!uct_obmm_pool_is_ready(pool)) {
244.         return 0;
245.     }
246. 
247.     cur = *word;
248.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
249.     state           = m->state;
250.     rollback_state  = state;
251.     owner_pid       = m->owner_pid;
252.     owner_starttime = m->owner_starttime;
253. 
254.     if (!(cur & bit)) {
255.         /* A crashed claimer may leave CLAIMING behind with bit still clear.
256.          * Reset it to FREE once its owner is known dead, then retry normal
257.          * allocation from the FREE state. */
258.         if (state == UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_CLAIMING) {
259.             if ((owner_pid == 0) ||
260.                 uct_obmm_proc_alive(owner_pid, owner_starttime)) {
261.                 return 0;
262.             }
263. 
264.             state_prev = ucs_atomic_cswap32(&m->state,
265.                                             UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_CLAIMING,
266.                                             UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE);
267.             if (state_prev != UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_CLAIMING) {
268.                 return 0;
269.             }
270.             state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE;
271.         }
272. 
273.         if (state != UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE) {
274.             return 0;
275.         }
276. 
277.         state_prev = ucs_atomic_cswap32(&m->state, UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE,
278.                                         UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_CLAIMING);
279.         if (state_prev != UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE) {
280.             return 0;
281.         }
282. 
283.         m->owner_pid       = self_pid;
284.         m->owner_starttime = self_starttime;
285.         ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
286. 
287.         /* free: reserve the bitmap bit only after state moved to CLAIMING */
288.         oldval = ucs_atomic_cswap64(word, cur, cur | bit);
289.         if (oldval != cur) {
290.             m->owner_pid       = 0;
291.             m->owner_starttime = 0;
292.             ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
293.             m->state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE;
294.             ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
295.             return 0; /* lost the race; caller will retry next slot */
296.         }
297.     } else {
298.         switch (state) {
299.         case UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_CLAIMING:
300.             if ((owner_pid == 0) ||
301.                 uct_obmm_proc_alive(owner_pid, owner_starttime)) {
302.                 return 0;
303.             }
304. 
305.             state_prev = ucs_atomic_cswap32(&m->state,
306.                                             UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_CLAIMING,
307.                                             UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_DEAD);
308.             if (state_prev != UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_CLAIMING) {
309.                 return 0;
310.             }
311.             state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_DEAD;
312.             /* fall through */
313.         case UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_DEAD:
314.             if ((owner_pid != 0) &&
315.                 uct_obmm_proc_alive(owner_pid, owner_starttime)) {
316.                 return 0;
317.             }
318. 
319.             state_prev = ucs_atomic_cswap32(&m->state,
320.                                             UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_DEAD,
321.                                             UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_CLAIMING);
322.             if (state_prev != UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_DEAD) {
323.                 return 0;
324.             }
325.             take_over = 1;
326.             break;
327.         case UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_IN_USE:
328.             if ((owner_pid != 0) &&
329.                 uct_obmm_proc_alive(owner_pid, owner_starttime)) {
330.                 return 0;
331.             }
332. 
333.             state_prev = ucs_atomic_cswap32(&m->state,
334.                                             UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_IN_USE,
335.                                             UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_CLAIMING);
336.             if (state_prev != UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_IN_USE) {
337.                 return 0;
338.             }
339.             take_over = 1;
340.             break;
341.         default:
342.             return 0;
343.         }
344.     }
345. 
346.     if (!uct_obmm_pool_is_ready(pool)) {
347.         if (take_over) {
348.             m->state = rollback_state;
349.             ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
350.         } else {
351.             uct_obmm_pool_clear_bit(word, bit);
352.             m->owner_pid       = 0;
353.             m->owner_starttime = 0;
354.             ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
355.             m->state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE;
356.             ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
357.         }
358.         return 0;
359.     }
360. 
361.     if (take_over) {
362.         m->owner_pid       = self_pid;
363.         m->owner_starttime = self_starttime;
364.         ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
365.     }
366. 
367.     /* Bump generation so any in-flight stale messages from prior owner are
368.      * dropped by the receive path. memset slot bytes only AFTER bumping
369.      * generation, so any racing writer's bytes won't survive un-stamped. */
370.     m->generation += 1;
371.     /* Zero the slot bytes for our use (FIFO ctl + elements). */
372.     memset(uct_obmm_pool_slot_ptr(pool, idx), 0, pool->slot_size);
373.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
374.     m->state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_IN_USE;
375.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
376. 
377.     *generation_p = m->generation;
378.     (void)take_over;
379.     return 1;
380. }

383. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_alloc_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool,
384.                                       uint32_t *slot_index_p,
385.                                       void **slot_ptr_p,
386.                                       uint32_t *generation_p)
387. {
388.     uint32_t      self_pid       = (uint32_t)getpid();
389.     unsigned long self_starttime = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time(getpid());
390.     uint32_t      i;
391. 
392.     if (self_starttime == 0ul) {
393.         ucs_warn("obmm: cannot read self process start time; "
394.                  "scavenge will treat us as dead");
395.     }
396. 
397.     for (i = 0; i < pool->slot_count; ++i) {
398.         if (!uct_obmm_pool_is_ready(pool)) {
399.             return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
400.         }
401.         if (uct_obmm_pool_try_claim(pool, i, self_pid,
402.                                     (uint64_t)self_starttime, generation_p)) {
403.             *slot_index_p = i;
404.             *slot_ptr_p   = uct_obmm_pool_slot_ptr(pool, i);
405.             return UCS_OK;
406.         }
407.     }
408. 
409.     return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
410. }

413. static int uct_obmm_pool_all_slots_free(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool)
414. {
415.     uint32_t i;
416. 
417.     for (i = 0; i < pool->hdr->bitmap_words; ++i) {
418.         if (pool->bitmap[i] != 0) {
419.             return 0;
420.         }
421.     }
422. 
423.     return 1;
424. }

427. int uct_obmm_pool_free_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t slot_index)
428. {
429.     volatile uint64_t    *word = &pool->bitmap[slot_index >> 6];
430.     uint64_t              bit  = 1ull << (slot_index & 63u);
431.     uct_obmm_slot_meta_t *m    = &pool->meta[slot_index];
432.     unsigned long         self_starttime;
433.     uint32_t              state_prev;
434. 
435.     /* Bump generation first so any in-flight stale messages are discarded by
436.      * a future re-using owner; mark DEAD and bus fence before clearing the
437.      * bit so a racing claimer sees the new generation. */
438.     m->generation += 1;
439.     m->state       = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_DEAD;
440.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
441. 
442.     uct_obmm_pool_clear_bit(word, bit);
443. 
444.     m->owner_pid       = 0;
445.     m->owner_starttime = 0;
446.     m->state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE;
447.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
448. 
449.     if (!uct_obmm_pool_all_slots_free(pool)) {
450.         return 0;
451.     }
452. 
453.     state_prev = ucs_atomic_cswap32(&pool->hdr->state, UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY,
454.                                     UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_INITING);
455.     if (state_prev != UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
456.         return 0;
457.     }
458. 
459.     self_starttime = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time(getpid());
460.     pool->hdr->initializer_pid       = (uint32_t)getpid();
461.     pool->hdr->initializer_starttime = (uint64_t)self_starttime;
462.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
463. 
464.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
465.     if (!uct_obmm_pool_all_slots_free(pool)) {
466.         ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
467.         pool->hdr->state = UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY;
468.         return 0;
469.     }
470. 
471.     return 1;
472. }

475. void uct_obmm_pool_reset(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool)
476. {
477.     uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t *hdr;
478.     char                *base;
479.     size_t               length;
480.     size_t               state_offset;
481.     size_t               state_end;
482.     size_t               init_pid_offset;
483.     size_t               init_start_offset;
484.     size_t               init_end;
485. 
486.     if ((pool == NULL) || (pool->hdr == NULL) || (pool->base == NULL)) {
487.         return;
488.     }
489. 
490.     hdr = pool->hdr;
491.     base   = (char*)pool->base;
492.     length = pool->length;
493. 
494.     state_offset      = offsetof(uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t, state);
495.     state_end         = state_offset + sizeof(hdr->state);
496.     init_pid_offset   = offsetof(uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t, initializer_pid);
497.     init_start_offset = offsetof(uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t, initializer_starttime);
498.     init_end          = init_start_offset + sizeof(hdr->initializer_starttime);
499. 
500.     if (state_offset > 0) {
501.         memset(base, 0, state_offset);
502.     }
503.     if (init_pid_offset > state_end) {
504.         memset(base + state_end, 0, init_pid_offset - state_end);
505.     }
506.     if (length > init_end) {
507.         memset(base + init_end, 0, length - init_end);
508.     }
509.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
510. 
511.     hdr->initializer_pid       = 0;
512.     hdr->initializer_starttime = 0;
513.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
514. 
515.     hdr->state = UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT;
516.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
517. 
518.     memset(pool, 0, sizeof(*pool));
519. }

522. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_open(void *region_base, size_t region_size,
523.                                 uct_obmm_pool_t *pool)
524. {
525.     uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t *hdr = (uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t*)region_base;
526.     uint32_t             state;
527.     uint32_t             slot_count, slot_size;
528.     size_t               required;
529. 
530.     if (region_size < sizeof(*hdr)) {
531.         return UCS_ERR_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL;
532.     }
533. 
534.     state = hdr->state;
535.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
536.     if (state != UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
537.         ucs_debug("obmm: pool at %p not READY (state=%u)", region_base, state);
538.         return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
539.     }
540. 
541.     if (hdr->magic != UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC) {
542.         ucs_error("obmm: pool magic mismatch on open (got 0x%lx)",
543.                   (unsigned long)hdr->magic);
544.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
545.     }
546. 
547.     slot_count = hdr->slot_count;
548.     slot_size  = hdr->slot_size;
549.     if ((slot_count == 0) || (slot_size == 0)) {
550.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
551.     }
552. 
553.     required = uct_obmm_pool_required_size(slot_count, slot_size);
554.     if (region_size < required) {
555.         ucs_error("obmm: peer pool geometry exceeds region size "
556.                   "(slots=%u, slot_size=%u, region=%zu, required=%zu)",
557.                   slot_count, slot_size, region_size, required);
558.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
559.     }
560. 
561.     pool->base       = region_base;
562.     pool->length     = region_size;
563.     pool->hdr        = hdr;
564.     pool->bitmap     = (volatile uint64_t*)((char*)hdr + sizeof(*hdr));
565.     pool->meta       = (uct_obmm_slot_meta_t*)((char*)hdr +
566.                                                uct_obmm_pool_meta_offset(slot_count));
567.     pool->slots      = (char*)hdr + hdr->slot_array_offset;
568.     pool->slot_count = slot_count;
569.     pool->slot_size  = slot_size;
570.     return UCS_OK;
571. }
572.
```

```
337. uct_mm_iface_fifo_has_new_data(uct_mm_iface_t *iface)

345. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE unsigned
346. uct_mm_iface_poll_fifo(uct_mm_iface_t *iface)
347. {
348.     if (!uct_mm_iface_fifo_has_new_data(iface)) {
349.         return 0;
350.     }
351. 
352.     /* read from read_index_elem */
353.     ucs_memory_cpu_load_fence();
354.     ucs_assert(iface->read_index <=
355.                (iface->recv_fifo_ctl->head & ~UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_HEAD_EVENT_ARMED));
356. 
357.     uct_mm_iface_process_recv(iface);
358. 
359.     /* raise the read_index */
360.     iface->read_index++;
361. 
362.     /* the next fifo_element which the read_index points to */
363.     iface->read_index_elem =
364.         UCT_MM_IFACE_GET_FIFO_ELEM(iface, iface->recv_fifo_elems,
365.                                    (iface->read_index & iface->fifo_mask));
366. 
367.     uct_mm_progress_fifo_tail(iface);
368. 
369.     return 1;
370. }

372. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void
373. uct_mm_iface_fifo_window_adjust(uct_mm_iface_t *iface,
374.                                 unsigned fifo_poll_count)
375. {
376.     if (fifo_poll_count < iface->fifo_poll_count) {
377.         iface->fifo_poll_count = ucs_max(iface->fifo_poll_count /
378.                                          UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_MD_FACTOR,
379.                                          UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_MIN_POLL);
380.         iface->fifo_prev_wnd_cons = 0;
381.         return;
382.     }
383. 
384.     ucs_assert(fifo_poll_count == iface->fifo_poll_count);
385. 
386.     if (iface->fifo_prev_wnd_cons) {
387.         /* Increase FIFO window size if it was fully consumed
388.          * during the previous iface progress call in order
389.          * to prevent the situation when the window will be
390.          * adjusted to [MIN, MIN + 1, MIN, MIN + 1, ...] that
391.          * is harmful to latency */
392.         iface->fifo_poll_count = ucs_min(iface->fifo_poll_count +
393.                                          UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_AI_VALUE,
394.                                          iface->config.fifo_max_poll);
395.     } else {
396.         iface->fifo_prev_wnd_cons = 1;
397.     }
398. }

400. static unsigned uct_mm_iface_progress(uct_iface_h tl_iface)
401. {
402.     uct_mm_iface_t *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_iface, uct_mm_iface_t);
403.     unsigned total_count  = 0;
404.     unsigned count;
405. 
406.     ucs_assert(iface->fifo_poll_count >= UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_MIN_POLL);
407. 
408.     /* progress receive */
409.     do {
410.         count = uct_mm_iface_poll_fifo(iface);
411.         ucs_assert(count < 2);
412.         total_count += count;
413.         ucs_assert(total_count < UINT_MAX);
414.     } while ((count != 0) && (total_count < iface->fifo_poll_count));
415. 
416.     uct_mm_iface_fifo_window_adjust(iface, total_count);
417. 
418.     /* progress the pending sends (if there are any) */
419.     ucs_arbiter_dispatch(&iface->arbiter, 1, uct_mm_ep_process_pending,
420.                          &total_count);
421. 
422.     return total_count;
423. }
```

```
229. static inline ucs_status_t
230. uct_mm_ep_get_remote_elem(uct_mm_ep_t *ep, uint64_t head,
231.                           uct_mm_fifo_element_t **elem)
232. {

234.     uint64_t new_head, prev_head;
235.     uint64_t elem_index;   /* index of the element to write */
236. 
237.     elem_index = head & iface->fifo_mask;
238.     *elem      = UCT_MM_IFACE_GET_FIFO_ELEM(iface, ep->fifo_elems, elem_index);
239.     new_head   = (head + 1) & ~UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_HEAD_EVENT_ARMED;
240. 
241.     /* try to get ownership of the head element */
242.     prev_head = ucs_atomic_cswap64(ucs_unaligned_ptr(&ep->fifo_ctl->head), head,
243.                                    new_head);

246.     }
247. 
248.     return UCS_OK;

252. {

255. }

258.                                                      unsigned flags)

261.         uct_ep_keepalive_check(&ep->super.super, &ep->keepalive,
262.                                ep->fifo_ctl->pid, 0, NULL);
263.     }
264. }

267. uct_mm_ep_no_resources_handle(uct_mm_ep_t *ep, unsigned flags)
268. {
```

```
468. ucs_arbiter_cb_result_t uct_mm_ep_process_pending(ucs_arbiter_t *arbiter,
469.                                                   ucs_arbiter_group_t *group,
470.                                                   ucs_arbiter_elem_t *elem,
471.                                                   void *arg)
472. {
473.     uct_mm_ep_t *ep        = ucs_container_of(group, uct_mm_ep_t, arb_group);
474.     unsigned *count        = (unsigned*)arg;
475.     uct_pending_req_t *req;
476.     ucs_status_t status;
477. 
478.     /* update the local tail with its actual value from the remote peer
479.      * making sure that the pending sends would use the real tail value */
480.     uct_mm_ep_update_cached_tail(ep);
481. 
482.     if (!uct_mm_ep_has_tx_resources(ep)) {
483.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_RESCHED_GROUP;
484.     }
485. 
486.     if (elem == &ep->arb_elem) {
487.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_REMOVE_ELEM;
488.     }
489. 
490.     req = ucs_container_of(elem, uct_pending_req_t, priv);
491. 
492.     ucs_trace_data("progressing pending request %p", req);
493.     status = req->func(req);
494.     ucs_trace_data("status returned from progress pending: %s",
495.                    ucs_status_string(status));
496. 
497.     if (status == UCS_OK) {
498.         (*count)++;
499.         /* sent successfully. remove from the arbiter */
500.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_REMOVE_ELEM;
501.     } else if (status == UCS_INPROGRESS) {
502.         (*count)++;
503.         /* sent but not completed, keep in the arbiter */
504.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_NEXT_GROUP;
505.     } else {
506.         /* couldn't send. keep this request in the arbiter until the next time
507.          * this function is called */
508.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_RESCHED_GROUP;
509.     }
510. }
```

### 💬 Copilot

Static-only read; highest-signal suspects:

- **Most likely: head-lock contention is still treated as “retry now”, not real backpressure.** `try_lock_head()` fails whenever `peer_ctl-\>lock` is nonzero (`ucx\src\uct\obmm\base\obmm_ep.c:42-52`), `reserve_slot()` maps that to `UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE` (`...obmm_ep.c:267-294`), then `pending_add()` returns **`UCS_ERR_BUSY`** if FIFO space exists and the per-EP queue is empty (`...obmm_ep.c:377-401`). In UCT/UCP, BUSY means “not queued; retry immediately” (`ucx\src\uct\api\uct.h:3194-3210`, `ucx\src\ucp\core\ucp_request.c:324-339`). That matches **4-proc cross-node fan-in** and fixed-1B short traffic. obmm already documents a prior BUSY-only livelock (`...obmm_iface.c:293-300`).

- **Secondary: lock ownership is inferred from a collision-prone token.** `lock_token` is XOR-built from local fields and a process-local pointer (`...obmm_ep.c:27-37`); success is inferred by `peer_ctl-\>lock == ep-\>lock_token` (`...obmm_ep.c:42-52`). A token collision would recreate silent message loss / head double-claim symptoms.

- **Secondary ordering defect:** `iface_fence` / `ep_fence` still use `ucs_memory_cpu_fence()` (`...obmm_iface.c:306-320`) even though obmm design requires **bus-domain** fences for cross-host NC visibility (`ucx\src\uct\obmm\DESIGN.md:25-28`).

**Next logging:** rate-limited logs/counters in `try_lock_head()` and `pending_add()` for `lock`, `lock_token`, `head`, `tail`, `cached_tail`, peer slot, local pid/slot/gen, arbiter-empty, and whether BUSY was returned; also log token once at EP create and count stale-drop events at `...obmm_iface.c:255-260`.

```
128. /* Full bus-domain fence: orders ALL prior memory accesses (loads and
129.  * stores) before ALL subsequent memory accesses, in the outer-shareable /
130.  * device domain that includes cross-host obmm peers.
131.  *
132.  * Why we need this in addition to ucs_memory_bus_{store,load}_fence:
133.  * the receiver must order its desc[N] LOADS (issued during the AM
134.  * handler) before the STORE that publishes the new tail. On ARM64,
135.  * ucs_memory_bus_store_fence() is `dmb oshst` (store→store only) and
136.  * does not order prior loads. Without this load→store barrier, a sender
137.  * could observe the advanced tail and overwrite desc[N] while the
138.  * receiver still has outstanding loads from the previous lap's payload.
139.  *
140.  * Defined locally in obmm rather than added to ucs/arch to keep the
141.  * change inside ucx/src/uct/obmm/ per AGENTS.md. */
142. #if defined(__aarch64__)
143. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() __asm__ __volatile__("dmb osh" ::: "memory")
144. #elif defined(__x86_64__) || defined(__i386__)
145. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() __asm__ __volatile__("mfence" ::: "memory")
146. #elif defined(__powerpc64__)
147. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() __asm__ __volatile__("sync" ::: "memory")
148. #elif defined(__riscv) && (__riscv_xlen == 64)
149. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() \
150.     __asm__ __volatile__("fence iorw, iorw" ::: "memory")
151. #else
152. /* Fallback: combine store + load fences. Not strictly load→store on all
153.  * archs but better than nothing; build will warn so the porter notices. */
154. #warning "obmm: no full bus fence for this arch; receiver tail release ordering may be weak"
155. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() do { \
156.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();        \
157.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();       \
158. } while (0)
159. #endif
160. 
161. #endif
162.
```

```
125.         hdr->magic                 = UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC;

128.         hdr->slot_array_offset     = slot_off;
```

## Issue: Race condition in diagnostic read of `last_no_res_reason`
**File:** ucx/src/uct/obmm/base/obmm_ep.c:403
**Severity:** Medium
**Problem:** The diagnostic code in `uct_obmm_ep_pending_add` reads `ep-\>last_no_res_reason` without synchronization after the call to `uct_obmm_ep_has_tx_resource(ep)`. This creates a race condition where:

1. Thread A calls `uct_obmm_ep_am_short()` → `uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot()` sets `last_no_res_reason = UCT_OBMM_EP_NO_RES_LOCK_BUSY` and returns `UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE`
2. Thread A returns to user code with `UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE`
3. **Thread B** concurrently calls `uct_obmm_ep_am_short()` → `uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot()` and **succeeds**, overwriting `ep-\>last_no_res_reason = UCT_OBMM_EP_NO_RES_NONE` (line 304)
4. Thread A's user code calls `uct_obmm_ep_pending_add()` and reads `ep-\>last_no_res_reason` at line 403, seeing `UCT_OBMM_EP_NO_RES_NONE` instead of the expected `UCT_OBMM_EP_NO_RES_LOCK_BUSY`

**Evidence:** 
- `last_no_res_reason` is a plain `uint8_t` field with no atomic protection
- It's written by `uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot()` which can be called concurrently by multiple send operations on the same endpoint
- It's read in `uct_obmm_ep_pending_add()` which is called *after* the send returns, creating a gap where another send can overwrite the value
- The only serialization is the head lock, which is already released when `last_no_res_reason` is set to `UCT_OBMM_EP_NO_RES_NONE` (line 304 is after `uct_obmm_ep_unlock_head` at line 302)

**Suggested fix:** The diagnostic should sample `last_no_res_reason` immediately inside `uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot()` before returning, or use a thread-local/stack variable to pass the reason back through the return path. Sampling it later in `pending_add` will see stale or wrong values in concurrent scenarios. Alternatively, accept that the diagnostic is best-effort and may misattribute causes in multi-threaded cases.

```
264. /* Reserve one slot in the peer's FIFO, returning the head index that was
265.  * claimed. Multi-producer reservation is serialized with a token lock because
266.  * on target NC/aarch64 mappings, CAS updates memory but its return value is
267.  * not a reliable ownership result. */
268. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE ucs_status_t
269. uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot(uct_obmm_ep_t *ep, uint64_t *head_p)
270. {
271.     uint64_t head;
272. 
273.     if (!uct_obmm_ep_try_lock_head(ep)) {
274.         if (uct_obmm_ep_has_tx_resource(ep) &&
275.             (ucs_atomic_cswap32(&uct_obmm_lock_busy_retry_logged, 0, 1) == 0)) {
276.             ucs_error("obmm: lock busy returned NO_RESOURCE while FIFO still "
277.                       "had tx resource; pending_add may convert this to BUSY "
278.                       "retry (peer slot=%u pid=%u lock=0x%llx token=0x%llx "
279.                       "head=%llu tail=%llu cached_tail=%llu fifo=%u)",
280.                       ep->peer_slot_index, ep->peer_pid,
281.                       (unsigned long long)ep->peer_ctl->lock,
282.                       (unsigned long long)ep->lock_token,
283.                       (unsigned long long)ep->peer_ctl->head,
284.                       (unsigned long long)ep->peer_ctl->tail,
285.                       (unsigned long long)ep->cached_tail, ep->fifo_size);
286.         }
287.         UCS_STATS_UPDATE_COUNTER(ep->super.stats, UCT_EP_STAT_NO_RES, 1);
288.         return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
289.     }
290. 
291.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
292.     head = ep->peer_ctl->head;
293. 
294.     if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
295.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
296.         ep->cached_tail = ep->peer_ctl->tail;
297.         if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
298.             UCS_STATS_UPDATE_COUNTER(ep->super.stats, UCT_EP_STAT_NO_RES, 1);
299.             uct_obmm_ep_unlock_head(ep);
300.             return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
301.         }
302.     }
303. 
304.     uct_obmm_bus_full_fence();
305.     ep->peer_ctl->head = head + 1;
306.     uct_obmm_ep_unlock_head(ep);
307. 
308.     *head_p = head;
309.     return UCS_OK;
310. }
311.
```

```bash
  -x UCX_TLS=obmm -x UCX_OBMM_MEMIDS=1,2 \
```

我在 `ucx\src\uct\obmm\base\obmm_ep.c:67-68` 补了这个前置声明：

```c
static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE int
uct_obmm_ep_has_tx_resource(uct_obmm_ep_t *ep);
```

```
267. /* Reserve one slot in the peer's FIFO, returning the head index that was
268.  * claimed. Multi-producer reservation is serialized with a token lock because
269.  * on target NC/aarch64 mappings, CAS updates memory but its return value is
270.  * not a reliable ownership result. */
271. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE ucs_status_t
272. uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot(uct_obmm_ep_t *ep, uint64_t *head_p)
273. {
274.     uint64_t head;
275. 
276.     if (!uct_obmm_ep_try_lock_head(ep)) {
277.         if (uct_obmm_ep_has_tx_resource(ep) &&
278.             (ucs_atomic_cswap32(&uct_obmm_lock_busy_retry_logged, 0, 1) == 0)) {
279.             ucs_error("obmm: lock busy returned NO_RESOURCE while FIFO still "
280.                       "had tx resource; pending_add may convert this to BUSY "
281.                       "retry (peer slot=%u pid=%u lock=0x%llx token=0x%llx "
282.                       "head=%llu tail=%llu cached_tail=%llu fifo=%u)",
283.                       ep->peer_slot_index, ep->peer_pid,
284.                       (unsigned long long)ep->peer_ctl->lock,
285.                       (unsigned long long)ep->lock_token,
286.                       (unsigned long long)ep->peer_ctl->head,
287.                       (unsigned long long)ep->peer_ctl->tail,
288.                       (unsigned long long)ep->cached_tail, ep->fifo_size);
289.         }
290.         UCS_STATS_UPDATE_COUNTER(ep->super.stats, UCT_EP_STAT_NO_RES, 1);
291.         return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
292.     }
293. 
294.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
295.     head = ep->peer_ctl->head;
296. 
297.     if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
298.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
299.         ep->cached_tail = ep->peer_ctl->tail;
300.         if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
301.             UCS_STATS_UPDATE_COUNTER(ep->super.stats, UCT_EP_STAT_NO_RES, 1);
302.             uct_obmm_ep_unlock_head(ep);
303.             return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
304.         }
305.     }
306. 
307.     uct_obmm_bus_full_fence();
308.     ep->peer_ctl->head = head + 1;
309.     uct_obmm_ep_unlock_head(ep);
310. 
311.     *head_p = head;
312.     return UCS_OK;
313. }
```

### 💬 Copilot

## Issue: Memory ordering race in has_tx_resource lock check

**File:** ucx/src/uct/obmm/base/obmm_ep.c:371-374  
**Severity:** Critical  
**Problem:** The new `has_tx_resource` logic places a load fence before reading the lock, then reads the lock without an acquire barrier. Meanwhile, `try_lock_head` (lines 43-50) uses a bus_load_fence + racy read + cswap + full_fence + verification pattern. The `has_tx_resource` check can observe `lock == 0` even though another thread has already acquired it (between the cswap at line 48 and the verification at line 50), leading to a false positive that defeats the entire fix.

**Evidence:** 
1. `try_lock_head` acquires with: `bus_load_fence → check != 0 → cswap → full_fence → verify owner`. Between the cswap and verify, lock is non-zero but `has_tx_resource` running concurrently may not see it yet because it only has a load fence before the read, not after.
2. `has_tx_resource` checks lock availability with only a load fence before the read (line 371), then reads `lock` (line 372) with no subsequent barrier. This is not sufficient to guarantee visibility of a concurrent lock acquisition in progress.
3. The result: `has_tx_resource` can return `1` (resource available) while another thread has already started the lock acquisition, leading to the same BUSY retry storm the patch is trying to prevent.

**Suggested fix:** After reading the lock at line 372, add `ucs_memory_bus_load_fence()` or upgrade to `ucs_memory_cpu_load_fence()` to ensure the lock check is properly ordered with concurrent lock acquisitions. Alternatively, mirror the `try_lock_head` pattern more closely by checking the lock value, adding a full fence, then re-checking to avoid observing stale state.

```
26. uct_obmm_ep_make_lock_token(uct_obmm_iface_t *iface, const uct_obmm_ep_t *ep)

30.     token = iface->region->info.exporter_dcna ^

32.             iface->region->info.exporter_deid.lo ^
```

```
18. /* Element flags carried in the shared FIFO element header. */
19. enum {
20.     /* Toggled every FIFO wraparound; receiver uses this to detect a freshly
21.      * written element without taking a tail/head delta lock. */
22.     UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER = UCS_BIT(0),
23. 
24.     /* Set by senders that wrote via am_bcopy (pack_cb output stored in the
25.      * payload area starting at elem+1, with NO 8-byte am_short header
26.      * prefix). When clear, the element was written via am_short and
27.      * &elem->header + length covers the [hdr][payload] buffer. */
28.     UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_BCOPY = UCS_BIT(1)
29. };
30. 
31. 
32. /* Per-slot FIFO control header. Lives at offset 0 of every allocated slot in
33.  * the obmm pool. Producers serialize `head` reservation with a token lock:
34.  * on target aarch64 NC mappings, cross-node CAS updates memory but its return
35.  * value is not a reliable ownership result. Consumers read/write `tail` to
36.  * release space. Control fields are accessed via non-cacheable mappings,
37.  * therefore all updates must be paired with bus fences
38.  * (ucs_memory_bus_*_fence), not CPU fences. */
39. typedef struct uct_obmm_fifo_ctl {
40.     /* 1st cacheline: producer-touched */
41.     volatile uint64_t head;
42.     volatile uint64_t lock;
43.     UCS_CACHELINE_PADDING(uint64_t, uint64_t);
44. 
45.     /* 2nd cacheline: consumer-touched */
46.     volatile uint64_t tail;
47.     UCS_CACHELINE_PADDING(uint64_t);
48. } UCS_V_ALIGNED(UCS_SYS_CACHE_LINE_SIZE) uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t;
49. 
50. 
51. /* FIFO element header. The element body (am short header + payload) follows
52.  * immediately. Total element stride is iface->config.fifo_elem_size, which
53.  * the iface chooses so that header+payload <= elem_size. */
54. typedef struct uct_obmm_fifo_element {
55.     uint8_t  flags;       /* UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_xx */
56.     uint8_t  am_id;       /* active message id */
57.     uint16_t length;      /* payload length (excluding am_short header) */
58.     uint32_t generation;  /* owner-slot generation token; receiver discards
59.                              elements whose generation doesn't match the
60.                              slot's current meta.generation */
61.     uint64_t header;      /* am_short 64-bit header */
62.     /* payload[length] follows here */
63. } UCS_S_PACKED uct_obmm_fifo_element_t;
64. 
65. 
66. /* Compute slot stride: control header + fifo_size * elem_size + (v2)
67.  * fifo_size * bcopy_seg_size, cacheline aligned so that adjacent slots
68.  * don't share a line. Returned as size_t; callers must validate the
69.  * result fits in the uint32_t pool_hdr->slot_size field before passing
70.  * to pool_attach. */
71. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE size_t
72. uct_obmm_slot_stride(unsigned fifo_size, unsigned fifo_elem_size,
73.                      unsigned bcopy_seg_size)
74. {
75.     return ucs_align_up(sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t) +
76.                         ((size_t)fifo_size * fifo_elem_size) +
77.                         ((size_t)fifo_size * bcopy_seg_size),
78.                         UCS_SYS_CACHE_LINE_SIZE);
79. }

96.

101. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void*

103.                     unsigned fifo_elem_size)

106.                                sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t) +
107.                                ((size_t)fifo_size * fifo_elem_size));
108. }

127. 
128. /* Full bus-domain fence: orders ALL prior memory accesses (loads and
129.  * stores) before ALL subsequent memory accesses, in the outer-shareable /
130.  * device domain that includes cross-host obmm peers.
131.  *
132.  * Why we need this in addition to ucs_memory_bus_{store,load}_fence:
133.  * the receiver must order its desc[N] LOADS (issued during the AM
134.  * handler) before the STORE that publishes the new tail. On ARM64,
135.  * ucs_memory_bus_store_fence() is `dmb oshst` (store→store only) and
136.  * does not order prior loads. Without this load→store barrier, a sender
137.  * could observe the advanced tail and overwrite desc[N] while the
138.  * receiver still has outstanding loads from the previous lap's payload.
139.  *
140.  * Defined locally in obmm rather than added to ucs/arch to keep the
141.  * change inside ucx/src/uct/obmm/ per AGENTS.md. */
142. #if defined(__aarch64__)
143. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() __asm__ __volatile__("dmb osh" ::: "memory")
144. #elif defined(__x86_64__) || defined(__i386__)
145. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() __asm__ __volatile__("mfence" ::: "memory")
146. #elif defined(__powerpc64__)
```

## Issue: Race condition in has_tx_resource lock check

**File:** ucx/src/uct/obmm/base/obmm_ep.c:371-374  
**Severity:** High  
**Problem:** The `uct_obmm_ep_has_tx_resource` function checks `ep-\>peer_ctl-\>lock != 0` after a load fence, but this check is not atomic with the subsequent `head` read at line 376. A peer could acquire the lock between the lock check (line 372) returning 0 and the head read (line 376), causing `has_tx_resource` to return true while the lock is actually held.

This creates a TOCTOU (time-of-check-time-of-use) race:
1. Thread A: checks lock == 0 (line 372) → passes
2. Thread B: acquires lock via `try_lock_head` 
3. Thread A: reads head (line 376) and returns true
4. Thread A: pending callback invokes send operation
5. Send operation calls `reserve_slot` → `try_lock_head` fails (lock held by B)
6. Returns NO_RESOURCE, requeueing the request

**Evidence:** The lock check and head read are separated by non-atomic operations. In `reserve_slot` (lines 273-276), the lock is checked and acquired atomically via `try_lock_head`. But in `has_tx_resource`, these are two separate loads with no mutual exclusion.

**Suggested fix:** The current behavior likely results in spurious NO_RESOURCE returns when the race occurs, causing the request to be requeued unnecessarily. While this is inefficient, it may not be a correctness bug if the send path properly handles NO_RESOURCE. However, if the intent is to guarantee that `has_tx_resource() == true` means the next send will succeed, the lock check and resource check must be atomic or the lock must be held during the resource check. Consider either:
- Remove the lock check from `has_tx_resource` and rely solely on the FIFO space check, since `reserve_slot` will catch lock contention anyway
- Or document that `has_tx_resource` is a conservative best-effort check that may have false positives

---

## Issue: Missing load fence before head read in has_tx_resource

**File:** ucx/src/uct/obmm/base/obmm_ep.c:376  
**Severity:** Medium  
**Problem:** After checking the lock at line 372-374, the code reads `ep-\>peer_ctl-\>head` at line 376 without an intervening load fence. The initial `ucs_memory_bus_load_fence()` at line 371 orders prior loads before the lock check, but does NOT order the lock check before the head read.

On weakly-ordered architectures, the head read could be reordered before the lock check, potentially reading a stale head value while believing the lock is free.

**Evidence:** In `reserve_slot` (line 278), there is an explicit `ucs_memory_bus_load_fence()` between the lock acquisition and the head read to ensure ordering. The same pattern should apply in `has_tx_resource`.

**Suggested fix:** Insert `ucs_memory_bus_load_fence()` between line 374 and line 376, immediately after the lock check passes and before reading head.

### 💬 Copilot

已按这个信号把修复收敛到 **“锁竞争不再走 BUSY 立即重试”**。

改动在 `ucx\src\uct\obmm\base\obmm_ep.c`：
- `pending_add()` 现在在 `NO_RESOURCE` 后**一律入队**，不再返回 `UCS_ERR_BUSY` 让 UCP 立刻重试。
- `uct_obmm_ep_has_tx_resource()` 现在只用于 `process_pending()` 的**保守预检**：必须同时满足 **FIFO 有空位** 且 **peer head-lock 当前为空**，才会在本轮 progress 里重试。
- 这轮为定位 hang 加的临时 `lock busy` / `stale elem` 日志都已去掉。

核心意义是：4 进程下即使 lock contention 很常见，也会走 **arbiter 排队**，而不是在 UCP/UCT 之间形成 retry storm。现在直接回到你那个复现场景重跑即可。

<sub>⏱️ 2286m 59s</sub>

### 💬 Copilot

**有影响，但在现在这个问题上，代价通常小于收益。**

关键点是：

- **无竞争时基本没影响**：发送成功的 fast path 还是直接走 `am_short/am_bcopy`，**不会进 arbiter**。
- **只有出现 `NO_RESOURCE` 时才排队**：也就是 FIFO 满或这次定位到的 **head-lock contention**。
- **竞争场景下，排队通常比立即重试更好**：立即重试会烧 progress 周期、放大锁竞争，还可能形成 retry storm；arbiter 至少能把请求串起来，给系统一个稳定前进路径。

所以性能影响更准确地说是：

| 场景 | 影响 |
|---|---|
| 2 进程、几乎无锁竞争 | 几乎没有 |
| 4 进程这类有明显锁竞争 | 可能略增一点延迟、略降一点峰值消息率 |
| 当前这个会挂死的场景 | **大概率净收益**，因为先换来稳定前进 |

本质上，arbiter 的代价是一次本地入队/调度，属于 **CPU 侧管理开销**；而 retry storm 的代价是反复失败、反复重试、不断争锁。对 1B 小消息来说，前者当然不是免费，但后者往往更糟。

所以我现在这版修复的判断是：**先用 arbiter 把 correctness 和 forward progress 稳住是对的**。如果后面实测发现 `osu_multi_lat` 不挂了但性能掉得明显，再继续做更细的优化，比如只把 **lock-busy** 走更轻量的本地等待/延后重试，而不是永久依赖当前这版保守策略。

### 💬 Copilot

Now I have all the context I need. Let me analyze the change for correctness issues:

## Issue: Lock token generation uses unchecked process start time that may return zero
**File:** ucx/src/uct/obmm/base/obmm_ep.c:42
**Severity:** High
**Problem:** `ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time(getpid())` returns `0ul` on error (line 1583 in sys.c), but the new token generation code does not check for this failure case. When start time is 0, the `self_id` value becomes predictable across processes (just `pid \<\< 32`), which dramatically increases the risk of token collisions between processes with the same PID on different nodes or between processes that recycle the same PID. The old code using simple XOR also had this issue, but the new code specifically introduces `self_starttime` as a collision prevention mechanism - it should verify it worked.

**Evidence:** In `obmm_pool.c:389-394`, the existing scavenge code explicitly checks for `self_starttime == 0ul` and logs a warning. The token generation should do the same, because a failed read undermines the entire collision-prevention strategy.

**Suggested fix:** Add a check after line 42:
```c
self_starttime = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time(getpid());
if (ucs_unlikely(self_starttime == 0ul)) {
    self_starttime = (unsigned long)time(NULL);  // fallback
}
```
Or at minimum, warn and continue with a degraded token.

<sub>⏱️ 2323m 10s</sub>

### 💬 Copilot

我又补了一处更可疑的并发缺陷：**head-lock token 生成方式本身不够稳妥**。

之前 `obmm_ep.c` 里的 lock token 是用这些字段直接异或出来的：

- 本地 exporter 身份
- 本地 `slot_index/generation`
- **进程内 `ep` 指针**

这里最大的隐患是：**不同进程的 `ep` 指针虚拟地址很可能重复**。而在你这个跨节点 4 进程场景里，只有发生了真正的多进程锁竞争，这个问题才有机会暴露；2 进程没竞争就基本看不出来。

现在我把 token 改成了一个混合后的 64-bit 值，输入改为：

- 本地 exporter 身份
- 本地 `slot_index/generation`
- **本进程 `pid + starttime`**
- 远端 `peer_slot_index + peer_pid`
- `ep` 指针

也就是说，`ep` 指针现在只作为**进程内区分**的一部分，不再是跨进程唯一性的主要来源。这样即便不同进程的 `ep` 地址碰巧一样，也不会轻易撞出相同 token。并且我对 `starttime==0` 的退化情况也加了单次告警兜底。

这次改动是纯修正 lock ownership 身份，不改协议和队列语义。你现在可以直接回到原来的跨节点 4 进程 `osu_multi_lat -m 1:1` 场景再试一次。

```
2. rest of the shared export region intact. The user wants all residual shared
3. memory data cleared on exit, following commit

6. Approach:
7. - Mirror only the cleanup-related parts of the reference commit that still fit
8.   the current NC-only branch:
9.   - make `uct_obmm_pool_free_slot()` report whether the caller released the
10.     final local slot and successfully acquired exclusive reset ownership
11.   - add `uct_obmm_pool_reset()` to zero the full local export region while
12.     keeping `hdr->state` in `INITING` until the rest of the pool is cleared
13.   - route iface cleanup through one shared helper so the last local iface
14.     resets the export region, while non-last ifaces still just free their slot
15. - Also mirror the reference commit's removal of persisted pool-version
16.   restrictions on this branch by turning the pool header's version word into a

34.   state to port, so the cleanup adaptation should stay focused on the local NC
35.   export region and pool header/slot lifecycle.
36. - The last-slot reset path must be race-safe with a new attach: once cleanup
37.   wins the `READY -> INITING` transition, no new attach may observe partially
38.   zeroed pool metadata.
39. - Validation remains static only in this Windows workspace.
40. - To close the attach-vs-reset gap from review, make `pool_alloc_slot()`
41.   refuse a pool that is no longer `READY`, so a late local attach cannot claim
42.   a slot after cleanup has already switched the pool to `INITING`.

44.   - remove the `version -> reserved0` replacement and drop other useless

47.     synchronization, then finish with literal all-zero shared memory

51.     export region and leaves the shared image as literal all-zero memory

53.     pool out of `READY`
54.   - updated DESIGN.md to describe full-region zero-on-exit semantics
55. - Latency anomaly analysis:
56.   - current defaults make effective UCP eager-short payload limit land just
57.     below 2048B, so 2048-byte messages fall off the short path and jump to
58.     eager bcopy
59.   - follow-up retune kept BCOPY_SEG_SIZE at 4096 and raised FIFO_ELEM_SIZE to
60.     2112 so 2048B payloads stay on the short path
61.   - next retune reduces local slot count from 256 to 64 and spends the freed
62.     budget on FIFO_ELEM_SIZE = 4160 so 4096B payloads can stay on the short
63.     path as well
64.   - latest latency reinvestigation found the earlier UCP-header-fitting logic
65.     was wrong for the actual benchmark path:
66.     - Open MPI blocking `MPI_Send` on this tree uses `mca_pml_ucx_send_nbr()`
67.       → `ucp_tag_send_nbx()`, and UCX defaults `PROTO_ENABLE=y`, so proto v2
68.       picks eager short / eager bcopy / rendezvous by cost model rather than
69.       the older simple threshold logic
70.     - non-64B-aligned sizes (`16392`, `16408`, `32792`) correlated strongly
71.       with the worst latency curves because obmm steps directly by
72.       `fifo_elem_size` / `bcopy_seg_size` when indexing every FIFO element and
73.       desc
74.     - follow-up user measurement showed `FIFO_ELEM_SIZE=16448`,
75.       `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE=32768` is slightly better than the previous best-known
76.       baseline, while keeping both strides 64B-aligned
77.     - adopt `16448/32768` as the new default pending the user's full
78.       regression sweep

81.     full local export mapping and there is no separate CC cleanup path here

83.   - `tag_match.c:62 unexpected tag-receive descriptor ... was not matched`
84.     is emitted only when UCP worker teardown still finds descriptors on the
85.     unexpected tag queue; this proves the receiver accepted extra/late/misrouted
86.     tag messages rather than a pure send-drop path
87.   - the strongest current root-cause candidate is a slot-allocation race in
88.     `uct_obmm_pool_try_claim()`:
89.     - process A can CAS the bitmap bit from 0->1
90.     - before A stores `slot_meta.state = IN_USE`, process B can observe the bit
91.       already set, see `state != IN_USE`, and "take over" the same slot with no
92.       atomic ownership step
93.     - both processes can therefore publish the same `slot_index` in
94.       `iface_get_address()`, and EP creation will trust that shared slot
95.     - on same-node 2-process runs, that can multiplex both ranks onto one recv
96.       FIFO and explain probabilistic duplicate / misrouted tag deliveries

98.     `UCX_LOG_LEVEL=debug` run should confirm or refute the race quickly

100.     exercises the same UCP tag pingpong path and should be the next testcase if
101.     the MPI case is still too noisy
102.   - instrumentation added for live confirmation:
103.     - `obmm_pool_try_claim()` now emits a one-time `ucs_error()` if it observes
104.       `bitmap bit set && slot_meta.state == FREE`, which is the suspected
105.       double-claim window
106.     - `ucp_tag_match_cleanup()` now collapses repeated unmatched-descriptor
107.       warnings into a single summary line so the obmm diagnostic stays visible
108.   - root cause confirmed by runtime logs and fixed in the pool state machine:
109.     - slot allocation/free now uses an explicit transient `CLAIMING` state
110.       instead of inferring ownership solely from `bitmap + state`
111.     - a process can no longer take over a slot while another process is still
112.       publishing allocation metadata or freeing the slot
113.     - `free_slot()` now keeps owner identity until after `clear_bit`, so
114.       `DEAD` means either "live free in progress" or "dead owner to scavenge"
115.       rather than an unowned takeover window
116.     - the temporary diagnostic log and warning-collapsing change were removed
117.       after the fix landed
118. - Cross-node 4-rank `osu_multi_lat -m 1:1` hang follow-up:
119.   - runtime signal:
120.     - 4-process runs always hit the temporary `lock busy` diagnostic
121.     - 2-process runs never hit it
122.     - temporary `stale elem drop` diagnostic never fired
123.   - strongest current interpretation:
124.     - the remaining hang is more consistent with multi-producer head-lock
125.       contention being treated as `BUSY` immediate retry, creating retry storms,
126.       than with message corruption or stale-slot loss
127.   - fix applied:
128.     - `obmm_ep_pending_add()` now always queues instead of returning `BUSY`

130.     - `uct_obmm_ep_has_tx_resource()` is now a conservative best-effort check
131.       for `process_pending()`: it requires both FIFO space and an unlocked peer
132.       head lock before retrying a pending request
```

```
158.                   (unsigned long)daddr->exporter_deid_lo);

162.     status = uct_obmm_pool_open(region->base, region->length, &peer_pool);
163.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
164.         ucs_error("obmm: failed to open peer pool: %s",
165.                   ucs_status_string(status));

169.     if (iaddr->slot_index >= peer_pool.slot_count) {
170.         ucs_error("obmm: peer slot_index %u out of range (slot_count=%u)",
171.                   iaddr->slot_index, peer_pool.slot_count);

173.     }

175.     if (peer_pool.slot_size !=

177.                              iaddr->bcopy_seg_size)) {

182.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
183.     }
184. 
185.     peer_slot = uct_obmm_pool_slot_ptr(&peer_pool, iaddr->slot_index);
186. 
187.     self->peer_ctl            = uct_obmm_slot_ctl(peer_slot);
188.     self->peer_elems          = uct_obmm_slot_elems(peer_slot);
189.     self->peer_descs          = uct_obmm_slot_descs(peer_slot,
190.                                                     iaddr->fifo_size,

192.     self->cached_tail         = self->peer_ctl->tail;
193.     self->expected_generation = iaddr->generation;
194.     self->fifo_size           = iaddr->fifo_size;

198.     self->peer_dcna           = daddr->exporter_dcna;

200.     self->peer_deid_lo        = daddr->exporter_deid_lo;

202.     self->peer_pid            = iaddr->pid;
```

```
293. /* Reserve one slot in the peer's FIFO, returning the head index that was
294.  * claimed. Multi-producer reservation is serialized with a token lock because
295.  * on target NC/aarch64 mappings, CAS updates memory but its return value is
296.  * not a reliable ownership result. */
297. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE ucs_status_t
298. uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot(uct_obmm_ep_t *ep, uint64_t *head_p)
299. {
300.     uint64_t head;
301. 
302.     if (!uct_obmm_ep_try_lock_head(ep)) {
303.         UCS_STATS_UPDATE_COUNTER(ep->super.stats, UCT_EP_STAT_NO_RES, 1);
304.         return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
305.     }
306. 
307.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
308.     head = ep->peer_ctl->head;
309. 
310.     if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
311.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
312.         ep->cached_tail = ep->peer_ctl->tail;
313.         if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
314.             UCS_STATS_UPDATE_COUNTER(ep->super.stats, UCT_EP_STAT_NO_RES, 1);
315.             uct_obmm_ep_unlock_head(ep);
316.             return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
317.         }
318.     }
319. 
320.     uct_obmm_bus_full_fence();
321.     ep->peer_ctl->head = head + 1;
322.     uct_obmm_ep_unlock_head(ep);
323. 
324.     *head_p = head;
325.     return UCS_OK;
326. }

329. ssize_t uct_obmm_ep_am_bcopy(uct_ep_h tl_ep, uint8_t id,
330.                              uct_pack_callback_t pack_cb, void *arg,
331.                              unsigned flags)
332. {
333.     uct_obmm_ep_t           *ep    = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep, uct_obmm_ep_t);
334.     uct_obmm_iface_t        *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep->iface,
335.                                                     uct_obmm_iface_t);
336.     uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem;
337.     void                    *desc;
338.     uint64_t                 head;
339.     size_t                   length;
340.     uint8_t                  owner_bit;
341.     ucs_status_t             status;
342. 
343.     /* flags (UCT_SEND_FLAG_PEER_CHECK etc.) are ignored: this transport
344.      * does not advertise EP_CHECK / keepalive in v1. */
345.     (void)flags;
346. 
347.     UCT_CHECK_AM_ID(id);
348. 
349.     status = uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot(ep, &head);
350.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
351.         return status;
352.     }
353. 
354.     elem = uct_obmm_slot_elem(ep->peer_elems, head, ep->fifo_mask,
355.                               ep->fifo_elem_size);
356.     desc = uct_obmm_slot_desc(ep->peer_descs, head, ep->fifo_mask,
357.                               ep->bcopy_seg_size);
358. 
359.     /* pack_cb writes pack_cb_ret bytes directly into the paired desc[N]
360.      * area. UCP guarantees pack_cb_ret <= cap.am.max_bcopy, which we set
361.      * to bcopy_seg_size. The asserts catch buggy direct UCT users in
362.      * debug builds; production safety relies on the iface cap contract. */
363.     length = pack_cb(desc, arg);
364.     ucs_assertv(length <= ep->bcopy_seg_size,
365.                 "obmm: pack_cb returned %zu > bcopy_seg_size=%u",
366.                 length, ep->bcopy_seg_size);
367.     ucs_assertv(length <= UINT16_MAX,
368.                 "obmm: pack_cb returned %zu > UINT16_MAX", length);
369. 
370.     elem->am_id      = id;
371.     elem->length     = (uint16_t)length;
372.     elem->generation = ep->expected_generation;
373.     elem->header     = 0; /* unused for bcopy */
374. 
375.     owner_bit = ((head / ep->fifo_size) & 1u) ? 0u :
376.                                                 UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER;
377. 
378.     /* Release barrier: orders the desc[N] payload writes AND elem header
379.      * writes BEFORE the flags publish. Receiver pairs with bus_load_fence
380.      * after observing the flags byte. */
381.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
382.     elem->flags = owner_bit | UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_BCOPY;
383. 
384.     UCT_TL_EP_STAT_OP(&ep->super, AM, BCOPY, length);
385.     uct_iface_trace_am(&iface->super, UCT_AM_TRACE_TYPE_SEND, id,
386.                        desc, length, "TX: AM_BCOPY");
387.     return (ssize_t)length;
388. }

391. /* Conservative best-effort check for whether a pending request is worth
392.  * retrying in this progress round. Returns false if the peer FIFO is full or
393.  * if the peer head lock is observed busy. Because another producer can race
394.  * us after this check, callers must still tolerate reserve_slot() returning
395.  * UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE and simply reschedule the request. */
396. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE int
397. uct_obmm_ep_has_tx_resource(uct_obmm_ep_t *ep)
398. {
399.     uint64_t head;
400. 
401.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
402.     if (ep->peer_ctl->lock != 0) {
403.         return 0;
404.     }
405. 
406.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
407.     head = ep->peer_ctl->head;
408.     if ((head - ep->cached_tail) < ep->fifo_size) {
409.         return 1;
410.     }
411.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
412.     ep->cached_tail = ep->peer_ctl->tail;
413.     return (head - ep->cached_tail) < ep->fifo_size;
414. }

417. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_ep_pending_add(uct_ep_h tl_ep, uct_pending_req_t *n,
418.                                      unsigned flags)
419. {
420.     uct_obmm_ep_t    *ep    = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep, uct_obmm_ep_t);
421.     uct_obmm_iface_t *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep->iface, uct_obmm_iface_t);
422. 
423.     (void)flags;
424. 
425.     /* obmm NO_RESOURCE can mean either FIFO-full or transient head-lock
426.      * contention. Queue unconditionally rather than returning BUSY for an
427.      * immediate retry, otherwise multi-producer contention can devolve into a
428.      * retry storm instead of making forward progress through the iface arbiter. */
429. 
430.     UCS_STATIC_ASSERT(sizeof(uct_pending_req_priv_arb_t) <=
431.                       UCT_PENDING_REQ_PRIV_LEN);
432.     uct_pending_req_arb_group_push(&ep->arb_group, n);
433.     ucs_arbiter_group_schedule(&iface->arbiter, &ep->arb_group);
434.     UCT_TL_EP_STAT_PEND(&ep->super);
435. 
436.     return UCS_OK;
437. }

440. ucs_arbiter_cb_result_t
441. uct_obmm_ep_process_pending(ucs_arbiter_t *arbiter, ucs_arbiter_group_t *group,
442.                             ucs_arbiter_elem_t *elem, void *arg)
443. {
444.     uct_obmm_ep_t     *ep    = ucs_container_of(group, uct_obmm_ep_t, arb_group);
445.     unsigned          *count = (unsigned*)arg;
446.     uct_pending_req_t *req;
447.     ucs_status_t       status;
448. 
449.     /* Refresh cached tail so the request callback's am_short/am_bcopy sees
450.      * the freshest peer state and is not falsely starved. */
451.     if (!uct_obmm_ep_has_tx_resource(ep)) {
452.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_RESCHED_GROUP;
453.     }
454. 
455.     req    = ucs_container_of(elem, uct_pending_req_t, priv);
456.     status = req->func(req);
457. 
458.     if (status == UCS_OK) {
459.         ++(*count);
460.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_REMOVE_ELEM;
461.     } else if (status == UCS_INPROGRESS) {
462.         ++(*count);
463.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_NEXT_GROUP;
464.     }
465. 
466.     /* NO_RESOURCE (or any other transient): keep the request and try
467.      * again the next time iface_progress runs. */
468.     return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_RESCHED_GROUP;
469. }

478. static ucs_arbiter_cb_result_t
479. uct_obmm_ep_arbiter_purge_cb(ucs_arbiter_t *arbiter, ucs_arbiter_group_t *group,
480.                              ucs_arbiter_elem_t *elem, void *arg)
481. {
482.     uct_obmm_ep_t         *ep   = ucs_container_of(group, uct_obmm_ep_t,
483.                                                    arb_group);
484.     uct_obmm_purge_args_t *args = arg;
485.     uct_pending_req_t     *req;
486. 
487.     req = ucs_container_of(elem, uct_pending_req_t, priv);
488.     if (args->cb != NULL) {
489.         args->cb(req, args->arg);
490.     } else {
491.         ucs_warn("obmm: ep=%p canceling pending request %p", ep, req);
492.     }
493.     return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_REMOVE_ELEM;
494. }
```

```
189.

191.         (iaddr->fifo_elem_size != iface->fifo_elem_size) ||

196.                                     "local fifo=%u elem=%u seg=%u)",
197.                                     iaddr->fifo_size, iaddr->fifo_elem_size,
198.                                     iaddr->bcopy_seg_size,
199.                                     iface->fifo_size, iface->fifo_elem_size,
200.                                     iface->bcopy_seg_size);
201.         return 0;
202.     }

204.     eid.hi = daddr->exporter_deid_hi;
205.     eid.lo = daddr->exporter_deid_lo;
206. 
207.     export_r = uct_obmm_md_export_region(md);
208.     if ((export_r != NULL) &&
209.         (export_r->info.exporter_dcna == daddr->exporter_dcna) &&
210.         (export_r->info.exporter_deid.hi == eid.hi) &&
211.         (export_r->info.exporter_deid.lo == eid.lo)) {
212.         return uct_iface_scope_is_reachable(tl_iface, params);
213.     }
214. 
215.     if (uct_obmm_md_find_import_region(md, daddr->exporter_dcna, &eid) != NULL) {

218. 
219.     uct_iface_fill_info_str_buf(params,
220.                                 "no mapped region for peer dcna=0x%lx "

222.                                 (unsigned long)daddr->exporter_dcna,
223.                                 (unsigned long)eid.hi, (unsigned long)eid.lo);
224.     return 0;

228. static unsigned uct_obmm_iface_progress(uct_iface_h tl_iface)
229. {
230.     uct_obmm_iface_t        *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_iface, uct_obmm_iface_t);
231.     unsigned                 polled = 0;
232.     uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem;
233.     uint8_t                  flags;
234.     uint8_t                  expected_owner;
235.     size_t                   max_poll = iface->fifo_max_poll;
236. 
237.     while (polled < max_poll) {
238.         elem = uct_obmm_slot_elem(iface->recv_elems, iface->read_index,
239.                                   iface->fifo_mask, iface->fifo_elem_size);
240. 
241.         /* Owner bit alternates each lap of the ring; pass 0 expects 1, pass
242.          * 1 expects 0, etc. Combined with zero-fill on slot allocation, this
243.          * means an unwritten slot reads as flags==0 and is correctly skipped
244.          * on the very first lap. */
245.         expected_owner = ((iface->read_index / iface->fifo_size) & 1u) ?
246.                          0u : UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER;
247. 
248.         flags = elem->flags;
249.         if ((flags & UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER) != expected_owner) {
250.             break;
251.         }
252. 
253.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
254. 
255.         if (elem->generation != iface->generation) {
256.             /* Stale write from a previous slot owner (we were torn down and
257.              * re-allocated this slot). Drop silently. */
258.             ucs_trace_data("obmm: drop stale elem (gen=%u expected=%u) "
259.                            "at idx=%lu", elem->generation, iface->generation,
260.                            (unsigned long)iface->read_index);
261.         } else if (flags & UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_BCOPY) {
262.             /* am_bcopy: payload is in the paired desc[N], not in the FIFO
263.              * element body. The bus_load_fence above orders this load
264.              * with respect to the sender's bus_store_fence + flag write. */
265.             void *desc = uct_obmm_slot_desc(iface->recv_descs,
266.                                             iface->read_index,
267.                                             iface->fifo_mask,
268.                                             iface->bcopy_seg_size);
269.             uct_iface_invoke_am(&iface->super, elem->am_id,
270.                                 desc, elem->length, 0);
271.         } else {
272.             /* am_short: contiguous [header(8B)][payload] starting at
273.              * &elem->header. elem->length already includes the 8B header. */
274.             uct_iface_invoke_am(&iface->super, elem->am_id,
275.                                 &elem->header, elem->length, 0);
276.         }
277. 
278.         iface->read_index++;
279.         polled++;
280.     }
281. 
282.     if (polled > 0) {
283.         /* Full bus fence: orders the AM handler's LOADS from desc[]/elem
284.          * payload BEFORE the STORE that publishes the new tail. A plain
285.          * bus_store_fence (e.g. dmb oshst on aarch64) only orders
286.          * store→store, which would let a sender observe the advanced
287.          * tail and overwrite desc[N] while we still have outstanding
288.          * loads in flight. See obmm_fifo.h:uct_obmm_bus_full_fence. */
289.         uct_obmm_bus_full_fence();
290.         iface->recv_ctl->tail = iface->read_index;
291.     }
292. 
293.     /* Drain any UCP requests waiting on TX backpressure. The peer-side
294.      * tail advance we just published may also have freed slots that *our*
295.      * pending eps have been waiting for; dispatch with a fresh head/tail
296.      * snapshot so retries see the latest state. Without this dispatch,
297.      * UCS_ERR_BUSY-only pending_add caused a livelock under symmetric
298.      * bidirectional load at BCOPY_SEG_SIZE. */
299.     ucs_arbiter_dispatch(&iface->arbiter, 1, uct_obmm_ep_process_pending,
300.                          &polled);
301. 
302.     return polled;
303. }
```

```
18. /* Element flags carried in the shared FIFO element header. */
19. enum {
20.     /* Toggled every FIFO wraparound; receiver uses this to detect a freshly
21.      * written element without taking a tail/head delta lock. */
22.     UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER = UCS_BIT(0),
23. 
24.     /* Set by senders that wrote via am_bcopy (pack_cb output stored in the

27.      * &elem->header + length covers the [hdr][payload] buffer. */
28.     UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_BCOPY = UCS_BIT(1)

32. /* Per-slot FIFO control header. Lives at offset 0 of every allocated slot in
33.  * the obmm pool. Producers serialize `head` reservation with a token lock:
34.  * on target aarch64 NC mappings, cross-node CAS updates memory but its return
35.  * value is not a reliable ownership result. Consumers read/write `tail` to
36.  * release space. Control fields are accessed via non-cacheable mappings,
37.  * therefore all updates must be paired with bus fences
38.  * (ucs_memory_bus_*_fence), not CPU fences. */
39. typedef struct uct_obmm_fifo_ctl {
40.     /* 1st cacheline: producer-touched */
41.     volatile uint64_t head;
42.     volatile uint64_t lock;
43.     UCS_CACHELINE_PADDING(uint64_t, uint64_t);
44. 
45.     /* 2nd cacheline: consumer-touched */
46.     volatile uint64_t tail;
47.     UCS_CACHELINE_PADDING(uint64_t);
48. } UCS_V_ALIGNED(UCS_SYS_CACHE_LINE_SIZE) uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t;

51. /* FIFO element header. The element body (am short header + payload) follows
52.  * immediately. Total element stride is iface->config.fifo_elem_size, which
53.  * the iface chooses so that header+payload <= elem_size. */
54. typedef struct uct_obmm_fifo_element {
55.     uint8_t  flags;       /* UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_xx */
56.     uint8_t  am_id;       /* active message id */
57.     uint16_t length;      /* payload length (excluding am_short header) */
58.     uint32_t generation;  /* owner-slot generation token; receiver discards
59.                              elements whose generation doesn't match the
60.                              slot's current meta.generation */
61.     uint64_t header;      /* am_short 64-bit header */
62.     /* payload[length] follows here */

69.  * result fits in the uint32_t pool_hdr->slot_size field before passing
70.  * to pool_attach. */
71. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE size_t
72. uct_obmm_slot_stride(unsigned fifo_size, unsigned fifo_elem_size,
73.                      unsigned bcopy_seg_size)

76.                         ((size_t)fifo_size * fifo_elem_size) +
77.                         ((size_t)fifo_size * bcopy_seg_size),

128. /* Full bus-domain fence: orders ALL prior memory accesses (loads and
129.  * stores) before ALL subsequent memory accesses, in the outer-shareable /
130.  * device domain that includes cross-host obmm peers.
131.  *
132.  * Why we need this in addition to ucs_memory_bus_{store,load}_fence:
133.  * the receiver must order its desc[N] LOADS (issued during the AM
134.  * handler) before the STORE that publishes the new tail. On ARM64,
135.  * ucs_memory_bus_store_fence() is `dmb oshst` (store→store only) and
136.  * does not order prior loads. Without this load→store barrier, a sender
137.  * could observe the advanced tail and overwrite desc[N] while the
138.  * receiver still has outstanding loads from the previous lap's payload.
139.  *
140.  * Defined locally in obmm rather than added to ucs/arch to keep the
141.  * change inside ucx/src/uct/obmm/ per AGENTS.md. */
142. #if defined(__aarch64__)
143. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() __asm__ __volatile__("dmb osh" ::: "memory")
144. #elif defined(__x86_64__) || defined(__i386__)
145. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() __asm__ __volatile__("mfence" ::: "memory")
146. #elif defined(__powerpc64__)
147. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() __asm__ __volatile__("sync" ::: "memory")
148. #elif defined(__riscv) && (__riscv_xlen == 64)
149. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() \
150.     __asm__ __volatile__("fence iorw, iorw" ::: "memory")
151. #else
152. /* Fallback: combine store + load fences. Not strictly load→store on all
153.  * archs but better than nothing; build will warn so the porter notices. */
154. #warning "obmm: no full bus fence for this arch; receiver tail release ordering may be weak"
155. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() do { \
156.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();        \
157.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();       \
158. } while (0)
159. #endif
160. 
161. #endif
162.
```

```
98.     if (ucs_likely(khiter != kh_end(&ep->remote_segs))) {
99.         *address_p = kh_val(&ep->remote_segs, khiter).address;
100.         return UCS_OK;
101.     }
102. 
103.     /* slow path - attach new segment */
104.     return uct_mm_ep_attach_remote_seg(ep, seg_id, length, address_p);
105. }

107. /* send a signal to remote interface using Unix-domain socket */
108. static void uct_mm_ep_signal_remote(uct_mm_ep_t *ep)
109. {
110.     uct_mm_iface_t *iface = ucs_derived_of(ep->super.super.iface, uct_mm_iface_t);
111.     char dummy = 0;
112.     int ret;
113. 
114.     ucs_trace("ep %p: signal remote", ep);
115. 
116.     for (;;) {
117.         ret = sendto(iface->signal_fd, &dummy, sizeof(dummy), 0,
118.                      (const struct sockaddr*)&ep->fifo_ctl->signal_sockaddr,
119.                      ep->fifo_ctl->signal_addrlen);
120.         if (ucs_unlikely(ret < 0)) {
121.             if (errno == EINTR) {
122.                 /* Interrupted system call - retry */
123.                 continue;
124.             }
125.             if ((errno == EAGAIN) || (errno == ECONNREFUSED)) {
126.                 /* If we failed to signal because buffer is full - ignore the error
127.                  * since it means the remote side would get a signal anyway.
128.                  * If the remote side is not there - ignore the error as well.
129.                  */
130.                 ucs_trace("failed to send wakeup signal: %m");
131.                 return;
132.             } else {
133.                 ucs_warn("failed to send wakeup signal: %m");
134.                 return;
135.             }
136.         } else {
137.             ucs_assert(ret == sizeof(dummy));
138.             ucs_trace("sent wakeup from socket %d to %s", iface->signal_fd,
139.                       ep->fifo_ctl->signal_sockaddr.sun_path);
140.             return;
141.         }
142.     }
143. }

145. void uct_mm_ep_cleanup_remote_segs(uct_mm_ep_t *ep)
146. {
147.     uct_mm_iface_t *iface = ucs_derived_of(ep->super.super.iface,
148.                                            uct_mm_iface_t);

150.

152.         uct_mm_iface_mapper_call(iface, mem_detach, &remote_seg);

158. static UCS_CLASS_INIT_FUNC(uct_mm_ep_t, const uct_ep_params_t *params)
159. {
160.     uct_mm_iface_t            *iface = ucs_derived_of(params->iface, uct_mm_iface_t);
161.     uct_mm_md_t               *md    = ucs_derived_of(iface->super.super.md, uct_mm_md_t);
162.     const uct_mm_iface_addr_t *addr  = (const void *)params->iface_addr;
163.     ucs_status_t status;
164.     void *fifo_ptr;
165. 
166.     UCT_EP_PARAMS_CHECK_DEV_IFACE_ADDRS(params);
167.     UCS_CLASS_CALL_SUPER_INIT(uct_base_ep_t, &iface->super.super);
168. 
169.     kh_init_inplace(uct_mm_remote_seg, &self->remote_segs);
170.     ucs_arbiter_group_init(&self->arb_group);
171. 
172.     /* save remote md address */
173.     if (md->iface_addr_len > 0) {
174.         self->remote_iface_addr = ucs_malloc(md->iface_addr_len, "mm_md_addr");
175.         if (self->remote_iface_addr == NULL) {
176.             status = UCS_ERR_NO_MEMORY;
177.             goto err;
178.         }
179. 
180.         memcpy(self->remote_iface_addr, addr + 1, md->iface_addr_len);
181.     } else {
182.         self->remote_iface_addr = NULL;
183.     }
184. 
185.     /* Attach the remote FIFO, use the same method as bcopy descriptors */
186.     status = uct_mm_ep_get_remote_seg(self, addr->fifo_seg_id,
187.                                       UCT_MM_GET_FIFO_SIZE(iface), &fifo_ptr);
188.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
189.         ucs_error("mm ep failed to connect to remote FIFO id 0x%"PRIx64": %s",
190.                   addr->fifo_seg_id, ucs_status_string(status));
191.         goto err_free_md_addr;
192.     }
193. 
194.     /* Initialize remote FIFO control structure */
195.     uct_mm_iface_set_fifo_ptrs(fifo_ptr, &self->fifo_ctl, &self->fifo_elems);
196.     self->cached_tail = self->fifo_ctl->tail;
197.     ucs_arbiter_elem_init(&self->arb_elem);
198. 
199.     status = uct_ep_keepalive_init(&self->keepalive, self->fifo_ctl->pid);
200.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
201.         goto err_free_segs;
202.     }
203. 
204.     ucs_debug("created mm ep %p, connected to remote FIFO id 0x%"PRIx64,
205.               self, addr->fifo_seg_id);
206. 
207.     return UCS_OK;
208. 
209. err_free_segs:
210.     uct_mm_ep_cleanup_remote_segs(self);
211. err_free_md_addr:
212.     ucs_free(self->remote_iface_addr);
213. err:
214.     return status;
215. }
216. 
217. static UCS_CLASS_CLEANUP_FUNC(uct_mm_ep_t)
218. {

220.     uct_mm_ep_cleanup_remote_segs(self);
221.     ucs_free(self->remote_iface_addr);
222. }

229. static inline ucs_status_t
230. uct_mm_ep_get_remote_elem(uct_mm_ep_t *ep, uint64_t head,
231.                           uct_mm_fifo_element_t **elem)
232. {
233.     uct_mm_iface_t *iface = ucs_derived_of(ep->super.super.iface, uct_mm_iface_t);
234.     uint64_t new_head, prev_head;
235.     uint64_t elem_index;   /* index of the element to write */
236. 
237.     elem_index = head & iface->fifo_mask;
238.     *elem      = UCT_MM_IFACE_GET_FIFO_ELEM(iface, ep->fifo_elems, elem_index);
239.     new_head   = (head + 1) & ~UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_HEAD_EVENT_ARMED;
240. 
241.     /* try to get ownership of the head element */
242.     prev_head = ucs_atomic_cswap64(ucs_unaligned_ptr(&ep->fifo_ctl->head), head,
243.                                    new_head);
244.     if (prev_head != head) {
245.         return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
246.     }
247. 
248.     return UCS_OK;
249. }
```

```
468. ucs_arbiter_cb_result_t uct_mm_ep_process_pending(ucs_arbiter_t *arbiter,
469.                                                   ucs_arbiter_group_t *group,
470.                                                   ucs_arbiter_elem_t *elem,
471.                                                   void *arg)
472. {
473.     uct_mm_ep_t *ep        = ucs_container_of(group, uct_mm_ep_t, arb_group);
474.     unsigned *count        = (unsigned*)arg;
475.     uct_pending_req_t *req;
476.     ucs_status_t status;
477. 
478.     /* update the local tail with its actual value from the remote peer
479.      * making sure that the pending sends would use the real tail value */
480.     uct_mm_ep_update_cached_tail(ep);
481. 
482.     if (!uct_mm_ep_has_tx_resources(ep)) {
483.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_RESCHED_GROUP;
484.     }
485. 
486.     if (elem == &ep->arb_elem) {
487.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_REMOVE_ELEM;
488.     }
489. 
490.     req = ucs_container_of(elem, uct_pending_req_t, priv);
491. 
492.     ucs_trace_data("progressing pending request %p", req);
493.     status = req->func(req);
494.     ucs_trace_data("status returned from progress pending: %s",
495.                    ucs_status_string(status));
496. 
497.     if (status == UCS_OK) {
498.         (*count)++;
499.         /* sent successfully. remove from the arbiter */
500.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_REMOVE_ELEM;
501.     } else if (status == UCS_INPROGRESS) {
502.         (*count)++;
503.         /* sent but not completed, keep in the arbiter */
504.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_NEXT_GROUP;
505.     } else {
506.         /* couldn't send. keep this request in the arbiter until the next time
507.          * this function is called */
508.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_RESCHED_GROUP;
509.     }
510. }
```

```
372. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void
373. uct_mm_iface_fifo_window_adjust(uct_mm_iface_t *iface,
374.                                 unsigned fifo_poll_count)
375. {
376.     if (fifo_poll_count < iface->fifo_poll_count) {
377.         iface->fifo_poll_count = ucs_max(iface->fifo_poll_count /
378.                                          UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_MD_FACTOR,
379.                                          UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_MIN_POLL);
380.         iface->fifo_prev_wnd_cons = 0;
381.         return;
382.     }
383. 
384.     ucs_assert(fifo_poll_count == iface->fifo_poll_count);
385. 
386.     if (iface->fifo_prev_wnd_cons) {
387.         /* Increase FIFO window size if it was fully consumed
388.          * during the previous iface progress call in order
389.          * to prevent the situation when the window will be
390.          * adjusted to [MIN, MIN + 1, MIN, MIN + 1, ...] that
391.          * is harmful to latency */
392.         iface->fifo_poll_count = ucs_min(iface->fifo_poll_count +
393.                                          UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_AI_VALUE,
394.                                          iface->config.fifo_max_poll);
395.     } else {
396.         iface->fifo_prev_wnd_cons = 1;
397.     }
398. }

400. static unsigned uct_mm_iface_progress(uct_iface_h tl_iface)
401. {
402.     uct_mm_iface_t *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_iface, uct_mm_iface_t);
403.     unsigned total_count  = 0;
404.     unsigned count;
405. 
406.     ucs_assert(iface->fifo_poll_count >= UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_MIN_POLL);
407. 
408.     /* progress receive */
409.     do {
410.         count = uct_mm_iface_poll_fifo(iface);
411.         ucs_assert(count < 2);
412.         total_count += count;
413.         ucs_assert(total_count < UINT_MAX);
414.     } while ((count != 0) && (total_count < iface->fifo_poll_count));
415. 
416.     uct_mm_iface_fifo_window_adjust(iface, total_count);
417. 
418.     /* progress the pending sends (if there are any) */
419.     ucs_arbiter_dispatch(&iface->arbiter, 1, uct_mm_ep_process_pending,
420.                          &total_count);
421. 
422.     return total_count;
423. }

456.                   iface, head & ~UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_HEAD_EVENT_ARMED,
457.                   iface->read_index);
458.         return UCS_ERR_BUSY;
```

```
336.     if (config->fifo_size == 0) {

338.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
339.     }
340.     if (!ucs_is_pow2(config->fifo_size)) {
341.         ucs_error("obmm: FIFO_SIZE (%u) must be a power of 2",
342.                   config->fifo_size);
343.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
344.     }
345.     if (config->fifo_elem_size <= sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_element_t)) {
346.         ucs_error("obmm: FIFO_ELEM_SIZE (%u) must be > %zu",
347.                   config->fifo_elem_size, sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_element_t));
348.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
349.     }
350.     /* elem->length is uint16_t; reject geometries whose advertised
351.      * max_short / max_bcopy would not fit in that field. */
352.     if ((config->fifo_elem_size - sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_element_t)) >
353.         UINT16_MAX) {
354.         ucs_error("obmm: FIFO_ELEM_SIZE (%u) too large; payload area must fit "

356.                   config->fifo_elem_size,
```
