````
1. # obmm UCT transport — design notes
2. 
3. This file is the **single source of truth** for the on-region wire format
4. and the data-path semantics of the `obmm` UCT transport. Update it
5. **before** changing layout, capabilities, or sync rules. AGENTS.md
6. mandates retrieve-before-recall; this doc is the first thing to grep.
7. 
8. Status legend:
9. - **v1** = shipped, MPI cross-node smoke tests pass.
10. - **v2** = current target: complete `am_bcopy` (max_bcopy decoupled from
11.   FIFO element size, no per-message UCP fragmentation below seg_size).
12. 
13. ---
14. 
15. ## Locked-in environment facts
16. 
17. (Mirrors `.github/skills/obmm-api-and-env/SKILL.md`. Do NOT contradict
18. without re-checking that file.)
19. 
20. - Each node pre-exports **one 128 MiB region**; export/import is done
21.   outside UCX. UCT must NOT call `obmm_export/import/preimport/...`.
22. - Data-path mapping is **non-cacheable** (`open(... O_SYNC)` + mmap).
23.   `obmm_set_ownership` is forbidden and irrelevant.
24. - Cross-host atomic FAA/CAS on NC is supported (project-owner statement).
25. - Memory ordering uses **bus-domain fences**
26.   (`ucs_memory_bus_store_fence` / `ucs_memory_bus_load_fence`), NOT the
27.   CPU-domain `ucs_memory_cpu_*_fence` that mm uses. mm peers share an
28.   inner-shareable cache domain; obmm peers do not.
29. - Reachability is keyed on `(exporter_dcna, exporter_deid, memid)`,
30.   never memid alone.
31. - Two-phase pool init (UNINIT → INITING → READY via CAS) plus per-slot
32.   `(generation, owner_pid, owner_starttime)` for crash/PID-reuse safety.
33.   During teardown, INITING is reused only as a transient cleanup lock; after
34.   reset the shared region returns to literal all-zero memory.
35. - ARM64 is the production ISA. NC + bus fences are correct on aarch64.
36. 
37. ---
38. 
39. ## Region layout (v2)
40. 
41. Inside the 128 MiB exported region:
42. 
43. ```
44. +-------------------------------------------------------+ offset 0
45. | uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t (magic, state, geometry)          |
46. +-------------------------------------------------------+
47. | alloc_bitmap[bitmap_words]                            |
48. +-------------------------------------------------------+
49. | slot_meta[slot_count]  (gen, owner_pid, starttime, …) |
50. +-------------------------------------------------------+ hdr->slot_array_offset
51. | slot[0]:                                              |
52. |   uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t  (head + tail, padded)          |
53. |   fifo_elem[fifo_size]  (elem_size each)              |
54. |   bcopy_desc[fifo_size] (seg_size each)   <-- NEW v2  |
55. +-------------------------------------------------------+
56. | slot[1]: …                                            |
57. …
58. ```
59. 
60. **Key invariant (v2)**: every FIFO element `elem[N]` (N = `idx & mask`)
61. has a paired `desc[N]` of `seg_size` bytes in the same slot. Lifetime of
62. `desc[N]` is **identical** to lifetime of `elem[N]` — both are released
63. together when the receiver bumps tail past index N, and both are
64. overwritten together by the sender that claims index N+fifo_size.
65. 
66. This eliminates the cross-host desc free-list problem: there is no
67. separate desc allocator, no per-desc CAS, and no risk of the desc pool
68. running dry while FIFO slots remain available. The FIFO already has
69. exactly the right backpressure semantics.
70. 
71. ### Slot stride
72. 
73. ```
74. slot_stride = align_up(
75.     sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t) +
76.     fifo_size * elem_size +
77.     fifo_size * seg_size,
78.     cacheline)
79. ```
80. 
81. The pool's `slot_count` (compile-time `UCT_OBMM_POOL_SLOT_COUNT = 32`)
82. **times** `slot_stride` MUST fit in `region->length` (128 MiB minus pool
83.  header overhead). Defaults are picked to favor short-path coverage over
84.  maximum local process count; lowering `seg_size` and/or `fifo_size`
85.  reduces per-slot footprint, but the supported local attach count remains
86.  the compile-time `slot_count`.
87. 
88. Default budget check:
89. ```
90. fifo_size       =     64
91. elem_size       =  16448   (raw UCT max_short = 16432 total bytes)
92. seg_size        =  32768   (raw UCT max_bcopy = 32768)
93. ctl + slot data = 128 + 64*(16448+32768) = ~3076 KiB / slot
94. slot_count      =     32
95. total           = ~ 96 MiB / 128 MiB                     ✓
96. ```
97. These defaults are chosen from the measured OSU latency sweep rather than from
98. wire-format arithmetic alone. With Open MPI PML/UCX on this tree, ordinary
99. `MPI_Send` goes through `mca_pml_ucx_send_nbr()` into `ucp_tag_send_nbx()`,
100. and UCX defaults `PROTO_ENABLE=y`, so protocol v2 selects between eager short,
101. eager bcopy single/multi, and rendezvous using its own headers and cost model.
102. The best reasoning-backed configuration found so far is to keep both geometry
103. knobs 64-byte aligned, leave `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE=32768` for 32KiB-class raw bcopy
104. capacity, and reduce `FIFO_ELEM_SIZE` to `16448` so 16KiB-class payloads stay
105. comfortably on short without over-extending the short window into slower
106. 32KiB-class territory.
107. 
108. If a user also pushes the short geometry back to a 32768-byte payload
109. (`elem_size=32792`) while simultaneously stretches bcopy to `seg_size=32792`,
110. the pool overruns the 128 MiB region by 103232 bytes and attach fails with a
111. clear error pointing at the geometry knobs.
112. 
113. When the last local iface on an export exits, UCX resets the entire local
114. export region to zero before another attach may re-initialize the pool.
115. 
116. ---
117. 
118. ## FIFO element layout
119. 
120. `uct_obmm_fifo_element_t` (16 bytes, packed) is unchanged from v1:
121. 
122. | field      | bytes | notes                                          |
123. |------------|-------|------------------------------------------------|
124. | flags      |   1   | OWNER bit + BCOPY bit                          |
125. | am_id      |   1   |                                                |
126. | length     |   2   | u16 — payload bytes (excl. am_short hdr)       |
127. | generation |   4   | slot generation token at TX time               |
128. | header     |   8   | am_short user-visible 8B header (unused bcopy) |
129. 
130. **am_short payload** still lives inline at `elem + 1` in the FIFO area.
131. Wire format and `max_short = elem_size - 16` are unchanged.
132. 
133. **am_bcopy payload** (NEW in v2) lives in the paired `desc[N]` instead
134. of inside the FIFO element body. The element body is unused for bcopy;
135. on bcopy the sender writes:
136. - `elem->flags  = OWNER | BCOPY`
137. - `elem->am_id  = id`
138. - `elem->length = pack_cb_returned_length`     (≤ seg_size, so ≤ u16max)
139. - `elem->generation = ep->expected_generation`
140. - `elem->header = 0` (unused)
141. 
142. Receiver, on seeing FLAG_BCOPY, computes
143. `desc[N] = slot_descs + (idx & mask) * seg_size` and calls
144. `uct_iface_invoke_am(am_id, desc[N], length, 0)`.
145. 
146. Because `desc[N]` is bound 1:1 to `elem[N]`, no extra metadata is
147. exchanged in the FIFO element to locate the desc.
148. 
149. ### `length` field width
150. 
151. `elem->length` stays `uint16_t`, capping `seg_size` at 65535. We reject
152. larger `seg_size` at iface init. If a future `seg_size > 64KiB` is
153. needed, widen `length` to `uint32_t` and update the compatibility checks.
154. 
155. ---
156. 
157. ## Sender side (`obmm_ep`)
158. 
159. Both `am_short` and `am_bcopy` reserve a slot identically:
160. 
161. ```
162. 1. load head from peer_ctl->head
163. 2. if (head - cached_tail) >= fifo_size:
164.        bus_load_fence; refresh cached_tail; recheck;
165.        if still full: return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE
166. 3. claim producer lock (`peer_ctl->lock`) with a unique token, then
167.    store head → head+1, then release the lock
168. 4. compute idx = head, N = idx & mask
169. 5. payload write:
170.      short: memcpy header+payload into elem[N]+1
171.      bcopy: pack_cb(desc[N], arg) -> length
172. 6. fill elem[N] header fields (am_id, length, generation, [header])
173. 7. ucs_memory_bus_store_fence()                          <- release barrier
174. 8. elem[N]->flags = OWNER_BIT_FOR_THIS_LAP | (BCOPY if bcopy)
175. ```
176. 
177. The OWNER bit alternates each lap of the ring (see `obmm_iface.c`
178. `uct_obmm_iface_progress` for why). Since `desc[N]` writes happen
179. **before** the bus_store_fence, they become visible to the peer at the
180. same time as the published flags byte.
181. 
182. The producer lock exists because on the validated target aarch64 NC
183. environment, cross-node CAS updates memory correctly but its return value
184. is not reliable enough to use as a head-claim ownership result. The token
185. lock converts reservation into: acquire lock by readback, re-check space,
186. plain-store new head, release lock.
187. 
188. ### Pending
189. 
190. `ep_pending_add` returns `UCS_ERR_BUSY` (UCP retries via its own
191. progress loop). Real arbiter is out of scope for v1/v2 — backpressure
192. is bounded because the receiver drains continuously.
193. 
194. ---
195. 
196. ## Receiver side (`obmm_iface_progress`)
197. 
198. ```
199. loop up to fifo_max_poll:
200.     elem = elem[read_index & mask]
201.     expected_owner = lap_parity(read_index)
202.     if (elem->flags & OWNER) != expected_owner: break       (no work)
203.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence()                              (acquire)
204.     if elem->generation != iface->generation:
205.         drop silently (slot was reused after our death+rebirth)
206.     elif elem->flags & BCOPY:
207.         desc = desc[read_index & mask]
208.         invoke_am(am_id, desc,  length, 0)
209.     else:
210.         invoke_am(am_id, &elem->header, length, 0)
211.     read_index++
212. if any progress:
213.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence()
214.     recv_ctl->tail = read_index
215. ```
216. 
217. **Why the fence ordering is correct for bcopy too**: the
218. `ucs_memory_bus_load_fence()` issued after observing the flags byte
219. orders **all** subsequent loads in this iteration — including the
220. load of `desc[N]` performed inside the AM handler's memcpy. The handler
221. is `CB_SYNC` (synchronous), so the fence-acquire pairs with the
222. sender's `bus_store_fence` before publishing flags.
223. 
224. ---
225. 
226. ## Capabilities (`iface_query`)
227. 
228. | flag                            | v1 | v2 | notes                       |
229. |---------------------------------|----|----|-----------------------------|
230. | AM_SHORT                        |  ✓ |  ✓ | max = elem_size - 16        |
231. | AM_BCOPY                        |  ✓ |  ✓ | v1: = max_short (cramped); v2: = seg_size |
232. | PENDING                         |  ✓ |  ✓ | returns BUSY only           |
233. | CONNECT_TO_IFACE                |  ✓ |  ✓ |                             |
234. | CB_SYNC                         |  ✓ |  ✓ |                             |
235. | INTER_NODE                      |  ✓ |  ✓ | required for cross-host UCT (otherwise OMPI's NET_ONLY filter strips us — see ucp_worker.c:2962) |
236. 
237. **Not advertised** in v1/v2: PUT/GET (any), ATOMIC, AM_ZCOPY, EP_CHECK,
238. AM_DUP, ERRHANDLE_PEER. Adding any of these requires a separate design
239. note.
240. 
241. ---
242. 
243. ## Wire-format compat
244. 
245. `uct_obmm_iface_addr_t` carries `(slot_index, generation, pid,
246. fifo_size, fifo_elem_size, bcopy_seg_size)`. v2 **adds** `bcopy_seg_size`
247. (replaces v1's `reserved` u32 → no struct-size change). Two ifaces are
248. mutually reachable iff all three geometry fields match — guarded in
249. `is_reachable_v2`. Pool compatibility is enforced by the shared pool
250. geometry checks in `pool_attach`/`pool_open`; the shared region does not
251. persist a separate pool version word or filler replacement field.
252.

254.

256. 
257. All under `UCX_OBMM_*` prefix.

259. | knob                      | default | meaning                          |

135.     attr->ep_addr_len            = 0;

196. static int
197. uct_obmm_iface_is_reachable_v2(const uct_iface_h tl_iface,
198.                                const uct_iface_is_reachable_params_t *params)
199. {
200.     uct_obmm_iface_t             *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_iface,
201.                                                          uct_obmm_iface_t);
202.     uct_obmm_md_t                *md    = ucs_derived_of(iface->super.md,
203.                                                          uct_obmm_md_t);
204.     const uct_obmm_device_addr_t *daddr;
205.     const uct_obmm_iface_addr_t  *iaddr;
206.     uct_obmm_eid_t                eid;
207.     uct_obmm_region_t            *export_r;
208. 
209.     if (!uct_iface_is_reachable_params_addrs_valid(params)) {
210.         return 0;
211.     }
212. 
213.     daddr = (const uct_obmm_device_addr_t*)params->device_addr;
214.     iaddr = (const uct_obmm_iface_addr_t*)params->iface_addr;
215.     if ((daddr == NULL) || (iaddr == NULL)) {
216.         uct_iface_fill_info_str_buf(params, "missing device or iface address");
217.         return 0;
218.     }
219. 
220.     if ((iaddr->fifo_size != iface->fifo_size) ||
221.         (iaddr->fifo_elem_size != iface->fifo_elem_size) ||
222.         (iaddr->bcopy_seg_size != iface->bcopy_seg_size)) {
223.         uct_iface_fill_info_str_buf(params,
224.                                     "incompatible OBMM geometry "
225.                                     "(peer fifo=%u elem=%u seg=%u, "
226.                                     "local fifo=%u elem=%u seg=%u)",
227.                                     iaddr->fifo_size, iaddr->fifo_elem_size,
228.                                     iaddr->bcopy_seg_size,
229.                                     iface->fifo_size, iface->fifo_elem_size,
230.                                     iface->bcopy_seg_size);
231.         return 0;
232.     }
233. 
234.     eid.hi = daddr->exporter_deid_hi;
235.     eid.lo = daddr->exporter_deid_lo;
236. 
237.     export_r = uct_obmm_md_export_region(md);
238.     if ((export_r != NULL) &&
239.         (export_r->info.exporter_dcna == daddr->exporter_dcna) &&
240.         (export_r->info.exporter_deid.hi == eid.hi) &&
241.         (export_r->info.exporter_deid.lo == eid.lo)) {
242.         return uct_iface_scope_is_reachable(tl_iface, params);
243.     }
244. 
245.     if (uct_obmm_md_find_import_region(md, daddr->exporter_dcna, &eid) != NULL) {
246.         return uct_iface_scope_is_reachable(tl_iface, params);
247.     }
248. 
249.     uct_iface_fill_info_str_buf(params,
250.                                 "no mapped region for peer dcna=0x%lx "
251.                                 "deid=0x%lx:0x%lx",
252.                                 (unsigned long)daddr->exporter_dcna,
253.                                 (unsigned long)eid.hi, (unsigned long)eid.lo);
254.     return 0;
255. }

258. static unsigned uct_obmm_iface_progress(uct_iface_h tl_iface)
259. {
260.     uct_obmm_iface_t        *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_iface, uct_obmm_iface_t);
261.     unsigned                 polled = 0;
262.     uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem;
263.     uint8_t                  flags;
264.     uint8_t                  expected_owner;
265.     size_t                   max_poll = iface->fifo_max_poll;
266. 
267.     while (polled < max_poll) {
268.         elem = uct_obmm_slot_elem(iface->recv_elems, iface->read_index,
269.                                   iface->fifo_mask, iface->fifo_elem_size);
270. 
271.         /* Owner bit alternates each lap of the ring; pass 0 expects 1, pass
272.          * 1 expects 0, etc. Combined with zero-fill on slot allocation, this
273.          * means an unwritten slot reads as flags==0 and is correctly skipped
274.          * on the very first lap. */
275.         expected_owner = ((iface->read_index / iface->fifo_size) & 1u) ?
276.                          0u : UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER;
277. 
278.         flags = elem->flags;
279.         if ((flags & UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER) != expected_owner) {
280.             break;
281.         }
282. 
283.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
284. 
285.         if (elem->generation != iface->generation) {
286.             /* Stale write from a previous slot owner (we were torn down and
287.              * re-allocated this slot). Drop silently. */
288.             ucs_trace_data("obmm: drop stale elem (gen=%u expected=%u) "
289.                            "at idx=%lu", elem->generation, iface->generation,
290.                            (unsigned long)iface->read_index);
291.         } else if (flags & UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_BCOPY) {
292.             /* am_bcopy: payload is in the paired desc[N], not in the FIFO
293.              * element body. The bus_load_fence above orders this load
294.              * with respect to the sender's bus_store_fence + flag write. */
295.             void *desc = uct_obmm_slot_desc(iface->recv_descs,
296.                                             iface->read_index,
297.                                             iface->fifo_mask,
298.                                             iface->bcopy_seg_size);
299.             uct_iface_invoke_am(&iface->super, elem->am_id,
300.                                 desc, elem->length, 0);
301.         } else {
302.             /* am_short: contiguous [header(8B)][payload] starting at
303.              * &elem->header. elem->length already includes the 8B header. */
304.             uct_iface_invoke_am(&iface->super, elem->am_id,
305.                                 &elem->header, elem->length, 0);
306.         }
307. 
308.         iface->read_index++;
309.         polled++;
310.     }
311. 
312.     if (polled > 0) {
313.         /* Full bus fence: orders the AM handler's LOADS from desc[]/elem
314.          * payload BEFORE the STORE that publishes the new tail. A plain
315.          * bus_store_fence (e.g. dmb oshst on aarch64) only orders
316.          * store→store, which would let a sender observe the advanced
317.          * tail and overwrite desc[N] while we still have outstanding
318.          * loads in flight. See obmm_fifo.h:uct_obmm_bus_full_fence. */
319.         uct_obmm_bus_full_fence();
320.         iface->recv_ctl->tail = iface->read_index;
321.     }
322. 
323.     /* Drain any UCP requests waiting on TX backpressure. The peer-side
324.      * tail advance we just published may also have freed slots that *our*
325.      * pending eps have been waiting for; dispatch with a fresh head/tail
326.      * snapshot so retries see the latest state. Without this dispatch,
327.      * UCS_ERR_BUSY-only pending_add caused a livelock under symmetric
328.      * bidirectional load at BCOPY_SEG_SIZE. */
329.     ucs_arbiter_dispatch(&iface->arbiter, 1, uct_obmm_ep_process_pending,
330.                          &polled);
331. 
332.     if ((polled == 0) && !ucs_arbiter_is_empty(&iface->arbiter)) {
333.         ++iface->trace_idle_pending_count;
334.         if (uct_obmm_trace_should_log(iface->trace_idle_pending_count)) {
335.             uct_obmm_iface_trace_pending_idle(iface, "iface idle with pending",
336.                                               iface->trace_idle_pending_count,
337.                                               polled);
338.         }
339.     } else if (iface->trace_idle_pending_count != 0) {
340.         uct_obmm_iface_trace_pending_idle(iface, "iface pending recovered",
341.                                           iface->trace_idle_pending_count,
342.                                           polled);
343.         iface->trace_idle_pending_count = 0;
344.     }
345. 
346.     return polled;
347. }

368. static UCS_CLASS_INIT_FUNC(uct_obmm_iface_t, uct_md_h tl_md, uct_worker_h worker,
369.                            const uct_iface_params_t *params,
370.                            const uct_iface_config_t *tl_config)
371. {
372.     uct_obmm_iface_config_t *config = ucs_derived_of(tl_config,
373.                                                      uct_obmm_iface_config_t);
374.     uct_obmm_md_t           *md     = ucs_derived_of(tl_md, uct_obmm_md_t);
375.     uct_obmm_region_t       *region;
376.     size_t                   stride;
377.     size_t                   required;
378.     ucs_status_t             status;
379. 
380.     if (config->fifo_size == 0) {
381.         ucs_error("obmm: FIFO_SIZE must be > 0");
382.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
383.     }
384.     if (!ucs_is_pow2(config->fifo_size)) {
385.         ucs_error("obmm: FIFO_SIZE (%u) must be a power of 2",
386.                   config->fifo_size);
387.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
388.     }
389.     if (config->fifo_elem_size <= sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_element_t)) {
390.         ucs_error("obmm: FIFO_ELEM_SIZE (%u) must be > %zu",
391.                   config->fifo_elem_size, sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_element_t));
392.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
393.     }
394.     /* elem->length is uint16_t; reject geometries whose advertised
395.      * max_short / max_bcopy would not fit in that field. */
396.     if ((config->fifo_elem_size - sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_element_t)) >
397.         UINT16_MAX) {
398.         ucs_error("obmm: FIFO_ELEM_SIZE (%u) too large; payload area must fit "
399.                   "in uint16 (max %zu)",
400.                   config->fifo_elem_size,
401.                   (size_t)UINT16_MAX + sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_element_t));
402.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
403.     }
404.     if (config->bcopy_seg_size == 0) {
405.         ucs_error("obmm: BCOPY_SEG_SIZE must be > 0");
406.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
407.     }
408.     if (config->bcopy_seg_size > UINT16_MAX) {
409.         ucs_error("obmm: BCOPY_SEG_SIZE (%u) too large; max_bcopy must fit "
410.                   "in uint16 (max %u)",
411.                   config->bcopy_seg_size, (unsigned)UINT16_MAX);
412.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
413.     }
414. 
415.     region = uct_obmm_md_export_region(md);
416.     if (region == NULL) {
417.         ucs_error("obmm: cannot create iface; this MD has no local export "
418.                   "region");
419.         return UCS_ERR_NO_DEVICE;
420.     }
421. 
422.     /* Compute slot stride as size_t, then validate it fits in u32 (the
423.      * pool header field is u32) AND that the total region budget covers
424.      * slot_count slots. Failing here is preferred over silently capping
425.      * BCOPY_SEG_SIZE — UCP would happily make protocol decisions based
426.      * on a quietly reduced max_bcopy. */
427.     stride = uct_obmm_slot_stride(config->fifo_size, config->fifo_elem_size,
428.                                   config->bcopy_seg_size);
429.     if (stride > UINT32_MAX) {
430.         ucs_error("obmm: slot stride %zu exceeds uint32_t (fifo_size=%u "
431.                   "elem=%u seg=%u); reduce one of the geometry knobs",
432.                   stride, config->fifo_size, config->fifo_elem_size,
433.                   config->bcopy_seg_size);
434.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
435.     }
436.     required = uct_obmm_pool_required_size(UCT_OBMM_POOL_SLOT_COUNT,
437.                                            (uint32_t)stride);
438.     if (required > region->length) {
439.         ucs_error("obmm: geometry does not fit in region: "
440.                   "fifo_size=%u elem_size=%u seg_size=%u stride=%zu "
441.                   "slot_count=%u required=%zu region=%zu. "
442.                   "Reduce UCX_OBMM_BCOPY_SEG_SIZE or UCX_OBMM_FIFO_SIZE.",
443.                   config->fifo_size, config->fifo_elem_size,
444.                   config->bcopy_seg_size, stride,
445.                   UCT_OBMM_POOL_SLOT_COUNT, required, region->length);
446.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
447.     }
448. 
449.     UCT_CHECK_PARAM(params->field_mask & UCT_IFACE_PARAM_FIELD_OPEN_MODE,
450.                     "UCT_IFACE_PARAM_FIELD_OPEN_MODE is not defined");
451.     if (!(params->open_mode & UCT_IFACE_OPEN_MODE_DEVICE)) {
452.         ucs_error("only UCT_IFACE_OPEN_MODE_DEVICE is supported");
453.         return UCS_ERR_UNSUPPORTED;
454.     }
455. 
456.     UCS_CLASS_CALL_SUPER_INIT(uct_base_iface_t, &uct_obmm_iface_ops,

353. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_ep_am_short(uct_ep_h tl_ep, uint8_t id, uint64_t header,
354.                                   const void *payload, unsigned length)
355. {
356.     uct_obmm_ep_t           *ep    = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep, uct_obmm_ep_t);
357.     uct_obmm_iface_t        *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep->iface,
358.                                                     uct_obmm_iface_t);
359.     size_t                   payload_total = sizeof(header) + length;
360.     uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem;
361.     uint64_t                 head;
362.     uint8_t                  owner_bit;
363. 
364.     UCT_CHECK_AM_ID(id);
365.     UCT_CHECK_LENGTH(payload_total, 0,
366.                      ep->fifo_elem_size - sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_element_t),
367.                      "am_short");
368. 
369.     if (ucs_unlikely(!ucs_arbiter_group_is_empty(&ep->arb_group))) {
370.         ++ep->trace_send_with_pending_count;
371.         if (uct_obmm_trace_should_log(ep->trace_send_with_pending_count)) {
372.             uct_obmm_ep_trace_state(ep, "send while pending",
373.                                     ep->trace_send_with_pending_count,
374.                                     "am_short entry", NULL);
375.         }
376.     }
377. 
378.     if (uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot(ep, &head) != UCS_OK) {
379.         return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
380.     }
381. 
382.     elem = uct_obmm_slot_elem(ep->peer_elems, head, ep->fifo_mask,
383.                               ep->fifo_elem_size);
384. 
385.     elem->am_id      = id;
386.     elem->length     = (uint16_t)payload_total;
387.     elem->generation = ep->expected_generation;
388.     elem->header     = header;
389.     if (length > 0) {
390.         memcpy(elem + 1, payload, length);
391.     }
392. 
393.     /* Publish: the OWNER bit toggles each wraparound. The receiver expects
394.      * bit==1 on even passes and bit==0 on odd passes (and vice versa) so
395.      * that uninitialized memory (zero) reads as "not yet written" on the
396.      * first pass. */
397.     owner_bit = ((head / ep->fifo_size) & 1u) ? 0u : UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER;
398. 
399.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
400.     elem->flags = owner_bit;
401. 
402.     UCT_TL_EP_STAT_OP(&ep->super, AM, SHORT, payload_total);
403.     uct_iface_trace_am(&iface->super, UCT_AM_TRACE_TYPE_SEND, id,
404.                        &header, payload_total, "TX: AM_SHORT");
405.     return UCS_OK;
406. }

409. /* Reserve one slot in the peer's FIFO, returning the head index that was
410.  * claimed. Multi-producer reservation is serialized with a token lock because
411.  * on target NC/aarch64 mappings, CAS updates memory but its return value is
412.  * not a reliable ownership result. */
413. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE ucs_status_t
414. uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot(uct_obmm_ep_t *ep, uint64_t *head_p)
415. {
416.     uint64_t head;
417. 
418.     if (!uct_obmm_ep_try_lock_head(ep)) {
419.         ++ep->trace_reserve_no_resource_count;
420.         if (uct_obmm_trace_should_log_persistent(
421.                 ep->trace_reserve_no_resource_count,
422.                 UCT_OBMM_TRACE_RESERVE_LOG_MIN)) {
423.             uct_obmm_ep_trace_state(ep, "reserve stalled",
424.                                     ep->trace_reserve_no_resource_count,
425.                                     "head lock busy", NULL);
426.         }
427.         UCS_STATS_UPDATE_COUNTER(ep->super.stats, UCT_EP_STAT_NO_RES, 1);
428.         return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
429.     }
430. 
431.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
432.     head = ep->peer_ctl->head;
433. 
434.     if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
435.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
436.         ep->cached_tail = ep->peer_ctl->tail;
437.         if ((head - ep->cached_tail) >= ep->fifo_size) {
438.             ++ep->trace_reserve_no_resource_count;
439.             if (uct_obmm_trace_should_log_persistent(
440.                     ep->trace_reserve_no_resource_count,
441.                     UCT_OBMM_TRACE_RESERVE_LOG_MIN)) {
442.                 uct_obmm_ep_trace_state(ep, "reserve stalled",
443.                                         ep->trace_reserve_no_resource_count,
444.                                         "peer fifo full", NULL);
445.             }
446.             UCS_STATS_UPDATE_COUNTER(ep->super.stats, UCT_EP_STAT_NO_RES, 1);
447.             uct_obmm_ep_unlock_head(ep);
448.             return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
449.         }
450.     }
451. 
452.     uct_obmm_bus_full_fence();
453.     ep->peer_ctl->head = head + 1;

78. static int uct_obmm_proc_alive(uint32_t pid, uint64_t starttime)
79. {

81. 
82.     if (pid == 0) {

85.

87.     if (live == 0ul) {

89.         return 0;

96. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE int
97. uct_obmm_pool_initializer_stamped(uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t *hdr)
98. {

103. /* CAS-claim the INITING transition; if we lose, wait until READY (or
104.  * recover the slot if the prior initializer died mid-init). */
105. static ucs_status_t
106. uct_obmm_pool_init_or_wait(uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t *hdr, uint32_t slot_count,
107.                            uint32_t slot_size)
108. {
109.     unsigned long      self_starttime = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time(getpid());
110.     uint32_t           prev;
111.     unsigned           spin;
112.     size_t             bitmap_words = uct_obmm_pool_bitmap_words(slot_count);
113.     size_t             slot_off     = uct_obmm_pool_slot_offset(slot_count);
114. 
115. retry:
116.     prev = ucs_atomic_cswap32(&hdr->state, UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT,
117.                               UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_INITING);
118. 
119.     if (prev == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT) {
120.         /* We won: zero metadata, fill geometry, publish READY */
121.         memset((char*)hdr + sizeof(*hdr), 0,
122.                bitmap_words * sizeof(uint64_t) +
123.                (size_t)slot_count * sizeof(uct_obmm_slot_meta_t));
124. 
125.         hdr->magic                 = UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC;
126.         hdr->slot_count            = slot_count;
127.         hdr->slot_size             = slot_size;
128.         hdr->slot_array_offset     = slot_off;
129.         hdr->bitmap_words          = (uint32_t)bitmap_words;
130.         hdr->initializer_pid       = (uint32_t)getpid();
131.         hdr->initializer_starttime = (uint64_t)self_starttime;
132. 
133.         ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
134.         hdr->state = UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY;
135.         return UCS_OK;
136.     }
137. 
138.     if (prev == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
139.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
140.         return UCS_OK;
141.     }
142. 
143.     /* state == INITING : wait or recover */
144.     for (spin = 0; spin < UCT_OBMM_POOL_INIT_SPIN_LIMIT; ++spin) {
145.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
146.         if (hdr->state == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
147.             return UCS_OK;
148.         }
149.         if (hdr->state == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT) {
150.             /* Some other rescuer reset; race for init */
151.             goto retry;
152.         }
153. 
154.         if ((spin & 0xfffu) == 0xfffu) {
155.             /* Periodically check if the initializer is alive. If not,
156.              * try to reset back to UNINIT so someone can re-init. */
157.             if (uct_obmm_pool_initializer_stamped(hdr) &&
158.                 !uct_obmm_proc_alive(hdr->initializer_pid,
159.                                      hdr->initializer_starttime)) {
160.                 ucs_warn("obmm: pool initializer pid=%u died; resetting "
161.                          "pool init state",
162.                          hdr->initializer_pid);
163.                 ucs_atomic_cswap32(&hdr->state, UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_INITING,
164.                                    UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT);
165.                 goto retry;
166.             }
167.         }
168.     }
169. 
170.     ucs_error("obmm: timed out waiting for pool init to complete "
171.               "(initializer pid=%u)", hdr->initializer_pid);
172.     return UCS_ERR_TIMED_OUT;
173. }

183.

191.                   "(slots=%u, slot_size=%u)",
192.                   region_size, required, slot_count, slot_size);

194.     }

203.                   (unsigned long)hdr->magic, (unsigned long)UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC);
204.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
205.     }
206.     if ((hdr->slot_count != slot_count) || (hdr->slot_size != slot_size)) {
207.         ucs_error("obmm: pool geometry mismatch "
208.                   "(have slots=%u size=%u, expected %u/%u)",
209.                   hdr->slot_count, hdr->slot_size, slot_count, slot_size);
210.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
211.     }
212. 
213.     pool->base       = region_base;
214.     pool->length     = region_size;
215.     pool->hdr        = hdr;
216.     pool->bitmap     = (volatile uint64_t*)((char*)hdr + sizeof(*hdr));
217.     pool->meta       = (uct_obmm_slot_meta_t*)((char*)hdr +
218.                                                uct_obmm_pool_meta_offset(slot_count));
219.     pool->slots      = (char*)hdr + hdr->slot_array_offset;
220.     pool->slot_count = slot_count;
221.     pool->slot_size  = slot_size;
222.     return UCS_OK;

226. /* Try to claim slot `idx` for the current process. Returns 1 on success
227.  * (bit was set by us, meta updated). Slots transition through CLAIMING so a
228.  * second process cannot take over while allocation/free is still publishing
229.  * ownership metadata. Dead owners (including crashed CLAIMING/DEAD states) may
230.  * be scavenged. Returns 0 if the slot is currently unclaimable. */
231. static int uct_obmm_pool_try_claim(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t idx,
232.                                    uint32_t self_pid, uint64_t self_starttime,
233.                                    uint32_t *generation_p)
234. {
235.     volatile uint64_t    *word    = &pool->bitmap[idx >> 6];
236.     uint64_t              bit     = 1ull << (idx & 63u);
237.     uct_obmm_slot_meta_t *m       = &pool->meta[idx];
238.     uint64_t              cur, oldval;
239.     uint32_t              state, rollback_state, state_prev, owner_pid;
240.     uint64_t              owner_starttime;
241.     int                   take_over = 0;
242. 
243.     if (!uct_obmm_pool_is_ready(pool)) {
244.         return 0;
245.     }
246. 
247.     cur = *word;
248.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
249.     state           = m->state;
250.     rollback_state  = state;
251.     owner_pid       = m->owner_pid;
252.     owner_starttime = m->owner_starttime;
253. 
254.     if (!(cur & bit)) {
255.         /* A crashed claimer may leave CLAIMING behind with bit still clear.
256.          * Reset it to FREE once its owner is known dead, then retry normal
257.          * allocation from the FREE state. */
258.         if (state == UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_CLAIMING) {
259.             if ((owner_pid == 0) ||
260.                 uct_obmm_proc_alive(owner_pid, owner_starttime)) {
261.                 return 0;
262.             }
263. 
264.             state_prev = ucs_atomic_cswap32(&m->state,
265.                                             UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_CLAIMING,
266.                                             UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE);
267.             if (state_prev != UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_CLAIMING) {
268.                 return 0;
269.             }
270.             state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE;
271.         }
272. 
273.         if (state != UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE) {
274.             return 0;
275.         }
276. 
277.         state_prev = ucs_atomic_cswap32(&m->state, UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE,
278.                                         UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_CLAIMING);
279.         if (state_prev != UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE) {
280.             return 0;
281.         }
282. 
283.         m->owner_pid       = self_pid;
284.         m->owner_starttime = self_starttime;
285.         ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
286. 
287.         /* free: reserve the bitmap bit only after state moved to CLAIMING */
288.         oldval = ucs_atomic_cswap64(word, cur, cur | bit);
289.         if (oldval != cur) {
290.             m->owner_pid       = 0;
291.             m->owner_starttime = 0;
292.             ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
293.             m->state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE;
294.             ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
295.             return 0; /* lost the race; caller will retry next slot */
296.         }
297.     } else {
298.         switch (state) {
299.         case UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_CLAIMING:
300.             if ((owner_pid == 0) ||
301.                 uct_obmm_proc_alive(owner_pid, owner_starttime)) {
302.                 return 0;
303.             }
304. 
305.             state_prev = ucs_atomic_cswap32(&m->state,
306.                                             UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_CLAIMING,
307.                                             UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_DEAD);
308.             if (state_prev != UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_CLAIMING) {
309.                 return 0;
310.             }
311.             state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_DEAD;
312.             /* fall through */
313.         case UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_DEAD:
314.             if ((owner_pid != 0) &&
315.                 uct_obmm_proc_alive(owner_pid, owner_starttime)) {
316.                 return 0;
317.             }
318. 
319.             state_prev = ucs_atomic_cswap32(&m->state,
320.                                             UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_DEAD,
321.                                             UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_CLAIMING);
322.             if (state_prev != UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_DEAD) {
323.                 return 0;
324.             }
325.             take_over = 1;
326.             break;
327.         case UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_IN_USE:
328.             if ((owner_pid != 0) &&
329.                 uct_obmm_proc_alive(owner_pid, owner_starttime)) {
330.                 return 0;
331.             }
332. 
333.             state_prev = ucs_atomic_cswap32(&m->state,
334.                                             UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_IN_USE,
335.                                             UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_CLAIMING);
336.             if (state_prev != UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_IN_USE) {
337.                 return 0;
338.             }
339.             take_over = 1;
340.             break;
341.         default:
342.             return 0;
343.         }
344.     }
345. 
346.     if (!uct_obmm_pool_is_ready(pool)) {
347.         if (take_over) {
348.             m->state = rollback_state;
349.             ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
350.         } else {
351.             uct_obmm_pool_clear_bit(word, bit);
352.             m->owner_pid       = 0;
353.             m->owner_starttime = 0;
354.             ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
355.             m->state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE;
356.             ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
357.         }
358.         return 0;
359.     }
360. 
361.     if (take_over) {
362.         m->owner_pid       = self_pid;
363.         m->owner_starttime = self_starttime;
364.         ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
365.     }
366. 
367.     /* Bump generation so any in-flight stale messages from prior owner are
368.      * dropped by the receive path. memset slot bytes only AFTER bumping
369.      * generation, so any racing writer's bytes won't survive un-stamped. */
370.     m->generation += 1;
371.     /* Zero the slot bytes for our use (FIFO ctl + elements). */
372.     memset(uct_obmm_pool_slot_ptr(pool, idx), 0, pool->slot_size);
373.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
374.     m->state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_IN_USE;
375.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
376. 
377.     *generation_p = m->generation;
378.     (void)take_over;
379.     return 1;
380. }

383. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_alloc_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool,
384.                                       uint32_t *slot_index_p,
385.                                       void **slot_ptr_p,
386.                                       uint32_t *generation_p)
387. {
388.     uint32_t      self_pid       = (uint32_t)getpid();
389.     unsigned long self_starttime = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time(getpid());
390.     uint32_t      i;
391. 
392.     if (self_starttime == 0ul) {
393.         ucs_warn("obmm: cannot read self process start time; "
394.                  "scavenge will treat us as dead");
395.     }
396. 
397.     for (i = 0; i < pool->slot_count; ++i) {
398.         if (!uct_obmm_pool_is_ready(pool)) {
399.             return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
400.         }
401.         if (uct_obmm_pool_try_claim(pool, i, self_pid,
402.                                     (uint64_t)self_starttime, generation_p)) {
403.             *slot_index_p = i;
404.             *slot_ptr_p   = uct_obmm_pool_slot_ptr(pool, i);
405.             return UCS_OK;
406.         }
407.     }
408. 
409.     return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
410. }

427. int uct_obmm_pool_free_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t slot_index)
428. {
429.     volatile uint64_t    *word = &pool->bitmap[slot_index >> 6];
430.     uint64_t              bit  = 1ull << (slot_index & 63u);
431.     uct_obmm_slot_meta_t *m    = &pool->meta[slot_index];
432.     unsigned long         self_starttime;
433.     uint32_t              state_prev;
434. 
435.     /* Bump generation first so any in-flight stale messages are discarded by
436.      * a future re-using owner; mark DEAD and bus fence before clearing the
437.      * bit so a racing claimer sees the new generation. */
438.     m->generation += 1;
439.     m->state       = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_DEAD;
440.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
441. 
442.     uct_obmm_pool_clear_bit(word, bit);
443. 
444.     m->owner_pid       = 0;
445.     m->owner_starttime = 0;
446.     m->state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE;
447.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
448. 
449.     if (!uct_obmm_pool_all_slots_free(pool)) {
450.         return 0;
451.     }
452. 
453.     state_prev = ucs_atomic_cswap32(&pool->hdr->state, UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY,
454.                                     UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_INITING);
455.     if (state_prev != UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
456.         return 0;
457.     }
458. 
459.     self_starttime = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time(getpid());
460.     pool->hdr->initializer_pid       = (uint32_t)getpid();
461.     pool->hdr->initializer_starttime = (uint64_t)self_starttime;
462.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
463. 
464.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
465.     if (!uct_obmm_pool_all_slots_free(pool)) {
466.         ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
467.         pool->hdr->state = UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY;
468.         return 0;
469.     }
470. 
471.     return 1;
472. }

475. void uct_obmm_pool_reset(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool)
476. {

18. /* Element flags carried in the shared FIFO element header. */
19. enum {
20.     /* Toggled every FIFO wraparound; receiver uses this to detect a freshly
21.      * written element without taking a tail/head delta lock. */
22.     UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER = UCS_BIT(0),
23. 
24.     /* Set by senders that wrote via am_bcopy (pack_cb output stored in the
25.      * payload area starting at elem+1, with NO 8-byte am_short header
26.      * prefix). When clear, the element was written via am_short and
27.      * &elem->header + length covers the [hdr][payload] buffer. */
28.     UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_BCOPY = UCS_BIT(1)
29. };
30. 
31. 
32. /* Per-slot FIFO control header. Lives at offset 0 of every allocated slot in
33.  * the obmm pool. Producers serialize `head` reservation with a token lock:
34.  * on target aarch64 NC mappings, cross-node CAS updates memory but its return
35.  * value is not a reliable ownership result. Consumers read/write `tail` to
36.  * release space. Control fields are accessed via non-cacheable mappings,
37.  * therefore all updates must be paired with bus fences
38.  * (ucs_memory_bus_*_fence), not CPU fences. */
39. typedef struct uct_obmm_fifo_ctl {
40.     /* 1st cacheline: producer-touched */
41.     volatile uint64_t head;
42.     volatile uint64_t lock;
43.     UCS_CACHELINE_PADDING(uint64_t, uint64_t);
44. 
45.     /* 2nd cacheline: consumer-touched */
46.     volatile uint64_t tail;
47.     UCS_CACHELINE_PADDING(uint64_t);
48. } UCS_V_ALIGNED(UCS_SYS_CACHE_LINE_SIZE) uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t;
49. 
50. 
51. /* FIFO element header. The element body (am short header + payload) follows
52.  * immediately. Total element stride is iface->config.fifo_elem_size, which
53.  * the iface chooses so that header+payload <= elem_size. */
54. typedef struct uct_obmm_fifo_element {
55.     uint8_t  flags;       /* UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_xx */
56.     uint8_t  am_id;       /* active message id */
57.     uint16_t length;      /* payload length (excluding am_short header) */
58.     uint32_t generation;  /* owner-slot generation token; receiver discards
59.                              elements whose generation doesn't match the
60.                              slot's current meta.generation */
61.     uint64_t header;      /* am_short 64-bit header */
62.     /* payload[length] follows here */
63. } UCS_S_PACKED uct_obmm_fifo_element_t;

69.  * result fits in the uint32_t pool_hdr->slot_size field before passing
70.  * to pool_attach. */
71. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE size_t
72. uct_obmm_slot_stride(unsigned fifo_size, unsigned fifo_elem_size,
73.                      unsigned bcopy_seg_size)

76.                         ((size_t)fifo_size * fifo_elem_size) +
77.                         ((size_t)fifo_size * bcopy_seg_size),
78.                         UCS_SYS_CACHE_LINE_SIZE);

103.                     unsigned fifo_elem_size)

117. }

121. uct_obmm_slot_desc(void *descs, uint64_t index, unsigned mask,
122.                    unsigned seg_size)

128. /* Full bus-domain fence: orders ALL prior memory accesses (loads and
129.  * stores) before ALL subsequent memory accesses, in the outer-shareable /
130.  * device domain that includes cross-host obmm peers.
131.  *
132.  * Why we need this in addition to ucs_memory_bus_{store,load}_fence:
133.  * the receiver must order its desc[N] LOADS (issued during the AM
134.  * handler) before the STORE that publishes the new tail. On ARM64,
135.  * ucs_memory_bus_store_fence() is `dmb oshst` (store→store only) and
136.  * does not order prior loads. Without this load→store barrier, a sender
137.  * could observe the advanced tail and overwrite desc[N] while the
138.  * receiver still has outstanding loads from the previous lap's payload.
139.  *
140.  * Defined locally in obmm rather than added to ucs/arch to keep the
141.  * change inside ucx/src/uct/obmm/ per AGENTS.md. */
142. #if defined(__aarch64__)
143. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() __asm__ __volatile__("dmb osh" ::: "memory")
144. #elif defined(__x86_64__) || defined(__i386__)
145. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() __asm__ __volatile__("mfence" ::: "memory")
146. #elif defined(__powerpc64__)
147. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() __asm__ __volatile__("sync" ::: "memory")
148. #elif defined(__riscv) && (__riscv_xlen == 64)
149. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() \
150.     __asm__ __volatile__("fence iorw, iorw" ::: "memory")
151. #else
152. /* Fallback: combine store + load fences. Not strictly load→store on all
153.  * archs but better than nothing; build will warn so the porter notices. */
154. #warning "obmm: no full bus fence for this arch; receiver tail release ordering may be weak"
155. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() do { \
156.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();        \
157.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();       \
158. } while (0)
159. #endif
160. 
161. #endif

86. def tokenize(query: str) -> list[str]:
87.     return re.findall(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*|\d+", query)

90. def build_match_expressions(query: str) -> list[str]:
91.     raw = query.strip()

106. 
107.     if f'"{escaped}"' not in expressions:
108.         expressions.append(f'"{escaped}"')
109. 
110.     deduped: list[str] = []
111.     for expr in expressions:
112.         if expr not in deduped:
113.             deduped.append(expr)
114.     return deduped
115. 
116. 
117. def clean_snippet(document: str, limit: int = 220) -> str:
118.     lines = document.splitlines()
119.     if lines[:3] and lines[0].startswith("path: ") and any(line.startswith("root: ") for line in lines[:4]):
120.         body_start = 0
121.         blank_seen = False
122.         for i, line in enumerate(lines):
123.             if line.strip():
124.                 if blank_seen:
125.                     body_start = i
126.                     break
127.             else:
128.                 blank_seen = True
129.         body = "\n".join(lines[body_start:]).strip()
130.     else:
131.         body = document.strip()
132.     body = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", body)
133.     return body[:limit]
134. 
135. 
136. def path_bias(collection: str, path: str) -> float:
137.     for prefix, bias in PATH_BIAS_RULES.get(collection, []):
138.         if path.startswith(prefix):
139.             return bias
140.     return 0.0
141. 
142. 
143. def hint_bias(path: str, hints: Iterable[str]) -> float:
144.     path_lower = path.lower()
145.     bias = 0.0
146.     for hint in hints:
147.         if hint.lower() in path_lower:
148.             bias -= 1.5
149.     return bias
150. 
151. 
152. def exact_bias(query: str, path: str, document: str) -> float:
153.     lowered = query.lower()
154.     bias = 0.0
155.     if lowered in path.lower():
156.         bias -= 1.0
157.     if lowered in document.lower():
158.         bias -= 1.5
159.     return bias
160. 
161. 
162. def fetch_candidates(
163.     con: sqlite3.Connection,
164.     collection: str,
165.     query: str,
166.     limit: int,
167. ) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
168.     results: dict[tuple[str, int, int], dict[str, object]] = {}
169.     expressions = build_match_expressions(query)
170.     if not expressions:
171.         return []
172. 
173.     sql = """
174.         select bm25(embedding_fulltext_search) as bm25_score,
175.                p.string_value as path,
176.                s.int_value as start_line,
177.                e.int_value as end_line,
178.                d.string_value as document
179.         from embedding_fulltext_search
180.         join embeddings emb on emb.id = embedding_fulltext_search.rowid
181.         join segments seg on seg.id = emb.segment_id and seg.scope = 'METADATA'
182.         join collections c on c.id = seg.collection
183.         join embedding_metadata d on d.id = emb.id and d.key = 'chroma:document'
184.         join embedding_metadata p on p.id = emb.id and p.key = 'path'
185.         join embedding_metadata s on s.id = emb.id and s.key = 'start_line'
186.         join embedding_metadata e on e.id = emb.id and e.key = 'end_line'
187.         where c.name = ? and embedding_fulltext_search match ?
188.         order by bm25_score
189.         limit ?
190.     """
191. 
192.     for expr in expressions:
193.         for row in con.execute(sql, (collection, expr, limit)):
194.             key = (row["path"], row["start_line"], row["end_line"])
195.             candidate = {
196.                 "collection": collection,
197.                 "path": row["path"],
198.                 "start_line": row["start_line"],
199.                 "end_line": row["end_line"],
200.                 "document": row["document"],
201.                 "bm25": float(row["bm25_score"]),
202.                 "match_expression": expr,
203.             }
204.             prev = results.get(key)
205.             if prev is None or candidate["bm25"] < prev["bm25"]:
206.                 results[key] = candidate
207.     return list(results.values())
208. 
209. 
210. def rerank(candidates: list[dict[str, object]], query: str, hints: list[str]) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
211.     reranked = []
212.     for item in candidates:
213.         doc = str(item["document"])
214.         path = str(item["path"])
215.         collection = str(item["collection"])
216.         adjusted = (
217.             float(item["bm25"])
218.             + path_bias(collection, path)
219.             + hint_bias(path, hints)
220.             + exact_bias(query, path, doc)
```

1. # obmm UCT transport — design notes
2. 
3. This file is the **single source of truth** for the on-region wire format
4. and the data-path semantics of the `obmm` UCT transport. Update it
5. **before** changing layout, capabilities, or sync rules. AGENTS.md
6. mandates retrieve-before-recall; this doc is the first thing to grep.
7. 
8. Status legend:
9. - **v1** = shipped, MPI cross-node smoke tests pass.
10. - **v2** = current target: complete `am_bcopy` (max_bcopy decoupled from
11.   FIFO element size, no per-message UCP fragmentation below seg_size).
12. 
13. ---
14. 
15. ## Locked-in environment facts
16. 
17. (Mirrors `.github/skills/obmm-api-and-env/SKILL.md`. Do NOT contradict
18. without re-checking that file.)
19. 
20. - Each node pre-exports **one 128 MiB region**; export/import is done
21.   outside UCX. UCT must NOT call `obmm_export/import/preimport/...`.
22. - Data-path mapping is **non-cacheable** (`open(... O_SYNC)` + mmap).
23.   `obmm_set_ownership` is forbidden and irrelevant.
24. - Cross-host atomic FAA/CAS on NC is supported (project-owner statement).
25. - Memory ordering uses **bus-domain fences**
26.   (`ucs_memory_bus_store_fence` / `ucs_memory_bus_load_fence`), NOT the
27.   CPU-domain `ucs_memory_cpu_*_fence` that mm uses. mm peers share an
28.   inner-shareable cache domain; obmm peers do not.
29. - Reachability is keyed on `(exporter_dcna, exporter_deid, memid)`,
30.   never memid alone.
31. - Two-phase pool init (UNINIT → INITING → READY via CAS) plus per-slot
32.   `(generation, owner_pid, owner_starttime)` for crash/PID-reuse safety.
33.   During teardown, INITING is reused only as a transient cleanup lock; after
34.   reset the shared region returns to literal all-zero memory.
35. - ARM64 is the production ISA. NC + bus fences are correct on aarch64.
36. 
37. ---
38. 
39. ## Region layout (v2)
40. 
41. Inside the 128 MiB exported region:
42. 
43. ```
44. +-------------------------------------------------------+ offset 0
45. | uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t (magic, state, geometry)          |
46. +-------------------------------------------------------+
47. | alloc_bitmap[bitmap_words]                            |
48. +-------------------------------------------------------+
49. | slot_meta[slot_count]  (gen, owner_pid, starttime, …) |
50. +-------------------------------------------------------+ hdr->slot_array_offset
51. | slot[0]:                                              |
52. |   uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t  (head + tail, padded)          |
53. |   fifo_elem[fifo_size]  (elem_size each)              |
54. |   bcopy_desc[fifo_size] (seg_size each)   <-- NEW v2  |
55. +-------------------------------------------------------+
56. | slot[1]: …                                            |
57. …
58. ```
59. 
60. **Key invariant (v2)**: every FIFO element `elem[N]` (N = `idx & mask`)
61. has a paired `desc[N]` of `seg_size` bytes in the same slot. Lifetime of
62. `desc[N]` is **identical** to lifetime of `elem[N]` — both are released
63. together when the receiver bumps tail past index N, and both are
64. overwritten together by the sender that claims index N+fifo_size.
65. 
66. This eliminates the cross-host desc free-list problem: there is no
67. separate desc allocator, no per-desc CAS, and no risk of the desc pool
68. running dry while FIFO slots remain available. The FIFO already has
69. exactly the right backpressure semantics.
70. 
71. ### Slot stride
72. 
73. ```
74. slot_stride = align_up(
75.     sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t) +
76.     fifo_size * elem_size +
77.     fifo_size * seg_size,
78.     cacheline)
79. ```
80. 
81. The pool's `slot_count` (compile-time `UCT_OBMM_POOL_SLOT_COUNT = 32`)
82. **times** `slot_stride` MUST fit in `region->length` (128 MiB minus pool
83.  header overhead). Defaults are picked to favor short-path coverage over
84.  maximum local process count; lowering `seg_size` and/or `fifo_size`
85.  reduces per-slot footprint, but the supported local attach count remains
86.  the compile-time `slot_count`.
87. 
88. Default budget check:
89. ```
90. fifo_size       =     64
91. elem_size       =  16448   (raw UCT max_short = 16432 total bytes)
92. seg_size        =  32768   (raw UCT max_bcopy = 32768)
93. ctl + slot data = 128 + 64*(16448+32768) = ~3076 KiB / slot
94. slot_count      =     32
95. total           = ~ 96 MiB / 128 MiB                     ✓
96. ```
97. These defaults are chosen from the measured OSU latency sweep rather than from
98. wire-format arithmetic alone. With Open MPI PML/UCX on this tree, ordinary
99. `MPI_Send` goes through `mca_pml_ucx_send_nbr()` into `ucp_tag_send_nbx()`,
100. and UCX defaults `PROTO_ENABLE=y`, so protocol v2 selects between eager short,
101. eager bcopy single/multi, and rendezvous using its own headers and cost model.
102. The best reasoning-backed configuration found so far is to keep both geometry
103. knobs 64-byte aligned, leave `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE=32768` for 32KiB-class raw bcopy
104. capacity, and reduce `FIFO_ELEM_SIZE` to `16448` so 16KiB-class payloads stay
105. comfortably on short without over-extending the short window into slower
106. 32KiB-class territory.
107. 
108. If a user also pushes the short geometry back to a 32768-byte payload
109. (`elem_size=32792`) while simultaneously stretches bcopy to `seg_size=32792`,
110. the pool overruns the 128 MiB region by 103232 bytes and attach fails with a
111. clear error pointing at the geometry knobs.
112. 
113. When the last local iface on an export exits, UCX resets the entire local
114. export region to zero before another attach may re-initialize the pool.
115. 
116. ---
117. 
118. ## FIFO element layout
119. 
120. `uct_obmm_fifo_element_t` (16 bytes, packed) is unchanged from v1:
121. 
122. | field      | bytes | notes                                          |
123. |------------|-------|------------------------------------------------|
124. | flags      |   1   | OWNER bit + BCOPY bit                          |
125. | am_id      |   1   |                                                |
126. | length     |   2   | u16 — payload bytes (excl. am_short hdr)       |
127. | generation |   4   | slot generation token at TX time               |
128. | header     |   8   | am_short user-visible 8B header (unused bcopy) |
129. 
130. **am_short payload** still lives inline at `elem + 1` in the FIFO area.
131. Wire format and `max_short = elem_size - 16` are unchanged.
132. 
133. **am_bcopy payload** (NEW in v2) lives in the paired `desc[N]` instead
134. of inside the FIFO element body. The element body is unused for bcopy;
135. on bcopy the sender writes:
136. - `elem->flags  = OWNER | BCOPY`
137. - `elem->am_id  = id`
138. - `elem->length = pack_cb_returned_length`     (≤ seg_size, so ≤ u16max)
139. - `elem->generation = ep->expected_generation`
140. - `elem->header = 0` (unused)
141. 
142. Receiver, on seeing FLAG_BCOPY, computes
143. `desc[N] = slot_descs + (idx & mask) * seg_size` and calls
144. `uct_iface_invoke_am(am_id, desc[N], length, 0)`.
145. 
146. Because `desc[N]` is bound 1:1 to `elem[N]`, no extra metadata is
147. exchanged in the FIFO element to locate the desc.
148. 
149. ### `length` field width
150. 
151. `elem->length` stays `uint16_t`, capping `seg_size` at 65535. We reject
152. larger `seg_size` at iface init. If a future `seg_size > 64KiB` is
153. needed, widen `length` to `uint32_t` and update the compatibility checks.
154. 
155. ---
156. 
157. ## Sender side (`obmm_ep`)
158. 
159. Both `am_short` and `am_bcopy` reserve a slot identically:
160. 
161. ```
162. 1. load head from peer_ctl->head
163. 2. if (head - cached_tail) >= fifo_size:
164.        bus_load_fence; refresh cached_tail; recheck;
165.        if still full: return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE
166. 3. claim producer lock (`peer_ctl->lock`) with a unique token, then
167.    store head → head+1, then release the lock
168. 4. compute idx = head, N = idx & mask
169. 5. payload write:
170.      short: memcpy header+payload into elem[N]+1
171.      bcopy: pack_cb(desc[N], arg) -> length
172. 6. fill elem[N] header fields (am_id, length, generation, [header])
173. 7. ucs_memory_bus_store_fence()                          <- release barrier
174. 8. elem[N]->flags = OWNER_BIT_FOR_THIS_LAP | (BCOPY if bcopy)
175. ```
176. 
177. The OWNER bit alternates each lap of the ring (see `obmm_iface.c`
178. `uct_obmm_iface_progress` for why). Since `desc[N]` writes happen
179. **before** the bus_store_fence, they become visible to the peer at the
180. same time as the published flags byte.
181. 
182. The producer lock exists because on the validated target aarch64 NC
183. environment, cross-node CAS updates memory correctly but its return value
184. is not reliable enough to use as a head-claim ownership result. The token
185. lock converts reservation into: acquire lock by readback, re-check space,
186. plain-store new head, release lock.
187. 
188. ### Pending
189. 
190. `ep_pending_add` returns `UCS_ERR_BUSY` (UCP retries via its own
191. progress loop). Real arbiter is out of scope for v1/v2 — backpressure
192. is bounded because the receiver drains continuously.
193. 
194. ---
195. 
196. ## Receiver side (`obmm_iface_progress`)
197. 
198. ```
199. loop up to fifo_max_poll:
200.     elem = elem[read_index & mask]
201.     expected_owner = lap_parity(read_index)
202.     if (elem->flags & OWNER) != expected_owner: break       (no work)
203.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence()                              (acquire)
204.     if elem->generation != iface->generation:
205.         drop silently (slot was reused after our death+rebirth)
206.     elif elem->flags & BCOPY:
207.         desc = desc[read_index & mask]
208.         invoke_am(am_id, desc,  length, 0)
209.     else:
210.         invoke_am(am_id, &elem->header, length, 0)
211.     read_index++
212. if any progress:
213.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence()
214.     recv_ctl->tail = read_index
215. ```
216. 
217. **Why the fence ordering is correct for bcopy too**: the
218. `ucs_memory_bus_load_fence()` issued after observing the flags byte
219. orders **all** subsequent loads in this iteration — including the
220. load of `desc[N]` performed inside the AM handler's memcpy. The handler
221. is `CB_SYNC` (synchronous), so the fence-acquire pairs with the
222. sender's `bus_store_fence` before publishing flags.
223. 
224. ---
225. 
226. ## Capabilities (`iface_query`)
227. 
228. | flag                            | v1 | v2 | notes                       |
229. |---------------------------------|----|----|-----------------------------|
230. | AM_SHORT                        |  ✓ |  ✓ | max = elem_size - 16        |
231. | AM_BCOPY                        |  ✓ |  ✓ | v1: = max_short (cramped); v2: = seg_size |
232. | PENDING                         |  ✓ |  ✓ | returns BUSY only           |
233. | CONNECT_TO_IFACE                |  ✓ |  ✓ |                             |
234. | CB_SYNC                         |  ✓ |  ✓ |                             |
235. | INTER_NODE                      |  ✓ |  ✓ | required for cross-host UCT (otherwise OMPI's NET_ONLY filter strips us — see ucp_worker.c:2962) |
236. 
237. **Not advertised** in v1/v2: PUT/GET (any), ATOMIC, AM_ZCOPY, EP_CHECK,
238. AM_DUP, ERRHANDLE_PEER. Adding any of these requires a separate design
239. note.
240. 
241. ---
242. 
243. ## Wire-format compat
244. 
245. `uct_obmm_iface_addr_t` carries `(slot_index, generation, pid,
246. fifo_size, fifo_elem_size, bcopy_seg_size)`. v2 **adds** `bcopy_seg_size`
247. (replaces v1's `reserved` u32 → no struct-size change). Two ifaces are
248. mutually reachable iff all three geometry fields match — guarded in
249. `is_reachable_v2`. Pool compatibility is enforced by the shared pool
250. geometry checks in `pool_attach`/`pool_open`; the shared region does not
251. persist a separate pool version word or filler replacement field.
252. 
253. ---
254. 
255. ## Configuration knobs
256. 
257. All under `UCX_OBMM_*` prefix.
258. 
259. | knob                      | default | meaning                          |
260. |---------------------------|---------|----------------------------------|
````

348. 
349.         uct_mm_iface_trace_am(iface, UCT_AM_TRACE_TYPE_SEND, elem_flags, am_id,

298. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void uct_mm_iface_process_recv(uct_mm_iface_t *iface)
299. {
300.     uct_mm_fifo_element_t *elem = iface->read_index_elem;
301.     ucs_status_t status;
302.     void *data;
303. 
304.     if (ucs_likely(elem->flags & UCT_MM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_INLINE)) {
305.         /* read short (inline) messages from the FIFO elements */
306.         uct_mm_iface_trace_am(iface, UCT_AM_TRACE_TYPE_RECV, elem->flags,
307.                               elem->am_id, elem + 1, elem->length,
308.                               iface->read_index);
309.         uct_mm_iface_invoke_am(iface, elem->am_id, elem + 1, elem->length, 0);
310.         return;
311.     }
312. 
313.     /* check the memory pool to make sure that there is a new descriptor available */
314.     if (ucs_unlikely(iface->last_recv_desc == NULL)) {
315.         UCT_TL_IFACE_GET_RX_DESC(&iface->super.super, &iface->recv_desc_mp,
316.                                  iface->last_recv_desc, return);
317.     }
318. 
319.     /* read bcopy messages from the receive descriptors */
320.     data = elem->desc_data;
321.     VALGRIND_MAKE_MEM_DEFINED(data, elem->length);
322.     uct_mm_iface_trace_am(iface, UCT_AM_TRACE_TYPE_RECV, elem->flags,
323.                           elem->am_id, data, elem->length, iface->read_index);
324. 
325.     status = uct_mm_iface_invoke_am(iface, elem->am_id, data, elem->length,
326.                                     UCT_CB_PARAM_FLAG_DESC);
327.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
328.         /* assign a new receive descriptor to this FIFO element.*/
329.         uct_mm_assign_desc_to_fifo_elem(iface, elem, 0);
330.         /* the last_recv_desc is in use. get a new descriptor for it */
331.         UCT_TL_IFACE_GET_RX_DESC(&iface->super.super, &iface->recv_desc_mp,
332.                                  iface->last_recv_desc, ucs_debug("recv mpool is empty"));
333.     }
334. }

336. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE int
337. uct_mm_iface_fifo_has_new_data(uct_mm_iface_t *iface)
338. {
339.     /* check the read_index to see if there is a new item to read
340.      * (checking the owner bit) */
341.     return (((iface->read_index >> iface->fifo_shift) & 1) ==
342.             (iface->read_index_elem->flags & 1));
343. }

345. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE unsigned
346. uct_mm_iface_poll_fifo(uct_mm_iface_t *iface)
347. {
348.     if (!uct_mm_iface_fifo_has_new_data(iface)) {
349.         return 0;
350.     }
351. 
352.     /* read from read_index_elem */
353.     ucs_memory_cpu_load_fence();
354.     ucs_assert(iface->read_index <=
355.                (iface->recv_fifo_ctl->head & ~UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_HEAD_EVENT_ARMED));
356. 
357.     uct_mm_iface_process_recv(iface);
358. 
359.     /* raise the read_index */
360.     iface->read_index++;
361. 
362.     /* the next fifo_element which the read_index points to */
363.     iface->read_index_elem =
364.         UCT_MM_IFACE_GET_FIFO_ELEM(iface, iface->recv_fifo_elems,
365.                                    (iface->read_index & iface->fifo_mask));
366. 
367.     uct_mm_progress_fifo_tail(iface);
368. 
369.     return 1;
370. }
371. 
372. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void
373. uct_mm_iface_fifo_window_adjust(uct_mm_iface_t *iface,
374.                                 unsigned fifo_poll_count)
375. {
376.     if (fifo_poll_count < iface->fifo_poll_count) {
377.         iface->fifo_poll_count = ucs_max(iface->fifo_poll_count /
378.                                          UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_MD_FACTOR,
379.                                          UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_MIN_POLL);
380.         iface->fifo_prev_wnd_cons = 0;
381.         return;
382.     }
383. 
384.     ucs_assert(fifo_poll_count == iface->fifo_poll_count);
385. 
386.     if (iface->fifo_prev_wnd_cons) {
387.         /* Increase FIFO window size if it was fully consumed
388.          * during the previous iface progress call in order
389.          * to prevent the situation when the window will be
390.          * adjusted to [MIN, MIN + 1, MIN, MIN + 1, ...] that
391.          * is harmful to latency */
392.         iface->fifo_poll_count = ucs_min(iface->fifo_poll_count +
393.                                          UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_AI_VALUE,
394.                                          iface->config.fifo_max_poll);
395.     } else {
396.         iface->fifo_prev_wnd_cons = 1;
397.     }
398. }
399. 
400. static unsigned uct_mm_iface_progress(uct_iface_h tl_iface)
401. {
402.     uct_mm_iface_t *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_iface, uct_mm_iface_t);
403.     unsigned total_count  = 0;
404.     unsigned count;
405. 
406.     ucs_assert(iface->fifo_poll_count >= UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_MIN_POLL);
407. 
408.     /* progress receive */
409.     do {
410.         count = uct_mm_iface_poll_fifo(iface);
411.         ucs_assert(count < 2);
412.         total_count += count;
413.         ucs_assert(total_count < UINT_MAX);
414.     } while ((count != 0) && (total_count < iface->fifo_poll_count));
415. 
416.     uct_mm_iface_fifo_window_adjust(iface, total_count);
417. 
418.     /* progress the pending sends (if there are any) */
419.     ucs_arbiter_dispatch(&iface->arbiter, 1, uct_mm_ep_process_pending,
420.                          &total_count);
421. 
422.     return total_count;
423. }

433. uct_mm_iface_event_fd_arm(uct_iface_h tl_iface, unsigned events)
434. {
435.     uct_mm_iface_t *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_iface, uct_mm_iface_t);
436.     char dummy[UCT_MM_IFACE_MAX_SIG_EVENTS]; /* pop multiple signals at once */
437.     uint64_t head, prev_head;
438.     int ret;
439. 
440.     if ((events & UCT_EVENT_SEND_COMP) &&
441.         !ucs_arbiter_is_empty(&iface->arbiter)) {
442.         /* if we have outstanding send operations, can't go to sleep */
443.         return UCS_ERR_BUSY;
444.     }
445. 
446.     if (!(events & UCT_EVENT_RECV)) {
447.         /* Nothing to do anymore */
448.         return UCS_OK;
449.     }
450. 
451.     /* Make the next sender which writes to the FIFO signal the receiver */
452.     head = iface->recv_fifo_ctl->head;
453.     if ((head & ~UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_HEAD_EVENT_ARMED) > iface->read_index) {
454.         /* head element was not read yet */
455.         ucs_trace("iface %p: cannot arm, head %" PRIu64 " read_index %" PRIu64,
456.                   iface, head & ~UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_HEAD_EVENT_ARMED,
457.                   iface->read_index);
458.         return UCS_ERR_BUSY;
459.     }

29. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE uint64_t uct_obmm_ep_mix64(uint64_t x)
30. {
31.     x ^= x >> 30;
32.     x *= UINT64_C(0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9);
33.     x ^= x >> 27;
34.     x *= UINT64_C(0x94d049bb133111eb);
35.     x ^= x >> 31;
36.     return x;
37. }

39. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE uint64_t
40. uct_obmm_ep_make_lock_token(uct_obmm_iface_t *iface, const uct_obmm_ep_t *ep)
41. {
42.     uint64_t token;
43.     uint64_t self_id;
44.     unsigned long self_starttime;
45. 
46.     self_starttime = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time(getpid());
47.     if ((self_starttime == 0ul) &&
48.         (ucs_atomic_cswap32(&uct_obmm_lock_token_starttime_warned, 0, 1) == 0)) {
49.         ucs_warn("obmm: cannot read self process start time while building "
50.                  "lock token; token uniqueness falls back to pid/slot/ep identity");
51.     }
52.     self_id        = ((uint64_t)(uint32_t)getpid() << 32) ^
53.                      (uint64_t)self_starttime;
54. 
55.     token = UINT64_C(0x9e3779b97f4a7c15);
56.     token = uct_obmm_ep_mix64(token ^ iface->region->info.exporter_dcna);
57.     token = uct_obmm_ep_mix64(token ^ iface->region->info.exporter_deid.hi);
58.     token = uct_obmm_ep_mix64(token ^ iface->region->info.exporter_deid.lo);
59.     token = uct_obmm_ep_mix64(token ^
60.                               (((uint64_t)iface->slot_index << 32) |
61.                                iface->generation));
62.     token = uct_obmm_ep_mix64(token ^ self_id);
63.     token = uct_obmm_ep_mix64(token ^
64.                               (((uint64_t)ep->peer_slot_index << 32) |
65.                                ep->peer_pid));
66.     token = uct_obmm_ep_mix64(token ^ (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)ep);
67.     return (token == 0) ? 1 : token;
68. }

84. uct_obmm_ep_trace_reason(uint64_t head, uint64_t cached_tail, uint64_t tail,

139. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE int
140. uct_obmm_ep_try_lock_head(uct_obmm_ep_t *ep)
141. {
142.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
143.     if (ep->peer_ctl->lock != 0) {
144.         return 0;
145.     }
146. 
147.     (void)ucs_atomic_cswap64(&ep->peer_ctl->lock, 0, ep->lock_token);
148.     uct_obmm_bus_full_fence();
149.     return ep->peer_ctl->lock == ep->lock_token;
150. }

153. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void
154. uct_obmm_ep_unlock_head(uct_obmm_ep_t *ep)
155. {
156.     uint64_t observed_lock;
157. 
158.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
159.     observed_lock = ep->peer_ctl->lock;
160.     if ((observed_lock != ep->lock_token) &&
161.         (ucs_atomic_cswap32(&uct_obmm_unlock_owner_mismatch_warned, 0, 1) == 0)) {
162.         ucs_warn("obmm: unlock owner mismatch ep=%p peer(pid=%u slot=%u gen=%u) "
163.                  "lock_addr=%p observed_lock=0x%llx token=0x%llx",
164.                  ep, ep->peer_pid, ep->peer_slot_index,
165.                  ep->expected_generation, &ep->peer_ctl->lock,
166.                  (unsigned long long)observed_lock,
167.                  (unsigned long long)ep->lock_token);
168.     }
169. 
170.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
171.     ep->peer_ctl->lock = 0;
172.     uct_obmm_bus_full_fence();
173.     observed_lock = ep->peer_ctl->lock;
174.     if ((observed_lock != 0) &&
175.         (ucs_atomic_cswap32(&uct_obmm_unlock_readback_warned, 0, 1) == 0)) {
176.         ucs_warn("obmm: unlock readback nonzero ep=%p peer(pid=%u slot=%u gen=%u) "
177.                  "lock_addr=%p readback_lock=0x%llx token=0x%llx",
178.                  ep, ep->peer_pid, ep->peer_slot_index,
179.                  ep->expected_generation, &ep->peer_ctl->lock,
180.                  (unsigned long long)observed_lock,
181.                  (unsigned long long)ep->lock_token);
182.     }
183. }
