192. static UCS_CLASS_INIT_FUNC(uct_obmm_ep_t, const uct_ep_params_t *params)
193. {
194.     uct_obmm_iface_t             *iface = ucs_derived_of(params->iface,
195.                                                          uct_obmm_iface_t);
196.     uct_obmm_md_t                *md    = ucs_derived_of(iface->super.md,
197.                                                          uct_obmm_md_t);
198.     const uct_obmm_device_addr_t *daddr;
199.     const uct_obmm_iface_addr_t  *iaddr;
200.     uct_obmm_region_t            *region;
201.     uct_obmm_pool_t               peer_pool;
202.     void                         *peer_slot;
203.     ucs_status_t                  status;
204. 
205.     UCT_EP_PARAMS_CHECK_DEV_IFACE_ADDRS(params);
206.     UCS_CLASS_CALL_SUPER_INIT(uct_base_ep_t, &iface->super);
207. 
208.     ucs_arbiter_group_init(&self->arb_group);
209. 
210.     daddr = (const uct_obmm_device_addr_t*)params->dev_addr;
211.     iaddr = (const uct_obmm_iface_addr_t*)params->iface_addr;
212. 
213.     /* Reject incompatible geometry. UCX wireup should already have filtered
214.      * this out via is_reachable_v2, but double-check. */
215.     if ((iaddr->fifo_size != iface->fifo_size) ||
216.         (iaddr->fifo_elem_size != iface->fifo_elem_size) ||
217.         (iaddr->bcopy_seg_size != iface->bcopy_seg_size)) {
218.         ucs_error("obmm: peer geometry (fifo=%u elem=%u seg=%u) differs from "
219.                   "local (fifo=%u elem=%u seg=%u); ep_create rejected",
220.                   iaddr->fifo_size, iaddr->fifo_elem_size,
221.                   iaddr->bcopy_seg_size,
222.                   iface->fifo_size, iface->fifo_elem_size,
223.                   iface->bcopy_seg_size);
224.         return UCS_ERR_UNREACHABLE;
225.     }
226. 
227.     /* Find the local region (export-for-self, import-for-remote) that maps
228.      * the peer's exporter coordinates. */
229.     {
230.         uct_obmm_region_t *exp_r;
231.         uct_obmm_eid_t     eid;
232. 
233.         eid.hi = daddr->exporter_deid_hi;
234.         eid.lo = daddr->exporter_deid_lo;
235. 
236.         exp_r  = uct_obmm_md_export_region(md);
237.         region = NULL;
238.         if ((exp_r != NULL) &&
239.             (exp_r->info.exporter_dcna == daddr->exporter_dcna) &&
240.             (exp_r->info.exporter_deid.hi == eid.hi) &&
241.             (exp_r->info.exporter_deid.lo == eid.lo)) {
242.             region = exp_r;
243.         } else {
244.             region = uct_obmm_md_find_import_region(md, daddr->exporter_dcna,
245.                                                     &eid);
246.         }
247.     }
248.     if (region == NULL) {
249.         ucs_error("obmm: ep_create cannot find region for peer "
250.                   "dcna=0x%lx deid=0x%lx:0x%lx",
251.                   (unsigned long)daddr->exporter_dcna,
252.                   (unsigned long)daddr->exporter_deid_hi,
253.                   (unsigned long)daddr->exporter_deid_lo);
254.         return UCS_ERR_UNREACHABLE;
255.     }
256. 
257.     status = uct_obmm_pool_open(region->base, region->length, &peer_pool);
258.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
259.         ucs_error("obmm: failed to open peer pool: %s",
260.                   ucs_status_string(status));
261.         return status;
262.     }
263. 
264.     if (iaddr->slot_index >= peer_pool.slot_count) {
265.         ucs_error("obmm: peer slot_index %u out of range (slot_count=%u)",
266.                   iaddr->slot_index, peer_pool.slot_count);
267.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
268.     }
269. 
270.     if (peer_pool.slot_size !=
271.         uct_obmm_slot_stride(iaddr->fifo_size, iaddr->fifo_elem_size,
272.                              iaddr->bcopy_seg_size)) {
273.         ucs_error("obmm: peer pool slot_size %u inconsistent with iface_addr "
274.                   "geometry (fifo=%u elem=%u seg=%u)",
275.                   peer_pool.slot_size, iaddr->fifo_size,
276.                   iaddr->fifo_elem_size, iaddr->bcopy_seg_size);
277.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
278.     }
279. 
280.     peer_slot = uct_obmm_pool_slot_ptr(&peer_pool, iaddr->slot_index);
281. 
282.     self->peer_ctl            = uct_obmm_slot_ctl(peer_slot);
283.     self->peer_elems          = uct_obmm_slot_elems(peer_slot);
284.     self->peer_descs          = uct_obmm_slot_descs(peer_slot,
285.                                                     iaddr->fifo_size,
286.                                                     iaddr->fifo_elem_size);
287.     self->cached_tail         = self->peer_ctl->tail;
288.     self->expected_generation = iaddr->generation;
289.     self->fifo_size           = iaddr->fifo_size;
290.     self->fifo_mask           = iaddr->fifo_size - 1u;
291.     self->fifo_elem_size      = iaddr->fifo_elem_size;
292.     self->bcopy_seg_size      = iaddr->bcopy_seg_size;
293.     self->peer_dcna           = daddr->exporter_dcna;
294.     self->peer_deid_hi        = daddr->exporter_deid_hi;
295.     self->peer_deid_lo        = daddr->exporter_deid_lo;
296.     self->peer_slot_index     = iaddr->slot_index;
297.     self->peer_pid            = iaddr->pid;
298.     self->lock_token          = uct_obmm_ep_make_lock_token(iface, self);
299.     self->trace_reserve_no_resource_count = 0;
300.     self->trace_pending_queue_count       = 0;
301.     self->trace_pending_resched_count     = 0;
302.     self->trace_send_with_pending_count   = 0;
303. 
304.     ucs_warn("obmm: ep token map ep=%p token=0x%llx local(pid=%d slot=%u "
305.              "gen=%u) peer(pid=%u slot=%u dcna=0x%llx deid=0x%llx:0x%llx)",
306.              self, (unsigned long long)self->lock_token, getpid(),
307.              iface->slot_index, iface->generation, self->peer_pid,
308.              self->peer_slot_index, (unsigned long long)self->peer_dcna,
309.              (unsigned long long)self->peer_deid_hi,
310.              (unsigned long long)self->peer_deid_lo);
311.     return UCS_OK;
312. }

315. {

329.                              const uct_ep_is_connected_params_t *params)
330. {

333.     const uct_obmm_iface_addr_t  *iaddr;

336.         return 0;

339.     daddr = (const uct_obmm_device_addr_t*)params->device_addr;
340.     iaddr = (const uct_obmm_iface_addr_t*)params->iface_addr;
341.     if ((daddr == NULL) || (iaddr == NULL)) {
342.         return 0;

344.

346.            (daddr->exporter_deid_hi == ep->peer_deid_hi) &&
347.            (daddr->exporter_deid_lo == ep->peer_deid_lo) &&
348.            (iaddr->slot_index == ep->peer_slot_index) &&
349.            (iaddr->generation == ep->expected_generation);
350. }

369.     if (ucs_unlikely(!ucs_arbiter_group_is_empty(&ep->arb_group))) {
370.         ++ep->trace_send_with_pending_count;

385.     elem->am_id      = id;
386.     elem->length     = (uint16_t)payload_total;
387.     elem->generation = ep->expected_generation;
388.     elem->header     = header;
389.     if (length > 0) {
390.         memcpy(elem + 1, payload, length);
391.     }
392. 
393.     /* Publish: the OWNER bit toggles each wraparound. The receiver expects

396.      * first pass. */

398. 
399.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
400.     elem->flags = owner_bit;
401. 
402.     UCT_TL_EP_STAT_OP(&ep->super, AM, SHORT, payload_total);

404.                        &header, payload_total, "TX: AM_SHORT");
405.     return UCS_OK;

196. static int
197. uct_obmm_iface_is_reachable_v2(const uct_iface_h tl_iface,
198.                                const uct_iface_is_reachable_params_t *params)
199. {
200.     uct_obmm_iface_t             *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_iface,
201.                                                          uct_obmm_iface_t);
202.     uct_obmm_md_t                *md    = ucs_derived_of(iface->super.md,
203.                                                          uct_obmm_md_t);
204.     const uct_obmm_device_addr_t *daddr;
205.     const uct_obmm_iface_addr_t  *iaddr;
206.     uct_obmm_eid_t                eid;
207.     uct_obmm_region_t            *export_r;
208. 
209.     if (!uct_iface_is_reachable_params_addrs_valid(params)) {
210.         return 0;
211.     }
212. 
213.     daddr = (const uct_obmm_device_addr_t*)params->device_addr;
214.     iaddr = (const uct_obmm_iface_addr_t*)params->iface_addr;
215.     if ((daddr == NULL) || (iaddr == NULL)) {
216.         uct_iface_fill_info_str_buf(params, "missing device or iface address");
217.         return 0;
218.     }
219. 
220.     if ((iaddr->fifo_size != iface->fifo_size) ||
221.         (iaddr->fifo_elem_size != iface->fifo_elem_size) ||
222.         (iaddr->bcopy_seg_size != iface->bcopy_seg_size)) {
223.         uct_iface_fill_info_str_buf(params,
224.                                     "incompatible OBMM geometry "
225.                                     "(peer fifo=%u elem=%u seg=%u, "
226.                                     "local fifo=%u elem=%u seg=%u)",
227.                                     iaddr->fifo_size, iaddr->fifo_elem_size,
228.                                     iaddr->bcopy_seg_size,
229.                                     iface->fifo_size, iface->fifo_elem_size,
230.                                     iface->bcopy_seg_size);
231.         return 0;
232.     }
233. 
234.     eid.hi = daddr->exporter_deid_hi;
235.     eid.lo = daddr->exporter_deid_lo;
236. 
237.     export_r = uct_obmm_md_export_region(md);
238.     if ((export_r != NULL) &&
239.         (export_r->info.exporter_dcna == daddr->exporter_dcna) &&
240.         (export_r->info.exporter_deid.hi == eid.hi) &&
241.         (export_r->info.exporter_deid.lo == eid.lo)) {
242.         return uct_iface_scope_is_reachable(tl_iface, params);
243.     }
244. 
245.     if (uct_obmm_md_find_import_region(md, daddr->exporter_dcna, &eid) != NULL) {
246.         return uct_iface_scope_is_reachable(tl_iface, params);
247.     }
248. 
249.     uct_iface_fill_info_str_buf(params,
250.                                 "no mapped region for peer dcna=0x%lx "
251.                                 "deid=0x%lx:0x%lx",
252.                                 (unsigned long)daddr->exporter_dcna,
253.                                 (unsigned long)eid.hi, (unsigned long)eid.lo);
254.     return 0;
255. }

258. static unsigned uct_obmm_iface_progress(uct_iface_h tl_iface)
259. {
260.     uct_obmm_iface_t        *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_iface, uct_obmm_iface_t);
261.     unsigned                 polled = 0;
262.     uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem;
263.     uint8_t                  flags;
264.     uint8_t                  expected_owner;
265.     size_t                   max_poll = iface->fifo_max_poll;
266. 
267.     while (polled < max_poll) {
268.         elem = uct_obmm_slot_elem(iface->recv_elems, iface->read_index,
269.                                   iface->fifo_mask, iface->fifo_elem_size);
270. 
271.         /* Owner bit alternates each lap of the ring; pass 0 expects 1, pass
272.          * 1 expects 0, etc. Combined with zero-fill on slot allocation, this
273.          * means an unwritten slot reads as flags==0 and is correctly skipped
274.          * on the very first lap. */
275.         expected_owner = ((iface->read_index / iface->fifo_size) & 1u) ?
276.                          0u : UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER;
277. 
278.         flags = elem->flags;
279.         if ((flags & UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER) != expected_owner) {
280.             break;
281.         }
282. 
283.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
284. 
285.         if (elem->generation != iface->generation) {
286.             /* Stale write from a previous slot owner (we were torn down and
287.              * re-allocated this slot). Drop silently. */
288.             ucs_trace_data("obmm: drop stale elem (gen=%u expected=%u) "
289.                            "at idx=%lu", elem->generation, iface->generation,
290.                            (unsigned long)iface->read_index);
291.         } else if (flags & UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_BCOPY) {
292.             /* am_bcopy: payload is in the paired desc[N], not in the FIFO
293.              * element body. The bus_load_fence above orders this load
294.              * with respect to the sender's bus_store_fence + flag write. */
295.             void *desc = uct_obmm_slot_desc(iface->recv_descs,
296.                                             iface->read_index,
297.                                             iface->fifo_mask,
298.                                             iface->bcopy_seg_size);
299.             uct_iface_invoke_am(&iface->super, elem->am_id,
300.                                 desc, elem->length, 0);
301.         } else {
302.             /* am_short: contiguous [header(8B)][payload] starting at
303.              * &elem->header. elem->length already includes the 8B header. */
304.             uct_iface_invoke_am(&iface->super, elem->am_id,
305.                                 &elem->header, elem->length, 0);
306.         }
307. 
308.         iface->read_index++;
309.         polled++;
310.     }
311. 
312.     if (polled > 0) {
313.         /* Full bus fence: orders the AM handler's LOADS from desc[]/elem
314.          * payload BEFORE the STORE that publishes the new tail. A plain
315.          * bus_store_fence (e.g. dmb oshst on aarch64) only orders
316.          * store→store, which would let a sender observe the advanced
317.          * tail and overwrite desc[N] while we still have outstanding
318.          * loads in flight. See obmm_fifo.h:uct_obmm_bus_full_fence. */
319.         uct_obmm_bus_full_fence();
320.         iface->recv_ctl->tail = iface->read_index;
321.     }
322. 
323.     /* Drain any UCP requests waiting on TX backpressure. The peer-side
324.      * tail advance we just published may also have freed slots that *our*
325.      * pending eps have been waiting for; dispatch with a fresh head/tail
326.      * snapshot so retries see the latest state. Without this dispatch,
327.      * UCS_ERR_BUSY-only pending_add caused a livelock under symmetric
328.      * bidirectional load at BCOPY_SEG_SIZE. */
329.     ucs_arbiter_dispatch(&iface->arbiter, 1, uct_obmm_ep_process_pending,
330.                          &polled);
331. 
332.     if ((polled == 0) && !ucs_arbiter_is_empty(&iface->arbiter)) {
333.         ++iface->trace_idle_pending_count;
334.         if (uct_obmm_trace_should_log(iface->trace_idle_pending_count)) {
335.             uct_obmm_iface_trace_pending_idle(iface, "iface idle with pending",
336.                                               iface->trace_idle_pending_count,
337.                                               polled);
338.         }
339.     } else if (iface->trace_idle_pending_count != 0) {
340.         uct_obmm_iface_trace_pending_idle(iface, "iface pending recovered",
341.                                           iface->trace_idle_pending_count,
342.                                           polled);
343.         iface->trace_idle_pending_count = 0;
344.     }
345. 
346.     return polled;
347. }

368. static UCS_CLASS_INIT_FUNC(uct_obmm_iface_t, uct_md_h tl_md, uct_worker_h worker,
369.                            const uct_iface_params_t *params,
370.                            const uct_iface_config_t *tl_config)
371. {
372.     uct_obmm_iface_config_t *config = ucs_derived_of(tl_config,
373.                                                      uct_obmm_iface_config_t);
374.     uct_obmm_md_t           *md     = ucs_derived_of(tl_md, uct_obmm_md_t);
375.     uct_obmm_region_t       *region;
376.     size_t                   stride;
377.     size_t                   required;
378.     ucs_status_t             status;
379. 
380.     if (config->fifo_size == 0) {
381.         ucs_error("obmm: FIFO_SIZE must be > 0");
382.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
383.     }
384.     if (!ucs_is_pow2(config->fifo_size)) {
385.         ucs_error("obmm: FIFO_SIZE (%u) must be a power of 2",
386.                   config->fifo_size);
387.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
388.     }
389.     if (config->fifo_elem_size <= sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_element_t)) {
390.         ucs_error("obmm: FIFO_ELEM_SIZE (%u) must be > %zu",
391.                   config->fifo_elem_size, sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_element_t));
392.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
393.     }
394.     /* elem->length is uint16_t; reject geometries whose advertised
395.      * max_short / max_bcopy would not fit in that field. */
396.     if ((config->fifo_elem_size - sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_element_t)) >
397.         UINT16_MAX) {
398.         ucs_error("obmm: FIFO_ELEM_SIZE (%u) too large; payload area must fit "
399.                   "in uint16 (max %zu)",
400.                   config->fifo_elem_size,
401.                   (size_t)UINT16_MAX + sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_element_t));
402.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
403.     }
404.     if (config->bcopy_seg_size == 0) {
405.         ucs_error("obmm: BCOPY_SEG_SIZE must be > 0");
406.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
407.     }
408.     if (config->bcopy_seg_size > UINT16_MAX) {
409.         ucs_error("obmm: BCOPY_SEG_SIZE (%u) too large; max_bcopy must fit "
410.                   "in uint16 (max %u)",
411.                   config->bcopy_seg_size, (unsigned)UINT16_MAX);
412.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
413.     }
414. 
415.     region = uct_obmm_md_export_region(md);
416.     if (region == NULL) {
417.         ucs_error("obmm: cannot create iface; this MD has no local export "
418.                   "region");
419.         return UCS_ERR_NO_DEVICE;
420.     }

18. /* Element flags carried in the shared FIFO element header. */
19. enum {
20.     /* Toggled every FIFO wraparound; receiver uses this to detect a freshly
21.      * written element without taking a tail/head delta lock. */
22.     UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER = UCS_BIT(0),
23. 
24.     /* Set by senders that wrote via am_bcopy (pack_cb output stored in the
25.      * payload area starting at elem+1, with NO 8-byte am_short header
26.      * prefix). When clear, the element was written via am_short and
27.      * &elem->header + length covers the [hdr][payload] buffer. */
28.     UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_BCOPY = UCS_BIT(1)
29. };

32. /* Per-slot FIFO control header. Lives at offset 0 of every allocated slot in
33.  * the obmm pool. Producers serialize `head` reservation with a token lock:
34.  * on target aarch64 NC mappings, cross-node CAS updates memory but its return
35.  * value is not a reliable ownership result. Consumers read/write `tail` to
36.  * release space. Control fields are accessed via non-cacheable mappings,
37.  * therefore all updates must be paired with bus fences
38.  * (ucs_memory_bus_*_fence), not CPU fences. */
39. typedef struct uct_obmm_fifo_ctl {
40.     /* 1st cacheline: producer-touched */
41.     volatile uint64_t head;
42.     volatile uint64_t lock;
43.     UCS_CACHELINE_PADDING(uint64_t, uint64_t);
44. 
45.     /* 2nd cacheline: consumer-touched */
46.     volatile uint64_t tail;
47.     UCS_CACHELINE_PADDING(uint64_t);
48. } UCS_V_ALIGNED(UCS_SYS_CACHE_LINE_SIZE) uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t;
49. 
50. 
51. /* FIFO element header. The element body (am short header + payload) follows
52.  * immediately. Total element stride is iface->config.fifo_elem_size, which
53.  * the iface chooses so that header+payload <= elem_size. */
54. typedef struct uct_obmm_fifo_element {
55.     uint8_t  flags;       /* UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_xx */
56.     uint8_t  am_id;       /* active message id */
57.     uint16_t length;      /* payload length (excluding am_short header) */
58.     uint32_t generation;  /* owner-slot generation token; receiver discards
59.                              elements whose generation doesn't match the
60.                              slot's current meta.generation */
61.     uint64_t header;      /* am_short 64-bit header */
62.     /* payload[length] follows here */
63. } UCS_S_PACKED uct_obmm_fifo_element_t;
64. 
65. 
66. /* Compute slot stride: control header + fifo_size * elem_size + (v2)
67.  * fifo_size * bcopy_seg_size, cacheline aligned so that adjacent slots
68.  * don't share a line. Returned as size_t; callers must validate the
69.  * result fits in the uint32_t pool_hdr->slot_size field before passing
70.  * to pool_attach. */
71. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE size_t
72. uct_obmm_slot_stride(unsigned fifo_size, unsigned fifo_elem_size,
73.                      unsigned bcopy_seg_size)
74. {
75.     return ucs_align_up(sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t) +
76.                         ((size_t)fifo_size * fifo_elem_size) +
77.                         ((size_t)fifo_size * bcopy_seg_size),
78.                         UCS_SYS_CACHE_LINE_SIZE);
79. }
80.

82. /* Get FIFO control header pointer from a slot base pointer. */
83. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t*
84. uct_obmm_slot_ctl(void *slot_base)
85. {
86.     return (uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t*)slot_base;
87. }
88. 
89. 
90. /* Get FIFO elements array pointer from a slot base pointer. */
91. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void*
92. uct_obmm_slot_elems(void *slot_base)
93. {
94.     return UCS_PTR_BYTE_OFFSET(slot_base, sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t));
95. }
96. 
97. 
98. /* Get bcopy desc array pointer from a slot base pointer. The desc area
99.  * lives immediately after the FIFO element array. Each desc is
100.  * `bcopy_seg_size` bytes; index N is paired 1:1 with FIFO element N. */
101. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void*
102. uct_obmm_slot_descs(void *slot_base, unsigned fifo_size,
103.                     unsigned fifo_elem_size)
104. {
105.     return UCS_PTR_BYTE_OFFSET(slot_base,
106.                                sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t) +
107.                                ((size_t)fifo_size * fifo_elem_size));
108. }

118. 
119. 
120. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void*
121. uct_obmm_slot_desc(void *descs, uint64_t index, unsigned mask,
122.                    unsigned seg_size)
123. {
124.     return UCS_PTR_BYTE_OFFSET(descs, (size_t)(index & mask) * seg_size);
125. }
126. 
127. 
128. /* Full bus-domain fence: orders ALL prior memory accesses (loads and
129.  * stores) before ALL subsequent memory accesses, in the outer-shareable /
130.  * device domain that includes cross-host obmm peers.
131.  *
132.  * Why we need this in addition to ucs_memory_bus_{store,load}_fence:
133.  * the receiver must order its desc[N] LOADS (issued during the AM
134.  * handler) before the STORE that publishes the new tail. On ARM64,
135.  * ucs_memory_bus_store_fence() is `dmb oshst` (store→store only) and
136.  * does not order prior loads. Without this load→store barrier, a sender
137.  * could observe the advanced tail and overwrite desc[N] while the
138.  * receiver still has outstanding loads from the previous lap's payload.
139.  *
140.  * Defined locally in obmm rather than added to ucs/arch to keep the
141.  * change inside ucx/src/uct/obmm/ per AGENTS.md. */
142. #if defined(__aarch64__)
143. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() __asm__ __volatile__("dmb osh" ::: "memory")
144. #elif defined(__x86_64__) || defined(__i386__)
145. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() __asm__ __volatile__("mfence" ::: "memory")
146. #elif defined(__powerpc64__)
147. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() __asm__ __volatile__("sync" ::: "memory")
148. #elif defined(__riscv) && (__riscv_xlen == 64)
149. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() \
150.     __asm__ __volatile__("fence iorw, iorw" ::: "memory")
151. #else
152. /* Fallback: combine store + load fences. Not strictly load→store on all
153.  * archs but better than nothing; build will warn so the porter notices. */
154. #warning "obmm: no full bus fence for this arch; receiver tail release ordering may be weak"
155. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() do { \
156.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();        \
157.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();       \
158. } while (0)
159. #endif
160. 
161. #endif
162.

35. /* In-region pool header. Lives at offset 0 of the local export region. All
36.  * fields are written via non-cacheable mappings: state transitions must be
37.  * paired with ucs_memory_bus_store_fence so peers (potentially on another
38.  * host) see the geometry before the READY transition. During cleanup, INITING
39.  * is only a transient coordination state; once reset completes, the shared
40.  * region is fully zero again. */
41. typedef struct uct_obmm_pool_hdr {
42.     uint64_t magic;             /* UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC */
43.     uint32_t state;             /* UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_xx, atomic */
44.     uint32_t slot_count;
45.     uint32_t slot_size;
46.     uint64_t slot_array_offset; /* offset (from region base) of slot 0 */
47.     uint32_t bitmap_words;      /* number of u64 words in alloc bitmap */
48.     uint32_t initializer_pid;   /* pid that owned the INITING transition */
49.     uint64_t initializer_starttime;
50.     /* followed by:
51.      *   uint64_t alloc_bitmap[bitmap_words];
52.      *   uct_obmm_slot_meta_t slot_meta[slot_count];
53.      */
54. } uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t;
55. 
56. 
57. /* Per-slot ownership metadata. Stored adjacent to the bitmap, separate from
58.  * the slot's actual FIFO contents. */
59. typedef struct uct_obmm_slot_meta {
60.     uint32_t state;            /* UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_xx */
61.     uint32_t generation;       /* monotonically increasing; bumped on free,
62.                                   scavenge, and when readers must discard
63.                                   in-flight stale elements */
64.     uint32_t owner_pid;
65.     uint32_t reserved;
66.     uint64_t owner_starttime;  /* /proc/<pid>/stat field 22, for liveness */
67. } uct_obmm_slot_meta_t;
68. 
69. 
70. /* Convenience accessor populated by uct_obmm_pool_attach. Pointers point
71.  * into the mapped region; nothing is owned by this struct. */
72. typedef struct uct_obmm_pool {
73.     void                  *base;     /* region base (pool hdr) */
74.     size_t                 length;   /* mapped region size */
75.     uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t   *hdr;
76.     volatile uint64_t     *bitmap;
77.     uct_obmm_slot_meta_t  *meta;
78.     void                  *slots;    /* base + hdr->slot_array_offset */
79.     uint32_t               slot_count;
80.     uint32_t               slot_size;
81. } uct_obmm_pool_t;
82. 
83. 
84. /* Compute the minimum region size required to hold a pool with the given
85.  * geometry. */
86. size_t uct_obmm_pool_required_size(uint32_t slot_count, uint32_t slot_size);
87. 
88. 
89. /* Initialize the pool inside `region_base` if not already initialized, or
90.  * attach to an existing valid pool. Cross-process safe: races between
91.  * multiple processes attaching to the same region are resolved via the
92.  * hdr->state CAS. On success, `pool` is populated with cached pointers.
93.  *
94.  * If an existing pool's geometry doesn't match the requested
95.  * (slot_count, slot_size), returns UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM.
96.  */
97. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_attach(void *region_base, size_t region_size,
98.                                   uint32_t slot_count, uint32_t slot_size,
99.                                   uct_obmm_pool_t *pool);
100. 
101. 
102. /* Allocate a free slot. Scavenges slots owned by dead processes. Returns the
103.  * slot index (0..slot_count-1), a pointer to the slot bytes (length
104.  * slot_size), and the generation token the caller must stamp into outgoing
105.  * iface_addr. Slot bytes are zeroed before return.
106.  *
107.  * Returns UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE if no slot can be obtained (all slots in use
108.  * by live processes).
109.  */
110. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_alloc_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool,
111.                                       uint32_t *slot_index_p,
112.                                       void **slot_ptr_p,
113.                                       uint32_t *generation_p);
114. 
115. 
116. /* Release a slot the caller owns. Bumps generation so any stale in-flight
117.  * elements written by remote senders are dropped on the next receiver's
118.  * dispatch. Marks slot as FREE in the bitmap. Returns non-zero only if this
119.  * caller released the final local slot and acquired exclusive permission to
120.  * reset the whole export region to zero before another attach re-initializes
121.  * it. */
122. int uct_obmm_pool_free_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t slot_index);
123. 
124. 
125. /* Reset the whole local export pool region to zero. The caller must already
126.  * hold exclusive cleanup ownership from uct_obmm_pool_free_slot(); this helper
127.  * keeps the shared state in INITING until the rest of the region is zero so a
128.  * new attach cannot race against a partially cleared pool. The final published
129.  * shared image is literal all-zero memory. */
130. void uct_obmm_pool_reset(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool);
131. 
132. 
133. /* Compute pointer to a slot by index. Does not validate ownership. */
134. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void*
135. uct_obmm_pool_slot_ptr(const uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t slot_index)
136. {
137.     return (char*)pool->slots + (size_t)slot_index * pool->slot_size;
138. }
139. 
140. 
141. /* Read-only attach: validates that an existing READY pool lives at
142.  * `region_base`, and populates `pool` with cached pointers. Does NOT
143.  * attempt initialization. Used by ep_create to access a peer's pool
144.  * without owning it. Returns UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE if the pool is not
145.  * READY (e.g. peer iface was destroyed between address exchange and ep
146.  * create). */
147. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_open(void *region_base, size_t region_size,
148.                                 uct_obmm_pool_t *pool);
149. 
150. #endif

46. {
47.     uint64_t cur, oldval;
48.

78. static int uct_obmm_proc_alive(uint32_t pid, uint64_t starttime)
79. {
80.     unsigned long live;
81. 
82.     if (pid == 0) {
83.         return 0;
84.     }
85. 
86.     live = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time((pid_t)pid);
87.     if (live == 0ul) {
88.         /* /proc/<pid>/stat unreadable: pid does not exist any more */
89.         return 0;
90.     }
91. 
92.     return (uint64_t)live == starttime;
93. }

96. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE int
97. uct_obmm_pool_initializer_stamped(uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t *hdr)

100. }

103. /* CAS-claim the INITING transition; if we lose, wait until READY (or
104.  * recover the slot if the prior initializer died mid-init). */
105. static ucs_status_t
106. uct_obmm_pool_init_or_wait(uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t *hdr, uint32_t slot_count,
107.                            uint32_t slot_size)
108. {
109.     unsigned long      self_starttime = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time(getpid());
110.     uint32_t           prev;
111.     unsigned           spin;
112.     size_t             bitmap_words = uct_obmm_pool_bitmap_words(slot_count);
113.     size_t             slot_off     = uct_obmm_pool_slot_offset(slot_count);
114. 
115. retry:
116.     prev = ucs_atomic_cswap32(&hdr->state, UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT,
117.                               UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_INITING);
118. 
119.     if (prev == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT) {
120.         /* We won: zero metadata, fill geometry, publish READY */
121.         memset((char*)hdr + sizeof(*hdr), 0,
122.                bitmap_words * sizeof(uint64_t) +
123.                (size_t)slot_count * sizeof(uct_obmm_slot_meta_t));
124. 
125.         hdr->magic                 = UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC;
126.         hdr->slot_count            = slot_count;
127.         hdr->slot_size             = slot_size;
128.         hdr->slot_array_offset     = slot_off;
129.         hdr->bitmap_words          = (uint32_t)bitmap_words;
130.         hdr->initializer_pid       = (uint32_t)getpid();
131.         hdr->initializer_starttime = (uint64_t)self_starttime;
132. 
133.         ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
134.         hdr->state = UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY;
135.         return UCS_OK;
136.     }
137. 
138.     if (prev == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
139.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
140.         return UCS_OK;
141.     }
142. 
143.     /* state == INITING : wait or recover */
144.     for (spin = 0; spin < UCT_OBMM_POOL_INIT_SPIN_LIMIT; ++spin) {
145.         ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
146.         if (hdr->state == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
147.             return UCS_OK;
148.         }
149.         if (hdr->state == UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT) {
150.             /* Some other rescuer reset; race for init */
151.             goto retry;
152.         }
153. 
154.         if ((spin & 0xfffu) == 0xfffu) {
155.             /* Periodically check if the initializer is alive. If not,
156.              * try to reset back to UNINIT so someone can re-init. */
157.             if (uct_obmm_pool_initializer_stamped(hdr) &&
158.                 !uct_obmm_proc_alive(hdr->initializer_pid,
159.                                      hdr->initializer_starttime)) {
160.                 ucs_warn("obmm: pool initializer pid=%u died; resetting "
161.                          "pool init state",
162.                          hdr->initializer_pid);
163.                 ucs_atomic_cswap32(&hdr->state, UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_INITING,
164.                                    UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_UNINIT);
165.                 goto retry;
166.             }
167.         }
168.     }
169. 
170.     ucs_error("obmm: timed out waiting for pool init to complete "
171.               "(initializer pid=%u)", hdr->initializer_pid);
172.     return UCS_ERR_TIMED_OUT;
173. }

176. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_attach(void *region_base, size_t region_size,
177.                                   uint32_t slot_count, uint32_t slot_size,
178.                                   uct_obmm_pool_t *pool)
179. {
180.     uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t *hdr = (uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t*)region_base;
181.     size_t               required;
182.     ucs_status_t         status;
183. 
184.     if ((slot_count == 0) || (slot_size == 0)) {
185.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
186.     }
187. 
188.     required = uct_obmm_pool_required_size(slot_count, slot_size);
189.     if (region_size < required) {
190.         ucs_error("obmm: region size %zu < required pool size %zu "
191.                   "(slots=%u, slot_size=%u)",
192.                   region_size, required, slot_count, slot_size);
193.         return UCS_ERR_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL;
194.     }
195. 
196.     status = uct_obmm_pool_init_or_wait(hdr, slot_count, slot_size);
197.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
198.         return status;
199.     }
200. 
201.     if (hdr->magic != UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC) {
202.         ucs_error("obmm: pool magic mismatch (got 0x%lx, expected 0x%lx)",
203.                   (unsigned long)hdr->magic, (unsigned long)UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC);
204.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
205.     }
206.     if ((hdr->slot_count != slot_count) || (hdr->slot_size != slot_size)) {
207.         ucs_error("obmm: pool geometry mismatch "
208.                   "(have slots=%u size=%u, expected %u/%u)",
209.                   hdr->slot_count, hdr->slot_size, slot_count, slot_size);
210.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
211.     }
212. 
213.     pool->base       = region_base;
214.     pool->length     = region_size;
215.     pool->hdr        = hdr;
216.     pool->bitmap     = (volatile uint64_t*)((char*)hdr + sizeof(*hdr));
217.     pool->meta       = (uct_obmm_slot_meta_t*)((char*)hdr +
218.                                                uct_obmm_pool_meta_offset(slot_count));
219.     pool->slots      = (char*)hdr + hdr->slot_array_offset;
220.     pool->slot_count = slot_count;
221.     pool->slot_size  = slot_size;
222.     return UCS_OK;
223. }

226. /* Try to claim slot `idx` for the current process. Returns 1 on success
227.  * (bit was set by us, meta updated). Slots transition through CLAIMING so a
228.  * second process cannot take over while allocation/free is still publishing
229.  * ownership metadata. Dead owners (including crashed CLAIMING/DEAD states) may
230.  * be scavenged. Returns 0 if the slot is currently unclaimable. */
231. static int uct_obmm_pool_try_claim(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t idx,
232.                                    uint32_t self_pid, uint64_t self_starttime,
233.                                    uint32_t *generation_p)
234. {
235.     volatile uint64_t    *word    = &pool->bitmap[idx >> 6];
236.     uint64_t              bit     = 1ull << (idx & 63u);
237.     uct_obmm_slot_meta_t *m       = &pool->meta[idx];
238.     uint64_t              cur, oldval;
239.     uint32_t              state, rollback_state, state_prev, owner_pid;
240.     uint64_t              owner_starttime;
241.     int                   take_over = 0;
242. 
243.     if (!uct_obmm_pool_is_ready(pool)) {
244.         return 0;
245.     }
246. 
247.     cur = *word;
248.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
249.     state           = m->state;
250.     rollback_state  = state;
251.     owner_pid       = m->owner_pid;
252.     owner_starttime = m->owner_starttime;
253. 
254.     if (!(cur & bit)) {
255.         /* A crashed claimer may leave CLAIMING behind with bit still clear.
256.          * Reset it to FREE once its owner is known dead, then retry normal
257.          * allocation from the FREE state. */
258.         if (state == UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_CLAIMING) {
259.             if ((owner_pid == 0) ||
260.                 uct_obmm_proc_alive(owner_pid, owner_starttime)) {
261.                 return 0;
262.             }
263. 
264.             state_prev = ucs_atomic_cswap32(&m->state,
265.                                             UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_CLAIMING,
266.                                             UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE);
267.             if (state_prev != UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_CLAIMING) {
268.                 return 0;
269.             }
270.             state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE;
271.         }
272. 
273.         if (state != UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE) {
274.             return 0;
275.         }
276. 
277.         state_prev = ucs_atomic_cswap32(&m->state, UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE,
278.                                         UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_CLAIMING);
279.         if (state_prev != UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE) {
280.             return 0;
281.         }
282. 
283.         m->owner_pid       = self_pid;
284.         m->owner_starttime = self_starttime;
285.         ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
286. 
287.         /* free: reserve the bitmap bit only after state moved to CLAIMING */
288.         oldval = ucs_atomic_cswap64(word, cur, cur | bit);
289.         if (oldval != cur) {
290.             m->owner_pid       = 0;
291.             m->owner_starttime = 0;
292.             ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
293.             m->state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE;
294.             ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
295.             return 0; /* lost the race; caller will retry next slot */
296.         }
297.     } else {
298.         switch (state) {
299.         case UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_CLAIMING:
300.             if ((owner_pid == 0) ||
301.                 uct_obmm_proc_alive(owner_pid, owner_starttime)) {
302.                 return 0;
303.             }
304. 
305.             state_prev = ucs_atomic_cswap32(&m->state,
306.                                             UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_CLAIMING,
307.                                             UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_DEAD);
308.             if (state_prev != UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_CLAIMING) {
309.                 return 0;
310.             }
311.             state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_DEAD;
312.             /* fall through */
313.         case UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_DEAD:
314.             if ((owner_pid != 0) &&
315.                 uct_obmm_proc_alive(owner_pid, owner_starttime)) {
316.                 return 0;
317.             }
318. 
319.             state_prev = ucs_atomic_cswap32(&m->state,
320.                                             UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_DEAD,
321.                                             UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_CLAIMING);
322.             if (state_prev != UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_DEAD) {
323.                 return 0;
324.             }
325.             take_over = 1;
326.             break;
327.         case UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_IN_USE:
328.             if ((owner_pid != 0) &&
329.                 uct_obmm_proc_alive(owner_pid, owner_starttime)) {
330.                 return 0;
331.             }
332. 
333.             state_prev = ucs_atomic_cswap32(&m->state,
334.                                             UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_IN_USE,
335.                                             UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_CLAIMING);
336.             if (state_prev != UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_IN_USE) {
337.                 return 0;
338.             }
339.             take_over = 1;
340.             break;
341.         default:
342.             return 0;
343.         }
344.     }
345. 
346.     if (!uct_obmm_pool_is_ready(pool)) {
347.         if (take_over) {
348.             m->state = rollback_state;
349.             ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
350.         } else {
351.             uct_obmm_pool_clear_bit(word, bit);
352.             m->owner_pid       = 0;
353.             m->owner_starttime = 0;
354.             ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
355.             m->state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE;
356.             ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
357.         }
358.         return 0;
359.     }
360.

38. static ucs_status_t uct_obmm_md_query(uct_md_h md, uct_md_attr_v2_t *attr)
39. {
40.     (void)md;
41.     uct_md_base_md_query(attr);
42.     /* obmm only does AM (short + bcopy). It does NOT expose remote memory
43.      * as a directly-dereferenceable pointer to its own peers: only the
44.      * pre-exported FIFO region is mmap'd, NOT the user's send/recv
45.      * buffers. So we MUST NOT advertise UCT_MD_FLAG_NEED_RKEY (which
46.      * implies remote-key-based access) -- doing so makes UCP pick
47.      * rendezvous-via-rkey_ptr for messages above the rndv threshold
48.      * (~256 KiB) and try to memcpy from a peer-VA pointer, segfaulting
49.      * inside ucs_memcpy_relaxed. */
50.     attr->flags                  = 0;
51.     attr->reg_mem_types          = 0;
52.     attr->reg_nonblock_mem_types = 0;
53.     attr->cache_mem_types        = 0;
54.     attr->access_mem_types       = UCS_BIT(UCS_MEMORY_TYPE_HOST);
55.     return UCS_OK;
56. }

58. static ucs_status_t
59. uct_obmm_md_parse_memids(const char *memids_str, uint64_t **memids_p,
60.                          unsigned *num_memids_p)
61. {
62.     uint64_t     *memids      = NULL;
63.     char         *cursor;
64.     char         *next;
65.     char         *copy        = NULL;
66.     char         *end;
67.     ucs_status_t  status      = UCS_OK;
68.     unsigned      count       = 0;
69.     unsigned      capacity    = 1;
70.     unsigned      i;
71.     uint64_t      memid;
72. 
73.     *memids_p     = NULL;
74.     *num_memids_p = 0;
75. 
76.     if (memids_str == NULL) {
77.         return UCS_OK;
78.     }
79. 
80.     copy = ucs_strdup(memids_str, "obmm_memids");
81.     if (copy == NULL) {
82.         return UCS_ERR_NO_MEMORY;
83.     }
84. 
85.     ucs_strtrim(copy);
86.     if (copy[0] == '\0') {
87.         goto out;
88.     }
89. 
90.     for (cursor = copy; *cursor != '\0'; ++cursor) {
91.         if (*cursor == ',') {
92.             ++capacity;
93.         }
94.     }
95. 
96.     memids = ucs_calloc(capacity, sizeof(*memids), "obmm_memid_list");
97.     if (memids == NULL) {
98.         status = UCS_ERR_NO_MEMORY;
99.         goto err;
100.     }
101. 
102.     cursor = copy;
103.     while (cursor != NULL) {
104.         errno = 0;
105.         next  = strchr(cursor, ',');
106.         if (next != NULL) {
107.             *next = '\0';
108.             ++next;
109.         }
110. 
111.         ucs_strtrim(cursor);
112.         if (cursor[0] == '\0') {
113.             ucs_error("obmm: OBMM_MEMIDS contains an empty entry: '%s'",
114.                       memids_str);
115.             status = UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
116.             goto err;
117.         }
118. 
119.         memid = strtoull(cursor, &end, 10);
120.         if ((errno == ERANGE) || (*end != '\0')) {
121.             ucs_error("obmm: invalid OBMM_MEMIDS entry '%s' in '%s'; "
122.                       "expected decimal memid list like '1,2'",
123.                       cursor, memids_str);
124.             status = UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
125.             goto err;
126.         }
127. 
128.         if (memid == 0) {
129.             ucs_error("obmm: OBMM_MEMIDS cannot contain memid 0");
130.             status = UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
131.             goto err;
132.         }
133. 
134.         for (i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
135.             if (memids[i] == memid) {
136.                 ucs_error("obmm: duplicate memid %" PRIu64
137.                           " in OBMM_MEMIDS='%s'",
138.                           memid, memids_str);
139.                 status = UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
140.                 goto err;
141.             }
142.         }
143. 
144.         memids[count++] = memid;
145.         cursor          = next;
146.     }
147. 
148. out:
149.     ucs_free(copy);
150.     *memids_p     = memids;
151.     *num_memids_p = count;
152.     return UCS_OK;
153. 
154. err:
155.     ucs_free(memids);
156.     ucs_free(copy);
157.     return status;
158. }

181. static ucs_status_t uct_obmm_md_map_devices(uct_obmm_md_t *md,
182.                                             const uct_obmm_dev_info_t *devs,
183.                                             unsigned num_devs)
184. {
185.     uct_obmm_region_t *regions;
186.     ucs_status_t       status;
187.     unsigned           i, mapped, j;
188.     int                export_idx = -1;
189. 
190.     regions = ucs_calloc(num_devs, sizeof(*regions), "uct_obmm_regions");
191.     if (regions == NULL) {
192.         return UCS_ERR_NO_MEMORY;
193.     }
194. 
195.     for (i = 0; i < num_devs; ++i) {
196.         regions[i].fd = -1;
197.     }
198. 
199.     mapped = 0;
200.     for (i = 0; i < num_devs; ++i) {
201.         status = uct_obmm_region_open(&devs[i], &regions[mapped]);
202.         if (status != UCS_OK) {
203.             ucs_debug("obmm: mapping %s (memid=%" PRIu64 ") failed: %s",
204.                       devs[i].dev_path, devs[i].memid,
205.                       ucs_status_string(status));
206.             goto err_unmap;
207.         }
208. 
209.         if ((regions[mapped].info.type == UCT_OBMM_DEV_EXPORT) &&
210.             (export_idx < 0)) {
211.             export_idx = (int)mapped;
212.         } else if (regions[mapped].info.type == UCT_OBMM_DEV_EXPORT) {
213.             ucs_debug("obmm: multiple export regions found "
214.                       "(memid=%" PRIu64 ", memid=%" PRIu64 "); obmm "
215.                       "requires exactly one local export",
216.                       regions[export_idx].info.memid,
217.                       regions[mapped].info.memid);
218.             uct_obmm_region_close(&regions[mapped]);
219.             status = UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
220.             goto err_unmap;
221.         }
222. 
223.         ++mapped;
224.     }
225. 
226.     if (mapped == 0) {
227.         ucs_free(regions);
228.         return UCS_ERR_NO_DEVICE;
229.     }
230. 
231.     if (export_idx < 0) {
232.         ucs_debug("obmm: no local export region found for obmm transport");
233.         status = UCS_ERR_NO_DEVICE;
234.         goto err_unmap;
235.     }
236. 
237.     md->regions     = regions;
238.     md->num_regions = mapped;
239.     md->export_idx  = export_idx;
240.     return UCS_OK;
241. 
242. err_unmap:
243.     for (j = 0; j < mapped; ++j) {
244.         uct_obmm_region_close(&regions[j]);
245.     }
246.     ucs_free(regions);
247.     return status;
248. }

250. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_md_open(uct_component_t *component, const char *md_name,
251.                               const uct_md_config_t *config, uct_md_h *md_p)
252. {
253.     static uct_md_ops_t md_ops = {
254.         .close              = uct_obmm_md_close,
255.         .query              = uct_obmm_md_query,
256.         .mkey_pack          = ucs_empty_function_return_success,
257.         .mem_reg            = uct_md_dummy_mem_reg,
258.         .mem_dereg          = uct_md_dummy_mem_dereg,
259.         .mem_attach         = ucs_empty_function_return_unsupported,
260.         .detect_memory_type = ucs_empty_function_return_unsupported
261.     };
262.     const uct_obmm_md_config_t *md_config  = (const uct_obmm_md_config_t*)config;
263.     uct_obmm_dev_info_t        *devs       = NULL;
264.     uint64_t                   *memids     = NULL;
265.     unsigned                    num_devs   = 0;
266.     unsigned                    num_memids = 0;
267.     uct_obmm_md_t              *md;
268.     ucs_status_t                status;
269. 
270.     (void)component;
271.     (void)md_name;
272. 
273.     md = ucs_calloc(1, sizeof(*md), "uct_obmm_md");
274.     if (md == NULL) {
275.         ucs_error("failed to allocate obmm md");
276.         return UCS_ERR_NO_MEMORY;
277.     }
278.     md->export_idx = -1;
279. 
280.     status = uct_obmm_md_parse_memids(md_config->memids, &memids, &num_memids);
281.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
282.         goto err_free_md;
283.     }
284. 
285.     status = uct_obmm_sysfs_discover(&devs, &num_devs, memids, num_memids);
286.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
287.         ucs_debug("obmm: sysfs discovery failed: %s",
288.                   ucs_status_string(status));
289.         goto err_free_memids;
290.     }
291. 
292.     if (num_devs == 0) {
293.         ucs_debug("obmm: no shmdev devices found under " UCT_OBMM_SYSFS_ROOT);
294.         status = UCS_ERR_NO_DEVICE;
295.         goto err_free_discovery;
296.     }
297. 
298.     status = uct_obmm_md_map_devices(md, devs, num_devs);
299.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
300.         ucs_debug("obmm: failed to map any device: %s",
301.                   ucs_status_string(status));
302.         goto err_free_discovery;
303.     }
304. 
305.     uct_obmm_sysfs_release(devs);
306.     ucs_free(memids);
307. 
308.     md->super.ops       = &md_ops;
309.     md->super.component = &uct_obmm_component;
310.     *md_p               = &md->super;
311.     return UCS_OK;
312. 
313. err_free_discovery:
314.     uct_obmm_sysfs_release(devs);
315. err_free_memids:
316.     ucs_free(memids);
317. err_free_md:
318.     ucs_free(md);
319.     return status;
320. }

383. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_alloc_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool,
384.                                       uint32_t *slot_index_p,
385.                                       void **slot_ptr_p,
386.                                       uint32_t *generation_p)
387. {
388.     uint32_t      self_pid       = (uint32_t)getpid();
389.     unsigned long self_starttime = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time(getpid());
390.     uint32_t      i;
391. 
392.     if (self_starttime == 0ul) {
393.         ucs_warn("obmm: cannot read self process start time; "
394.                  "scavenge will treat us as dead");
395.     }
396. 
397.     for (i = 0; i < pool->slot_count; ++i) {
398.         if (!uct_obmm_pool_is_ready(pool)) {
399.             return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
400.         }
401.         if (uct_obmm_pool_try_claim(pool, i, self_pid,
402.                                     (uint64_t)self_starttime, generation_p)) {
403.             *slot_index_p = i;
404.             *slot_ptr_p   = uct_obmm_pool_slot_ptr(pool, i);
405.             return UCS_OK;
406.         }
407.     }
408. 
409.     return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;

416. 
417.     for (i = 0; i < pool->hdr->bitmap_words; ++i) {

427. int uct_obmm_pool_free_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t slot_index)
428. {
429.     volatile uint64_t    *word = &pool->bitmap[slot_index >> 6];
430.     uint64_t              bit  = 1ull << (slot_index & 63u);
431.     uct_obmm_slot_meta_t *m    = &pool->meta[slot_index];
432.     unsigned long         self_starttime;
433.     uint32_t              state_prev;
434. 
435.     /* Bump generation first so any in-flight stale messages are discarded by
436.      * a future re-using owner; mark DEAD and bus fence before clearing the
437.      * bit so a racing claimer sees the new generation. */
438.     m->generation += 1;
439.     m->state       = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_DEAD;
440.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
441. 
442.     uct_obmm_pool_clear_bit(word, bit);
443. 
444.     m->owner_pid       = 0;
445.     m->owner_starttime = 0;
446.     m->state = UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_FREE;
447.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
448. 
449.     if (!uct_obmm_pool_all_slots_free(pool)) {
450.         return 0;
451.     }
452. 
453.     state_prev = ucs_atomic_cswap32(&pool->hdr->state, UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY,
454.                                     UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_INITING);
455.     if (state_prev != UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY) {
456.         return 0;
457.     }
458. 
459.     self_starttime = ucs_sys_get_proc_create_time(getpid());
460.     pool->hdr->initializer_pid       = (uint32_t)getpid();
461.     pool->hdr->initializer_starttime = (uint64_t)self_starttime;
462.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
463. 
464.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
465.     if (!uct_obmm_pool_all_slots_free(pool)) {
466.         ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
467.         pool->hdr->state = UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_READY;
468.         return 0;
469.     }
470. 
471.     return 1;
472. }

476. {
477.     uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t *hdr;
478.     char                *base;
479.     size_t               length;
480.     size_t               state_offset;
481.     size_t               state_end;

489. 
490.     hdr = pool->hdr;

492.     length = pool->length;

497.     init_start_offset = offsetof(uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t, initializer_starttime);
498.     init_end          = init_start_offset + sizeof(hdr->initializer_starttime);
499. 
500.     if (state_offset > 0) {

539. /* Conservative best-effort check for whether a pending request is worth
540.  * retrying in this progress round. Returns false if the peer FIFO is full or
541.  * if the peer head lock is observed busy. Because another producer can race
542.  * us after this check, callers must still tolerate reserve_slot() returning
543.  * UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE and simply reschedule the request. */
544. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE int
545. uct_obmm_ep_has_tx_resource(uct_obmm_ep_t *ep)
546. {
547.     uint64_t head;
548. 
549.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
550.     if (ep->peer_ctl->lock != 0) {
551.         return 0;
552.     }
553. 
554.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
555.     head = ep->peer_ctl->head;
556.     if ((head - ep->cached_tail) < ep->fifo_size) {
557.         return 1;
558.     }
559.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
560.     ep->cached_tail = ep->peer_ctl->tail;
561.     return (head - ep->cached_tail) < ep->fifo_size;
562. }

23. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_region_open(const uct_obmm_dev_info_t *info,
24.                                   uct_obmm_region_t *region)
25. {
26.     ucs_status_t status;
27.     void        *map;
28.     int          fd;
29. 
30.     if (!info->allow_mmap) {
31.         ucs_debug("obmm: device %s does not support mmap", info->dev_path);
32.         return UCS_ERR_UNSUPPORTED;
33.     }
34. 
35.     if (info->size == 0) {
36.         ucs_debug("obmm: device %s reports zero size", info->dev_path);
37.         return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
38.     }
39. 
40.     /* O_SYNC selects the non-cacheable mapping, which is required for
41.      * cross-host shared FIFO use without obmm_set_ownership() flips. */
42.     fd = open(info->dev_path, O_RDWR | O_SYNC | O_CLOEXEC);
43.     if (fd < 0) {
44.         ucs_debug("obmm: open(%s) failed: %m", info->dev_path);
45.         return UCS_ERR_IO_ERROR;
46.     }
47. 
48.     map = mmap(NULL, info->size, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED, fd, 0);
49.     if (map == MAP_FAILED) {
50.         ucs_debug("obmm: mmap(%s, size=0x%" PRIx64 ") failed: %m",
51.                   info->dev_path, info->size);
52.         status = UCS_ERR_IO_ERROR;
53.         goto err_close;
54.     }
55. 
56.     region->info   = *info;
57.     region->fd     = fd;
58.     region->base   = map;
59.     region->length = info->size;
60. 
61.     ucs_debug("obmm: mapped %s memid=%" PRIu64 " size=0x%" PRIx64
62.               " base=%p type=%s dcna=0x%" PRIx64,
63.               info->dev_path, info->memid, info->size, map,
64.               (info->type == UCT_OBMM_DEV_EXPORT) ? "export" : "import",
65.               info->exporter_dcna);
66. 
67.     return UCS_OK;
68. 
69. err_close:
70.     close(fd);
71.     return status;
72. }
73. 
74. 
75. void uct_obmm_region_close(uct_obmm_region_t *region)
76. {
77.     if (region->base != NULL) {
78.         if (munmap(region->base, region->length) != 0) {
79.             ucs_warn("obmm: munmap(%s, %p, 0x%zx) failed: %m",
80.                      region->info.dev_path, region->base, region->length);
81.         }
82.         region->base = NULL;
83.     }
84. 
85.     if (region->fd >= 0) {
86.         close(region->fd);
87.         region->fd = -1;
88.     }
89. }

### 💬 Copilot

Promising, but not drop-in safe.

- **Biggest hole: generations.** In sender-owned slots, one `generation` is no longer enough. You need:
  - **receiver generation** in each message, so a recycled destination slot doesn’t consume stale traffic;
  - **sender-slot epoch** in lane control/acks, so a stale consumer can’t write `cons_seq` into a reclaimed sender slot. Plain 32-bit `prod_seq/cons_seq` is ABA/wrap-risk.
- **EP-list polling is the main integration risk.** `obmm_iface_progress` today is slot-centric; `obmm_ep.c` does not dedup peers. SPSC lanes break if duplicate local eps ever target the same peer.
- **Ack ordering:** `cons_seq` publish needs a **full bus load→store fence**, like current tail release.
- **Banking:** derive bank from **sender exporter identity vs local export identity**, not slot index/import-vs-export.
- **Pending:** depth-1 makes `NO_RESOURCE` common; keep real arbiter pending and dispatch every progress call, even if no RX.
- **Budget:** depth-1/64 lanes is probably still within 128 MiB; extra epoch/control padding is the margin risk.

Main files touched: `obmm_fifo.h`, `obmm_ep.[ch]`, `obmm_iface.[ch]`, `DESIGN.md`; `obmm_pool.c` if epoch semantics change.

255. ## Configuration knobs
256. 
257. All under `UCX_OBMM_*` prefix.
258. 
259. | knob                      | default | meaning                          |
260. |---------------------------|---------|----------------------------------|
261. | BW                        | 3400MBs | effective transport bandwidth reported to UCP for lane/protocol cost modeling; optional |
262. | FIFO_SIZE                 |    64   | ring depth (power of 2)          |
263. | FIFO_ELEM_SIZE            | 16448   | bytes per FIFO elem (incl. 16B hdr) → raw UCT max_short = 16432 total bytes |
264. | BCOPY_SEG_SIZE   (v2 NEW) | 32768   | bytes per paired desc → raw UCT max_bcopy |
265. | FIFO_MAX_POLL             |    16   | RX completions per progress()     |
266. | MEMIDS        (optional)  |   ""    | comma-separated explicit shmdev memids (for example `1,2`); when set, obmm queries only these memids instead of scanning all shmdevs. Regardless of whether this knob is set, discovery is fail-fast: any discovered/requested shmdev that is missing, unusable, or yields an invalid export/import topology fails md_open |
267. 
268. `BW` is a UCP-facing estimate, not a wire-format limit. UCP folds it into lane
269. selection and protocol cost modeling, so it should track sustained transport
270. throughput rather than a one-off peak number. Leaving `UCX_OBMM_BW` unset is
271. valid; obmm then uses the built-in default above.
272. 
273. Validation at iface init:
274. - `FIFO_SIZE` > 0, power of 2
275. - `FIFO_ELEM_SIZE` > sizeof(elem_hdr) and `(elem_size - hdr) <= UINT16_MAX`
276. - `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE` > 0 and `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE <= UINT16_MAX`
277. - `slot_count * slot_stride + pool_overhead <= region->length`
278. 
279. ---
280. 
281. ## Future scope (not in v2)
282. 
283. - `am_zcopy`: requires UCT MD memory-handle plumbing (`mem_reg`,
284.   `mkey_pack`, `mem_attach`). Currently obmm has no MD-level
285.   registration — every peer access is via the pre-existing 128 MiB
286.   region. Out of scope until libobmm-aware md is added.
287. - `put_bcopy / get_bcopy`: blocked by the same MD plumbing; UCP RMA
288.   cannot be served by the FIFO-only data path.
289. - Real pending arbiter: needed only if profiling shows BUSY-retry
290.   storms.
291. - Multi-region per node, NUMA-aware slot placement.
292. - Variable-size desc allocator (mm-style mpool) to cover medium-size
293.   messages without burning seg_size per FIFO depth.
294. 
295. ---
296. 
297. ## Receive-side fence ordering (full bus fence at tail release)
298. 
299. `ucs_memory_bus_store_fence()` on aarch64 is `dmb oshst` — store→store
300. only. It does NOT order prior loads against subsequent stores. The
301. receiver's lifetime invariant requires:
302. 
303. ```
304. loads from desc[N]  HAPPENS-BEFORE  store to recv_ctl->tail = N+1
305. ```
306. 
307. Otherwise a sender that observes the new tail can reuse `desc[N]` while
308. the receiver core still has outstanding loads in flight from the old
309. lap's payload. We therefore use `uct_obmm_bus_full_fence()` (defined
310. locally in `obmm_fifo.h`: `dmb osh` on aarch64, `mfence` on x86,
311. `sync` on ppc64, `fence iorw,iorw` on rv64) before the tail store, not
312. the bus_store fence.
313. 
314. Why a local helper rather than adding `ucs_memory_bus_fence()` for all
315. archs in `ucs/arch/`: AGENTS.md restricts changes to
316. `ucx/src/uct/obmm/`. If/when the helper proves useful elsewhere, it can
317. be promoted to ucs/arch — but that is a separate ask.
318. 
319. ## Receive-buffer semantics for AM handler
320. 
321. `invoke_am(..., desc, length, 0)` — the trailing `0` (no
322. `UCT_CB_PARAM_FLAG_DESC`) means the data pointer is valid **only for the
323. duration of the callback**. The handler MUST NOT retain it; UCP knows
324. this contract and copies into its own buffer when persistence is
325. needed.
326. 
327. This is by design: the desc lifetime is bound 1:1 to the FIFO element
328. slot, so as soon as the receiver advances `tail` past N, the sender is
329. free to overwrite `desc[N]` on the next lap. There is no separate desc
330. allocator to support post-callback retention.
331. 
332. If a future need arises to support `UCT_CB_PARAM_FLAG_DESC`-style
333. returnable descriptors (e.g. for AM zcopy or large-message rendezvous
334. without copy), it requires a real per-iface mpool of receive
335. descriptors that the upper layer can hold and release explicitly —
336. mirroring `uct_mm_recv_desc_t`. Out of scope for v2.
337. 
338. ## Verification (no hardware)
339. 
340. Per `.github/skills/ucx-build-verify/SKILL.md`:
341. 
342. 1. Build via `task` agent: `./autogen.sh && ./contrib/configure-devel
343.    && make -j && make install`.
344. 2. `ucx_info -d -t obmm` → confirm `am_short` and `am_bcopy` lines:
345.    `max_short` should report 16432 total bytes and `max_bcopy` should reflect
346.    raw `seg_size` (default 32768).
347. 3. `ucx_info -c | grep OBMM` → confirm new `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE` entry.
348. 4. `nm -D libuct.so | grep uct_obmm_ep_am_bcopy` → exists.
349. 5. Hardware-required checks (cross-node MPI, sweep sizes through
350.    `> max_short` and `> max_bcopy`) deferred to user-driven runs on
351.    the real two-node setup.
352.

168.                   iface->fifo_size, iface->fifo_elem_size,
169.                   iface->bcopy_seg_size);
170.         return UCS_ERR_UNREACHABLE;

173.     eid.hi = daddr->exporter_deid_hi;
174.     eid.lo = daddr->exporter_deid_lo;

176.     region = NULL;

179.         (iface->region->info.exporter_deid.lo == eid.lo)) {
180.         region = iface->region;

183.     }
184. 
185.     if (region == NULL) {
186.         ucs_error("obmm: ep_create cannot find region for peer "
187.                   "dcna=0x%lx deid=0x%lx:0x%lx",
188.                   (unsigned long)daddr->exporter_dcna,
189.                   (unsigned long)daddr->exporter_deid_hi,
190.                   (unsigned long)daddr->exporter_deid_lo);

194.     status = uct_obmm_pool_open(region->base, region->length, &peer_pool);

201.     if (iaddr->slot_index >= peer_pool.slot_count) {

204.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
205.     }

207.     if (peer_pool.slot_size !=
208.         uct_obmm_slot_stride(iaddr->fifo_size, iaddr->fifo_elem_size,
209.                              iaddr->bcopy_seg_size)) {
210.         ucs_error("obmm: peer pool slot_size %u inconsistent with iface_addr "
211.                   "geometry (fifo=%u elem=%u seg=%u)",
212.                   peer_pool.slot_size, iaddr->fifo_size,
213.                   iaddr->fifo_elem_size, iaddr->bcopy_seg_size);

218.     self->fifo_size           = iaddr->fifo_size;
219.     self->fifo_mask           = iaddr->fifo_size - 1u;
220.     self->fifo_elem_size      = iaddr->fifo_elem_size;
221.     self->bcopy_seg_size      = iaddr->bcopy_seg_size;
222.     self->peer_dcna           = daddr->exporter_dcna;
223.     self->peer_deid_hi        = daddr->exporter_deid_hi;
224.     self->peer_deid_lo        = daddr->exporter_deid_lo;
225.     self->peer_slot_index     = iaddr->slot_index;
226.     self->peer_pid            = iaddr->pid;
227.     self->mailbox_bank        = uct_obmm_ep_mailbox_bank(iface, daddr);

229.     tx_lane        = uct_obmm_slot_lane(iface->slot, self->mailbox_bank,

231.                                         iface->fifo_elem_size,

236.                                          iface->fifo_elem_size);
237.     self->tx_index = self->tx_ctl->head;
238.     self->cached_tail = (self->tx_ctl->tail_generation == iface->generation) ?
239.                         self->tx_ctl->tail : self->tx_index;
240. 
241.     peer_slot = uct_obmm_pool_slot_ptr(&peer_pool, iaddr->slot_index);
242.     uct_obmm_ep_register_rx_lane(iface, self, peer_slot);
243.     return UCS_OK;

164. uct_obmm_iface_is_reachable_v2(const uct_iface_h tl_iface,
165.                                const uct_iface_is_reachable_params_t *params)
166. {
167.     uct_obmm_iface_t             *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_iface,
168.                                                          uct_obmm_iface_t);
169.     uct_obmm_md_t                *md    = ucs_derived_of(iface->super.md,
170.                                                          uct_obmm_md_t);
171.     const uct_obmm_device_addr_t *daddr;
172.     const uct_obmm_iface_addr_t  *iaddr;
173.     uct_obmm_eid_t                eid;
174.     uct_obmm_region_t            *export_r;
175. 
176.     if (!uct_iface_is_reachable_params_addrs_valid(params)) {
177.         return 0;
178.     }
179. 
180.     daddr = (const uct_obmm_device_addr_t*)params->device_addr;
181.     iaddr = (const uct_obmm_iface_addr_t*)params->iface_addr;
182.     if ((daddr == NULL) || (iaddr == NULL)) {
183.         uct_iface_fill_info_str_buf(params, "missing device or iface address");
184.         return 0;
185.     }
186. 
187.     if ((iaddr->fifo_size != iface->fifo_size) ||
188.         (iaddr->fifo_elem_size != iface->fifo_elem_size) ||
189.         (iaddr->bcopy_seg_size != iface->bcopy_seg_size)) {
190.         uct_iface_fill_info_str_buf(params,
191.                                     "incompatible OBMM geometry "
192.                                     "(peer fifo=%u elem=%u seg=%u, "
193.                                     "local fifo=%u elem=%u seg=%u)",
194.                                     iaddr->fifo_size, iaddr->fifo_elem_size,
195.                                     iaddr->bcopy_seg_size,
196.                                     iface->fifo_size, iface->fifo_elem_size,
197.                                     iface->bcopy_seg_size);
198.         return 0;
199.     }
200. 
201.     eid.hi = daddr->exporter_deid_hi;
202.     eid.lo = daddr->exporter_deid_lo;
203. 
204.     export_r = uct_obmm_md_export_region(md);
205.     if ((export_r != NULL) &&
206.         (export_r->info.exporter_dcna == daddr->exporter_dcna) &&
207.         (export_r->info.exporter_deid.hi == eid.hi) &&
208.         (export_r->info.exporter_deid.lo == eid.lo)) {
209.         return uct_iface_scope_is_reachable(tl_iface, params);
210.     }
211. 
212.     if (uct_obmm_md_find_import_region(md, daddr->exporter_dcna, &eid) != NULL) {
213.         return uct_iface_scope_is_reachable(tl_iface, params);
214.     }
215. 
216.     uct_iface_fill_info_str_buf(params,
217.                                 "no mapped region for peer dcna=0x%lx "
218.                                 "deid=0x%lx:0x%lx",
219.                                 (unsigned long)daddr->exporter_dcna,
220.                                 (unsigned long)eid.hi, (unsigned long)eid.lo);
221.     return 0;
222. }

225. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE unsigned
226. uct_obmm_iface_progress_lane(uct_obmm_iface_t *iface, uct_obmm_rx_lane_t *lane)
227. {
228.     uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem;
229.     uint32_t                 head;
230. 
231.     if (!lane->active) {
232.         return 0;
233.     }
234. 
235.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
236.     if (lane->ctl->sender_generation != lane->sender_generation) {
237.         return 0;
238.     }
239. 
240.     head = lane->ctl->head;
241.     if (head == lane->rx_index) {
242.         return 0;
243.     }
244. 
245.     elem = uct_obmm_lane_elem(lane->elems, lane->rx_index, iface->fifo_mask,
246.                               iface->fifo_elem_size);
247.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
248. 
249.     if (elem->generation == iface->generation) {
250.         if (elem->flags & UCT_OBMM_MAILBOX_ELEM_FLAG_BCOPY) {
251.             void *desc = uct_obmm_lane_desc(lane->descs, lane->rx_index,
252.                                             iface->fifo_mask,
253.                                             iface->bcopy_seg_size);
254.             uct_iface_invoke_am(&iface->super, elem->am_id,
255.                                 desc, elem->length, 0);
256.         } else {
257.             uct_iface_invoke_am(&iface->super, elem->am_id,
258.                                 &elem->header, elem->length, 0);
259.         }
260.     }
261. 
262.     lane->rx_index++;
263.     uct_obmm_bus_full_fence();
264.     lane->ctl->tail = lane->rx_index;
265.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
266.     lane->ctl->tail_generation = lane->sender_generation;
267.     return 1;
268. }
269.

271. static unsigned uct_obmm_iface_progress(uct_iface_h tl_iface)
272. {
273.     uct_obmm_iface_t *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_iface, uct_obmm_iface_t);
274.     unsigned          polled = 0;
275.     unsigned          total_lanes = UCT_OBMM_MAILBOX_BANK_COUNT *
276.                                     UCT_OBMM_POOL_SLOT_COUNT;
277.     unsigned          scanned;
278. 
279.     for (scanned = 0; (scanned < total_lanes) && (polled < iface->fifo_max_poll);
280.          ++scanned) {
281.         unsigned           idx  = (iface->rx_lane_rr + scanned) % total_lanes;
282.         unsigned           bank = idx / UCT_OBMM_POOL_SLOT_COUNT;
283.         unsigned           slot = idx % UCT_OBMM_POOL_SLOT_COUNT;
284. 
285.         polled += uct_obmm_iface_progress_lane(iface,
286.                                                &iface->rx_lanes[bank][slot]);
287.     }
288. 
289.     iface->rx_lane_rr = (iface->rx_lane_rr + 1) % total_lanes;
290. 
291.     ucs_arbiter_dispatch(&iface->arbiter, 1, uct_obmm_ep_process_pending,
292.                          &polled);
293. 
294.     return polled;
295. }

18. /* Number of iface-owned slots in the per-region pool. Caps how many ifaces can
19.  * attach to a single obmm region from one host. */
20. #define UCT_OBMM_POOL_SLOT_COUNT 32u
21. 
22. /* Every sender-owned slot contains two mailbox banks so destination slot
23.  * indexes from the local host and the remote host cannot collide. */
24. enum {
25.     UCT_OBMM_MAILBOX_BANK_LOCAL  = 0u,
26.     UCT_OBMM_MAILBOX_BANK_REMOTE = 1u,
27.     UCT_OBMM_MAILBOX_BANK_COUNT  = 2u
28. };
29. 
30. 
31. /* Element flags carried in the shared mailbox element header. */
32. enum {
33.     UCT_OBMM_MAILBOX_ELEM_FLAG_BCOPY = UCS_BIT(0)
34. };
35. 
36. 
37. /* Per-lane mailbox control. One sender owns head/sender_generation; one
38.  * receiver owns tail/tail_generation. The slot owner initializes all lanes'
39.  * sender_generation to its slot generation when the slot is allocated. */
40. typedef struct uct_obmm_mailbox_ctl {
41.     /* 1st cacheline: sender-touched */
42.     volatile uint32_t head;
43.     volatile uint32_t sender_generation;
44.     UCS_CACHELINE_PADDING(uint32_t, uint32_t);
45. 
46.     /* 2nd cacheline: receiver-touched */
47.     volatile uint32_t tail;
48.     volatile uint32_t tail_generation;
49.     UCS_CACHELINE_PADDING(uint32_t, uint32_t);
50. } UCS_V_ALIGNED(UCS_SYS_CACHE_LINE_SIZE) uct_obmm_mailbox_ctl_t;
51. 
52. 
53. /* Mailbox element header. The element body (am short header + payload) follows
54.  * immediately. Total element stride is iface->config.fifo_elem_size. */
55. typedef struct uct_obmm_fifo_element {
56.     uint8_t  flags;       /* UCT_OBMM_MAILBOX_ELEM_FLAG_xx */
57.     uint8_t  am_id;       /* active message id */
58.     uint16_t length;      /* payload length (excluding am_short header) */
59.     uint32_t generation;  /* receiver-slot generation token; receiver discards
60.                              elements whose generation doesn't match its local
61.                              iface generation */
62.     uint64_t header;      /* am_short 64-bit header */
63.     /* payload[length] follows here */
64. } UCS_S_PACKED uct_obmm_fifo_element_t;
65. 
66. 
67. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE size_t
68. uct_obmm_mailbox_lane_stride(unsigned fifo_size, unsigned fifo_elem_size,
69.                              unsigned bcopy_seg_size)
70. {
71.     return ucs_align_up(sizeof(uct_obmm_mailbox_ctl_t) +
72.                         ((size_t)fifo_size * fifo_elem_size) +
73.                         ((size_t)fifo_size * bcopy_seg_size),
74.                         UCS_SYS_CACHE_LINE_SIZE);
75. }
76. 
77. 
78. /* Compute slot stride: every slot contains one mailbox lane for every
79.  * (bank, destination-slot-index) pair. Returned as size_t; callers must still
80.  * validate it fits in the uint32_t pool header field. */
81. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE size_t
82. uct_obmm_slot_stride(unsigned fifo_size, unsigned fifo_elem_size,
83.                      unsigned bcopy_seg_size)
84. {
85.     return ucs_align_up((size_t)UCT_OBMM_MAILBOX_BANK_COUNT *
86.                         UCT_OBMM_POOL_SLOT_COUNT *
87.                         uct_obmm_mailbox_lane_stride(fifo_size, fifo_elem_size,
88.                                                      bcopy_seg_size),
89.                         UCS_SYS_CACHE_LINE_SIZE);
90. }
91. 
92. 
93. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void*
94. uct_obmm_slot_lane(void *slot_base, unsigned bank, unsigned dst_slot_index,
95.                    unsigned fifo_size, unsigned fifo_elem_size,
96.                    unsigned bcopy_seg_size)
97. {
98.     size_t lane_index = ((size_t)bank * UCT_OBMM_POOL_SLOT_COUNT) +
99.                         dst_slot_index;
100.     size_t lane_stride = uct_obmm_mailbox_lane_stride(fifo_size, fifo_elem_size,
101.                                                       bcopy_seg_size);
102. 
103.     return UCS_PTR_BYTE_OFFSET(slot_base, lane_index * lane_stride);
104. }
105. 
106. 
107. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE uct_obmm_mailbox_ctl_t*
108. uct_obmm_lane_ctl(void *lane_base)
109. {
110.     return (uct_obmm_mailbox_ctl_t*)lane_base;
111. }
112. 
113. 
114. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void*
115. uct_obmm_lane_elems(void *lane_base)
116. {
117.     return UCS_PTR_BYTE_OFFSET(lane_base, sizeof(uct_obmm_mailbox_ctl_t));
118. }
119. 
120. 
121. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void*
122. uct_obmm_lane_descs(void *lane_base, unsigned fifo_size,
123.                     unsigned fifo_elem_size)
124. {
125.     return UCS_PTR_BYTE_OFFSET(lane_base,
126.                                sizeof(uct_obmm_mailbox_ctl_t) +
127.                                ((size_t)fifo_size * fifo_elem_size));
128. }
129. 
130. 
131. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE uct_obmm_fifo_element_t*
132. uct_obmm_lane_elem(void *elems, uint32_t index, unsigned mask,
133.                    unsigned elem_size)
134. {
135.     return (uct_obmm_fifo_element_t*)
136.            UCS_PTR_BYTE_OFFSET(elems, (size_t)(index & mask) * elem_size);
137. }
138.

141. uct_obmm_lane_desc(void *descs, uint32_t index, unsigned mask,

148. /* Full bus-domain fence: orders ALL prior memory accesses (loads and stores)
149.  * before ALL subsequent memory accesses, in the outer-shareable / device
150.  * domain that includes cross-host obmm peers. */
151. #if defined(__aarch64__)
152. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() __asm__ __volatile__("dmb osh" ::: "memory")
153. #elif defined(__x86_64__) || defined(__i386__)
154. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() __asm__ __volatile__("mfence" ::: "memory")
155. #elif defined(__powerpc64__)
156. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() __asm__ __volatile__("sync" ::: "memory")
157. #elif defined(__riscv) && (__riscv_xlen == 64)
158. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() \
159.     __asm__ __volatile__("fence iorw, iorw" ::: "memory")
160. #else
161. #warning "obmm: no full bus fence for this arch; mailbox ack ordering may be weak"
162. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() do { \
163.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();        \
164.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();       \
165. } while (0)
166. #endif
167. 
168. #endif

330.     if (config->fifo_size == 0) {

336.                   config->fifo_size);

338.     }
339.     if (config->fifo_elem_size <= sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_element_t)) {

341.                   config->fifo_elem_size, sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_element_t));
342.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
343.     }
344.     if ((config->fifo_elem_size - sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_element_t)) >

347.                   "in uint16 (max %zu)",

350.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
351.     }
352.     if (config->bcopy_seg_size == 0) {

374.                   "elem=%u seg=%u); reduce one of the geometry knobs",
375.                   stride, config->fifo_size, config->fifo_elem_size,
376.                   config->bcopy_seg_size);
377.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
378.     }
379.     required = uct_obmm_pool_required_size(UCT_OBMM_POOL_SLOT_COUNT,
380.                                            (uint32_t)stride);
381.     if (required > region->length) {
382.         ucs_error("obmm: mailbox geometry does not fit in region: "
383.                   "fifo_size=%u elem_size=%u seg_size=%u stride=%zu "
384.                   "slot_count=%u required=%zu region=%zu",
385.                   config->fifo_size, config->fifo_elem_size,

391.     UCT_CHECK_PARAM(params->field_mask & UCT_IFACE_PARAM_FIELD_OPEN_MODE,
392.                     "UCT_IFACE_PARAM_FIELD_OPEN_MODE is not defined");
393.     if (!(params->open_mode & UCT_IFACE_OPEN_MODE_DEVICE)) {
394.         ucs_error("only UCT_IFACE_OPEN_MODE_DEVICE is supported");
395.         return UCS_ERR_UNSUPPORTED;

398.     UCS_CLASS_CALL_SUPER_INIT(uct_base_iface_t, &uct_obmm_iface_ops,

404.                               UCS_STATS_ARG(params->mode.device.dev_name));

406.     self->region           = region;
407.     self->config.bandwidth = config->super.bandwidth;
408.     self->fifo_size        = config->fifo_size;
409.     self->fifo_mask        = config->fifo_size - 1u;
410.     self->fifo_elem_size   = config->fifo_elem_size;
411.     self->bcopy_seg_size   = config->bcopy_seg_size;

417.     status = uct_obmm_pool_attach(region->base, region->length,

422.         return status;
423.     }
424. 
425.     status = uct_obmm_pool_alloc_slot(&self->pool, &self->slot_index,
