310. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE unsigned
311. uct_obmm_iface_progress_lane(uct_obmm_iface_t *iface, uct_obmm_rx_lane_t *lane)
312. {
313.     uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem;
314.     uint32_t                 head;
315. 
316.     if (!lane->active) {
317.         return 0;
318.     }
319. 
320.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
321.     if (lane->ctl->sender_generation != lane->sender_generation) {
322.         return 0;
323.     }
324. 
325.     head = lane->ctl->head;
326.     if (head == lane->rx_index) {
327.         return 0;
328.     }
329. 
330.     elem = uct_obmm_lane_elem(lane->elems, lane->rx_index, iface->fifo_mask,
331.                               iface->fifo_elem_size);
332.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
333. 
334.     if (elem->generation == iface->generation) {
335.         if (elem->flags & UCT_OBMM_MAILBOX_ELEM_FLAG_BCOPY) {
336.             void *desc = uct_obmm_lane_desc(lane->descs, lane->rx_index,
337.                                             iface->fifo_mask,
338.                                             iface->bcopy_seg_size);
339.             uct_iface_invoke_am(&iface->super, elem->am_id,
340.                                 desc, elem->length, 0);
341.         } else {
342.             uct_iface_invoke_am(&iface->super, elem->am_id,
343.                                 &elem->header, elem->length, 0);
344.         }
345.     }
346. 
347.     lane->rx_index++;
348.     uct_obmm_bus_full_fence();
349.     if (lane->ctl->sender_generation != lane->sender_generation) {
350.         return 1;
351.     }
352.     lane->ctl->tail = lane->rx_index;
353.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
354.     if (lane->ctl->sender_generation != lane->sender_generation) {
355.         return 1;
356.     }
357.     lane->ctl->tail_generation = lane->sender_generation;
358.     return 1;
359. }
360.

362. static unsigned uct_obmm_iface_progress(uct_iface_h tl_iface)
363. {
364.     uct_obmm_iface_t *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_iface, uct_obmm_iface_t);
365.     unsigned          polled = 0;
366.     unsigned          total_lanes = UCT_OBMM_MAILBOX_BANK_COUNT *
367.                                     UCT_OBMM_POOL_SLOT_COUNT;
368.     unsigned          scanned;
369. 
370.     for (scanned = 0; (scanned < total_lanes) && (polled < iface->fifo_max_poll);
371.          ++scanned) {
372.         unsigned           idx  = (iface->rx_lane_rr + scanned) % total_lanes;
373.         unsigned           bank = idx / UCT_OBMM_POOL_SLOT_COUNT;
374.         unsigned           slot = idx % UCT_OBMM_POOL_SLOT_COUNT;
375. 
376.         polled += uct_obmm_iface_progress_lane(iface,
377.                                                &iface->rx_lanes[bank][slot]);
378.     }
379. 
380.     iface->rx_lane_rr = (iface->rx_lane_rr + 1) % total_lanes;
381. 
382.     if (polled < iface->fifo_max_poll) {
383.         polled += uct_obmm_iface_progress_unregistered_lanes(iface,
384.                                                              iface->fifo_max_poll - polled);
385.     }
386. 
387.     ucs_arbiter_dispatch(&iface->arbiter, 1, uct_obmm_ep_process_pending,
388.                          &polled);
389. 
390.     return polled;
391. }

468. ucs_arbiter_cb_result_t uct_mm_ep_process_pending(ucs_arbiter_t *arbiter,
469.                                                   ucs_arbiter_group_t *group,
470.                                                   ucs_arbiter_elem_t *elem,
471.                                                   void *arg)
472. {
473.     uct_mm_ep_t *ep        = ucs_container_of(group, uct_mm_ep_t, arb_group);
474.     unsigned *count        = (unsigned*)arg;
475.     uct_pending_req_t *req;
476.     ucs_status_t status;
477. 
478.     /* update the local tail with its actual value from the remote peer
479.      * making sure that the pending sends would use the real tail value */
480.     uct_mm_ep_update_cached_tail(ep);
481. 
482.     if (!uct_mm_ep_has_tx_resources(ep)) {
483.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_RESCHED_GROUP;
484.     }
485. 
486.     if (elem == &ep->arb_elem) {
487.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_REMOVE_ELEM;
488.     }
489. 
490.     req = ucs_container_of(elem, uct_pending_req_t, priv);
491. 
492.     ucs_trace_data("progressing pending request %p", req);
493.     status = req->func(req);
494.     ucs_trace_data("status returned from progress pending: %s",
495.                    ucs_status_string(status));
496. 
497.     if (status == UCS_OK) {
498.         (*count)++;
499.         /* sent successfully. remove from the arbiter */
500.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_REMOVE_ELEM;
501.     } else if (status == UCS_INPROGRESS) {
502.         (*count)++;
503.         /* sent but not completed, keep in the arbiter */
504.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_NEXT_GROUP;
505.     } else {
506.         /* couldn't send. keep this request in the arbiter until the next time
507.          * this function is called */
508.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_RESCHED_GROUP;
509.     }
510. }

1. # obmm UCT transport — design notes
2. 
3. This file is the **single source of truth** for the on-region wire format
4. and the data-path semantics of the `obmm` UCT transport. Update it
5. **before** changing layout, capabilities, or sync rules. AGENTS.md
6. mandates retrieve-before-recall; this doc is the first thing to grep.
7. 
8. Status legend:
9. - **v1** = shipped, MPI cross-node smoke tests pass.
10. - **v2** = current target: complete `am_bcopy` (max_bcopy decoupled from
11.   FIFO element size, no per-message UCP fragmentation below seg_size).
12. - **Current validated baseline** = sender-owned mailbox transport with
13.   `am_short`, `am_bcopy`, pending dispatch, dynamic progress of one-way
14.   inbound lanes, and OSU point-to-point plus collective suites passing on
15.   the target hardware per user report.
16. 
17. ---
18. 
19. ## Locked-in environment facts
20. 
21. (Mirrors `.github/skills/obmm-api-and-env/SKILL.md`. Do NOT contradict
22. without re-checking that file.)
23. 
24. - Each node pre-exports **one 128 MiB region**; export/import is done
25.   outside UCX. UCT must NOT call `obmm_export/import/preimport/...`.
26. - Data-path mapping is **non-cacheable** (`open(... O_SYNC)` + mmap).
27.   `obmm_set_ownership` is forbidden and irrelevant.
28. - Cross-host 64-bit FAA/CAS on the target NC mapping are available only when
29.   emitted as explicit arm64 **LSE** instructions; compiler-default **LL/SC**
30.   atomics are not supported on this NC memory. A follow-up LSE-based probe
31.   confirmed both FAA and CAS are usable. The current transport baseline still
32.   keeps shared cross-node atomic RMW out of the hot path.
33. - Memory ordering uses **bus-domain fences**
34.   (`ucs_memory_bus_store_fence` / `ucs_memory_bus_load_fence`), NOT the
35.   CPU-domain `ucs_memory_cpu_*_fence` that mm uses. mm peers share an
36.   inner-shareable cache domain; obmm peers do not.
37. - Reachability is keyed on `(exporter_dcna, exporter_deid, memid)`,
38.   never memid alone.
39. - Two-phase pool init (UNINIT → INITING → READY via CAS) plus per-slot
40.   `(generation, owner_pid, owner_starttime)` for crash/PID-reuse safety.
41.   During teardown, INITING is reused only as a transient cleanup lock; after
42.   reset the shared region returns to literal all-zero memory.
43. - ARM64 is the production ISA. NC + bus fences are correct on aarch64.
44. 
45. ---
46. 
47. ## Region layout (v2)
48. 
49. Inside the 128 MiB exported region:
50. 
51. ```
52. +-------------------------------------------------------+ offset 0
53. | uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t (magic, state, geometry)          |
54. +-------------------------------------------------------+
55. | alloc_bitmap[bitmap_words]                            |
56. +-------------------------------------------------------+
57. | slot_meta[slot_count]  (gen, owner_pid, starttime, …) |
58. +-------------------------------------------------------+ hdr->slot_array_offset
59. | slot[0]:                                              |
60. |   bank[local]: lane[0..slot_count-1]                  |
61. |   bank[remote]: lane[0..slot_count-1]                 |
62. +-------------------------------------------------------+
63. | slot[1]: …                                            |
64. …
65. ```
66. 
67. Each slot is **sender-owned** by exactly one iface. Inside that slot:
68. 
69. - there are two banks: `local` and `remote`
70. - each bank has one lane per destination slot index
71. - each lane is SPSC:
72.   - slot owner is the only writer of `head` and `sender_generation`
73.   - the matching receiver is the only writer of `tail` and `tail_generation`
74. 
75. Banking is derived from exporter identity relative to the sender's local export
76. region, not from slot index. This avoids local-slot-index and remote-slot-index
77. collisions in the fixed two-node topology.
78. 
79. Every lane element `elem[N]` has a paired `desc[N]` in that same lane. Their
80. lifetime is identical: once the receiver advances `tail` past index `N`, the
81. sender may reuse both on the next lap.
82. 
83. ### Slot stride
84. 
85. ```
86. lane_stride = align_up(
87.     sizeof(uct_obmm_mailbox_ctl_t) +
88.     fifo_size * elem_size +
89.     fifo_size * seg_size,
90.     cacheline)
91. 
92. slot_stride = align_up(
93.     2 * slot_count * lane_stride,
94.     cacheline)
95. ```
96. 
97. The pool's `slot_count` (compile-time `UCT_OBMM_POOL_SLOT_COUNT = 32`)
98. **times** `slot_stride` MUST fit in `region->length` (128 MiB minus pool
99.  header overhead). Defaults are picked to favor short-path coverage over
100.  maximum local process count; lowering `seg_size` and/or `fifo_size`
101.  reduces per-slot footprint, but the supported local attach count remains
102.  the compile-time `slot_count`.
103. 
104. Default budget check:
105. ```
106. fifo_size       =      1
107. elem_size       =  16448   (raw UCT max_short = 16432 total bytes)
108. seg_size        =  32768   (raw UCT max_bcopy = 32768)
109. lane_stride     =  49344
110. ctl + slot data = 64 * 49344 = ~3084 KiB / slot
111. slot_count      =     32
112. total           = ~ 96 MiB / 128 MiB                     ✓
113. ```
114. These defaults are chosen from measured latency sweeps rather than from
115. wire-format arithmetic alone. With Open MPI PML/UCX on this tree, ordinary
116. `MPI_Send` goes through `mca_pml_ucx_send_nbr()` into `ucp_tag_send_nbx()`,
117. and UCX defaults `PROTO_ENABLE=y`, so protocol v2 selects between eager short,
118. eager bcopy single/multi, and rendezvous using its own headers and cost model.
119. The best reasoning-backed configuration found so far is to keep both geometry
120. knobs 64-byte aligned, leave `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE=32768` for 32KiB-class raw bcopy
121. capacity, and reduce `FIFO_ELEM_SIZE` to `16448` so 16KiB-class payloads stay
122. comfortably on short without over-extending the short window into slower
123. 32KiB-class territory.
124. 
125. When the last local iface on an export exits, UCX resets the entire local
126. export region to zero before another attach may re-initialize the pool.
127. 
128. ---
129. 
130. ## FIFO element layout
131. 
132. `uct_obmm_fifo_element_t` (16 bytes, packed):
133. 
134. | field      | bytes | notes                                          |
135. |------------|-------|------------------------------------------------|
136. | flags      |   1   | BCOPY bit only                                 |
137. | am_id      |   1   |                                                |
138. | length     |   2   | u16 — bytes passed to the AM callback          |
139. | generation |   4   | receiver-slot generation token at TX time      |
140. | header     |   8   | am_short user-visible 8B header (unused bcopy) |
141. 
142. For **am_short**, callback data starts at `&elem->header`, so the callback sees
143. `[header | payload]` and `elem->length = sizeof(header) + payload_length`.
144. The raw UCT limit remains `max_short = elem_size - 16`.
145. 
146. For **am_bcopy**, payload lives in the paired `desc[N]`. On bcopy the sender
147. writes:
148. - `elem->flags  = BCOPY`
149. - `elem->am_id  = id`
150. - `elem->length = pack_cb_returned_length`     (≤ seg_size, so ≤ u16max)
151. - `elem->generation = ep->expected_generation`
152. - `elem->header = 0` (unused)
153. 
154. Receiver, on seeing FLAG_BCOPY, computes
155. `desc[N] = slot_descs + (idx & mask) * seg_size` and calls
156. `uct_iface_invoke_am(am_id, desc[N], length, 0)`.
157. 
158. Because `desc[N]` is bound 1:1 to `elem[N]`, no extra metadata is
159. exchanged in the FIFO element to locate the desc.
160. 
161. ### `length` field width
162. 
163. `elem->length` stays `uint16_t`, capping `seg_size` at 65535. We reject
164. larger `seg_size` at iface init. If a future `seg_size > 64KiB` is
165. needed, widen `length` to `uint32_t` and update the compatibility checks.
166. 
167. ---
168. 
169. ## Sender side (`obmm_ep`)
170. 
171. Each EP binds to one outbound lane in its **local sender-owned slot**:
172. 
173. - slot base = local `iface->slot`
174. - bank = `local` if the peer device address names our export region, otherwise
175.   `remote`
176. - destination lane index = peer `iface_addr.slot_index`
177. 
178. Both `am_short` and `am_bcopy` publish to that lane identically:
179. 
180. ```
181. 1. load local cached tail for this lane
182. 2. if (tx_index - cached_tail) >= fifo_size:
183.         bus_load_fence; refresh cached_tail; recheck;
184.         if still full: return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE
185. 3. idx = tx_index, N = idx & mask
186. 4. payload write:
187.       short: memcpy header+payload into elem[N]+1
188.       bcopy: pack_cb(desc[N], arg) -> length
189. 5. fill elem[N] header fields (flags, am_id, length, generation, [header])
190. 6. ucs_memory_bus_store_fence()                          <- release barrier
191. 7. tx_index++
192. 8. lane_ctl->head = tx_index
193. ```
194. 
195. There is no shared producer lock, shared head CAS, or shared FAA. All hot-path
196. ownership is single-writer by construction.
197. 
198. ### Pending
199. 
200. `ep_pending_add` always queues into the iface arbiter. `iface_progress`
201. dispatches pending on every call, even if no RX completion occurred, because
202. depth-1 lanes will hit `UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE` frequently.
203. 
204. ---
205. 
206. ## Receiver side (`obmm_iface_progress`)
207. 
208. ```
209. round-robin over registered inbound lanes, up to fifo_max_poll completions:
210.     if lane is inactive: continue
211.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence()
212.     if lane_ctl->sender_generation != expected_sender_generation:
213.         continue                                             (stale registration)
214.     if lane_ctl->head == rx_index:
215.         continue                                             (no work)
216.     elem = elem[rx_index & mask]
217.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence()                              (acquire payload)
218.     if elem->generation != iface->generation:
219.         drop silently (slot was reused after our death+rebirth)
220.     elif elem->flags & BCOPY:
221.         desc = desc[rx_index & mask]
222.         invoke_am(am_id, desc,  length, 0)
223.     else:
224.         invoke_am(am_id, &elem->header, length, 0)
225.     rx_index++
226.     full bus fence
227.     if lane_ctl->sender_generation != expected_sender_generation:
228.         skip ack publish for this completion
229.     lane_ctl->tail = rx_index
230.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence()
231.     if lane_ctl->sender_generation != expected_sender_generation:
232.         skip tail_generation publish
233.     lane_ctl->tail_generation = expected_sender_generation
234. ```
235. 
236. Each inbound lane is registered by `(bank, sender_slot_index)` and refcounted,
237. so multiple EPs to the same sender slot do not duplicate-consume one lane.
238. 
239. ---
240. 
241. ## Capabilities (`iface_query`)
242. 
243. | flag                            | v1 | v2 | notes                       |
244. |---------------------------------|----|----|-----------------------------|
245. | AM_SHORT                        |  ✓ |  ✓ | max = elem_size - 16        |
246. | AM_BCOPY                        |  ✓ |  ✓ | v1: = max_short (cramped); v2: = seg_size |
247. | PENDING                         |  ✓ |  ✓ | iface arbiter, always queued |
248. | CONNECT_TO_IFACE                |  ✓ |  ✓ |                             |
249. | CB_SYNC                         |  ✓ |  ✓ |                             |
250. | INTER_NODE                      |  ✓ |  ✓ | required for cross-host UCT (otherwise OMPI's NET_ONLY filter strips us — see ucp_worker.c:2962) |
251. 
252. **Not advertised** in v1/v2: PUT/GET (any), ATOMIC, AM_ZCOPY, EP_CHECK,
253. AM_DUP, ERRHANDLE_PEER. Adding any of these requires a separate design
254. note.
255. 
256. ---
257. 
258. ## Wire-format compat
259. 
260. `uct_obmm_iface_addr_t` carries `(slot_index, generation, pid,
````

37. static unsigned
38. uct_obmm_iface_progress_unregistered_lanes(uct_obmm_iface_t *iface,
39.                                            unsigned max_poll)
40. {
41.     uct_obmm_md_t         *md = ucs_derived_of(iface->super.md, uct_obmm_md_t);
42.     uct_obmm_pool_t        pool;
43.     uct_obmm_region_t     *region;
44.     uct_obmm_rx_lane_t     lane;
45.     uct_obmm_mailbox_ctl_t *ctl;
46.     ucs_status_t           status;
47.     void                  *slot_base;
48.     void                  *lane_base;
49.     unsigned               i;
50.     unsigned               slot;
51.     unsigned               bank;
52.     unsigned               completions = 0;
53.     uint32_t               head;
54.     uint32_t               tail;
55. 
56.     for (i = 0; i < md->num_regions; ++i) {
57.         region = &md->regions[i];
58.         bank   = (i == (unsigned)md->export_idx) ? UCT_OBMM_MAILBOX_BANK_LOCAL :
59.                                                    UCT_OBMM_MAILBOX_BANK_REMOTE;
60. 
61.         status = uct_obmm_pool_open(region->base, region->length, &pool);
62.         if (status != UCS_OK) {
63.             continue;
64.         }
65. 
66.         for (slot = 0; (slot < pool.slot_count) &&
67.                        (slot < UCT_OBMM_POOL_SLOT_COUNT); ++slot) {
68.             if ((bank == UCT_OBMM_MAILBOX_BANK_LOCAL) &&
69.                 (slot == iface->slot_index)) {
70.                 continue;
71.             }
72.             if (iface->rx_lanes[bank][slot].active) {
73.                 continue;
74.             }
75.             if (pool.meta[slot].state != UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_IN_USE) {
76.                 continue;
77.             }
78. 
79.             slot_base = uct_obmm_pool_slot_ptr(&pool, slot);
80.             lane_base = uct_obmm_slot_lane(slot_base, bank, iface->slot_index,
81.                                            iface->fifo_size,
82.                                            iface->fifo_elem_size,
83.                                            iface->bcopy_seg_size);
84.             ctl = uct_obmm_lane_ctl(lane_base);
85. 
86.             ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
87.             if (ctl->sender_generation != pool.meta[slot].generation) {
88.                 continue;
89.             }
90. 
91.             head = ctl->head;
92.             tail = ctl->tail;
93.             if (head == tail) {
94.                 continue;
95.             }
96. 
97.             memset(&lane, 0, sizeof(lane));
98.             lane.ctl               = ctl;
99.             lane.elems             = uct_obmm_lane_elems(lane_base);
100.             lane.descs             = uct_obmm_lane_descs(lane_base,
101.                                                          iface->fifo_size,
102.                                                          iface->fifo_elem_size);
103.             lane.sender_generation = pool.meta[slot].generation;
104.             lane.rx_index          = (ctl->tail_generation == lane.sender_generation) ?
105.                                      tail : 0;
106.             lane.active            = 1;
107. 
108.             completions += uct_obmm_iface_progress_lane(iface, &lane);
109.             if (completions >= max_poll) {
110.                 return completions;
111.             }
112.         }
113.     }
114. 
115.     return completions;
116. }

248. static int
249. uct_obmm_iface_is_reachable_v2(const uct_iface_h tl_iface,
250.                                const uct_iface_is_reachable_params_t *params)
251. {
252.     uct_obmm_iface_t             *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_iface,
253.                                                          uct_obmm_iface_t);
254.     uct_obmm_md_t                *md    = ucs_derived_of(iface->super.md,
255.                                                          uct_obmm_md_t);
256.     const uct_obmm_device_addr_t *daddr;
257.     const uct_obmm_iface_addr_t  *iaddr;
258.     uct_obmm_eid_t                eid;
259.     uct_obmm_region_t            *export_r;
260. 
261.     if (!uct_iface_is_reachable_params_addrs_valid(params)) {
262.         return 0;
263.     }
264. 
265.     daddr = (const uct_obmm_device_addr_t*)params->device_addr;
266.     iaddr = (const uct_obmm_iface_addr_t*)params->iface_addr;
267.     if ((daddr == NULL) || (iaddr == NULL)) {
268.         uct_iface_fill_info_str_buf(params, "missing device or iface address");
269.         return 0;
270.     }
271. 
272.     if ((iaddr->fifo_size != iface->fifo_size) ||
273.         (iaddr->fifo_elem_size != iface->fifo_elem_size) ||
274.         (iaddr->bcopy_seg_size != iface->bcopy_seg_size)) {
275.         uct_iface_fill_info_str_buf(params,
276.                                     "incompatible OBMM geometry "
277.                                     "(peer fifo=%u elem=%u seg=%u, "
278.                                     "local fifo=%u elem=%u seg=%u)",
279.                                     iaddr->fifo_size, iaddr->fifo_elem_size,
280.                                     iaddr->bcopy_seg_size,
281.                                     iface->fifo_size, iface->fifo_elem_size,
282.                                     iface->bcopy_seg_size);
283.         return 0;
284.     }
285. 
286.     eid.hi = daddr->exporter_deid_hi;
287.     eid.lo = daddr->exporter_deid_lo;
288. 
289.     export_r = uct_obmm_md_export_region(md);
290.     if ((export_r != NULL) &&
291.         (export_r->info.exporter_dcna == daddr->exporter_dcna) &&
292.         (export_r->info.exporter_deid.hi == eid.hi) &&
293.         (export_r->info.exporter_deid.lo == eid.lo)) {
294.         return uct_iface_scope_is_reachable(tl_iface, params);
295.     }
296. 
297.     if (uct_obmm_md_find_import_region(md, daddr->exporter_dcna, &eid) != NULL) {
298.         return uct_iface_scope_is_reachable(tl_iface, params);
299.     }
300. 
301.     uct_iface_fill_info_str_buf(params,
302.                                 "no mapped region for peer dcna=0x%lx "
303.                                 "deid=0x%lx:0x%lx",
304.                                 (unsigned long)daddr->exporter_dcna,
305.                                 (unsigned long)eid.hi, (unsigned long)eid.lo);
306.     return 0;
307. }

311. uct_obmm_iface_progress_lane(uct_obmm_iface_t *iface, uct_obmm_rx_lane_t *lane)
312. {
313.     uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem;
314.     uint32_t                 head;
315. 
316.     if (!lane->active) {
317.         return 0;
318.     }
319. 
320.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
321.     if (lane->ctl->sender_generation != lane->sender_generation) {
322.         return 0;

324. 
325.     head = lane->ctl->head;
326.     if (head == lane->rx_index) {
327.         return 0;

331.                               iface->fifo_elem_size);
332.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
333. 
334.     if (elem->generation == iface->generation) {
335.         if (elem->flags & UCT_OBMM_MAILBOX_ELEM_FLAG_BCOPY) {
336.             void *desc = uct_obmm_lane_desc(lane->descs, lane->rx_index,
337.                                             iface->fifo_mask,
338.                                             iface->bcopy_seg_size);
339.             uct_iface_invoke_am(&iface->super, elem->am_id,
340.                                 desc, elem->length, 0);

158.     daddr = (const uct_obmm_device_addr_t*)params->dev_addr;
159.     iaddr = (const uct_obmm_iface_addr_t*)params->iface_addr;

172. 
173.     eid.hi = daddr->exporter_deid_hi;
174.     eid.lo = daddr->exporter_deid_lo;
175. 
176.     region = NULL;
177.     if ((iface->region->info.exporter_dcna == daddr->exporter_dcna) &&
178.         (iface->region->info.exporter_deid.hi == eid.hi) &&
179.         (iface->region->info.exporter_deid.lo == eid.lo)) {
180.         region = iface->region;
181.     } else {
182.         region = uct_obmm_md_find_import_region(md, daddr->exporter_dcna, &eid);
183.     }
184. 
185.     if (region == NULL) {
186.         ucs_error("obmm: ep_create cannot find region for peer "
187.                   "dcna=0x%lx deid=0x%lx:0x%lx",
188.                   (unsigned long)daddr->exporter_dcna,
189.                   (unsigned long)daddr->exporter_deid_hi,
190.                   (unsigned long)daddr->exporter_deid_lo);
191.         return UCS_ERR_UNREACHABLE;
192.     }
193. 
194.     status = uct_obmm_pool_open(region->base, region->length, &peer_pool);
195.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
196.         ucs_error("obmm: failed to open peer pool: %s",
197.                   ucs_status_string(status));
198.         return status;
199.     }
200. 
201.     if (iaddr->slot_index >= peer_pool.slot_count) {
202.         ucs_error("obmm: peer slot_index %u out of range (slot_count=%u)",
203.                   iaddr->slot_index, peer_pool.slot_count);
204.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
205.     }
206. 
207.     if (peer_pool.slot_size !=

213.                   iaddr->fifo_elem_size, iaddr->bcopy_seg_size);
214.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
215.     }
216. 
217.     self->expected_generation = iaddr->generation;
218.     self->fifo_size           = iaddr->fifo_size;
219.     self->fifo_mask           = iaddr->fifo_size - 1u;
220.     self->fifo_elem_size      = iaddr->fifo_elem_size;
221.     self->bcopy_seg_size      = iaddr->bcopy_seg_size;
222.     self->peer_dcna           = daddr->exporter_dcna;
223.     self->peer_deid_hi        = daddr->exporter_deid_hi;
224.     self->peer_deid_lo        = daddr->exporter_deid_lo;
225.     self->peer_slot_index     = iaddr->slot_index;
226.     self->peer_pid            = iaddr->pid;
227.     self->mailbox_bank        = uct_obmm_ep_mailbox_bank(iface, daddr);
228. 
229.     tx_lane        = uct_obmm_slot_lane(iface->slot, self->mailbox_bank,
230.                                         self->peer_slot_index, iface->fifo_size,
231.                                         iface->fifo_elem_size,
232.                                         iface->bcopy_seg_size);
233.     self->tx_ctl   = uct_obmm_lane_ctl(tx_lane);
234.     self->tx_elems = uct_obmm_lane_elems(tx_lane);
235.     self->tx_descs = uct_obmm_lane_descs(tx_lane, iface->fifo_size,
236.                                          iface->fifo_elem_size);
237.     self->tx_index = self->tx_ctl->head;
238.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
239.     self->cached_tail = (self->tx_ctl->tail_generation == iface->generation) ?
240.                         self->tx_ctl->tail : self->tx_index;
241. 
242.     peer_slot = uct_obmm_pool_slot_ptr(&peer_pool, iaddr->slot_index);
243.     uct_obmm_ep_register_rx_lane(iface, self, peer_slot);
244.     return UCS_OK;
245. }

372. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void
373. uct_mm_iface_fifo_window_adjust(uct_mm_iface_t *iface,
374.                                 unsigned fifo_poll_count)
375. {
376.     if (fifo_poll_count < iface->fifo_poll_count) {
377.         iface->fifo_poll_count = ucs_max(iface->fifo_poll_count /
378.                                          UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_MD_FACTOR,
379.                                          UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_MIN_POLL);
380.         iface->fifo_prev_wnd_cons = 0;
381.         return;
382.     }
383. 
384.     ucs_assert(fifo_poll_count == iface->fifo_poll_count);
385. 
386.     if (iface->fifo_prev_wnd_cons) {
387.         /* Increase FIFO window size if it was fully consumed
388.          * during the previous iface progress call in order
389.          * to prevent the situation when the window will be
390.          * adjusted to [MIN, MIN + 1, MIN, MIN + 1, ...] that
391.          * is harmful to latency */
392.         iface->fifo_poll_count = ucs_min(iface->fifo_poll_count +
393.                                          UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_AI_VALUE,
394.                                          iface->config.fifo_max_poll);
395.     } else {
396.         iface->fifo_prev_wnd_cons = 1;
397.     }

403.     unsigned total_count  = 0;
404.     unsigned count;
405. 
406.     ucs_assert(iface->fifo_poll_count >= UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_MIN_POLL);
407.

409.     do {
410.         count = uct_mm_iface_poll_fifo(iface);
411.         ucs_assert(count < 2);
412.         total_count += count;
413.         ucs_assert(total_count < UINT_MAX);

415. 
416.     uct_mm_iface_fifo_window_adjust(iface, total_count);
417.

432. static ucs_status_t
433. uct_mm_iface_event_fd_arm(uct_iface_h tl_iface, unsigned events)
434. {
435.     uct_mm_iface_t *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_iface, uct_mm_iface_t);
436.     char dummy[UCT_MM_IFACE_MAX_SIG_EVENTS]; /* pop multiple signals at once */
437.     uint64_t head, prev_head;
438.     int ret;
439. 
440.     if ((events & UCT_EVENT_SEND_COMP) &&
441.         !ucs_arbiter_is_empty(&iface->arbiter)) {
442.         /* if we have outstanding send operations, can't go to sleep */
443.         return UCS_ERR_BUSY;
444.     }
445. 
446.     if (!(events & UCT_EVENT_RECV)) {
447.         /* Nothing to do anymore */
448.         return UCS_OK;
449.     }
450. 
451.     /* Make the next sender which writes to the FIFO signal the receiver */
452.     head = iface->recv_fifo_ctl->head;
453.     if ((head & ~UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_HEAD_EVENT_ARMED) > iface->read_index) {
454.         /* head element was not read yet */
455.         ucs_trace("iface %p: cannot arm, head %" PRIu64 " read_index %" PRIu64,
456.                   iface, head & ~UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_HEAD_EVENT_ARMED,
457.                   iface->read_index);
458.         return UCS_ERR_BUSY;
459.     }
460. 
461.     if (!(head & UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_HEAD_EVENT_ARMED)) {
462.         /* Try to mark the head index as armed in an atomic way; fail if any
463.            sender managed to update the head at the same time */
464.         prev_head = ucs_atomic_cswap64(
465.                 ucs_unaligned_ptr(&iface->recv_fifo_ctl->head), head,
466.                 head | UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_HEAD_EVENT_ARMED);
467.         if (prev_head != head) {
468.             /* race with sender; need to retry */
469.             ucs_assert(!(prev_head & UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_HEAD_EVENT_ARMED));
470.             ucs_trace("iface %p: cannot arm, head %" PRIu64
471.                       " prev_head %" PRIu64,
472.                       iface, head, prev_head);
473.             return UCS_ERR_BUSY;
474.         }
475.     }
476. 
477.     /* check for pending events */
478.     ret = recvfrom(iface->signal_fd, &dummy, sizeof(dummy), 0, NULL, 0);
479.     if (ret > 0) {
480.         ucs_trace("iface %p: cannot arm, got a signal", iface);
481.         return UCS_ERR_BUSY;
482.     } else if (ret == -1) {
483.         if (errno == EAGAIN) {
484.             ucs_trace("iface %p: armed head %" PRIu64 " read_index %" PRIu64,
485.                       iface, head & ~UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_HEAD_EVENT_ARMED,
486.                       iface->read_index);
487.             return UCS_OK;
488.         } else if (errno == EINTR) {
489.             return UCS_ERR_BUSY;
490.         } else {
491.             ucs_error("iface %p: failed to retrieve message from socket: %m",
492.                       iface);
493.             return UCS_ERR_IO_ERROR;
494.         }
495.     } else {
496.         ucs_assert(ret == 0);
497.         ucs_trace("iface %p: remote socket closed", iface);
498.         return UCS_ERR_CONNECTION_RESET;
499.     }
500. }

18. /* Number of iface-owned slots in the per-region pool. Caps how many ifaces can
19.  * attach to a single obmm region from one host. */
20. #define UCT_OBMM_POOL_SLOT_COUNT 32u
21. 
22. /* Every sender-owned slot contains two mailbox banks so destination slot
23.  * indexes from the local host and the remote host cannot collide. */
24. enum {
25.     UCT_OBMM_MAILBOX_BANK_LOCAL  = 0u,
26.     UCT_OBMM_MAILBOX_BANK_REMOTE = 1u,
27.     UCT_OBMM_MAILBOX_BANK_COUNT  = 2u
28. };

32. enum {
33.     UCT_OBMM_MAILBOX_ELEM_FLAG_BCOPY = UCS_BIT(0)
34. };
35. 
36. 
37. /* Per-lane mailbox control. One sender owns head/sender_generation; one
38.  * receiver owns tail/tail_generation. The slot owner initializes all lanes'
39.  * sender_generation to its slot generation when the slot is allocated. */
40. typedef struct uct_obmm_mailbox_ctl {
41.     /* 1st cacheline: sender-touched */
42.     volatile uint32_t head;
43.     volatile uint32_t sender_generation;
44.     UCS_CACHELINE_PADDING(uint32_t, uint32_t);
45. 
46.     /* 2nd cacheline: receiver-touched */
47.     volatile uint32_t tail;
48.     volatile uint32_t tail_generation;
49.     UCS_CACHELINE_PADDING(uint32_t, uint32_t);
50. } UCS_V_ALIGNED(UCS_SYS_CACHE_LINE_SIZE) uct_obmm_mailbox_ctl_t;
51. 
52. 
53. /* Mailbox element header. The element body follows immediately. For am_short,
54.  * the callback data is [header|payload] starting at &elem->header. For
55.  * am_bcopy, the callback data lives in the paired desc entry. */
56. typedef struct uct_obmm_fifo_element {
57.     uint8_t  flags;       /* UCT_OBMM_MAILBOX_ELEM_FLAG_xx */
58.     uint8_t  am_id;       /* active message id */
59.     uint16_t length;      /* bytes passed to the AM callback */
60.     uint32_t generation;  /* receiver-slot generation token; receiver discards
61.                              elements whose generation doesn't match its local
62.                              iface generation */
63.     uint64_t header;      /* am_short 64-bit header */
64.     /* payload[length] follows here */
65. } UCS_S_PACKED uct_obmm_fifo_element_t;

149. /* Full bus-domain fence: orders ALL prior memory accesses (loads and stores)
150.  * before ALL subsequent memory accesses, in the outer-shareable / device
151.  * domain that includes cross-host obmm peers. */
152. #if defined(__aarch64__)
153. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() __asm__ __volatile__("dmb osh" ::: "memory")
154. #elif defined(__x86_64__) || defined(__i386__)
155. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() __asm__ __volatile__("mfence" ::: "memory")
156. #elif defined(__powerpc64__)
157. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() __asm__ __volatile__("sync" ::: "memory")
158. #elif defined(__riscv) && (__riscv_xlen == 64)
159. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() \
160.     __asm__ __volatile__("fence iorw, iorw" ::: "memory")
161. #else
162. #warning "obmm: no full bus fence for this arch; mailbox ack ordering may be weak"
163. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() do { \
164.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();        \
165.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();       \
166. } while (0)
167. #endif

35. /* In-region pool header. Lives at offset 0 of the local export region. All
36.  * fields are written via non-cacheable mappings: state transitions must be
37.  * paired with ucs_memory_bus_store_fence so peers (potentially on another
38.  * host) see the geometry before the READY transition. During cleanup, INITING
39.  * is only a transient coordination state; once reset completes, the shared
40.  * region is fully zero again. */
41. typedef struct uct_obmm_pool_hdr {
42.     uint64_t magic;             /* UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC */
43.     uint32_t state;             /* UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_xx, atomic */
44.     uint32_t slot_count;
45.     uint32_t slot_size;
46.     uint64_t slot_array_offset; /* offset (from region base) of slot 0 */
47.     uint32_t bitmap_words;      /* number of u64 words in alloc bitmap */
48.     uint32_t initializer_pid;   /* pid that owned the INITING transition */
49.     uint64_t initializer_starttime;
50.     /* followed by:
51.      *   uint64_t alloc_bitmap[bitmap_words];
52.      *   uct_obmm_slot_meta_t slot_meta[slot_count];
53.      */
54. } uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t;
55. 
56. 
57. /* Per-slot ownership metadata. Stored adjacent to the bitmap, separate from
58.  * the slot's actual FIFO contents. */
59. typedef struct uct_obmm_slot_meta {
60.     uint32_t state;            /* UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_xx */
61.     uint32_t generation;       /* monotonically increasing; bumped on free,
62.                                   scavenge, and when readers must discard
63.                                   in-flight stale elements */
64.     uint32_t owner_pid;
65.     uint32_t reserved;
66.     uint64_t owner_starttime;  /* /proc/<pid>/stat field 22, for liveness */
67. } uct_obmm_slot_meta_t;
68. 
69. 
70. /* Convenience accessor populated by uct_obmm_pool_attach. Pointers point
71.  * into the mapped region; nothing is owned by this struct. */
72. typedef struct uct_obmm_pool {
73.     void                  *base;     /* region base (pool hdr) */
74.     size_t                 length;   /* mapped region size */
75.     uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t   *hdr;
76.     volatile uint64_t     *bitmap;
77.     uct_obmm_slot_meta_t  *meta;
78.     void                  *slots;    /* base + hdr->slot_array_offset */
79.     uint32_t               slot_count;
80.     uint32_t               slot_size;
81. } uct_obmm_pool_t;
82. 
83. 
84. /* Compute the minimum region size required to hold a pool with the given
85.  * geometry. */
86. size_t uct_obmm_pool_required_size(uint32_t slot_count, uint32_t slot_size);
87. 
88. 
89. /* Initialize the pool inside `region_base` if not already initialized, or
90.  * attach to an existing valid pool. Cross-process safe: races between
91.  * multiple processes attaching to the same region are resolved via the
92.  * hdr->state CAS. On success, `pool` is populated with cached pointers.
93.  *
94.  * If an existing pool's geometry doesn't match the requested
95.  * (slot_count, slot_size), returns UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM.
96.  */
97. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_attach(void *region_base, size_t region_size,
98.                                   uint32_t slot_count, uint32_t slot_size,
99.                                   uct_obmm_pool_t *pool);
100. 
101. 
102. /* Allocate a free slot. Scavenges slots owned by dead processes. Returns the
103.  * slot index (0..slot_count-1), a pointer to the slot bytes (length
104.  * slot_size), and the generation token the caller must stamp into outgoing
105.  * iface_addr. Slot bytes are zeroed before return.
106.  *
107.  * Returns UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE if no slot can be obtained (all slots in use
108.  * by live processes).
109.  */
110. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_alloc_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool,
111.                                       uint32_t *slot_index_p,
112.                                       void **slot_ptr_p,
113.                                       uint32_t *generation_p);
114. 
115. 
116. /* Release a slot the caller owns. Bumps generation so any stale in-flight
117.  * elements written by remote senders are dropped on the next receiver's
118.  * dispatch. Marks slot as FREE in the bitmap. Returns non-zero only if this
119.  * caller released the final local slot and acquired exclusive permission to
120.  * reset the whole export region to zero before another attach re-initializes
121.  * it. */
122. int uct_obmm_pool_free_slot(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t slot_index);
123. 
124. 
125. /* Reset the whole local export pool region to zero. The caller must already
126.  * hold exclusive cleanup ownership from uct_obmm_pool_free_slot(); this helper
127.  * keeps the shared state in INITING until the rest of the region is zero so a
128.  * new attach cannot race against a partially cleared pool. The final published
129.  * shared image is literal all-zero memory. */
130. void uct_obmm_pool_reset(uct_obmm_pool_t *pool);
131. 
132. 
133. /* Compute pointer to a slot by index. Does not validate ownership. */
134. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void*
135. uct_obmm_pool_slot_ptr(const uct_obmm_pool_t *pool, uint32_t slot_index)
136. {
137.     return (char*)pool->slots + (size_t)slot_index * pool->slot_size;
138. }
139. 
140. 
141. /* Read-only attach: validates that an existing READY pool lives at
142.  * `region_base`, and populates `pool` with cached pointers. Does NOT
143.  * attempt initialization. Used by ep_create to access a peer's pool
144.  * without owning it. Returns UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE if the pool is not
145.  * READY (e.g. peer iface was destroyed between address exchange and ep
146.  * create). */
147. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_open(void *region_base, size_t region_size,
148.                                 uct_obmm_pool_t *pool);
149.

310. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE unsigned
311. uct_obmm_iface_progress_lane(uct_obmm_iface_t *iface, uct_obmm_rx_lane_t *lane)
312. {
313.     uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem;
314.     uint32_t                 head;
315. 
316.     if (!lane->active) {
317.         return 0;
318.     }
319. 
320.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
321.     if (lane->ctl->sender_generation != lane->sender_generation) {
322.         return 0;
323.     }
324. 
325.     head = lane->ctl->head;
326.     if (head == lane->rx_index) {
327.         return 0;
328.     }
329. 
330.     elem = uct_obmm_lane_elem(lane->elems, lane->rx_index, iface->fifo_mask,
331.                               iface->fifo_elem_size);
332.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
333. 
334.     if (elem->generation == iface->generation) {
335.         if (elem->flags & UCT_OBMM_MAILBOX_ELEM_FLAG_BCOPY) {
336.             void *desc = uct_obmm_lane_desc(lane->descs, lane->rx_index,
337.                                             iface->fifo_mask,
338.                                             iface->bcopy_seg_size);
339.             uct_iface_invoke_am(&iface->super, elem->am_id,
340.                                 desc, elem->length, 0);
341.         } else {
342.             uct_iface_invoke_am(&iface->super, elem->am_id,
343.                                 &elem->header, elem->length, 0);
344.         }
345.     }
346. 
347.     lane->rx_index++;
348.     uct_obmm_bus_full_fence();
349.     if (lane->ctl->sender_generation != lane->sender_generation) {
350.         return 1;
351.     }
352.     lane->ctl->tail = lane->rx_index;
353.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
354.     if (lane->ctl->sender_generation != lane->sender_generation) {
355.         return 1;
356.     }
357.     lane->ctl->tail_generation = lane->sender_generation;
358.     return 1;
359. }

362. static unsigned uct_obmm_iface_progress(uct_iface_h tl_iface)
363. {
364.     uct_obmm_iface_t *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_iface, uct_obmm_iface_t);
365.     unsigned          polled = 0;
366.     unsigned          total_lanes = UCT_OBMM_MAILBOX_BANK_COUNT *
367.                                     UCT_OBMM_POOL_SLOT_COUNT;
368.     unsigned          scanned;
369. 
370.     for (scanned = 0; (scanned < total_lanes) && (polled < iface->fifo_max_poll);
371.          ++scanned) {
372.         unsigned           idx  = (iface->rx_lane_rr + scanned) % total_lanes;
373.         unsigned           bank = idx / UCT_OBMM_POOL_SLOT_COUNT;
374.         unsigned           slot = idx % UCT_OBMM_POOL_SLOT_COUNT;
375. 
376.         polled += uct_obmm_iface_progress_lane(iface,
377.                                                &iface->rx_lanes[bank][slot]);
378.     }
379. 
380.     iface->rx_lane_rr = (iface->rx_lane_rr + 1) % total_lanes;
381. 
382.     if (polled < iface->fifo_max_poll) {
383.         polled += uct_obmm_iface_progress_unregistered_lanes(iface,
384.                                                              iface->fifo_max_poll - polled);
385.     }
386. 
387.     ucs_arbiter_dispatch(&iface->arbiter, 1, uct_obmm_ep_process_pending,
388.                          &polled);
389. 
390.     return polled;
391. }

69. /* AIMD (additive increase/multiplicative decrease) algorithm adopted for FIFO
70.  * polling mechanism to adjust FIFO polling window.
71.  * - FIFO window is increased if the number of completed RX operations during
72.  *   the current iface progress call reaches FIFO window size and previous iface
73.  *   progress call was able to fully consume FIFO window (protection against
74.  *   impacting ping-pong pattern where handling of > 1 RX operation should not
75.  *   be expected).
76.  * - FIFO window is decreased if the number of completed RX operations during
77.  *   the current iface progress call does not reach FIFO window size.
78.  * See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Additive_increase/multiplicative_decrease
79.  * for more information about original AIMD algorithm used for congestion
80.  * avoidance. */

93. static ucs_status_t uct_mm_iface_get_address(uct_iface_t *tl_iface,
94.                                              uct_iface_addr_t *addr)
95. {
96.     uct_mm_iface_t      *iface      = ucs_derived_of(tl_iface, uct_mm_iface_t);
97.     uct_mm_md_t         *md         = ucs_derived_of(iface->super.super.md,
98.                                                      uct_mm_md_t);
99.     uct_mm_iface_addr_t *iface_addr = (void*)addr;
100.     uct_mm_seg_t        *seg        = iface->recv_fifo_mem.memh;
101. 
102.     iface_addr->fifo_seg_id = seg->seg_id;
103.     return uct_mm_md_mapper_ops(md)->iface_addr_pack(md, iface_addr + 1);
104. }

107. uct_mm_iface_query_tl_devices(uct_md_h md,
108.                               uct_tl_device_resource_t **tl_devices_p,
109.                               unsigned *num_tl_devices_p)
110. {
111.     uct_md_attr_t md_attr;

113. 
114.     status = uct_md_query(md, &md_attr);
115.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
116.         return status;
117.     }
118. 
119.     if (!(md_attr.cap.flags & (UCT_MD_FLAG_ALLOC | UCT_MD_FLAG_REG))) {
120.         *num_tl_devices_p = 0;
121.         *tl_devices_p     = NULL;
122.         return UCS_ERR_NO_DEVICE;

125.     return uct_sm_base_query_tl_devices(md, tl_devices_p, num_tl_devices_p);
126. }

304.     if (ucs_likely(elem->flags & UCT_MM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_INLINE)) {
305.         /* read short (inline) messages from the FIFO elements */
306.         uct_mm_iface_trace_am(iface, UCT_AM_TRACE_TYPE_RECV, elem->flags,
307.                               elem->am_id, elem + 1, elem->length,
308.                               iface->read_index);
309.         uct_mm_iface_invoke_am(iface, elem->am_id, elem + 1, elem->length, 0);
310.         return;
311.     }
312. 
313.     /* check the memory pool to make sure that there is a new descriptor available */
314.     if (ucs_unlikely(iface->last_recv_desc == NULL)) {
315.         UCT_TL_IFACE_GET_RX_DESC(&iface->super.super, &iface->recv_desc_mp,
316.                                  iface->last_recv_desc, return);
317.     }
318. 
319.     /* read bcopy messages from the receive descriptors */
320.     data = elem->desc_data;
321.     VALGRIND_MAKE_MEM_DEFINED(data, elem->length);
322.     uct_mm_iface_trace_am(iface, UCT_AM_TRACE_TYPE_RECV, elem->flags,
323.                           elem->am_id, data, elem->length, iface->read_index);
324. 
325.     status = uct_mm_iface_invoke_am(iface, elem->am_id, data, elem->length,
326.                                     UCT_CB_PARAM_FLAG_DESC);
327.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
328.         /* assign a new receive descriptor to this FIFO element.*/
329.         uct_mm_assign_desc_to_fifo_elem(iface, elem, 0);
330.         /* the last_recv_desc is in use. get a new descriptor for it */
331.         UCT_TL_IFACE_GET_RX_DESC(&iface->super.super, &iface->recv_desc_mp,
332.                                  iface->last_recv_desc, ucs_debug("recv mpool is empty"));
333.     }
334. }
335. 
336. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE int
337. uct_mm_iface_fifo_has_new_data(uct_mm_iface_t *iface)
338. {
339.     /* check the read_index to see if there is a new item to read
340.      * (checking the owner bit) */
341.     return (((iface->read_index >> iface->fifo_shift) & 1) ==
342.             (iface->read_index_elem->flags & 1));
343. }
344. 
345. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE unsigned
346. uct_mm_iface_poll_fifo(uct_mm_iface_t *iface)
347. {
348.     if (!uct_mm_iface_fifo_has_new_data(iface)) {
349.         return 0;
350.     }
351. 
352.     /* read from read_index_elem */
353.     ucs_memory_cpu_load_fence();
354.     ucs_assert(iface->read_index <=
355.                (iface->recv_fifo_ctl->head & ~UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_HEAD_EVENT_ARMED));
356. 
357.     uct_mm_iface_process_recv(iface);
358. 
359.     /* raise the read_index */
360.     iface->read_index++;
361. 
362.     /* the next fifo_element which the read_index points to */
363.     iface->read_index_elem =
364.         UCT_MM_IFACE_GET_FIFO_ELEM(iface, iface->recv_fifo_elems,
365.                                    (iface->read_index & iface->fifo_mask));
366. 
367.     uct_mm_progress_fifo_tail(iface);
368. 
369.     return 1;
370. }
371.

258. ## Wire-format compat
259. 
260. `uct_obmm_iface_addr_t` carries `(slot_index, generation, pid,
261. fifo_size, fifo_elem_size, bcopy_seg_size)`. Two ifaces are mutually
262. reachable iff all three geometry fields match — guarded in
263. `is_reachable_v2`. Pool compatibility is enforced by the shared pool geometry
264. checks in `pool_attach`/`pool_open`; the shared region does not persist a
265. separate pool version word or filler replacement field.
266. 
267. ---
268. 
269. ## Configuration knobs
270. 
271. All under `UCX_OBMM_*` prefix.
272. 
273. | knob                      | default | meaning                          |
274. |---------------------------|---------|----------------------------------|
275. | BW                        | 3400MBs | effective transport bandwidth reported to UCP for lane/protocol cost modeling; optional |
276. | FIFO_SIZE                 |     1   | mailbox depth per sender->receiver lane (power of 2) |
277. | FIFO_ELEM_SIZE            | 16448   | bytes per FIFO elem (incl. 16B hdr) → raw UCT max_short = 16432 total bytes |
278. | BCOPY_SEG_SIZE   (v2 NEW) | 32768   | bytes per paired desc → raw UCT max_bcopy |
279. | FIFO_MAX_POLL             |    16   | RX completions per progress()     |
280. | MEMIDS        (optional)  |   ""    | comma-separated explicit shmdev memids (for example `1,2`); when set, obmm queries only these memids instead of scanning all shmdevs. Regardless of whether this knob is set, discovery is fail-fast: any discovered/requested shmdev that is missing, unusable, or yields an invalid export/import topology fails md_open |
281. 
282. `BW` is a UCP-facing estimate, not a wire-format limit. UCP folds it into lane
283. selection and protocol cost modeling, so it should track sustained transport
284. throughput rather than a one-off peak number. Leaving `UCX_OBMM_BW` unset is
285. valid; obmm then uses the built-in default above.
286. 
287. Validation at iface init:
288. - `FIFO_SIZE` > 0, power of 2
289. - `FIFO_ELEM_SIZE` > sizeof(elem_hdr) and `(elem_size - hdr) <= UINT16_MAX`
290. - `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE` > 0 and `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE <= UINT16_MAX`
291. - `slot_count * slot_stride + pool_overhead <= region->length`
292. 
293. ---
294. 
295. ## Future scope (not in v2)
296. 
297. - `am_zcopy`: requires UCT MD memory-handle plumbing (`mem_reg`,
298.   `mkey_pack`, `mem_attach`). Currently obmm has no MD-level
299.   registration — every peer access is via the pre-existing 128 MiB
300.   region. Out of scope until libobmm-aware md is added.
301. - `put_bcopy / get_bcopy`: blocked by the same MD plumbing; UCP RMA
302.   cannot be served by the FIFO-only data path.
303. - Multi-region per node, NUMA-aware slot placement.
304. - Variable-size desc allocator (mm-style mpool) to cover medium-size
305.   messages without burning seg_size per FIFO depth.
306. 
307. ---
308. 
309. ## Receive-side fence ordering (full bus fence at tail release)
310. 
311. `ucs_memory_bus_store_fence()` on aarch64 is `dmb oshst` — store→store
312. only. It does NOT order prior loads against subsequent stores. The
313. receiver's lifetime invariant requires:
314. 
315. ```
316. loads from desc[N]  HAPPENS-BEFORE  store to lane_ctl->tail = N+1
317. ```
318. 
319. Otherwise a sender that observes the new tail can reuse `desc[N]` while the
320. receiver core still has outstanding loads in flight from the old lap's
321. payload. We therefore use `uct_obmm_bus_full_fence()` before the tail store,
322. not only a store-store fence.
323. 
324. Why a local helper rather than adding `ucs_memory_bus_fence()` for all
325. archs in `ucs/arch/`: AGENTS.md restricts changes to
326. `ucx/src/uct/obmm/`. If/when the helper proves useful elsewhere, it can
327. be promoted to ucs/arch — but that is a separate ask.
328. 
329. ## Receive-buffer semantics for AM handler
330. 
331. `invoke_am(..., desc, length, 0)` — the trailing `0` (no
332. `UCT_CB_PARAM_FLAG_DESC`) means the data pointer is valid **only for the
333. duration of the callback**. The handler MUST NOT retain it; UCP knows
334. this contract and copies into its own buffer when persistence is
335. needed.
336. 
337. This is by design: the desc lifetime is bound 1:1 to the FIFO element
338. slot, so as soon as the receiver advances `tail` past N, the sender is
339. free to overwrite `desc[N]` on the next lap. There is no separate desc
340. allocator to support post-callback retention.
341. 
342. If a future need arises to support `UCT_CB_PARAM_FLAG_DESC`-style
343. returnable descriptors (e.g. for AM zcopy or large-message rendezvous
344. without copy), it requires a real per-iface mpool of receive
345. descriptors that the upper layer can hold and release explicitly —
346. mirroring `uct_mm_recv_desc_t`. Out of scope for v2.
347. 
348. ## Verification (no hardware)
349. 
350. Per `.github/skills/ucx-build-verify/SKILL.md`:
351. 
352. 1. Build via `task` agent: `./autogen.sh && ./contrib/configure-devel
353.    && make -j && make install`.
354. 2. `ucx_info -d -t obmm` → confirm `am_short` and `am_bcopy` lines:
355.    `max_short` should report 16432 raw bytes and `max_bcopy` should reflect
356.    raw `seg_size` (default 32768).
357. 3. `ucx_info -c | grep OBMM` → confirm `FIFO_SIZE=1` default and
358.    `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE` entry.
359. 4. `nm -D libuct.so | grep uct_obmm_ep_am_bcopy` → exists.
360. 5. Hardware-required checks (cross-node MPI, sweep sizes through
````

39. {
40.     (void)md;
41.     uct_md_base_md_query(attr);
42.     /* obmm only does AM (short + bcopy). It does NOT expose remote memory
43.      * as a directly-dereferenceable pointer to its own peers: only the
44.      * pre-exported FIFO region is mmap'd, NOT the user's send/recv
45.      * buffers. So we MUST NOT advertise UCT_MD_FLAG_NEED_RKEY (which
46.      * implies remote-key-based access) -- doing so makes UCP pick
47.      * rendezvous-via-rkey_ptr for messages above the rndv threshold
48.      * (~256 KiB) and try to memcpy from a peer-VA pointer, segfaulting
49.      * inside ucs_memcpy_relaxed. */

58. static ucs_status_t
59. uct_obmm_md_parse_memids(const char *memids_str, uint64_t **memids_p,
60.                          unsigned *num_memids_p)
61. {
62.     uint64_t     *memids      = NULL;
63.     char         *cursor;
64.     char         *next;
65.     char         *copy        = NULL;
66.     char         *end;
67.     ucs_status_t  status      = UCS_OK;
68.     unsigned      count       = 0;
69.     unsigned      capacity    = 1;
70.     unsigned      i;
71.     uint64_t      memid;
72. 
73.     *memids_p     = NULL;
74.     *num_memids_p = 0;
75. 
76.     if (memids_str == NULL) {
77.         return UCS_OK;
78.     }
79. 
80.     copy = ucs_strdup(memids_str, "obmm_memids");
81.     if (copy == NULL) {
82.         return UCS_ERR_NO_MEMORY;
83.     }
84. 
85.     ucs_strtrim(copy);
86.     if (copy[0] == '\0') {
87.         goto out;
88.     }
89. 
90.     for (cursor = copy; *cursor != '\0'; ++cursor) {
91.         if (*cursor == ',') {
92.             ++capacity;
93.         }
94.     }
95. 
96.     memids = ucs_calloc(capacity, sizeof(*memids), "obmm_memid_list");
97.     if (memids == NULL) {
98.         status = UCS_ERR_NO_MEMORY;
99.         goto err;
100.     }
101. 
102.     cursor = copy;
103.     while (cursor != NULL) {
104.         errno = 0;
105.         next  = strchr(cursor, ',');
106.         if (next != NULL) {
107.             *next = '\0';
108.             ++next;
109.         }
110. 
111.         ucs_strtrim(cursor);
112.         if (cursor[0] == '\0') {
113.             ucs_error("obmm: OBMM_MEMIDS contains an empty entry: '%s'",
114.                       memids_str);
115.             status = UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
116.             goto err;
117.         }
118. 
119.         memid = strtoull(cursor, &end, 10);
120.         if ((errno == ERANGE) || (*end != '\0')) {
121.             ucs_error("obmm: invalid OBMM_MEMIDS entry '%s' in '%s'; "
122.                       "expected decimal memid list like '1,2'",
123.                       cursor, memids_str);
124.             status = UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
125.             goto err;
126.         }
127. 
128.         if (memid == 0) {
129.             ucs_error("obmm: OBMM_MEMIDS cannot contain memid 0");
130.             status = UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
131.             goto err;
132.         }
133. 
134.         for (i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
135.             if (memids[i] == memid) {
136.                 ucs_error("obmm: duplicate memid %" PRIu64
137.                           " in OBMM_MEMIDS='%s'",
138.                           memid, memids_str);
139.                 status = UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
140.                 goto err;
141.             }
142.         }
143. 
144.         memids[count++] = memid;
145.         cursor          = next;
146.     }
147. 
148. out:
149.     ucs_free(copy);
150.     *memids_p     = memids;
151.     *num_memids_p = count;
152.     return UCS_OK;
153. 
154. err:
155.     ucs_free(memids);
156.     ucs_free(copy);
157.     return status;
158. }

217.                       regions[mapped].info.memid);
218.             uct_obmm_region_close(&regions[mapped]);
219.             status = UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
220.             goto err_unmap;
221.         }
222. 
223.         ++mapped;
224.     }
225. 
226.     if (mapped == 0) {
227.         ucs_free(regions);
228.         return UCS_ERR_NO_DEVICE;
229.     }
230. 
231.     if (export_idx < 0) {
232.         ucs_debug("obmm: no local export region found for obmm transport");
233.         status = UCS_ERR_NO_DEVICE;
234.         goto err_unmap;
235.     }
236. 
237.     md->regions     = regions;
238.     md->num_regions = mapped;
239.     md->export_idx  = export_idx;
240.     return UCS_OK;
241. 
242. err_unmap:
243.     for (j = 0; j < mapped; ++j) {
244.         uct_obmm_region_close(&regions[j]);
245.     }
246.     ucs_free(regions);
247.     return status;
248. }

312.     elem->generation = ep->expected_generation;
313.     elem->header     = header;
314.     if (length > 0) {
315.         memcpy(elem + 1, payload, length);
316.     }
317. 
318.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
319.     ep->tx_index      = index + 1;
320.     ep->tx_ctl->head  = ep->tx_index;
321. 
322.     UCT_TL_EP_STAT_OP(&ep->super, AM, SHORT, payload_total);
323.     uct_iface_trace_am(&iface->super, UCT_AM_TRACE_TYPE_SEND, id,
324.                        &elem->header, payload_total, "TX: AM_SHORT");
325.     return UCS_OK;
326. }
327. 
328. 
329. ssize_t uct_obmm_ep_am_bcopy(uct_ep_h tl_ep, uint8_t id,
330.                              uct_pack_callback_t pack_cb, void *arg,
331.                              unsigned flags)
332. {
333.     uct_obmm_ep_t           *ep    = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep, uct_obmm_ep_t);
334.     uct_obmm_iface_t        *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep->iface,
335.                                                     uct_obmm_iface_t);
336.     uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem;
337.     void                    *desc;
338.     uint32_t                 index;
339.     size_t                   length;
340.     ucs_status_t             status;
341. 
342.     (void)flags;
343.     UCT_CHECK_AM_ID(id);
344. 
345.     status = uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot(ep, &index);
346.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
347.         return status;
348.     }
349. 
350.     elem = uct_obmm_lane_elem(ep->tx_elems, index, ep->fifo_mask,
351.                               ep->fifo_elem_size);
352.     desc = uct_obmm_lane_desc(ep->tx_descs, index, ep->fifo_mask,
353.                               ep->bcopy_seg_size);
354. 
355.     length = pack_cb(desc, arg);
356.     ucs_assertv(length <= ep->bcopy_seg_size,
357.                 "obmm: pack_cb returned %zu > bcopy_seg_size=%u",
358.                 length, ep->bcopy_seg_size);
359.     ucs_assertv(length <= UINT16_MAX,
360.                 "obmm: pack_cb returned %zu > UINT16_MAX", length);
361. 
362.     elem->am_id      = id;
363.     elem->length     = (uint16_t)length;
364.     elem->generation = ep->expected_generation;
365.     elem->header     = 0;
366.     elem->flags      = UCT_OBMM_MAILBOX_ELEM_FLAG_BCOPY;
367. 
368.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
369.     ep->tx_index     = index + 1;
370.     ep->tx_ctl->head = ep->tx_index;
371. 
372.     UCT_TL_EP_STAT_OP(&ep->super, AM, BCOPY, length);
373.     uct_iface_trace_am(&iface->super, UCT_AM_TRACE_TYPE_SEND, id,
374.                        desc, length, "TX: AM_BCOPY");
375.     return (ssize_t)length;
376. }
377.

379. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_ep_pending_add(uct_ep_h tl_ep, uct_pending_req_t *n,
380.                                      unsigned flags)
381. {
382.     uct_obmm_ep_t    *ep    = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep, uct_obmm_ep_t);
383.     uct_obmm_iface_t *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep->iface, uct_obmm_iface_t);
384. 
385.     (void)flags;
386. 
387.     UCS_STATIC_ASSERT(sizeof(uct_pending_req_priv_arb_t) <=
388.                       UCT_PENDING_REQ_PRIV_LEN);
389.     uct_pending_req_arb_group_push(&ep->arb_group, n);
390.     ucs_arbiter_group_schedule(&iface->arbiter, &ep->arb_group);
391.     UCT_TL_EP_STAT_PEND(&ep->super);
392.     return UCS_OK;
393. }
394. 
395. 
396. ucs_arbiter_cb_result_t
397. uct_obmm_ep_process_pending(ucs_arbiter_t *arbiter, ucs_arbiter_group_t *group,
398.                             ucs_arbiter_elem_t *elem, void *arg)
399. {
400.     uct_obmm_ep_t     *ep    = ucs_container_of(group, uct_obmm_ep_t, arb_group);
401.     unsigned          *count = (unsigned*)arg;
402.     uct_pending_req_t *req;
403.     ucs_status_t       status;
404. 
405.     if (!uct_obmm_ep_has_tx_resource(ep)) {
406.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_RESCHED_GROUP;
407.     }
408. 
409.     req    = ucs_container_of(elem, uct_pending_req_t, priv);
410.     status = req->func(req);
411. 
412.     if (status == UCS_OK) {
413.         ++(*count);
414.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_REMOVE_ELEM;
415.     } else if (status == UCS_INPROGRESS) {
416.         ++(*count);
417.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_NEXT_GROUP;
418.     }
419. 
420.     return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_RESCHED_GROUP;
421. }
422.

425.     uct_pending_purge_callback_t cb;
426.     void                        *arg;
427. } uct_obmm_purge_args_t;
428. 
429. 
430. static ucs_arbiter_cb_result_t
431. uct_obmm_ep_arbiter_purge_cb(ucs_arbiter_t *arbiter, ucs_arbiter_group_t *group,
432.                              ucs_arbiter_elem_t *elem, void *arg)
433. {
434.     uct_obmm_ep_t         *ep   = ucs_container_of(group, uct_obmm_ep_t,
435.                                                    arb_group);
436.     uct_obmm_purge_args_t *args = arg;
437.     uct_pending_req_t     *req;
438. 
439.     req = ucs_container_of(elem, uct_pending_req_t, priv);
440.     if (args->cb != NULL) {
441.         args->cb(req, args->arg);
442.     } else {
443.         ucs_warn("obmm: ep=%p canceling pending request %p", ep, req);
444.     }
445.     return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_REMOVE_ELEM;
446. }
447. 
448. 
449. void uct_obmm_ep_pending_purge(uct_ep_h tl_ep,
450.                                uct_pending_purge_callback_t cb, void *arg)
451. {

453.     uct_obmm_iface_t      *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep->iface,
454.                                                   uct_obmm_iface_t);
455.     uct_obmm_purge_args_t  args  = {cb, arg};
456. 
457.     ucs_arbiter_group_purge(&iface->arbiter, &ep->arb_group,
458.                             uct_obmm_ep_arbiter_purge_cb, &args);
459. }

39. uct_mm_ep_attach_remote_seg(uct_mm_ep_t *ep, uct_mm_seg_id_t seg_id,
40.                             size_t length, void **address_p)
41. {
42.     uct_mm_iface_t *iface = ucs_derived_of(ep->super.super.iface,

51.         ucs_error("failed to add remote segment to mm ep hash");

54. 
55.     /* we expect the key would either be
56.      * never used (BUCKET_EMPTY) or deleted (BUCKET_CLEAR) */

65.         kh_del(uct_mm_remote_seg, &ep->remote_segs, khiter);

107. /* send a signal to remote interface using Unix-domain socket */
108. static void uct_mm_ep_signal_remote(uct_mm_ep_t *ep)
109. {
110.     uct_mm_iface_t *iface = ucs_derived_of(ep->super.super.iface, uct_mm_iface_t);
111.     char dummy = 0;
112.     int ret;
113. 
114.     ucs_trace("ep %p: signal remote", ep);
115. 
116.     for (;;) {
117.         ret = sendto(iface->signal_fd, &dummy, sizeof(dummy), 0,
118.                      (const struct sockaddr*)&ep->fifo_ctl->signal_sockaddr,
119.                      ep->fifo_ctl->signal_addrlen);
120.         if (ucs_unlikely(ret < 0)) {
121.             if (errno == EINTR) {
122.                 /* Interrupted system call - retry */
123.                 continue;
124.             }
125.             if ((errno == EAGAIN) || (errno == ECONNREFUSED)) {
126.                 /* If we failed to signal because buffer is full - ignore the error
127.                  * since it means the remote side would get a signal anyway.
128.                  * If the remote side is not there - ignore the error as well.
129.                  */
130.                 ucs_trace("failed to send wakeup signal: %m");
131.                 return;
132.             } else {
133.                 ucs_warn("failed to send wakeup signal: %m");
134.                 return;
135.             }
136.         } else {
137.             ucs_assert(ret == sizeof(dummy));
138.             ucs_trace("sent wakeup from socket %d to %s", iface->signal_fd,
139.                       ep->fifo_ctl->signal_sockaddr.sun_path);
140.             return;
141.         }
142.     }
143. }

### 💬 Copilot

**(a) Sound**

- Budget is plausible: `2 banks × 8 shards × depth 4 = 64 elem/desc pairs`, same pair count as today’s `2 × 32 × depth 1`, so 128 MiB still works if shard ctl stays cacheline-scale (`obmm_fifo.h:68-90`, `DESIGN.md:83-123`).
- Polling only the **local receiver slot** is a real simplification and preserves one-way traffic progress without today’s unregistered-lane scan (`obmm_iface.c:38-116,362-389`).
- Keeping `AM_SHORT|AM_BCOPY|PENDING|CONNECT_TO_IFACE|CB_SYNC|INTER_NODE` is correct **if** ops/query stay matched (`obmm_iface.c:181-214,569-610`, `mm_iface.c:504-536`).

**(b) Highest-risk gaps**

1. **Head-only MPSC is underspecified.** mm’s bounded FIFO uses **head CAS + shared tail** (`mm_ep.c:34-35,229-249,294-305`, `mm_iface.c:264-277`). With only head+owner/parity, I don’t see a hole-free/full-safe `UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE` path.
2. **Producer crash after reserve can wedge a shard.** Current recovery only reclaims dead **slot owners**, not dead producers inside a shared receiver shard (`obmm_pool.h:57-67,102-130`).
3. **Generation only on elements is insufficient.** It protects dispatch, but stale senders can still reserve capacity in a reinitialized receiver slot unless shard control exposes/validates current receiver generation before reserve.
4. **Wire compatibility needs an explicit layout ABI/version**, not just `shard_count`; current design explicitly has no pool version word (`DESIGN.md:258-265`).
5. **Fence rules must be explicit**: bus-store before publish bit, bus-load after publish-bit observe, full-bus before tail release; do not treat LSE acquire/release as a substitute (`DESIGN.md:309-323`, `mm_iface.c:336-369`).

**(c) Strong recommendation**

Use **receiver-local banks+shards**, but keep **mm-style `head + tail` per shard**, plus `receiver_generation`. Reserve with explicit arm64 LSE CAS on `head`, publish with owner/parity, receiver advances `tail` after full bus fence. It still fits budget and gives clear pending/full semantics.

**(d) Implementation sequence**

1. `obmm_fifo.h`: new shard ctl/layout, explicit layout/version constants, LSE CAS helper, fence invariants.
2. `obmm_iface.h/c`: replace `rx_lanes` with local shard-consumer state; rework init/progress/get_address/is_reachable; keep progress enable/disable wiring intact.
3. `obmm_ep.h/c`: bind TX to peer receiver slot bank+shard; add cached-tail + generation validation; remove RX-lane registration.
4. `DESIGN.md`: update layout, compat/versioning, stale-generation behavior, and abandoned-reservation policy.

36. 
37. static unsigned
38. uct_obmm_iface_progress_unregistered_lanes(uct_obmm_iface_t *iface,
39.                                            unsigned max_poll)
40. {
41.     uct_obmm_md_t         *md = ucs_derived_of(iface->super.md, uct_obmm_md_t);
42.     uct_obmm_pool_t        pool;
43.     uct_obmm_region_t     *region;
44.     uct_obmm_rx_lane_t     lane;
45.     uct_obmm_mailbox_ctl_t *ctl;
46.     ucs_status_t           status;
47.     void                  *slot_base;
48.     void                  *lane_base;
49.     unsigned               i;
50.     unsigned               slot;
51.     unsigned               bank;
52.     unsigned               completions = 0;
53.     uint32_t               head;
54.     uint32_t               tail;
55. 
56.     for (i = 0; i < md->num_regions; ++i) {
57.         region = &md->regions[i];
58.         bank   = (i == (unsigned)md->export_idx) ? UCT_OBMM_MAILBOX_BANK_LOCAL :
59.                                                    UCT_OBMM_MAILBOX_BANK_REMOTE;
60. 
61.         status = uct_obmm_pool_open(region->base, region->length, &pool);
62.         if (status != UCS_OK) {
63.             continue;
64.         }
65. 
66.         for (slot = 0; (slot < pool.slot_count) &&
67.                        (slot < UCT_OBMM_POOL_SLOT_COUNT); ++slot) {
68.             if ((bank == UCT_OBMM_MAILBOX_BANK_LOCAL) &&
69.                 (slot == iface->slot_index)) {
70.                 continue;
71.             }
72.             if (iface->rx_lanes[bank][slot].active) {
73.                 continue;
74.             }
75.             if (pool.meta[slot].state != UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_IN_USE) {
76.                 continue;
77.             }
78. 
79.             slot_base = uct_obmm_pool_slot_ptr(&pool, slot);
80.             lane_base = uct_obmm_slot_lane(slot_base, bank, iface->slot_index,
81.                                            iface->fifo_size,
82.                                            iface->fifo_elem_size,
83.                                            iface->bcopy_seg_size);
84.             ctl = uct_obmm_lane_ctl(lane_base);
85. 
86.             ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
87.             if (ctl->sender_generation != pool.meta[slot].generation) {
88.                 continue;
89.             }
90. 
91.             head = ctl->head;
92.             tail = ctl->tail;
93.             if (head == tail) {
94.                 continue;
95.             }
96. 
97.             memset(&lane, 0, sizeof(lane));
98.             lane.ctl               = ctl;
99.             lane.elems             = uct_obmm_lane_elems(lane_base);
100.             lane.descs             = uct_obmm_lane_descs(lane_base,
101.                                                          iface->fifo_size,
102.                                                          iface->fifo_elem_size);
103.             lane.sender_generation = pool.meta[slot].generation;
104.             lane.rx_index          = (ctl->tail_generation == lane.sender_generation) ?
105.                                      tail : 0;
106.             lane.active            = 1;
107. 
108.             completions += uct_obmm_iface_progress_lane(iface, &lane);
109.             if (completions >= max_poll) {
110.                 return completions;
111.             }
112.         }
113.     }
114. 
115.     return completions;
116. }

288. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_ep_am_short(uct_ep_h tl_ep, uint8_t id, uint64_t header,
289.                                   const void *payload, unsigned length)
290. {
291.     uct_obmm_ep_t           *ep    = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep, uct_obmm_ep_t);
292.     uct_obmm_iface_t        *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep->iface,
293.                                                     uct_obmm_iface_t);
294.     size_t                   payload_total = sizeof(header) + length;
295.     uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem;
296.     uint32_t                 index;
297. 
298.     UCT_CHECK_AM_ID(id);
299.     UCT_CHECK_LENGTH(payload_total, 0,
300.                      ep->fifo_elem_size - sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_element_t),
301.                      "am_short");
302. 
303.     if (uct_obmm_ep_reserve_slot(ep, &index) != UCS_OK) {
304.         return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE;
305.     }
306. 
307.     elem = uct_obmm_lane_elem(ep->tx_elems, index, ep->fifo_mask,
308.                               ep->fifo_elem_size);
309.     elem->flags      = 0;
310.     elem->am_id      = id;
311.     elem->length     = (uint16_t)payload_total;
312.     elem->generation = ep->expected_generation;
313.     elem->header     = header;
314.     if (length > 0) {
315.         memcpy(elem + 1, payload, length);
316.     }
317. 
318.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
319.     ep->tx_index      = index + 1;
320.     ep->tx_ctl->head  = ep->tx_index;
321. 
322.     UCT_TL_EP_STAT_OP(&ep->super, AM, SHORT, payload_total);
323.     uct_iface_trace_am(&iface->super, UCT_AM_TRACE_TYPE_SEND, id,
324.                        &elem->header, payload_total, "TX: AM_SHORT");
325.     return UCS_OK;
326. }

331.                              unsigned flags)
332. {
333.     uct_obmm_ep_t           *ep    = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep, uct_obmm_ep_t);
334.     uct_obmm_iface_t        *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep->iface,
335.                                                     uct_obmm_iface_t);
336.     uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem;

338.     uint32_t                 index;
339.     size_t                   length;
340.     ucs_status_t             status;
341. 
342.     (void)flags;
343.     UCT_CHECK_AM_ID(id);

353.                               ep->bcopy_seg_size);

355.     length = pack_cb(desc, arg);
356.     ucs_assertv(length <= ep->bcopy_seg_size,
357.                 "obmm: pack_cb returned %zu > bcopy_seg_size=%u",
358.                 length, ep->bcopy_seg_size);

365.     elem->header     = 0;
366.     elem->flags      = UCT_OBMM_MAILBOX_ELEM_FLAG_BCOPY;
367. 
368.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
369.     ep->tx_index     = index + 1;
370.     ep->tx_ctl->head = ep->tx_index;
371. 
372.     UCT_TL_EP_STAT_OP(&ep->super, AM, BCOPY, length);

374.                        desc, length, "TX: AM_BCOPY");

396. ucs_arbiter_cb_result_t
397. uct_obmm_ep_process_pending(ucs_arbiter_t *arbiter, ucs_arbiter_group_t *group,
398.                             ucs_arbiter_elem_t *elem, void *arg)
399. {
400.     uct_obmm_ep_t     *ep    = ucs_container_of(group, uct_obmm_ep_t, arb_group);
401.     unsigned          *count = (unsigned*)arg;
402.     uct_pending_req_t *req;
403.     ucs_status_t       status;
404. 
405.     if (!uct_obmm_ep_has_tx_resource(ep)) {
406.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_RESCHED_GROUP;
407.     }
408. 
409.     req    = ucs_container_of(elem, uct_pending_req_t, priv);
410.     status = req->func(req);
411. 
412.     if (status == UCS_OK) {
413.         ++(*count);
414.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_REMOVE_ELEM;
415.     } else if (status == UCS_INPROGRESS) {
416.         ++(*count);
417.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_NEXT_GROUP;
418.     }
419. 
420.     return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_RESCHED_GROUP;
421. }
422. 
423. 
424. typedef struct {
425.     uct_pending_purge_callback_t cb;
426.     void                        *arg;
427. } uct_obmm_purge_args_t;
428. 
429. 
430. static ucs_arbiter_cb_result_t
431. uct_obmm_ep_arbiter_purge_cb(ucs_arbiter_t *arbiter, ucs_arbiter_group_t *group,
432.                              ucs_arbiter_elem_t *elem, void *arg)
433. {
434.     uct_obmm_ep_t         *ep   = ucs_container_of(group, uct_obmm_ep_t,
435.                                                    arb_group);
436.     uct_obmm_purge_args_t *args = arg;
437.     uct_pending_req_t     *req;
438. 
439.     req = ucs_container_of(elem, uct_pending_req_t, priv);
440.     if (args->cb != NULL) {
441.         args->cb(req, args->arg);
442.     } else {
443.         ucs_warn("obmm: ep=%p canceling pending request %p", ep, req);
444.     }
445.     return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_REMOVE_ELEM;
446. }
447. 
448. 
449. void uct_obmm_ep_pending_purge(uct_ep_h tl_ep,
450.                                uct_pending_purge_callback_t cb, void *arg)
451. {
452.     uct_obmm_ep_t         *ep    = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep, uct_obmm_ep_t);
453.     uct_obmm_iface_t      *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep->iface,
454.                                                   uct_obmm_iface_t);
455.     uct_obmm_purge_args_t  args  = {cb, arg};
456. 
457.     ucs_arbiter_group_purge(&iface->arbiter, &ep->arb_group,
458.                             uct_obmm_ep_arbiter_purge_cb, &args);
459. }
