258. ## Wire-format compat
259. 
260. `uct_obmm_iface_addr_t` carries `(slot_index, generation, pid,
261. fifo_size, fifo_elem_size, bcopy_seg_size)`. Two ifaces are mutually
262. reachable iff all three geometry fields match — guarded in
263. `is_reachable_v2`. Pool compatibility is enforced by the shared pool geometry
264. checks in `pool_attach`/`pool_open`; the shared region does not persist a
265. separate pool version word or filler replacement field.
266. 
267. ---
268. 
269. ## Configuration knobs
270. 
271. All under `UCX_OBMM_*` prefix.
272. 
273. | knob                      | default | meaning                          |
274. |---------------------------|---------|----------------------------------|
275. | BW                        | 3400MBs | effective transport bandwidth reported to UCP for lane/protocol cost modeling; optional |
276. | FIFO_SIZE                 |     1   | mailbox depth per sender->receiver lane (power of 2) |
277. | FIFO_ELEM_SIZE            | 16448   | bytes per FIFO elem (incl. 16B hdr) → raw UCT max_short = 16432 total bytes |
278. | BCOPY_SEG_SIZE   (v2 NEW) | 32768   | bytes per paired desc → raw UCT max_bcopy |
279. | FIFO_MAX_POLL             |    16   | RX completions per progress()     |
280. | MEMIDS        (optional)  |   ""    | comma-separated explicit shmdev memids (for example `1,2`); when set, obmm queries only these memids instead of scanning all shmdevs. Regardless of whether this knob is set, discovery is fail-fast: any discovered/requested shmdev that is missing, unusable, or yields an invalid export/import topology fails md_open |
281. 
282. `BW` is a UCP-facing estimate, not a wire-format limit. UCP folds it into lane
283. selection and protocol cost modeling, so it should track sustained transport
284. throughput rather than a one-off peak number. Leaving `UCX_OBMM_BW` unset is
285. valid; obmm then uses the built-in default above.
286. 
287. Validation at iface init:
288. - `FIFO_SIZE` > 0, power of 2
289. - `FIFO_ELEM_SIZE` > sizeof(elem_hdr) and `(elem_size - hdr) <= UINT16_MAX`
290. - `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE` > 0 and `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE <= UINT16_MAX`
291. - `slot_count * slot_stride + pool_overhead <= region->length`
292. 
293. ---
294. 
295. ## Future scope (not in v2)
296. 
297. - `am_zcopy`: requires UCT MD memory-handle plumbing (`mem_reg`,
298.   `mkey_pack`, `mem_attach`). Currently obmm has no MD-level
299.   registration — every peer access is via the pre-existing 128 MiB
300.   region. Out of scope until libobmm-aware md is added.
301. - `put_bcopy / get_bcopy`: blocked by the same MD plumbing; UCP RMA
302.   cannot be served by the FIFO-only data path.
303. - Multi-region per node, NUMA-aware slot placement.
304. - Variable-size desc allocator (mm-style mpool) to cover medium-size
305.   messages without burning seg_size per FIFO depth.
306. 
307. ---
308. 
309. ## Receive-side fence ordering (full bus fence at tail release)
310. 
311. `ucs_memory_bus_store_fence()` on aarch64 is `dmb oshst` — store→store
312. only. It does NOT order prior loads against subsequent stores. The
313. receiver's lifetime invariant requires:
314. 
315. ```
316. loads from desc[N]  HAPPENS-BEFORE  store to lane_ctl->tail = N+1
317. ```
318. 
319. Otherwise a sender that observes the new tail can reuse `desc[N]` while the
320. receiver core still has outstanding loads in flight from the old lap's
321. payload. We therefore use `uct_obmm_bus_full_fence()` before the tail store,
322. not only a store-store fence.
323. 
324. Why a local helper rather than adding `ucs_memory_bus_fence()` for all
325. archs in `ucs/arch/`: AGENTS.md restricts changes to
326. `ucx/src/uct/obmm/`. If/when the helper proves useful elsewhere, it can
327. be promoted to ucs/arch — but that is a separate ask.
328. 
329. ## Receive-buffer semantics for AM handler
330. 
331. `invoke_am(..., desc, length, 0)` — the trailing `0` (no
332. `UCT_CB_PARAM_FLAG_DESC`) means the data pointer is valid **only for the
333. duration of the callback**. The handler MUST NOT retain it; UCP knows
334. this contract and copies into its own buffer when persistence is
335. needed.
336. 
337. This is by design: the desc lifetime is bound 1:1 to the FIFO element
338. slot, so as soon as the receiver advances `tail` past N, the sender is
339. free to overwrite `desc[N]` on the next lap. There is no separate desc
340. allocator to support post-callback retention.
341. 
342. If a future need arises to support `UCT_CB_PARAM_FLAG_DESC`-style
343. returnable descriptors (e.g. for AM zcopy or large-message rendezvous
344. without copy), it requires a real per-iface mpool of receive
345. descriptors that the upper layer can hold and release explicitly —
346. mirroring `uct_mm_recv_desc_t`. Out of scope for v2.
347. 
348. ## Verification (no hardware)
349. 
350. Per `.github/skills/ucx-build-verify/SKILL.md`:
351. 
352. 1. Build via `task` agent: `./autogen.sh && ./contrib/configure-devel
353.    && make -j && make install`.
354. 2. `ucx_info -d -t obmm` → confirm `am_short` and `am_bcopy` lines:
355.    `max_short` should report 16432 raw bytes and `max_bcopy` should reflect
356.    raw `seg_size` (default 32768).
357. 3. `ucx_info -c | grep OBMM` → confirm `FIFO_SIZE=1` default and
358.    `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE` entry.
359. 4. `nm -D libuct.so | grep uct_obmm_ep_am_bcopy` → exists.
360. 5. Hardware-required checks (cross-node MPI, sweep sizes through
````

43. /* Per-shard FIFO control. Multiple senders CAS-reserve head; the local
44.  * receiver alone advances tail. receiver_generation records which slot
45.  * generation initialized this shard layout. */
46. typedef struct uct_obmm_fifo_ctl {
47.     /* 1st cacheline: sender-touched */
48.     volatile uint64_t head;
49.     UCS_CACHELINE_PADDING(uint64_t);
50.

53.     volatile uint32_t receiver_generation;

62.  * that flips every ring wrap. */
63. typedef struct uct_obmm_fifo_element {

68.                              elements whose generation doesn't match its local
69.                              iface generation */
70.     uint64_t header;      /* am_short 64-bit header */
71.     /* payload[length] follows here */

76. uct_obmm_atomic_cswap64(volatile uint64_t *ptr, uint64_t oldval,
77.                         uint64_t newval)
78. {
79. #if defined(__aarch64__)
80.     uint64_t observed = oldval;
81. 
82.     __asm__ __volatile__(
83.             ".arch_extension lse\n\t"
84.             "casal %x[observed], %x[newval], [%[ptr]]"
85.             : [observed] "+&r"(observed)
86.             : [newval] "r"(newval), [ptr] "r"(ptr)
87.             : "memory");
88.     return observed;
89. #else
90.     return __sync_val_compare_and_swap(ptr, oldval, newval);
91. #endif
92. }

237. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE unsigned
238. uct_obmm_iface_progress_shard(uct_obmm_iface_t *iface, uct_obmm_rx_shard_t *shard)
239. {
240.     uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem;
241. 
242.     if (shard->ctl == NULL) {
243.         return 0;
244.     }
245. 
246.     elem = uct_obmm_shard_elem(shard->elems, shard->rx_index, iface->fifo_mask,
247.                                iface->fifo_elem_size);
248.     if (!uct_obmm_fifo_elem_is_ready(elem, shard->rx_index, iface->fifo_size)) {
249.         return 0;
250.     }
251. 
252.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
253.     if (elem->generation == iface->generation) {
254.         if (elem->flags & UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_BCOPY) {
255.             void *desc = uct_obmm_shard_desc(shard->descs, shard->rx_index,
256.                                              iface->fifo_mask,
257.                                              iface->bcopy_seg_size);
258.             uct_iface_invoke_am(&iface->super, elem->am_id,
259.                                 desc, elem->length, 0);
260.         } else {
261.             uct_iface_invoke_am(&iface->super, elem->am_id,
262.                                 &elem->header, elem->length, 0);
263.         }
264.     }
265. 
266.     shard->rx_index++;
267.     uct_obmm_bus_full_fence();
268.     shard->ctl->tail = shard->rx_index;
269.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
270.     return 1;
271. }

273. 
274. static unsigned uct_obmm_iface_progress(uct_iface_h tl_iface)
275. {
276.     uct_obmm_iface_t *iface        = ucs_derived_of(tl_iface, uct_obmm_iface_t);
277.     unsigned          polled       = 0;
278.     unsigned          total_shards = UCT_OBMM_FIFO_BANK_COUNT * iface->shard_count;
279.     unsigned          scanned;
280. 
281.     for (scanned = 0; (scanned < total_shards) && (polled < iface->fifo_max_poll);
282.          ++scanned) {
283.         unsigned idx   = (iface->rx_shard_rr + scanned) % total_shards;
284.         unsigned bank  = idx / iface->shard_count;
285.         unsigned shard = idx % iface->shard_count;
286. 
287.         polled += uct_obmm_iface_progress_shard(iface,
288.                                                 &iface->rx_shards[bank][shard]);
289.     }
290. 
291.     iface->rx_shard_rr = (iface->rx_shard_rr + 1) % total_shards;
292. 
293.     ucs_arbiter_dispatch(&iface->arbiter, 1, uct_obmm_ep_process_pending,
294.                          &polled);
295.     return polled;

378.     (void)take_over;
379.     return 1;

### 💬 Copilot

Based on my review of the uncommitted changes, I've identified the following critical issues:

## Issue: Missing head/tail initialization on receiver side
**File:** ucx/src/uct/obmm/base/obmm_iface.c:451-470
**Severity:** Critical
**Problem:** The receiver-side initialization sets `receiver_generation` but never initializes `head` or `tail` fields in the FIFO control structure. After the pool's `memset` zeroes the slot, the iface init sets only `receiver_generation` but leaves `head` and `tail` at zero. However, the memset happens in `uct_obmm_pool_alloc_slot` (pool.c:372) which zeroes the entire slot including the FIFO ctl. The iface then sets `receiver_generation` but never explicitly initializes `head` or `tail`. While they are implicitly zero from memset, relying on implicit zeroing for lockless MPSC queue state is fragile—if the slot is reused or if there's a partial initialization, the receiver could be processing phantom messages or the sender CAS loop could start at the wrong index.

**Evidence:** Code inspection shows:
- Line 466-467: only `receiver_generation` is explicitly set
- Lines 458-465: ctl/elems/descs pointers are set, rx_index is set to 0
- No explicit `ctl-\>head = 0` or `ctl-\>tail = 0` initialization
- Sender in obmm_ep.c reads `ep-\>fifo_ctl-\>head` (line 109) and uses it directly for space check

**Suggested fix:** Add explicit initialization of `head` and `tail` to 0 after setting `receiver_generation`, before the store fence at line 470. This makes the initialization contract explicit and robust against future changes to the pool allocation path.

---

## Issue: TOCTOU race in send path space check
**File:** ucx/src/uct/obmm/base/obmm_ep.c:109-120
**Severity:** High
**Problem:** The send path reads `head` once at line 109 for the space check, but then uses that same `head` value for the CAS at line 131 (inside `uct_obmm_ep_get_remote_elem`). Between the space check and the CAS, other senders can advance `head`, making the space check stale. If multiple senders race and the FIFO is near-full, a sender could pass the space check at line 110-114, then fail the CAS at line 131, retry with `goto retry` at line 119, but never refresh the `head` value used for the space check, leading to an infinite retry loop if the queue stays full.

**Evidence:** Line 109 loads `head` outside the retry loop. The retry at line 119 does not reload `head` before checking space again on the next iteration (line 109-115). If the queue is full and the CAS fails repeatedly, the sender will keep checking space with the old `head` value.

**Suggested fix:** Move the `head = ep-\>fifo_ctl-\>head;` load inside the retry loop, after the retry label at line 104, so that every retry iteration gets a fresh view of head. Alternatively, reload head after a failed CAS before going to retry.

---

## Issue: Store fence placement before FIFO owner flag publish
**File:** ucx/src/uct/obmm/base/obmm_ep.c:155-156
**Severity:** Medium
**Problem:** The store fence at line 155 (`ucs_memory_bus_store_fence()`) orders payload writes before the flag write at line 156. However, for bcopy, the payload was written into `desc` (line 137-142), not into `elem` itself. The fence only guarantees ordering of stores issued by this CPU before the fence vs. stores after the fence. If the `desc` buffer is in a different cache line or memory region, and if the fence doesn't provide full visibility to remote peers (e.g., on ARM without DMB OSH for device memory), the receiver might see the owner flag flip before the bcopy data is visible.

**Evidence:** Line 135 writes to `desc` (which is `uct_obmm_shard_desc(...)`), line 144-149 writes to `elem`, then line 155 issues a bus_store_fence, then line 156 writes `elem-\>flags`. The fence is `ucs_memory_bus_store_fence()` which may not be as strong as `uct_obmm_bus_full_fence()` (defined in obmm_fifo.h:197-215).

**Suggested fix:** Use `uct_obmm_bus_full_fence()` instead of `ucs_memory_bus_store_fence()` at line 155, to match the receiver's use of the full fence at line 267 (iface.c). This ensures cross-host ordering for both am_short and am_bcopy payloads.

---

## Issue: Receiver-side load fence timing may allow speculative read of elem fields before owner check
**File:** ucx/src/uct/obmm/base/obmm_iface.c:248-253
**Severity:** Medium  
**Problem:** The receiver checks the owner bit at line 248 (`uct_obmm_fifo_elem_is_ready`), then issues a load fence at line 252, then reads `elem-\>generation` at line 253. On weakly-ordered architectures, the CPU might speculatively load `elem-\>generation` before the fence if the owner check passes but the fence hasn't yet executed. If the sender wrote generation after the owner flag (which it does: writes generation at line 147, then flags at line 156), the receiver could read a stale generation value.

**Evidence:** Code flow at lines 246-264 shows owner check -\> fence -\> generation check -\> payload read. The fence at line 252 is after the owner check, but the owner bit read itself doesn't have a load fence before it. If the elem is reused (ring wrap), the receiver might see the new owner bit but the old generation value if the fence timing is off.

**Suggested fix:** Insert `ucs_memory_bus_load_fence()` between line 246 (shard_elem call) and line 248 (is_ready check), so the receiver doesn't speculatively read elem fields until after confirming the cacheline is stable. Alternatively, use a consume-load semantic for the flags field (though C11 consume is broken, so explicit fence is safer).

---

No significant issues found in:
- Wire-format compatibility: layout field correctly prevents cross-version mix
- Shard selection logic: `iface-\>slot_index & (shard_count - 1)` is correct for power-of-2 sharding
- Generation validation: ep_create checks both slot meta generation and shard ctl receiver_generation
- Geometry validation: ep_create rejects mismatched layout/shard_count/fifo_size/elem_size/seg_size

80. ## Locked-in design decisions (do not change without re-asking)
81. 
82. These were explicitly decided with the project owner during the v1
83. am_short plan review. They override any conflicting suggestion the
84. agent may otherwise default to (notably the mm transport's behavior).
85. 
86. 1. **NC mapping for the data path.** Open shmdev with
87.    `O_RDWR | O_SYNC` and mmap with `MAP_SHARED`. This puts the FIFO
88.    region into a non-cacheable mapping, which:
89.      - bypasses the OBMM cacheable consistency model (writers and
90.        readers from any host coexist),
91.      - removes the need to ever call `obmm_set_ownership` from the
92.        transport.
93. 2. **Cross-node 64-bit FAA/CAS on NC are available only via arm64
94.    LSE instructions.** The hardware team confirmed that the target NC
95.    mapping supports cross-node atomics for arm64 **LSE** atomics, but
96.    not for compiler-default **LL/SC** sequences. A follow-up probe with
97.    explicit LSE instructions confirmed both FAA and CAS are usable on
98.    the target hardware. The current transport baseline nevertheless
99.    remains the sender-owned mailbox design; any future atomic path or
100.    probe must force explicit LSE rather than relying on compiler
101.    builtins.
102. 3. **UCT owns the in-region layout.** The 128 MiB exported region is
103.    zero-filled at platform export time. The transport places its own
104.    header (state / version / slot bitmap / slot_meta / fixed-size
105.    slots) at the start of the region. A two-phase init is used:
106.    `state` transitions UNINIT→INITING (CAS) → fill geometry → bus
107.    fence → store READY. Losers spin on READY then bus-load fence.
108.    Single-magic init is racy (geometry not yet visible) and must
109.    not be used.
110. 4. **Topology**: per node there is exactly 1 export region and 1
111.    import region (the peer node's export). Discovered via
112.    `/sys/devices/obmm/obmm_shmdev*/{export_info,import_info}`.
113.    Reachability and mapping table keys are
114.    `(exporter_dcna, exporter_deid, memid)` from sysfs — NOT memid
115.    alone (collision-prone).
116. 5. **One obmm iface per process** is the current assumption for this
117.    transport baseline.
118. 6. **Self-loopback inside one node** is supported: same-node processes
119.    communicate by both mapping the local export region (the imported
120.    "peer region" entry simply will not exist in the single-node case,
121.    or will equal the local one — handle both).
122. 7. **Wire/layout alignment is 64 bytes.** Keep mailbox lane and element
123.    strides 64-byte aligned unless the user provides new measurements.
124. 8. **Sender-owned mailbox receive must tolerate one-way traffic.**
125.    Collective parent→child traffic may arrive before the receiver has
126.    created a local EP back to the parent, so `iface_progress` must be
127.    able to discover and progress unregistered inbound lanes dynamically.
128. 9. **Slot lifecycle uses generation tokens.** Each slot has
129.    `(owner_pid, owner_starttime, generation, state)` in slot_meta.
130.    `iface_addr` and every FIFO elem carry `generation`; receiver
131.    discards mismatches. Destroy = mark DEAD → bus fence → bump
132.    generation → clear bit. Crash recovery: scan bitmap, validate
133.    `/proc/<pid>/stat starttime`, reclaim. PID alone is insufficient
134.    (PID reuse).
135. 10. **Cross-node memory ordering uses BUS-domain fences.**
136.    `ucs_memory_bus_store_fence()` / `ucs_memory_bus_load_fence()`
137.    (sfence/lfence on x86, `dmb oshst`/`dmb oshld` on arm64). The
138.    CPU-domain fences mm uses (`ucs_memory_cpu_*_fence`) are
139.    inner-shareable only and DO NOT cover cross-host NC visibility.
140. 
141. ## OBMM consistency model — why NC matters
142. 
143. From `obmm/doc/libobmm.md` and `obmm/doc/obmm_set_ownership.md`:
144. 
145. - For **cacheable** OBMM mappings, at any moment all hosts touching a
146.   region must be in one of two states:
147.     a) all hosts are PROT_READ or PROT_NONE, OR
148.     b) exactly one host has writers; all other hosts must be PROT_NONE.
149. - A receive-FIFO model (writer on the sending host, reader on the
150.   receiving host, on the SAME region) violates this: it would require
151.   one host to write while another host reads simultaneously.
152. - Therefore the obmm transport CANNOT use cacheable mappings for the
153.   FIFO region without expensive ownership flips per message.
154. - NC (O_SYNC) mappings are exempt: per the doc, "用户无需关心一致性
155.   模型，所有的用户均具备读写权限". This is why decision (1) above
156.   is mandatory, not optional.
157. 
158. ## Implications for the transport design
159. 
160. These follow from the facts above and should be treated as defaults; ask
161. the user before deviating:
162. 
163. - **Memory registration** (`uct_md_ops_t::mem_reg` / `mem_dereg`) does not
164.   need to call libobmm. The current placeholders
165.   (`uct_md_dummy_mem_reg` / `uct_md_dummy_mem_dereg`) are appropriate
166.   because the buffers used by am_short live inside the pre-imported
167.   peer region, not in arbitrary user buffers.
168. - **Address exchange** uses split device/iface addresses:
169.   - `device_addr` carries `(exporter_dcna, exporter_deid_hi,
170.     exporter_deid_lo)`
171.   - `iface_addr` carries `(slot_index, generation, pid, fifo_size,
172.     fifo_elem_size, bcopy_seg_size)`
173.   Reachability stays keyed on exporter identity; memid filtering belongs
174.   to MD discovery, not to peer matching in the hot path.
175. - **Reachability**: `iface_is_reachable_v2` must validate geometry and
176.   confirm that the MD already has a mapped export/import region for the
177.   peer exporter identity. Do not fall back to same-host-only
178.   reachability checks.
179. - **Progress wiring**: `iface_progress_enable/disable` MUST call
180.   `uct_base_iface_progress_enable_cb(...)` /
181.   `uct_base_iface_progress_disable(...)`. The current
182.   `ucs_empty_function` stubs prevent UCP from ever polling the iface.
183. - **EP_CHECK**: do NOT advertise `UCT_IFACE_FLAG_EP_CHECK` in v1.
184.   The current skeleton sets it but `ep_check` only returns OK; no
185.   cross-node liveness check exists. PID-in-addr is not enough.
186. - **Sender-owned mailbox receive path** must not rely only on local
187.   `ep_create` registration. Keep the ability to progress inbound lanes
188.   that were discovered dynamically from the shared pool, because
189.   collective traffic can be one-way.
190. - **Ownership / `obmm_set_ownership`**: do not call this in the current
191.   NC mailbox transport.
192.

194. 
195. Do not invent answers to any of these. Use the `ask_user` tool:
196. 
197. 1. Whether multiple obmm ifaces per process are expected, or strictly
198.    one peer per local iface (current assumption: 1 iface per process,
199.    pool holds many ifaces from many processes).
200. 2. What the wire `am_id` / header / payload alignment requirements are
201.    on the obmm hardware (e.g. 64 B cache line? 256 B?). Default plan
202.    aligns elements to 64 B; confirm before tuning.
203. 3. ~~Whether NC writes from one host become visible to remote loads
204.    without an explicit fabric-level barrier other than CPU
205.    `dmb`/`mfence`.~~ **RESOLVED in plan-review**: must use bus-domain
206.    fences (`ucs_memory_bus_*_fence`), not CPU-domain. CPU fences are
207.    inner-shareable only and don't reach cross-host NC.

82. ## Current obmm data-path pattern
83. 
84. Reference: `uct_mm_ep_am_short` in `ucx/src/uct/sm/mm/base/mm_ep.c` and the
85. matching `uct_mm_iface_progress` reception loop in
86. `ucx/src/uct/sm/mm/base/mm_iface.c`, but adapt them to the current
87. **sender-owned mailbox** design rather than mm's receiver-owned FIFO.
88. 
89. Conceptual flow on the **sender** side:
90. 
91. 1. Select the outbound lane in the **local sender-owned slot**, keyed by:
92.    - bank (`local` vs `remote`, derived from exporter identity)
93.    - destination slot index
94. 2. Check `(head - cached_tail) < fifo_size`; if full, return
95.    `UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE` so pending can retry later.
96. 3. Pack either:
97.    - `am_short`: `[header | payload]` into the lane element body
98.    - `am_bcopy`: payload into the paired desc entry
99. 4. Fill element metadata (`am_id`, `length`, `generation`, `flags`).
100. 5. Publish by bus-store-fencing the payload/metadata writes, then updating
101.    the lane `head`.
102. 
103. Conceptual flow on the **receiver** side, inside `iface_progress`:
104. 
105. 1. Poll registered inbound lanes round-robin.
106. 2. If a lane has `head != rx_index`, acquire-load the element.
107. 3. Validate receiver generation, then dispatch via
108.    `uct_iface_invoke_am(&iface->super, am_id, data, length, flags)`.
109. 4. Advance `tail` / `tail_generation` with the required full-bus fence.
110. 5. Also handle **unregistered** inbound lanes: one-way traffic such as
111.    collectives may arrive before local `ep_create`, so receive progress
112.    cannot depend exclusively on EP-created lane registration.
113. 
114. For obmm, the mailbox slots live in the pre-mapped export/import regions
115. discovered by the MD; no `obmm_export/import` calls happen at runtime.
116. 
117. ## Helper macros worth knowing
118. 
119. - `UCT_CHECK_AM_ID(am_id)`  — validate AM id at entry of am_short
120. - `UCT_CHECK_LENGTH(length, 0, max_short, "am_short")`
121. - `UCT_TL_EP_STAT_OP(ep, AM, SHORT, length)`
122. - `uct_iface_invoke_am(iface, id, data, len, flags)`
123. - `ucs_derived_of(p, type)`  — downcast
124. - `UCS_CLASS_CALL_SUPER_INIT(super_t, ...)`
125. - `UCS_STATIC_BITMAP_*`, `ucs_arbiter_*`  — pending/queue patterns
126. - `uct_iface_trace_am(...)`               — align obmm AM tracing with UCT
127.

<sub>⏱️ 3845m 49s</sub>

### 💬 Copilot

**已切到新的 128MiB 下 receiver-local sharded atomic FIFO 实现。**  
核心改动是把 sender-owned mailbox 整体换成了 **receiver-owned slot + 2 bank × 8 shard × depth 4** 的 FIFO 布局；发送端改为对 **peer receiver shard** 做 **mm-style head CAS 预留**，并且在 arm64 上强制用 **显式 LSE `casal`**，不再走旧的 shared lock word。接收端现在只轮询**本地 receiver slot** 的 bank/shard 队列，不再依赖 mailbox 的远端 lane 扫描。

同步改了这些面：
- `ucx\src\uct\obmm\base\obmm_fifo.h`：新 FIFO wire/layout、OWNER bit 语义、LSE CAS helper
- `obmm_iface.h/.c`：`layout + shard_count` 地址兼容、local shard init/progress、默认 `SHARD_COUNT=8` / `FIFO_SIZE=4`
- `obmm_ep.h/.c`：EP 绑定到 peer receiver shard，走 shared-head/shared-tail 回压
- `ucx\src\uct\obmm\DESIGN.md`、`AGENTS.md` 和相关 skills：全部改成当前 atomic FIFO 基线

**当前只完成了代码和静态一致性收敛**；这个 Windows 环境里没法做 Linux UCX build / `ucx_info` / 硬件运行确认，所以新架构的真实效果还要到你的目标机上继续看。

### 💬 Copilot

Based on my detailed analysis of the uncommitted changes, I have identified the following critical issue:

## Issue: Race condition in sender's head read before CAS reservation
**File:** ucx/src/uct/obmm/base/obmm_ep.c (in `uct_obmm_ep_am_common_send` function)
**Severity:** High
**Problem:** The sender reads the shared `head` counter with a non-atomic load before performing the CAS reservation. In the MPSC (Multi-Producer Single-Consumer) design where multiple senders compete via CAS on `ep-\>fifo_ctl-\>head`, this plain load can read a stale or partially-written value.

The problematic sequence in the diff is:
```c
retry:
    ...
    head = ep-\>fifo_ctl-\>head;  // ← NON-ATOMIC READ of shared counter
    if (!uct_obmm_fifo_has_space(head, ep-\>cached_tail, ep-\>fifo_size)) {
        ...
    }
    status = uct_obmm_ep_get_remote_elem(ep, head, &elem);  // ← CAS on head
```

**Evidence:** 
1. The `head` field in `uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t` is declared as `volatile uint64_t head` but is accessed with a plain C load, not an atomic operation
2. Multiple EP threads from different senders can target the same receiver shard simultaneously, creating genuine MPSC contention
3. The ARM memory model (which this code targets) does not guarantee that a plain 64-bit load will see the most recent CAS-updated value without proper acquire semantics
4. While the subsequent CAS will catch stale values and retry, using stale `head` for the `has_space` check can cause spurious `NO_RESOURCE` returns even when space exists

**Suggested fix:** Use an atomic load with at least relaxed ordering (or acquire to match the CAS release semantics) when reading `head`:
```c
// On aarch64 with LSE atomics available:
head = __atomic_load_n(&ep-\>fifo_ctl-\>head, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
```
Or wrap it in a UCX atomic helper if one exists. The non-atomic read works on x86 TSO but is not portable to ARM's weaker memory model, especially when the DESIGN.md explicitly states bus-domain NC memory is in use.

---

No other significant issues found in the reviewed changes. The rest of the FIFO redesign (owner-bit publish, receiver progress loop, shard mapping, LSE CAS implementation) appears logically sound based on code inspection alone. Hardware validation is needed to confirm correctness, as noted in the updated skill docs.

300.     uct_mm_fifo_element_t *elem = iface->read_index_elem;
301.     ucs_status_t status;
302.     void *data;
303. 
304.     if (ucs_likely(elem->flags & UCT_MM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_INLINE)) {
305.         /* read short (inline) messages from the FIFO elements */
306.         uct_mm_iface_trace_am(iface, UCT_AM_TRACE_TYPE_RECV, elem->flags,
307.                               elem->am_id, elem + 1, elem->length,
308.                               iface->read_index);
309.         uct_mm_iface_invoke_am(iface, elem->am_id, elem + 1, elem->length, 0);
310.         return;
311.     }
312. 
313.     /* check the memory pool to make sure that there is a new descriptor available */
314.     if (ucs_unlikely(iface->last_recv_desc == NULL)) {
315.         UCT_TL_IFACE_GET_RX_DESC(&iface->super.super, &iface->recv_desc_mp,
316.                                  iface->last_recv_desc, return);
317.     }
318. 
319.     /* read bcopy messages from the receive descriptors */
320.     data = elem->desc_data;
321.     VALGRIND_MAKE_MEM_DEFINED(data, elem->length);
322.     uct_mm_iface_trace_am(iface, UCT_AM_TRACE_TYPE_RECV, elem->flags,
323.                           elem->am_id, data, elem->length, iface->read_index);
324. 
325.     status = uct_mm_iface_invoke_am(iface, elem->am_id, data, elem->length,
326.                                     UCT_CB_PARAM_FLAG_DESC);
327.     if (status != UCS_OK) {
328.         /* assign a new receive descriptor to this FIFO element.*/
329.         uct_mm_assign_desc_to_fifo_elem(iface, elem, 0);
330.         /* the last_recv_desc is in use. get a new descriptor for it */
331.         UCT_TL_IFACE_GET_RX_DESC(&iface->super.super, &iface->recv_desc_mp,
332.                                  iface->last_recv_desc, ucs_debug("recv mpool is empty"));
333.     }
334. }
335. 
336. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE int
337. uct_mm_iface_fifo_has_new_data(uct_mm_iface_t *iface)
338. {
339.     /* check the read_index to see if there is a new item to read
340.      * (checking the owner bit) */
341.     return (((iface->read_index >> iface->fifo_shift) & 1) ==
342.             (iface->read_index_elem->flags & 1));
343. }
344. 
345. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE unsigned
346. uct_mm_iface_poll_fifo(uct_mm_iface_t *iface)
347. {
348.     if (!uct_mm_iface_fifo_has_new_data(iface)) {
349.         return 0;
350.     }
351. 
352.     /* read from read_index_elem */
353.     ucs_memory_cpu_load_fence();
354.     ucs_assert(iface->read_index <=
355.                (iface->recv_fifo_ctl->head & ~UCT_MM_IFACE_FIFO_HEAD_EVENT_ARMED));
356. 
357.     uct_mm_iface_process_recv(iface);
358. 
359.     /* raise the read_index */
360.     iface->read_index++;
361. 
362.     /* the next fifo_element which the read_index points to */
363.     iface->read_index_elem =
364.         UCT_MM_IFACE_GET_FIFO_ELEM(iface, iface->recv_fifo_elems,
365.                                    (iface->read_index & iface->fifo_mask));
366. 
367.     uct_mm_progress_fifo_tail(iface);
368. 
369.     return 1;
370. }

**我已经修掉一个很像根因的初始化错误。**  
新 FIFO 里空 ring 的元素初始 `flags` 全是 `0`，而当前 OWNER/parity 判定会把这解释成“第 0 圈已有数据”，于是接收端在没有真实消息时就提前推进 `tail`。随后发送端看到的就是长期“队列已满”，所以 OSU 只打印 header 后卡住。

我改成了和 mm 一致的初始化语义：**每个 shard 在空队列时先把所有元素的 OWNER bit 置成 not-ready 极性**。这样 `rx_index==0` 时不会误消费空槽，只有真正发送后才会变成 ready。

请先重跑你说的那个**节点内第一个 OSU 用例**。如果还卡，下一步我就直接在 **send reserve / owner publish / recv progress / tail release** 这四个点加一次性限流日志。

183.             Since we calculated min_length by our formula:
184.                 length >= (lane_perf->min_length << SHIFT) / weight

186.             Let's mark "(lane_perf->min_length << SHIFT)" as "M" for simplicity:
187.                 length >= M / weight
188. 
189.             Since weight <= mask + 1, then weight - (mask + 1) <= 0, so we get:
190.                 length >= (M + weight - (mask + 1)) / weight)
191. 
192.             Changing order:
193.                 length >= ((M - mask) + (weight - 1)) / weight)
194. 
195.             The righthand expression is actually rounding up the result of
196.             "M - mask" divided by weight. So if we multiplied the righthand
197.             expression by weight, it would be >= "M - mask".
198.             We can multiply both sides by weight and get:
199.                 length * weight >= "righthand expression" * weight >= M - mask
200.             So:
201.                 length * weight >= M - mask
202. 
203.             Changing order:
204.                 length * weight + mask >= M = lane_perf->min_length << SHIFT
205. 
206.             Shifting right, we get the needed inequality, which means the result
207.             of ucp_proto_multi_scaled_length() will be always greater or equal
208.             to min_length:
209.                 (length * weight + mask) >> SHIFT >= lane_perf->min_length
210.         */
211.         min_length = (lane_perf->min_length << UCP_PROTO_MULTI_WEIGHT_SHIFT) /
212.                      lpriv->weight;
213.         ucs_assert(ucp_proto_multi_scaled_length(lpriv->weight, min_length) >=
214.                    lane_perf->min_length);
215.         perf.min_length = ucs_max(perf.min_length, min_length);
216. 
217.         weight_sum           += lpriv->weight;
218.         min_end_offset       += lane_perf->bandwidth *
219.                                 context->config.ext.min_rndv_chunk_size /
220.                                 min_bandwidth;

### 💬 Copilot

我已经把这个边界算清楚了：**131072 在当前 `max_bcopy=32768` 下会走 `tag eager multi bcopy`，而且不是 4 片，是 5 片。**  
第一片要带 `ucp_eager_first_hdr_t`（24B），后续每片带 `ucp_eager_middle_hdr_t`（16B），所以 `131072` 需要 `1 + 4 = 5` 个 FIFO 槽；我们现在默认 `FIFO_SIZE=4`，很容易把 shard 顶满后静默卡住。我要把同样 128MiB 预算下的默认几何从 **8×4** 调成 **4×8**。

280. ---
281. 
282. ## Configuration knobs
283. 
284. All under `UCX_OBMM_*` prefix.
285. 
286. | knob                     | default | meaning                          |
287. |--------------------------|---------|----------------------------------|
288. | BW                       | 3400MBs | effective transport bandwidth reported to UCP for lane/protocol cost modeling; optional |
289. | SHARD_COUNT              |     8   | receive FIFO shards per bank (power of 2) |
290. | FIFO_SIZE                |     4   | depth per shard (power of 2) |
291. | FIFO_ELEM_SIZE           | 16448   | bytes per FIFO elem (incl. 16B hdr) → raw UCT max_short = 16432 total bytes |
292. | BCOPY_SEG_SIZE           | 32768   | bytes per paired desc → raw UCT max_bcopy |
293. | FIFO_MAX_POLL            |    16   | RX completions per progress()     |

295. 
296. `BW` is a UCP-facing estimate, not a wire-format limit. UCP folds it into lane
297. selection and protocol cost modeling, so it should track sustained transport
298. throughput rather than a one-off peak number. Leaving `UCX_OBMM_BW` unset is
299. valid; obmm then uses the built-in default above.
300. 
301. Validation at iface init:

324. ## Receive-side fence ordering (full bus fence at tail release)

326. `ucs_memory_bus_store_fence()` on aarch64 is `dmb oshst` — store→store

<sub>⏱️ 3989m 23s</sub>

### 💬 Copilot

**我已经把默认几何从 `8×4` 改成了 `4×8`。**  
原因已经基本坐实：`131072` 在当前 `max_bcopy=32768` 下会走 **tag eager multi bcopy**，而且需要 **5 片**，不是 4 片。第一片带 `ucp_eager_first_hdr_t`，后续片带 `ucp_eager_middle_hdr_t`，所以 `FIFO_SIZE=4` 正好会把 shard 顶死。

这次改动保持 **128MiB** 预算不变，只是把总 pair 预算从“更多 shard、较浅队列”改成“更少 shard、更深队列”，更适合这种多片 eager 路径：
- `UCX_OBMM_SHARD_COUNT`: **8 → 4**
- `UCX_OBMM_FIFO_SIZE`: **4 → 8**

我也把设计文档和验证说明一起同步了，并保留了前一轮修掉的空 FIFO owner-bit 初始化错误。

请先重跑你刚才那个 **节点内 `osu_latency`**。如果还卡，我下一步就不再猜了，直接在 **fragment reserve / publish / recv progress / tail release** 四个点加限流定位日志。

42.     /* obmm only does AM (short + bcopy). It does NOT expose remote memory

280. `pool_attach`/`pool_open`; the shared region does not persist a separate pool

283. ---
284. 
285. ## Configuration knobs
286. 
287. All under `UCX_OBMM_*` prefix.
288. 
289. | knob                     | default | meaning                          |
290. |--------------------------|---------|----------------------------------|
291. | BW                       | 3400MBs | effective transport bandwidth reported to UCP for lane/protocol cost modeling; optional |
292. | SHARD_COUNT              |     4   | receive FIFO shards per bank (power of 2) |
293. | FIFO_SIZE                |     8   | depth per shard (power of 2) |
294. | FIFO_ELEM_SIZE           | 16448   | bytes per FIFO elem (incl. 16B hdr) → raw UCT max_short = 16432 total bytes |
295. | BCOPY_SEG_SIZE           | 32768   | bytes per paired desc → raw UCT max_bcopy |
296. | FIFO_MAX_POLL            |    16   | RX completions per progress()     |
297. | MEMIDS       (optional)  |   ""    | comma-separated explicit shmdev memids (for example `1,2`); when set, obmm queries only these memids instead of scanning all shmdevs. Regardless of whether this knob is set, discovery is fail-fast: any discovered/requested shmdev that is missing, unusable, or yields an invalid export/import topology fails md_open |
298. 
299. `BW` is a UCP-facing estimate, not a wire-format limit. UCP folds it into lane
300. selection and protocol cost modeling, so it should track sustained transport
301. throughput rather than a one-off peak number. Leaving `UCX_OBMM_BW` unset is
302. valid; obmm then uses the built-in default above.
303. 
304. Validation at iface init:
305. - `SHARD_COUNT` > 0, power of 2, `<= 32`
306. - `FIFO_SIZE` > 0, power of 2
307. - `FIFO_ELEM_SIZE` > sizeof(elem_hdr) and `(elem_size - hdr) <= UINT16_MAX`
308. - `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE` > 0 and `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE <= UINT16_MAX`
309. - `slot_count * slot_stride + pool_overhead <= region->length`
310. 
311. ---
312. 
313. ## Future scope (not in v2)
314. 
315. - `am_zcopy`: requires UCT MD memory-handle plumbing (`mem_reg`,
316.   `mkey_pack`, `mem_attach`). Currently obmm has no MD-level
317.   registration — every peer access is via the pre-existing 128 MiB
318.   region. Out of scope until libobmm-aware md is added.
319. - `put_bcopy / get_bcopy`: blocked by the same MD plumbing; UCP RMA
320.   cannot be served by the FIFO-only data path.
321. - Multi-region per node, NUMA-aware slot placement.
322. - Variable-size desc allocator (mm-style mpool) to cover medium-size
323.   messages without burning seg_size per FIFO depth.
324. 
325. ---
326.

328. 
329. `ucs_memory_bus_store_fence()` on aarch64 is `dmb oshst` — store→store

160. ## Implications for the transport design
161. 
162. These follow from the facts above and should be treated as defaults; ask
163. the user before deviating:
164. 
165. - **Memory registration** (`uct_md_ops_t::mem_reg` / `mem_dereg`) does not

169.   peer region, not in arbitrary user buffers.
170. - **Address exchange** uses split device/iface addresses:
171.   - `device_addr` carries `(exporter_dcna, exporter_deid_hi,
172.     exporter_deid_lo)`
173.   - `iface_addr` carries `(slot_index, generation, pid, layout,
174.     shard_count, fifo_size, fifo_elem_size, bcopy_seg_size)`
175.   Reachability stays keyed on exporter identity; memid filtering belongs
176.   to MD discovery, not to peer matching in the hot path.
177. - **Reachability**: `iface_is_reachable_v2` must validate geometry and
178.   confirm that the MD already has a mapped export/import region for the
179.   peer exporter identity. Do not fall back to same-host-only
180.   reachability checks.
181. - **Progress wiring**: `iface_progress_enable/disable` MUST call
182.   `uct_base_iface_progress_enable_cb(...)` /
183.   `uct_base_iface_progress_disable(...)`. The current
184.   `ucs_empty_function` stubs prevent UCP from ever polling the iface.
185. - **EP_CHECK**: do NOT advertise `UCT_IFACE_FLAG_EP_CHECK` in v1.
186.   The current skeleton sets it but `ep_check` only returns OK; no
187.   cross-node liveness check exists. PID-in-addr is not enough.
188. - **Receiver-local FIFO progress** must not rely on reverse local
189.   `ep_create()`. One-way collective traffic is served by polling the
190.   receiver-owned local slot directly, not by discovering inbound lanes
191.   from sender-owned remote slots.
192. - **Ownership / `obmm_set_ownership`**: do not call this in the current
193.   NC FIFO transport.
194.
```

</details>

<sub>⏱️ 3991m 55s</sub>

### 💬 Copilot

**可以更开阔，但要分清两件事：真正的 UCT PUT/GET，和“像 PUT/GET 一样”的大消息 bulk 协议。**  
在你现在这套硬件和仓库约束下，**后者可行且值得做，前者暂时不现实**。

1. **真正的 UCT PUT/GET：现在不适合直接做。**  
   现在 `obmm_md.c` 明确把 MD 能力收得很死：只映射了**预先存在的 128MiB transport region**，不是用户任意 buffer，所以不宣称 `NEED_RKEY`，也没有真正的 `mem_reg/mkey_pack/rkey_ptr` 路线；`DESIGN.md` 也已经把 `put_bcopy/get_bcopy` 标成被 MD plumbing 卡住。  
   这意味着你现在不能像标准 RMA 那样，对**任意用户缓冲区**提供 UCX 所期待的 PUT/GET 语义。

2. **大消息不依赖 AM 分片：完全可以，而且我认为这是正确方向。**  
   更合理的是把 **AM/FIFO 退成控制面**，大数据走 **transport-owned bulk window**：  
   - 小消息：继续 `am_short/am_bcopy`  
   - 大消息：走 **RTS/CTS/ATP** 之类的 rendezvous 控制  
   - 真正数据：在预共享 128MiB region 里按 chunk 传

3. **在你这个环境下，我更推荐先做“PUT-like bulk”，不是 GET。**  
   也就是：**receiver-owned bulk buffer + sender push**。  
   原因不是我断言 remote write 一定比 remote read 快，而是它和你现在的 receiver-local FIFO 架构更一致：  
   - receiver 发 credit / buffer descriptor  
   - sender 直接把大块数据写进 receiver 的 bulk slot  
   - receiver 本地看完成标记、做重组  
   这条路能继续保持“**接收完成尽量本地可见**”的优点。  

4. **“GET-like bulk”也能做，但更适合作为第二阶段。**  
   也就是 sender 先把数据放到自己的 staging area，receiver 收到控制消息后去 remote read。  
   这在协议上可行，但会把大消息热路径重新拉回 **remote load/pull**，完成语义和流控也更绕。

**所以我的判断很明确：**  
**大消息后续应该尽快减少对 AM 分片的依赖，但第一步不该是硬上真正的 UCT PUT/GET，而应该是做一个 transport-internal 的 rendezvous bulk path。**  
如果只选一个方向，我会优先做 **receiver-owned bulk buffer 的 sender-push（PUT-like）协议**。

<summary>260 lines</summary>

````
1. # obmm UCT transport — design notes
2. 
3. This file is the **single source of truth** for the on-region wire format
4. and the data-path semantics of the `obmm` UCT transport. Update it
5. **before** changing layout, capabilities, or sync rules. AGENTS.md
6. mandates retrieve-before-recall; this doc is the first thing to grep.
7. 
8. Status legend:
9. - **v1** = shipped, MPI cross-node smoke tests pass.
10. - **v2 mailbox baseline** = the previously validated sender-owned mailbox
11.   transport that passed OSU point-to-point plus collective suites on the
12.   target hardware.
13. - **Current in-tree design** = receiver-local sharded atomic FIFO with
14.   `am_short`, `am_bcopy`, and pending support. Hardware validation is still
15.   pending after this pivot.
16. 
17. ---
18. 
19. ## Locked-in environment facts
20. 
21. (Mirrors `.github/skills/obmm-api-and-env/SKILL.md`. Do NOT contradict
22. without re-checking that file.)
23. 
24. - Each node pre-exports **one 128 MiB region**; export/import is done
25.   outside UCX. UCT must NOT call `obmm_export/import/preimport/...`.
26. - Data-path mapping is **non-cacheable** (`open(... O_SYNC)` + mmap).
27.   `obmm_set_ownership` is forbidden and irrelevant.
28. - Cross-host 64-bit FAA/CAS on the target NC mapping are available only when
29.   emitted as explicit arm64 **LSE** instructions; compiler-default **LL/SC**
30.   atomics are not supported on this NC memory. A follow-up LSE-based probe
31.   confirmed both FAA and CAS are usable. The current FIFO redesign therefore
32.   uses explicit arm64 LSE CAS for shard-head reservation and must not fall
33.   back to compiler-builtins on arm64.
34. - Memory ordering uses **bus-domain fences**
35.   (`ucs_memory_bus_store_fence` / `ucs_memory_bus_load_fence`), NOT the
36.   CPU-domain `ucs_memory_cpu_*_fence` that mm uses. mm peers share an
37.   inner-shareable cache domain; obmm peers do not.
38. - Reachability is keyed on `(exporter_dcna, exporter_deid, memid)`,
39.   never memid alone.
40. - Two-phase pool init (UNINIT → INITING → READY via CAS) plus per-slot
41.   `(generation, owner_pid, owner_starttime)` for crash/PID-reuse safety.
42.   During teardown, INITING is reused only as a transient cleanup lock; after
43.   reset the shared region returns to literal all-zero memory.
44. - ARM64 is the production ISA. NC + bus fences are correct on aarch64.
45. 
46. ---
47. 
48. ## Region layout (v3)
49. 
50. Inside the 128 MiB exported region:
51. 
52. ```
53. +-------------------------------------------------------+ offset 0
54. | uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t (magic, state, geometry)          |
55. +-------------------------------------------------------+
56. | alloc_bitmap[bitmap_words]                            |
57. +-------------------------------------------------------+
58. | slot_meta[slot_count]  (gen, owner_pid, starttime, …) |
59. +-------------------------------------------------------+ hdr->slot_array_offset
60. | slot[0]:                                              |
61. |   bank[local]: shard[0..shard_count-1]                |
62. |   bank[remote]: shard[0..shard_count-1]               |
63. +-------------------------------------------------------+
64. | slot[1]: …                                            |
65. …
66. ```
67. 
68. Each slot is **receiver-owned** by exactly one iface. Inside that slot:
69. 
70. - there are two banks: `local` and `remote`
71. - each bank has `shard_count` FIFO shards
72. - each shard is MPSC / single-consumer:
73.   - multiple senders CAS-reserve `head`
74.   - the slot owner alone advances `tail`
75. 
76. Banking is derived from **sender exporter identity relative to the receiver's
77. local export region**, not from slot index. This avoids local-slot-index and
78. remote-slot-index collisions in the fixed two-node topology.
79. 
80. Every shard element `elem[N]` has a paired `desc[N]` in that same shard. Their
81. lifetime is identical: once the receiver advances `tail` past index `N`, any
82. sender that later reserves that index on the next lap may reuse both.
83. 
84. ### Slot stride
85. 
86. ```
87. shard_stride = align_up(
88.     sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t) +
89.     fifo_size * elem_size +
90.     fifo_size * seg_size,
91.     cacheline)
92. 
93. slot_stride = align_up(
94.     2 * shard_count * shard_stride,
95.     cacheline)
96. ```
97. 
98. The pool's `slot_count` (compile-time `UCT_OBMM_POOL_SLOT_COUNT = 32`)
99. **times** `slot_stride` MUST fit in `region->length` (128 MiB minus pool
100. header overhead). Defaults are chosen to keep the current 16KiB-class short
101. path / 32KiB bcopy path while replacing “many depth-1 lanes” with “fewer,
102. deeper receiver-local queues”.
103. 
104. Default budget check:
105. ```
106. shard_count     =      4
107. fifo_size       =      8
108. elem_size       =  16448   (raw UCT max_short = 16432 total bytes)
109. seg_size        =  32768   (raw UCT max_bcopy = 32768)
110. shard_stride    = 393856
111. ctl + slot data = 8 * 393856 = ~3077 KiB / slot
112. slot_count      =     32
113. total           = ~ 96 MiB / 128 MiB                     ✓
114. ```
115. These defaults are chosen from measured latency sweeps rather than from
116. wire-format arithmetic alone. With Open MPI PML/UCX on this tree, ordinary
117. `MPI_Send` goes through `mca_pml_ucx_send_nbr()` into `ucp_tag_send_nbx()`,
118. and UCX defaults `PROTO_ENABLE=y`, so protocol v2 selects between eager short,
119. eager bcopy single/multi, and rendezvous using its own headers and cost model.
120. The best reasoning-backed configuration found so far is to keep both geometry
121. knobs 64-byte aligned, leave `BCOPY_SEG_SIZE=32768` for 32KiB-class raw bcopy
122. capacity, and reduce `FIFO_ELEM_SIZE` to `16448` so 16KiB-class payloads stay
123. comfortably on short without over-extending the short window into slower
124. 32KiB-class territory. After the first sharded-FIFO runs, defaults were further
125. rebalanced from `8 x 4` to `4 x 8`: `131072`-byte tag eager multi bcopy sends
126. need **5 fragments** with UCX's `first`/`middle` headers, so depth 4 could
127. stall even though the total pair budget still fit in 128 MiB.
128. 
129. When the last local iface on an export exits, UCX resets the entire local
130. export region to zero before another attach may re-initialize the pool.
131. 
132. ---
133. 
134. ## FIFO element layout
135. 
136. `uct_obmm_fifo_element_t` (16 bytes, packed):
137. 
138. | field      | bytes | notes                                          |
139. |------------|-------|------------------------------------------------|
140. | flags      |   1   | OWNER parity bit + BCOPY bit                   |
141. | am_id      |   1   |                                                |
142. | length     |   2   | u16 — bytes passed to the AM callback          |
143. | generation |   4   | receiver-slot generation token at TX time      |
144. | header     |   8   | am_short user-visible 8B header (unused bcopy) |
145. 
146. For **am_short**, callback data starts at `&elem->header`, so the callback sees
147. `[header | payload]` and `elem->length = sizeof(header) + payload_length`.
148. The raw UCT limit remains `max_short = elem_size - 16`.
149. 
150. For **am_bcopy**, payload lives in the paired `desc[N]`. On bcopy the sender
151. writes:
152. - `elem->flags  = BCOPY`
153. - `elem->am_id  = id`
154. - `elem->length = pack_cb_returned_length`     (≤ seg_size, so ≤ u16max)
155. - `elem->generation = ep->expected_generation`
156. - `elem->header = 0` (unused)
157. 
158. Receiver, on seeing FLAG_BCOPY, computes
159. `desc[N] = slot_descs + (idx & mask) * seg_size` and calls
160. `uct_iface_invoke_am(am_id, desc[N], length, 0)`.
161. 
162. Because `desc[N]` is bound 1:1 to `elem[N]`, no extra metadata is
163. exchanged in the FIFO element to locate the desc. Publish is mm-style: sender
164. writes payload/metadata first, then bus-store-fences, then flips the OWNER bit
165. for that absolute ring index.
166. 
167. An empty shard initializes every element with the OWNER bit set, so the initial
168. `rx_index == 0` observes the ring as **not ready** until a sender publishes the
169. first real message with OWNER parity matching that absolute index.
170. 
171. ### `length` field width
172. 
173. `elem->length` stays `uint16_t`, capping `seg_size` at 65535. We reject
174. larger `seg_size` at iface init. If a future `seg_size > 64KiB` is
175. needed, widen `length` to `uint32_t` and update the compatibility checks.
176. 
177. ---
178. 
179. ## Sender side (`obmm_ep`)
180. 
181. Each EP binds to one outbound shard in the **peer receiver-owned slot**:
182. 
183. - slot base = peer `iface_addr.slot_index`
184. - bank = `local` if the peer device address names our export region, otherwise
185.   `remote`
186. - shard = `local_slot_index & (shard_count - 1)`
187. 
188. Both `am_short` and `am_bcopy` publish to that shard identically:
189. 
190. ```
191. 1. if this EP already has queued pending requests: return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE
192.    to preserve order
193. 2. load shard head and cached tail
194. 3. if (head - cached_tail) >= fifo_size:
195.        bus_load_fence; refresh cached tail; recheck;
196.        if still full: return UCS_ERR_NO_RESOURCE
197. 4. reserve with explicit-LSE CAS:
198.        if (CAS(head, head+1) fails) retry from step 2
199. 5. N = head & mask
200. 6. payload write:
201.       short: memcpy header+payload into elem[N]+1
202.       bcopy: pack_cb(desc[N], arg) -> length
203. 7. fill elem[N] metadata (am_id, length, generation, [header], BCOPY flag)
204. 8. ucs_memory_bus_store_fence()                          <- release barrier
205. 9. flip OWNER parity bit in elem[N].flags                <- publish
206. ```
207. 
208. There is no separate shared lock word. The only hot-path cross-node atomic is
209. the shard-head CAS.
210. 
211. ### Pending
212. 
213. `ep_pending_add` queues into the iface arbiter. `iface_progress` dispatches
214. pending on every call so senders blocked on shard capacity make forward
215. progress as soon as the local receiver releases tail.
216. 
217. ---
218. 
219. ## Receiver side (`obmm_iface_progress`)
220. 
221. ```
222. round-robin over local (bank, shard) queues, up to fifo_max_poll completions:
223.     elem = elem[rx_index & mask]
224.     if OWNER parity != expected parity for rx_index:
225.         continue                                             (no work yet)
226.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence()                              (acquire payload)
227.     if elem->generation != iface->generation:
228.         drop silently (slot was reused after our death+rebirth)
229.     elif elem->flags & BCOPY:
230.         desc = desc[rx_index & mask]
231.         invoke_am(am_id, desc,  length, 0)
232.     else:
233.         invoke_am(am_id, &elem->header, length, 0)
234.     rx_index++
235.     full bus fence
236.     shard_ctl->tail = rx_index
237.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence()
238. ```
239. 
240. Because the receive queues are local again, **one-way collectives no longer
241. need dynamic unregistered-lane discovery**. Progress only depends on polling
242. the local receiver slot.
243. 
244. ### Unsupported peer-failure window
245. 
246. If a sender wins the shard-head CAS and dies before publishing the OWNER bit,
247. that shard can stall until peer-failure handling exists. obmm still does not
248. advertise `EP_CHECK` or `ERRHANDLE_PEER`; this is treated as an unsupported
249. peer-failure case rather than a supported recovery path.
250. 
251. ---
252. 
253. ## Capabilities (`iface_query`)
254. 
255. | flag                            | v1 | v2 | notes                       |
256. |---------------------------------|----|----|-----------------------------|
257. | AM_SHORT                        |  ✓ |  ✓ | max = elem_size - 16        |
258. | AM_BCOPY                        |  ✓ |  ✓ | v1: = max_short (cramped); v2: = seg_size |
259. | PENDING                         |  ✓ |  ✓ | iface arbiter, always queued |
260. | CONNECT_TO_IFACE                |  ✓ |  ✓ |                             |
````

</details>

24. #define UCT_OBMM_FIFO_LAYOUT_ATOMIC_SHARDED 2u
25. 
26. /* Every receiver-owned slot contains two banks so sender slot indexes from the
27.  * local host and the remote host cannot collide. */
28. enum {
29.     UCT_OBMM_FIFO_BANK_LOCAL  = 0u,
30.     UCT_OBMM_FIFO_BANK_REMOTE = 1u,
31.     UCT_OBMM_FIFO_BANK_COUNT  = 2u,
32.     UCT_OBMM_MAX_FIFO_SHARDS  = UCT_OBMM_POOL_SLOT_COUNT
33. };
34. 
35. 
36. /* Element flags carried in the shared FIFO element header. */
37. enum {
38.     UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER = UCS_BIT(0),
39.     UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_BCOPY = UCS_BIT(1)
40. };
41. 
42. 
43. /* Per-shard FIFO control. Multiple senders CAS-reserve head; the local
44.  * receiver alone advances tail. receiver_generation records which slot
45.  * generation initialized this shard layout. */
46. typedef struct uct_obmm_fifo_ctl {
47.     /* 1st cacheline: sender-touched */
48.     volatile uint64_t head;
49.     UCS_CACHELINE_PADDING(uint64_t);
50. 
51.     /* 2nd cacheline: receiver-touched */
52.     volatile uint64_t tail;
53.     volatile uint32_t receiver_generation;
54.     uint32_t          reserved;
55.     UCS_CACHELINE_PADDING(uint64_t, uint32_t, uint32_t);
56. } UCS_V_ALIGNED(UCS_SYS_CACHE_LINE_SIZE) uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t;
57. 
58. 
59. /* Shared FIFO element header. For am_short the callback data is
60.  * [header|payload] starting at &elem->header. For am_bcopy the callback data
61.  * lives in the paired desc entry. The owner bit is the mm-style publish bit
62.  * that flips every ring wrap. */
63. typedef struct uct_obmm_fifo_element {
64.     uint8_t  flags;       /* UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_xx */
65.     uint8_t  am_id;       /* active message id */
66.     uint16_t length;      /* bytes passed to the AM callback */
67.     uint32_t generation;  /* receiver-slot generation token; receiver discards
68.                              elements whose generation doesn't match its local
69.                              iface generation */
70.     uint64_t header;      /* am_short 64-bit header */
71.     /* payload[length] follows here */
72. } UCS_S_PACKED uct_obmm_fifo_element_t;
73. 
74. 
75. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE uint64_t
76. uct_obmm_atomic_cswap64(volatile uint64_t *ptr, uint64_t oldval,
77.                         uint64_t newval)
78. {
79. #if defined(__aarch64__)
80.     uint64_t observed = oldval;
81. 
82.     __asm__ __volatile__(
83.             ".arch_extension lse\n\t"
84.             "casal %x[observed], %x[newval], [%[ptr]]"
85.             : [observed] "+&r"(observed)
86.             : [newval] "r"(newval), [ptr] "r"(ptr)
87.             : "memory");
88.     return observed;
89. #else
90.     return __sync_val_compare_and_swap(ptr, oldval, newval);
91. #endif
92. }

95. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE size_t
96. uct_obmm_fifo_shard_stride(unsigned fifo_size, unsigned fifo_elem_size,
97.                            unsigned bcopy_seg_size)
98. {
99.     return ucs_align_up(sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t) +
100.                         ((size_t)fifo_size * fifo_elem_size) +
101.                         ((size_t)fifo_size * bcopy_seg_size),
102.                         UCS_SYS_CACHE_LINE_SIZE);
103. }
104. 
105. 
106. /* Compute slot stride: every slot contains one FIFO shard for every
107.  * (bank, shard-index) pair. Returned as size_t; callers must still validate it
108.  * fits in the uint32_t pool header field. */
109. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE size_t
110. uct_obmm_slot_stride(unsigned shard_count, unsigned fifo_size,
111.                      unsigned fifo_elem_size, unsigned bcopy_seg_size)
112. {
113.     return ucs_align_up((size_t)UCT_OBMM_FIFO_BANK_COUNT * shard_count *
114.                         uct_obmm_fifo_shard_stride(fifo_size, fifo_elem_size,
115.                                                    bcopy_seg_size),
116.                         UCS_SYS_CACHE_LINE_SIZE);
117. }
118. 
119. 
120. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void*
121. uct_obmm_slot_shard(void *slot_base, unsigned bank, unsigned shard_index,
122.                     unsigned shard_count, unsigned fifo_size,
123.                     unsigned fifo_elem_size, unsigned bcopy_seg_size)
124. {
125.     size_t index  = ((size_t)bank * shard_count) + shard_index;
126.     size_t stride = uct_obmm_fifo_shard_stride(fifo_size, fifo_elem_size,
127.                                                bcopy_seg_size);
128. 
129.     return UCS_PTR_BYTE_OFFSET(slot_base, index * stride);
130. }
131. 
132. 
133. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t*
134. uct_obmm_shard_ctl(void *shard_base)
135. {
136.     return (uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t*)shard_base;
137. }
138. 
139. 
140. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void*
141. uct_obmm_shard_elems(void *shard_base)
142. {
143.     return UCS_PTR_BYTE_OFFSET(shard_base, sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t));
144. }
145. 
146. 
147. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void*
148. uct_obmm_shard_descs(void *shard_base, unsigned fifo_size,
149.                      unsigned fifo_elem_size)
150. {
151.     return UCS_PTR_BYTE_OFFSET(shard_base,
152.                                sizeof(uct_obmm_fifo_ctl_t) +
153.                                ((size_t)fifo_size * fifo_elem_size));
154. }
155. 
156. 
157. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE uct_obmm_fifo_element_t*
158. uct_obmm_shard_elem(void *elems, uint64_t index, unsigned mask,
159.                     unsigned elem_size)
160. {
161.     return (uct_obmm_fifo_element_t*)
162.            UCS_PTR_BYTE_OFFSET(elems, (size_t)(index & mask) * elem_size);
163. }
164. 
165. 
166. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void*
167. uct_obmm_shard_desc(void *descs, uint64_t index, unsigned mask,
168.                     unsigned seg_size)
169. {
170.     return UCS_PTR_BYTE_OFFSET(descs, (size_t)(index & mask) * seg_size);
171. }
172. 
173. 
174. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE uint8_t
175. uct_obmm_fifo_owner_bit(uint64_t index, unsigned fifo_size)
176. {
177.     return (index & fifo_size) ? UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER : 0;
178. }
179. 
180. 
181. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE int
182. uct_obmm_fifo_elem_is_ready(const uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem, uint64_t index,
183.                             unsigned fifo_size)
184. {
185.     return ((elem->flags & UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_OWNER) ==
186.             uct_obmm_fifo_owner_bit(index, fifo_size));
187. }
188. 
189. 
190. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE int
191. uct_obmm_fifo_has_space(uint64_t head, uint64_t tail, unsigned fifo_size)
192. {
193.     return (head - tail) < fifo_size;
194. }
195. 
196. 
197. /* Full bus-domain fence: orders ALL prior memory accesses (loads and stores)
198.  * before ALL subsequent memory accesses, in the outer-shareable / device
199.  * domain that includes cross-host obmm peers. */
200. #if defined(__aarch64__)
201. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() __asm__ __volatile__("dmb osh" ::: "memory")
202. #elif defined(__x86_64__) || defined(__i386__)
203. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() __asm__ __volatile__("mfence" ::: "memory")
204. #elif defined(__powerpc64__)
205. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() __asm__ __volatile__("sync" ::: "memory")
206. #elif defined(__riscv) && (__riscv_xlen == 64)
207. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() \
208.     __asm__ __volatile__("fence iorw, iorw" ::: "memory")
209. #else
210. #warning "obmm: no full bus fence for this arch; FIFO tail ordering may be weak"
211. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() do { \
212.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();        \
213.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();       \
214. } while (0)
215. #endif
216. 
217. #endif
218.

71. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE ucs_status_t
72. uct_obmm_ep_get_remote_elem(uct_obmm_ep_t *ep, uint64_t head,

93.                            const void *payload, uct_pack_callback_t pack_cb,
94.                            void *arg)
95. {
96.     uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem;
97.     uint8_t                  elem_flags;
98.     uint64_t                 head;
99.     void                    *desc;
100.     ucs_status_t             status;
101. 
102.     UCT_CHECK_AM_ID(am_id);
103. 
104. retry:
105.     if (!ucs_arbiter_group_is_empty(&ep->arb_group)) {
106.         return uct_obmm_ep_no_resources_handle(ep);
107.     }
108. 
109.     head = ep->fifo_ctl->head;
110.     if (!uct_obmm_fifo_has_space(head, ep->cached_tail, ep->fifo_size)) {
111.         uct_obmm_ep_update_cached_tail(ep);

113.             return uct_obmm_ep_no_resources_handle(ep);

119.         goto retry;
120.     }
121. 
122.     switch (send_op) {
123.     case UCT_OBMM_SEND_AM_SHORT:
124.         elem_flags      = 0;
125.         elem->am_id     = am_id;
126.         elem->length    = (uint16_t)(sizeof(header) + length);
127.         elem->generation = ep->expected_generation;
128.         elem->header    = header;
129.         if (length > 0) {
130.             memcpy(elem + 1, payload, length);
131.         }
132.         UCT_TL_EP_STAT_OP(&ep->super, AM, SHORT, sizeof(header) + length);
133.         break;
134.     case UCT_OBMM_SEND_AM_BCOPY:
135.         desc = uct_obmm_shard_desc(ep->fifo_descs, head, ep->fifo_mask,
136.                                    ep->bcopy_seg_size);
137.         length = pack_cb(desc, arg);
138.         ucs_assertv(length <= ep->bcopy_seg_size,
139.                     "obmm: pack_cb returned %zu > bcopy_seg_size=%u",
140.                     length, ep->bcopy_seg_size);
141.         ucs_assertv(length <= UINT16_MAX,
142.                     "obmm: pack_cb returned %zu > UINT16_MAX", length);
143. 
144.         elem_flags       = UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_BCOPY;
145.         elem->am_id      = am_id;
146.         elem->length     = (uint16_t)length;
147.         elem->generation = ep->expected_generation;
148.         elem->header     = 0;
149.         UCT_TL_EP_STAT_OP(&ep->super, AM, BCOPY, length);
150.         break;
151.     default:
152.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
153.     }
154. 
155.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
156.     elem->flags = elem_flags | uct_obmm_fifo_owner_bit(head, ep->fifo_size);
157. 
158.     switch (send_op) {
159.     case UCT_OBMM_SEND_AM_SHORT:
160.         uct_iface_trace_am(&iface->super, UCT_AM_TRACE_TYPE_SEND, am_id,
161.                            &elem->header, sizeof(header) + length,
162.                            "TX: AM_SHORT");
163.         return UCS_OK;
164.     case UCT_OBMM_SEND_AM_BCOPY:
165.         uct_iface_trace_am(&iface->super, UCT_AM_TRACE_TYPE_SEND, am_id,
166.                            desc, length, "TX: AM_BCOPY");
167.         return (ssize_t)length;
168.     default:
169.         return UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
170.     }

319. int uct_obmm_ep_is_connected(const uct_ep_h tl_ep,
320.                              const uct_ep_is_connected_params_t *params)
321. {
322.     const uct_obmm_ep_t          *ep = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep, uct_obmm_ep_t);
323.     const uct_obmm_device_addr_t *daddr;
324.     const uct_obmm_iface_addr_t  *iaddr;
325. 
326.     if (!uct_base_ep_is_connected(tl_ep, params)) {
327.         return 0;
328.     }
329. 
330.     daddr = (const uct_obmm_device_addr_t*)params->device_addr;
331.     iaddr = (const uct_obmm_iface_addr_t*)params->iface_addr;
332.     if ((daddr == NULL) || (iaddr == NULL)) {
333.         return 0;
334.     }
335. 
336.     return (daddr->exporter_dcna == ep->peer_dcna) &&
337.            (daddr->exporter_deid_hi == ep->peer_deid_hi) &&
338.            (daddr->exporter_deid_lo == ep->peer_deid_lo) &&
339.            (iaddr->slot_index == ep->peer_slot_index) &&
340.            (iaddr->generation == ep->expected_generation) &&
341.            (iaddr->layout == UCT_OBMM_FIFO_LAYOUT_ATOMIC_SHARDED) &&
342.            (iaddr->shard_count == ep->shard_count);
343. }

380.     uct_obmm_iface_t *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep->iface, uct_obmm_iface_t);
381. 
382.     (void)flags;
383. 
384.     UCS_STATIC_ASSERT(sizeof(uct_pending_req_priv_arb_t) <=
385.                       UCT_PENDING_REQ_PRIV_LEN);
386.     uct_pending_req_arb_group_push(&ep->arb_group, n);

388.     UCT_TL_EP_STAT_PEND(&ep->super);

393. ucs_arbiter_cb_result_t
394. uct_obmm_ep_process_pending(ucs_arbiter_t *arbiter, ucs_arbiter_group_t *group,
395.                             ucs_arbiter_elem_t *elem, void *arg)
396. {
397.     uct_obmm_ep_t     *ep    = ucs_container_of(group, uct_obmm_ep_t, arb_group);
398.     unsigned          *count = (unsigned*)arg;
399.     uct_pending_req_t *req;
400.     ucs_status_t       status;
401. 
402.     uct_obmm_ep_update_cached_tail(ep);
403.     if (!uct_obmm_ep_has_tx_resource(ep)) {
404.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_RESCHED_GROUP;
405.     }
406. 
407.     req    = ucs_container_of(elem, uct_pending_req_t, priv);
408.     status = req->func(req);
409. 
410.     if (status == UCS_OK) {
411.         ++(*count);
412.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_REMOVE_ELEM;
413.     } else if (status == UCS_INPROGRESS) {
414.         ++(*count);
415.         return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_NEXT_GROUP;
416.     }
417. 
418.     return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_RESCHED_GROUP;
419. }

424.     void                        *arg;
425. } uct_obmm_purge_args_t;

427. 
428. static ucs_arbiter_cb_result_t
429. uct_obmm_ep_arbiter_purge_cb(ucs_arbiter_t *arbiter, ucs_arbiter_group_t *group,
430.                              ucs_arbiter_elem_t *elem, void *arg)
431. {
432.     uct_obmm_ep_t         *ep   = ucs_container_of(group, uct_obmm_ep_t,
433.                                                    arb_group);
434.     uct_obmm_purge_args_t *args = arg;
435.     uct_pending_req_t     *req;
436. 
437.     req = ucs_container_of(elem, uct_pending_req_t, priv);
438.     if (args->cb != NULL) {
439.         args->cb(req, args->arg);
440.     } else {
441.         ucs_warn("obmm: ep=%p canceling pending request %p", ep, req);
442.     }
443.     return UCS_ARBITER_CB_RESULT_REMOVE_ELEM;
444. }
445. 
446. 
447. void uct_obmm_ep_pending_purge(uct_ep_h tl_ep,
448.                                uct_pending_purge_callback_t cb, void *arg)
449. {
450.     uct_obmm_ep_t         *ep    = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep, uct_obmm_ep_t);
451.     uct_obmm_iface_t      *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_ep->iface,
452.                                                   uct_obmm_iface_t);
453.     uct_obmm_purge_args_t  args  = {cb, arg};
454. 
455.     ucs_arbiter_group_purge(&iface->arbiter, &ep->arb_group,
456.                             uct_obmm_ep_arbiter_purge_cb, &args);
457. }

279.     unsigned          scanned;

35. /* In-region pool header. Lives at offset 0 of the local export region. All
36.  * fields are written via non-cacheable mappings: state transitions must be
37.  * paired with ucs_memory_bus_store_fence so peers (potentially on another
38.  * host) see the geometry before the READY transition. During cleanup, INITING
39.  * is only a transient coordination state; once reset completes, the shared
40.  * region is fully zero again. */
41. typedef struct uct_obmm_pool_hdr {
42.     uint64_t magic;             /* UCT_OBMM_POOL_MAGIC */
43.     uint32_t state;             /* UCT_OBMM_POOL_STATE_xx, atomic */
44.     uint32_t slot_count;
45.     uint32_t slot_size;
46.     uint64_t slot_array_offset; /* offset (from region base) of slot 0 */
47.     uint32_t bitmap_words;      /* number of u64 words in alloc bitmap */
48.     uint32_t initializer_pid;   /* pid that owned the INITING transition */
49.     uint64_t initializer_starttime;
50.     /* followed by:
51.      *   uint64_t alloc_bitmap[bitmap_words];
52.      *   uct_obmm_slot_meta_t slot_meta[slot_count];
53.      */
54. } uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t;
55. 
56. 
57. /* Per-slot ownership metadata. Stored adjacent to the bitmap, separate from
58.  * the slot's actual FIFO contents. */
59. typedef struct uct_obmm_slot_meta {
60.     uint32_t state;            /* UCT_OBMM_SLOT_STATE_xx */
61.     uint32_t generation;       /* monotonically increasing; bumped on free,
62.                                   scavenge, and when readers must discard
63.                                   in-flight stale elements */
64.     uint32_t owner_pid;
65.     uint32_t reserved;
66.     uint64_t owner_starttime;  /* /proc/<pid>/stat field 22, for liveness */
67. } uct_obmm_slot_meta_t;
68. 
69. 
70. /* Convenience accessor populated by uct_obmm_pool_attach. Pointers point
71.  * into the mapped region; nothing is owned by this struct. */
72. typedef struct uct_obmm_pool {
73.     void                  *base;     /* region base (pool hdr) */
74.     size_t                 length;   /* mapped region size */
75.     uct_obmm_pool_hdr_t   *hdr;
76.     volatile uint64_t     *bitmap;
77.     uct_obmm_slot_meta_t  *meta;
78.     void                  *slots;    /* base + hdr->slot_array_offset */
79.     uint32_t               slot_count;
80.     uint32_t               slot_size;
81. } uct_obmm_pool_t;

90.  * attach to an existing valid pool. Cross-process safe: races between

93.  *
94.  * If an existing pool's geometry doesn't match the requested
95.  * (slot_count, slot_size), returns UCS_ERR_INVALID_PARAM.
96.  */
97. ucs_status_t uct_obmm_pool_attach(void *region_base, size_t region_size,
98.                                   uint32_t slot_count, uint32_t slot_size,
99.                                   uct_obmm_pool_t *pool);

113.     return ucs_align_up((size_t)UCT_OBMM_FIFO_BANK_COUNT * shard_count *
114.                         uct_obmm_fifo_shard_stride(fifo_size, fifo_elem_size,
115.                                                    bcopy_seg_size),
116.                         UCS_SYS_CACHE_LINE_SIZE);
117. }

120. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE void*
121. uct_obmm_slot_shard(void *slot_base, unsigned bank, unsigned shard_index,
122.                     unsigned shard_count, unsigned fifo_size,
123.                     unsigned fifo_elem_size, unsigned bcopy_seg_size)
124. {
125.     size_t index  = ((size_t)bank * shard_count) + shard_index;
126.     size_t stride = uct_obmm_fifo_shard_stride(fifo_size, fifo_elem_size,
127.                                                bcopy_seg_size);
128. 
129.     return UCS_PTR_BYTE_OFFSET(slot_base, index * stride);
130. }

175. uct_obmm_fifo_owner_bit(uint64_t index, unsigned fifo_size)

183.                             unsigned fifo_size)

191. uct_obmm_fifo_has_space(uint64_t head, uint64_t tail, unsigned fifo_size)

197. /* Full bus-domain fence: orders ALL prior memory accesses (loads and stores)
198.  * before ALL subsequent memory accesses, in the outer-shareable / device
199.  * domain that includes cross-host obmm peers. */
200. #if defined(__aarch64__)
201. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() __asm__ __volatile__("dmb osh" ::: "memory")
202. #elif defined(__x86_64__) || defined(__i386__)
203. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() __asm__ __volatile__("mfence" ::: "memory")
204. #elif defined(__powerpc64__)
205. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() __asm__ __volatile__("sync" ::: "memory")
206. #elif defined(__riscv) && (__riscv_xlen == 64)
207. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() \
208.     __asm__ __volatile__("fence iorw, iorw" ::: "memory")
209. #else
210. #warning "obmm: no full bus fence for this arch; FIFO tail ordering may be weak"
211. #define uct_obmm_bus_full_fence() do { \
212.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();        \
213.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();       \
214. } while (0)
215. #endif
216. 
217. #endif
218.

169. static int
170. uct_obmm_iface_is_reachable_v2(const uct_iface_h tl_iface,
171.                                const uct_iface_is_reachable_params_t *params)
172. {
173.     uct_obmm_iface_t             *iface = ucs_derived_of(tl_iface,
174.                                                          uct_obmm_iface_t);
175.     uct_obmm_md_t                *md    = ucs_derived_of(iface->super.md,
176.                                                          uct_obmm_md_t);
177.     const uct_obmm_device_addr_t *daddr;
178.     const uct_obmm_iface_addr_t  *iaddr;
179.     uct_obmm_eid_t                eid;
180.     uct_obmm_region_t            *export_r;
181. 
182.     if (!uct_iface_is_reachable_params_addrs_valid(params)) {
183.         return 0;
184.     }
185. 
186.     daddr = (const uct_obmm_device_addr_t*)params->device_addr;
187.     iaddr = (const uct_obmm_iface_addr_t*)params->iface_addr;
188.     if ((daddr == NULL) || (iaddr == NULL)) {
189.         uct_iface_fill_info_str_buf(params, "missing device or iface address");
190.         return 0;
191.     }
192. 
193.     if ((iaddr->layout != UCT_OBMM_FIFO_LAYOUT_ATOMIC_SHARDED) ||
194.         (iaddr->shard_count != iface->shard_count) ||
195.         (iaddr->fifo_size != iface->fifo_size) ||
196.         (iaddr->fifo_elem_size != iface->fifo_elem_size) ||
197.         (iaddr->bcopy_seg_size != iface->bcopy_seg_size)) {
198.         uct_iface_fill_info_str_buf(params,
199.                                     "incompatible OBMM layout "
200.                                     "(peer layout=%u shards=%u fifo=%u elem=%u "
201.                                     "seg=%u, local layout=%u shards=%u fifo=%u "
202.                                     "elem=%u seg=%u)",
203.                                     iaddr->layout, iaddr->shard_count,
204.                                     iaddr->fifo_size, iaddr->fifo_elem_size,
205.                                     iaddr->bcopy_seg_size,
206.                                     UCT_OBMM_FIFO_LAYOUT_ATOMIC_SHARDED,
207.                                     iface->shard_count, iface->fifo_size,
208.                                     iface->fifo_elem_size,
209.                                     iface->bcopy_seg_size);
210.         return 0;
211.     }
212. 
213.     eid.hi = daddr->exporter_deid_hi;
214.     eid.lo = daddr->exporter_deid_lo;
215. 
216.     export_r = uct_obmm_md_export_region(md);
217.     if ((export_r != NULL) &&
218.         (export_r->info.exporter_dcna == daddr->exporter_dcna) &&
219.         (export_r->info.exporter_deid.hi == eid.hi) &&
220.         (export_r->info.exporter_deid.lo == eid.lo)) {
221.         return uct_iface_scope_is_reachable(tl_iface, params);
222.     }
223. 
224.     if (uct_obmm_md_find_import_region(md, daddr->exporter_dcna, &eid) != NULL) {
225.         return uct_iface_scope_is_reachable(tl_iface, params);
226.     }
227. 
228.     uct_iface_fill_info_str_buf(params,
229.                                 "no mapped region for peer dcna=0x%lx "
230.                                 "deid=0x%lx:0x%lx",
231.                                 (unsigned long)daddr->exporter_dcna,
232.                                 (unsigned long)eid.hi, (unsigned long)eid.lo);
233.     return 0;
234. }

237. static UCS_F_ALWAYS_INLINE unsigned
238. uct_obmm_iface_progress_shard(uct_obmm_iface_t *iface, uct_obmm_rx_shard_t *shard)
239. {
240.     uct_obmm_fifo_element_t *elem;
241. 
242.     if (shard->ctl == NULL) {
243.         return 0;
244.     }
245. 
246.     elem = uct_obmm_shard_elem(shard->elems, shard->rx_index, iface->fifo_mask,
247.                                iface->fifo_elem_size);
248.     if (!uct_obmm_fifo_elem_is_ready(elem, shard->rx_index, iface->fifo_size)) {
249.         return 0;
250.     }
251. 
252.     ucs_memory_bus_load_fence();
253.     if (elem->generation == iface->generation) {
254.         if (elem->flags & UCT_OBMM_FIFO_ELEM_FLAG_BCOPY) {
255.             void *desc = uct_obmm_shard_desc(shard->descs, shard->rx_index,
256.                                              iface->fifo_mask,
257.                                              iface->bcopy_seg_size);
258.             uct_iface_invoke_am(&iface->super, elem->am_id,
259.                                 desc, elem->length, 0);
260.         } else {
261.             uct_iface_invoke_am(&iface->super, elem->am_id,
262.                                 &elem->header, elem->length, 0);
263.         }
264.     }
265. 
266.     shard->rx_index++;
267.     uct_obmm_bus_full_fence();
268.     shard->ctl->tail = shard->rx_index;
269.     ucs_memory_bus_store_fence();
270.     return 1;
271. }
272. 
273. 
274. static unsigned uct_obmm_iface_progress(uct_iface_h tl_iface)
275. {
276.     uct_obmm_iface_t *iface        = ucs_derived_of(tl_iface, uct_obmm_iface_t);
277.     unsigned          polled       = 0;
278.     unsigned          total_shards = UCT_OBMM_FIFO_BANK_COUNT * iface->shard_count;
279.     unsigned          scanned;
280. 
281.     for (scanned = 0; (scanned < total_shards) && (polled < iface->fifo_max_poll);
282.          ++scanned) {
283.         unsigned idx   = (iface->rx_shard_rr + scanned) % total_shards;
284.         unsigned bank  = idx / iface->shard_count;
285.         unsigned shard = idx % iface->shard_count;
286. 
287.         polled += uct_obmm_iface_progress_shard(iface,
288.                                                 &iface->rx_shards[bank][shard]);
289.     }
290. 
291.     iface->rx_shard_rr = (iface->rx_shard_rr + 1) % total_shards;
292. 
293.     ucs_arbiter_dispatch(&iface->arbiter, 1, uct_obmm_ep_process_pending,
294.                          &polled);
295.     return polled;
296. }
